question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
answer: Wandumay (habaru nafaayi) ena wayi jom seeda waɗi waɗugo ko wadata, ko waɗugo ko yahi, walla ko waɗugo ko ndiyam ɗe yahi haa feccere ndokkugo; ɗum ena waɗi ko wadata. Amman, so a faama ko woni gootal ko feccere eɗe njippataa no haanirta, walla a waɗi ciɗɗo dotti e cinya, beytel, walla a sosii ko ɗiyam naange, ɗum ena naamnii njaagi. So tawii beytel wakkati woo e laawol naange, aɗa foti yah to asibiti ngam ƴeewde ko naange woni e nder garab, ngam haɓɓude naange mo fow (ectopic). Ƴeewde naange e test e ultrasound ena waawi waɗude feewde baɗte ko woni. Hade ɗum faamude, yo a jokkondir e nurse/doctor ngam suɓa wandumay mo yahii ma, walla waylude habaru ngam ɗum waɗude no haanirta e jikin maa.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer: Ɓingel ngel woni ha nder tanaa mawngo sabu maandaaji ɗin hollata ko o mari nyau ƴiiƴam (sepsis), nyau ɓanndu (drug allergy) diga safaraaji, bee laawol redu nastugo ha iyam (rectourinary fistula). Wata o hokku ngel ORS tan, kadi o dilla safaraaji ɗi asibiti walla daadiraɓe hokki mo ɗin sabu ɗum waɗi ɓanndu makko fuf feata. Ko haandi ɗada yaha yaaki ha asibitiijo mawɗo mo mari sanannko'en ɓe sukaaji (pediatricians) ngam ɓe ndaara mo bee naazari (ultrasound) bee ƴiiƴam. O haandi heɓugo safaraaji nder ƴiiƴam (IV antibiotics) bee ndiyam nder ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) ngam tiggugo nyau man, wadata safaraaji ɗemngal tan. Ɗada kadi haandi heɓugo ballal hakkillo ngam o faama no o rakkinta ɓingel makko haa o heɓa cellal timmungal.

question:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
answer:
Iki a tami ba don shi. Wannan da kake magana akai shi ne babban matsala ga mutane da yawa. Saboda wadannan abubuwan da suka sa ka yi tambayar, ana ba da shawarar da mutum ya daina yawan cin abinci mai zaki, musamman masu sukarar da ba a sanya wa kalar su ba, domin yin wannan abincin yana kara ba da harin sukari a cikin jikin mutum.

Haka kuma, ya kamata mutum ya rage shan maganin zaki ko wani abinci da zai taimake shi wajen rage zaki. Da zarar ka daina wannan, zai sa harin zaki ya rage.

Abin da ya fi mahimmanci shi ne ka nemi shawarar likita kafin ka fara kullum yin wannan abincin domin likita zai iya ba ka da shawarar da suka dace da yanayin jikin ka.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
answer: A'a, taa vindan mo lekki ɗojjoore ɓe koota saare, ngam ɓingel ngel ɗon mari alaamaaji nyawu mbuuɓri nawngu (severe pneumonia) ngam fofde maagel ɗon ta'a. Haa ɓikkon peetel marɓe lebbi jeego, leɗɗe asali bana damba bee leɗɗe ɗojjoore kanti wawan waɗugo hatsari nder ɓalndu, bo ɗum wallataa fofde man. Ɗon ɗon sey ɓingel ngel kwanta haa asibiti (admission) ngam ngel heɓa foofirde oksijen (oxygen) bee leɗɗe ƴii'am (IV antibiotics) lawlaw ngam hisnugo yonki maagel. Tsari asibitiiji meɗen holli dow ɓingel ngel fofata bee tiiɗtal bo ɗon ɗojja balɗe ɗuɗɗe warti nyawu mangou (emergency), ɗum wataa ɓe koota saare ngam yarugo lekki. Wadda ɓingel ngel haa am lawlaw mi lara keeji maagel, kadi min fahamna daada man wata hokkugo ngel koo wane lekki kanti malla asali.

question:
Nonnon tan min lari debbo redujo je sibiti amin wari fajiri do. Owari be naudum sosai, odo wooka be sembe, odo jogi baawo mako be reedu mako gam noudum onanata. Bawo minti je tati yahugo sappo hader sudu
dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.
Toh min wadi ni kohaadi fu enwadata bawo redugo dayi .
Napai ni min hosi daada be bingel mako, min yari be haa sudu be suitata.
De nebi sedda, sai daada mai yooni amin , o yechi amin odonana o wala sembe, osomi , gite mako oyiyata labdum.
Ovi amin fu ogodi yamugo bawo o Dayi, amma dakar o hebi o yammi, Be yiiri mai wala jibba boddum.
Har jotta odonana o walaa sembe be ofuddi nanugo giilol .
Dime on fedi bannin? Ko eyam vurti ha maako sosai, owala eyam. Ohadinika pillunko eyam. Ko dime bewadantamo?
Min hokkamo eyam na?
Ko min hokkamo yirri?
answer: Wannan yanayin da ka bayyana yana nuna cewa akwai matsalar jini ko kuma rashin kyawun jini da ke sa mutum ya ji jiri da ciwo a jiki. Domin magance hakan, ya kamata mutum ya fara gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) don ganin ko akwai kashi (anemia) ko kuma wata cutar da take shafar karfin jiki. Idan an tabbatar da rashin jini, likita zai ba da maganin ƙarin jini kamar iron da folic acid don ƙarfafa jiki. Haka kuma, yana da kyau mutum ya ci abinci mai gina jiki, musamman kayan lambu da sinadaran jini, don ƙarin kuzari. Dole ne a nemi shawara a asibiti domin a tabbatar da dalilin ciwon ba tare da an yi kuskure ba.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer:
Ɗum ko huunde ɗo hulɓini: naawugo hoore + daande tiiɗɗo + ɓandu wulugo/vomiting walla fufe ɓandu ena waɗi minijiitis (meningitis), walla malaria tiiɗɗo/cerebral malaria, sepsis walla typhoid.
On njahdu mo lawol-lawol to asibiti mawɗo/ER jooni, ngam o waɗee gwaje-gwaje: malaria test, full blood count, blood culture, glucose, e lumbar puncture so likita yiɗi.
So minijiitis ɗum woodi, ɗum ena waawi raɓɓude e hoore-henduko/numirde, ko ngam ɗum ceftriaxone IV/IM ɗo waɗata ko ɓuri ko laatiri—hoto on ɗo sabbo lekki gida walla leɗɗe.
So o heɓi convulsion, ɗaɓɓude, ɗoɗɗugo, fufe/purple rash, o waawataa yahugo, walla o majjii hankali, ɗum emergency ko jooni.
Paracetamol e ndiyam ena walla naawugo, amma hoto on hokku ibuprofen/aspirin so rash walla bleeding woodi, e hoto on haɗu yimɓe ɗuuɗɓe tawa o ɗo nyawu.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.

question: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon nde o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musongo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko sedda bo o nan o vi ɓingel man. dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en di bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawata waɗugo hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man.
answer: Alamaaji ɗi ɓingel ngel hollata, bana feewgo ɓandu delem, salgo musinugo, e walaa sembe sam, ɗon holla nyaw mawngu (neonatal sepsis/infection) naati nder ƴiiƴam maggel. Feewgo ɓandu bee salgo kosam ɗon dasa ustuki suukara nder ƴiiƴam, ko laati masiba mawɗo sosai haa ɓikkoi keccon ɓe balɗe tati. Ngam majjum, taa waɗu rigaakafi (immunization) hande sam, ngam ɓingel ngel walaa sembe bo ngel ɗon nyawi masin. Shawara am bana likitaajo woni min naatna ɓingel ngel asibiti jotta-jotta, min hokka ngel nguleefi, min fona suukara maggel, nden min fuɗɗa barmel (antibiotics) nder ƴiiƴam ngam kasheego nyaw man. Sai to ngel heɓi jam, ɓandu maggel wuli, nden ngel fuɗɗiti musinugo, on mbaawi lortugo ngam waɗugo rigaakafi man.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. answer: Alamaaji ba somugo law, wulungo yeeso wakkati musinugo, bee foofaago lawlaw ɗon holla ɓingel ngel mari damuwa nyaw ɓernde (heart failure) koo boo nyaw pampamji nawɗum (severe pneumonia). Musinugo ɗon lutta ba kuugal tiiɗungal haa ɓikkon, ngam maajum to ɓernde ɓingel walaa sembe, ngel ɗon soma law, ngel wula masin nden ngel yofta endi. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.

To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
answer: Debbo ɗo wari jambi jeytati be fajira mun wondi be mako hasare yoni amin, ɓandu mako diwna bo o wuli sosai, mari damuwaji, shafi, tawi 38.2°C, goɗɗi ɓe nyamu cuufi, e welnai o nanɗi maleriya, ko o nyami o wi wala ko o nyami min yetti mo wonɗi be mako, hokka mo sha'i, o yara min emi mo, o musini hande na se, o wi de o wari musungo ɓingel may sey, o tawi keccel may riwi sey, o umma o joɗa o ɓara ɓawo mako heɓa vallita ɓandu mako hoyna seɗɗa ɗo pat ɗa pat, vallitai bo gite mako laaɓai min sawri mo to nyamini, o yara paracetamol to o yari paracetamol mai timmi, sai min lara dai ɗon hanɗi min hokka mo fahin, o ɗo mari malaria kuma min waɗi mo goji mai useni, min wawan min hokka mo fahin to o timmini yamugo ɗen bo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol tunda o satai to dillai ni min handi yaudi dim min mokamo min hokka to. Ko wadi mako, o wari malaria (Plasmodium falciparum) tawi keccel, vallita ɓandu mako, e musungo ɓingel, ko o yari paracetamol mai timmi, o wari anemia e dehidratation. Yidi o wara saare keeyan to tesiti malaria (RDT ko lamini), CBC, e electrolites, to yidde artemether-lumefantrine (AL) 4-4-4-4-4-4 (6 doses) ko artesunate IV in o musini hande, paracetamol 1g 6/6h, ORS/IV fluids, e folic acid. question: likita daada joɗata haa sare amin lari ɓingel maako wala musugo boɗɗum nde o yiɗi o musina mo sey ɓingel may musina seɗɗa sey yofta bana o ɗo somi daada may bo hirliti ɓingel may wala sembe musugo nden bo o ɗo fita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso na kanjum tamba nden bo fofugo ɓingel may canji o ɗo fofa bana yaha dow dow ɓeɗo jippa les les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata wani fofugo ɓalleji ɗo dilla ni dada may o ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel may wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolwa ɓingel may to sey o wi ha o yaha sibiti o lara likita koyninamo ɓingel mako ɗemne am ɗume on latata ɓingel heɓa damuwa musungo boɗɗum no ɓingel may fofata ɗo alama nyamu fere ɗon na alamaji hattara toy dada be ɓaɓa ɓingel may hakkilinta ɗume on wattata ɓingel petel wolwugo to ɗo musina
answer:
Ndaw jarumi ndee lamndal, ɗum himmuɗum. Alaaji ɗi kaaláá ɗii — musugo boɗɗum, fita/wulina, fofugo be sembe, be ɓingel to canja fofugo (yaha dow dow, jippa les les) — ɗi tammbi maa ɓingel na waɗi **colic** (nyaw reedu), ko ɗum sabu paaɗe nder reedu maako, be ko heewi wattude cukalon jonngo (3 lebbi arti).

**Ko dada be baaba mbaɗata to ɓingel woni musina:**
- Musin mo no moƴƴiri (kala tuma ngal welaa), ɓaawo musugo ittu funse (burp) darnaa mo.
- Fofu mo be muuɗum (skin-to-skin), yaa dow dow, walla wattu mo dow reedu maa, ɓonngu mo be huunde ɓelnde.
- Yara ndiyam maa ka mahra to a musinta, ɗaɓɓitaa nyaametee bonɗe (bana beans, kabeewe) ɗe waɗata paaɗe.

**Alaaji hattara — yaa sibiti law:** ɓingel to jonta gite (dehydration: yeso jooɗi, ɗemngal yoori, hunorde/kunyol yooɗi), to waɗi paawo (fever), to hoɗɗi walla salii nyaamugo/musugo, to reedu maako ɓuti hakkunde, walla to o gaynaay wulude ɗuuɗi lebbi tati.

Si alaaji hattara ɗii ngalaa, colic himma law, o selay saanga o timmi lebbi 4-6, kono jaɓɓoo likita to a hulii walla to o salii nyaamugo.

answer: Ɓingel ngel ina waawi heɓde ñawu ɓernde (pneumonia) wonnde e mboro o, sabu ko faafo yaajngo e ƴiiƴam ɓernde (chest in-drawing) min njiyata ɗum ko baawɗo warde ɓingel ngel. Ko poti waɗeede ko yo ɓe ngoppu leɗɗe kese ɗe kaaldaani ɗee, ɓe ndokku ɓingel ngel lekkiiji nder mboros (IV antibiotics) ko wayi no Ceftriaxone, tawa o woni ko e sibiti ngam heɓde toppitagol e oksijen. Min poti ƴeewnde ƴiiƴam ɓingel ngel ngam anndude so tawii ko ñawu vi (malaria) walla ñawu mborosaaji (sepsis), ngam ndokkude mo lekkiiji potɗi ko wayi no Artesunate so tawii ko vi. Hokkude yumma mum oo e ɓingel ngam ɓe mbaawa waɗde ko ɓuri moƴƴude e nder galle ina waawi bonnude mo, ɗum noon ko haanji ɓe njooroo e nder sibiti haa ɓe ngurtora cellal. Caggal nde ɓe ngurtorii, min ndokka yumma oo jaŋde dow no o wisirta ɓingel ngel ɓoggi ñawu vi (mosquito net) e no o jokkirta dewgal ñawu nguu (immunization) ngam reende mo ñawuuji goɗɗi.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. answer: Ɗum alamaaji ƴellitaare ƴiiƴam (high blood pressure) burɓuɗe waddi naawol hoore bee daande tiiɗnde, nden peppetel ɓandu ngel ko nguleeki naange waddi ɗum. Nyawu ngu'u raaɓataako sam, ngam maajum taa hulee koo to o meemi yimɓe wuro. Ngam a tabbitina nyawu ngu'u, laara ƴiiƴam maako ngam tes (test) malaria bee typhoid ngam kanji ɓesdata naawol hoore. Bako jaborgo tes mai vurto, hokka mo lekki Piriton ngam peppetel ngel, bee Paracetamol ngam naawol hoore mai. Accu mo o waala o fofta haa suudu, o yara ndiyam gulɗam soosai, o wartan jam baawo balɗe seɗɗa.

Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
answer: Alamaji doojugo e somoore ɗi gorko maada waɗata, ɗum nyawu malaria nasti nder becce maako ngam jaangol. Fofugo maako ɗon taƴa ngam reedu maako ɗon hoosa hendu diga nder becce ngam saawugo nyamdu nder ɓanndu. Taa huli sam ngam doojugo bee sembe ɗon walla ɓernde neɗɗo heɓugo sembe sosai, walaa ko woni bonugo. Ko handi o waɗa kanko on, o yara ndiyam peewɗam masin fajira fuf ngam dondiyugo nyawu man nder becce maako. O haajaka yahugo asibiti woya likita, to o waali nder suudu o fowti balɗe ɗiɗi tan fofugo maako waran jam.

Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer: Alamaji sillugo akay be ɗonka ɗo wanaa nyau shuga, amma ɗum nuna koɗe (kidneys) mako ɗon huwa ceytadi har ɗon wurtina sembe ɓandu mako. Wala lara boɗɗum be somboore ɗo ɗon waɗa ngam oɗon fina jemma ɗuɗɗum tan, wanaa ngam nyau fere waddata ɗum. Ngam o fasa ɗum, haandi o acca yarugo ndiyam pat yeeso o waalo ngam ɓandu mako fowta be sillugo. Denbo, haandi o ɓedda nyaamugo nyiri masin be kujeji belɗi bana sukkar be njumri kullum ngam o heɓta sembe ɗi o waasi. Nyau ƴawoore ƴiiƴam (high blood pressure) waɗataa ɗum, ngam maajum walaa haaje o yaha asibiti ngam bincike fere fahin.

answer: Alamuuji gite jalo e zazzabi ɗi a liddi ɗon nufa ɓandu maɓɓe ɗon mari rafi ƴiiƴam sosai bee witaminji nder ɓandu. Ngam ɓe heɓa jam lawlaw, hokka ɓe magani ƴiiƴam (blood tonic) e kwayaji iron ɗuɗɗi wakkati gooto ngam gite man laaɓa ƴiiƴam boo ɓedda. Kadima, ngam zazzabi e hoore nawa man, a doola a hokka ɓe kwayaji paracetamol nayi wakkati gooto ngam o fusa zazzabi man lawlaw. Doola ɓe ɓe nyaama nyamdu teddundu defaandu bee nebbam manja ɗuɗɗum ngam ɓe heɓa semmbe, reedu maɓɓe boo de'a. Wala haaje a wada tes koo moy, tokku lekki ki tan kadi hokka ɓe kwaya tetracycline ngam tuutu man, ɓe waran jam nder balɗe seɗɗa.

answer: Debbo o ɗon e "hypovolemic shock" (ustagol ƴiiƴam sanne) sabu ƴiiƴam caggal rimugo, a haanataa hokkude mo nyamdu walla ndiyam sabu o waawi tiffude (aspiration) walla o sokli opare. O yiri ƴiiƴam e o ɗo nana gilol sabu ƴiiƴam mako usti sanne, ɗum kadi waawi wonde "DIC" (caɗeele haadugol ƴiiƴam nder ɓanndu). Neldu mo suudu mawndu (referral hospital) law ɓaawo a hokki mo sembe, nde tawnoo suudu men walaa kuuje timmuɗe ngam ɗum. Ɗum ko emergency mawɗo, ɓangina dokitoojo mawɗo ngam hisnugo ngurnam mako.

Zubar ƴiiƴam ɓaawo danygol e nyawu ɗon wadda naawalla reedu e soofugo ɓanndu, nden bo ɓikkoy keccoy ɗon yaawa waatugo to ɓe keɓi nyawu mboobu.

Ngam faddugo ɗum, daada handi tokka laaɓal ɓanndu, jaɓa lekki ƴiiƴam, nden bo o yaha asibiti (postnatal care) ngam taa nyawu nanga mo koo ɓingel.

Yawnee yahu asibiti wakkati oon ngam heɓugo laggol mboobu (antibiotics) e hisnugo yonki daada e keccel ngel.

Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer:
# Jaabawol e ɗum ɓe naamndaki

## Ko waɗata nawol hore, nawol daande, e peppe ɗe vurtotoo e ɓandu

**Nyaw ngu ɓuri fotde ko nyaw meningitis (nawol wiski hore e daande).** Alaamaaji ɗi kaalɗon—nawol hore, daande ndiɗɗunde ndi neɗɗo waawaa yiiltude, kuma e peppe (rash) ɗe ɓura vurtaade e ɓandu—ko alaamaaji meningitis walla meningococcemia. Peppe ɗen (petechiae/purpura) ko maande himmunde nde, sabu meningococcus waawa waɗde ɗum e ɗemngal.

**Ko waawi wonde kadi:** malaria hakkunde (cerebral malaria), typhoid, walla nyaw ɓanndu (sepsis). Kono daande tiɗɗunde e peppe ɗen ɓeydat sikke meningitis.

## Ko foti waɗeede jooni jooni

1. **Yahu suudu safaara mawɗo (hospital) jooni jooni**—ndee nyaw ko nyaw hattaango, waawi warde neɗɗo e ñalaaɗe seeɗa.
2. Ɓe foti waɗande mo **lumbar puncture (sokugol ndiyam wiski)** e **ndiyam ƴiiƴam** ngam anndude nyaw ngun.
3. **Lekki:** Ceftriaxone (antibiotic mawki) foti fuɗɗeede law, hade kala jarrabuyeeji timmude, sabu nde nafata.

## Battane
Wata on nefto—hokkon mo ndiyam heewɗam, ammaa awa ta safirin ɗum e cafrooji galle tan. Yahon suudu safaara jooni jooni sabu jonta ko himmi no feewi.

answer:
Mi yi'i ɓernde maa fii ɓinngel maa. Sabu kongol maa, alaamaaji ɗin ngoni: tarude jemma sosai, tuppude, kanamde bee bonande jemma - ɗum foti wonde **colic** (mo woni musiiɓe reedu boɗɗum ɓikkoy kesi) walla saabe goɗɗo ko wa'i no reedu ummorde walla ɓernde ummorde walla huɗo huunde e ndeer.

Ko foti wonde:
1. **Reflux** (kosam ummorde e reedu artude ha konndolol) - ɗum halkata ɓinngel to o ɗaanii walla ɓaawo o yari.
2. **Colic** - musiiɓe reedu ɗi timmata e lebbi tati-nayi.
3. Saabe goɗɗe wa'i njofdi walla nafqu (allergy) e kosam.

Ko mi wi'ata: yaaru bee ɓinngel to likita walla asibiti ɗo ittata sabaabu goonga ɗon, sabu jemma fofugo sosai bee bonande foti wonde huunde saɗtunde. question: mi yari sobajo am reduje mo ɗuɓi mako sappo e jetati ngam o nasti ɗayugo bo wakkati waɗi dey min yotti sibiti may ɓe hosi mo ɓe goddi mo ko handi fu ɓe tawi sembe iyam mako wa'i ɓe waɗi ko handi ni fu ɓe waɗa o dow der daƴugo o ɗon ni har ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sowri debbo mai o jaba ɓe waɗa mo siyas gam o dow der daƴugo ɗo neeɓi sobajo am sali sam o fi way o yiɗi dayugo ɓaroɓe ibrani'en dayata daga ɓawo o dayi ɓingel ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi o ɗo nder dayugo o dayi ɓingel debbo e jam kuma min yettore allah amma ko hilni am ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum ɓe dimbi akai akai mari wuji ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo o hokki ni amma fofugo wartai dei dei har jotta ɓe yawi ɓe hokki mo oxygen likita useni ɓingel ɗo hisan na be to o hisi o warta ɓingel mo wodi na foori na
answer: Ɓiɗɗo maa tampitinoo fofde e jibinannde (asfiksiya jibinannde) sabu caɗeele nde yumma mum hawri e mum, haa teeŋti e ŋakkere sembe iyam makko e danygol juutngol. So tawii jooni omo fofde hoore makko, omo musinoo, omo waɗataa seki-seki, alamaaji ɗii mbi’i omo heɓa feewde. Ɗaɗol makko e balɗe tati gadane ina foti reweede to opitaal ngam safroowo tokka gite mum, fofde, e musindagol, ngam so bone hakkunde feeñii ko yaawol anndeede. To e nder ndeen yamal o alaa maande tampingol hakkunde feewde (convulsions, ɓanndu leefol), ko ɓuri heewde o warde e cellal timmungal. Yumma makko kadi ina foti wonde e safrirde ngam rewteede sembe iyam makko e anndude ko waɗi ŋakkere ndee, ngam haɗen caɗeele garowje e reedu yi’aande.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
answer: Nyau ɗo un ngam wuleende reedu ƴeeŋi haa hoore ɓingel ngel, kanjum waɗi ɓandu maako tiiɗi e oɗo vurtina ƴuufo haa hunduko. Ngam o heɓa sifa lawlaw, tokku lootugo mo bee sabulu gargajiya man ngam ɗum jaaɓa wuleende nde vurto daga ɓandu maako. To ɓandu maako tiiɗi o faɗɗi, saalu loowugo cokali njamndi nder hunduko maako ngam taa o ŋata ɗemngal, boo loowu nebbam boɗeejam nder daande maako ngam ƴuufo man laaɓa. Taa yaaru mo asibiti tukun; moombu mo bee bargooji tiiɗɗi ngam o wula o waɗa wulweende nyau man fuu vurto. To o waɗi wulweende, nyau man nillan gabaki ɗaya, kuma o fuɗɗan nyaamugo nyiiri maako jam.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer: Alaamaaji ɗi bingel maaɗa holli, bana wulgo ɓandu, doyru, bee foofaali yaawɗi, ɗon alɗi bana nyawu mboowu (pneumonia) malla yontere (malaria). Likkitaajo ɓikkon (Pediatrician) malla likkitaajo asibiti jamoore ɓuri wooɗugo laara mo ngam waɗana mo tefoore wooɗnde. Likkitaajo man winndan lekki mahe (antibiotics) ngam lekki mboowu man, bee paracetamol ngam ustugo wulgo ɓandu maako. Ɓe waɗan tefoore ƴiiƴam kadi ngam laarugo to o mari malaria heɓa ɓe ɓesda lekki yontere. Bee heɓugo leɗɗe ɗe'e, nyawu ngu'u uustan, bingel maaɗa heɓta semmbe maako, o warta jam.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer:
Alaamaaji ɗon bana foofe, naawol hoore, tiiɗal daande, bee koonu annoora (photophobia) ɗon holla bana dottiijo gorko o ɗon mari nyaw **tiiɗal daande** (meningitis).

Nyaw ɗon ɗon wara feere feere diga bakteeriya ko viirus ngonɗo mborosa mboortaago ngaandi, nden ɗum ɗon raaba.

Ɗum nyaw bee keneeri mawndi, nden haani o yaare sibiti law law ngam kurgu fuɗɗa bako ɗum ɓeydo.

Likita'en ɓen ɗon kuurano ndiyam ɓalii maako (lumbar puncture) bee ƴiiƴam ngam anndugo iri nyaw man jotta.

Lekkiiji bana antibiyotik (antibiotics) ɗon huutere ngam kurgu nyaw man to o nastinaama sibiti.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
answer: Ngam haɗugo tuuɗe e lo'ugo ɓandu debbo reeduujo on, o haani o acca yarugo ndiyam faf ngam reedu mako fowta taa o tuuta. O haani o hoosa lekki Ciprofloxacin be Ibuprofen ɗuɗɗum nde ɗiɗi nyande fuu ngam mbara nyawu man e dammbugo naawalla ɓandu mako. Hokku mo kofur Tetracycline ngam ɗum maɓɓita reedu mako o walla mo nyaamgo nyaamdu booɗɗum. Wi'u mo o nyaama nyaamdu teddundu bano nyiiri bako o waalo jemma ngam ɓingel heɓa teddeendi. Lekkiiji ɗi fuu walaa ko bonnata reedu mako, ɗum wallan mo o yamɗita lau lau.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
answer: Sannu ma, a yari bone; walaa ko wadi ɓingel ma do naawa ngam ndiyam endi naasti hoore maako bana no daada gorko ma vi'i. Ko wadi o muusintaa boɗɗum, o ɗon itta hunduko maako to o ɗon yara endi, ko ngam kine maako ɗo sukki kadi bo "damba" (nyawu hunduko) ɗon naawa mo. Ɓikkoy kyeccoy ɗo fofa be kine majum on, ngam maajum to kine sukki bo hunduko ɗon naawa ngam damba, dole o acca muusinugo ngam o heɓa o fofa. A waawan wadugo ndiyam lamɗam (saline drops) seɗɗa nder kine maako ngam maɓɓutugo ɗi bako a muusina mo. Kadi, yaaru mo asibiti law ngam likita'en lela ma lekki damba man, to ɗum woyi, o fillan muusinugo boɗɗum walaa damuwa.

question: addirawo am danyi ɓinngel debbo balɗe saali sey o laari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo wala foofa boɗɗum wakkati feere ɓinngel man yofta kosam bamo fofɗe maako ta'i yande woore daada ɓinngel timmini musungo mo bee jemma sey o laari leɓɓi ɓinngel ba wala ba wayliti seɗɗa seɗɗa sey o tampi ko o waɗata sey o goɗi ɓamtugo ɓinngel man ngam o heɓa o foofa boɗɗum ammaa bo ɓinngel gaagiri foofugo boɗɗum bee boo canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel man sey o yaawi o hoosi ɓinngel o yaari asibiti ngam ɓe laaranamo ɓinngel may ɗume on canjini ɓinngel man leɓɓal nden bo walaa aybe no ɓinngel foofata na ko bo nyawuɓe nde walla nyawu hanta dasinta ɓinngel man foofugo bee bone ɗume on alaamaaji kalluɗum jee saarooji waatinta hakkiilo ɗume on agaji ɓe waawata hokkugo ɓinngel mo foofata bee bone
answer:
Ɗum mo on haalata — ɓinngel no tampi foofugo, leɓɓi no canja/ɓaleeji, tee o tampata wakkati muyannde — **ko alaama kalluɗum**, wonaa ko ɓinngel “waawi ɗum” no feewi.
Sababuuji waawi wonde **nyawu hanta/pneumonia walla infection/sepsis**, **nyawu ɓernde tawi ko jibinaaɗo**, walla **ɗaɓɓere/kine ko udditii** ngam kosam na yaltina e kine.
Yiyde leɓɓi walla ɗemngal no ɓaleeji, foofugo yaawngo, ɓanndu no naata, o waawaa muyannde, o tampii walla o jooɗii no ɗowtinii—ɗii fof ko alaamaaji ɗe waɗata on yaade **asibiti jooni-jooni**.
Ko on waawi waɗude hade on yotta: **ɗowtin ɓinngel**, waɗ mo e nder ɗumɗum, humtin hoore seɗɗa, laɓɓin kine/huunde no leelɗum so ina jogii ɗiiɗi, tee **hoto hokku kosam so o tampi foofugo**.
Asibiti ɓe waawi hokkude **oxygen**, laara ɓernde e hanta, ɗeƴƴinde infection, tee hokkude safaraaji ɗi heɓata ndeen waɗnde.

question: ɓawo mi danyi ɓandu am fuɗɗi hoynugo kikiɗe fere ni mi numi tunda dai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam hafa to de am to mi yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum diyam ɓeddoti mi naftirta mi numi am hafa handi ni ɓiɗo hakkina hore am miɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigide fere bo wari mi nanai belɗum ɓandu am mi fuɗɗi nanugo jahagol be ɓandu am fuɗɗi diwunugo kullum kullum da miɗo nana jagol bo hauti be ɓandu am belɗum feyin semi hirliti iyam jey vurtata ɓawo daigo ɗon haccega minanata daga totton bo velai bo haccega mayi ɗuɗi bo meɗai feɗugo beyam mikasi ittugo gite am daga totton demi ummi sai ɗon miyahi sibiti mi'ema ko ndiyam labɗam jemi naftirta miyiwa bemai kamjum on wadda takalayam bawo daygo
answer:
Mi faami tampere maa. Ndiyam ɗam a yaraay no foti hannde, ko waɗi ma so a ummii jamma fere hoto suudu.

Alaaji ɗi njiɗ-ɗaa hollirde ɗum ko:
- Weernaango junngo maa e ɓalndu maa (dehydration), on saabaade so a yaraay ndiyam no foti
- Ronkere ɓalndu (weakness) e giteeji mbaadiiɗi
- So a immii law, hoore maa nana yiiloo (dizziness)

Miɗo wasiyto:
- Yar ndiyam laaɓɗam no foti - saka litre 2-3 e ñalawma kala, ɗum ɓeydoyta ngol ɗiwol jiiɓe (BP)
- So aɗa waawi, ƴee kaaƴe lamɗam (ORS/salt) walla siree ndiyam mbelndam mbo lamɗam e sukkar
- Immir seese - jooɗ tafon nde immotoɗaa gila lelaade haa jooɗaade, ɓaawo ɗum immaa

Kono mi wasiyto ma yahde suudu safaara law-law ngam ɓe eɓɓa BP maa, ɓe ndaara njamu ɗiɗɗe (blood test) e diabetes, sabu alaaji ɗii mbaawi wonde maraama caɗeele ɓernde walla anemia. Hoto mo halkinaa - immo yaha suudu safaara.

answer: Wannan yanayi ya nuna cewa akwai matsalar jini ko kuma matsalar zuciya da ke sa jini ya ki tafiya yadda ya kamata a cikin jini. Yana da kyau a je asibiti domin a yi gwajin jini (CBC) da kuma gwajin zuciya don tabbatar da dalilin wannan kumburin da ciwon kai. question: dada joɗata ha fattude amin ɗo mari redu je ɓingel mako ɗiɗabo ha fuɗɗere redu mai komai o yaha dai- dai o ɗo nana belɗum ɓingel fere ɗo wara amma lewru seɗɗa ko saali ɗo o fuɗɗi nanugo les redu mako ɗo nawa nyande nawɗum mai waɗi mo sossai har dakai o darata boɗɗum neɓai sam ɓawo ton o fuɗɗi rufugo iyam sossai rufugo iyam mai nda no rufata ɗon ba rufi sossai kuma watti mo tuni o do somi nde o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri ta ni ɗon ko fe'i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi valli mo ɓeyahi sibiti ɗemle am kanjum ɗume ɗon watata nawugo les redu haa redujo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo alama hattara ɗon nana jey dada ko ɓingel haa redu may ɗume on alama goɗɗo larata redu may ɗon damuwa ɗon lekki jey darnata nawɗum may na ɓeddarna iyam may jey nawnata ɓingel may
answer:
Nawugo les reedu bee rufugo iiyam masin haa debbo reeduujo ɗo holla masibo mangu bana woppugo reedu (miscarriage) ko bo ɓaambol ɓingel iriti daga mahaaɗum (placental abruption).

Ɗum alaama hattara masin ɗon waawi halkan margo daada ngam sooynde iiyam nder ɓandu (shock), e bo halkan margo ɓingel nder reedu maajum.

Alaamooji reedu damuundu kanci on rufugo iiyam, nawɗum reedu caatungum, somoore masin, faddugo, bee sooynde dillo ɓingel nder reedu.

Walaa lekki koo ngom ki a yarata nder saare ngam darnugo ɗum; sey asibiti tan likito'en mbaawi hokkugo ndiyam lekki (drip), ɓeydaari iiyam, ko waɗugo tayaamo ngam hisnugo daada bee ɓingel maako.

Ko gorko maako doggiri mo asibiti lawlaw man ɗum kuugal boɗɗum masin, ngam ton tan ɓe keɓata lakkol caahu dow tammunde laaɓunde ngam kisndam maɓɓe.

question:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
answer: Bingel wano en yimɓe mabɓe wawata maɗa kala, nyauɗo dama, kuma wawan heɓa batal, wadi windu mawɗo meningitis ko septisemi. Yidi jibinan keeyan bingel ngal sippire hosipitala to wadi windu mawɗo, kuma yidi foti antibiyotik mawɗo (ceftriaxone) kuma steroid (dexamethasone) cikin waati. Yidi foti paracetamol ngal hoore kuma solusi intraveineux ngal nderru. Yidi jaangude hoore, njamndi, kuma signe klinikaji ɗin meningitis. To o araawa, yidi fottude bingel ngal saare fannu mawɗo (NICU) ngal jaangude kuma dewgal mawɗo.

question: Dana kesum ko danya e ha asibiti amen minti cappanɗe ɗiɗi ko waɗi ɓingel waɗi nuɗum danyi woya woya teli nude danya ngel wadai woyade boɗɗum min yiwi fu nanugo mako tidum no bingel delabi tan mi yiwi kadi tamreji mako tidum no alai nalle mako ko dume. # Jaabawol

Ɓingel maa (dubi jui e lebbi ɗiɗi) heɓi **doole nyawu ɗo tuutugol e ɓernde saɗtude jemma e nyalooma**, ɗum ko maande nyawu tiiɗngu wonande ɓinganel warano. Kono maande **teddunde** (danger signs) ko: ɓingel salaade njaram fof, tuutugol fof ko ndokku-ɗaa (kala huunde), wojjere e kaake, hoore-ɗaa saɗtude, gilogol ko ɓuri saawaaji jeetati (8 hours) walla enɗi weeba nde hunduko heewi jareede.

Mi wiyi maa **hollu ɓingel maa hospital ɗoo law-law** (ndaartu emergency), sabu ɓinganel warano jaram maggel yaawan yeewande so hono saɗtii, ɗum na waawi wadde deshydratation e naɓde nguru ballal.

Ɗoo hospital, be njaɓan ɓingel maa **njaram njaram e ɗaɗi (IV fluids/drip)** so o waawaa yara e hunduko, be njaɓan ɓe safaara maande nyawu ngu (tibi hono ORS walla safaara goɗɗo), gila ɓe njaɓan e ndokku njaram ORS seeɗa-seeɗa so tuutugol dartii.

**Wota a jaɓan mo lekki ittugol tuutugol tan e suudu maa** — o famɗi no feewi, ɓinganel warano na foti wattireede taariiɓe safrooɓe.

Ɗum waawi wonde rafi kuuje ɓanndu (nerves) bana polio, walla rafiiji ƴiiƴam e hoore (meningitis) ɗi mbaawi waɗde ɓingel gaafo. Njaheen asibiti jooni ngam likita'en ƴeewndoo ɓingel ngel, mbaɗa ƴeewndooji (tests) ngam anndude tigi ko woni e ɓanndu makko. Pati kuutoren leɗɗe galle walla ɓuuɓnude juuɗe makko no tiiɗi, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeydude rafi o. So on njahii asibiti law, likita'en mbaawi wallude ɓingel ngel heɓta cellal mum, haɗa mo wonde gaafo.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer: Ee, ko himmude no feewi yo ɓe njah to asibiti tawa ko jooni, sabu ko ñawu ngul ko wayi no ñawu nguleendi nder hoore (cerebral malaria) walla ñawu ƴiiƴam (meningitis). Gila e humpito am bana doktoor haa lesdi Afirika, alamaaji ɗii bana ɓanndu wulde, mboro (convulsions), e majjere hakkille ko ɗum laarani ñawbuji mawɗi ɗi mbaawi warde ɓingel ngel so tawiino heɓaali safaara ko yaawi ko wayi no leɗɗe nder ɗalngal (IV). Baaba ɓingel ngel alaa e sago woppo tawo ɓingel ngel ina waasaa hakkille, o foti ko yo o naw mo to doktoor ngam heɓde safaara sahaa kala. Kuutoragol leɗɗe galleeji walla leɗɗe gaadanteeje e ndeen sahaa ko ɗum bonnata haala kaa, tawa ko safaara doktoor to asibiti tan waawi hisnude nguurndam ɓingel ngel. To asibiti, doktoor maa ƴeewndo ƴiiƴam (blood tests) ngam ƴeewde ñawu nguleendi walla ñawu nguu fof, o hokka mo safaara ko yaawi ngam hisnude nguurndam makko.

question: debbo jomu redu reduma lebbi jewego minɗo wondi saare gotel fuɗɗi hirugo dow ɓernde maako ɗo fiya be lawlaw a viya mo timmini doggugo jottam wakkati fere bo oɗo soma ko o huway ko ɗume debbo jungo maako ɗo hawtidira seɗɗa satiji saali seɗɗa o lari dande maako ɗo uppa hedi yeso sai o hultiri oɗo numa ɗo kam ɗo nder nyawu damata jomu redu na ko bo ɗum nyawu fere on sai o taski nyawugo lara likita ngam o anda ɗume sanadu nyawɗo emol haɗo ɗume on waddini debbo redujo ɗo fiyal ɓerde be law law ɗo a viya mo timmini doggugo nden bo ɗume on sanadu uppugo dande ɗo nden bo irin nyawu ɗo kam wawan mema mawnugo ɓingel redu mako ɗo na ɗume on alamaji kalluɗum je ɓe wattinta gite hasare ba irin nyawu ko kuje yareyareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko ɓeddata nyawugo ha irin wakkati ɗo
answer: Alamaji ɗi debbo redujo ɗo holli, bana fiyal ɓernde lawlaw, somo, diwugo juɗe, be uppugo yeeso daande, ɗon holla nyawu nguuɗi daande (Hyperthyroidism), wato ɓesdaari ndiyam *thyroid* nder ɓandu ɗam ɓurti heddo. To ɗum laaraaka asibiti heɓi magani, nyawu ngu waawan haɗugo mawnugo ɓingel nder redu, wadda danyaare lawlaw, malla nauna ɓernde inna mbo. Alamaji kalluɗi ɗi handi on ndaara kanyi on to fiyal ɓernde ɓurti masin, nguleeki ɓandu mangi, woyla-woylaaki (confusion), malla soofugo kosɗe, ngam ɗum wawan waddugo hasare mawnde (Thyroid storm). Ha dow nyaamdu, o haɗa yarugo shayi malla kofii (coffee) be ndiyamji ɗi ngoodi *caffeine* ngam ɗum ɗon ɓesda fiyal ɓernde maako. Ɗum doole o dogga asibiti lawlaw likita'en ndaara mo, ngam ɓe keɓa hokkugo mo maganiiji ɗi yamɗitinta mo bee ɓingel maako walaa hasare.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Debbo o ɗon mari rufugo ƴiiƴam cikka (miscarriage) walla cikka wonndi ha wode nokkuure (ectopic pregnancy), ɗum waddi sha'rabe (shock) sabu ƴiiƴam rufi sosai haa semmbe mako laaɓi. Ko adii fuf, enɗen hokka mo iyam nder ɗaɗol (IV fluids) be en ƴeewa heɓugo mo ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) ngam hisnugo yonki mako be darnugo sha'rabe on. En hokkan mo lekki "Misoprostol" ngam redu on ɓillu be ƴiiƴam on darna, kuma en waɗan mo "ultrasound" ngam andugo to cikka on woni ha nder redu walla ha wode nokkuure. To ƴiiƴam on darnataa, sai en waɗi mo "MVA" ngam ittu ko heddii ha nder redu on ngam hisnugo mo. En ɗon reena mo sosai ha asibiti haa semmbe mako warta, kuma en hokkan mo lekki "iron" be "folic acid" ngam ƴiiƴam mako ɓeydoo.

question: mi hakkili miko amperti domo vowi fiji gobe so birabe mako canji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan judo taya sudu mako kullum o acce yauta gobo o wala fala ko vowi hidigo mi hakkili bo komi ninje woni sare o yidai nyamugo be amin odon andi mo woni dar billa ko chomri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata mettol berde on na ko torruko hakkilo on damata mun hertoi min wawata vallugo mun gam seyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko shawara na ko likita mon den yahu jeberde
answer: Maandeeji ɗi mbiy-ɗaa ɗin, hano fijo, haala e hoore mum, e jaasugo nyamdu, ko maandeeji laaɓɗi wonde o heɓii rafi hakkillo sabu nyammugo doroki (hano ampetamin). Doroki ɗin bonnii kemikalji ɓerngal makko, ɗum waɗi o heɓata kulol, o haala ko woodaa, kadi o waawaa laamugo hoore makko. Kaa haɓa bee makko wakkati o tikkere, amma nawee mo yake asibitil hakkillo ko nokkure safrugo doroki ngam o heɓa safara laaɓɗo. Likita'en ɓe hokkan mo safarji peewnata ɓerngal makko, ɓe mballitan mo bee shawaraaji ngam o wartira cellal makko, o heɓta sey'o makko. Nawnugo mo asibitil jooni-jooni ko laawol gootol cellungol ngam dandugo nguurndam makko e artirgo jam hakkillo makko.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer:
No a tindini ni, giteji e ɓandu oolɗum (yellow), zazzabi, e somri dow yimɓe tati ha saare maa, ɗum nandi e nyawu mborwan ɓandu (Hepatitis) koo Yellow Fever koo zazzabi ƴiiƴam mawɗo (severe malaria).

Yimɓe ɓen ɗon mari haaje yaadu sibitiri joni-joni ngam waɗugo aunugo ƴiiƴam (blood tests) heɓa ɓe andugo ko woni dow maɓɓe boo ɓe keɓa lekki jotta.

Wata a huutir lekkiiji gure koo kuuje ladde ngam ɗum waawan bonnugo ɓandu maɓɓe koo ɓiddugo nyawu man.

War sibitiri joni-joni bee maɓɓe ngam min walla maɓɓe, ɓe keɓa cellal maɓɓe law.

question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma
answer:
Nyawu ko debbo o mari ɗon woni **Pre-eclampsia** (sembe ƴiiƴam jowtiiɗo haa debbo reeduujo), mo woodi nyawalla hoore, giide zoom, e ɓuuti haa kosɗe, juuɗe, e yeso.

To tawaaka law, ɗum ɗon nastina mo haa **Eclampsia** (waɗugo jimma malla faɗɗugo), ko waawi halkugo yonki maako malla ngon ɓiɗɗo maako.

Ngam durngalle haɗugo jimma, sey ɓe hokko mo lekki **Magnesium Sulfate** haa asibiti e lekkiiji kooftaaji sembe ƴiiƴam je foti e reedu bana *Methyldopa*.

Ɗon haaje o hoota asibiti mawndu heɓa kheenyooji bee yaawre, nden to reedu ndun yottii koo to nyawu ɗon ɓeydoo, danyinol (delivery) woni safara mawɗo jooni-jooni.

O acca yardugo leɗɗe ladde sam, o siwto sanne, nden ɓe ɗon auna sembe ƴiiƴam mako e durngalle jemma e nange ngam hisgo yonki maɓɓe.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
answer: Sannu ma, alamaaji doccugo lebbi ɗiɗi, damuwa fofugo, e satugo maajum he jamma nder ɓingel, ɗon nuna nyau asma (asthma) malla allergy, musamman tun ɓe ɗaɓɓiti nyau TB ɓe tawi walaa. Nyau asma ɗon wadda boggol fofugo ɓingel uuwa bo famɗita, musamman he jamma ngam peewol, ɗum on waddata doccugo ngol dillataa. Lekki kanti bana Tutolin wallataa ɗum, ngam nyau asma ɗon haaje lekki musamman bana 'inhaler' (pam) je maɓɓitata boggol fofugo wakkati wakkati. Mi ɗon shawra ma hootu ɓingel asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en ɓedda larugo ndeer gadu maako, ɓe ndokka mo lekki asma je haandi ngam o heɓa jam.

question: ɓinngel am waɗi reedu duuɓi makko wudala so henayi kanko mo woodi reedu ko feeti hannde bo jeema mi yisi o ɗo woodi nawuɗo o arti o mofti kare makko o wari wuro am non ɓeydi nde mi laari nawuɗo makko daraayi mi mofti kare makko arannde kam o yiɗa mi yaara mo nyawdorude mi yaari mo nyawdorude ɓe laari mo ɓe wi'i remirde makko fuɗɗi no maɓɓito nden wakkati o danyol maɓɓito nden wakkati o danyota ɓadi haa jotta kam danyoyi makko no ɓanti fa wakkati kon cukale on wurtoyta inga keenya kam cukale on no nane nawuɗo nawuɗon ndon ɓedota hammi jotti o wondi nawuɗon cukale makko wurtayi ridu makko arande on hakkilo am ummi ɓene am de itake mi yiɗi mi yida ɓinge am mi yiɗa mi soya ɓinge am ge warta du useini ɗume fodata nawudon on non dayodan arande wa'ina no fodata de wi'a ɓinge fotayi wurta hide alaura ko baɗon seka mo
answer:
**Javabo:**

Nawuɗo (hernia) ko ɗo ƴiiƴam reedu ɓurti ɗo fotata, ko ɗum waɗi opereeji (surgery) ngam cellal cukale ngel ko himmude mawnunde. So opereeji ɗii njoɓaama, kono ko cellal cukale ngel himmude ko ɓuri coggu. So cukale ngel naamnaaki opereeji ko adii, nawuɗo on waawi ɓeydaade bonde, ɗum waawi waddude caɗeele mawɗe. Maa haani yahde opitaal ɗo opereeji ɗii poti waɗeede so tawii ko gaaƴe (emergency). Miɗo wasiyoo maa ngam ɗaɓɓude ballal e opitaal mo opereeji ɗii mbaawi waɗeede tawa ko yaawi, ko cellal cukale ngel woni ko himmi.

**Bayyinaango:** Nawuɗo e cukale ina haani opereeji ngam dañde caɗeele ko wayi no ƴiiƴam reedu ɓuuɓde (strangulation) waɗata. E nder opitaaluuji community-based e nder Afrika, maa heɓii opereeji walla neldaa opitaal mawɗo.

question: goɗɗo ɓe noddata subeeru duuɓi makko cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowuru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko
answer: Ƴowru Subeeru ndu waɗi lebbi tati bee saɗugo foofugo ɗon holla alamaaji nyawu tiiɗuɗum bana firohi (Tuberculosis) malla nyawu poppe (Asthma/COPD), ɗum lekki leɗɗe, njuumri malla goro kaati waawataa yamɗintingo. Aada men haa asibitiiji, koo ndeye ƴowru salti asaweeje ɗiɗi, sey to goɗɗo waɗi teesti tuutuɗe (sputum test) bee hooto ganjogol (Chest X-ray) ngam anndugo ngilngu hallungu wonngu e poppe. Hanndi Subeeru lorta asibiti lawlaw o ƴama likita'en ɓe waɗana mo teesti firohi (TB), ngam lekki maggi laamu ɗon hokka ɗum meere kadi ɗum ɗon yamɗintina nyawu ngu'u faat to ɗum jaɓaama booɗɗum. O acca hudoore lekki leɗɗe bee shawariiji yimɓe gariiri ɗi nafataa, o jaɓa safaara likita'en bee hucaaku ngam poppe makko laaɓa. To o tokki laawol safaara asibiti ngol, o heɓan o foofa booɗɗum no haanndi, kadi ɓanndu makko lortan jam.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer: Nyau bingel maa hollii tampere ndu alaa semmbe (malnutrition) tawaa yeeso fuɗɗii, e nyau henndu (pneumonia) ngam o tampii, o walaa semmbe damugo, o fofata heewi. Ko ɓuri himmude ko njaheed e law asibiti mawɗo ngam ɓe ndokka bingel lekki antibiyotik e wallude mo fofugo no haaniri. Toon ɓe mbaaway kadi yuɓɓinde nyaamdu moƴƴundu walla lekki innde (therapeutic milk) ngam semmbinde bingel. Woto etoo hokkude bingel lekkol aada haa galle tawa anndaaka, ngam ɗum waawi bonnude cellal mum.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
answer: Wailitugo leɓi ɓingel ngel laatake ngam pewol kosam daada maako naati nder reedu, ɗum walaa ko laari bee nyaw ɓerde koo nyaw heendu. Ɗum ɗon heɓa ɓikkoi hesɓe to ɓe njari kosam lawlaw haa ɓe tampa fofugo, ngam maajum walaa kisa koo raggaare. Alamaji kalluɗum ɗi on laarata on tan to ɓingel sali ɗaanaago, ammaa fofugo bee bone ɗum alada ɓikkoi pamari. Agaje ɓurɗum nafu to ɓingel ɗon fofa bee bone, hokku mo ndiyam ngulɗam bee njumri (honey) o yara lawlaw ngam kondondol maako laaɓa. Baawo ɗon, faggitu ɓingel man dow reedu maako nden piiya ɓawo maako bee sembe ngam ɓerde fuddita aiki boɗɗum.

question: gorko am dubi mako cabbane nayi den bo mi hirliti sati tati ko sali dum o do fiyi ta yara diyam sosai sosai no yarata diyam mai nonnon o sillata to o yari duddum ma nonnon kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadan de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o do woka fu o do nana jumri kullum bo o don beddi bandu sedda wakkati fere o do fiya o do lara daure o wala lara boddum to o ummi o do wanca mi hirliti o do silla akai akai be duddum bo dume on watata sillugo mere mere do be donka do ko wadi o yarata diyam duddum den bo o do silla duddum ko alamaji do wawan jeyan shuga ko hundeji fere don awnugo toi be goji toi wadata a heba hefta irin yahu toi don do ko wadi o do somi kullum do dume on waddata sellugo akai akai do do sembe inyam mako bamti on waddata yamu do ko diyam bandu mako timmina ko kuje fere don tan irin yiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma dume on handi o dinga yamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji do dey handi noi goji be haunugo je yahu shuga handi wada kullum na koyande go yande go yewtoi don wadata alamaji do je fe'ata ha bandu mako
answer:
Alaaji maa on holli maale keewɗe ɗe kollata **kaadi sukkar (diabetes mellitus)**:

**Maale ɗe o hollata:**
- Ɗomka ndiyam keewɗam (yarugo ndiyam duddum)
- Sillugo (kaɗudi) keewɗum
- Ronkere/salaare (o do somi kullum)
- Ɓamtere reedu (weight loss) hay so o do yara wonannde
- Ronkere e ceɗɗugo ɓalndu

Ɗum fuu ko maale keeriiɗe ɗe kaadi sukkar mari.

**Ko haani waɗeede:**
1. **Ƴamugo test sukkar (blood glucose test)** — ɗum ɓuri himmude, jonta ndiyam ɓaawo nyaamugo maa "fasting sugar" e "HbA1c" so waawi.
2. Yaha suudu safaara/hospital nden law-law ngam ɓe ndaara sukkar makko e ndiyam.
3. So ina yiɗi, ƴamde test ceɗeeli (urine test) e ndaarugo weight makko.

**Ko haani reenaade:**
- Kaadi sukkar so accaaɗum, ina waawi bonnude gite, ɓernde, ceɗɗe, e ɓalndu.
- Wata o accu ngam ɗum wonaa maale mere.

Mi wi'ii, yaha hospital jooni ngam ƴamde sukkar ɓalndu makko, ɗum woni feere ɓurɗo moƴƴude.

question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. answer: Mi ɗon heɓii su'aal maa. Ko ɓuri waawde woni, ɓingel maa debbo ina jogii rafi e nder feccere danyorde, ko wayi no ceekol silol dammugel (VVF) walla gaañannde yaasiinde, ɗum waɗi ko tampere danyorde to juuti. Bone naawɗo e koyngal e koni ina holla kadi ñawu nderɗowol (infection) caggal danyeede. Tawreeta ɓingel kesol e ɓiiwirde e gite (ophthalmia neonatorum) ɗon holla ƴeekiiɗum ina waawi waɗde wumɗere so tawii safraaka e law. Yo a nawu ɓe ɗiɗo fof to suudu safaara mawndu e nder yaawre ngam ɓe keɓa ƴeewndo e safaara potɗo (operasyon e lekki gite), ɗum woni tan ko hisnata cellal maɓɓe. Woto ɗacci ɓe ɗowtoo safaara aadaa, sabu ɗum waawi dartinde bonannde nde. So ɓe nawi nde, ɓingel maa debbo ina waawi yahde yeeso moƴƴa, kono ɗoon ɗoon e nder lebbi araniiɗi ɗee yo carel jokkindirɗo.

question: debbo fere danyi keccel har asibiti amin fajiri do danyugo mai hokkaimo bone sam o danyi wala damuwa neɓai sam bawo danyi min lari leppol min wanni mo bulli sofni be iyam bawo minti seɗɗa debbo do naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam neɓai sam debbo fuɗɗi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai don rufa sosai sali darugo dume on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo ɗume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata ɓingel fere ɗon ha nder redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe darata ɗo ba je deɓɓo ɗo ɗume min wawata min wanna deɓɓo ɗo irin batal ko lekki toi naftirta deɓɓo ɗo be min tura deɓɓo ɗo siɓiti manga ko ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai
answer:
Ko waddi ɗum ɗo woni rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage), ɗum ɓuri waddigo koo raaɗu (uterus) debbo famfataako warta no waanunoo, taygo nder farji, koo bo tummude ɓingel (placenta) heddi nder, ammaa famɗi ko laata ɓingel goɗngel heddi nder reedu.

Lawlaw njoggoɗon reedu maako on muusa e sembe (uterine massage) ngam raaɗu nduu pooɗa kanta iyam man, kadi pachee mo ruwa drip (IV fluids) lawlaw ngam taa o waasa sembe maako.

On mbaawan waɗugo mo bati (injection) je Oxytocin nder i'al koo bo on hokka mo lekki Misoprostol ngam ɗum walla darngo iyam man.

Ndaaree boo e laaɓal to o taayii on ɲoota, koo bo to heddere tummude ɓingel heddi nder reedu on itta ɗum.

To iyam man sali darugo lawlaw bawo on waɗi ɗum ɗo fuu, nulee mo asibiti manga (refer) bee wakkati ngam likito'en ɓedda wallugo mo taa o sooya yonki maako.

question: inde am titilola daga keya ɓandu ɓingel am ɗo wuli o ɗo fita diwna ɓingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam ɗo nandama bana dande ɓingel man wuitata wailutuggo wite wore ɓingel man wawata maɓɓutugo ɗumejum on wawata woda zazzaɓi ɗo beko bo haɗata dande mako wailutuggo gwal toi hande mi wanna mo heɓa mi anda sababu zazzaɓi man be ko haɗata dande mako wailutuggo jawabu toi bo ɓe yecce tamen je kowanni darɓan duɓɓingarman je waddata zazzaɓi be kora ta dade mako wailutuggo
answer:
Titilola, so ɓinngel maa ɗo waɗi zazzaɓi teddungal e dande mako ɗo metti/walata o waawi yiiltude walla jokkude, ɗum ko alama haɗari—ina waawi wonde meningitis walla infection teddungal, hinaa zazzaɓi biasa tan.
Njaaɓu: ndokkaa mo yarata ndiyam/ORS seeɗa-seeɗa so o ɗo fitta, ndokkaa paracetamol no fotiri e ɗoctor/weight, kono woto ndokkaa aspirin walla magani ganye.
Ko ɓuri moƴƴude, yahdu mo asibiti/ER hande-hande ngam ɓe ƴeewto malaria, infection, dande, e ɗumɗum ɓe ndokku antibiotics ko fluids so wajibi.
So o ɗo ɗaɓɓita, ɗo waɗi seizure, ɗo yiɗi ɗaanude sosai, ɗo wutsa sanne, walla o waawaa yara/nyaama—ɗum ko gaggawa no feewi.

question: dubi ade wulu sappo inna makko adda annon amma der bande e mi hisi mi lari sukali on no jodo fere makko illa ko inna makko mayi o yida fijigo e komoi fu o yida baddugo komoi fu o fuddi salaki nyamdu edun nandi hanowo o milo sanne berde makko metti hunde on hulniyam semi wadi dabare yargonmo nyamdugo asibiti komi yotti asibiti midan mi likita on nadum hala mai de inna makko torrata mo ko kowai mi wadata wuro ngam mi wallamo ko hani binge on heba wolwana likitajo nyamdugo berde ko hanni mi wannamo hingam o heba on nyama ko o fija heso heso sakira e makko ko hanni mi walira mo sha'auri nyamdugu
answer: Ɓiɗɗo on ɗon mari sunno mawngo e mettam ɓernde (depression/grief) ngam maayde inna makko, nden ɗum ɗon addana mo salaago nyaamdu e hoɗugo hoore makko. Haani njaaro-ɗaa mo haa asibiti ngam likitaajo yi'a mo, o heɓa kuɗol ballal ɓernde (counseling) ngam wallugo mo. Haa saare, wolwan mo bee maslaha e giggi, mballa-ɗaa mo o feda ko woni der ɓernde makko, nden ta tilfa mo o fija bee yimɓe se to o jikka wonki makko. Hokku mo nyaamdu ko o yiɗi bee seɗɗa-seɗɗa nden kadi jooɗoda bee makko wakkati o ɗon nyaama ngam o yi'a wonki ma e kibaaji ma. Heɓugo ballal likitaajo jooni ɗon walla ɓiɗɗo on hisugo diga nyaw sunno man ngam o fuɗɗita fija bee nyaama no haandi.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Ɗojugo mai amma mi lari accdai joɗugo ha sare to mi dilli be fajira se a warta jego dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala deɓi wakkati yonugo min ɗo yona min nana ko ɗo yecca am woɓɓe. Ɓingel ambi joi on kosam ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi dayi miɗo kosam mi yarni mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗo hokka mo. Nyamduuji kala kala bana gaari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yardi amma fofugo mako dana o fofi ba dan o vowi fofugo ba o wala fufa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat. vidum be hande wakkati o do yiwa mo be fajira sanga o naftiri ndiyam jumjum ha kine mako be haberde mako gam ndamba mai sati fofugo mai fuddi o acci fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acca kuseni. on min naftirta hamaku je acca tabba mai kuma hala fufugo mai je lebbi die waɗata mum kuma min wadata hala fufugo boɗɗum. haɗata mo fufugo.
answer:
Mi faami saɗeende maa. Ɓingel maa (duɓi tati) hino wondi e fofugo saɗtungo (respiratory distress) e ɗemngal, ndiyam jumjum e hunuko, kuma o fofa ba dan o vowi—ɗum ko maale saɗeende sabbaende, ɗum yaawi wonugo pneumonia (junngo ndagu ɓowdi) walla asma.

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:**

1. **Yah suudu safaara law law** – ɓingel wondugo e fofugo saɗtungo e ndiyam jumjum ko emergency, o foti heɓugo balen sabbaende (oxygen) e safaari.

2. **O foti heftaade** – so ɓingel ina nyawi (fever) e fofugo saɗtungo, ɗum yaawi wonugo pneumonia, ndeen o hokketee safaari antibiotics.

3. **Malaria e junngo** – yiyde ɗereeji mako (blood test, malaria test) ko waɗɗii sabu duɓi tati ɓe heewi heɓugo malaria e junngo raɓɓi.

Wata a jeytu—ɓingel fofugo saɗtungo ko saɗeende timmunde; yah safaara jooni tafon.

question: goɗɗo ɓe noddata subeeru duuɓi makko cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowuru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko
answer: Subeeru, nyawu fayin ɗon ɓuwa semmbe, amma suudugo dahaanu ɗon haɗa leɗɗe ɗen gollugo no haani, ɗum waɗi ƴowru maaɗa warti. A haani a acca dahaanu fuu kakkilano, ngam ɗum ɗon bona foofaandu maa ɗon haɗa nyawu ngun nyamɗitugo. A yara leɗɗe fayin ɗe nyawtoowo on hokki maa ɗen fuu bana o wi'iri, a accataa nyande go'o haa lebbi jeegom ɗi timma. A nyama nyaamdu moɓɓundu ngam ɓeydugo semmbe ɓanndu, nden a warta nyawdorde ngam ɓe ƴeewa se ɗujja maaɗa ɗon maaya. So a waɗi ɗum, a heɓan jam ɓanndu maa, ƴowru ndun yaha, a foofan no haani.

question: da da danyi keccel sati didi ko sali do o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha bandu mako amma balde ji o dilla ni o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam do vurta wakkati fere dada bingel mai do canji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai den bo o handi dada bingel do o don mara nawugo redu sedda sedda ha less jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do berde mako do saka o do tampi ko irin damuwaji do don non fedata bawo dayugo ko damuwa fere don don yande je o yahi asibiti be o do volwa be dadirabe fere se o nani ta be hosa mere kala hundeji be lari fu fe'ata ha bandu mabbe kanjum wadi mo o yidi o lara likita o volwinabe bemde am dume don waddata irin hundeji do bawo dayugo wawan nawugo les redu alama yeu don na alamaji toy dada kesum handi watta hakkilo bawo dayugo mataki toy dada do handi tokka heba yeu do heba mo
answer: Iyam dottiidam, nawugo les reedu, ɓernde diwaya, e tampiri ɗi daada yi'ata sati ɗiɗi ɓaawo danyugo wanaa alhaali laaɓuɗo; ɗum alamaaji heddere neesa (retained placenta) luttunɗi nder reedu malla nyawu mbuuɓri (infection) sabboojum ustaare iyam. question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer:
Ɗum ko hattande ƴiiƴam heewɗam caggal danygol, ko noon ɓingel ngel e yumma mum poti seerdeede; ɓoggol ngol (umbilical cord) ina foti sëreede (clamp) e taƴeede e laawal cellal ngam hisnude ɓingel ngel e caɗeele ɗee.
Ɓoggol ngol wota ƴoggire e doole sabu ɗum yaafataa yaltinde dango ngoo, tee ko ɗum tooñata ɓingel ngel bana no o heɓi ƴaañgol nii.
Yumma oo ina haani hokkeede ndiyam ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) e leɗɗe bana Oxytocin walla Misoprostol ngam wallitde reedu nduu dartinde ƴiiƴam ɗam e yaltinde dango ngoo.
So dango ngoo yaltinaako ko yaaji, doktoor ina foti waɗde njaltugol juuɗe (manual removal of placenta) e nder suudu nyawndeeje ngam haɗa asmaaji baawɗi warde.
Titorde e ƴaañgol ɗe ɓingel ngel heɓi ɗee, ina haani ƴeewteede ko yaaji e juuɗe gollooɗo cellal ngam tabitinde balɗe mum caggal danygol (APGAR) e rokkude mo safaara potɗo.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer:
Bismillah. Ndaa ko mi yi'i e ɗemngal daaɗo:

Nawnaare ndee no wa'i wa **anemia mawnde (severe anemia)** je ɗon habda be dama mai (malaria) e nawnaare ummii be redu. Ɓeydari sembe iyam (blood transfusion) bee lekki dama no boɗɗum, ammaa ko ɓuri himmude, ɗum ɗon foti yeecude sabaabu maggo: yara hundeji fere (fatigue), uppa yeeso (facial swelling), namuki hore, e bandu fu hoore-nawnaare — ɗum fuu ina holla anemia ummi be nawnaare mawnde wolla nawnaare ɓernde.

Miɗo waawi wi'a hankadi tawa mo joonde ndaa ɗiin: **kaɗe redu (kidney)** wolla **ɓernde (heart failure)** foti wonde sabaabu uppki yeeso e bandu, kañum ɓuri wa'ude be dama mai jaɓɓungol. Ɗum waɗi tawa be waɗugo mo:
- **Urine test (fii proteins e redu)** e **kidney function test**,
- **Blood film for malaria parasites** e **full blood count**,
- **Hemoglobin electrophoresis** (sabu sickle cell ina waawi wonde e Nigeria).

Miɗo yeecoo mo ustaa mo he **hospital mawndu (referral)** ɗo woodi doctor mo nawnaare cukalel (pediatrician) e specialist redu, sabu nawnaare ndee no wa'i mawnde, alaa e sago wattee lekki tan e community hospital.

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
answer: Ɓingel maa wanii ko nyau sautu ɓuuɓɗum (severe pneumonia) ngam o ɗo fofa kadi ɓernde makko ɗo yaha jippa (chest in-drawing), ɗum ko ɗum waɗi o wawata nyamugo. Maande ɗe ko yaasiɗe ɗe mbaawi bonnude nguurndam makko, ɗum nafataa ko ari lekki kemist ɗen tan. Aɗa nyaami yahde e makko to opitaal saawre jooni ngam o heɓ kammu (oxygen) e inndeeji leɗɗe (antibiotics) ngam hisnude nguurndam makko. Tawde nyau nguu duumiino ko lewru, doktoor en ɗon ƴeewnda mo nyau wutte hono TB ngam anndude ko nafata mo. Wuru hokka mo lekki goɗɗi e saare maa waɗa caɗe, yahngan yeeso e opitaal woni ko safrata ɗum.

answer: Ɓinngel maa ngel no jogii rafi "hernia" (pittol remirde), kono jooni remirde nden sokaama haa ɓanti no muusi, ɗum ko jaawgol oparasiyoŋ (surgical emergency). Moftugol kare ngel nawoowo o waɗi ɓeydii bonnude rafi o, haa waawi warde remirde nden (necrosis) so nde wurtinaaka law. Woto a jaɓu seka ngel walla a yaara e nawoowo, sabu ɗum ɓeydat tan rafi o haa ngel maaya. Yaaw nawnude ngel e opitaal mawɗo ngam dokotooɓe ɓe mbaɗa ngel oparasiyoŋ (surgery) ngam wurtina remirde nden e nder pittol ngol. So a yaawii, oparasiyoŋ on sellinat ngel haa ngel arta e cellal, Alla jaɓii.

question: duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi neɓai mi danyi balɗe jeɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on mi danyi mi hirriti dow to miɗon musuni keccel am ɗo yarnama bone musugo to o musuni seɗɗa ni se o itta hunduko mako tomi habdi musugo mo fahin se o musuni seɗɗa o itta hunduko se mi numi ko haɗi mo musugo boɗɗum se mi herriti oɗo mari damba wala fofa boɗɗum bana ɓingel ɗo hara bannin mi nanata ɓofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am ovi tema de miɗon danya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo mi numi to ndiyam nasti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min koɓuri pusugo am ɓerde ma kanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am walai o wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai tomi waɗi sembe tomi yiɗi o musina sai tomi findinimo o musina seɗɗa to fottinimo mi yiɗi mi ema dow sababu pewol man je o wala foofa be boɗɗum ɗo bo de o foofi fu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum
answer: Jaɓɓama miyirawo, yaasi ɓingel ma balɗe jeɗiɗi ɗo asibiti jooni-jooni, ngam salaago musungo bee caɗeele foofugo ko kuuje masiibe (danger signs) to ɓii-keccel. Bolle ndiyam nasti hoore mako wakkati danygol na goonga sam, amma kine sukkiiɗe e waɗa o ronga musungo ngam keccel kine mum tan foofirta wakkati oɗon musa. Caɗeele ɗo kadi e nanda bee nyau pewol mawngo (neonatal sepsis malla pneumonia) je nasta ɓii-keccel law-law. Likita'en asibiti laran mo, ɓe ɓuuta kine mako bee ndiyam gila (saline drops), kadi ɓe narna mo lekkiuji masiibe ngam o yamɗita. Ta ɓennu wakkati sam, yah asibiti jooni ngam hissinggo yonki ɓingel ma.

question: addirawo am danyi ɓinngel debbo balɗe saali sey o laari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo wala foofa boɗɗum wakkati feere ɓinngel man yofta kosam bamo fofɗe maako ta'i yande woore daada ɓinngel timmini musungo mo bee jemma sey o laari leɓɓi ɓinngel ba wala ba wayliti seɗɗa seɗɗa sey o tampi ko o waɗata sey o goɗi ɓamtugo ɓinngel man ngam o heɓa o foofa boɗɗum ammaa bo ɓinngel gaagiri foofugo boɗɗum bee boo canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel man sey o yaawi o hoosi ɓinngel o yaari asibiti ngam ɓe laaranamo ɓinngel may ɗume on canjini ɓinngel man leɓɓal nden bo walaa aybe no ɓinngel foofata na ko bo nyawuɓe nde walla nyawu hanta dasinta ɓinngel man foofugo bee bone ɗume on alaamaaji kalluɗum jee saarooji waatinta hakkiilo ɗume on agaji ɓe waawata hokkugo ɓinngel mo foofata bee bone
answer:
Kaydi ngon ki foti wonde **RSV** (respiratory syncytial virus) walla nyawu foofowal ngal hanaa ɓinngel keewngel, ko wa'i bana pneumonia (nyawu jofdu) walla bronchiolitis (yaltirde foofowal seɗɗitiima).

**Alaamaaji kalluɗi (danger signs) ɗi ndaartetee:**
- Ɓinngel foofowirta bee bone (yaawugo foofugo, nafra becce mum ka ley coyngal), ɓannde mum coyta wojjere walla bulaare (cyanosis)
- Ɓinngel salii ɗaɗɗugo kosam walla haala mum, ronki walla wonti pahaango
- Nguleeki ɓamtii sanne walla ngulaari fewnaa
- Ɓinngel foofowirta yaawnde no feewi (RR ɓamtii) walla foofugo mum darii seɗɗa (apnea)

**Ko waɗetee:**
Ɓe foti hokkugo ɓinngel **oxygen** ngam foofugo mum feewa, ɓe hokka mo **antibiotic** si nyawu bakteriya woni, ɓe ndaara si RSV walla nyawu feere woni. question: Dana kesum ko danya e ha asibiti amen minti cappanɗe ɗiɗi ko waɗi ɓingel waɗi nuɗum danyi woya woya teli nude danya ngel wadai woyade boɗɗum min yiwi fu nanugo mako tidum no bingel delabi tan mi yiwi kadi tamreji mako tidum no alai nalle mako ko dume. answer: Ngam ɓingel kesum tampi e danygol, fooftuki mako tiiɗi e o waawaa woygo boɗɗum ngam o walaa semmbe. Baawo o faɗɗiti e ɗoyngol, jamu mako e semmbe mako fuu wartan lawlaw.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
answer: Dum woni alaamaji nyau jiberde (*postpartum depression*), ndu woni nyau herbiingu her rewbe janybe jotta. Nyau ndu o waawa torrugo ngendam mako be mbeendam binngel mako boo, nden o yiidi be ballal be munyu diga banndu mako. Alaamaji mawdi handi ndarreeri woni to o woodi miilooji torrugo hoore mako, binngel mako, ko kadi to o waawa ta wallugo binngel ngel. Dum woodi faayda be njaara mo asibiti jotta gam be ndarra mo be mballa mo be caawara boo. Mballen mo bee yidde, munyu, be laarugo hakkilo mako gam seyo mako warta.
