question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Innde maa Tilola, ɗaande ɓingel maa yaltude ndee ko ɓuuɓri (umbilical hernia) keewnde e suukaaɓe, kono zazzabi e reedu mum ƴuuɓde ko dente kulɓiniiɗe. Ɗuum waawi wonde ko ɗaande makko heɓi ñawu (infection) walla ko caɗe e nder reedu, ɗum noon ko haani ƴeewndaade to opitaal ko yaawi. Hoto ndokku mo leɗɗe ɗe doktoor ɗaɓɓaani ɗe walla leɗɗe aadaaji, wuro tee naw mo to doktoor jooni ngam ƴeewtude. Doktoor maa waɗ ƴeewndo laboratuwaar e ƴeewnde reedu ngam anndude ko faŋka zazzabi o ngam o heɓa safaara moƴƴo. Tawa ko ɗaande yaltude ndee heewi woppiteede hoore mum caggal ɗuum, kono zazzabi oo e tiiɗnaare reedu ina haani safrteede ko yaawi ngam haɗde caɗe cellal.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
answer: Ɓingel ngel ɗon mari rafi pofɗe e ɗofaare (neonatal sepsis/pneumonia) sabu rimayel e ndiyam dargo, den haaje arande woni hokkugo oxygen ngam wallugo pofɗe mako. Min mannga laawol nder ɓanndu (IV line) ngam hokkugo lekki Ampicillin be Gentamicin ɗi tiggata rafi ɓingel ngel, be ndiyam nder ɓanndu (IV fluids) seɗɗa. Min tila dada mako hokkugo ɓiraaki tan, o woppa ndiyam dargo ɗam sabu ɗum ɗon ɓeyda rafi. Min reena ɓingel ngel ha nder ward ngam en ndaara pofɗe, nguleeki ɓanndu, e ɗofaare mako kala wakkati. Ɗum ɗon laara laawol WHO ngam cellugo ɓiɓɓe rimayel ɓe ngala pofɗe moƴƴe, ɗum wallan ɓingel ngel heɓugo cellal.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
answer:
Ko ɓuri waɗde ɓinngel no sali keccal sabu hunduko oo ena nawi (kanyum: hulaare/“thrush”, ɗamɗamol, nyiɓɓe/dental, walla ɗonɗe/noppi), walla ɗum ko latch/moƴƴude muynude ngal waɗi naange.
Alaa damba e fufa moƴƴa ko ceertu, amma so o salii muynude, o weeyii, walla o ɗon waɗa ndiyam ndiyam seeɗa (pampers ndiyam <6 e ɓalɗe), yah to asibiti/MCH ɗoon ɗoon ngam ɓe ndaaru hunduko, noppi, kilo e dehydration.
Hoto a doole mo keccal; ƴettu ɗam keccal ɗonɗon, hokku mo e koppu/spoon/cup, ngam o heɓa ñaamdu haa ɓe ndaaru mo.
So a yi’i ɗane-ɗane e hunduko walla keccal maa ena nawi/ena uddi, likita/CHO maa hokku nystatin walla dawa moƴƴo, ɗum hoto jeyaa ɗon.

answer: Dada fere hakkili layi, ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Eey, ɗuum ko feere moƴƴere e safrugol makko nde tawno o waawaa jogaade meɗe feɗugo (ORS) sabu ko o rufata kala. Rokkude mo darnata iyam (IV fluids) ko yaaji ko himmende no feewi ngam artirde ndiyam nder ɓanndu e hisnude yonki makko. Poti rokkude mo kadi bateji (injections) ngam daɗndude rufgol ngol, e lekkiji ngam safrude 'puseni' (ƴeewndo reedu) walla rufgol 'redu' (ƴiiƴam) so tawii ko ɗuum o mari. Ɗuum fof ko laawol potngol ngam safrude ŋakkere ndiyam e mboro ko wayi no gastroenteritis. Kono doktoor ina poti jokkude ƴeewnda mo ngam tabitnde ko fijata ɗum, haa e ƴeewnude ƴiiƴam makko ngam rokkude mo safrugol ngo moƴƴi.

question: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
answer: Sabbabi danya ndiyam nasti hore mako ko ɓarɗe ɓe fofidda (malnutrition) ko maɓe ɓe fofidda (infection) e ɗiɗi neɓai. E ɗiɗi neɓai, ɓe yiɗi ɓe mido ɓe fofidda kono ɓe mido ɓe ɗiɗi neɓai (anemia) ko ɓe mido ɓe fofidda (malaria) e ɓe mido ɓe fofidda (parasites). Mi numi ko haɗi mo musugo boɗɗum se mi herriti oɗo mari damba wala fofa boɗɗum bana kono ɓe mido ɓe fofidda (dehydration) ko ɓe mido ɓe fofidda (diarrhea) ko ɓe mido ɓe fofidda (cholera). question: debbo jomu redu reduma lebbi jewego minɗo wondi saare gotel fuɗɗi hirugo dow ɓernde maako ɗo fiya be lawlaw a viya mo timmini doggugo jottam wakkati fere bo oɗo soma ko o huway ko ɗume debbo jungo maako ɗo hawtidira seɗɗa satiji saali seɗɗa o lari dande maako ɗo uppa hedi yeso sai o hultiri oɗo numa ɗo kam ɗo nder nyawu damata jomu redu na ko bo ɗum nyawu fere on sai o taski nyawugo lara likita ngam o anda ɗume sanadu nyawɗo emol haɗo ɗume on waddini debbo redujo ɗo fiyal ɓerde be law law ɗo a viya mo timmini doggugo nden bo ɗume on sanadu uppugo dande ɗo nden bo irin nyawu ɗo kam wawan mema mawnugo ɓingel redu mako ɗo na ɗume on alamaji kalluɗum je ɓe wattinta gite hasare ba irin nyawu ko kuje yareyareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko ɓeddata nyawugo ha irin wakkati ɗo
answer:
Debbo reduujo mo lebbi 6, ɓernde fijra lawlaw e mettere dow ɓernde, hawti e uppagol dande (goiter), ina waawi wonde ko maande nyawu "hyperthyroidism" (gollol thyroid ɓeydii).
Ndeeɗoo wonnde so nde safraaka, ina waawi mema mawnugol ɓingel e addude jibineede e ɓingel tedduɗo walla reedu yahde ko yaawi.
O foti yaawde yahude to doktoor ngam ƴeewndaade, waɗa ƴiiƴam ƴeewndorɗam thyroid, ngam anndude caɗeele ɗee e fuɗɗoode.
Alamaaji kulɓiniiɗi ɗi poti ndaarɗeede : ɓernde fijra haa heewi (ko ɓuri 120 e nder hoɗorde), ɓanndu nguleeki, boɗɗol, tampol mawngol, walla reedu fuɗɗaago mettinde.
So o anndinaama, o waawi huutorgo leɗɗe antithyroid hono propylthiouracil (PTU) e leɗɗe ɗe paltata ɓernde (beta-blocker) e dow laawol doktoor; o haɗee ñaameteeɗi baɗɗi iyod ceertuɗi, o daɗɗu kulol, o rewi toppitagol haa saanga ronki.

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. Lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwini mo sei o vi o dilli tan o yahi a sibiti heɓa ɓe hefta ko fe’ata be petul damuwa ɗo wawan hoina ɓingal ɗo damuwa ɓerde na ko asma ɗon fe’ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toi ɗon handi ɓingel ɗo handi acca heɓa ko. damata mo wadinta mo o dodda ho’ina mo usta sosai.
answer: Nyau ɓernde caggal danygol (peripartum cardiomyopathy) waɗi ko ɓernde maako yaafake balɗe seeɗa ɓaawo o danyi, ɗum waɗi o heɓata fooftere, ɗojjuki jemma, o waawa ɗaanago lelnaago, kadi ina waawi nanndude e asma haa ɓe njuumta. To suudu safrirdu ɓe poti hollude ɗum woni rafi ɓernde, ɓe kokka mo lekki ƴeetinoowo ndiyam ɓandu (diuretic) e wasiyaaji ustugo lamɗam (sosai) ngam hisnugo ɓernde. Mi wasiyake o woppu lekki gargajiya ɗin, o yahu suudu safrirdu mawndu ngam waɗdee echocardiogram, to annduɓe ɓernde mbaawa toppitaago mo e lekki jaɓɓaaka.

answer: Eey, ko ɓuri teeŋtude e alkawaliji ɗin ko ma ñawu jeyan shuga (diabetes mellitus), ko wayi no yarde ndiyam keewɗam, duƴƴe geɗe heewɗe kollirteeɗe e jamma, famɗude teddeendi ɓanndu, e ronooɓe. Ko kadi geɗe goɗɗe mbaawi waɗde ɗum ko wayi no kuutorgol leɗɗe aadaaji ɗe nganndaaka walla ñawbuuli mawɗi, kono omo naamni ƴeewndo toɓo ƴiiƴam (blood sugar test) to safrirde ngam tabitinde. Alamaaji jeyan shuga potɗi anndeede ko heewde yarde ndiyam, duƴƴe geɗe keewɗe, heblaare duumiinde, e famɗude teddeendi ɓanndu ɗe nganndu-ɗaa ko ɗe njiytata omo waawi heɓde safaa. E nguurdam, omo waawi ñaamude cereeji e ƴiye keewɗi ɗi ngalaa shuga keewɗo, o woppa yarde njaram ɗam shukaare, o yaro ndiyam laaɓɗam. Tiiɗno nawo mo to doktoor ko yaawa ngam ƴeewndude mo, woto o wondir heen leɗɗe aadaaji tawa ƴeewndo waakaani, nde tawnoo ɗe mbaawa bonnude koyngal (kidney) e heedu (liver) makko.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer:
# Nafarki Debbo Rufoowo Iyam (Postpartum Hemorrhage)

Ndee jamre ko haala **rufugo iyam ko ɓura keerol ɓaawo jibinugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage)**, ko woni musiiba mawɗo e nder sibiti, ɓe foti hentaade law-law.

**Ko foti waɗeede jaka:**

1. **Massage Uterus** – Ɗabbaade reedu debbo (fundus) e junngo, saka'u no yaawi fii yo reedu 'e hoora, sabu ko heewi rufugo iyam ummii e reedu ndu waɗtaani hoorde.

2. **Lekkiiji darnayɗi iyam** – Rokku **Oxytocin (10 IU IM/IV)** ko woni lekki gadanki; so alaa maa yonaani, rokku **Misoprostol (800mcg)** walla **Ergometrine** (so debbo alaa ñaw ɓernde/hypertension).

3. **Yonki (fluids)** – Habbir laawol ɗiɗi (IV lines) mawɗi, rokku **Normal Saline walla Ringer's Lactate** law fii yo yiiyam mum artu, saka'u eɓɓu **iyam heɓaneede (blood transfusion)** so debbo ustii yiiyam sanne.

4. **Ndaaru sabaabu:** Ndaaru so tawii jibinaani fof (retained placenta), walla ɓoli 'e leyɗe jibinirde ɓoli (vaginal/cervical tear) yo mooɓe, sabu ɗiin no rufina iyam.

Roƴu debbo o sibiti mawɗo (referral) so lekkiiji e katanɗe alaa e sibiti maa, sabu ndee jamre no wara law.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
answer: Rufugo iyam ɓurɗum ɓaawo danyugo ɗon saabo bee ranga ɓaawo danyugo koo luttuɗum haa nokkuure ɓiɗɗo, kanjum waɗi ɓandu ma ɗon feyi, a ɗon somi kadi ngam ɓuytol iyam. Likita ɗon laɓɓina joonde ɓingel (cleaning the womb) ngam ittugo ko lutti boo, bee hokkugo lekkiji bana *oxytocin* koo *misoprostol* ngam darnugo iyam ɗon. Ngam lornugo sembe ma e iyam ma, min ɗon hokkay ma lekki darnoojum iyam bana *tranexamic acid*, wattingo iyam (blood transfusion) bee lekkiiji darnuɗe iyam bana *iron*. Min hokkay ma lekkiji *antibiotics* ngam reenugo koo yaɓɓugo mborndi (infections) haa nder ɓandu ma. Bee ɗum, a loran jam, ɓandu ma sembiɗa mbele a hakkila bee ɓingel ma no haandi.

question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma
answer: Ndee ɗo woni ko haani yaawde no feewi, sabu toowgol sembe iyam (168/100) e ɓuutol yeeso e juuɗe ɗon holla wonde ɓokki (kidneys) walla ƴiiƴam hore ɗon e caɗeele mawɗe (hypertensive emergency). Sey ɓe nawta mo asibiti mawɗo ngam ɓe mbaɗa ƴeewgol hore (CT scan) e ƴeewgol ɓokki (renal tests) ngam anndugo to ɗum woni "stroke" walla caɗeele ɓokki. Lekki sembe iyam ki ɓe hokki mo kin ɗon moƴƴi, amma o haani heɓugo lekki ɗon yaawa ustugo sembe iyam (IV antihypertensives) nder ward. Wota o yaru safara guri (hunɗe jifere) kadi sam, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓeyda bone ɓokki maako e toowgol sembe iyam maako. Nder asibiti, sey ɓe ndaara no o ɗo yara, ɓe mbaɗa mo nyaamdu (diet) moƴƴuru, nden o hoota ɗo ƴeewte kullum ngam halkugo ɓuutol ngol.

question: daniel e kesum ko daniel e ha azibiti amin minti chappan de didi ko wadi bingel gel ena wadi nodum danye woyayi woyayi ta min yali noden danya gel wadayi woyande boddum min yiwi mufanago mako tidum nowadu kono bingel gel ena yidi ta min yiwi kadi tambereji mako tidum no ala chedele namle mako kodume wawi dami ɓingel kesum wadi no dum dami haa wayai en wadai wadade boɗɗum gele de danya har no je jamu wala jokkoderal darajagal ɓingel gel foti heɓɓe inna o warti wuro en ɓingel gel koɗume o wawi koɗum hokkude ɓingel gel sey ko ɗume o wawa hokkude har irin nyamdu inna ma nyamdu gam o wanna en jam tiɓɓingel gel ma waɗi en jam
answer:
Mi yiɗi hollude ma ɗum ko himmi haa bunɗure:

**Ko woni ɗum:** Ɓingel maa kesum ena foti heɓde **hakkilo ngesa (jaundice)** - ɗum ko nde terɗe ɓingel wonta oolde (yellow), gite mum kadi wonta oolɗe. Ɗum ena heewi e ɓikkoy kesum, ɓuri heewde e ñalɗe tati haa jeeɗiɗi.

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:**
1. **Wattu ɓingel haa azibiti law-law** - ndaɗi ɓe ndaru ɓingel, ɓe ƴeewa toɓɓere oolde nder ƴiiƴam (bilirubin test).
2. **Waɗ ɓingel yeeso naange (phototherapy)** so tan tawa oolde ko heewi - ndaari azibiti so eɓe mari kaɗeele naange.
3. **Ɓamtu ɓingel enɗam law-law e sahaaji keewɗi** (ñalnde 8-12 laawol) - enɗam ummba oolde nde tumbita.
4. **Hokku ɓingel enɗam tan** - taa hokku ndiyam maa nyaamdu goɗɗum.

**Tinno:** So ɓingel jaɓaani muyde, so ena ɗaanoo no feewi, so terɗe mum kadi ena mari oolde haa cegeneeji, ɗum ko **caɗtudi mawndi** - wattu haa azibiti jooni jooni. Oolde ndeen so ɓeydii, ena waawi wonde bone hakkille ɓingel.

Yah azibiti jooni, taa habbo!

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
answer:
Ɗum ɗo woodi e ma ɓurti nanndude e **hulde mawnde/panic attack**, tee sabu ko gorko mako yaltina ɗum, en foti hollude so woodi **wuyde, haɓɓude, nyandeede walla jeyal cuusol e suudu**.
O foti ari sibiti ngam aawtagol: ɗoctor yoƴƴina mo, ƴeewta so wala ciki, cuta ɓernde, jinni fanɗude, thyroid, walla ɗum ko damuwa/hakkillo.
So gorko mako ina lorina mo walla ina waɗa mo hulde, ko arande: **o yaha e nokku kisal**, o haalana neɗɗo koolniiɗo, ardo’en jeyal, Women Affairs/social welfare, ko polisi so jam mako ina haɗii.
Lekki gargajiya ngam ɗum hinaa doole; ɗoctor fitina mo e counselling, dabaru no hendo-seyde/huutoraade, tee so woni ɗuuɗi, lekki damuwa/panic no sertraline walla ko ɗoctor waɗi.
So ɓernde ina dogga no feewi, o va’a, o hokkita ngam, walla o yiɗi bonnude hoore mako, **ɓe yaha emergency ɗoon ɗoon**.

answer: Debbo on ko gadiɗo jibineede (primigravida) kadi redu makko ɓuri lewru nayaɓuru (post-term), ɗum ɓeydirta baasre ko ɓingel ngel ɗo yahataa nder wuro (obstructed labor). question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.
answer: Goji e tayre kerdake ɓuri heɓugo sabu ɓingel dodataa nono no haandi ko wala ɓingel woodi nyawu "thrush" ha hunuko. Ngam wannugo ɗum, tilay a lora ɓingel har nono haa ɓingel nata koful nono (areola) fuu, wana kerdake tan. Likitoci maa waɗu jarribol e fuɗɗo **antibiotic/ceftriaxone** law, ɗum woni ko ɓuri haɗani mo.

question: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa yaron yana da matsalar numfashi (respiratory distress) wadda ke bukatar magani nan take. Useni, ɓingel maa lebbi jowi ɗon mari caɗeele fofugo mawɗe, nden ɗum kuugal gariwal lekki (asibiti) hennyitii ngam hismugo yonki makko joni-joni.

Taa huuturu sirupuuji kata koo damba ndiyam gulum haa kine walla ɓaawo makko, ngam ɗum darnataa caɗeele fofugo man nden boo ɗum mawninan nyawu man.

Doktoor'en asibiti booɗɗum ngadata mo aawno kine, nden ɓe kokka mo oksijin (oxygen) be lekkiiji kaandiiji ngam udditugo kine makko e wallugo mo o fofa bee jam.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
answer:
Sannu ma, bana likitaajo, miɗo tabbitinane ɓingel ma wala ndiyam nder hoore bana daada gorko ma wi'i; ko dammata mo ko kine makko ɗe sukki (peewol), ngam ɓikkon keccoy kine tan ɓe kuutortoo to ɓe ɗon foofa.

Ngam kine ɗen ɗon sukki, o waawaa foofaago bee boɗɗum to o ɗon musina, kanjum waɗi o musinan seɗɗa o acca ngam o heɓa pofɗe, kadi kanjum haɗata mo lelaago boɗɗum.

Ngam wallugo mo, soodu lekki kine (Normal Saline drops) haa kemis, to a ɗon faalaa musingo mo a toɓɓa toɓɓere wootere nder kine makko fuu ngam ɗe maasa nden sukkoode man waɗɗa.

Kadi, ɓuuwna ɓingel ngel boɗɗum ngam peewol, nden a tokka musingo mo bee munyal dow gado.

Ammaa to a yi'i o ɗon foofa bee wakkuli masin, gabaare makko ɗon looha, koo bo ɓanndu makko ɗon wuli (fever), waddamo asibiti wakkati maajum ngam min ndaara mo.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
answer: Nyawu dattijo on ko Cerebrospinal Meningitis (nyawu ƴiiƴam haa nder hoore), ko nyawu bonɗo saakteteeɗo e mboros hono kokhaku e fiiɗde. Alamaaji makko ɗii ko ɓuuɓri, ƴeewndo hoore tiiɗnde, ɓuuɓri daande, e mboros ɓanndu, ɗum fof ko baakteeriya waɗata ɗum. Omo haani nawteede safrirde jaajol ngam heɓde safaara nder ƴiiƴam (IV antibiotics) ngam hisnude nguurndam makko, sabu leɗɗe walla safaara galleeji maa njaɓaa ɗum. Nyawu nguu ina saaktoo, ɗum waɗi woɗɓe ina poti seerndi e makko haa o safriraa. Yimɓe ɓe nganndi e makko no feewi ina poti kadi yahde doktoor ngam heɓde toɓɓe (safaara) ngam haɗde heɓde ñawu nguu.

question: min lilibin ge am suda bafe wedu kenya kiki be ana min taji sappa hejoyi hosamin o warti wuro o wulla komin ki'a min mo kofeti e wolwali ni am bosarun ngati hoste mako mi ki'a min ma dume kala bosaro on toi dunduroyi kodin bosaru kindira benon wakati den mi wudani mo nebban ha balba bosaro ngati mo gan bun wara to hokke bosaro dun be hokki am shawara mi yara mo asibitin daniul derekindira den be windani bate tentanos mi yaha mi soda ha kemist mi sodi bate on tufi modun kenya mi yari mo wuro amma laki nya futere man dunti no kure non wojji jotta kam hakkilo am ummi e mi tammi bosaru dun hokki binge am nyandu bosaru nyandu bosaru mi do 'yama wodi likki ko mi sodin tsana mon ko mi yara mosi a sibiti beron bedala rokkomo
answer:
Mi faami ɓiɗɗo ma nanngaama e nyawu tetanos, o hokkaama likki tetanos toxoid asibiti. Kono, hakke bosaru dun (bosaru dun harata) ana hulɓinii sanne—wonaa haala mo suusataa.

**Ko foti waɗeede jonta:**
- **Yaɓɓinu ɓiɗɗo ma asibiti law-law**, ngati bosaru dun harɗi ana waawi hollude tetanos ko ana ɓeydii bonande, walla infekshon (marowu) ana no.
- Woɗɗitaa nde ɓiɗɗo maa yara likki e hoore mun tan; tetanos ko nyawu bonngu no waawi warde ɓiɗɓe famɓe.
- Duktar ana foti ƴeewde bosaru dun, hokka likki marowu (antibiotics) e ceppitgol tetanos so ana haani.

Mi weeɓndaa e hokkugol likki keeriingu—yaɓɓinu asibiti hakkunde law walla ontuma ontuma.

question: da da danyi keccel sati didi ko sali do o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha bandu mako amma balde ji o dilla ni o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam do vurta wakkati fere dada bingel mai do canji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai den bo o handi dada bingel do o don mara nawugo redu sedda sedda ha less jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do berde mako do saka o do tampi ko irin damuwaji do don non fedata bawo dayugo ko damuwa fere don don yande je o yahi asibiti be o do volwa be dadirabe fere se o nani ta be hosa mere kala hundeji be lari fu fe'ata ha bandu mabbe kanjum wadi mo o yidi o lara likita o volwinabe bemde am dume don waddata irin hundeji do bawo dayugo wawan nawugo les redu alama yeu don na alamaji toy dada kesum handi watta hakkilo bawo dayugo mataki toy dada do handi tokka heba yeu do heba mo
answer:
Iyam e kureeji (clots) vurtooji ɓaawo danygol satti ɗiɗi nandi e heddungo kuuje danygol nder reedu (retained placenta/membranes) malla jonte nder saare danygol, kanjum waddata nawalla les reedu. Tampiri e ɓurtugo ɓernde ma ɗon waddama ngam ustagol iyam (anemia) malla kuuje mettamɓernde ɓaawo danygol.

Kujeji meeraaji ɗi dada kesum haandi lara ngam hakkilango yo: to iyam ɗon vurta ko heewi, urdi mbonndi ɗon vurta, jontere ɓanduu, malla nawalla reedu burtuka. Haandi a yaha asibiti yaasi ngam likita’en ndara ma, ɓe njuurto to woodi kuuje keddiɗe nder reedu ma mbel ɓe njaara ma lobbo.

Kadi, tokkugo yaadu asibiti ɓaawo danygol (postnatal care) e heɓugo siwtaare be nyaamdu lobbu ɗon wallita dada kesum sanne ngam heɓugo sellingo timmungo.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer:
Kamar yadda kike bayani, pingeel maa ko ina yiɗi e ndiyam yɔrɗi ngam kaɓɓe njiɗɗo, ɗum naɗi ko alama dow njangu (infection) e feccere.
Hoto maa jogii kala, haa waɗa ko fii yitere: feccitorde ndiyam-dum e sabulu, ligge beere (warm compress) ko sappo e sappo ɗum, tee rewti e herde ɗum haa a wala jikkirde dow feccere.
Hoto maa, to a waawi, njah to asibiti ngam gandal: doktor maa waawi addude magani njangu (antibiotic) e cilirde naange ngam heɓde zafi, kisa ngam yaltude feccere.
Hoto maa, hoto no feccere njiɗɗo, ko feewi a yarbude ko ɓuri, ko a haɓɓude oɗon jokkude seŋa, walla ko zazzabi tawii, ngal ko alama to a waɗi njangu mawɗo, njah asibiti ko yaawde.
Rewti haɓɓude “cut” e razor e kala feccere, sabu ko ɗum mbaawi addude njangu maa.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Ɗojugo mai amma mi lari accdai joɗugo ha sare to mi dilli be fajira se a warta jego dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala deɓi wakkati yonugo min ɗo yona min nana ko ɗo yecca am woɓɓe. Ɓingel ambi joi on kosam ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi dayi miɗo kosam mi yarni mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗo hokka mo. Nyamduuji kala kala bana gaari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yardi amma fofugo mako dana o fofi ba dan o vowi fofugo ba o wala fufa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat. vidum be hande wakkati o do yiwa mo be fajira sanga o naftiri ndiyam jumjum ha kine mako be haberde mako gam ndamba mai sati fofugo mai fuddi o acci fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acca kuseni. on min naftirta hamaku je acca tabba mai kuma hala fufugo mai je lebbi die waɗata mum kuma min wadata hala fufugo boɗɗum. haɗata mo fufugo.
answer: Ɓingel mako ngel ina waawi wonde e rafi fofugo (asthma) walla rafi ɓuuɓri ɓernde, sabu ɓernde mako ina sukki kadi accugo nyamugo kosam neene ko yaasi ina ɓeyda rafiiji fofugo. Acca hokkugo mo ndiyam jumjum walla hamaku sabu safaraaji gida ɗin ina mbaawi bonnugo ɓanndu mako walla ɓeydugo rafi o. Nawu mo asibiti ngam daktiijo o hefta ko woni ha ɓernde mako o hokku mo safaraaji ɗi mbeltinta fofugo (bana salbutamol) walla antibiotik to ko rafi ɓuuɓri. Hokku mo ndiyam ngulɗam e nyamdu moƴƴuru ngam wallitugo mo, amma to o fofi haa o waawaa fofugo no feewi walla ɓernde mako ina ɓilla, ɗum ko rafi tiiɗɗo, nawu mo asibiti kisan.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
answer:
**Nchi/faɗa:** Debbo ɗo mo warata (reɗujo) tan ina heɓa kulol mawngol, ɓernde dogga, semmbe iyam ummagol, e hakkilo bonngol si gorko mako warti sare. Ɗum ina wi'ee **damuna e kulol** (anxiety) maa **PTSD** (kulol ummaade e ko yani mo ko boni, ɗum woni ko wa'ata debbo ɗo si o tinaama maa o fiyaama).

**Ko o waɗata:**
1. Reftin mo to **sibiti mawɗo** maa wuro cellal (mental health clinic) ngam o yi'a doktoor haala hakkile (psychiatrist/counsellor), ɗum ɓuri lekki gargajiya.
2. Kulol ndemal (breathing exercises) e deƴƴere ina wallita si ɓernde dogga - o foota ndemal seɗɗa, o jaɓɓoo seɗɗa, ɗum ina ja'inɓo.
3. Ina jaati o daña **ballal to koye mum**: yimɓe belɗi ɓe o hoolii, maa jamaa'a, ngam kadi safaara kaŋko debbo ɗo woɗɗina mo e ko bonata mo.
4. So kulol ngol ina saɗti, doktoor ina waawi hokka mo lekki (SSRI wa'i sertraline) e counselling, kono ɗum sai to sibiti mawɗo.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer: Ɓingel ngel somi masin ngam bone danyuwol, kadi ngel ɗon fowta wakkati seɗɗa. Yiiwnee ngel lawlaw be ndiyam gulɗam ngam ɓandu tiddi ndu sako. Hokkee ngel njaram ndiyam sugaar ngam ngel heɓa sembe wokaago bana no handi. Soomee ngel boɗɗum nder bargooji, nden accee ngel ɗaanoo walaa dimbugo ngel koo seɗɗa. Walaa damuwa, to ngel ɗaani fowti, ngel ummoto jam ngel fuɗɗa nyamgo e wokaago.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
answer: Bingel o ɗon nder hadari masin ngam pofde mako ɗon ta'a, o ɗon mari jere, bo o acci musugo. Ta mbinndane mo lekki yahugo saare jonta, ngam bingel o ɗon mari haaje yaulugo asibiti ha dukkan laartogo pofde mako bee giccol mako. Sey ngadane mo goje-goje ƴiiƴam bee godɗum njaula ngam anndugo ko naddi nyau pneumonia ko godɗum. O ɗon mari haaje o jippine (admission) ngam o hokka lekkiji nder giccol (IV) bee oksijin to o ɗon mari haaje ngam pofde mako. Yaulugo asibiti jonta on wallata ngam hissinggo yonki bingel o diga hadari nyau man.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer:
commentary=Ina so in ji maka a takaice: bari in tsara amsa mai sauƙi da amfani bisa alamu da abin da ke iya jawo su.Alamaji ɗi nan sun fi kama da cutar kamuwa (kamar zazzaɓi da gudawa) fiye da “shuga”, amma yawan fitsari da yawan sha suna buƙatar a duba.
“Shuga” a yaro yawanci yana zuwa da yawan ƙishirwa sosai, yawan fitsari (har da kwantar da gado), da ramewa/raunin nauyi, ba tare da zazzaɓi da gudawa ba.
Ci gaba da ba shi ORS a ƙanana-ƙanana, ƙara zinc kamar yadda aka ba ku, da kuma ci/sha a hankali; ku ci gaba da shayar da nono idan yana samu.
Ku tafi asibiti idan yana ta amai har ba ya iya riƙe ruwa, idan fitsari ya yi zafi ko warin ban mamaki, idan gudawa ta yi jini, idan yana yin kasala sosai, ko idan zazzaɓi ya ci gaba.
A asibiti a gwada malaria, fitsari, da sukar (glucose) don tabbatar da musabbabin, domin gwaji ne kaɗai zai tabbatar da “shuga”.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer: Hunde satunde nde o yi'i nder enndu maako ɗum kossam maɓɓi malla nebbam ɓanndu nden wondi, walaa ko hulɓinta. Nyawu kanser enndu walaa waɗugo non, ngam kanser sey to ɗon naawa sosai wakkati fuu ɓaawo walngo kule man. Tura mo o wulna ndiyam ngulɗam o foya enndu man sosai bee semmbe haa hunde satunde man taara nder ɓanndu. O ɓeyda wujjugo mankanya malla ori nder jemma ngam nguleefi man hoosa hunde man fahin. Walaa haaje o yaha asibiti larugo se to enndu man fuɗɗi wurtungo ƴiiƴam malla ɗum pusi.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer: Nyau majum woni zazzabi pukoje, ɗum warata to ƴiiƴam ɓingel ɓuuti ngam pewri naati nder ɓandu. Hakkulungo arannde a waɗata, kanjum woni a saawa ɓingel man nder bargoore tekkunde ngam ngel wuuwa guli maajum. A wuja albasa dow tafal-tafalje kosɗe maggel ngam daɗɗugo dimbugo man law-law bako a yaha asibiti. Taa a meemu ɓandu maggel be ndiyam koo wujugo ngel ndiyam peewɗam, ngam ɗum ɓeydan dimbooje man. To ngel wulii guli ɗuɗɗum tan, zazzabi man fuu maayay nden ɓandu maagel fawata.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
answer:
Ɗum ko haala ko haɗari: semteende/fainting, chafi ɓernde, hendu ɗo metti, lornugo ɓalli, yawnugo/sweating, walla hakkillo ɗo wayli, ena waawi wonde ciwo ɓernde, BP mawɗo, suga lesɗo, malaria/jontinooje, walla stroke.
Yahee asibiti jooni ngam likita ƴeewta BP, suga, ECG, jini/malaria, ngam heɓa ko ɗum woni.
So chafi ɓernde ɗon juuti, hendu ɗo metti, o fainti, o waawaa haala/jahugo, walla ɓalli gooto lorna—ɗum ko emergency, ndeeɓndee mo asibiti ko gila ɗon.
Hoto hokkitee mo barasa, maganin gargajiya, walla magani nde likita hokkaa; waɗee mo ɗo fowru, hokka ndiyam seeɗa so o ɗo hakkille.
So ko ciwo ɓernde/stroke ɗum, waawi warude so a laatina, kono so a yahi asibiti law, jamde mum ena waawi hisaade.

question: Mini amodai we'e anɓɓa he jo jonamo o warti wuro o wulla, kominma ko fetiyam bosaru ha kosɗe mako me kala bo saru on toi ɗum ɗuroi koɗum bosaru kindiraɓe on wakkati nden meban ha balbe bo salun nga timmo ngam ɗum warake bo saru. mi yarama asibiti danyu dare kindira bate den tan mi yaha mi soda ha kemis mi sodi bata on ɗum tufuma ɗum kenya illa wakkati den mi yarima wuro amma lake man umti nokkure nanwoji jotta kam hakkila ammi hemi tammi bo sare ɗon hokki ɓingel nyamdu bo sare. mido nyama wodi lekki combiti larugo ko mo.
answer: Taa huli, tufaangal ngal keɓɗon haa kemis man he'i ngam faddaago kala nyawu bosaaru. Ngam bosaaru ndu'u waatake, tooke maajum maaydi bee maajum, ɗum waawataa naawugo ɓingel ma. Haɓɓu leffol cattuɗum dow nokkuure nde bosaaru man ŋati ngam haɗugo tooke yahugo ɓernde. Wujju nebbam boɗeejam wulɗum dow ɓuyam man ngam ɗum ɗaata naawalla usta. Hokku mo paracetamol tan o foofta haa wuro, walaa haaje lortugo asibiti.

question: Jam ɓandu likita waddi bingal amin larin no o fofata ɗon woni bana sautu hendu ɗo sala babal petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo dake o fofata milliti bo balɗe tati jotta o ɗo ɗotta be jamma wakkati fere mi ɗo lara ɓe ɗo nasta sosai. Ɗo sosai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako seto o naftira sembe mako o hokkata mi lari bo o wala nyama banani to o nyamai fu sauto nyamai fu sau to o nangi pofɗe mako seto nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokka tame oɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati. Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. To handini hotina heɓa famta ko damata mo be kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum irin nyaundi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha sare hoinina mo heɓa o fofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataki je hosata hado ɓingel ɗo.
answer: Sannu ma, mi faami damuwa ma dow pofɗe ɓingel ma ɗo. Sauti hendu bee dojugo ko nantaa ɗon ɗum alama peewol yoori nder ɓerde mako, ɗum wadi pofɗe mako ɗon tawee. Ngam hoinugo mo haa saare, jillandir nebbam boɗejam bee njuumri bulam hokka mo o yara ngam ɗum wujja ɗatal pofɗe mako laɓɓina hendu. Kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum ngam reedu mako ɗon meere kanko bo o ɗon naftira sembe, ngam maajum soodu lekki dojugo ɗaaningo (sedative) ngam o heɓa o fowta jamma. Walaa haaje doggugo asibiti jooni; to o yarii ɗum o ɗaaniima boɗɗum, pofɗe mako wartan daidai janngo.

question:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali, o yeti larugo likita. O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
answer:
Debbo wona en, ko wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala, o laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin, o fuddi on ha en, o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala, nden no wulata makko ko **aborsiyon** (janngo makko) walla **mokku makko** (ectopic pregnancy) walla **plasenta** wona ɗo wadda (placenta previa/abruption).

Nasaama: **Yeewa debbo wona jaango hospital walla sardo dokotoro jeego fow** ton e jam, to o wulata ko hakkilanta walla ko makko wona no wulata, toɗo o fof koɗɗo damuwa be mai sosai nden no wulata ko anemiya walla shock.

Dokotoro o sappata o wulata makko (vital signs), o yeeya damuwa (CBC, grouping), o yeeya echographie (ultrasound) ton o fahma sabaabu, kadi o reyda dewgal laawol (IV fluids, blood transfusion, oxytocics, walla surgiri) ton o balli makko walla o balli janngo makko.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer: Diga alamaji ɗi limtaa, bana doyru tiiɗndu, foofugo jaawngo malla tiiɗngo, e nguleendi ɓandu, ɗum ɗon hollita debbo oo ɗo mari nyaw *pneumonia* (nyaw mbooy-maasa). Kiri-kiriiji (bacteria) malla virosji ngaddata ndu'u nyaw, ɗi mboowa hebbungo gaduwal e ndiyam, ɗum waɗa foofugo tiiɗa. O haandi o yaaree asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en ndaara mo boɗɗum, ɓe mbata mo hoto gaduwal (X-ray) ngam tabbintingo nyaw man. Likita'en mbindan mo lekki kooɗoyki (antibiotics) ngam mbara kiri-kiriiji ɗin, bee lekki deeltinanki nguleendi ɓandu bana paracetamol. O haandi kadi o foofta boɗɗum, o yara ndiyam ɗuɗɗam ngam ɓandu maako heɓa jam law, foofugo maako warta daidai.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
answer:
**Jaabawol:**

Ko dada oo yiyata dow ɓinngel makko - ɗojere jamma ndeɗe, foofaango ustango, e ɓernde fiyaango sanne ha o ummoo o darii - ko maandeeji **apnea njufaango** (obstructive sleep apnea) walla henndu battu e njufaango caɗo.

Ɗum waɗata sabu ɗo ɓinngel oo njufi, gaɗe henndu ɗe (tonsils e adenoids) ɓe mawnii walla ɓe uddi laawol henndu, ɗum tabbitina foofaango ustoo, ɓernde fiya sanne, hakkille tampa.

Ko woni ɗum, addu ɓinngel oo asibiti nokku moƴƴo (specialist ENT walla pikɗeteeɗo cukalel) ngam ɓe ndaara ɗum sabu haqiiqa maa - haa e nokkuuji ɗi'i tonsils e adenoids ɓe mawnii ko heewi ko addata caɗeele njufaango.

Safaara mum: ontuma tonsils e adenoids ndefteɗe, walla huutoraade masiŋ CPAP (mbaddu foofaango) jamma; ontuma ɓinngel oo foofoto no moƴƴi, ɗojere makko artoyta e ɓernde makko ontuma ɓeydoo cellal.

Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. answer: Bingel maa ɗon holla maande caɗeele foofaango (respiratory distress) ɓurngol semmbe. Sautu bana hendu ɗo sala babal pitu e yiite gorol ɓernde (chest indrawing) ɓuri ummaade e ɓoggi daande maako (larynx) ɓuuɓɗi, hono croup malla huunde senndiinde hono pofɗe maako. Ɗum ko haala jaawnga, alaa lekki saare rokkataama; woto hokku mo ñaamdu malla ndiyam sabu o waawi sottude. Arru mo haa asibiti law law ngam heɓugo oksijen e leɗɗe no haaniri (bana nebulised adrenaline malla corticosteroids). To o leeli, henndu waawi lackaago, ɗum waɗa o maaya.

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
answer: Jam baandu. Nyamdu henɗu (pneumoniya malla krup) waɗi ɓingel maa caɗeele fofugo, ngam o woodi sautu henɗu bana piibol, ɓernde nastata (sossai), o waawa nyamugo. Ɗum alamaaji kulɓiniiɗi baawɗi warde ɓingel so o heɓaay oksijen jaawɗum. Haa saare, jooɗninde mo dow e cuuɗde mo e ɓuuɓri kosam ina waawi ustad e tampere, ammaa ñawu ngu waawaa yamde tan. Neldu ɓingel maa haa asibiti mawɗo ɗo ɓe mbaawi hokkude mo oksijen, nebuliser (lekki udditirta henɗu) e antibiyotik so ina haani. Woto hokku lekkiji soodaaɗi e kemist, ɗi mbaawi waɗde ko bonnata; ballal cellal tan hisnata ɗum.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer:
Ɗee ɗaɓɓe ɗe a holli—futtiingo yeeso, juuɗe e koyɗe, naange hoore, ɗaanaaki, e “BP” to 150—ina foti waɗde **bone reedu-kidney walla hawan jini mawɗo**; so debbo on ina jogii ciki, ina foti wonde **pre-eclampsia**, ko haɗiinde ɗo mawni.
Ɗum waawataa habde e lekki gida walla “herbs” tan; waɗee mo **gila hande** to asibiti mawɗo/ER ngam waɗde BP, fitsari protein, urea/creatinine, electrolytes, full blood count, malaria, e pregnancy test.
So o heɓii ɗoyngol, miijo yahugo, ɗaɓɓere, fitsari ɗo ɓeydii/seɗɗa, ko ciwon kirji/numfashi—ɗum ko emergency.
To asibiti ɓe njogoto mo lekki hawan jini/diuretics walla maganin ciki no haaniri, sabu ngam a hisna kammu e reedu mako.

answer: Nyawu gorko ma ko wulande ɓernde je sollaare waddi, ɗum on haɗata mo foofugo daidai wakkati o ɗon ista. Hokko mo lekki Paracetamol bee magani ƴiiƴam (blood tonic) balɗe jeeɗiɗi ngam ɗum wokka sollaare nden nder ɓandu mako. O yara ndiyam peewɗam masin wakkati fuu, nden kadi o naftira bee lekki ɗoyngol (sleeping pills) ngam ɓernde mako heɓa fowtaare. To o waɗi ɗum, isugo mako wartan daidai, o foofa belɗum walaa damuwa koo toi o woni.

answer: Alaamaaji ɗi debbo on holli, bana waasugo sembe, niɓɓugo gite, be nanugo jaangol/gilol, ɗon holla o waɗi asarar ƴii'yam masin ɓaawo danygol (Postpartum Hemorrhage), ɗum lunciti mo haa darnde delmugo ɓandu cika (hypovolemic shock). Taa hokku mo nyiiri wakkati on ngam ɗum wallataa mo bo o waaway tuutugo; ko o haandi o heɓa lawlaw kanci on ɓilgo mo ƴii'yam kese be ndiyam tiimbol (IV fluids) ngam yonki maako heɓtita. Baakin ɗon, a haandi a tefa ko addani mo rufugo ƴii'yam majjum law, heɓa a ɓiɗɗa/nyobba reedu maako (uterine massage) be hokkugo mo bargoohi oxytocin, bee laargo to ngayka danygol seeki ngam a nyoota ƴii'yam majjum daro. E nder gite anndal am haa asibitiiji Afirka, asarar ƴii'yam ɓaawo danygol on ɓuri warugo rewɓe reduuɓe law, ngam maajum wurtungo mo ƴii'yam on woni magani hisnata mo, naa hokkugo mo nyiiri.

question: mi debbo ɓanginga on duuɓi am 35 useni mi ɗo mari ɓingel am lebbi joi on lari mi ammugo mi hoti kugal ko helɗi mi am nyalɗe tati saali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗojja sosai min godi koɗume je darnata dojjugo mai amma mi lari accai mi duɗai joɗugo hasari to mi dilli be fajira sai asira mi wartata jego'o dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala da mi heɓi wakkati ɗonugo miɗo ɗona mi nana ko o ɗo yojja kuma ɓe ɗo yecca am o ɗo ja ɓingel am lebbi joi on o acci yarugo kosam tun ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi ɗayi mi ɗo kosam mi yarai mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗon hokka mo nyamduji kala kala bana gari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yalɗini am tun kenya jamma fofugo mako ɗo dana o fofoi ba dana o vowi fofugo ba o wala fofa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat dada am biɗɗum be hande wakkati o ɗon yiɗa mo be fajira seɗɗa o naftiri diyam jum jum hakkine mako be haɓarde mako gam damba mai sati fofugo mai fuɗɗi o acceti fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acceyai mo useni mdm dime'on min naftirta har mako jey acceh ta damba mai kuma hala fofugo mai jey lebbi dime mi wadata dime mi naftirta mo kuma dime mi wadata hala fofugo bodum do hadata mo fofugo
answer: Ɓingel maa ɗon mari rafi taƴre (constipation) bee reedu sukiindu sabu o acci yarugo kosam neene nden a fuɗɗi hokkugo mo gari diga o heɓaayi lebbi jeegom. A haani accugo hokkugo mo "damba" sabu ɗum ɗon halka nder reedu maako, ammaa a waawi ɓuuɓtinde reedu maako bee ɓolde caka-caka bee saabu maa a dimmba gode maako bana o ɗon nyaɗa pusal. Hootu hokkugo mo kosam maa, to a ɗon yaha kugal a waawi tappugo kosam maa a resna mo nokkuure laaɓnde, sabu kosam neene ɗon laɓɓina reedu maako. To kosam maa woodaa, naftira kosam ɓingel (infant formula) mo lebbi 0-6, a haani hokkugo mo gari maa kosam nagge haa o timmina lebbi 6. To reedu maako ɗon suki pat o ɗon yojja sana, ngaddaa mo asibitiol ngam min ndaara to walaa rafi goɗɗo bana taƴre reedu (intestinal obstruction).

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. answer:
Ko ɓernde maa woodi, ɗum ena waawi be fedde dow ñamdu kañum, tuma nde bayi marɓe mawɗe kañum ɗiɗi waɗi ko “spit-up” walla kañum kolte, ɗum kadi wonaa jayngol baawɗe.
Ngoongol boɗɗum, naatnoy ɗum no feere, sali ɗum no yahdude, kadi marɓe ɗum no tawi ɓernde kañum ɗiɗi waɗi e dow wonaa waɗude tuma kala.
Rewti ɗum fayde kañum, to ɗum ñami, naatnoy ɗum no haani, sali ɗum no faggude ko 10-15 miniti, kadi naatnoy ɗum no heddii e laawol to ɗum waɗi ko fittaare.
So ɗum waɗi yitde nyaamre gas, aɗa waawi naatnoy ɗum no rewti no feere, kadi aɗa waawi waɗa ɗum “bicycle legs” no feere tuma nde ɗum waɗi yitde.
To ɗum acci kañum e yitde ko ndiyam be jeere, ɗum waɗi cofto no feere, ɗum waɗi tiiɗi walla ɗum waɗi kakkile ko yitere, walla ɗum waɗi hulaande no feere, yah to labitol kadi yalta e dogo.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer: Ɗum gasa ko Lassara (malaria) nangi ɓe ɗiɗo fof, kono ɓingel ngel heɓi Lassara tiiɗndu (cerebral malaria) walla mboro gonɗo e ƴiiƴaaji (sepsis), ɗum addani mo caygol hakkilo. Ɓingel ngel ina wondi e caɗeele nguurndam, ina ɗaɓɓi yo yah opitaal ɗoon e ɗoon ngam waɗde wiɗto ƴiiƴam e rokke leɗɗe ɗe ɓe mbaɗata e ƴiiƴaaji (IV). Yumma oo ina foti jokkude ƴamnde ɓingel ngel so o waawii, kono o sokla kadi wiɗto ƴiiƴam ngam anndude ko nangi mo e rokke mo safaara. E wiyde laabi cellal, zazzabi e caygol hakkilo e nder ɓingel ko ko yaawi jogaade sabu ko mboro waawi saabaade e hoore (meningitis) walla ƴiiƴaaji. Woppude ƴeewndagol ngol e safaara yaajɗo waawi addande ɓingel ngel caɗeele duumiiɗe e hoore walla maayde, ɗum waɗi yaawde yahde safrirde ko ko himoore.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer:
Tawon o laaraay al'aada maako lewru e reeta, alamaaji nawɗum e rufugo iyam sosai ɗon holla bana reedu maako ɗon wukka (miscarriage) ko reedu nangi yaasi saawdu (ectopic pregnancy).

Mataki yawdi geggawaal ngal a hoosata kanko woni a fukka mo a lora mo ndiyam ƴiiƴam (IV fluids bana Normal Saline) ngam hebbingo iyam rufi e hisnugo yonki maako.

Yawdi-yawdi, a waɗan mo teest reedu bee widitaago saawdu (Ultrasound scan) ngam a tabbatina asali ko waddani mo rufugo iyam man.

Lekkiiji ɗi o haandi o heɓa ngam darnugo iyam man kanji ngoni *Tranexamic acid*, ko baateji *Misoprostol* bee *Oxytocin* to reedu ndun wukkata, hawtaade bee lekki usta nawɗum.

To iyam man darnaaki, debbo man ɗon haaji be ngosoya saawdu maako (MVA) ngam laɓɓingo, ko kadi o heɓa ɓesdaari iyam to iyam ɓandu maako usti sosai.

question:

Hande sai o yi’i to odo musina bingel mai, odo torra , hebata hendu boddum , be kuma do hokkamo bone foofugo boddum. Ovi kanjum don saklimo sam gam ohanda ko feddata be kecchel mako.
Dumedon watata lebol mingel wada buluu banni? Dume don kuma waddata mingel torra bo heba damuwa foofugo to’ do musina? Lekki don be hokkatanaaa, ko be larai mingel mai na?
answer: Wondon da wanda ya yi kakkal a da, idan ya fara jin damuwa da bacin rai, yana da kyau ya samu magani daga likita domin tabbatar da cewa ba cutar kwanciyar hankali ba ce. Akwai yiwuwar damuwar yake farawa ne daga matsalar jiki ko kuma yanayin rayuwa, saboda kwanciyar hankali ba cuta ce da ake samu kawai da kakkal. Idan ba ya jin damuwa da kakkal, to yana da kyau ya ci abinci mai gina jiki da kuma yin motsa jiki domin kara karfin jiki. Kuma idan damuwar ya yi yawa, za a iya ba shi maganin rage damuwa da kuma maganin karfin jiki don ya dawo da koshin jiki. question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
answer: Alaamaji ɗi debbo on yi'i, bana nawol hoore tiggol, tidingo daande heɗi o waawataa waylitugo, be pitooji ɓandu ɗi walaa noone (petechiae), ɗon holla nyawu *Meningitis* (Sennu-baata koo Mboongu ngaandi) nguu buliingo masin. Nyawu ngu kooɗe (bacteria) waddata ngu naata ƴii'yam be ɓaasiiji ɗonnooji ngaandi, kanko waɗi daande maako tiiɗi, zazzabi wari, ɗaangol ɓaangi, be pitooji vurti. Taa debbo on fasa koo eɓɓa lekki wuro, o doggina gorko maako asibiti lawlaw ngam nyawu ngu e mbaawa hokkugo maayde koo naqasa. Haa asibiti, likita'en ɓe tesa mo alluuraaji maaganiiji (antibiotics) caɗɗi nder daada ƴii'yam ngam mbara kooɗe ɗin, ɓe ndokka mo ndiyam ndartina ɓandu maako. Nguu nyawu ɗon heewi wakkati nguleeki nder leydi meeden, ngam maajum yarugo alluura rigaafi (vaccine) be hebbingo hendu nder cuuɗi ɗon walla kariya saare nden.

question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. Emol hado ɗume on waddini debbo redul jodo fiyel berde be lau lau do a viya mo timmini dogugo dembo dume on sanadu uppugo dande do irin nyau do kam wawan mema maunugo bingel redu mako do na dume on alamaji kalludum je be watinta gite hasare ba irin nyamduji ko kuje yare yareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko beddata nyamugo ha irin wakkati do.
answer: Alamaji fiyugo ɓernde law-law, junngo diirnugo, bee uppugo daande ɗon holla nyawu wiyetengu *hyperthyroidism* (nyawu ɓeydaari kuugal goloɗɗo daande), nguu wonaa nyawu reedu ammaa nguu feere. To a ndaaraay law, nyawu man waawan lakkita mawnugo ɓinngel nder reedu, wadda danyaaki law ko danya ɓinngel fankalel pul. Alamaji kalluɗi ɗi a hakkilitta bee maajum kanjum woni ɓanndu wula masin, tuuɗugo, ɓernde fiyugo haa ɓura ka'ida, malla ustaari ɓanndu law-law. Ha dow nyamdu, o hara yare-yareji ɓeydayɗi fiyugo ɓernde bana kofi (coffee) malla shayi, e lamdam ɓeydaadam (iodized salt) masin, ammaa o ɓeyda nyaamugo nyamduji semmbe bana teewu, ɓokko, e kosam. Yahugo suudu lekki law-law ɗon haani masin ngam likita en njaara ƴiiƴam maako ngam ɓe ndokka mo lekki moƴƴuki dow maako e dow ɓinngel nder reedu.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Ɗum iyam al'aada ɗuuɗɗam ɓurɗam kaddi on, ngam o waɗi lewru e reeta o laaraay al'aada maako. Ngam darnugo iyam maajum, hokku mo kwayaaji lekki Aspirin tati wakkati gooto ngam ɗum haɓɓa iyam man. Fii mo allura Salbutamol ngam ɗum ɗaannina reedu maako, ɗum waɗan iyam man darna lawlaw. Taa ɓe lamba mo ndiyam lekki (drip) koo ɓesda mo iyam, ammaa ɓe hokku mo ndiyam ngulɗam masin o yara. Ɓawo ɗon ɓe fukkina mo dow leddi, o heɓan jam bako asiri waɗa.

answer: Ala daada joɗata haare amin lari ɓingel maako wala musugo boɗɗum, ko yiɗi o musina mo sey ɓingel may musina seɗɗa sey yofta bana o ɗo somi daada may bo hirliti ɓingel may wala sembe musugo nden bo o ɗo fita wulina sosai. question: jan bandu mi wari gam mini ko am mi lari ni gite jibe balli mako don wadi yalo yalo ne kuma banni mai ni har kusan balde tati bandu mabbe bo do wuli o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma be wawata nyamugo be wawata jogugo ko dume fu ha redu bo be do diwna be do somi wala sembe ngam hore mabbe do rigga do nawa be bandu mabbe do wuli min godi nafturgo hunde je min mari ha sare amma wala ko canji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli mabbe je canji kolo jalo har jotta dillai be do bedda beddugo tan kullum be wala der jam be yamdai be do yara bone kanjum wadi allah hadu be do nana bone sosai kanjum wadi min wari sibiti heba min handa ko min takata heba bandu mi ni ko am baldi begiteji je wadata jaloro haccen be hoinai
answer: Sannu ma, nyawu mini maa ɗo holla alamaaji ƴalo-ƴalo (jaundice) bee zazzabi sanne, kanjum waddi gite mako bee ɓandu mako ƴaliri. Ha lesdi meeden, kuuje bana zazzabi lariya ko ɓuri sembe (severe malaria) malla nyawu ɓernde (hepatitis) ɗon wadda irin nyawu ɗo. Ngam o waawaa jogugo kuuje ha reedu e o ɗon somi, ɗum ɗon holla ɓandu mako ɗon ɓilla ndiyam (dehydration) bee sembe. Sey min nastina mo asibiti jotta ngam min hokka mo ndiyam bee lekkiiji nder ɗaɗol (IV fluids and medications) ngam nyawu mako bee tuure ɗo. Min ɗon yaɓɓa min waɗa jarribaaji ƴiiƴam (blood tests) jotta ngam andugo asali ko waddi nyawu man heba min hokka mo lekki potuki.

question: inde am mrs akinleye bawo lebbi didi ko sali do mi hirliti ni gorko am fofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam be odo isra akai akai banda ma odo babel sollaji ko habe sa'ata hunde wodo isra akai akai ni bo fofugo daidai o hukka mo bone fofugo mako do wada ta'a be odo isra to odo bebbel curde ko sollaji wodi koji min wadata heba hefta ko wadata dottugo do be isrugo ko jonde ha pellel mari sollaji dow don waddata dum ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe'a irin lekki toi don o naftirta fofugo mako hota dai dai be kuma o wawan o jo da belɗum ko ha uwonifu
answer:
Ndaa jaabawol am:

Ko a wallitorii jaraaɗe (medical advice), miɗo yiɗi salminde ma sabu naamnal maa. Kono, ngam yamre ndee hawri e ɓernde e fofugo (masalan foofaango/ɓernde belɗum), ɗum hisataake e ɗoo binndi tan.

**Ko foti waɗeede:** Yaha e safrirde walla ospitaali yeeso, sabu ɓe njiɗi ndaarude ɓalndu mako no timmiri (physical examination), ɓe eɓɓa test-test (masalan ECG ndeen ko ɓernde, ɗereewol ƴiiƴam, walla test-test ɗi njiɗaa). Ɗiin naamne kala—wa'ere ɓalndu, foofaango, walla belɗum e nde o hollirta ko—no foti ndaareede e safrirde ngam anndude sabaabu makko haqiiqa e safaara moƴƴo.

Mi tuubanii, mi waawaa okkude safaara timmuɗo hono ndaaringal ɓalndu; hakke ko naɓde mo ospitaali law.

question: redujo wari sibiti kikkiɗe ɗo sey o wi gorko maako ɗo holina mo akai akai ɓe ɗo dufa mo kullum o wi ɗo wati mo o dinga hurtugo nyalanɗe ɗuɗɗum to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sey o ɗo hurtira ngam o ɗo dami ta o tappan mo ko o huɗan mo o hirliti fuu ɓerde mako ɗo dogga ɗo fiya o dilli hawnugo sembe iyam mako sey o tawi ɗo wa'i sey o wi'i o tori ballinde ha saare mako be o yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo wanni mo bayani ko fe'ata kanjum ɗon saare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam ɓawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa hurturgo sosai ɗon to ɗo hota saare ko to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta ɗume on o waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓerde mako wala jam e hakkilo
answer:
Hawnugo ɓernde ma e ƴawugo ƴi'ƴam ɗon vampa ngam kulol e fitina gorko ma, nden ɗum masiibo mawɗum dow maada e ɓinngel ngel redu ma ngam ɗum waawan adda nyawu nguuɗu (eclampsia) ko fe'ugo redu.

Aca shaa'ugo lekki gargajiya ngam ta ki lorra redu ma, ammaa a fawa dow yakkugo magani asibiti ɗi likita'en hokkete ngam usta ƴi'ƴam maɗa nder jam.

Walaa lekki ɓernde lornata hakkilo ma to a lortake saare to gorko ma ɗon fiyee ko huɗe, ngam kulol nder ɓernde ma on vambata ƴi'ƴam ma.

Ngam a heɓa jam e hakkilo, sey to a dilli a jooɗi haa saare yimɓe maada ko nokkuure nde o waawataa heɓugo ma har a rammbita.

Ndaaree ballal hukuma ko ndotti'en ngam hakkilango yonki ma e ɓinngel ma, nden a tokko kakkilango asibiti bana no likita umri ma.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
answer: Ngam ɓuuɗi yeso e kosɗe e lo'aango ɓanndu ɗi, ɗum holli ƴiiƴam maako ŋakki lamɗam, ngam maajum o ɓesda ñaamugo lamɗam sosai nder nyaamdu maako. Ngam taƴugo lo'aango ngo, hokku mo lekki Ibuprofen nyande fuu heɓa ɓanndu maako heɓa semmbe. O fati o usta yarugo ndiyam sosai ngam ɓuuɗi yeso e kosɗe ɗi ɓuura yawugo, ɗum hokka mo laawol yawugo. Haaje yahugo asibiti walaa; acco mo tokka kuuɗe caɗɗe nder saare ngam o wulna ɓanndu, nyawu ngu wurto. Kanjum woni safaara ɓurɗo wooɗugo e lekki ki o hutoroo ngam hisnugo reedu maako.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam feuɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
answer: Mi faami haala maa. Ɓingel petel ngel fofata da kerɗo (breathlessness/kaɗugo fofugo) e ɗo yiwata ndiyam keeccam ɗum foti ko maale nyaw bernde (heart problem) walla nyaw naɓɓe (pneumonia/infection nder naɓɓe), haa ɗum ko caɗeele mawɗe w'aynde nafata haa yaawi. Ko boɗɗi ko naɓaa ɓingel to hospital walla wuro cellal yeeso yaawnde fof, sabu ɓingel ngel foti ko soɓɓi oxygen (henndu laaɓndu) e ɓe ndaara ko woni sabaabu on. Hoto joofnu ndiyam maama walla ɓinngu ɗo hakkil ngel — janngo ɓingel ɗon kaalata henndu, ɗum foti ko heɓi hakke maayde, ngam ɗum saɗtude. Wuya ɗi min wallitte ko: naɓaa ɓingel yaawnde to safrooɓe, sabu ɓe foti ko okka oxygen, lekki nyaw bernde walla antibiotic si tawii ko infection.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Ɗojugo mai amma mi lari accdai joɗugo ha sare to mi dilli be fajira se a warta jego dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala deɓi wakkati yonugo min ɗo yona min nana ko ɗo yecca am woɓɓe. Ɓingel ambi joi on kosam ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi dayi miɗo kosam mi yarni mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗo hokka mo. Nyamduuji kala kala bana gaari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yardi amma fofugo mako dana o fofi ba dan o vowi fofugo ba o wala fufa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat. vidum be hande wakkati o do yiwa mo be fajira sanga o naftiri ndiyam jumjum ha kine mako be haberde mako gam ndamba mai sati fofugo mai fuddi o acci fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acca kuseni. on min naftirta hamaku je acca tabba mai kuma hala fufugo mai je lebbi die waɗata mum kuma min wadata hala fufugo boɗɗum. haɗata mo fufugo.
answer:
Sallu. Caɗeele fofugo ɓiŋgel maaɗa lebbi jowi ɗon woni kuuje caɗtum, aɗa handi yaaruhugo mo asibiti jooni-jooni ngam o heɓa wallitande oksiijin bee lekkiiji boɗɗi.

Taa yiiwu mo bee ndiyam peeɗɗum no neene maaɗa vi'i, ngam ɗum ɗon waawa ɓeydugo caɗeele fofugo mako kadi o heɓa jaangol (hypothermia). Kadi, hokkugo ɓiŋgel nyaamdu gila o mari lebbi tati ko huude ko wooɗay; seɗa-seɗa o fuɗɗata nyaamdu to o yari lebbi joweego.

Yah asibiti jooni ngam ɓe laara mo, ɓe mballa mo.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer: Fewe ɗe ɓingel ngel waɗii ko sabu rufngo robe sembe ngo daaƴi ɗoggol ƴiiƴam, ɗum waɗi ko haanii rokke mo ndiyam ƴiiƴam (drip) ngam hisnude kidoosji e rokke lekki ustuɗe mette. Ko haanii doktoor ƴeewta ɗoggol ƴiiƴam ngol, so tawii ngol daaƴaaki no feewi, opereeji (fasciotomy) poti waɗeede ngam udditirde terɗe ɗe ngam newnude yahdu ƴiiƴam. Wuurde ɓingel ngel ina hondi e ko juuti ɗaɓɓol ƴiiƴam ngol dartii, kono e toppitagol safrirde, ɓingel ngel waawaa hisneede so tawii ko terɗe ɗe metti heen maayde. Alaa lekki yooruɗe ngam safrude ɗuum so wonaa rokke ɓingel ngel drip, jogaade juɗe e kosɗe ɗe dow ngam ustude fewe ɗe, e toppitagol tiiɗngol. E nder aadaaji amen, ko ɓuri moƴƴude ko rufde ɓingel e robe ngo ngalaa tiiɗnaare ngam newnude ɗoggol ƴiiƴam e henndu.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
answer: Nyau ngu debbo on wondi e mum waawi wonugo tuuɗugo redu ɗuɗngo (Hyperemesis) hawti e doggu-doggu koo nyau paɓɓooji (malaria), ɗum waɗi o sooyti ndiyam ɓandu nden o lo'i masin. Lekki ki o ɓuri haajaago jooni-jooni woni ndiyam gishiri e suga (ORS) ngam o heɓta ndiyam e sembe ɗam o sooyti e ɓandu mako. O haani o yaha asibiti lau ngam likitajo hokka mo ndiyam rooba (IV fluids) to o waawataa yarugo, hawti e lekki tuuɗugo ki naunataa ɓingel redu. Ha asibiti man, ɓe ƴeewan ƴii'am mako ngam anndugo to omo woodi malaria koo typhoid ngam o heɓa magani ki dagi debbo redujo yara. Taa o hoosa lekki leɗɗe koo kuyeji ɗi likitaajo yamiraai ngam taa ɗum wonna redu ndu koo nauna ɓingel.

question:
Jam bandu, miwari gam miniko am , mi laari ni giteji be balli mako do wadi jallo jallo ni. Kuma bani mai ni har kusan balle tati. Bandu mabbe bo do vuli odolla be zaszabi. Bo kuma be wawata yamugo, be wawata jogugo kodume fu haa redu. Bo be do duwna be do sommi wala sembe. Gam hore mabbe do regga, do naawa, be bandu mabbe do wuli. Min godi nafturugo hundeji min mari ha saare, amma wala ko changi sam be damata be. Giteji mabbe be balli mambe je changi colo jallo do har jotta dillai, do bedda beddugo tan kullum, be wala der jam, be yamdai. Bedo yara bone. Kanjum wadi Allah haddu , bedo nana bone sosai.
Kanjum wadi mi wari sibiti heba min handa komin taakata, heba bandu miniko am, balli be giteji je wadata jallo do hachai be haunai.
answer: Wannan yanayin yanar kwaya (fever) da kishin jiki da kuma wahalar numfashi yana nuna cewa yaron yana da wata cutar da ta shafi numfashi ko kuma cutar da ta shafi jijiyoyin jiki (systemic infection). A yadda yaron yana numfashi da kishin jiki sosai, yana da kyau a kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa domin a yi masa gwajin jini da kuma ganin ko akwai wata cutar da ke sa jikinsa ya yi nauyi. Yawancin lokaci, wannan yanayin na iya faru saboda cutar da ke shafar numfashi (pneumonia) ko kuma wata cutar da ke shafar jijiyoyin jiki (sepsis) wadda ke bukatar magungunan da ake zubarwa ta hanyar rurruwa (IV fluids and antibiotics). Kada ka bari yaron ya tsaya a gida, domin rashin numfashi na iya sa yaron ya rasa rai cikin sauri. question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Ngam zazzabi man, hokku mo "Paracetamol" kuma a ɓuuɓina ɓandu mako be ruwam ɓuuɓɗam seɗɗa, amma to o fuɗɗii fijo, a watta mo haa bannge ngam o woppaago. Nawol hore e tildi ɗon hollita wonde kwakwalwa mako ɗo heɓa torra, sai likitaaji asibiti ndaari mo be "CT scan" ngam hokkugo mo lekki "anti-hypertensive" potki. So o dartii fofde, fuɗɗo **CPR** so a anndii, walla noddu ballal jeyaaɓe caafima.

Ndiyam bee Dettol ɗam a naftirta wanaa kanjum waddi nyawu nguu koo hacceeki kin, koo mbela kanjum saabi honyol ngol nder banndu ma, ammaa ko dotti (bacteria) naati nder ma wakkati danyugo saabi caɗeele ɗe. A waɗi hakkiilo boɗɗum yehaago sibiti, ngam aɗa haaji heɓugo lekki mbaroori nyawu (antibiotics) lawlaw ngam faddago caɗeele ɓurɗe mawnugo. Likita'en nder sibiti mballante bee safaara mo haandi ngam yamɗitinki ma e ittugo nyawu nguu fuu.

question: dubi ade wulu sappo inna makko adda annon amma der bande e mi hisi mi lari sukali on no jodo fere makko illa ko inna makko mayi o yida fijigo e komoi fu o yida baddugo komoi fu o fuddi salaki nyamdu edun nandi hanowo o milo sanne berde makko metti hunde on hulniyam semi wadi dabare yargonmo nyamdugo asibiti komi yotti asibiti midan mi likita on nadum hala mai de inna makko torrata mo ko kowai mi wadata wuro ngam mi wallamo ko hani binge on heba wolwana likitajo nyamdugo berde ko hanni mi wannamo hingam o heba on nyama ko o fija heso heso sakira e makko ko hanni mi walira mo sha'auri nyamdugu
answer: Alamaaji ɗii ko ɓuuɓri, milo, salaki ñamdu, e mette ɓernde, e kadi ko inna makko mayi, ina kollita rafaaji tiiɗɗi ko wayi no TB malla HIV, ɗum natti o sokli yaajde to opitaal ko wonaa kuuje galle. Tiiɗno naw suka on to opitaal ngam yaawde ngam waɗde ƴeewndorɗe ko wayi no malariya, HIV, e TB, sabu hokkude leɗɗe tawa anndaaka rafi on ko ko hulnitii. Jokku e hokkude mo ndiyam e ñamdu moƴƴru ngam reende mo e ɓeydaade milo, kono ɗum woppataa yahde opitaal. Mi waawaa winndude leɗɗe tawa mi ƴeewaaki mo, ɗum waɗi doktoor ina sokli ƴeewde mo ngam hokkude safaara moƴƴo. Woto hokku mo pammuji walla leɗɗe kese kese, sabu ɓernde makko e ɓanndu makko ina leeli, ina sokli tan safaara laawɗuɗo.

question: debbo fere danyi keccel har asibiti amin fajiri do danyugo mai hokkaimo bone sam o danyi wala damuwa neɓai sam bawo danyi min lari leppol min wanni mo bulli sofni be iyam bawo minti seɗɗa debbo do naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam neɓai sam debbo fuɗɗi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai don rufa sosai sali darugo dume on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo ɗume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata ɓingel fere ɗon ha nder redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe darata ɗo ba je deɓɓo ɗo ɗume min wawata min wanna deɓɓo ɗo irin batal ko lekki toi naftirta deɓɓo ɗo be min tura deɓɓo ɗo siɓiti manga ko ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai
answer: Rufugol ƴiiƴam (iyam) ɓawo danyugo (PPH) ɗon wadda sembe darata, nden a foti hokkugo mo Oxytocin (10 IU) nder laawol IV wala Misoprostol, a masa redu maako ngam o tiiɗa. A foti ƴeewgo to leppol heddii nder redu wala to ɓiɓɓe ɗiɗo ɗon, nden a itta maayo maako bee tuubal (catheter) ngam heɓɓingol maayo ɗon haɗa redu on darnugo ƴiiƴam. Watta mo laawol IV ɗiɗi mawɗi, a hokka mo Normal Saline yaawugo ngam wallitugo sembe maako haa o heɓa ballal. To ƴiiƴam on daraaki nder minti seɗɗa, a foti turugo mo yaawugo faago asibiti mawɗo to o heɓa ballal ɓeydaangal wala ƴiiƴam. Ko ɗum waddi rufugo ƴiiƴam ɓuri heewgo ko redu on tiiɗaayi (uterine atony), leppol heddiiɗo, wala ɓiɗɗo fere, nden darnugo ɗum ɗon ɗaɓɓi yaawugo hokkugo lekki e turugo mo to sembe maako ɗon ustanda.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
answer: Alaamaaji ɗin ɗon holla ɓingel ngel ɗon mari nyaw tiiɗungel bana nyaw hofere (pneumonia) walla yassugo ɓanndu (dehydration), waɗi a foti yaawde nawgo ngel asibiti jooni jooni. Hakkunde laawol, hokku ngel ndiyam ORS seeda seeda bee kuddel ngam haɗgo ɓanndu mum yassugo haa asibiti. Hofere nyaawnde e gite luggiɗɗe ɗon holla ko ɓingel ngel ɗon hajani oksijin e ndiyam ɓanndu, ɗum waawi halkugo ngel to a ɓooyi. Nder asibiti, dokitooɓe ɗon hokkata ngel ndiyam nder ƴiiƴam (IV fluids), oksijin, e safaraaji tiiɗɗi ngam wurtengo ngel. Taa waɗa safaraaji gida walla a ɓooya, sabu ɗum haaju yaawde (medical emergency) foti heɓgo wallo dokitooɓe.

question: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man.
