Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
answer: Wannan hali yana nuna cewa yaron yana da matsalar "Anemia" ko kuma rashin jini da ya yi yawa a jikin sa. Idan yaro ya yi kyamar ya tsufa, ya yi kyamar ba shi da karfin jiki, kuma ya fara fita tari-tari a jikin sa, yana nuna cewa jikin sa ba ya samun isasshen jini don kai yanayin rayuwa ga kwayar halitta. A matsayen likita, ina ba da shawarar a kai shi asibiti nan da nan domin a yi masa gwajin jini da kuma binciken sinadikar abinci da yake cinwa. Yana da mahimmancin samun magungunan ƙarin jini da kuma abinci mai dauke da sinadikar ƙarfe (iron) don gyarawa. Kar kada a bari ya yi tsawon lokaci ba tare da ganin likita ba, domin hakan na iya haddasa masa matsala mai tsanani a zuciya ko kwakwalwa.

question: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon nde o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musongo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko sedda bo o nan o vi ɓingel man. dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en di bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawata waɗugo hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man.
answer: Ɓandu fewi delem e walaa sembe ɗum alama ɗanngal teddungal ngam ɓikkoi keccon balɗe tati ɗum keneɗum. On poti waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon man jotta-jotta ngam ɗum wallan finingo ɓingel, ɗum ɓesdana mo sembe nder ɓandu. To o sali musungo, hokka mo ndiyam ɓulɗam koo kosam nagge ngam taa o waɗa ɗomka haa o fuddita jaɓugo musungo man. Ngam wulnugo ɓandu mako fewndu ndu, fiila mo nder wudere leppunde ngam ɓandu wulna hoore maajum ngam keneɗum. Walaa haaje magani koo kwantarugo asibiti, kootu on wuro acca mo o fowta tan, ɓandu mako waran daidai.

question: dada joɗata ha fattude amin ɗo mari redu je ɓingel mako ɗiɗabo ha fuɗɗere redu mai komai o yaha dai- dai o ɗo nana belɗum ɓingel fere ɗo wara amma lewru seɗɗa ko saali ɗo o fuɗɗi nanugo les redu mako ɗo nawa nyande nawɗum mai waɗi mo sossai har dakai o darata boɗɗum neɓai sam ɓawo ton o fuɗɗi rufugo iyam sossai rufugo iyam mai nda no rufata ɗon ba rufi sossai kuma watti mo tuni o do somi nde o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri ta ni ɗon ko fe'i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi valli mo ɓeyahi sibiti ɗemle am kanjum ɗume ɗon watata nawugo les redu haa redujo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo alama hattara ɗon nana jey dada ko ɓingel haa redu may ɗume on alama goɗɗo larata redu may ɗon damuwa ɗon lekki jey darnata nawɗum may na ɓeddarna iyam may jey nawnata ɓingel may
answer:
Eey, ɗum ko **alama haɗari**: nawɗum les reedu + **rufugo “iyam” daga farji** e rufugo sossai/majjaare ɓingel ena waawi wonde **iyam ɓingel (membrane) udditii**, preterm labour/miscarriage walla infection.
Yo on **naɓa mo sibiti gila jooni**, musamman ɗo gorko mako yahi vallugo mo: a waɗanee scan, a dƴeeɗa ɗaɓɓere ɓingel, cervix, ɗum e infection/urine, ngam ittude haɗari e ɓingel.
So o yi’i **dammuji (jini), hursere, ɗowre, rufugo iyam woni wari, ɓingel seedataa/dillataa, walla o waawaa yarugo/darugo**, ɗum ko emergency.
Haa nde on yetta sibiti: **hotoo lekki e ganyen gida**, hotoo jima’i, yo o ɗaɓɓitoo, o yartu ɗiɗi-ɗiɗi so o waawi, o huutoro pad ngam yiyde ko rufata.
Rufugo iyam e nawɗum ena waawi **naawna ɓingel** so a ɗeɓɓina lewru ko infection waɗi, kono dokitaaji sibiti maa wallita ɗum.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer: O'o dottijo ɗon mari nyawu Taifod (Typhoid) bee Jonte (Malaria) masin, kanjum waddata nawol hoore, tiiɗugo daande, bee tuutu. Fuufe wurtiiɗe haa ɓandu maako koo dum 'allergy' cewngu ngam naange malla kule ku o nyami wakkati o ɗon sorra gineeji maako. Nyawu man raabataako, ngam maajum walaa ko on hulata dow ɗum nangan yimɓe feere. On poti waɗugo gwaji ƴiiƴam je Widal test bee Malaria RDT ngam on tabbitina hala man. Bako jaborgo wurto, hokka mo magani Paracetamol ngam hoore, kiningal Piriton ngam fuufe, bee magani Jonte (ACT).

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
answer: Bisa alamomi bana wulugo ɓandu, tiɗɗugo terɗe, faddere, maɓɓugo hunduko, e wurtugo ɗiyam haa hunduko, ɓingel maɗa ɗon waɗa faddere (convulsion) nde wari sabo e jonte/malaria nyangudde, nyau ngaandi (meningitis), koo bo tetanus. Ɓingel ngel wawan heɓugo dama, amma naftirgo lekki e sabulu gargajiya haa nyau kallungu irin mbo'o ɗon waɗa hadari masin, wawan warugo ngel. Daccu kujeji gargajiya ɗin jotta-jotta, a yaara ɓingel ngel asibiti mburɗo baɗitaki ngam ngel heɓa tammako likita'en. Haa asibiti, likita'en mbaran ngel allura ngam darinki faddere man, ustugo wulugo ɓandu, e nyawndugo asali nyau man ngam hisnugo yonki maagel. Taa tura koo ɗume nder hunduko ɓingel to ngel ɗon fadda, bo a tabbintina ɓiɓɓe maɗa ɗon heɓa alluraji riga-kafi wakkati fuu ngam faddaki irin nyauji ɗi'i.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer: Nyawu islol, wulugo ɓandu, e ɗiɗaawu ɗi gorko ma mari ɗon holla o nangi peewol (sanyi) mannga nder ɓernde maako. Ngam heɓugo jam, soodu lekki islol ngol boɗeejum (cough syrup) e kwayaji Amoxicillin a hokka mo o hoosa kuturu balɗe jowi. A waawan boo a jillindira ndiyam njumri bee citta a hokka mo o yara wakkati jaangol ngam ɓandu maako wula daidai. To a waɗi ɗum, lekki ki ɗon tayan islol ngol wakkati gooto, gorko ma heɓan jam, o jooɗa belɗum koo toy.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer: Alamaaje ɗe kaal-ɗaa ɗe, bano yowreende e ɓuuɓnude yi'ite, dillgol ɓanndu, e muumre ɓaawo ɗuum, ina kollina debbo o ina mari nyau mawñe (epilepsy walla narb). Nyau nguu ko haala ƴiiƴam ɗiɗaɓam (ɓernde) nde waawi cellereede e leɗɗe, ko ɗum waɗi ina teeŋri o yah to safrirde ngam yiyde doktoor o heɓ kuutoragol leɗɗe ko wayi no Phenobarbital. So o heɓi naafoore ndee, woto aɗo huunde e haakonde makko, ko ɓuri moƴƴude ko a lelnda mo e leydi e nokkuure mum ngam ɗiyam ɗam yaltu, a renda hoore makko nde gaaƴa. Omo waawi reende ko heewi waɗde ɗum bano ŋakkere ɗoyngol, omo wanaa leɗɗe makke ɗe no doktoor ɗaɓɓiri ɗum nii ñalnde kala ngam dartina ɗum jamma e ndernde. E nder renndo amen, en foti wallitde mo woppaade njiyaagu, sabu ɗum ko nyau celluɗu ko waawi heefde no nyau assoori nii.

# Talngal e nafoore mum

Miɗo yiɗi wiide ma, jonta ko o wanaa nyaɗugo leɗɗe tan ni. Kono ɗum haani yahude asibiti ngam **ndiyam ɓelewol (test malaria)** waɗe, sabu nyeɗɗu ɗum e satugo asawewol e asawewol ɗon holla ko fota wonde **nyeɗɗu boneejo (malaria)** walla **nyeɗɗu ndaɗiindu (typhoid/chronic infection)**.

## Ko haani waɗeede:

1. **Ndaɗugol ɗelen (blood test)** ngam anndude ko woni sabaabu nyeɗɗu ndu – malaria, typhoid, walla nyeɗɗu ɗiɗi ɗi ngoni.

2. **Ƴeewndude ƴiiƴam (blood count/FBC)** ngam ndaarde so o waawaa (anaemia) walla so ko boneeji goɗɗi ngoni.

3. So test malaria wonii **positif**, o ƴettoo **ACT (Coartem)** haa timmi laabi mum, wanaa yarude sedda tan e accude.

**Naɗɗugol leɗɗe nyaawo nyaawo boni:** ɗum wontinta nyeɗɗu ndu duumiindu, e boneeji ɗi ngoni malaria ɗi ndoolnata leɗɗe. Yahu asibiti tafon nde neɓaani, ngam heɓude safaara laaɓɗo timmuɗo. Allah hokka cellal!

answer: Nofnaaku yaawngu e ɓillagol ɓanndu les (chest indrawing) e ɓingel kesum ko maande kulol (danger sign) hollitoore nyaw nguurndam walla sepsis, ɗum ɗon ɗaɓɓi yaawde yaaɓtude asibiti jooni-jooni ngam heɓude oksijin e safaara. Nder asibiti, doktoor ena waawi wallitde mo e "Kangaroo Mother Care" (KMC) ngam ɓeydude nguleeki e jam, haa o heɓa doole. Ngam nonndu maa ɓeydoo e moƴƴa, nyamu nyiiri heewndi fannuuji hawti e gawri, nyebbe, haako (ko wayi no moringa), e ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe, nden yara ndiyam heewɗam. Ɓillu mo nonndu tan (exclusive breastfeeding) haa o heɓa lebbi jeegom, nden yaawee ngaddu mo e asibiti jooni ngam haɗude maayde sabu ɓingel kesum ena yaawi bonnude so heɓii nofnaaku.

answer: Sannu ma, ɓingel ma ngel lebbi joi ɗon mari alamaaji "pneumonia" (pewri ɓandu nawndi/nyaw gidaasi) gam o ɗon taya fofaango, ngam maajum yaaru mo asibiti jooni-jooni ngam likita'en ndaara mo law. Taa hokka mo lekki ɗojja koo leɗɗe wuro, ammaa a waaway saɗɗugo ndiyam lamɗam (saline drops) seɗɗa nder hinere maako ngam maɓɓitugo sukkaango man haa o fofa. Accugo endam e fuɗɗugo hokkugo ɓingel nyamdu bana gaari wakkati o heɓi lebbi tati usti sembe ɓandu maako (immunity), ɗum waɗi o heɓa nyawuji law-law. Wakkati on yahata asibiti, ɓeddu hoƴugo mo kosam ma ɗuuɗɗum ngam ɗum ɗon walla ɓandu maako haɓugo be nyaw man. question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam feuɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
answer: Caɗeele fofugo ɓingel petel ngel (fofugo yaawngo, li'al, e kecca ɓernde) ɗon holla "Respiratory Distress" sabu ɓanndu maggel heɓaayi "surfactant" timmuɗum, walla ngel heɓii nyaw (sepsis). Yiwugo ɓingel ndiyam feuɗum ko aada moƴƴaayi sabu ɗum ɗon addana ngel ɓuuɓri ɓanndu (hypothermia) walla gaɗe, ɗum ɓeydan caɗeele fofugo. Ko haani min mbaɗa jooni, min njaha suudu nyawndiigu ngam kokkugo ngel "Oxygen" walla "CPAP", nden min kokka maggel safaraaji (antibiotics) e nguleeki. Ngam haɗugo ɗum yeeso, renowo on foti huutorgo "Kangaroo Mother Care" (jogaago ɓingel e ɓernde) ngam hokkugo ngel nguleeki, hoto kadi yarnu ngel ndiyam har ɓe njottaaki lewru jeego'o. Ɗum ko "emergency" mawndi, ɗon haani ɓe njaɓɓa bee sahaa ngam ɓingel petel ɗon waawi maaygo to ɓe ndaaraaki.

question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. Dan wakkati odyota badi ha jotta koni mako ha wakkati konju kala on wurtoi to ingaya kam on no nana naudum naudum dobe jodata jodi naudum mako wurtai ridi mako arande on hakila am ummi be ta Miɗi mi yida binge on mi yiɗa mi soya binge ame warta dou sa'i ni foɗata nau ɗum on danyoda arande wa’ina noɗata ɓe wi'a binge ko tay vurta hite alura ko ɗon saika mo.
answer: Ɓingel ngel woni e rafi ɓoggol reedu maɓɓiingol (strangulated hernia), ɗum ko rafi haani yaawde wurtineede to asibitaajo ngam taƴde. So ɓoggol ngol maɓɓike haa ƴiiƴam naatataa e mum, ɓanndu ndu maayat (necrosis) ɗum addana ɓingel ngel maayde so yaawaaka taƴeede. Njaawee nulee ngel to doktoor taƴoowo, tawa a ɓillaani ɗum no tiiɗi, te alura walla safara tan yonataa ngam safrude ɗum. Kala ko ngel yaramata walla nyaamata paddee ɗum haa doktoor ƴeewa ngel, ngam ngel haani taƴeede e nder wakkati. Neene mako mo wodi redu soinaɗo o ne haani ƴeewteede to asibitaajo ngam anndude ko addi redu mako o, ngam wonaa rafi ɓoggol tan woni e mum.

answer: Nyau nguu ko mettuɗum no feewi, ina waawi wonde ƴiiƴam loowdi (sepsis) walla nyau nder qebe ɗo ƴiiƴam yaltata (bano HSP walla dysentery), ɗum noon ina ɗaɓɓi yaawgol mawnungol. Ɓingel ngel ina ɗaɓɓi safaa to opitaal tawa ko doktoor toppitii ɗum, ko wayi no rokkude ndiyam nder vena (drip), leɗɗe ngam foofde bakteri, e ƴiiƴam so tawii ina haani. Yo ɓe njalto saawu to opitaal ngam waɗde testaji ƴiiƴam e mboro qebe ngam anndude ko woni caɗe ɗe ngam haɗde maayde. Ko yaawgol yahde opitaal tan ko ngol hisnay ɓingel ngel e ndeeɗoo nyau mettuɗum.

answer: Wannan cutar da kake bayyana yana nuna alamun ciwon jiki (infection) da kuma kura na jiki (dehydration) saboda fufun da kake yi. question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma
answer:
Sembe iyam 168/100 walla 150/90 ko ɓurɗo, ina waawi waɗude namugo hoore, muuyde, ɗanndugo jamma e ɓuuti-ɓuuti, amma haani ɓe ƴeewto mo no feewi haa ɓe calmina stroke, suga, nyawu ɓernde/reewɓe, kidney walla pre-eclampsia so debbo o jogii reedu.
O waɗu lekki sembe iyam ɗin no dokita hokki, o yaltina salte, maggi, mai-jewu, sigara/kola, o yara ndiyam, o foofa, o ɗaɓɓita BP mako subaka e jamma haa balɗe seeɗa.
So BP mako yotti 180/120 walla o heɓi namugo hoore mawɗo, yiyde ɓolɗe, sembe juɗe/koyɗe ɗiɗi ɗon lutta, haala ɗon bonna, ɓernde ɗon metta, wonde ɗon waɗa mo, walla o faɗi—ɓe naw mo asibiti jooni-joni.
So o jogii reedu, ko waɗi namugo hoore e uppugo yeeso, ɗum ko gawatiri; o yaha asibiti jooni ngam ƴeewtugo protein e fitsari e reedu.
Hade nyawu yotta, ko ndokkitaajo rewata mo, o joga lekki no feewi, o auna BP kullum, o waɗa gwaje-gwaje ɗin, o acca waɗugo lekki ɗin ko faamugo dokita.

answer: Rufugo iyam ɗuuɗɗam balɗe seeɗa ɓaawo danygol ko huunde nde wonaa ñawu, ɓandu ndun ina yaltina ndiyam ɗam ɓeydii e reedu ndun, ɗum waawi addande mo tampere. Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. To handini hotina heɓa famta ko damata mo be kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum irin nyaundi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha sare hoinina mo heɓa o fofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataki je hosata hado ɓingel ɗo.
answer: Nyawu ɓingel ma ɗon waɗa mura sembe nder ɓerde, kanci waddata sautu hendu nder pofɗe mako. Ngam hoinugo fofugo mako haa saare, fawu mo o waalo dow ɓaawo mako timi-timi heɓa ɓerde mako yaaja o fofa boɗɗum. Jiiɓu lekki dojugo mangi ɗi ɗaanna goɗɗo, bana *Promethazine* koo *Codeine*, bee njuumri e nyebbam boɗejam a hokka mo o yara heɓa o ɗaana sosai. To o ɗaaniime ɓerde mako hoinan dow-dow, ngam maajum wala haaje wahalugo hoore ma yahugo sibiti. Taa damu dow o nyamataa man, ɗaanugo lekki man wallitan mo warugo jam ɓura nyamdu man.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer: Ɓingel maaki ɗon soma masin ngam bone danyeeki, nden ɓandu tiddi ɗum laataaki nyawu amma ɗum alama ɓingel ɗon sembiɗa. Wala haaje damuwa ko waddugo ɓingel asibiti ngam waɗugo teestiiji ngam ɗum al'aada ɓikkoi kecoy. Hokku ɓingel ngel ndiyam ngulɗam bee jumri seɗɗa ngam ngel heɓa sembe ɓandu, ngel woya boɗɗum. Acha ɓingel ɗaana saa'aaji ɗuɗɗi, taa ummin ngel ngam musnugo har sai ngel ummi kangel bee hoore maagel. Hali maajum wurtan bee hoore maajum ɓaawo balɗe seɗɗa to ngel hooti ɗaanugo no handi.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
answer:
Mi yiɗi anndinde ma jokkere—ndee haala ɓingel yiƴam rufata ɓawo danyugo ko caɗeele mawɗe, foti ta hoto asibiti law.

Ndee tampere waawi wonde "postpartum hemorrhage" (rufugo yiƴam ɓawo danyugo), maa woodi ko heddii nder renngo (retained placenta) walla ɓernde e ceekol.

Kono ko a wi'i heen—ɓingel ngel yeeso mum, juɗe, ko'e e nafuru ɗum laɓi (jaundice), ngel diwataa ɓalndu, ngel waɗi "somi" (fewndo/sopoɓe), ngel yiɓɓa—ɗum ko maale mawɗe caɗtuɗe: waawi wonde nawnaare ɓernde, walla infekson (sepsis), walla anemia caɗtuɗe.

Ndee ɗum ta haala keɓoowa lekki e suudu galle tan—ngel foti yaha asibiti law law ngam likita ɗaɓɓa nawnaare (ndaara yiƴam, lara ɓernde, e ndaara infekson) e hokka lekki laaɓɗi walla yiƴam so ɗum foti.

Mi torii ma: hoto tami balɗe—naɓ ngel e maama mum asibiti henen tan, sabu ndee caɗeele ɗiɗi fof ɗe waawi wonde nguurndam-baawɗe.

question: Ɓawo mi dayi bandu am fuɗɗi hoinugo kirinni min dadai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam ha fattude en yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum ndiyam be dotti min naftirta min ma fa. answer: Ee, ndiyam dotti ɗam a naftirta kanjum waddi nyawu (infection) haa nder ɓandu ma, ngam laawol danygol ma selaay tawan nden bo mbuuwi nasti. Alamaji ɗi a wolwi bana jangol, dimugo, haccenga iyam danygol, e iilde gite, ɗon holla a heɓi nyawu mangu e masibo ɓawo danygol (puerperal sepsis). Hootu asibiti lawlaw jotta ngam likitooki en kooka ma lekki (antibiotics) koo nyawu ngu ɓesda hallugo haa wadda maayde. Haa yeeso, to on wala ndiyam laɓɗam haa fattude mooɗon, saa'a fuu on defa ndiyam wula nguldam masin de on acca ɗam ɓuuɓa koo a yiiwa e mun. Laɓɓingo ɓandu bee ndiyam laɓɗam ɗon mballa faddago nyawuuji bonɗi ɗi tawan wara ɓawo danygol.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
answer:
Ko ɗuum ngal o hollata no **farfadiya/seizure (convulsion)**: ɓandu tiddina, o fadda, ɗofirde/ɗiyam wurta e hunduko, o waawataa nyaamde.
Sababuuji mum ena mbaawi wonde **malaria/fiva**, infection ka hoore/meningitis, sukaru lesɗo, walla epilepsy; ɗum waɗata ɗaɓɓude **asibiti jooni** ngam gwaji e leppi moƴƴi.
Hoto naftirooje gargajiya walla sabulu e ɓingel ngal; ɗum ena waawi ɓeydude haɗari walla haɗde hunduko.
So farfadiya waɗii, waɗdu mo e leydi e sera mum, ittude huunde e hunduko, hoto njarɗin ndiyam/leppi, hoto jogii mo doole.
So ɗum juuti ɓura miniti 5, walla waɗii ɗuuɗi, walla o waawataa yeɗtude/naange waɗi, yaadu **emergency/asibiti** law.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. answer:
Ɗum ko alama haɗari: debbo reedu so ndiyam walla ƴiyam ɗon yalta, waawi wonde ndiyam reedu ruttinii, jiiɓgol arii, walla matsala placenta/ɓinngel.
Hoto waɗu “wanka/koji nder reedu” walla hoto naatnu honɗun nder farji haa likita yi’i mo, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeyda ƴiyam walla infection.
Yahanee mo asibiti mawɗo jooni ngam ɓe waɗa ultrasound/scan, ɗowgol ɓinngel, BP, zazzabi, Hb, blood group, ɓe ndaara ko ɓinngel ina wuuri.
So ƴiyam ɗuuɗi, reedu na nawni, zazzabi, mo yulli, walla ɓinngel stoppi dillaade—ɗum ko galle galle, hoto haɗa mo dilla.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer: Nafa ɗum o tampata sahaa ɓiɗɗo on nana ko nafa potɗo (afterpains) sabu ɓamtaare oxytocin nde wadata ko mawninde reedu haa nde woppata ɓural ngal. Kono yaltugol ko ƴiye wano kosam ɗam, ina haani o waɗa 'ultrasound scan' reedu ngam ƴeewtude so tawii ko heddiiɓe reedu (retained placenta) walla ko ɓoggol ƴiiƴam potngam. Nafa ɗum o woppata les ɗerewol makko ko no njahrata e reedu nde woppata ko ɗum kadi ko nafa potɗo. O foti jokkude yarbude leɗɗe ɗe doktoor on dotti ɗam, so wonaa tawa ina woodi ƴiiƴam ɓurngo tatiika, ɓuuɓri mawndi walla ko huɗo bonɗo ummotoo. Ɗaɓɓitaneeɗo on waɗa yo o yillo doktoor ngam ƴeewndeede e waɗde scan ngol ngam hoolkisaade cellal makko timmungal.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer: Ee, alamaji ɗo o yara ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, o wanca ɗum ɗuɗɗum, e o wattata, ko ɗe alamaji nyau shuga (diabetes), amma njaram boɗeejo ɗum e caɗe nder ɓalli ɗon waawi holla kadi nyau Filiariasis walla nyau njaram (UTI) ɗe ɗon heewa waɗugo e nyauɓe shuga. Ɗum waɗi o foti yahde opitaal ngam waɗugo ƴeewngo ƴiiƴam (blood sugar test) e ƴeewngo njaram (urinalysis) ngam tabitinde ko ɗum woni nyau ngun. To ɗum nyau shuga, o ƴetta leɗɗe ɗe doktoor ndokki bana metformin walla insulin, o acca ñaamdu ɗe ɗuuɗi suukara bana ƴi'e e ɗokku. O ɓeyda ñaamugo ɗi ɗoƴƴuɗi bama kosam, diggol, e purƴi ngam wallude cellal ɓalli, tawa o ƴeewta ɓalli makko ɗuuɗuka. Kadi, o laɓɓina caɗe ɗe nder ɓalli makko e ndiyam sabulu o doga kuɗe ngam reena ɗum en ɓeyngude mawnude.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer:
Ko waɗi woni “bingel” no feewi e maɓɓe, ɗum ena waawi be hernia (ɓernde tawaama) ngam bangon fello maako ko yahi ko cindi e leydi naatude e gite.
Ko feewde tawa o walaa diiwa, o walaa ndewru, o walaa hakke kilo, ɗum ena haɗi no ɓuri hernia so tawii ɗum ena yaha kadi so tawii o welti no feewi.
Hernia ɗo, magani mawɗo ko feddere (surgery), sabu ɗum ena waawi ɓuri tawa so tawii o jipporee.
Ngam nafoore, reento e waɗde ko feewi: haɗa ɗawtude loowdi kañum, yiɗdu e waɗde haɓɓere no feewi, faggude tuufaare/cough e laawol, tee waɗde ndiyam e laawol ngam constipation.
So bingel ndiyam ena welti, o ɗo waɗi mballal, walla o waɗi saɓɓe, yah to asibiti kisa.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
answer: Sannu maada, ɗojugo ɓooymaajo be saɗeende fofugo ɓurɗum saɗugo wakkati jamma nder ɓingel duuɓi jowi, to ɗum wanaa nyawu tibi, waawi lencitugo asma (fuka) koo pure (allergy). Nyawu asma ɗon ɓiɗɗa ɗatal foofngo musamman wakkati jemma, ɗum waɗa ɓingel ɗoja bee uja ngam fofugo saɗani mo, ngam maajum lekki Tutolin wallataa ngam wanaa nyawu mboobo meere. Bana non boo, nyawu ɗojugo baali (whooping cough) koo njaangundi gineeji (pneumonia) je heɓaay laccitki booɗɗum waawan waddana ɓingel irin ɗum. Dan Allah yahru ɓingel asibiti ngam likita'en meeta ndaarugo gineeji maako, nden ɓe ndokka mo lekki pampam (inhaler) koo ko haandi ngam udditki ɗatal fofugo maako. Accu soodugo leɗɗe haa kanti walaa shawari likita nden taa tammude tibi koo gude ngam taa nyawu man ɓesdana ɓingel saɗeende.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Wadde a hokku nafaaɗo kaɗi-kaɗi, ko feewi yo a waɗtu ko laawol, a yaltu mo ka nder nder 20-30 minti caggal nafaaɗo, tee hoto a naatnoy mo ka laawol sa’i.

answer: Alamaji ɗi ɓingel ma waddi, bana dojjere jamma, ta'ol pofɗe, bee iido nder ɓerde, ɗo holla alama nyawu asma (asthma) ko bo pewol ɓerde mangol (pneumonia). answer: E dow ko on kaali, ene holli wonde ɓingel ngel ina jogii aleeji mawndi hakkunde ngaandi walla ɓernde, bana menenjit walla malaria cerebral. Min poti fuɗɗora reende ngeesa makko e lekki jukale (diazepam rektal walla nder ƴiiƴam), nden min ƴeewndo malaria e nder ƴiiƴam e, so alaa haɗde, min ƴeewndo ndiyam ɓingel (ponction lombaire) ngam anndude so ñawu nguu ko menenjit. So o waɗaani padde walla cuuɗi, maande ɗum o tampii, o yoɓaaki; min ngaddana mo ndiyam e nder ƴiiƴam e min ndaara golle kidey makko. So goɗɗum jokki, en nodda doktoor mawɗo ɓurɗo seeda ngam wallude.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. O nana osomi gite mako o yi'ata laɓɗo o vi' amin ogodi nyamugo ɓawo o danyi amma da kek o heɓi o nyami be nyiri mai wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta oɗo ɗaana o wala sembe be o fuddi nanugo gelo on feɗi bannin ko iyam vurti ha mako sosai o wala iyam o handini ko o handi ni. Kilungo iyam ko ɗume wa nanta mo min hokka mo iyam na ko min hokka mo nyiri.
answer:
Ɗum ko heɓi daada man hollata o ɗon sankita iyam sosai ɓaawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage), kanjum waɗi o wala sembe, o ɗon sula, kadi o ɗon nana gelo.

Teema handi en hokka mo iyam (blood transfusion) bee law, ta mboɗɗon mo nyiri jotta gam o somi kadi o waawan lukkugo ko mutugo.

Bago iyam heɓa, foti en fukka mo, en fottina lekki gije "IV fluids" (bana Normal Saline ko Ringer's Lactate) e juuɗe mako fuu gam ɓesdugo sembe ƴiiƴam mako (blood pressure).

Kadi, foti en masugo reedu mako (uterine massage) bee juuɗe meɗen, be en hokka mo lekkiji bana oxytocin ko misoprostol gam reedu ndun sika (contract), iyam man tatta.

# Jaabawol

**Nyaawu ngu debbo redu ɗo heɓi ngu ko "palpitations" e "shortness of breath" (ɓernde fiyugo law law e uppugo dande), nyaawu ngu foti ka ɗum jibaru redu (anemia) mo heewi e rewɓe redu ɓe.** Debbo redu na foti heɓa ɗiiɗi ƴiiƴam (increased blood volume) e wonugo yeeso ɓinngel, ɗum addata palpitations e nayeere (fatigue).

**Kono, alaamaaji o siftini ɗi—ɓernde fiyugo law, uppugo dande, satugo satiji, e ronkugo huutorgo jungo—foti ko alamaaji ɓurɗi bonugo wano hypertension (ɓalɗe ƴiiƴam ɓeydaade) walla ɓernde nawnaare (heart disease).** Ɗum ne foti anndinta wonugo "pre-eclampsia" so tawii ɓalɗe ƴiiƴam ɓeydike e proteins ɗon e cottol, ɗum ko caɗeele mawɗe e redu.

**Ko moƴƴi ko yaagol law law to safrirde ngam likita ɗaɓɓita ɓalɗe ƴiiƴam (blood pressure), ƴiiƴam (blood count/PCV), e cottol, ngam anndude ko addi alaamaaji ɗi e safrude ɗum law.** Wata a haɗtin—alaamaaji redu ɗi na foti wonude caɗeele ɓurɗi mawnude nde tawii safaara heɓaaki law.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. answer:
Debbo o ina mari nyaw reedu e ƴiiƴam caggal jibgol (sepsis) e malariya tiiɗɗo, ko ɗum waɗi gite makko ɗe ƴeeɓi (jaundice).
Omo haani neldireede opitaal mawɗo ko yaawi ngam heɓde leɗɗe nder ƴiiƴe (IV drip) hono antibiyotik e artesunate, tawa ko kuɗe (tablets) tan mbaawataa safrude ɗuum.
Wajjitii waɗde mo ƴeewndo ƴamarre (blood test) e ƴeewngo reedu ngam humpitaade ko addani parasitaaji ɗii njokkude e nguleendi ɓanndu.
Jaɓgol nyamnude mo kuɗe seeɗɗe e wakkati o ɗon mari caɗeele e ƴiiƴam nii, waawaa moƴƴitinde mo kono ina waawi bonnude nguurndam makko.
Ngam reende nguurndam makko ngam wallude sukaaɓe makko tato, accittoo neldude mo opitaal ngam safrugol jaajugol.

question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma
answer:
Sembe iyam 168/100 walla 150/90 ko ɓurɗo, ina waawi waɗude namugo hoore, muuyde, ɗanndugo jamma e ɓuuti-ɓuuti, amma haani ɓe ƴeewto mo no feewi haa ɓe calmina stroke, suga, nyawu ɓernde/reewɓe, kidney walla pre-eclampsia so debbo o jogii reedu.
O waɗu lekki sembe iyam ɗin no dokita hokki, o yaltina salte, maggi, mai-jewu, sigara/kola, o yara ndiyam, o foofa, o ɗaɓɓita BP mako subaka e jamma haa balɗe seeɗa.
So BP mako yotti 180/120 walla o heɓi namugo hoore mawɗo, yiyde ɓolɗe, sembe juɗe/koyɗe ɗiɗi ɗon lutta, haala ɗon bonna, ɓernde ɗon metta, wonde ɗon waɗa mo, walla o faɗi—ɓe naw mo asibiti jooni-joni.
So o jogii reedu, ko waɗi namugo hoore e uppugo yeeso, ɗum ko gawatiri; o yaha asibiti jooni ngam ƴeewtugo protein e fitsari e reedu.
Hade nyawu yotta, ko ndokkitaajo rewata mo, o joga lekki no feewi, o auna BP kullum, o waɗa gwaje-gwaje ɗin, o acca waɗugo lekki ɗin ko faamugo dokita.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Rufugo iyam ɗam sosai ɗon wara ngam iyam al'ada je ɓooyi ɗon wurtida wakkati gooto ngam reedu maako ɗon hoosa sanyi. Ngam darnugo iyam man lawlaw, hokku mo kwayaji *Aspirin* ngam ɗum ɗon walla iyam man haɓɓa wakkati gooto, bee allura *Vitamin C*. Ɓawo ɗon, hokku mo kwayaji *Iron* (Ayon) ngam ɓandu maako heɓa iyam kesam wakkati gooto ngam iyam je o rufi. Ummin mo o jooɗa tikkere ngam iyam man taa yaha hoore maako, boo hokku mo ndiyam gulɗam o yara ngam ɗum laaɓina saarawel maako. Lekkiiji ɗi bee matakiiji ɗi darnan iyam man lawlaw, hisna yonki maako wakkati gooto.

question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
answer: Alamuuji ɓingel ma ɗon holla woni hendu reedu bee fuɗɗoode wuddugo nyiiye ngaddi damuwa foofugo man. Hendu ɗon tura ɓernde mako, kanjum saabi o ɗon waɗa bulu bee turrugo wakkati o ɗon musa. Walaa haaje a hara likita fahin gam ɗum nyaw pamaro je ɓikkoi keccoy fuu ɗon heɓa. Soodu lekki reedu ba 'gripe water' a hokka mo, ɓawo ɗon a wujja nyebbam gulɗam haa gaada mako. To a waɗi ɗum, ɓingel foofan boɗɗum, bulu man boo majjan wakkati gooto, on mbaawi dillugo saare.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer: Alamji ɗi a laari ɗo fuu ɗum dabi'a, ɗum ɗon holla ɓandu ma ɗon laɓɓina hoore maako diga ndiyam duniya e tuundi ɓaawo danyugo. Naawalla les jaaburu e daande ma ɗum huunde nde woodi ngam ƴiiƴam ɗon wayla wartugo kosam ɓingel. Walaa haaje yaago asibiti, ko a haandi a waɗa tan woni a haɓɓa reedu ma bee leffol tiiɗɗum, nden a yara ndiyam guluɗam bee lamɗam ngam ɗum saaya ƴiiƴam ɗon. Chanji ɓingel bo ɗum ngam ngel ɗon woowa henndu yaasi, ngam maajum a ɓuuwa ngel bee limse ɗuuɗɗe. To a tokki matakiiji ɗi, a heɓataa nyawu koo ɗume, ɓandu ma wartan jam koo walaa lekki asibiti.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam feuɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
answer: Fofugo lawlaw (dakkere) bee dojjooru wakkati-wakkati nder ɓikkoi pettoi, ɓurna fuu nyawu mboombu (pneumonia) koo nyawu pallande foofugo waddata ɗum. Nyawuuji ɗi ɗon ɓilla goriiru foofugo ɓingel, ɗum haɗa hendu naatugo daidai, waɗa ɓingel fofa bee tiiɗaaku. Kooti koo mbutu-mbutu (virus) waddata nyawu nguu, na yiwgo ɓingel bee ndiyam peewɗam bana no yimɓe tammi ba. Kuje nde a waɗata lawlaw woni a yaara ɓingel asibiti ngam likita'en caanca, ɓe hokka lekki (antibiotics) koo hendu (oxygen) to dagi. Taa hokka lekki dojjooru koo safaare leɗɗe haa wuro; tiiɗa-foofugo woni alama nyawu nawnungu ngu waawi taya yonki ɓingel to a yaaraayi asibiti lawlaw.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
answer: Walaa safara mo mbaawataa kokkugo debbo ngam bingel dilla, tilay o yaa asibiti law ngam heɓugo "scan" (ultrasound) e heɗugo ɓernde bingel man. Famɗugo dillugo bingel nder lebbi jego ko maande bone, ɗum hollan bingel man ɗon e tampere walla ndiyam redu ɗon usta. "Scan" e heɗugo ɓernde bingel tan waaway hollugo cellal mako e ko fe'i nder redu haa laaɓa. Gorko mako duu foti yaa asibiti ngam ƴeewugo ko waɗi ɓawo mako ɗo nawa e ƴeewugo jabur (sukkar/cokkol) mako. Ndonkee kokkugo debbo man safaraaji ɓaawo laawol, ɗum ɗon ɓeyda bone haa bingel man.

question:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. De neɓi seeɗa , se saldorimo bobɗe . Ɗun goĝa on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata hinddeeko nyouru dun satayi amma ɗun pat manju ɗun waɗai. Da hanuno o ƴamɗita ,ƴowru tulliti. De O hilliti ,dou o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha Nyaurdorde o yi'a Nyautowo. Nde o yokki Nyaurdorde ,o yecci ɓe ,o ɗou ɗojja lebi tati ko saali. O lori fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
answer: Wannan yanayi ya nuna cewa goɗɗo tana da matsalar "anemia" ko kuma akwai matsalar jini a cikin jikinta wanda ya sa ta ji daci da kwarin rami. Saboda tsawon lokaci da ta sha kifi da kuma kishin kifi, yana iya zama wani abin da ya sa jikinta ya daina karɓar sinadarin da yake bukata. Dole ne a kiyaye ta don kada kishin kifin ya sa ta daina cin abinci mai gina jiki wanda zai ƙara da jinin ta. Ina ba da shawarar a yi ta gwaji don sanin matakin jini da kuma bincika ko akwai cutar "parasitism" (kwai ko kwayoyin cuta) a cikin jinin ta. Zai yi kyawu idan ta fara cin abinci kamar ganye da sinadarin jini, yayin da ake bin ta don ganin idan yanayin ya canza.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Rufugo iyam sembe ɓawo danyugo ɗum alama reedu debbo ɗon laɓɓina hoore maajum ngam ittugo iyam nyidduɗam nder ɓanndu. Ngam darnugo iyam man, fiyee mo allura *Heparin* ko on hokko mo lekki *Aspirin* ngam ɗum wallita ɗaɗi iyam reedu maako maɓɓa. Kadi on mbaɗa leppol ngulngol dow reedu maako ngam ɗum danna reedu man, amma taa on piyo mo ruwa asibiti (drip) sam ngam taa ndiyam ɓesda rufugo iyam man. On ɓamta hoore maako dow sosai, on tura kosɗe maako les ngam iyam man heɓa lora nder ɓanndu. To on waɗi ɗum, iyam man daroto wakkati seɗɗa, ngam maajum wala haaje turugo mo asibiti manga sam.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
answer: Alamuje ɗe ka ftata ɗe ko bana ñawu hakkille, hono fuɗɗorde saasumuki (psychosis) walla moyɓere ɓernde tiiɗnde. Doktoor ɗo poti yahde ko doktoor ñawuuji hakkille (Psychiatrist), ko kanko andi nyawuji berde, o tawatee e opitaal mawɗo. O ɓamtoo ko leɗɗe (medication) ɗe mbaawata wallitde mo haa o moƴƴa, kadi o waawanɗo heɗaade caɗe maɓɓe. Yantuma njillu nguu ari, hisnu mo e nder suudu, acca ƴattaade mo, ndokku mo ñaameteeɗe e ndiyam laaɓɗam. Ñawu nguu ina waawi safreede so ndartinaama e sahaa to doktoor on.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
answer: Rufugo iyam ɗuɗɗum ɓawo danygol (secondary PPH) ɗon saabe luttingo hettorde (retained placenta) nder saare ɓiɗɗo walla nyawu mbuuku (infection). Ngam darnugo iyam ɗon, doto'en ɗon kookata lekkiiji bana *oxytocin* walla *misoprostol*, e kadi ɓe loota nder saare ɓiɗɗo to goɗɗum luttii ton. Ngam o heɓa sembe mako kadi, haani o hokkaa ndiyam gillaaji (IV fluids), iyam to o lori (blood transfusion), e lekkiiji sembiɗingol iyam (iron). Mi ɗon shaworoo dada man o mumnina ɓinngel ngel enndi faat ngam ɗum ɗon wallita saare ɓiɗɗo ustago e darnugo iyam. Haani o taskoo laabal bandu mako, o nyaama nyaamdu mari sembe, boo to o yi'i iyam walla fooyre o lorta sibiti jaawɗum ngam hisna yonki mako be ɓinngel mako.

answer:

E nder laawol on, yaroy mo e nder leeso haa faya nano ngam wallude ƴiiƴam heɓde henndu, wanaa naftoroo huunde e nder tufleeje makko ngam haɗde ɓillaaji.

Seesta (CS) walla rokkude kuuɗe goɗɗe, ko doktoor mooftuɗo humpito tan poti suɓaade caggal nde o ƴeewta mo, wonaa ko min poti waɗde e hoore minen.

Yaawu nawde mo to opitaal toɗɗaaɗo ɗoo jooni, ɗum woni ko nafata ngam hisnude nguurndam yumma e cukalel ngel.

question: dai bo je jodata hasari amin o huwa dowada kugal mako bo o wala nyawu yande fere wakkati o do yi wa o nane en e mako do mari hunde petel satinga hada o numi wala ko dume o nani wala ko dume o lari o nani dum fahim nyande fere fahim do wakkati o dillai o fuddi numugo be mai sosai o fuddi numugo de mai on ha en e nyaku wala nyamugo molana wamo amma babali mai o sati bo sali dillugo o fuddi tum bo labari je ingol robbe je mari dum ha'i ndi naddi sati je sali o yahi larugo likita o yidi o anda dume on dasi dum de dumi on o wadata hala mai mdejema mdejemako mi on dasata hunde mai ha'i en idi bo ko mi onje satinga ha'i en i'o nagansa mi on de bolora talara fahim ha'i en imai
answer: Ɓoyre satunde, walaa naawalla nder enndu debbo, waaway laatago nyawu pamaru bana tana (fibroadenoma) koo boo nyawu ladde enndu (kansa). Ngam ɓoyre nden ɗon saati boo ɗon sali dillugo, o waɗi daadaa ngam o yehi larugo likitaajo laara daliila maajum. Nder asibitiiji amin, min ɗon waɗa sikaan (ultrasound) koo min ƴetta kusel pamarel (biopsy) ngam min laara koo kansa on waddi ɗum. Daliila waddata ɗum ɗon ƴiwoy diga tagdi ɓandu (hormones) koo iwdi asuli, ammaa faamugo law ɗon hisna yonki debbo. Vi'i mo taa o humtu, ammaa o tokka umroore likitaajo haa koondey ngam o heɓa lekki caahiiki.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer: Debbo on foti yahugo asibiti ngam waɗugo ndaargo yende (urinalysis) da scan, amma wada yahugo larugo babal mai ngam safiti mawɗo ina waawi bonnugo ƴiƴe (kidneys) mako. Ƴiiƴam ha yende bee ciwol wada fahin fahin ina holla nyau infection (UTI), haƴre ƴiƴe (kidney stones), walla schistosomiasis (nyau ruji) je heewi ha endiije men. Wala safara jemma mo o yari o sotta tawi likita andaa ko nyau on woni, ngam safaraaji ɗin ina mbaawi ɓeydugo nyau mako. To o yahi asibiti, likita soto o hokki mo safara je fotti, bana antibiotics to ko infection, walla praziquantel to ko schistosomiasis. Ngam majjum, o acca larugo babal mai, o yaara asibiti joni ngam o heɓa dagnugo nyau mako da safara je hakkilannde.

answer: Alaamaaji nawol hoore mangol, daande tiggunde nde waawata waylugo, e pulel perpetel wurtungel e ɓandu ɗon holla gorko maako ɗon mari nyawu masiibo inneteeɗo Sankara (Meningitis). Nyawu ngun ko kulle pamare inneteeɗe bakteriya addanta ɗum, ɗum ɗon heewi nder leydi Naajeeriya, te pulel ngel ɗon holla bakteriya majjum saasi faati haa nder ƴiiƴam maako. Debbo ɗon haani yaaranugo gorko maako asibiti lawlaw koo ɓe ndoƴƴa, ngam nyawu Sankara nguun wulataa lakkiteego haa saare sam. Likito'en ɗon haani fukkugo mo, ɓe ƴeewa ndiyam ɓawo maako, nden ɓe mbakka mo bakkale lekki (intravenous antibiotics) ngam warugo kulle ɗen law. Wakkati ɗon mari haaje masin, ngam to ɓe leeli o heɓaay lekki, nyawu ngun waaway warugo mo malla waddana mo lakkule ɗe ngamnata haa abada.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Tilola, alamaji bingel ma holli bana zazzabi mangi, dande sati, be gite mabbutaako, don holla alama nyaw sankaraw (meningitis) walaa shakka. Nyaw sankaraw don wadda kakkudi nder ndiyam dande be nyi'e hakkilo, kanjum wadi dande bingel sati be nerviiji gite naawi ngam kakkudi man. Dila be bingel man haa asibiti mawnugo jotta-jotta, ngam nyawndi ndi faadaa, ndi wawan hooyugo yonki to a leeli. Haa asibiti, likitoci fottan tefta ndiyam caka kukuwal bingel (lumbar puncture) be yiyam ngam be anda ko waddi zazzabi man tabas. To on yehi, masinji asibiti nder 'lab' yeccante ko woni nder bandu bingel ma, bo likita'en fuddan laccu bingel man nder gaara yiyam law-law.

answer:

Sey law law ɓe neldi ɓingel to opitaal mawɗo ngam heɓugo oksijen e ñawndi leɗɗe (antibiyotik) ɗe safroowo hokkata.
Daada e ɓaɓa ina poti hakkillaade so ɓingel fofii ko ɓuri heewi, ɓalndu maggo naati nder fooftere, tampere ɓeydii, ɓingel woppi musude fof, walla waɗii fitinaaji.

question: debbo ɗo danyi ha amin fajira ɗo veyti ɗo danyi de o wari jambi jeytati be fajira mun wondi be mako hasare yoni amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako do diwna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o ɗo mari damuwaji ko shafi ɓandu mako je damata mo sosai min yahi min lari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolwugo ɓandu mako min tawi 38.2 min wanni mo goɗɗi ɓe nyamu cuufi gam debbo ɗo welnai o nanɗi maleriya min emi mo ko wonɗi ko o nyami o wi wala ko o nyami min yetti mo wonɗi mo wonɗi be mako ɓe hokka mo sha'i o yara min emi mo o musini hande na se o wi de o wari musungo ɓingel may sey o tawi keccel may riwi sey min wi debbo may o umma o joɗa o ɓara ɓawo mako heɓa vallita ɓandu mako hoyna seɗɗa ɗo pat ɗa pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laaɓai min sawri mo to nyamini sai o yara paracetamol to o yari paracetamol mai timmi sai min lara dai ɗon hanɗi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria kuma min waɗi mo goji mai useni min wawan min hokka mo fahin to o timmini yamugo ɗen bo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol tunda o satai to dillai ni min handi yaudi dim min mokamo min hokka to

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer: Ɓingel keccel ngel ɗon mari caɗeele inneteeɗe *Birth Asphyxia*, waato ngel heɓaay hendu (oxygen) ko he'i nder ngaandi wakkati danygol, kanjum waɗi ngel wokkataa, ngel fofataa boɗɗum, kadi ɓandu maagel ɗon tiiɗi koo lo'i. Mataki jawjawri ko haani waɗeego kanjum on wuuwugo kine e hunnduko maagel, hokkugo ngel hendu jawjaw (resuscitation), e naadugo ngel nder dakiire asibiti keeriinde ngam ɓikkoi keccoy (SCBU) ngam ɗum faggitina ngel. Gooji (tests) ɗi haani waɗeego hawti e ƴeewugo sukkaari e mboowu (infection) nder ƴiiƴam ɓingel, bee ƴeewugo kalar ƴiiƴam daada (*blood group*) koo ɗon mari caɗeele liddiigo (Rh incompatibility) sabu ɓikkoi maako maayɓe ɓawo. E gandal am nder asibitiiji Afrik, booyugo wakkati danygol koo nyawu daada mo huraaka wakkati reedu (bana *syphilis*) ɓuri waddude irin lallibaaji ɗi. To ɓingel heɓi wallindeeki hendu e maagani jawjaw haa asibiti, ngel yamɗitay, ngaandi maagel fottitay kadi ngel fuɗɗan dimbugo e musinugo boɗɗum.

question: debbo do danyi ha sibiti mai dan labbi jego ko sali o wadi sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi bingel mardo labbi jego mai o wardi be mako jonta dada man wadi bayani du o heriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nayi ko sali o wi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda o wi dojjere man halli on daga ki'a balde tati ko fuddi amma har durti o wi de o musinimo fu odon hokkamo lekki diyam je nder gora je be sorata je do jogo do je o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara o wi daga keya do jogoman turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawan fofa be boddum gidami am sosai bana bofde man do ta'a on do yaha dow do je palace kala wakkati fu be hultiri hanjum wadi be waddi musibiti meden jotta emol am hado hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo be bingel do ha sare na larugo no pofde mako ta'ata be dojjere do min vindina be lekki dojjugo na ko'en wadda goje goje dow bingel man yiddeko min hokkamo lekki ko bate
answer:
Bingel do woodi nyaw pofɗe mawɗo (severe respiratory distress/pneumonia), nden o yonaay laartitirego haa saare sam ngam ɗum ɗon hula yonki maako.

Haani o naasta asibiti jotta ngam en hokka mo pofgal (oxygen) bee lekkiiji mbuuɗotooɗi (IV antibiotics) ngam hisgo mo.

Taa mbindanmo lekki dojjugo (cough syrup) koo hokka mo lekki dambe bee ndiyam gora, ngam ɗum ɗon mawnina nyaw bingel pamaro bana o'o.

Nden boo, dada man haani muynugo bingel man kalfungaɗum (exclusive breastfeeding) tan, wala hokka mo kowyeere feere haa o yotta lebbi jego ngam reenugo nyabbeeli.

Ngaddee bingel man jotta haa suudu gollirdu Emergency ngam en puɗɗa safareeji mawnunɗi ngam hisgo mo.

answer: Debbo maaɗa ina wondi e rafi hakkillo baɗɗo caggal danygol (postpartum psychosis), mo alamaaji mum njogii nanugol daande, miijo doggol, e yoɓɓol ɓernde fof. To ballal ngal heɓaaka law, o waawi waɗude ko bonnata hoore makko, ko waɗi ɗum yaawde waajib. Nde o heɓi safaara moƴƴo, o waawi sellude timmude.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
answer: Alamaji di lari do, zazzabi cizon lamu (malaria) be taifod (typhoid) kakkurdi naati hoore mako, naa nyawu hakkilo ko metol berde kogan. Gam man, taa hooyu mo yaara haa likitaajo nyawu hakkilo ko andudo nyawuji berde gam o heba shawara. Kadi, on wada mo dole o loota be ndiyam peewdam masin kala fajjiri gam ƴiiƴam mako yaha, hoore mako fina fuddan nyamugo. Toh on wadi do, baasi mako fuu hattan wakkati gotel, o wartan fijigo be sobirabe mako bana no o wowi.

Taa waɗu puchol ngol e hoore maa walla taa yah rimɗo ɗum, ngam ɗum ɓeydaa rafi e nasta nyobule nder ƴiiƴam.
Mbaawaa waɗande ɗum tan ko lamɗam ndiyam gulɗam laaɓɗam ngam wallude ɓooɗol ngol ɓilta, ammaa ɗum loraaki safaara ganndal.

answer:
Debbo o ɗon wondi e masiibo iyam ɗuɗɗum yaasi ɓaawo danyugo (postpartum hemorrhage), e o ɗon yiɗi yaadu asibiti jotta.

answer:

Haa nde o yi’a likita, o yar ndiyam laaɓɗam, o acca zaki/soft drink/juice/ti shuga, o ɓamta nyamri: ganyen miya, wake, kifi/nyama, e o famɗina tuwo/shinkafa/gari.
To o ɗo yuyra sosai, o ɗo amai, ciki mettude, numfashi no yaawi, walla o ɗo sumorii, ɗum gawatiri—ngar asibiti jooni.

question: renowo ɓingel laari ɓingel may ɗo docca sosai nauɗum har karshe doccugo mingel nonnon tan fofugo daker toh ɗume ɗon waɗata doccugo haa ɓingel bannin tan har karshe doccugo may wala fofa boɗɗum daker daker fofata goji ɗume be ɗume ɓe wawata ɓe wanna ɓingel ɗo coɓoraaɗe toy min hokkata mo be kuma shawara toy hokkata reenuwo ɓingel may
answer:
Mi faami nacaake maa. Ngel ɓinngel maa no woodi doccugo dume dume e daker (feɓaango) haa fusaa - ɗum no wi'ee "bronchiolitis" walla mbeelu mbeelu ndeer ɓernde, kaa ndu no waawi wonde asma (asthma) ɗo ɓikkoy.

Reenugo ngel ɓinngel:
1. **Yaha safrorde walla ospitaali law-law** so tawi ngel no doccude sanne, foofaango mum no yaawi, walla nguru mum no waylii wojjere walla buluu - ɗum maanaa ngel heɓaani foofaango moƴƴo.
2. Reen ngel e curu (huɗo), toko (smoke), pusru, e cuurki nyaame - ɗum ina ɓeydi doccugo.
3. Hokku ngel ndiyam e mbaalu no waawi wonde so ngel no soomii, tee reen ngel e ɓuɓɓol.

Doktoro no waawi ferle ngel lekki fatta doccugo (bronchodilator/inhaler) walla lekki wombo (nebulizer) so tawi ko asma, tee o wi'a ma no ndokkirtaa ngel. Mi weltike so a yaari ngel safrorde ngam ɓe ndaara ngel no moƴƴi tee ɓe hokka ma safaara laaɓɗo.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
answer: Alamaaji ɗi debbo man holli, wato nawol jaburru be ɓawo bana non bo be yiiyam be ndiyam ɗon wara, naa alama debbo yotti fukkugo ba ngam redu mako lebbi jego on tan (wakati yottai). Ɗum masibo wurtango ɓingel ko wakati yottai (preterm labour) koo bo tawe sappo (placenta) ɗon ɓorta nder redu ngam nawol turoowol be yiiyam ɗon wara hawta. Eey, on wawan yaarugo mo o waɗa hoto redu wato "Scan" ngam a laara no ɓingel be sappo wa’i nder redu. Amma don-don, on yara mo asibiti manga je mari likita’en rewɓe ngam ɓe ndarna yiiyam man, ɓe ndaara no ɓe hisna ngurndam mako be ɓingel man.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
answer: Rufugo iyam ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa ɓuri waɗde ngam heddiigo geɗal ɓiɗɗo nder reedu, malla nyau nder reedu (endometritis), ko ɗon haɗa reedu haɓɓaago. Nder sibiti a waawi hokkude leɗɗe ɓeydanooje sembe reedu (uterotonics) bana misoprostol, e antibiotik ngam haɓaago nyau. To iyam ɗon rufa dudi masin, ɓe njaara hokkude ƴiƴam ngam o lorta sembe mako e yaawre. Dada debbo haani fooɗugo ɓingel mum ɗon-ɗon, ɗum wallita reedu haɓɓaago, o nyaama nyamdu ɓeydiyam iyam bana heeñere ɓaleeje, haako kore e kosam. Shawara mawnde: o warta sibiti law to o yi’i koo ɗume waylaaki, o fooɗ ɓingel wooɗi, o fowtaa, o walaa kulol.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer: Caɗeele debbo ɗee woni "puerperal sepsis" (infection reedu caggal daygol) be "uterine atony" (reedu luttii) sabu jamdi mako ɗo heɓi wakkati juutugo, wanaa malaria. A haani darta hokkugo mo nyau malaria to a testaali, a haani hokkugo mo "antibiotics" (hano Ampicillin, Gentamicin, be Metronidazole) nder ɗaɗol (IV) law ngam safargo infection reedu mako. Jokku hokkugo mo "oxytocin" ko "misoprostol" ngam reedu mako tiiɗa, amma a haani laarugo to jamdi heddii nder reedu ngam a itta ɗum be junngo ko masin (MVA). Suddu mo ɗaɗol (IV fluids) ngam o heɓa semmbe, a laara ƴiiƴam mako ngam haɓugo be ƴiiƴam to o heɓii ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗɗam. Safargo debbo ɗo e infection reedu caggal daygol be ittago ko heddii nder reedu ɗon haani waɗeede law ngam o maaya be sepsis ko ƴiiƴam.

question: dai bo je jodata hasari amin o huwa dowada kugal mako bo o wala nyawu yande fere wakkati o do yi wa o nane en e mako do mari hunde petel satinga hada o numi wala ko dume o nani wala ko dume o lari o nani dum fahim nyande fere fahim do wakkati o dillai o fuddi numugo be mai sosai o fuddi numugo de mai on ha en e nyaku wala nyamugo molana wamo amma babali mai o sati bo sali dillugo o fuddi tum bo labari je ingol robbe je mari dum ha'i ndi naddi sati je sali o yahi larugo likita o yidi o anda dume on dasi dum de dumi on o wadata hala mai mdejema mdejemako mi on dasata hunde mai ha'i en idi bo ko mi onje satinga ha'i en i'o nagansa mi on de bolora talara fahim ha'i en imai
answer:
Mi faami ko a wolwata. Kono, no woodi ko mi salii: mi anda tigi tigi ndi labarey moye a wolwata haa.

Ngal ngol wolde maa fewndi haa nyawu **hakkil** (mental health), sabi maa yeewti fii:
- Neɗɗo mo huwata golle mum booɗɗum, kono jooni o jaggii, o nanaa welɗum, o himmaa golle,
- O horii ñaamde e ñaamdu, o himmaa yaadu,
- Ɓe ngoni miijitaade fii cellal mum (worries, anxiety),
- Waɗi tuma o larii likita, ɓe njoolataako ko wonaa haa ɓalndu mum.

Ɗiin kala ko maandeeje **buŋre/muusu hakkil** (depression walla anxiety), ɗum ko nyawu tigi, wonaa "waame walla juju" hono no yimɓe njeddi. Mi wiyi golle: **jooɗ e likita cellal hakkil (mental health clinic) walla likita mawɗo**, o hebba safaara e wolde-safaara (counselling); nyawu ngu no sella no wooɗi si o hebi ballal law. Tiiɗno, nyawuɗo o hokku maa taƴitaare, ɓeydu welɗeere, njamnaa mo si o miijii bonannde hoore mum.

question: debbo mo ɗuɓi caɓɓanɗe tati danyi minti seɗɗa ko saali danyugo may daidai ɗon amma day ɓe danyi ɓingel ɗo ɓingel ɗo ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum ndenbo wala notititta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo danyugo ɓingel may wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone ha finugo ɓandu ɓingel may ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimbano handi ɓingel may wala nyama boɗɗum ɓe torna mo musulungo dada may ɗo sakli ngam ɓikkoiji mako ɓe saali ɗo ɓe ɗo woka ataake to ɓe ɗanyi may ɗume on waɗata damuwa ɗo godi toy ɓe waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki geggewol toy hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo
answer: Ɓingel ngel ina waawi heɓde rafi ƴiiƴam ɓuuɓɗo (neonatal sepsis) walla caɗe henndu (birth asphyxia), ɗum ko ko addani ngel waasde woya, mawnude, e ƴattaade. Hokkude 'musulungo' aadaaji ina waawi bonnude ɓanndu ɓingel ngel tee ɗum moƴƴaani e rafi o. Ɗuum ko sabu ƴiiƴam ɓuuɓɓam walla famɗude henndu e nder danygol ina addana ɗum caɗe, ɗum noon ko doktoor tan waawi safreede e opitaal. Neldon ɓingel ngel to opitaal jooni ngam heɓde oksijen e leɗɗe (antibiotics) rewrude e ƴiiƴam. Yaawgol yahde opitaal ko haaneteeɗo, kala caggal ɗuum ina waawi addande maayde walla caɗe duumiiɗe e hoore ɓingel ngel.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
answer: Reedujo on ɗon mari lornina hakkilo e kulol ɗe ɗon addana mo ƴiiɓam ɗo e mette nder reedu, ɗum ko ɗaɓɓa ƴeewngo saawra to sibiti ngam hisnude nguurndam maako e ɓiɗɗo on. Ɓii'ude ƴiiɓam ɗo o heɓata ɗo ɗon ɗaɓɓa ƴeewngo doktoor rewɓe e ƴeewndirde ultrasound to sibiti, o acca ɗum huutortoo lekki gargajiya ɗin bawo ɗi mbaawaa dartinde caɗeele ɗen. Kulol e mette ɗe gorko maako naddata ɗum ɗon ɓeyda caɗeele ɓernde, ɗum ko ɗaɓɓa o ɗaɓɓa ballal doktoor ngam ƴeewndirde hakkillo maako (counseling) ngam wallitde mo heɓde jam. Ko ɓuri teeŋtude ko yo o artu sibiti saawra yaajɗa ngam ƴeewteede ngam heɓde safaa'e potɗe ɗe ƴellitirta cellal makko e jam hakkillo maako.

question:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. De neɓi seeɗa , se saldorimo bobɗe . Ɗun goĝa on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata hinddeeko nyouru dun satayi amma ɗun pat manju ɗun waɗai. Da hanuno o ƴamɗita ,ƴowru tulliti. De O hilliti ,dou o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha Nyaurdorde o yi'a Nyautowo. Nde o yokki Nyaurdorde ,o yecci ɓe ,o ɗou ɗojja lebi tati ko saali. O lori fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
answer: Subeeru wonaa ɓe noddata cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer: Fofugo ɓingel caca, wulugo hoore, e tampiri musinngo ɗon holla tan kosam daada ɗon tiddi masin dow reedu ɓingel. Ɗum wulugo ɓandu e fofugo dow-les ɗo ko alamaaji boɗɗi hollooji ɓingel yiɗi fuɗɗugo nyi'e, na nyawu nawnngu koo go'o. Ngam wallugo ɓingel ngel, daada fota yoftugo musinngo wakkati seɗɗa, hokka ngel ndiyam guluwe bee jumri (honey) ngam ɓernde maagel laaɓa. Baaba ɓingel boo fota wujjuki ɓernde e hoore maagel bee nebbam wulɗam ngam fofugo caca go'o daro. Walaa haaje yaha asibiti gam walaa damuwa, ɗum kade al'aada ngam mawngu ɓikkon peetoy fuu.

question:
Gorko am dubi mako cappende ni. Denbo mi hirliti saati tati ko saali do odo fi ta yara diyam sosai sosai. No o yarata deyam mai nonon o sillata. Toh oyari dumdum ma nonnon. Kuma nonnon ma be jamma o finai wadai de sappo, o ummi o yaha o silla. Odo wooka fu, odo nana chomri kullum. Bo odon beddi bandu sedda. Wakati fere odo fi’a o do lara dowre, owala laara boddum to o ummi odo wancha. Mi hirliti odo silla akai akai bo dundum bo. Dumedon watata sillugo mere mere do be donka do? Kwadi oyarata diyam dumdum denbo odo silla duddum? Ko alaamaji do waawan je ye’u shuga, ko hundeji fere don? Haunigo toi be goji toi waddata heba hefta irin ye’u toi don do? Kowadi odo somi kullum do? Dumedon waddata silligo akai akai do? Do sembe eyam mako bamti don waddata ye’u do, ko diyam bandu mako timmi na, ko kujjeji fere don tan? Irin yiiri be kujeji yarugo toi o acchata, kuma dume don haadi odinga yaamugo?
Mataaki toi ohosata, vallititta alaamaji do? De haadi noi goji be haunugo je Ye’u shuga haadi wada, kullum na ko yandego yandego? Ye’u toi don waddata alaamaji do je fe’data ha bandu mako?
answer: Wannan cuta tana nuna alamajin ciwon sukar (Diabetes Mellitus), wanda yake sa jini ya yayi daɗin suga kuma ya sa jini ya yi kuncin (high blood sugar). Alamajin da ka bayyana, kamar kishin kusa, kusan fita, da kuma nanar jiki, suna nuna cewa jini ba ya iya amfani da sugar yadda ya kamata don samar da kuzari. Ana bukatar yin gwajin jini (Blood Glucose Test) don tabbatar da matakin sugar da kuma binciken kwayoyin cuta ko kuma matsalar kwayar jini (hypertension). A halin yanzu, ana bukatar cin abinci mai amfani, shan ruwa sosai, da kuma cin magungin da likita zai ba don daidaita matakin sugar a jini. Idan ba a magance ba, cutar tana iya kawo matsaloli masu tsanani kamar cutar koda ko lalacewar idanu.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Sannu Tilola, ɗum ɗon wada ngam ɓiɗɗo maada ɗon fuɗa nyi'e (teething), nden boo o waali laawol ngol walaa wooɗi waɗi daande maako nangi hendu pewtundu. Zazzabi bee daande nde waylitata ɗon wara ngam ɗaɗi daande nangi ɓernde nyi'e maako ngam ɗum ɗon fuda. Ngam dartina ɗamru ndam, hokka mo Siɓiti (Oxytocin) tawa ko doktoor yamiri, wana kadi lelɗo reedu (uterine massage) ngam wallugo reedu ndu darnde.
Ƴeewto so ɓingel gaccam yaltiima timmude, so wanaaki, ittu ngel e laawol cellungal potɗun.
Waddiraa nafooje leɗɗe (herbs) ngam ɗe nafataa safrude ɗam, ƴeewto kadi so tawii ko ɗamru ƴiiƴam (tears) e laawol danyugo woni sabaabu ngam cuɓeede.

question: dada joɗata ha fattude amin ɗo mari redu je ɓingel mako ɗiɗabo ha fuɗɗere redu mai komai o yaha dai- dai o ɗo nana belɗum ɓingel fere ɗo wara amma lewru seɗɗa ko saali ɗo o fuɗɗi nanugo les redu mako ɗo nawa nyande nawɗum mai waɗi mo sossai har dakai o darata boɗɗum neɓai sam ɓawo ton o fuɗɗi rufugo iyam sossai rufugo iyam mai nda no rufata ɗon ba rufi sossai kuma watti mo tuni o do somi nde o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri ta ni ɗon ko fe'i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi valli mo ɓeyahi sibiti ɗemle am kanjum ɗume ɗon watata nawugo les redu haa redujo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo alama hattara ɗon nana jey dada ko ɓingel haa redu may ɗume on alama goɗɗo larata redu may ɗon damuwa ɗon lekki jey darnata nawɗum may na ɓeddarna iyam may jey nawnata ɓingel may
answer: Nawre les reedu tiiɗnde e rufuki iyam sossai e debbo reedu ko alamaaji hattara mawɗi ɗon holla toksemia reedu (pre-eclampsia mawnde) malla abruption placenta (reedu seertii e ɓingel) – kamɓe ɗon waɗa reedu nana metti haa debbo waawa daraaki, iyam ɗon rufa, ɗum ɓeydoo heebannde reedu. Ɗum alama hattara mawnde wonande daada e ɓingel sabu ɗon waawi warde maɓɓe law. Lekki darnata nawre ndu e darnata iyam ɗon waawi heɓaaka so naa nder opitaal mawɗo ɗo ɓe kokkata debbo oo magnesium sulfate, leɗɗe ɗe ngaddata iyam (transfusion), ɓe ittana ɓingel ngam hisnude daada e ɓingel. So a yiyii debbo ina wonda e maandeeji ɗii, a waɗa semmbe yawre ngam o yaɓɓa opitaal o warde ɓingel ko yaawani. Waktu ko carel; leeltol waawi warude daada e ɓingel.

question:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do?
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
answer: Dada wannan ɓingal, ana neman rufe daidai na kaji (ear canal) da kuma raba kura ko jini da ke ciki domin rage ciwo da yaki. Shawarata ita ce kada ya yi amfani da wani abu mai dudi kamar kura ko ruwan baki, domin hakan na iya sa kaji ya yi yayi ko ka samu cutar kaji (otitis externa). Ya kamata ya yi amfani da tsumu (cotton swab) mai natsuwa don jan kura da ke waje kawai, ba tare da shigowa kaji sosai ba. Idan ciwon ya yi tsanani, ya kamata ya nemi likita domin yin wani magani na ruwa ko maganin kaji (ear drops) da za a sanya a ciki. Rufe daidai zai taimaka wajen rage yawan kura da kuma sa kaji ya samu numfashi da natsuwa.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Rufugo iyam sembe ɓawo danyugo (PPH) ɗon wara ngam redu uwtaki (uterine atony), luttal danyel goɗɗo ko luttal koɗem danyel ha nder, ko bo barme ha danyirde. Kuuje arande je kuwatton kanjum on peeɗol redu (uterine massage) ngam redu uwtugo, bo kuttone to danyel goɗɗo ɗon ha nder redu ngam darna iyam man. Hokkee debbo ɗo batal *Oxytocin* unit gajji sappo (10 IU) ha dango ko ha iyam ɓandu (IV) ngam darna rufugo iyam ɗon law-law. To wala *Oxytocin*, naftiree kwayaji *Misoprostol* microgram 800 ha les demgal (sublingual) ko ha sigo, ko bo batal *Ergometrine* to debbo ɗo wala iyam dow (hypertension). To iyam ɗon sali darugo, naddiranee mo iyam ɓandu (IV fluids) nden tura mo asibiti manga be yaawre ngam hisgo yonki maako.

answer: Oɗo debbo reeduujo ɗo mari nyawu ƴawoore ƴiiƴam mawndi nder reedu (Severe Preeclampsia), ngam hoore naawande, ɓuutol ɓandu, be gite daurɗe ɗe o yi'ata. Nyawu ngun ɗo holla ƴawoore ƴiiƴam ɗon tora ɓandu be ngaandi mako, ɗum bo wawan waddigo faddere (eclampsia) haa debbo to ɓe reenay. O haani o jooɗa haa asibiti lawlaw ngam ɓe auna ndiyam cille mako, be hokkugo mo lekki bammbiiji (Magnesium Sulfate) ngam haɗugo faddere nden. Magani nyawu ngun timmi ko rimmbugo cukkayel ngel, ngam maajum likito'en haani ɓe kakkilana mo sosaay koo ɓe seeka mo (CS) to wakkati rimmbugo yottake ngam hisnugo mo be ɓingel ngel. O haani o fowta boɗɗum, o acca miilooji mettooji ɓernde, nden o tokka yarugo lekki ƴawoore ƴiiƴam ɗi likito'en hokki mo.
