answer: Eey, yerbu debbo man kisin to asibitirde mawnde nde woodi sifaa wallugo ɓiɓɓe pamari (NICU) sabu o ɗon jibina ɓiɗɗo lebbi jeygo. Ɗiggal ƴiiƴam be dilla redu holli wonde o woodi ko nawi haa nder redu wano "placental abruption", ɗum ɗon haani darnde likitaaɓe mawɓe. Asibitirde mawnde tan woodi ƴiiƴam, masiŋaaji, be likitaaɓe annduɓe ngam hisnugo nguurndam makko be ɓiɗɗo man. Haa wakkati yerbugo man, accu mo ɗon lelii e bannge nano, o ɗon lari ɗiyam nder ɓanndu, kadi a nodda ambulan. On waɗi ko haani ngam on anndi ko on mbaawaa wallugo mo, ɗum woni laawol hisnugo nguurndam.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam feuɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
answer: Haala ɗo ko ɓuuɓri henndu (infantile colic) nder ɓalndu ɓingel ngel, ko ɗum waɗi ɗum ina woya, haɗan rokkude ɗum "li'al" walla ndiyam nguleendi sabu ɗum ko bonannde mawnde waawi taƴde ƴiiƴe nder ɓalndu. Ko haɗata ɓuuɓri (fofugo) ɗii ko yo yumma mum (haa teeŋti noon e rewɓe jeyngol) ñaamta ko laaɓta, o nafku ɓingel ngel laawol gootol, o mem ɓalndu ɓingel ngel seeɗa e ɓernde ngam wallude henndu nduu yaltude. Caggal kala nde ɓingel ngel woni e yaraade kosam, yumma mum yo nafku ɗum laawol gootol ngam yo ɗum yaltu e henndu (burping), ɗum noon ko haɗata ɓalndu nduu fofugo. Woppude aadaaji bonɗi ɗii ko noon ɓuri cellal ɓingel ngel moƴƴude, kadi rokkude ɗum ko ɓuri heewde ko yumma mum tawa ko e cellal tan. Kono so ɓingel ngel woyi ko juuti, dañii heckere, walla ɓuuɓri ndii ɓeydii mawnude, ko yaawngo yahde opitaal ngam ƴeewndaade ñawu nguu wona ko colic tan.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer:
Ndu'u nyawu on nguu debbo heɓata rufugo iyam masin ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum hemorrhage), kanjum waddi soynde iyam cattuɗum je waɗi ɓandu maako laaɓi, kosɗe e juuɗe maako fewi, bo o somi masin.

Miilo dada maako ɗon haa laawol; dole likitaajo laaɓina saaldu ɓingel (womb) ngam ittugo heddiije so'oore danyugo ko heddi nder ɓandu waddata rufugo iyam man.

Haa sibiti ɗon e ɗon, dole min lora mo ndiyam ɓandu (IV fluids) e min ɓesda mo iyam kesam ngam o heɓtindira iyam ko rufi ɗam, ngam hisnugo yonki maako.

Min kadi min piya mo baatal darnugo iyam (bano Oxytocin) ngam wallugo saaldu ɓingel ndu nyukkitoo e darnugo rufugo iyam man faf.

Be ɗi'i lekkiiji e kakkilanol sibiti cattuɗum, sembe maako lornitoto bo o waawan hakkilgo ɓingel maako booɗɗum.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
answer: Alaamaji bana ɗojjo tiiɗngo, saɗteende foofaango (fofugo dakerdo), e somugo law ɗon sabaabo ngam caɗeele nder ɓokkooje (bana nyaw asma malla tibo) malla nyaw ɓernde. To ɓernde waawataa pampugo ƴiiƴam no haaniri, ndiyam ɗon waawi mooɓtugo nder ɓokkooje, ɗum adda ɗojjo e saɗteende foofaango wakkati neɗɗo ɗon yaha malla to o waali. Alaamaji kulɓiniiɗi ɗi haandi bandiraaɓe lara hakkilina ngoni: foofaango tiiɗngo masin haa neɗɗo waawataa wolwugo, tuutugo ƴiiƴam, naawol nder gabaare, e uumaango wakkati foofaango. To ɗii alaamaji kulɓiniiɗi ɗon feenya, ɗum firti nyawu ngun ɗon mawnira e ɗum waawi warugo neɗɗo to o heɓaay wallende. Ngam maajum, sarda e rewɓe oo yiɗi hooygo gorko maako asibiti law-law, ngam likita en kuuwa bincike (tests) ɓe annda asali nyawu ngu haa ɓe ndokka mo safaara keneendi.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
answer: Vurtungo dammutore bee ɗuti ɗon nufa lekki abboro ki ɗon huuwa booɗɗum ngam vurtungo tooke rawandu mai daga ɓandu bingel. To rawandu mai ɗon jam ba, wala haaje yarugo bingel asibiti ngam heɓugo allura baccin (vaccine) ngam o wawata heɓugo nyau rawandu. Safaare ɓurnde wooɗugo jonta kanko a woka babal mai bee ndiyam ngulɗam, ɓaawo ɗon a wuuja nebbam boɗejam ngam usta ɗuti mai. Wala damuwa, tokken safaare gargajiya nde haa babal mai maɓɓa, bingel heɓata kowoni.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
answer: Miɗo waɗi ko feewi haa mi jawdi ɗum ɗoo, miɗo waɗde mawnude ko ɗum woni e ko ɗum waɗata, kisa mi waɗde e ko fiiɗa.Ko ɗum ina yiɗi, ɗum ina heɓɓi alamaji naatude “deep vein thrombosis (DVT)”. Ɗum ko haɗari sabu goɗɗo, sabu fayde goɗɗo yahda e yitere (pulmonary embolism), ɗum ko sababbin saare. Awa, yah to asibiti faako; doctoor maa waɗi Doppler ultrasound, kisa maa hokku cinandi ndiyam (anticoagulant) ngam haɗa laanaaji ndiyam. Hoto, fof ko feewi, haɗa kaɓɓol, cuppiti, walla tampi e hakkunde; haɗa rewrude saare. So aɗa waɗi waɗiɗi, aɗa waɗi aɗaɓɓe, walla aɗaɗi e laawol, waɗi waɗi waɗi waɗiɗi e jom leydi.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
answer: Alamaji ɗin—wano fofugo bone, wuitugo wakkati fofugo kosam, ta'ugo gabbal, e waylitugo leppol—ina kolla ko ɓingel man ina mari rafi ɓernde jibinannde (Congenital Heart Disease) adduɗo tampannde ɓernde (Heart Failure), walla rafi hanta tiiɗuɗo (Pneumonia). Wakkati ɓingel fofata, ɓernde man ina tampan, ɗum addata ndiyam nder hanta, ko wadi gagirgol fofugo e waylitugo leppol. Aɗa haani yaarugo ɓingel man asibiti law ngam dokitirjo sukaaɓe laɓɓina rafi on bee njaayndi ɓernde (Echocardiogram) e X-ray hanta. Hakkunde wakkati, fofin ɓingel man kosam seeɗa-seeɗa e wakkati fere-fere, nden kadi mbiɗɗina mo ngam wallitugo mo fofugo boɗɗum. Hoto kuutiro safaraaji galle, kono jaɓu safaraaji ɗi dokitirjo hokkata ngam wallitugo ɓernde walla hanta ɓingel man golla boɗɗum.

question: Mini amodai we'e anɓɓa he jo jonamo o warti wuro o wulla, kominma ko fetiyam bosaru ha kosɗe mako me kala bo saru on toi ɗum ɗuroi koɗum bosaru kindiraɓe on wakkati nden meban ha balbe bo salun nga timmo ngam ɗum warake bo saru. mi yarama asibiti danyu dare kindira bate den tan mi yaha mi soda ha kemis mi sodi bata on ɗum tufuma ɗum kenya illa wakkati den mi yarima wuro amma lake man umti nokkure nanwoji jotta kam hakkila ammi hemi tammi bo sare ɗon hokki ɓingel nyamdu bo sare. mido nyama wodi lekki combiti larugo ko mo.
answer: Ngam a tufaama lekki haa kemis bo boosaaru ndun warteema, tooke boosaaru ndun waawaa nango ɓinngel maaɗa fahin. Ɓuuɗu nokkuure nden ɗon hollita lekki kemis kin ɗon huuwa ngam yamɗingo feyoore nden. Wujju ndiyam ngulɗam bee lamɗam haa kosngal gal feccaa, ɓaawo ɗon a hokka ɓinngel paracetamol ngam naawalla. Walaa haaje a hoota asibiti ngam heɓugo baccin (vaccine) mboɗu rawaandu fahin. Ɓinngel maaɗa ɗon e jam, ɓaawo balɗe seɗɗa naawalla man pastan o warta garau.

question: Debbo fere kam waddi bingel mako mo dimbi tati asibiti be laramo hande subaka ko be halibo eketo yimɓe olo wani binge on tatata kosam o larata goddo fere mo wolwal tamo heddi inde mako o sota mo damai ha noi masan hingare jungo nyami debbo on cokali on medi hiɓugo badde na mako. O meda himɓe baɗɗe minbedi men cokali heɓi jaɓugo kala batel mum ha tummude ko o fotti noɓugo bana no inna mako waddi redi nyaudugo ɗum min kotoltol laɓii mingew on jarbi bate mako pat feiti. Innde cukali on ingol wala paɗɗe o jaɓi bate pesode mako pat ko dami cu.
answer: Nyawu cukalel ngel, e baɗɗe ɗe ngel waɗata fof, alamaaji peewol naatungol ɓandu e puɗki nyiiƴe tan. Saawu ngel law nder bargooji tedduɗi ngam ngel waɗa wulweende haa nguleeki ɓandu man worta pat. Burɓutu kwayaaji magani 'Aspirin' mawɓe, jillindira bee kosam, nden doola ngel yara law ngam darnugo baɗɗe man. Lekki haakooji ɗi a hokki ngel nder tummude man boo ɗon wooɗi masin ngam wuppugo reedu maagel. Walaa haaje jooɗaago asibiti, kootu galle ngam ngel waalo ngel ɗaana.

question: debbo jomu redu reduma lebbi jewego minɗo wondi saare gotel fuɗɗi hirugo dow ɓernde maako ɗo fiya be lawlaw a viya mo timmini doggugo jottam wakkati fere bo oɗo soma ko o huway ko ɗume debbo jungo maako ɗo hawtidira seɗɗa satiji saali seɗɗa o lari dande maako ɗo uppa hedi yeso sai o hultiri oɗo numa ɗo kam ɗo nder nyawu damata jomu redu na ko bo ɗum nyawu fere on sai o taski nyawugo lara likita ngam o anda ɗume sanadu nyawɗo emol haɗo ɗume on waddini debbo redujo ɗo fiyal ɓerde be law law ɗo a viya mo timmini doggugo nden bo ɗume on sanadu uppugo dande ɗo nden bo irin nyawu ɗo kam wawan mema mawnugo ɓingel redu mako ɗo na ɗume on alamaji kalluɗum je ɓe wattinta gite hasare ba irin nyawu ko kuje yareyareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko ɓeddata nyawugo ha irin wakkati ɗo
answer: Nyawu ngu debbo on mariɗo ko Eklamsiya (nyawu ƴiiƴam ɓernde ɗam mawni), ɗum addani mo majjere e ƴellitgol juɗe e koyɗe (seizures), ɗum wonaa doggugol gañum. Fiylugol ɓernde maako be lawlaw ko bonngu no feewi, ina waawi yirbude reedu (uterine rupture), ko kadi ɗum waddaali mawnugo ɓingel ngel, ko ɗum tan addani ƴellitgol taska maako. Hay debbo reduɗo haa lebbi sappo ina waawi jibinde ɓingel mawnuɗo, kono Eklamsiya ko gaño e nguurndam yumma e ɓiɗɗo on so o safranaake jooni. Alamuje kalluɗe ɗe poti reeneede ɗe ko: ɓuuɓgol hoore tiiɗngol, jippagol gite (blurred vision), ɓuuɓgol yeeso, e ɓiɗɗo on ɗaɓɓaaki nder reedu. O foti ko yaawnude etaade haa safrirde mawnde ngam rokke leɗɗe haɗe ƴiiƴam (Magnesium sulfate) e yaltinde ɓiɗɗo on ngam hisnude nguurndam maɓɓe ɗimmam.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
answer: Gorkom do ko jijjiiji (hemorrhoids) kadi woni ko ɗiɗɗal naange e ndiyam e leydi, wano “ndiyam” nder naawol hore heɓotaako no feewi. Wekki e laana kala saanga nafaaka, kadi ko moƴƴi a huutoro kañum haa warta, kadi aɗa waawi huutora ndiyam e sabulu sa to a nafi. Pilol (iron) ena waawi wallude heɓtude “iron” so aɗa njamdi ko feewi, amma waawaa yaltude sariyaaji e gorkom, o ɗum ko fayde gollal gootal. Kuccu (pillow) waawaa “ɗoɓa” gorkom, amma ko nafata kañum ngam a tottirde e faamde sabuɗum. So laanaaji, yaynirde, ko fayi e faamde tawa kañum ena faamdi, walla so woni alaa “control” kala, aɗa foti yahude to labotorii ngam njiylawu e gollal naawol hore.

question: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon nde o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musongo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko sedda bo o nan o vi ɓingel man. dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en di bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawata waɗugo hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man.
answer: Fewngo ɓandu e lo’ugo ɓingel man ko kuugal tagdi ɓikkoi keccon ngam reedu mako ɗon woowa e neema duniyaaru. Salgo musinngo on waddi fewngo man, ngam maajum walaa nyawu kulniingu haa ɓandu mako. Toh o sali kosam endi, hokku mo ndiyam gulɗam bee sugaari ko kosam nagge ngam ɓandu mako wula law. Dole on jaɓa riga kafin (pito) hande, ngam lekki man on hokkata ɓingel man sembe o ummo o fuɗɗa dimbugo. Bawo pito man, saawu ɓingel man nder wudere njaha wuro on foofta, jaango jam o wartan kalaw walaa damuwa.

answer: Alamuuji ɗi suka on holli, bana jooɗaago feere maako, salagol nyaamdu, e ɓernde mettuɗum, ɗon holla nawngu miilooji e dilaawol tiiɗngol (grief/depression) ngam maayde inna maako. Nder asibiti, min ndaaran njamu ɓalndu maako ngam o heɓa semmbe, nden min tura on haa likitaajo hakkillo (counselor) ngam o walla mo e waawugo dilaawol ngol. Ha wuro, jippin ɓernde maako bee hollugo mo yidde sanne, yewta bee maako dow inna maako bee hoyɗum, nden a ɓaɗtina mo e sukaaɓe ɓe o mari faamu e muɓɓen ngam ɓe pija. Taa waɗu mo doole dow nyaamdu, ammaa waddu nyaamduuji ɗi o ɓuri yiɗugo heso-heso, nden a jooɗa a nyaamda e maako ngam o heɓa sha'awa nyaamugo. Munyana mo sanne ngam sellugo ɓernde ɗon ƴetta wakkati, ammaa bee ballal likita en e yidde mon nder wuro, o warat njamu maako o fuɗɗa fijugo.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
answer: Rufugo ƴiiƴam (lochia) ɓawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa ko huunde haanunde, amma sembe Dada maayugo hollata o heɓii ƴiiƴam famarugo (anemia), nden o haani nyamdu moƴƴuru be tableti ƴiiƴam (iron). Ɓingel mako mai dubi nai ngel rufata iyam masin be yarta iyam, ɗum hollata ngel woodi rafi suukara (Type 1 Diabetes), nden ngel haani ƴeewndaago ƴiiƴam law ngam heɓugo safara. Ɓingal kesel ngel wullata be ta yara nono haani ƴeewndaago ngam anndugo ko wadi ngel, bana rafi be kuma wallitugo ngel yarugo nono. Shawara am ko Dada yaha asibiti law be ɓiɓɓe mako ɗon ngam ƴeewndaago maɓɓe tun, hokkugo ɓe safara haaniɗo, be kuma dandugo ɓe dille rafiiji ɗin ɓe njahda.

answer:
Bismillah. Ndaɗa jaabu am e ɗum:

**Ko waɗata alaamaaji ɗii:** Sabaabu ɓurɗo yaawugo waɗugo alaamaaji ɗii (dojjugo, ronkugo foofugo to yaaɓi, yaawugo tampugo, hino somoo) ko **nyawu ɓernde (heart failure/cardiac disease)**, walla nyawu foofɗe kaɗ na COPD walla asthma, walla anemia (heɓaay ƴiiƴam wonande). Kono kañum ɓernde ɓuri yaawugo, sabu foofɗe ɗon jarna ndiyam.

**No damuwa waɗirta ɓernde:** Eyyo, damuwa (stress) e sunaare hino wawi lorlude ɓernde. Ko wiyetee "stress cardiomyopathy" walla "broken heart syndrome" hino woodi, kadi cinkaari ɓernde e tampere ɓernde hino ɓeydoo bee sunaare e miijo keewɗo.

**Ko poti waɗeede:** Naɓ mo asibiti law-law ngam ɓe ndaara ɓernde makko (ECG, echocardiogram), ɓe ƴeewa ƴiiƴam (blood pressure, blood count), e ndiyam wonande foofɗe. Rokku mo fooftere, hoto o gollu golle tiiɗɗe, kadi ittu mo e ko sunniɓe/tikkiniɓe mo.

Ɗum ko **nyawu tiiɗɗo no wa’i e meningitis** (ɓekkitanol/moƴƴugol ɗiɗi ɗiɗi heɓa huunde ndee: naawol hoore, daande tiiɗɗude, fowru/jontino, ɓandu nawa, ɗoon e pelle/peteeji e ɓandu).
Meningitis ina waawi raɓɓude hakkunde yimɓe, ɗum waɗi ngam ko waɗata **ka sibiti ɗon ɗon**, doctor’en ngoodi waɗa: bincike ɗii (jini, malaria test, full blood count, blood culture) e **lumbar puncture** ngam ƴeewde ndiyam ɓernde/CSF so alamaaji ina yamiri.
So ko meningitis, lekki ɗum ko **antibiotic IV no ceftriaxone** (ko cefotaxime) ko ɗum fuɗɗata ko fewndo sabu waɗde jokkondiral; paracetamol, ndiyam drip, e reedu foofde/pressure maɓɓe.
Yimɓe ɓadiiɗɓe mako (ɓesngu/ɗiɗo ɗoɗɗi) ina foti heɓde **lekki kariya** (misal ciprofloxacin/rifampicin/ceftriaxone) so doctor tabbatar ko meningococcal meningitis.
Hoto ndaaron ka suudu: daande tiiɗɗude e naawol hoore ɗum ina waawi wonde haɗari, o yaaha sibiti tiiɗi/doctor jooni.

Hande sai o yi’i to odo musina bingel mai, odo torra , hebata hendu boddum , be kuma do hokkamo bone foofugo boddum. Ovi kanjum don saklimo sam gam ohanda ko feddata be kecchel mako.
Dumedon watata lebol mingel wada buluu banni? Dume don kuma waddata mingel torra bo heba damuwa foofugo to’ do musina? Lekki don be hokkatanaaa, ko be larai mingel mai na?
answer: Wannan hali yana nuna cewa ɓikkin da ke ji dukan fiffi da kuma ciwo a waje da biki yana iya kasancewa da cutar "Malaria" ko kuma "Urinary Tract Infection" (UTI). A wannan yanayi, yana da kyau a yi amfani da magungunan da za su rage zafin ciwon da kuma ƙarfafa jiki, kamar paracetamol ko kuma magungunan da likita ya rubuta. Yana da mahimmanci a tabbatar da cewa ɓikkin tana shan ruwa sosai domin wanke kwayoyin cuta da kuma hana jiki bushewa. Idan ciwon ya ƙara tsananta ko kuma ɓikkin ta fara zama da zafi, dole ne a kai ta asibiti domin ganin likita ya yi gwaji (test) domin tabbatar da cutar. Kuma yana da kyau a kiyaye tsaftar biki da kuma abincin da take ci don kare ta daga ƙarin cuta.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer: Satugo haa nder enndu debbo ɗon wara ngam salndu ƴiƴƴam ɗon tura ngam tampiri kugal e tiiɗugo ɓandu. To hunde man ɗon naawa, ɗum holli walaa nyaw kansa, ngam kansa enndu naawataa sam haa fari. Kuje je o waɗata kanko debbo man, o wujja nebbam o foonda enndu ndun e ndiyam wulɗam jemma fuu. Foondungo enndu e ndiyam wulɗam ɗon taaƴina hunde satunde man haa ɗum majja pat, gam non walaa haaje yaha asibiti lara likita. Taa o damu hoore mako, nyaw man wurtoto bana non bo seɗɗa-seɗɗa ɗum dilla kani'um to o tokki laawol ngol.

answer: Ndee ɗo woni ko haani yaawde no feewi, sabu toowgol sembe iyam (168/100) e ɓuutol yeeso e juuɗe ɗon holla wonde ɓokki (kidneys) walla ƴiiƴam hore ɗon e caɗeele mawɗe (hypertensive emergency). Sey ɓe nawta mo asibiti mawɗo ngam ɓe mbaɗa ƴeewgol hore (CT scan) e ƴeewgol ɓokki (renal tests) ngam anndugo to ɗum woni "stroke" walla caɗeele ɓokki. Lekki sembe iyam ki ɓe hokki mo kin ɗon moƴƴi, amma o haani heɓugo lekki ɗon yaawa ustugo sembe iyam (IV antihypertensives) nder ward. Wota o yaru safara guri (hunɗe jifere) kadi sam, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓeyda bone ɓokki maako e toowgol sembe iyam maako. Nder asibiti, sey ɓe ndaara no o ɗo yara, ɓe mbaɗa mo nyaamdu (diet) moƴƴuru, nden o hoota ɗo ƴeewte kullum ngam halkugo ɓuutol ngol.

Si o fuɗɗii hendu no yaawi, o ndimmii/blue, o tampii haa waawataa yara, nguleeki, walla o yawnataa—ɗum ko **gawatirde**.
Hoto on hokku lekki walla saroji ɗi dokita waɗaani, sabu lekki heddii e nyaw ɗin ndaarotaako ina waawi haɗde ɓingel.

answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji haɗayɗe: harniya/ɓurtol reedu nde waɗi koɓol, naange, maɓɓito walla reedu ɓanti—ɗum ina waawi waɗude “strangulated hernia” walla toŋŋere ɓernde reedu, ko haɗari.
Alaa jam faa njooɗon; yahaa e asibiti mawɗo jooni-joni, to doktor/likita jaraajo walla surgeon laara mo, sabu ina waawi waɗude opreshon yaawngon.

Ko ɓe waɗata ko opreshon ngam naatnude ɓeɗe reedu e feewtinde ɗo ɓurtol ɗon ummii, ngam haɗde reedu maayde walla ɓinngel waɗde caɗeele.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. answer: Rufugo iyam ɗuɗɗam ɓawo danyugo ɗum alama boɗɗum ngam ɓandu mako ɗon wurtina iyam nyadɗam je lebbi jenai ɗin. Ngam iyam mai dara law law, on hokka mo ndiyam zafi ngulɗam bee lamɗam ɗuɗɗam o yara heɓa tanni mako yoora. Haɗu mo yarugo ndiyam ɗuɗɗam koo nyamugo kusel ngam taa iyam mako laata ndiyam ndiyam, ɗum ɓesda rufugo iyam mai. question: mi hakkili miko amperti domo vowi fiji gobe so birabe mako canji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan judo taya sudu mako kullum o acce yauta gobo o wala fala ko vowi hidigo mi hakkili bo komi ninje woni sare o yidai nyamugo be amin odon andi mo woni dar billa ko chomri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata mettol berde on na ko torruko hakkilo on damata mun hertoi min wawata vallugo mun gam seyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko shawara na ko likita mon den yahu jeberde
answer: Alamaji ɗi a limti ɗon—bana woɗɗitaago yimɓe, jooɗande feere kanko tan, ɓilli ɓernde, e lortaago nyaamdu—ɗon hollita o ɗon haɓa e dammuwa hakkilo maunɗo bi'eteeɗo "mettol ɓernde" (depression). Ɗum ɗon wara saabe caatugo yonki, torra hakkilo, ko kaddungal hakkilo ngal o waawaa hoosugo kanko tan. Gam on walla mo, ku njaɓo mo, ku heɗito mo be ɓernde laaɓnde, kadi ku sembiɗina mo o wolwa be likita. To on nji'ii o ɗon wolwa haala halkugo yonki maako, ko o acci yarugo magunguna ko taarugo hoore maako, ku kuuto joni-joni. Mi ɗon shawara on njaara mo asibiti ɓadiiɗo on gam likitaajo lara mo bo o hokko mo walliteego handi.

Gargaaji: rotavirus vaccine, Vitamin A, deworming e goongaaji feere ɓe mbaawi wallude, kadi a yiɗi kaani antibiotics so doktoor o hollata ɗum.

answer: Bingelman, a common skin condition in Nigeria, is caused by a bacterial infection. It is characterized by red, itchy, and scaly patches on the skin. answer: Rufugo iyam sossai haa redu ko maande iyam ciki ya farfashe kafin lokaci (PPROM), kuma ciwo les redu na nuna alamar haihuwa ko matsalar bawon ciki (placental abruption). answer: Foofugo ɓural teemedere wona ko saba kadi ko maande nyau mawnde (ko wayi no nyau juulde walla sepsis), ɗum addanata ɓuuɓnude, ɓeydagol leppi (abdominal distension), e ɓaleeje (jaundice) ɗe njiɗaa ƴeewndo safrirde yaawngo. answer: Ko wadata ɓingel ɗo ɗodda sosai, kuma ɓingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo, wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata, goji dume be dume be wawata, be wanna bingal to borade, toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai, nden no wadata mbeewa mbaalu (malaria) wala mbeewa mbaalu e jam (typhoid) wala mbeewa mbaalu e jangol (brucellosis) wala jangol bingel (meningitis). question: duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi neɓai mi danyi balɗe jeɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on mi danyi mi hirriti dow to miɗon musuni keccel am ɗo yarnama bone musugo to o musuni seɗɗa ni se o itta hunduko mako tomi habdi musugo mo fahin se o musuni seɗɗa o itta hunduko se mi numi ko haɗi mo musugo boɗɗum se mi herriti oɗo mari damba wala fofa boɗɗum bana ɓingel ɗo hara bannin mi nanata ɓofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am ovi tema de miɗon danya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo mi numi to ndiyam nasti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min koɓuri pusugo am ɓerde ma kanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am walai o wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai tomi waɗi sembe tomi yiɗi o musina sai tomi findinimo o musina seɗɗa to fottinimo mi yiɗi mi ema dow sababu pewol man je o wala foofa be boɗɗum ɗo bo de o foofi fu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum
answer:
Mi faami sunaare maa e caɗeele ɓinngel maa keccel. Ndaa ko mi yiɗi anndinaa maa:

**Sabu maa hakke:** Ɓinngel keccel danyaaɗel accan musugo boɗɗum, foofaango mum ka nanda bana hino sukki e kine, kadi ka jaɓataa musineede - ɗum fof ina hollira caɗeele mawɗe ɗe ɓe mbaawaa ɗaɓɓude ballal to safirdu.

**Ko mi wallitirta maa:**
1. **Yaadu safirdu law-law** - oo bonannde ina foti ndaaraa e likita en boɗɓe (ɓe ɓinngel keccel), sabu foofaango caɗaango e musugo caɗum ina waawi wonde alaamaji satti (bana jibru, caɗeele ɓerde, walla bonannde e ndiyam hore).
2. Wota a acce ɓinngel he suudu tan; oo caɗeele ina naamnii ballal nokku mo mari kaɓirɗe.

**Ko mi yenanaa:** Mi waawaa fewndude safaara ɓaleeɗo dow ɓataake tan - so a yaadii to safirdu, likita en ndaarayɓe ɓinngel maa ngstartira feccude ndaɓɓen sabu goonga, ɓe ngaɗana ka safaara laaɓɗo. Yaadu law-law, sabu law law ɓuri moƴƴude wonande ɓinngel keccel.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer:
Alaa, “ƴiiƴam/dada nde boni” walla ƴeewtere nde ɓe loota dada e ndiyam ɗum hinaa daliilu ngol; dada yumma lawol ngal ɓurɗum moƴƴude ɓingel.
Ɓingel lewru 3 mo woni e rufugo ɓawo muynude, ɓandu wuli, juɗe/koyɗe laɓi walla fuuɓi, e ɗoynude no feewi—ɗum ko **alamaji haɗari**, waawi wonde malaria/sepsis, ɗamol ƴiiƴam, dehydration, walla caɗeele ɓernde/reni.
Ɗum waɗi no haanirta o heddii e asibiti haa ɓe ƴeewa: zazzau/malaria test, PCV/Hb, sugar, ƴiiƴam/urine, ɗum e ndaw saare; ɓe njogora IV fluids no haani, antibiotics/antimalaria walla blood transfusion so woodi.
Woto ɓe ndokku lekki galle walla “lekki darnata dada” tawa likita asibiti yamiraani, sabu ina waawi bonnude ɓingel.
Yumma yo ɓesdu muynude dada ɗooɗɗum ko seeɗa-seeɗa so ɓingel waawi; amma so o rufi kala huunde walla o ɗoynii, ɗum ko gilaade asibiti jooni.

question: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
answer:
Ko woni haala Dada oo, alamaaji e maande mum holli ko o heɓi redu nder dowrowol (ectopic pregnancy) nde furi, ɓernde nder ɓanndu feccii, ɗum waddi nawore les redu, somude, e ƴiiƴam e nder rufaango sabu ŋakkere ƴiiƴam mawnde.

Alamaaji hattara ɗi doktoor larta dow reedu makko e dow ndonu makko ngoni: nawore les reedu tiiɗnde, gasa (nawore isaare), ɓanndu ɓeydi daneejum, pulse jaawɗo semɓɗaani, fittaandu les, e somude kalluɗum.

Ngam darnugo iyam oo, operasyon law (laparotomy) woni lekki tan, ɗo ɓe karnata dowrowol ngol ɓe itta kosam redu ɗam ɗo ɓe mbaɗa ligatir ngam haɗugo iyam foɗɗude, tawi kadi ɓe nasta ndiyam-ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) ngam artirde ko makko he en majji.

Ɓingel hin ko walaa nder reedu so wonaa nder dowrowol, waawaa daande, amma operasyon ina hisna ngeedam neesɗo oo e rimɗinde mum garowam so salpingectomy waɗaaka tan.

Caggal operasyon, o haani yarlitagol e lekki njamndi (iron) ngam teskagol makko timma.

question: debbo jomu redu reduma lebbi jewego minɗo wondi saare gotel fuɗɗi hirugo dow ɓernde maako ɗo fiya be lawlaw a viya mo timmini doggugo jottam wakkati fere bo oɗo soma ko o huway ko ɗume debbo jungo maako ɗo hawtidira seɗɗa satiji saali seɗɗa o lari dande maako ɗo uppa hedi yeso sai o hultiri oɗo numa ɗo kam ɗo nder nyawu damata jomu redu na ko bo ɗum nyawu fere on sai o taski nyawugo lara likita ngam o anda ɗume sanadu nyawɗo emol haɗo ɗume on waddini debbo redujo ɗo fiyal ɓerde be law law ɗo a viya mo timmini doggugo nden bo ɗume on sanadu uppugo dande ɗo nden bo irin nyawu ɗo kam wawan mema mawnugo ɓingel redu mako ɗo na ɗume on alamaji kalluɗum je ɓe wattinta gite hasare ba irin nyawu ko kuje yareyareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko ɓeddata nyawugo ha irin wakkati ɗo
answer:
**Alaamaaji e sabaabuuji nyawu ngu:**

Debbo ɗo o wondi e nyawu **preeclampsia** maa **eclampsia**, ndu ɗum nyawu kaɗɗudu haa faddaade tawa woodi ɓesngu, ɗo alamaji mum:

1. **Ɓernde fiyugo be lawlaw** (heartbeat/palpitations) e **ronkugo timmingo doggugo** (shortness of breath) ko alamaji ɓalndu na hebi caɗeele mawɗe.

2. **Uppugo dande** (goiter maa thyroid swelling) e **hulɓinaare** (anxiety/restlessness) mbaɗta hawtude e nyawu ɓernde maa hyperthyroid ka reeduujo.

3. **Ndiyam ɓe ɓeydotoo e ɓalndu** e ceekol yeeso (edema) ɗum alama preeclampsia, ndu wawi jaalaade haa **eclampsia** (fiɗtinaango/convulsions).

**Caɗeele fewndo mum:** Ɓesngu on wawi mawnude, ɓe ndaɗtude tawa, maa ronkude heɓde ɗeɓ e njamu, ɗum wawi warde ɓesngu on maa yumma on.

**Feere:** Yaa likita law-law ngam ɓe eɓɓa deefol (blood pressure), ɓe ndaara ɗereewol ɓalndu (blood tests) e thyroid, ɓe ndaara ɓesngu (ultrasound), tawa ɗum feere maɓɓi ngam faddaade caɗeele mawɗe.

question: min lilibin ge am suda bafe wedu kenya kiki be ana min taji sappa hejoyi hosamin o warti wuro o wulla komin ki'a min mo kofeti e wolwali ni am bosarun ngati hoste mako mi ki'a min ma dume kala bosaro on toi dunduroyi kodin bosaru kindira benon wakati den mi wudani mo nebban ha balba bosaro ngati mo gan bun wara to hokke bosaro dun be hokki am shawara mi yara mo asibitin daniul derekindira den be windani bate tentanos mi yaha mi soda ha kemist mi sodi bate on tufi modun kenya mi yari mo wuro amma laki nya futere man dunti no kure non wojji jotta kam hakkilo am ummi e mi tammi bosaru dun hokki binge am nyandu bosaru nyandu bosaru mi do 'yama wodi likki ko mi sodin tsana mon ko mi yara mosi a sibiti beron bedala rokkomo
answer:
Ɗum ko haɗari; **tetanus tok ko yaaɗaani** ngam bite/ɓaawo rawandu walla ɓosaru ko ina foti hokke **rigakafin rabies** e dabbunde asibiti.
A waɗu: lawol ɗoon **naatnu mo asibiti jooni**, musamman sabu ɗum no futi/wojji walla no nawa—ɗum ina mbaawi wonde infection.
Hade nde yehi, lootu ɓosaru ndu e **ndiyam e sabulu minti 15**, woto a waɗu nebban/magani gargajiya nder ɓosaru.
Dokta ina waɗa dubaade ɓosaru, hokke antibiotics/ciwon-ɗaɗi so haani, tetanus dose ɗi peewi, e **rabies vaccine** (so bite rawandu/ɓaleeji).
So o woni e hoore nguru, fiva, pus, futere no ɓurta, walla o waawataa yahde—ɗum ko **gaggawa**, yahi asibiti heti.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
answer: Alamaaji ɗi gorko man holli, bana naawol hoore mangol, occugol daande, bee puɗal perpeɗal ɗon ɓanndu, ɗon holla alamaaji nyawu gataare nguu meningitis (siiro). Nyawu ngun ɗon wara bee mangu (bacteria) naawata hoore bee kucel ɓawo, ngun waawan warugo neɗɗo to a leeli. Puɗal ɓanndu ngal o mari ɗon holla nyawu man yaari haa nder ƴiiƴam maako, ɗum wondi kuye kungaaye masin nde haandi a waɗa lawlaw. Debbo man sey yaara gorko maako asibiti lawlaw walaa faasaare ngam likit'en mbaɗana mo bincike bee hokkugo mo lekki pamharo (antibiotics) ngam daɗndugo yonki maako.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer: Nafa ɗum o tampata sahaa ɓiɗɗo on nana ko nafa potɗo (afterpains) sabu ɓamtaare oxytocin nde wadata ko mawninde reedu haa nde woppata ɓural ngal. Kono yaltugol ko ƴiye wano kosam ɗam, ina haani o waɗa 'ultrasound scan' reedu ngam ƴeewtude so tawii ko heddiiɓe reedu (retained placenta) walla ko ɓoggol ƴiiƴam potngam. Nafa ɗum o woppata les ɗerewol makko ko no njahrata e reedu nde woppata ko ɗum kadi ko nafa potɗo. O foti jokkude yarbude leɗɗe ɗe doktoor on dotti ɗam, so wonaa tawa ina woodi ƴiiƴam ɓurngo tatiika, ɓuuɓri mawndi walla ko huɗo bonɗo ummotoo. Ɗaɓɓitaneeɗo on waɗa yo o yillo doktoor ngam ƴeewndeede e waɗde scan ngol ngam hoolkisaade cellal makko timmungal.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer: Fofugo ɓingel mai dow e les be wulugo ɓandu ɗon holla endam dada mai ɗon teddi kadi ɗon wuli masin ha reedu ɓingel mai. Ngam ɓingel mai woya, hani dada aca hokkugo mo endam balɗe ɗiɗi heɓa reedu mako fowta sedɗa. Baawo hokkugo endam, o hokkamo ndiyam ngulɗam ɗon hauti be sukari ngam ɓingel mai heɓa sembe wala ha o somi e musungo. Dada mai wuja nebbam robb ha hore be gaba ɓingel mai ngam ɓandu mako feewa kadi fofugo mako usta. Wala haaje doggugo asibiti lawlaw, ɓingel mai wartiran fofugo boddum to endam tedduɗam mai saali ha ɓandu mako.

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer:
Ngam ngatiri ɓosaaru ɗon hulyini, lawlaw fu, lootee nokkuure ɗon ngataama ɓingel man bee ndiyam ɗon ila e saabunde ko ɓuri minti sappo e jowi (15) ngam riiwtugo guurɗum nyau man.

Yahdu asibiti ɓadiiɗo jooni jooni ngam ɓingel man heɓa lekki haɗugo nyau saru (*rabies vaccine*) e riga-baddo *tetanus*.

Ta faɓɓitir bee maggal gure ngam nyau saru (*rabies*) walaa lekki ndiyamtoowo to ɗum fuɗɗake nder ɓanndu, nden boo ɗum ɗon wara yonki.

Ta nyootu buuluure/nokkuure ngatiri man seɗɗa fu ngam ɗon ɓeyda nastinki nyau man nder ɓanndu, sey to likita'en mari daliila waɗugo non.

To ɓosaaru ndu'u anndaama, yoobee ndu haa balɗe sappo ngam yi'ugo to ndu maayi ko ndu ɗon njaura, ammaa ta faɓɓitir hokkugo ɓingel man lekki asibiti jooni jooni.

question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
answer:
Rufugo iyam ɗuɗɗum ɓaawo danygol (secondary PPH) ɗon waddoo ngam saabi heddiije riga danygol luttuɗe nder daada, walla guurte (infection), e riga danygol ngol ustaaki no haandiri.

Ngam nyawndugo ɗum, haandi ɓe hokka mo lekkiije mballooje riga danygol ustagol (uterotonics) bana Oxytocin walla Misoprostol, ɓe njuwa mo iyam bee ndiyam fitiila (IV fluids), e lekkiije kunooje nyawu (antibiotics).

O yiɗi kadi lekkiiji ɓallinooji iyam (iron supplements) bee nyaamduuji mardɗi sembe bana teewu, ɓiraadam, bee liɗɗi ngam o heɓta sembe maako law.

Mi ɗon saawaaro dada man o daddina ɓiɗɗo man enndu tan (exclusive breastfeeding) ngam ɗum ɗon walla riga danygol ustagol, den bo o fowta sosai o acca dunyaaru ko say o selliti.

To on ngi'i alamaji ba jonte, luuɓol iyam man, walla ɓeydagol ɗonki sembe, ngaddon mo sibiti lawlaw ngam hisngo yonki maako bee ɓiɗɗo mako.

question: rawandu gati bingel banɗan dubi mako jeɗiɗi de rawandu mai gati mo e yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta'i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum a foro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuɗɗi wurtugo namputure bo ɓuti e yecci ɓe yara mo asibiti useni iri kalariroye toy e wannata ɓingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo wutandu gam rawandu may koda rawandu may ɗo dama bo iri sabandi toy hani e wanna ɓingel petel ɗo mandoro wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako
answer:
Nyaawre rawandu ko heɓeede haasidi: ɓe njaha asibiti jooni, ɓe lootira fernde ndiyam e saabulu, ɓe ittira lekki gargajiya ɗii, ɓe waɗa dressing.
Bingel maa hokkire **allurar rabies** jooni (post‐exposure vaccine); so ɓaawo/ɓandu fernde ko mawnde walla rawandu mayii, o haani heɓude **rabies immunoglobulin** e fernde nde.
O haani kadi heɓude **allurar tetanus** so ɗum waɗaako ɗoo, e **antibiotic** ngam hana namputure/pus.
Rabies so fuɗɗii alamaaji, ko ɗum waɗata maayde; sabu ɗum, waasde waɗde gargajiya tan—asibiti ko ɗo hani.
So rawandu on mayii, ɓe mbaɗa ɗum ha biro lafiya/animal health ngam ndaarndu, amma ɗum waasata haɗde fuɗɗaade allurar rabies.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
answer:
Salaam. Ko a wiyani koo hollirii ko hono **depression** (nyaw berde/hakkilo), tawde bibbe maa oo:

1. **Alaamaji ndaartaten:** O acci fijirde e sobiraaɓe maako, o jodoto tan e suudu, o salii yewtude, o yiɗaa nyaamde, o wondi e sunaare wakkati kala – ɗum fuu ko alaamaji depression.

2. **Ko waɗi:** Nyaw ngaa waawi wardude e caɗeele nguurndam, walla ganndal e balɗe garooje, ɓoo ndikka o suɗtaake nde wooru sabu o waawi wonde e miijooji halkugo hoore-makko.

3. **Ko foti waɗeede:** Yaaru mo to **likita gannduɗo nyawuji berde/hakkilo (psychiatrist/counselor)**, ngam ɗum nyaw jaɓoowo safaara – waawi wonde e safaara (ɗawti-ɗawti) walla yeewtidal wallitiingal.

4. **Ballal maa:** Wonu takko makko, heɗo mo aldaa e ñikkitaare, hokku mo yerduyee, taa woɗɗina mo – ɗum fuu ina wallita.

5. **Reendo no feewi:** Si a yi'ii o wowlii halkude hoore-makko walla o wondi e miijo maayde, ɗum ko caɗeele mawɗe, yaaru to safrooɓe yaawi.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer: Iyam wurtotooko bee ɓaale (clots) e naawawol les reedu ɓaawo debbo dacci danyugo (menopause), wawan warugo ngam canji tagu (hormones), ɓuuɓri nder sappaandu, koo bo nyawu kansa sappaandu. Naawawol les reedu woni alaama moolanaandi holloore wondi caɗeele ɗon nder sappaandu maako, ngam maajum taa o jooɗa e wuro. Daada ma haandi waata hakkilo masin to iyam ɗon ɓeyda ɗuuɗugo, to o ɗon fusa ndiyam luuɓɗam, koo bo to ɓanndu maako ɗon usta. Mataki je o tokkata wakkatiire nde'e woni o yaha asibiti mangu lawlaw ngam likita'en pija mo (ultrasound scan) e ƴeewndaago sappaandu maako laaɓɗum. Taa o sakka ɓernde maako ngam kulol, amma yi'ugo likita lawlaw wallan anndugo ko dammi mo ngam o heɓa safaara boɗɗum.

question: ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hanɗe fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha mako sosai fa kuma ɗo sakli mo ɗa seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o wi meɗi feɗugo ɗe ɗiɗi ko sali ɗe fe'ata o ɗo nana nauɗum den bo iyam mai rufata a rufata be emi ko reɗu ɗon rufata o wi o anda ko oɗon mari reɗu ko oɗo be reɗu be emi dai o lari al'ada mako o wi neɓai ko o lari o wi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo em ɗo fuɗɗi dai hande fajira useni ɗume on watata debbo rufugo em sosai ɗo banni mataki geggewal toi hosata yahu ndigi toi hokkata debbo ɗo hisnu yonki mako be darnata emmai lekkiji toi be bateji toi be hokkatamo je darnata emmai
answer: Debbo oo ina wondi e rufgo iyam reedu saɗɗam, ko maande miscarriage mo haani hisnineeki yonki. Arande fuu, mbaɗanen mo laawol ɓeydugol ndiyam e nder ƴiye (drip Ringer’s Lactate walla Normal Saline) ngam darnugo tiitoonde ƴiiƴam. Ndeen ndokken mo lekki darnugo reedu, hono oxytocin (10 IU e cowu) walla misoprostol (800 mcg e nder koyngal) ngam haɗugo iyam jaawnga. So iyam jokki walla reedu wooɗii, haani ittugol ko heddii e reedu (evacuation) e juuɗe annduɗo. To o ɓuuɗii ƴiiƴam masin, mbaɗanen mo ƴiiƴam (transfusion) ngam hisnude mo. So kuuje ɗee ngalaa to opitaal men, en neldan mo jaawnga to opitaal mawɗo ɗo o heɓa ballal timmungal.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
answer: Aɗa haani yaha asibitirde kisan kisan sabo ɓinngel maa ɗo mari nyaw mawngam (neonatal sepsis) bee nyaw kwakwalwa (meningitis), ɗum wonaa "ndiyam nati hore" bana no yaaye gorko mako wi'i. Maandeeji bana fufa ɓurɗum, suunago, hore mintugo, bee kine sukkugo ɗo holla wonde ɓanndu mako ɗo haɓa bee nyaw mawngam haa ƴiiƴam bee kwakwalwa. Ɓelna ngel kisan haa likita'en ɓe ndaara ƴiiƴam mako ɓe kokka mo safara (antibiotics) haa nder ƴiiƴam (IV) ngam wallitugo ngel wuura. Wata a jokka e haala yimɓe wuro, ngam to a ɗonci, nyaw man ɗon maaya ɓinngel ngel kisan sabo ɓinngel keccel walaa doole haa kaɓa bee nyaw.

question: nonnon tan min laari debbo reduje je sibiti amin wari fajiri ɗo o wari be nauɗum sosai o ɗo hoka be sembe o ɗo jogi ɓawo mako be redu mako ngam nonɗum o nanata ɓawo minti jetati yahugo sappo haa nder sudu dayugo min waddi mo min laari mo min tawi ɓingel ɗo jippa pellel dayugo ɗi neeɓai sam o dayi ɓingel debbo to min waddi ni ko haandi fu en waɗata ɓawo redujo dayi neeɓai ni min hoosi dada be ɓingel maako min jari ɓe har suudu ɓe siwtata de neeɓi seɗɗa sai dada mai yoni amin o yoni amin o yecci amin o ɗo nana o wala sembe o nana o somi gite maako o yi'ata laɓɗum o wi'a amin o godi nyamugo ɓaawo o danyi amma daker o heɓi o nyami be yiri may wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta o ɗo dana o wala sembe be o fuɗɗi nanugo gilol ɗime on fe'i bannin ko yi'am vurti ha maako sosai o wala yi'am o handi ni ka ko o handi ni kaɓilungo yi'am ko ɗume wadanta mo min hokka mo yi'am naa ko min hokka mo nyiri
answer:
Ɗum ɗon holla wondugo dada on ɗon heɓa caɗeele mawɗe ko biyete *"Postpartum Hemorrhage"* ngam yiri (placenta) maako jippaki e o ɗon sula yi'am masin.

Ta kokkee mo nyiri sam ngam o ɗon lora e o waaway faddago, amma o handi heɓugo yi'am (*blood transfusion*) e ndiyam *IV fluids* ɗon e ɗon ngam hisgugo yonki maako.

Nastinee mo ɓoggi ndiyam (*IV lines*) ɗiɗi mawɗi ngam hokkugo mo ndiyam saline hako yi'am heɓoto.

Handi likitaajo ƴetta yiri on be juuɗe mum (*manual removal of placenta*) haa nder suudu kuugal (*theatre*) boɗɗum.

Njaaree mo suudu nyawndirdu mawndu (*referral hospital*) jooni-jooni ngam o heɓa kandinol e hisgo yonki yaawngo.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer: Lardiije bana yaawre fofugo (malla fofugo caɗtungun), wulungo ɓanndu tiiɗngo, e ronkugo musingo, lardiije hasariiɗe ɗon mawnani bingel pētel. Ɗum ɗo holla wonde bingel man na mari nyawu gu tiiɗɗi bana pneumonia malla jonte ɓanndu (sepsis) je yiɗi yaahu asibiti joni-joni. Lardiije goɗɗe ɗe manguɗum ngona: siko-siko, ɓanndu feewungo sosai, nyawu oolo (jaundice), malla bingel ngel yirwataa sam. O yaara bingel man sudu lekki (asibiti) joni-joni ngam heɓugo laartungo be lekki likita yaawungo. Ta njeeɗon jooɗaki malla kuwtungo lekkiji goɗɗi ha sare, sabo ɗum woni jooɗe hasari mawnunde ha bingel.

question:

dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.
Toh min wadi ni kohaadi fu enwadata bawo redugo dayi .
Napai ni min hosi daada be bingel mako, min yari be haa sudu be suitata.
De nebi sedda, sai daada mai yooni amin , o yechi amin odonana o wala sembe, osomi , gite mako oyiyata labdum.
Ovi amin fu ogodi yamugo bawo o Dayi, amma dakar o hebi o yammi, Be yiiri mai wala jibba boddum.
Har jotta odonana o walaa sembe be ofuddi nanugo giilol .
Dime on fedi bannin? Ko eyam vurti ha maako sosai, owala eyam. Ohadinika pillunko eyam. Ko dime bewadantamo?
Min hokkamo eyam na?
Ko min hokkamo yirri?
answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa yaron yana da matsalar "Anemia" (rashin jini) wanda ke kawo saurin gajiya da raunaye. Saboda yaron yana da kiba da kuma rashin cin abinci mai gina jini, ya kamata a fara sa shi cin abinci mai dauke da sinadarin ƙarfe (iron), kamar kabeji, kuka, da kuma sinadaran jini. Idan yanayin ya ci gaba, ya kamata a je asibiti don a yi masa gwajin jini (HB test) domin a san adadin jinin da ke jikinsa. Haka kuma, ya kamata a tabbatar yana samun kwanciya da kuma shan ruwa sosai don ƙarfafa jikinsa. Idan aka ga ya fara yin zazzabi ko jini ya tsage, a kai shi asibiti nan take domin samun maganin gaggawa.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
answer:
Nyawu keccel ma ɗon holla, wano tari mawnungu be jemma, fofugo be bone, be salugo musnugo, ɗon suddita wonki mako mari nyawu ɓernde mawnungu wano pneumonia (ɗonɗol) ko mboɗu kirndol (respiratory infection). Fofugo be lau be bone ɗon holla wonki keccel man ɗon habda gam heɓugo yaka-yaka (oxygen) ngam mboɗu ɗon hebbini mabuuji mako.

Ta huwtinu lekki maaje ko njaara keccel man kabaaji booɗɗum wala umroore likita, gam salugo musnugo ɗum holloore hasare mawnunde (danger sign) yiɗnde yaadu asibiti dow yeeso. To likita lari mo, o hokkan mo lekkiije caatunde (antibiotics) be pefndungol ngam fofugo mako jotta booɗɗum o heɓa o ɗana jemma. Ngam keccel man heɓa jam, reene mo diga cuurki defuɗum, loope, be mbulku gam ɗon ɓesda mboɗu kirndol be tari jemma.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
answer: Alamoji ɗi a limti bana nawol hoore tsariindi, daande tiiɗugo, hulugo annoora (hite), e peppetel ɓandu ɗon nufa nyawu nguleendi mboɗeeri je ɓi'eteeɗum 'Meningitis' (Sankara koo Pabbuwa), nguu laatoto nyawu masiibo raɓotoongu sosai. Ngam tabbitingo nyawu ngu taa on ngada tijjoore, laabi on waɗa gwodi teetugo ndiyam ɓawo (Lumbar Puncture) e asibiti heɓa ɓe laara nder kakkal (lab) ngam anndugo irin kuroori maajum. Ngam ɗum haala gaggabo ndi waawata warugo neɗɗo, nyawɗo o foti heɓugo leɗɗe injeeshin ɗe sembe bana 'Ceftriaxone' lawlaw, nden o foti haseego feere mako taa o raɓa woɓɓe. Dottijo garɗo bee mako e yimɓe fottuɓe bee nyawɗo man pat ɗon haaji heɓugo leɗɗe daaɗol (prophylaxis) ngam taa nyawu ngu'u raɓa ɓe.

question: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon nde o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musongo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko sedda bo o nan o vi ɓingel man. dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en di bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawata waɗugo hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man.
answer: Bana likitaajo mo woodi andal duuɓi ɗuɗɗi, mi ɗon tabbitina ma ɓingel ngel walaa nyawu koonduye; ɓandu maagel ɗon fewi ngam ngel ɗon woowa be weeyo yaasi. To ngel sali musinugo koo dimbugo, nduytee ndiyam suukara koo kosam na'i nder hunduko maagel doole ngam ngel heɓa sembe law-law. On poti waɗugo ngel riga man (immunization) hande-hande go, ngam naawalla bantal man finatinan ngel, ɓandu maagel bo fuɗɗan wulugo. Baawo on waɗi riga man, kuucee saare, assee ngel waalo haa weendu faya ngam ngel siwta walaa damuwa koo hulaago.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer: Gonga ma, nyawu malaria bee sompooje danygol on waɗi ɓandu mako ɗo wula, ɗo dimna sosai. Nde ɓandu mako ɗo wuli, ɓesde suddugo mo bee kare koo bargooji ɗuɗɗi ngam o wula nguleeki mai wurta. Haa o fasa hokkugo ɓingel endi tukun ngam o waawa fooftugo, nden o tokka yarugo sha'i wulɗum bee parasita mol tan. Walaa haaje yaharugo mo asibiti koo hokkugo mo maganiiji alluhaaji (antibiotics), ngam debbo danyi kesum ɓandu mako ɗo wula doole. answer:
Nyawu poofirde bana asma, feewu (pneumonia), malla dojjere lekki (whooping cough) on waddata dojjere cattiinde e satti pofde haa bingel, musamman nder jamma.

To bingel don dojja haa o waawaa fofugo boddum, joodin mo o tura yeeso sedda (sit upright) gam pofde maako yoota, amma taa fukkin mo.

Gam ustugo waddande dojjere nden, lalla bingel daga cuudi, kuraari, e peewol, nden bo tabbitin o don yara ndiyam guldam sedda-sedda gam taa godol maako yoora.

Yahru bingel asibiti gam likita'en timmina bincikaki, be hokka mo safaara asma malla magani kwayoyi (antibiotics) ngam o heba laafiya boddum.

answer: Alamaaji ɗii ina nanndi e nyawu rirawa (malaria), tifoyid (typhoid), walla ŋakkere ƴiiƴam (anemia), tee ŋakkere nguuru e nder ƴiiƴam (hypoglycemia) ko nde addana mo ŋakkere semmbe e tiɗde so o waawa ñaameede. No teeŋiri nii yo o yah to safrirde (hopitaal) ngam waɗde ƴeewndorɗe laboratuwaar ko wayi no ƴeewngo rirawa, ƴeewngo ƴiiƴam (FBC), e ƴeewngo diamɗe ƴiiƴam (BP/glucose), tawa ko ɗum tan hollirta saba asli nyawu nguu. E galle, yo o yaru ore (ndiyam) e ORES ngam haɗde deesima (dehydration), o ñaame horde belde-belde ngam rokkude semmbe e haɗde ustude nguuru ƴiiƴam. So tawii ko rirawa walla tifoyid, ɗum ko nyawuuji keewɗi e nder leydi men, doktoor on maa rokk mo safaaji potɗi caggal nde o yaltina njeñtudi ƴeewngo ngoo. Woppude rokke ɗe o keɓi ɗe ngalaa baawɗe, e ƴeewndaade doktoor goɗɗo ngam ɓeydude tafngo, ko ɗum tan woni laawol ngam heɓde safaa jaɓaaɗo e sahaa gooto.

Ɓingel lebbi joyi mo saare/ɗojugo balɗe 13–14, o waawaa yarugo walla o tampii no feewi, ko **tampere mawnde**—waɗee mo **sibiti jooni**, hinaa lekki suudu.
Ngam yahde sibiti, hokkitee mo **ORS** seeɗa-seeɗa kala ɗakiikaaji seeɗa e jokku **nono**, amma so o wuttii kala ɗam walla o waawaa yarugo, accitee hokkugo ley hunduko.
Ha sibiti min ndarata kuivde ndiyam, malaria, sepsis, e sukar; so kuivde ndiyam ɗuuɗi, min hokkata **Ringer lactate/normal saline IV**.
Hokkitee **zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala balɗe 10–14**; antibiotic hinaa ko hokkata kala saare, sey so jiiɗam woodi e saare, kisaare mawnde, cholera, walla sepsis.
Accitee **lekki damba/traditional** ngam ina waawi ɓeydude tampere e waɗde ɓingel o bonde.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer: Alaamaaji ɗi limtaɗaa ɗi—naawal hoore mangal, daande tiiɗnde, nguleendi, e gite kulayɗe laaɓal—ɗon holla nyawu *Meningitis* (nyawu mboɓɓodi malla ngaandi). Eey, nyawu nguun ɗon raaba masin, ngu raaboto lorto e henndu to neɗɗo ɗojji malla isli, nden ngu wondi e laajal mangal. Hatojinaama yawtu e mbo e asibiti ɓadiiɗo lawlaw ngam likita'en kuuwa gwaji nden ɓe ndokka mo leɗɗe (antibiotics) wakkati oon. Taa ndaaru safaara wuro koo jooɗaago wakkati juutɗo, ngam leeltugo fawata nyawɗo e caɗeele mawɗe ɗe ngaandi malla maayde. Heɓa o woɗɗitaake jama'aare, nden yimɓe ɓe o waɗi kawtal bee maɓɓe fuu laara asibiti ngam heɓugo leɗɗe daaɗol ngam reentugo njamu maɓɓe.

answer: Ɓingel ngel ina waawi heɓde cokali ɗum sabu ɓuuɓri tiiɗndi ko wayi no sitta walla ɗemngal wuli, ɗum noon addani mo salaka nyaamdu e ɓuuɓnude omilo. Eɗa poti waɗde ƴeewndo ƴakkere ngam anndude sitta, o hokka leɗɗe ƴiiɓre e ɗe ustata ɓuuɓri ko yaawi. Ngam muñɗe ɗemngal makko, hokka mo leɗɗe pamarel ñemmbitorɗe ngam ustude mette ɗee, ɗum wallita mo yaawde ñaamde. Ndokku mo ndiyam ƴettuɗam e ORS ngam haɗa ɗum yoorde, kadi ndarto jogaade mo e asbiti ngam reende caɗeele ɗe mbaawi aroyde e nder hoore makko. Eɗa poti jogaade deeƴre, tawa ko e toppitagol moƴƴol o waawi yaawde moƴƴineede, o hoota e fiyde e sakiraɓe makko.

question:
Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
answer: Debbo ɗo en yimɓe fere sibiti hande fajira, rufa ha maako sosai, sakli, kuma lari bana lewru gotel, wadi wulita jowlaare gawri ɗin hiiraanɗo (preeclampsia) to wulita jowlaare gawri ɗin hiiraanɗo mawɗo (eclampsia) saboda lari. O no wadi yeeso hospital ton luumo fof koyngal gawri, teewɗo protein uri, kuma teewɗo fuu kala (CBC, LFT, RFT) nden ko wulita jowlaare gawri. Kuuɗi o wulita jowlaare gawri, o wadi yeeso magnesium sulfate nden ko lari, labetalol wala nifedipine nden gawri, kuma dexamethasone nden hiiraanɗo Ɓeeru. Yimɓe fere sibiti hande fajira, wulita jowlaare gawri wadi keeyan hiiraanɗo Ɓeeru (37 hande) nden salminye debbo kuma Ɓeeru. Ko wulita jowlaare gawri mawɗo (eclampsia), magnesium sulfate wadi hayre ton luumo, kuma hiiraanɗo Ɓeeru wadi keeyan ton luumo.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
answer: Doggudu reedu e doggudu ɓernde ɗi a heɓata, ko nyawu kootu (bacteria) nasti reedu maaɗa addani ma ɗum, naa ngam gorko maaɗa ɗo warta. Ngam a darna doggudu reedu ndu, moƴƴi a hoosa lekki Tetracycline nyande fuu haa yontere ɗiɗi, ngam ɗum ɗon wooɗi sosai ngam reɗujo. Ƴahugo iyam (high BP) maaɗa ɗon wara ngam aɗa dogga wurtugo saare, ngam maajum a foti jooɗaago nder suudu maaɗa ngam iyam ma fowta. Ngam a heɓa sembe e hakkilo maaɗa lorta, a ringa yarugo kofi (coffee) cembiɗɗum fajiri e kikkide fuu. Taa doggu fahin to o ɗo warta; jooɗa e saare a naftira bee lekki ki'i, komoi fuu wartan jam.

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. Lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwini mo sei o vi o dilli tan o yahi a sibiti heɓa ɓe hefta ko fe’ata be petul damuwa ɗo wawan hoina ɓingal ɗo damuwa ɓerde na ko asma ɗon fe’ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toi ɗon handi ɓingel ɗo handi acca heɓa ko. damata mo wadinta mo o dodda ho’ina mo usta sosai.
answer: Nyau ɗojugo e tiiɗo fofugo ɗi ɓingel ma heɓi, ɗum peewol naati e ɓerde waɗi asma. Ngam a ho'ina ngel, a foti accugo hokkugo ngel endam wakkati fuf, ngam kosam ɗon ɓesda majol e ndiyam nder ɓerde maako. To jemma waɗi, maɓɓu jolɗe suudu fuf ngam peewol taa naata, kadi a saawa ɓingel man nder bargooji ɗuɗɗi heɓa ngel wula ngel wurtina nyau man. Ɓesda kadi, soodu lekki ɗojugo mawɓe a hokka ngel, heɓa ɗojugo man daro ngel ɗaana boɗɗum. To a waɗi kujeji ɗi, ɓingel ma yamɗitan sosai, asma e damuwa man fuf ɗon wurtoto.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer:
Sabu bingel ngel o danyi waɗi balɗe tati e nayi tan, jawnugo ɓandu (fever) 38.2°C e woygo sosai ko kabauru mawndu ngun holloore nyawu mashi (neonatal sepsis).

Ngam ɗon, ta hokka mo lekki paracetamol ko malaria ha saare; yaar mo asibiti mashi law-law ngam nyawu ngun ta mawnita.

Likitoci ɗon handi njaɓa mo, ɓe njuurnito mo booɗɗum, ɓe hokka mo lekki mashi bana "antibiotics" ngam hisgo yonki mako.

Gite looltoɗe (yellow eyes) bee ɓendu jawndu ɗon holla mawnuki nyawu ngun mbo handi likita laara ɗum law.

Inna man bo handi heɓa ballal ngam nyawndugo ɓendu mako ngun muusata, heɓa o musina bingel man booɗɗum.

question: jan bandu mi wari gam mini ko am mi lari ni gite jibe balli mako don wadi yalo yalo ne kuma banni mai ni har kusan balde tati bandu mabbe bo do wuli o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma be wawata nyamugo be wawata jogugo ko dume fu ha redu bo be do diwna be do somi wala sembe ngam hore mabbe do rigga do nawa be bandu mabbe do wuli min godi nafturgo hunde je min mari ha sare amma wala ko canji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli mabbe je canji kolo jalo har jotta dillai be do bedda beddugo tan kullum be wala der jam be yamdai be do yara bone kanjum wadi allah hadu be do nana bone sosai kanjum wadi min wari sibiti heba min handa ko min takata heba bandu mi ni ko am baldi begiteji je wadata jaloro haccen be hoinai
answer: Ɗum ko rafi emergency waawi wonde malaria bonɗo walla rafi hanki, ɗum waɗi aɗa haani naatnude ɓiɗɗo maa e asibiti jooni-jooni. Accu rokkude mo leɗɗe galleeji sabu ɗe ɓeydan rafi hanki e ɓanndu makko bone. Min mbaɗan ƴeewndo ƴiiƴam ngam anndude ko addi ɗum, min kadi ƴeewa suukara makko. Min puɗɗoto rokkude mo safaara e nder ƴiiƴam (IV), ndiyam, e wallude mo so tawii ƴiiƴam makko ustiima. Jawwu, nawnu ɓiɗɗo maa e ward emergency jooni ngam min puɗɗo safarde mo hade rafi o ɓeydaade.

question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. Emol hado ɗume on waddini debbo redul jodo fiyel berde be lau lau do a viya mo timmini dogugo dembo dume on sanadu uppugo dande do irin nyau do kam wawan mema maunugo bingel redu mako do na dume on alamaji kalludum je be watinta gite hasare ba irin nyamduji ko kuje yare yareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko beddata nyamugo ha irin wakkati do.
answer: Uppugo kosɗe e juuɗe debbo jom reedu leebbi jeegom waawan laatade huunde laaliiɗe ngam hebbingo ndiyam, ammaa kadi ɗum alaama nyau ɓeydaari ɓalto (preeclampsia). To ɗum woni nyau man, ɗum waawan samɗingo mawnugo ɓiɗɗo man walla danygol bako wakkati timma. Alaamaji masiibooji ɗi o taskoto kam woni hoore nawoore sanne, niɓɓugo gite, naawalla reedu dow, e uppugo yeeso. O ɗon mari haaje yahugo asibiti jooni ngam ɓeta ɓeydaari maako (blood pressure) e ndartol ndiyam cikilli ngam tabbintingo cellal maako.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer: To debbo danyi kesum, ɓandu wulngo e dimngol ɗon wara ngam tampiri danygol e nyawu malaria seɗɗa tan. Jokke suddigo mo be bargooji tedduɗi ngam o waɗa wulweende, nguleeki maajum fota wurtago daga ɓandu. Walaa haaje magunji feere ko bincike ƴiiƴam haa asibiti, tokke hokkugo mo paracetamol e sha'i wulɗo tan haa o daɗa. Gite maako daneeje ɗen holli o ɗon mari haaje hottollo tan, ɓandu maako safray hoore maajum to o joɗi jam. To o waɗii wulweende ɓandu maako feyyitan, nden o foti waddingo ɓingel ngel ngam musingo bana no haandi.

question: debbo do danyi ha sibiti mai dan labbi jego ko sali o wadi sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi bingel mardo labbi jego mai o wardi be mako jonta dada man wadi bayani du o heriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nayi ko sali o wi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda o wi dojjere man halli on daga ki'a balde tati ko fuddi amma har durti o wi de o musinimo fu odon hokkamo lekki diyam je nder gora je be sorata je do jogo do je o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara o wi daga keya do jogoman turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawan fofa be boddum gidami am sosai bana bofde man do ta'a on do yaha dow do je palace kala wakkati fu be hultiri hanjum wadi be waddi musibiti meden jotta emol am hado hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo be bingel do ha sare na larugo no pofde mako ta'ata be dojjere do min vindina be lekki dojjugo na ko'en wadda goje goje dow bingel man yiddeko min hokkamo lekki ko bate
answer:
Bingel do woodi nyaw pofɗe mawɗo (severe respiratory distress/pneumonia), nden o yonaay laartitirego haa saare sam ngam ɗum ɗon hula yonki maako.

Haani o naasta asibiti jotta ngam en hokka mo pofgal (oxygen) bee lekkiiji mbuuɗotooɗi (IV antibiotics) ngam hisgo mo.

Taa mbindanmo lekki dojjugo (cough syrup) koo hokka mo lekki dambe bee ndiyam gora, ngam ɗum ɗon mawnina nyaw bingel pamaro bana o'o.

Nden boo, dada man haani muynugo bingel man kalfungaɗum (exclusive breastfeeding) tan, wala hokka mo kowyeere feere haa o yotta lebbi jego ngam reenugo nyabbeeli.

Ngaddee bingel man jotta haa suudu gollirdu Emergency ngam en puɗɗa safareeji mawnunɗi ngam hisgo mo.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana.
