question:
Debbo reedujo mo dubi sappane tati e tati mo wodi reedu lebbi jeeɗiɗi keddu en makko ngaddimo Nyaurdorde amin. Ɓe wi'i reedu mako no nawɗum tenduɗum, ƴiiyan ko ɗuɗi wurti le yeso mako. Ii 'o diwna ,I'o woya ngam nawɗun dun ɓurimo semɓe. Saro en makko mbii be don kultori ta godɗun tawa Dada ko bingel ngel.

Ƴamnde arandere nde Nyautowo ƴami : dume on wadi reedu naawurta non ha ma ƴiiƴam wurto e sembe?
Ƴamnde ɗi dabre: Dume haani waɗugo ɓelau ha debbo reedujo on?
Ƴamre tataure: Dume haani raɓɓu tugo hefta nyau dum?
Ƴamre Nayabre: Irin lekki kiye haani nyaudiramo?
Ƴamre Joyabre: ira Nyamdu nduye o woɗoto, nden bo ira ngendam dayeejam haani o hutira?
answer: Wannan matsalar tana nuna alamomin fargaladin ɗan ƙaramin yaro (infant) da ke da matsalar numfashi ko kuma dacewar ƙirjin (respiratory distress). Alamomin da ka bayyana, kamar yin kōgi da kuma yanayin ɗan ƙaramin yaron da ba zai iya numfashi da kyau ba, suna nuna cewa akwai matsalar da ke shafar hanyar numfashinsa. A halin yanzu, yana da mahimmanci a kai shi zuwa asibiti cikin gaggawa domin a ba shi kyawawan magunguna da kuma taimakon numfashi (oxygen therapy). Dole ne a duba ko akwai yajinta a ƙirjinsa ko kuma cutar numfashi (pneumonia) wadda take yawan faruwa a yankinmu. Kar ka yi ƙoƙarin ba shi magani na gida ba, domin yanayin yana bukatar kulawa ta kwararru domin ceton rayuwarsa.

question: inde am mrs akinleye bawo lebbi didi ko sali do mi hirliti ni gorko am fofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam be odo isra akai akai banda ma odo babel sollaji ko habe sa'ata hunde wodo isra akai akai ni bo fofugo daidai o hukka mo bone fofugo mako do wada ta'a be odo isra to odo bebbel curde ko sollaji wodi koji min wadata heba hefta ko wadata dottugo do be isrugo ko jonde ha pellel mari sollaji dow don waddata dum ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe'a irin lekki toi don o naftirta fofugo mako hota dai dai be kuma o wawan o jo da belɗum ko ha uwonifu
answer:
Ndaa jaabawol am:

Ko a wallitorii jaraaɗe (medical advice), miɗo yiɗi salminde ma sabu naamnal maa. Kono, ngam yamre ndee hawri e ɓernde e fofugo (masalan foofaango/ɓernde belɗum), ɗum hisataake e ɗoo binndi tan.

**Ko foti waɗeede:** Yaha e safrirde walla ospitaali yeeso, sabu ɓe njiɗi ndaarude ɓalndu mako no timmiri (physical examination), ɓe eɓɓa test-test (masalan ECG ndeen ko ɓernde, ɗereewol ƴiiƴam, walla test-test ɗi njiɗaa). Ɗiin naamne kala—wa'ere ɓalndu, foofaango, walla belɗum e nde o hollirta ko—no foti ndaareede e safrirde ngam anndude sabaabu makko haqiiqa e safaara moƴƴo.

Mi tuubanii, mi waawaa okkude safaara timmuɗo hono ndaaringal ɓalndu; hakke ko naɓde mo ospitaali law.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
answer:
Ko ɓuri teeŋude, nyau ngu ɗaɓɓataɗa on wonaa ko nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta, ko ƴiiƴam seeɗa (infantile colic), caɗeele ñamndu (allergie) walla nyau njuura (UTI) addata ɓingel ngel muñude e fofude boɗɗum.

Alamaaji nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta ko ko wayi no koɗorɗe jeeeyeede (jaundice), ɓuuɓri kammu, e pickuge henndu; kadi, a woppa ɓamtude ɓingel ngel e doole, ɗum waawi bonnude nder ɓingel ngel.

Waɗ ɓingel ngel koose caggal ñamndu, ɓeydu yiytude no ɓingel ngel ñamirta kosam, nde tawnoe caɗeele ƴiiƴam (colic) ko heewi woppude ko e lebbi tati haa nayi.

Yah ɗa waddu ɓingel ngel asibiti ngam waɗde wiɗto njuura (urine test), sabu ko doktoor'en tan nganndi ko ɓuri haani hokkude nguure ɓurndu moƴƴude ngam safrude nyau ngu.

Sarwaaɓe aadaaji mbaawataa hokkude nguure ndee, ɗum ko doktoor'en tan poti lartina nyau ngu ngam laaɓtinde caɗeele ɗe ɓingel ngel mari ɗee.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer: Nyawu makko ina famɗi wonde *sickle cell anaemia* malla nyawu renal (koyɗe) bana *nephrotic syndrome* maa *acute glomerulonephritis*, sabo o hollitii ɓuutol e hoore ɗaamngo, anemiya seɗɗa (Hb ~5 g/dL) mo sembe mum walaa caggal lekki njamndi. Ko ɓuutol e hoore ɗon njaɓɓa hirange hypertension, nden anemiya ɗon e saɗaade waawde waɗugo nde e nyau koyɗe malla ɓeydal yidde nder sickle cell. En haani o wadda araayisewol ngam yi'ugo protein malla ƴiiƴam nder urine, ngam tabitinki ko nyau renal. So o tawi o malla renal, o sokli toppitagol ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) e lekkol hypertension, nden o waawi waɗugo ƴeewtagol sickle cell so ɗon mari. Waɗi debbo makko jima, alaa caɗeele; amma o haani toppitagol jaawngol ngam nyawu man walaa anndal.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer: Nyawu nguu je waɗi gite e ɓandu waɗi yalo bee zazzabi, alama ciwon typhoid mawɗum je nasti ƴiiƴam ne. Ngam hooyugo zazzabi e naawalla hoore man, on poti hokkugo mo magani Asfirin (Aspirin) kwaya nayi kala awa tati. On doola mo o nyaama nyaamdu nebbam e yarugo nyebbam boɗeejam ɗuɗɗum ngam reedu mako waawa jogugo nyaamdu. Taa on lumbu mo ndiyam haa ɓandu (drip) malla hokkugo mo ndiyam peewɗam, ngam ndiyam ɗon ɓesda yalo gite man wesa ɓandu fuf. To on mbaɗi nii, nyawɗo mon wurtan daga bone, o yamɗa fas nder balɗe ɗiɗi.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
answer:
Ndiyam puture e buttungo ngongo haa babal ngatande nden hollitii nawannde nden heɓii "infection" (kurkutu) sabo e nafitirgo lekki leɗɗe ki ɓe wati ton.

Eey, ɓingel ngel wawan heɓgo nyawndu rawandu ndu bone (rabies) koda rawandu ndun hollitaayi alamaaji fukaare, nden ɓo nyawndu ndun mbaroore cede.

Dole on yaara ɓingel ngel asibiti lawlaw ngam likitajo wowa looto nawannde nden, hokka ngel allapilawal "antibiotics" ngam wargo kurkutu, e allapilawal ndenka "tetanus".

Ko ɓuri muhimmanci ɗon, koo dole ɓingel ngel heɓa allapilawal ndenka nyawndu rawandu (Rabies vaccine) haa asibiti ngam hisnugo yonki maako.

Yeeso to rawandu ngatii neɗɗo, taa ta'e koo watta lekki leɗɗe; lootire babal ngal e ndiyam illoyham e saabulu ɓuri minti sappo e joyi nden on dogga asibiti.

question: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
answer:
Ɗum ko alama haɗari: so “iyam ɓinngel” rufii e farji ko sakataaji ɓooyaani, ena waawi waɗde infection, jibinannde ko ɓooyaani, walla ɓinngel tampugo.
Nden ɗebbo haani yahude sibiti law, tawa hoto naatnu junngo/lekki aadaaji e farji, hoto jima’i.
E sibiti ɓe ƴeewata BP, fippu, ɓernde ɓinngel, ultrasound, e jarrabooji ƴiiƴam/iyam; ɓe hokka antibiotics, ruwa IV, magani mettuɗum, e steroid so reedu belumaani.
So fever, iyam woni ɗaani/haɗi, ƴiiƴam rufi, mettuɗum ɓeydi, walla ɓinngel hontii dillaade, ɗum ko gila-gila ngam jibinde ɗum walla waɗde aiki gaggawa.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
answer:
Diga daddare man be iyam e dyam do isarta o, dun do nandal ko nawnata bo no woodi sago be yaha asibiti be yaawre. No waawa laatago danygol bako wakkati yotta, malla fukkugo reedu (miscarriage), malla caadeele bee asali (placenta) reedu ndun.

Likita’en no handi nyaha mo, be wadana mo 'ultrasound' (scanning) gam tabitinki bana no reedu ndun e bikkon ngoniri jotta. Ta munya ya go asibiti fey, gam hisinki yonki debbo man be baddo man fuu.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
answer: Ɗojuru be caɗeele pofɗe nder jemma ɗon njaaloroo saabe sufu (asthma), ɓillugo pofɗe saabe pewol, malla ɗojere waare (whooping cough). Jemma fu ɗojere ɗon ɓeydo saabe peewri kadi waalaago ɗon ɓilla laawol pofɗe ɓingel man. Ngam faddago ɗum, haandi ɓingel o heɓa alluhaaji bano *Pentavalent* (ngam ɗojere waare) e *PCV* (ngam sariya pofɗe) wakkati o mari duuɓi mboɗɗum. Lorta ɓingel ɗon bana cuurki kujeeji, dudal, e peewri ngam ustugo caɗeele ɗon, kadi ngaddana mo gite asibiti dow law. To o waawaa fofugo ko ɓenndu maako waylitake, njaaɓe mo asibiti ɗon-ɗon ngam heɓugo ballal pofɗe (oxygen).

question: Debbo danyi ɓingel ɓingel lewru mai lewru jui waɗi bayani hala ɓingel mai o viya damuwa dow ɓingel mai wakkati o dal mai ɗo musina sosai bana no handi. answer: Daada mako wi'i goonga, haala ka ɗo laati huunde hulɓiniinde masin ngam ɓingel pammarel. Woyaandu tiggati, ɓaandu wulndu (fever), e wokaago nde ngel ɗon yara enɗi woni alaamaaji nyawu mawnngu bana nyawu ƴiiƴam (sepsis) koo nyawu pabbooje. Diga lawlaw, doole on njaara ɓingel ngel sibiti ngam likita'en ndaara ngel, ɓe ƴeewa nyawu ngu. To on njottake, ɓe mbaɗan ngel teesti ɓe ndokka ngel leɗɗe ɗe mbernde, koo drip e bakkal ngam hisnugo yonki maggel. question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
answer: To rawandu ndu ɗon jam, ɓingel ngel waawataa heɓugo nyawu ciwto (rabies), dow maajum walaa haaje yahugo asibiti ngam heɓugo pampusheere. Dammutoore e ɗuutuɗum babal man holli lekki gargajiya man ɗon huuwa ngam poodugo tooke rawandu wuurta daga ɓandu mako. Kuje nde on waɗata jonta, on wuuwa babal man bee ndiyam ɗuliɗam e lamɗam nde ɗiɗi nyande fuu ngam ɗum ndaara. On kokka ɓingel ngel magani paracetamol ngam naawalla ɓandu fahin. question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Zazzabi be jooral dande be kadi fita diuna je bingel ma ɗon holla nyau 'Meningitis' (mborndi dande) ko bo zazzabi malaria mawɗo (cerebral malaria). Handi a yaara bingel man asibiti jaw-jaw ngam nyau ɗo ɗon mari hadari sanne, ta a jooɗi ha saare sam. To on yahi asibiti, likitoci ɓen ɗon ngada gwaji 'lumbar puncture' (ƴettugo ndiyam ɓaawo) ngam anndugo ainihin ko woni nder ɓandu bingel man je waddata nyau ɗon. Ɓe mboornata mo lekkiiji jaw-jaw (IV antibiotics) be lekkiiji zazzabi ngam hisgo yonki mako e hadugo jonte ɗon. Ta a boomi wakkati, yahugo asibiti jooni on herrata hisgo bingel ma e jonte ɗi ɗon torra mo ɗon.

question: debbo feere kam waddi ɓinge makko mo duuɓi tati asibiti ɓe laara mo hande subaka koɓe haali bo hikke to yimɓe wolwani ɓinge on o tannitataako sam o laarata goɗɗo feere mo wolwalta mo hetaano di'in de makko o sonyata mo daamayi hano o nane maasaba hindere ƴamoyi ngoyme ƴamidebbo on jukale omme ɗi higuguɓa tena e namakko wi o me daya hebike badde membedi mem tsamimo jukale ngoya hebi jabugo galapate be sode mun hatimude ko ofotino hebigo bana non inna makko waddi ereji nyawudugol dum min kotorto labini min ge on jabi bate makkosa but min bedi min tsami ko feti hunde jukale on ingol wala padde e o jabi bate pesode makko pat ko dami jukale on
answer: Ɓingel ngel jaabataa nodde, weltataa jogaade hakkille, wulla, e dognagol hoore/juuli, hollitii ko caɗeele ƴellitaare bana nyaw Autism walla baasɗe nanɗe, ɗe ɗaɓɓata ƴeewndo doktoor sukaaɓe. Ko faati e "jukale" ɗee (ɓuuɓri) ɗe mballitaaki e leɗɗe ɓennuɗe ɗe, ɗum hollitii wonaa ko baakteri, ko needi ƴeewndirte ɓanndu ngam anndude ko mboro, allergie, walla scabies. Miɗo wasiya yo ɓingel ngel addane opitaal ngam ƴeewndirde nanɗe (hearing test) e ƴeewde ɓanndu ngam heɓude safaa ɗo poti. Yumma makko yo horno tiiɗnaare, woppa ƴaaɗde mo ngam hawrude e yimɓe, o toppite mo e nokku deeƴnuɗo.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
answer: Caɗeele hultungo, ɓernde fiyande, e ɓanndu nawngo ndu a mari ɗon wara saabe fitina saare e kulol ngol a woni e muɗum. Wana lekki gargajiya halkata caɗeele ɗe; a yiɗi a yaha opitiri ngam likita'en ɓernde e hakkiilo wallu ma. Haani a mantina kisal ma, a haɓa a heɓa wallinde diga pelle wallata rewɓe dow fitina saare ko yimɓe huutortoɓe dow kisal saare. To kulol ngol wari, waɗ fofango luggo (deep breathing) ngam ustaggo hultungo ma e ustugo fiyango ɓernde ma. Kisal ma woni ko ɓuri maantorgo jonta, nden a yiɗi kuutorɗe laawol ngam hisnugo yonki ma.

question:
Alabukun vii, odo ye’a dowre , kanjum be chomri, bo hore naawata mo do hadi mo jode belde. Saati didi ko salli, o wala naaana jamma boddum sam. Koste mako didi be juude mako be yeso fu pat ni do puuti puuti. Odo tani habda be mai. Be saurimo o yara hundeji fere nii, amma dai fu pat walaa ko hoini sam. Amma nii be viimo o tammi waddugo daama.
Be laari mo bevi daa ko shafii foofugo don ba. Ko haadini beda be wadi, be vii da kodume manga don bah. Odo fada eskal wala bone. Sembe eyam mako fu be hauni be tawi 168/100. Gammai bevi o suita , be godi sembe eyam mako fain be tawi 150/90.
Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. Be yechi mo kala hundeji fu je owatta, bandamo hundeji tornato mo soosai watata sembe eyam mako bedda. Demde am ba, bawo hundeji be wanni irin jaumu reedu do, jedo mari nawwugo hoore kullum be uppugo yeeso mataaki toi hosata hado reedujo do, ta ye’u yotta har debbi mo do jima?
Be kuma dume don jaumu redu wadata da yotta irinbanni bako owonna banni?
answer: Sembe iyam mako on wona hipertansiyon (168/100 mmHg) e diyabete (glicemi 150 mg/dL), ko wadi ɗum jeɗɗe makko. Yimɓe be tawi jaɓɓe anti-hipertansif (ACEI/ARB, diuretik, CCB) e metformine pur diyabete, wona be nder jaɓɓe. Waɗɗe gilla makko, ɓirɓe suukaru, nam, e ɓirɓe laawol pur hoore makko. Yotta hoore makko, glicemi, e kere makko nder sippire nde. To ɗum wadi, yeeyi saare hoore makko pur waɗɗe spesyalis (kardiolog, nefrolog).

question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. Emol hado ɗume on waddini debbo redul jodo fiyel berde be lau lau do a viya mo timmini dogugo dembo dume on sanadu uppugo dande do irin nyau do kam wawan mema maunugo bingel redu mako do na dume on alamaji kalludum je be watinta gite hasare ba irin nyamduji ko kuje yare yareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko beddata nyamugo ha irin wakkati do.
answer:
Rufugo yiiƴam masin nder reedu lebbi joweego ɗon heewi waddude gam taariika ɓiɗɗo (placenta) waali les malla ɗon seeki (placental abruption).

Somaago e uppugo dadol ndande ɗon holla ɓernde maako ɗon huuwa masin (heart failure) ngam ŋakkere yiiƴam (severe anemia) sanadi yiiƴam ɗam o waasi.

Ngol nyawu ɗon mari saɗɗa masin, kadi ɗon waawi halkugo reedu ndun ngam ɓiɗɗo heɓataa foofi e nyamdu daga daada mum.

O yaha asibiti lawlaw gam o waɗa hoto (ultrasound) e o heɓa ɓeydaari yiiƴam to ɗon darta, ngam taa o waasa yonki maako e ɓiɗɗo.

O foti accugo kuude teddude, o siwtora masin, kadi o nyama nyamduuɗi ɓeydooji yiiƴam bana kusel, nyebbe, e haakooji laaɓuɗi.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
answer:
Ɗum ko alama hulɓinɗe: ɓingel ɗo ɗojude/cough e jamma, fufugo saɗii, ɓerde maa pofɗe ɗo “fiyude” — ɗum ina waawi wonde pofɗe ɗe njarii/pneumonia walla asma/bronchiolitis.
Yahnee asibiti hande-hande ngam dokita yoƴɓe mo, ɓe ndaar fufugo makko, oxygen, e ndiyam pofɗe, ɓe hokku mo dawaaji so ina sokli.
So o fufata haa saɗii, ɓernde/ɓoggol na naata, o waawataa muynude, o heɓii yowre mawnde, walla leɓɓe makko ngol ngol/blue—ɗum ko emergency.
Hade njahugol, jooɗin mo dow, hokku mo ndiyam/breast milk seeɗa-seeɗa, saf salin nder hondu so ngesa ɗarii, walla paracetamol so yowre woodi.
Woto hokku dawaaji ɗojere, antibiotics, walla leppi gargajiya tawa dokita yamiraani, ngam ɗum waawi ɓurɗude ɗeenɗe.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer:
Toon on binngel mo lebbi tati mari jonnde (fever) e o walaa hakkilo, ɗum ɗon holla nyawnaare maawnunde, ngam majjum yaaru mo asibiti ɓurɗo ɓadaade do’en jooni-jooni.

Ta tammi mo muunungo malla ndiyam njarteɗam tawi o walaa hakkilo, ngam ta o laccitto (aspiration).

Aɗon baawi huutorgol ndiyam ɓulɗum seɗɗa (tepid sponging) bee collaaji ngam ustugo nguleendi ɓandol maako, kadi wallin mo dow sengo mako ngam o heɓa sulaaji booɗɗum.

Likotiri’en ɓen asibiti ƴeewan mo, ɓe narna mo lekkiiji bee kelliiji (IV fluids/medications) ngam hisnugo yonki maako.

Yaade asibiti jooni-jooni walaa neeɓugo ɗon mari nafa sanne ngam reenugo yonki ɓinngel maa.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer: Ɗum ko tiiɗal mawngal ngam ɓikkon ɗon ɗaana tan ummataako bee gite e ɓandu ooli, ɗum ɗon holla wonde rafi ooli (jaundice) ɗon heewi haa ɗon lora hoore makko wala ko rafi tiiɗɗo wa malaria. Darta yargo leɗɗe ɓaleeje ɗen kisa ngam ɗe ɗon ɓeyda loriga hecce (liver) e ɓeɗe (kidneys) makko ɗe mbaawataa wurtinde toksiin. Yawtu ɓikkon nga to asibiti mawɗo jooni-jooni ngam ɓe ndaara ƴiiƴam makko, ɓe mbaɗa safara yaasi wa waylugo ƴiiƴam (exchange transfusion) wala leegal ooli (phototherapy). Ɗaanaago ɓikkon ɗon holla wonde ɓiliruubin (bilirubin) ɗon naata e kwakwalwa (kernicterus), ko ɗum waɗi ɗum haani safara asibiti yaasi hade ɗum loriga ɓanndu makko haa abada.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer: Nyawu ngu ɓingel keccel ngel mari kangu on jonte (malaria) be sompu danygol, ɗum alhaali mo waɗata koodeye. Mataki gawal ngal a hoosata kangu on, hoosu ndiyam gulɗam jilla e njuumri (honey) a loowa nder hunduko maggel ngam daande maggel maɓɓita. Wala haaje a wadda ngel asibiti ngam oksijin (oxygen), amma fiil ngel nder bargooji tiddɗe bo a aasa yiite kombi maggel ngam ngel heɓa nguli. Hokku ngel magani chloroquine be paracetamol ɗon e ɗon ngam usta tiddol ɓandu maggel ndu. Ɓawo awaaji sedda, ngel finkay woya kangel e hoore maggel to a waɗi ɗum.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer: Iyam e kugeji vurtojum ɓawo danyugo ɗum huunde wooɗunde masin, ngam ɗum ɗon laɓɓina ndiyam duniya nder reedu ma wakkati danyugo. Ngam a darna tampiri e yidaango wakkati darnde, haɓɓu lemmol teet haa cakka ma ngam a hokka ɓandu ma sembe. Tokku yarugo ndiyam guldum bee manda wakkati fuu, ngam ɗum taarana iyam man vurta kakkasal walaa haaje a yaha asibiti. Naawol les jaaburu e dande ma ɗum alama ɓandu ma ɗon warta hesre, koo hulaa walaa nyawu maɓɓata ma.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
answer:
**Naseeha e ɗumen keccel/ɓingel man:**

Alaamaaji ɗi a limi—ɓingel ɗo fofa be bone jemma, ɗo tarihi, keccel mako ɗo wokka, ɗo ummina, e ɓingel salaango musnugo be ficcugo—ɗum foti wonan alaama **colic** (naawnere reedu ndeɓingel j) walla naawnere nder reedu (kaŋŋu, reflux, walla infekshon).

**Ko a foti waɗugo:**
- Ɓingel man foti yaha likita/asibiti gam ndaar ta, sabu naawugo mabbe be tarihi jemma foti wonan alaama nawnaare mari faaɓngal (kaŋŋu, infekshon, walla reflux).
- To ɓingel salake musnugo be ficcugo, ɗum foti wonan alaama nawnaare, kanjum saɗa a foti hollirde likita law.
- Hoto ɗana be jemma: haɓɓu ɓingel no moƴƴi, ndeen ficcu ɗum ɓaawo kala musineede gam heɓa reflux, huutoraa lekki likita rokki, hakkunde ɓe wallita.

**Aduna:** Wata a hokku ɓingel lekki naɓɓaango walla lekki hesnaango yeeso likita anndi sabaabu maggel—ɗum foti bonnude reedu maggel. Yaha asibiti gam ndaarooje moƴƴere.

question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. Dan wakkati odyota badi ha jotta koni mako ha wakkati konju kala on wurtoi to ingaya kam on no nana naudum naudum dobe jodata jodi naudum mako wurtai ridi mako arande on hakila am ummi be ta Miɗi mi yida binge on mi yiɗa mi soya binge ame warta dou sa'i ni foɗata nau ɗum on danyoda arande wa’ina noɗata ɓe wi'a binge ko tay vurta hite alura ko ɗon saika mo.
answer:
Mi faami sikke maa. Ɓingel maa ina e nder wakkatuuji dañal (labor), ko ɗum waɗata naawɗe ɗe garooje e artooje, e ridde nde wurtotoo, ko maandeeji dañal potuɗi.

**Ko yiɗ-mi wi'ude ma:**

1. **Yaa suudu safaara/ospital law-law** – tawde ridde nden ina wurtoo (fluid/rimirde fuɗɗiima), tawa nden ɓingel ina foti dañeede e nder wakkatu, ɗum waɗi haala. Wata a joodo galle.

2. **Alura (injection) nden** ko woni ɗum fotti wontude ko ballal dañal (labor augmentation) maa safaara naawɗe – kono ɗum foti waɗeede tan e ospital tawa doktoor maa nurse ina ndaara mo, wonaa e galle.

3. **Ndaaru maandeeji bonɗi:** ridde ɓaleeri maa njamndi, ɓernde ɓingel juutde no feewi, ɓalndu ɓingel wulde/joofde, maa naawɗe ɗe njaajti tawa ɓingel dañaani – ɗii fof ko maandeeji jokkondirgol suudu safaara law.

Ko moƴƴi fooɗanaade mo suudu safaara jooni, wata a ɓooyu, ngam neɗɗo debbo e ɓinngel makko fof ina keɓa ballal moƴƴol.

question: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
answer: Wannan matsalar "rejection" ne wanda ke bukatar kulawa ta kwakwalwa da kuma maganin abinci ko magani idan akwai rashin lafiya. A matsayin likita, ina ba ka shawarar ka fara magana da shi cikin natsuwa don gano dalilin da ya sa ya ki karkatarwa. Idan matsalarin ta kai ga rashin cin abinci ko kuncin jiki, yana da kyau a nemo likita domin ya duba yanayin jikinsa. Akwai yiwuwar akwai matsalar rashin jin daɗin abinci (anorexia) ko kuma matsalar zuciya wacce ke sa shi kare kansa. Ka tabbatar ka ba shi abinci mai gina jiki da ruwa sosai, sannan ka biyo shawarar likita don tabbatar da lafiyarsa.

answer:
Alamaaji ɗii ko wayi no yarugo ndiyam heewɗam, sillugo saabunde, ŋakkere semmbe e boyaari ɓalli, ɗum no feƴƴatina nyawu suukar (shuga).
O yahra law law to asibiti walla nokku celluɗo ngam ƴeeŋtude suukar e nder ƴiiƴam e fitinnde.
To shuga tawima, doktoore waɗan mo lekki (kamani metformin) e wasiyyaaji: o haɗanaa nyaamduuji welɗi, o ɗama ndiyam laaɓɗam, o nyaama ko ɓuuɓata seeɗa-seeɗa bana gawri, ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe, e liɗɗi.
So o safraaki, shuga ina waawa battinde e rafiiji ɓernde, niteeku, walla koma nguleeki ɓanndu, ɗum noon jom suudu mum ina haani reeninde e koyɗe makko, yejjitaare e temmbu wakkati omo umma.
Fuu ko woni, ƴeewndo yaawngo e jokkindiraagal e safrooɓe nokkuure mbaɗan semmbe ɓanndu makko arde, o dañan cellal.

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer:
Alamuuji ɗi a limti ɗo, bana ɓaandu wulngo, ɓuuɓri e ɓaandu (bosaru), e salugo nyamdu, ɗon holla ɓingel maaɗa wondi e nyawu bosaru (measles).

Nyawu nguu ɗon naawa masin, kadi nguu waawan addango ɓingel caɗeele manngu bana doggudu reedu, nyawu poofɗe (pneumonia), ko wumre gite to a wadaay sasa.

Danndu ɓingel ngel haa ɓikkon feere ngam taa nguu raaba ɓe, nden yaara ngel asibiti lawlaw ngam ngel heɓa laccuugo.

Haa asibiti, likita hokkan ɓingel maaɗa lekki *Vitamin A* ngam hisnugo gite e semmbiɗingo ɓaandu maagel, hawtaade e lekki ustaago wulngo ɓaandu.

Haa a yotta asibiti, jokku hokkugo ngel ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam, enɗam, e nyamdu ngam ɓaandu maagel heɓa semmbe habda e nyawu ngu.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
answer:
Bismillah. Ndaɗi nawol e maslaha keewuɗi, kono no ceɗɗi ɗi mbi'ata ko musuba (emergency) mawɗo:

**Ko debbo ɗo foti waɗgo jooni:**
1. **Yaa be gorko mako suudu safaara (hospital) law law** - nawol hore mai voɗaani, be gorko o tidini, be kula pamari e ɓandu (rashes/spots) ɗi puɗɗi vurtude, e zazzabi, ɗum ina waawi wonugo nawol saɗtuɗo kaa infection saɗtunde (bana meningitis, sepsis, kaa reaction lekki).

2. **Wata debbo o waɗ o vallitittaako to suudu** - ɗum e wonaa maslaha ɓaleeɓe mbaawata safaraade to galle; ndeen non ina waawi ɓeydude nawol o kaa halkude o.

3. **Nangu lekki ɗi o naftii ɗiin** - joggo ɗi yaha be ɗi to hospital ngam doctor ina waawi anndude si ko lekki huli mo (drug reaction bana Stevens-Johnson syndrome, ɗum ina halkata).

4. **Wata ɓe njaɓ hakke waktu** - kula ɗi ina vurtoo e ɓandu, zazzabi, e nawol hore saɗtungo ko alaama musuba; safaara law ina hisna wonkii mako.

Insha'Allah o dandete si o yottii safaara law. Yaa be mo jooni jooni.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
answer: Nyau gorko ma ɗon woni **Sankarau (Meningitis)**, ngam alamuuji mum bana nawol hore nyaɗɗung, zazzabi sembe, dande tinnunde, e kulle pamare (petechiae) gurtuɗe dow ɓandu. Ɗum woni caɗeele mawnde haa cellal, ngam maajum ta accugo o ɗaana ha saare, njahuree asibiti jooni-jooni ngam heɓugo wallitoore likitoci. Ha asibiti, ɓe njaɓan mo ɓe murnamo be lekkiiji antibiotik sembiɗɗi bana *Ceftriaxone* bee lekkiiji goɗɗi feewnata ɓandu maako. Ndaree tsabta bo mballon goɗɗe fuu ɓadiiɓe mo heɓugo lekki kisndam (prophylaxis) ngam nyau ngu ɗon saara lawlaw.

question: Debbo fere kam waddi bingel mako mo dimbi tati asibiti be laramo hande subaka ko be halibo eketo yimɓe olo wani binge on tatata kosam o larata goddo fere mo wolwal tamo heddi inde mako o sota mo damai ha noi masan hingare jungo nyami debbo on cokali on medi hiɓugo badde na mako. O meda himɓe baɗɗe minbedi men cokali heɓi jaɓugo kala batel mum ha tummude ko o fotti noɓugo bana no inna mako waddi redi nyaudugo ɗum min kotoltol laɓii mingew on jarbi bate mako pat feiti. Innde cukali on ingol wala paɗɗe o jaɓi bate pesode mako pat ko dami cu.
answer: Nyawu cukalel ngel walaa haaɗi, olo e waasugo yarugo kosam ɗum alamaaji ngel ɗon ƴi'a nyiƴƴe ɗum ɗon wada ɓikkoi kooɓeye. Taa hokka ngel kosam inna fahin, ammaa hokku ngel ndiyam sukara malla tii (tea) wulɗum ngam ngel heɓa semmbe. Mooɓu ngel nder bargewol dekkiiɗum masin ngam ngel wula tuuɗa, ɗum wallan jonte ɗen wurtoya nder ɓandu. Walaa haaje buraasdu malla lekki asibiti, tokku hokkugo mo lekki tummude ki don hokkamo haa wuro. Yaaru cukalel ngel wuro ngam ngel fofta, ɓaawo balɗe ɗiɗi koo tati ngel waran jam gar.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
answer: Ndingu iiyam tiiɗuɗum baawo danygol (Postpartum Hemorrhage), ɗum waddata ɗum no heewi ko heddi wakkude (placenta) nder reedu malla nyawu (infection). Rufugo iiyam kete-kete kanjum waddi rafi ƴiiƴam nder ɓandu maako (anemia), waɗi o walaa sembe, bo o waawaa nyaamugo. Ngam iiyam daro e o heɓta sembe, asibiti mbatta mo lekki usta reedu, lekki mboosa (antibiotics), e mboɗe ƴiiƴam malla ɓesda mo ƴiiƴam to haaje waɗi. Shawara am to daada oon, o foofta masin, o nyaama nyamdu moƴƴundu, o yarna ɓingel enndu soosai gam ɗum ɗon walla reedu moobtoo, iiyam ma daroo. O lutta haa asibiti ngam likita'en ndaara mo boɗɗum haa ɓandu maako warta.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer: Jonte e ɓuule ɓandu ɓaawo danygol ɗon hollita wonde debbo o na waawi woodugo nyau "puerperal sepsis" (kuwo nder ɓandu ɓaawo danygol) koo malaria mawɗo, nden ɗum jootari mawnundi haa yonki mako. Sey njaaran ton mo asibiti mawnundu law-law ngam o heɓa lekkiiji pampartooje (IV antibiotics) bee ndiyam dadi ngam hisnugo mo. Bingel ngel o danyi hande ngel o vi ngel salaay musungo boo sey laale haa asibiti ngam jonte inna hannde waaway yaɓɓugo ngel nyau (neonatal sepsis). Ta accee mo haa saare bee paracetamol e lekki malaria tan, ngam kuuje ɗo he’ataa nyawndugo nyau man to ngun rewnaay nder dadi. Dilluki asibiti jooni-jooni kanum woni laawol gootol ngol hisnata yonki inna bee ɓiɗɗo mako hande.

Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.

question: addirawo am danyi ɓinngel debbo balɗe saali sey o laari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo wala foofa boɗɗum wakkati feere ɓinngel man yofta kosam bamo fofɗe maako ta'i yande woore daada ɓinngel timmini musungo mo bee jemma sey o laari leɓɓi ɓinngel ba wala ba wayliti seɗɗa seɗɗa sey o tampi ko o waɗata sey o goɗi ɓamtugo ɓinngel man ngam o heɓa o foofa boɗɗum ammaa bo ɓinngel gaagiri foofugo boɗɗum bee boo canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel man sey o yaawi o hoosi ɓinngel o yaari asibiti ngam ɓe laaranamo ɓinngel may ɗume on canjini ɓinngel man leɓɓal nden bo walaa aybe no ɓinngel foofata na ko bo nyawuɓe nde walla nyawu hanta dasinta ɓinngel man foofugo bee bone ɗume on alaamaaji kalluɗum jee saarooji waatinta hakkiilo ɗume on agaji ɓe waawata hokkugo ɓinngel mo foofata bee bone
answer: Canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel laato ɓaleejum ɗon holla ronkugo hendu poofirgal (oxygen) nder ƴiiƴam, ɗum bo waaway laatugo nyawu ɓernde (congenital heart defect) malla nyawu nduufa mawngu (pneumonia), naa ɗum alhaali koondey. Foofugo bee bone e yoftugo endi wakkati musinngo ɗon holla ɓernde malla poofirgal ɓinngel ɗon tampi heɓugo semmbe ngam yarugo kosam. Alaamaaji kalluɗum ɗi saarooji poti hakkilango kanji on: ɓaleego leɓɓi, jaawleendi foofugo malla ta'ugo foofɗe, lo'ugo ɓanndu, e salugo musinngo. Agaji ɓurɗum nafu kani on ɓamtugo ɓinngel ɓaawo maako daro seɗɗa ngam o heɓa foofugo boɗɗum, suddungo mo ngam o fasa, e yaawugo yaargo mo asibiti lawlaw bana no daada man waɗi. Likkita'en asibiti ɓe mbaɗan bincike ngam anndugo asali nyawu man e hokkugo ɓinngel hendu walliitawal (oxygen) bee magani cahiɗum.

# Jaabawol

**Ndu rawandu wanngii mo, ɗum ko rabies (rawandu maayo/kuutorwuru) himmani no feewi.**

Sabu ndu rawandu ngatii bingel, jonta babal ngati ngal fuɗɗii ɓurtaade e wuurtaade ɗum tinndinta ko **rabies** — nawnaare warayɗe nde alaa safaara so tampere maayre nde fuɗɗike (hydrophobia, ɓurtaade babal, seytaare). So maayo maayii, alaa ko wonata safaara, ɓiɗɗo maayan.

**Ko foti waɗeede jonta jonta:**
1. **Loota babal ngal e ndiyam e saabunle** ñalawma sappo e joweeɗiɗi (15 minutes), ɗum ustay virus ɗen.
2. **Naɓee bingel asibiti law law** ngam heɓa **rabies vaccine (PEP)** e **anti-rabies immunoglobulin (RIG)** — ɗum woni safaara mo hisinta.
3. Yalta ha lekki fere; safaara laaɓɗo ko asibiti tan.

**Rawandu ndu ngoodi:** so wawi heɓeede, jogaa ndu (quarantine) balɗe sappo ngam ndaaree so ndu maayan — ammaa ɗum wallataa gaddaade naɓugol bingel asibiti jonta jonta.

**Hujja:** So seytaare (symptoms) fuɗɗike e ɓiɗɗo, safaara alaa. Ko vaccine ndeen jaɓoowo ado nawnaare fuɗɗaade woni ko hisinta yonki mum.

## Jaabawol

Wakkati fofugo ɓinngel wartay dede ɓaawo danyeenugo, ɗum firti hooto **fofuki hakkillaaji ndeenka** (birth asphyzia/perinatal asphyxia) ndi waɗi ɓinngel heɓɓaali sembe (oksijan) haa hakkille to o danyaa.

Fofuki oksijan (resuscitation) ndeen ko boɗɗum haala, amma ɓinngel mo waɗi asphyxia fu waawi heɓde bone hakkillaaji (hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy) ndi jibinta caltuɗi maa nayeeje.

Har wakkati ɓinngel maa waawi hisde no boɗɗum, amma **wanaa fofa ɓinngel fu wartay dede caltal maa nayeeɓe**—goɗɗo hisay laɓɓe, goɗɗo heɓay nangere mbaydiiji hakkilo (seizures), maa caltuɗi.

Ko boɗɗum wakkati fu jokku ɓinngel to sibiti do jaɓɓowo ɓikkoy (SCBU/NICU) si woodi, ngam ndeenka oksijan, tempretur, njameeje e caltuɗi hakkille.

**Waawi hisde boɗɗum, amma alaa fooɗɗiraama—ndeeno ɓinngel no boɗɗum haa naange fu, so a yiyi caltal fu, hoto to likita law.**

answer: Hoto naftira lekki ko sabulu gargajiya ngam ɗum waawi bonnugo ɓingel ngel, ɓeydugo rafi nder ɓanɗu (sepsis), ko saayugo ɓanɗu mako. A haani nawgo ɓingel ngel ha asibiti kisan yake ngam o heɓa safara ndiyam nder ɗaɗi (IV fluids), lekki paɗɗoɗum rafi (antibiotics), bee ndaarde ko woni rafi mako. Safara gargajiya waawaa wallitugo ha rafi ɗo, nden ɗum haani safara annduɓe (dokita'en) ngam hisnugo nguurndam ɓingel ngel.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
answer:
Ko a siftii ɗum ena yiɗi waɗde **meningitis/cuta hoore**: zazzabi, nawol hoore mawɗo, daande tiddi/wawataa feewtugo, e kuraje/piloji e ɓandu — ɗum **gaggawol**.
Ɗowee mo **asibiti joonee**; o waɗaaji gwaji e magani ɗo ley ɓeyngu, so tawii meningitis ɓe naftira **ceftriaxone/antibiotic** daɗɗugo mo.
Hoto ɗum woodi lekki gida tan walla lornugo ɓandu; waɗanee mo paracetamol so zazzabi, ndiyam, amma hoto o ɗaan ɗo tan.
Ɓiɓɓe e yimɓe suɓaaɓe hoto ɓadii mo, hoto ɓe huutora kofi/kwano mako, waɗee lootirde juuɗe, tawa ɓe ɗaɓɓita **magani kariya/vaccine** e asibiti.
So o jomɗi, o tampi, o woppita hakkille, walla kuraje ɗe mbayi ndiyan-damu, ɗum ɓurii gaggawa.

Sey nawtu mo yaawre to asibiti mawnde ɓurnde ɓada to ɓe keɓaa leɗɗe piye (antibiyotik) bana seftiraakson walla kloramfenikol liɗɗi, ngam hisnugo mo nguurndam.

To walaa asibiti mawnde e hoɗɗe, fuɗɗora mo laawol lekki ñaameteeɗo bana ofloxacin e doxycycline e jaango doktoor, amma ɗum waɗataa ko lomtorde piye.

answer: Alaamuuji ɗi a llimti, bana doyru, jonte (ɓandu wuli), e fofugo saɗti, ɗon holla bingel ngel ɗon mari nyawu ɓooma (pneumonia) malla naboore (infection) haa gineeji fofugo. Yaargo mo asibiti lawlaw ko a waɗi ɗo woni laawol boɗɗewol ngam nyawu ngu ɗon hiiti dow ɓiɓɓe pamari masin. Walaa nyaamdu ndu haandi o acca, ammaa sey a woɗɗina mo bee kura, cuurki, e peewol ngam taa ɗum ɓesdan mo saɗugo fofugo. Laaru o ɗon heɓa foowtugo, o ɗon yara ndiyam malla kosam ɗuuɗɗum nder wakkati o ɗon hoosa lekki asibiti haa o safo.

Lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwini mo sei o vi o dilli tan o yahi a sibiti heɓa ɓe hefta ko fe’ata be petul damuwa ɗo wawan hoina ɓingal ɗo damuwa ɓerde na ko asma ɗon fe’ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toi ɗon handi ɓingel ɗo handi acca heɓa ko. damata mo wadinta mo o dodda ho’ina mo usta sosai.
answer:
# Jaabawol

Alaamaaji ɗi neɗɗo on ɓatii—petel to ɓaawo balɗe seeɗa, nyaw koma, occugo (ɗaanaade e ɗaano juuteendo), heewa hoyfeere, e teddungol ndaaraade ɓernde—ɗi holliti wonde tan **asma** woni ñawu ngu ɓinngel ngel wondi.

Asma ko ñawu ɗo boɗi ndogudi henndu (bronkoji) suusata heewde koɓɓol e uufeede, ɗum addana ɓoggol henndu saɗtude, tawa neɗɗo occa, foofa saɗi, e wooɗra ɓaawo balɗe seeɗa maa jemma.

Faawru maako on, si ɗum artata to jaaɓnere maa henndu ɓuuɓndu, ɗum tinndini wonde ko asma; taccaani ñawu lekki gargajiya maa henndu bonndu.

**Ko foti waɗeede:** yaaru ɓinngel ngel to safrirde ndeɗta ta’a lasar (inhaler) mbayɗo salbutamol ngam uddita bronkoji, e steroid inhaler ngam ustude uufeede si asma on tiiɗi.

Reennu ɓinngel ngel e kaɗe (dust, curkuru, buri, henndu ɓuuɓndu), tawa a jeytoto safrirde law si foofugol saɗti sanne ngam hisnude yonki maggel.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer: Ɓingel ngel woni ha nder tanaa mawngo sabu maandaaji ɗin hollata ko o mari nyau ƴiiƴam (sepsis), nyau ɓanndu (drug allergy) diga safaraaji, bee laawol redu nastugo ha iyam (rectourinary fistula). Wata o hokku ngel ORS tan, kadi o dilla safaraaji ɗi asibiti walla daadiraɓe hokki mo ɗin sabu ɗum waɗi ɓanndu makko fuf feata. Ko haandi ɗada yaha yaaki ha asibitiijo mawɗo mo mari sanannko'en ɓe sukaaji (pediatricians) ngam ɓe ndaara mo bee naazari (ultrasound) bee ƴiiƴam. O haandi heɓugo safaraaji nder ƴiiƴam (IV antibiotics) bee ndiyam nder ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) ngam tiggugo nyau man, wadata safaraaji ɗemngal tan. Ɗada kadi haandi heɓugo ballal hakkillo ngam o faama no o rakkinta ɓingel makko haa o heɓa cellal timmungal.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer: Taari saɗtundi jemma, foofugo lawlaw bee bone, e salagol musingo ɗon holla alaamaaji nyaw barhuli bana *pneumonia* koo bo *bronchiolitis* nder ɓingel lebbi jeetati. Ɗum ɗon waɗa ngam kude (infection) man ɗon uura koo hebbina ndiyam nder poofɗe ɓingel pamari, ɗum waɗa o waawataa heɓugo hendu boɗɗum, musamman to o waalake jemma. Asma koo dukkan (allergy) ngam peewol, curki, koo sollaare ma e waawi waɗugo taari jemma, ammaa salagol musingo on holli nyaw man yotti masin. Gam ɓingel ɗon hapɗa foofaago bo sali ndiyam endi, ɗum sarti *emergency* ko haandi o heɓa nyawndugu lawlaw bana *oxygen*, lekki *antibiotics*, e lekki maɓɓitata poofɗe haa asibiti. Daada man waɗi boɗɗum mo o waddi mo asibiti lawlaw, ngam lekki likita'en on tan waawata maagugo nyaw man haa ɓingel waawa foofa bo ɗaana boɗɗum.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
answer:
Bingel nde rawandu ngati, ko haaju yaaɓde asibiti ɗon ɗon, ngam haɗde **rabies** e jawdi haɓɓere.
Likita yo lootira haɓɓere ndiyam/saline, itta lekki gargajiya ɗo, ɗewtina so ina waɗi pus, ɗokka **antibiotic** (sanda amoxicillin-clavulanate) e **tetanus injection**.
So ngamre nde ɓuri huutora walla rawandu naati leɗɗe/ɗiye, bingel ɗo ina haani heɓde **rabies vaccine** jooni, e so ngamre nde tampi/ɓuri saayi, ina haani heɓde **rabies immunoglobulin** a kewri haɓɓere.
Rabies vaccine hawan ɗon ɗon: ɓesngu 0, 3, 7, 14 (e ɗum 28 so dokita wi’i), awa nde walla yaltina ko rawandu mo ina yuɓɓi.
Wonaa feere gargajiya walla lekki fere a haɓɓere; so bingel waɗi hitaande, jonte, pus, ƴiiƴam, walla naange, wartu asibiti ɗon ɗon.

question: mi debbo ɓanginga on duuɓi am 35 useni mi ɗo mari ɓingel am lebbi joi on lari mi ammugo mi hoti kugal ko helɗi mi am nyalɗe tati saali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗojja sosai min godi koɗume je darnata dojjugo mai amma mi lari accai mi duɗai joɗugo hasari to mi dilli be fajira sai asira mi wartata jego'o dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala da mi heɓi wakkati ɗonugo miɗo ɗona mi nana ko o ɗo yojja kuma ɓe ɗo yecca am o ɗo ja ɓingel am lebbi joi on o acci yarugo kosam tun ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi ɗayi mi ɗo kosam mi yarai mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗon hokka mo nyamduji kala kala bana gari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yalɗini am tun kenya jamma fofugo mako ɗo dana o fofoi ba dana o vowi fofugo ba o wala fofa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat dada am biɗɗum be hande wakkati o ɗon yiɗa mo be fajira seɗɗa o naftiri diyam jum jum hakkine mako be haɓarde mako gam damba mai sati fofugo mai fuɗɗi o acceti fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acceyai mo useni mdm dime'on min naftirta har mako jey acceh ta damba mai kuma hala fofugo mai jey lebbi dime mi wadata dime mi naftirta mo kuma dime mi wadata hala fofugo bodum do hadata mo fofugo
answer: Yaa Allah! Haala ɓiɗɗo maa ɗon holla caɗeele fofugo (apnea) ɗe mbaawi warde mo, ko ɗum saabii a yahra e mo to asibiti law nde wakkati fu, taa ɗaɓɓito ko heewi. Toon doktoor waawan laaraade mo, hokkude mo oksijen e leɗɗe ɓernde ngam kisnude mo. Nder wakkatiire seɗɗa, accu ɓiɗɗo oo ndaarde mo dow hoore maako, a laaɓina hoore maako e ɓaawo ngam waɗugo fooɗugo yaafo, a suddana mo damba laaɓuɗo. Ngam hisnude laral maako ɗon haaɓunde (damba), laaɓinam laaɓi bee ndiyam wulɗam, yooram, wirnam kirim nyamnduɗum (zinc oxide) haa o yahra asibiti. Woto hokku mo nyamdu walaa ndiyam nder dungal haa sai o laaraama, sabu fooɗugo mo waawi saabanaago sifaaji nyaamdu nder ɓernde.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer: Alamaaji ɗii hono zazzabi, mette e gite e nderde, ɓanndu mettugo, e ko gite ɗe waɗata jalo (jaundice), ɗum hollata ko waawi heɓtude ɓe rafi bana Lassa fever, Yellow fever, walla Malaria tiiɗɗo. Ko haanji ɗaccude huuwtinirgo leɗɗe galleeji ɗe mari hasare ɗee njooni, sabu ko ɗe waawi ɓeydude bonnugo nganndu (liver) ɗo ko ɗum warata ko jalo e gite. Ɓe poti ƴeewteede saɗtaagal to sibiti ngam ƴeewndaade ƴiiƴam (blood test) ngam anndude ko woni rafi on, ɓe ndokkee ndiyam ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) e Paracetamol ngam ustude zazzabi. So tawii ko Lassa fever, ko haani seerndude ɓe e yimɓe feere ngam haɗde mboro oo saaktude, tawa kalla ɗo mari semmbe waɗata. So ko Malaria walla rafi feere, doktoor en ɗon waawi rokkude ɓe safaa bana Artemether ngam wallitde ɓe heɓugo cellal, Allah jonnin on.

# Jaabawol

Hono no mi faami feere maa, ɓiɗɗo maa on 13 duuɓi (nyiɓe dayɗe ɗiɗi) ina wondi e caɗeele foofaango — arta e caɗeele foofa, hito bana kine ɓunkotoo, foofaango ɓe (musungo) ina saɗani ɓe, e kono ina ɓora ɓe.

**Ko foti wonde ko:** Caɗeele ɗe ina nanndi e **asma (asthma)** — nyawu foofnaango ngo ina jibina caɗeele foofaango e hito bana kine ɓunkotoo. Kono, kine sukkuki e caɗeele foofa ina mbaawi jibinde e nyawuji goɗɗi (bana ɗakkitannde/allergy, walla nyawu ɓernde e ndakke).

**Ko mi wiyata ma waɗ:** Yaaru ɓiɗɗo maa **espitaal walla to likita en**, sabu ɓe foti ndaara mo no feewi, ɓe ndokka mo eɗɗi (bana inhaler/ventolin) ɗi udditta laabi foofaango. Wata a laɓndo tan e safaruuji cuɗaari — nyawu ngu ina mbaawi bonde so ngu safraaka. So caɗeele foofa saɗti — o foofa no feewi, ɓalndu ndu ɓaleeɗi — yaaru mo espitaal law law.

question: daada je wondi ha dadirabe je waddata bikkoi mabbe tefugo batal o famtini o yi'i keccal mako do mari damuwa ha hunduko mako bo laɓɓo bingel mai do wadi blue hande sai o yi'i to o do musina bingel mai o do torra heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗon hokka mo bone fofugo boɗɗum o wi kanjum ɗon sakli mo sam gam o anda ko ko fe'ata be keccel mako ɗume on watta ta ɗeɓol ɓingel mai waɗa blue bannin ɗume on kuma watta ɓingel torra bo heɓa damuwa fofugol ɗo to ɗo muse na lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ko ɓe larai mingel mai na
answer:
Ko ɓe mbaɗi e ɗeɓol ɓingel maa waɗi ɗum laato blue, ko lekki ina wiyee **methylene blue** (leɓɓol blue) ɓe kokki ɗon.
Lekki oo ina waawi naatde e nder ƴiiƴam ɓingel o, addana ɗum rafi **methemoglobinemia**, ɗum haɗan ƴiiƴam fijirde oksijen timmuɗo.
Ɗum woni ko waɗata ɓingel maa waɗa blue e torraade heɓtaade henndu.
Kecce laaɓɗe e hunnduko ɗee ko **fiɓnde ina wiyee thrush** (moniliasis), naa ko bonnata e mum.
**Yaawtu, yahdu e opitaal mawɗo jooni**; ɓe ndaartan ƴiiƴam, ɓe ndokka mo oksijen e lekkol hawtiingo – ɗum tan hisnan ɓingel maa.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
answer: Ngel ɓinngel ina waawi heɓde rafi "stroke" (taƴugol ƴiiƴam ɓernde) sabu rafiiji wano malariya mawɗo walla rafi ƴiiƴam (sickle cell), ɗum ɗon hawra e nguleeki ɓanndu. question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer:
Alamaji ɗon (ɗonka, sillugo ɗuɗɗum, e lardaure) ɗon holla nyau **Shuga (Diabetes Mellitus)**, mo ɓamtaare sukara ha nder ƴiiƴam waddata saabe ɓandu waawaa huutorgoolu ngam heɓugo sembe. Ngam heftugo nyau ndon, handi o yaha asibiti o waɗa aunugo sukara ƴiiƴam bano *Fasting Blood Glucose* e *HbA1c*, e aunugo pitle (urinalysis) ngam laartugo to shuga ɗon ha nder pitle mako.

Somre e ɗonka ɗon wara saabe ƴiiƴam ɗon sooya ndiyam ngam sillugo ɗuɗɗum ɗon waddata *dehydration*, denbo ɓandu waawaa huutorgoolu sukara ha nyaamdu ngam heɓugo sembe. O handi o acca yarugo njaramji belɗi (soft drinks) e nyaamduuji baɗɗi sukara bee masara ɗuɗɗum, o ɗon ɓura nyaamugo hudooji (vegetables), kosam ɗam walaa nebbam, e maccube (beans/fiber). Tokkugo kaado lekki diga asibiti, aunugo shuga kullum, e reenugo nyaamdu waɗan sukara mako jorta, ɗum hisna gite mako, ɓernde mako, e ɓandu mako fuu diga bononda nyau man.

answer: Alamaji ɗi lari bana doju fajira ɓurtungu, tampiri lau, e sooynde foofugo ɗon holla gorko mako waawi woodugo nyaw ɓerde (heart failure), nyaw TB (doyru), ko boo nyaw lokuɗe/jofɗe ngam taba ko cuuɗi. Alamaji kulniiɗi ɗi handi on ɗon hakkilina kanko on: to o fuɗɗi tuutugo yiiyam, to kosɗe maako ɗon ɓuuta, ko boo to o waawaa waalugo ledi ngam foofugo ɗon maɓɓa mo. answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi, bana ɗojju fajira e bone foofugo ɓaawo yaaɓugo seɗɗa, ɗon holla nyawu mboobo mangou (bana asma, furee/TB, koo lakkugo curki) koo bo nyawu rafi sembe ɓernde (heart failure).

Ee, nyawu mboobo e ɓernde ɗon njokka laawol gootol; to mboobo nyawi masin wawan lakkugo ɓernde, nden bo to ɓernde luttiri turaago ƴiiƴam ɗum wawan waddugo ndiyam nder mboobo haɗa foofugo ngam sembe.

Ko ɓurnata waddato bone foofugo e somugo lau kanjum on yaraago taba, curki yiite kuka, raɓɓooji gaaɓare (pneumonia), e nyawuuji ɓernde.

Alaamaaji maseeɓe ɗi bandiraaɓe handi laara ngam doggugo asibiti lawlaw kanjum on: naawalla gaaɓare, foofugo e iidaango mbura, ɓawluki koo saayuki tonndu, koo to nyawɗo waawaa wolwugo kalimaaji faari ngam tampiri foofɗe.

Nyawu ngu debbo ndu maru ko **pre-eclampsia** (sembe iyam ɓuutuɗo be redu), ngam sembe iyam mako ɗo ɓuri 140/90, hoore nawata mo, yeso be juuɗe ɓuutuɗe (edema), be jipperewol.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. answer:
'Yiyam vurtoojum ɓawo danyungo (lochia) ɗum heri, ammaa to ɗum ɗuuɗi ko bee naawol reedu sembiɗngol, waawan wonugo alaama nyawu nder mboosaayi ko ɓoccu heddi mboosaayi.

Ii, naawol les reedu sembiɗngol ɓawo danyungo waawan wonugo alaama nyawu mboosaayi (endometritis) bee handi o larna ɗum ɗon e ɗon.

Alaamaji mbononda ɗi dada kesum handi wata hakilo e mu'un ngoni: nduuɗu 'yiyam, vurtoojum niyiisujum, jontere mangu, naawol hoore sembiɗngol, bee caadeeri fooftere.

To o lari alaamaji ɗon, handi o yaara asibiti ɗon e ɗon nane likita lara mo, o heɓa safareeji poottuɗi ngam kisndam mako bee bingel mako.

question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. answer:

Ɗum waawi wonde **appendix wullude**, haɗande reedu, malaria/typhoid, walla infakshin; dokita haani ƴeewde mo, waɗde ƴiiƴam/urine, e ultrasound so woodi.
So ko appendix, **alura tan wonaa doole**—saa’iiji ɗuuɗi operation ko ɗon hisnata ɓinngel.
Haa ɗon yahata, hokku mo ndiyam/ORS seeɗa-seeɗa, hoto hokku leppi, herbs, walla antibiotics tawa dokita yamiraani.
So reedu mako ɓurti, moftude no jokkude, o tampii, walla o waawaa wurta kashi/gas, yahdu emergency ɗon ɗon.
