question: debbo laari gorko maako debbo laari gorko maako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira be do leso mai ni dojjugo nonnon ni fuɗɗata o neeɓa ni bako dara balɗeji o waɗa ni o laari gorko maako o yara bone foofugo to o yaaɓi seɗɗa ni ko o fa'i scal o do dara lorna foofɗe maako nden bo o do yawa soomugo be lau don nyande gorko maako neɓi o do ɗojja be o do haɓda lorna foofɗe ɗami debbo may o fuɗɗi numugo ko ɗon nyawu je waddata damuwaji jango may sai o volwini gorko mako be yaha asibiti ɓe lara likita heba ɓe hefta ko damata on ɗemɗe may ɗume on waɗata ɗuttugo kalnuɗi bannin be yawugo somugo be fofugo dakere ɗo damuwa ɗo wawan ko shafi ɓerɗe na ko yanko shafi ɓerɗe hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko tsarna goɗɗo bone fofugo harje goɗɗo mai handiri dasa hakkilo yauɗiɓe alamaji kalnuɗun je damuwaji fofugo je derdiraɓe handi lara hakkilina je tsugo be fofugo da kerɗum
answer: Alamaji ɗin, hawti e ɗojjugol, bone ɓernde, e soomugo, ɗon holla wonde gorko maako o ɗon mari rafi ɓernde addanoowo ƴiiƴam yottaaki kwakwalwa, waddanta mo ɗojjugol ngol. Ko haani o waɗa jawi ko njiylawu ɓernde (ECG) ngam anndugo no ɓernde maako gollirta, caggal ɗum likita waddan mo safaraaji potuɗi. Ngam ɗuttugo kalnuɗi ɗin, o haani o yara safaraaji maako sahaa fuu, o deeƴa gollal teddungal, nden o reena ɲaamdu moƴƴuru. Alamaji jango ɗi potu-ɗon hakkilana ko: bone ɓernde, dille ɓernde, ŋakkere foofugo, e soomugo ɓurtungo, ɗum fow ɗon holla rafi ɓernde tiiɗuɗo. On waawi lornugo ɗum rewrugo e limtugo ɗoƴƴe maako (pulse) e foofugo maako, nden on nawwa mo asibiti jawi to on nji'i ɗin alamaji.

question: Daada peju, do mari bikkon tati, peju don petel mai . Peju domari dubu gotel. Daada peju mai hirliti bawo palde sedda dai odayi . Peju do mari ye’u dojjugo, kuma tun wakati mai odo ta dojja wala darugo sam . Ovi kuma o hirliti foofugo fu do hokkamo bone.ovi dojjugo do yawanchi do warinamo be kikkide wakati komai fu nasti do naana. Ovi foofugo mako do sadina mo ofoofa boddum. Kam dojjugo do wala acchamo o foofa o vurtina boddum . Ovi oyahi ha yaudiko gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwunimo. So ovi odilli tan oyahi sibiti heba be o hefta ko fedata be peju. Damuwa do waawan hoyina bingel do na? Damuwa berde na ko asma don feddata be bingel do? Kujeji toi don haadi bingel do haadi accha, heba ko damaatamo wadintamo o dojja hoyinnamo, usta sosai?
answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa akwai matsalar fita kofin da yayi (intestinal obstruction) saboda fari da kofin da ke ciki, wanda ke hana abinci da ruwa fita. Dole ne a kai shi asibiti da gaggawa domin a yi musu bincike da kuma kwashe abin da ke hana fita (surgical intervention) idan bukatar hakan ta taso. Ba za a iya barinsa a gida ba saboda yana iya janyo ciwon jiki mai tsanani ko kuma kofin ya fita daga jiki (perforation) wanda zai iya kashe shi. A asibiti, za a ba shi kwararan magungunan ruwa ta hanyar kofin (IV fluids) da kuma magungunan rage radadi kafin a yanke shawara kan hadin gwiwa. Wannan shi ne hanya mafi aminci don kare rayuwarsa tsammani.

question: gorko am dubi mako cabbane nayi den bo mi hirliti sati tati ko sali dum o do fiyi ta yara diyam sosai sosai no yarata diyam mai nonnon o sillata to o yari duddum ma nonnon kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadan de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o do woka fu o do nana jumri kullum bo o don beddi bandu sedda wakkati fere o do fiya o do lara daure o wala lara boddum to o ummi o do wanca mi hirliti o do silla akai akai be duddum bo dume on watata sillugo mere mere do be donka do ko wadi o yarata diyam duddum den bo o do silla duddum ko alamaji do wawan jeyan shuga ko hundeji fere don awnugo toi be goji toi wadata a heba hefta irin yahu toi don do ko wadi o do somi kullum do dume on waddata sellugo akai akai do do sembe inyam mako bamti on waddata yamu do ko diyam bandu mako timmina ko kuje fere don tan irin yiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma dume on handi o dinga yamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji do dey handi noi goji be haunugo je yahu shuga handi wada kullum na koyande go yande go yewtoi don wadata alamaji do je fe'ata ha bandu mako
answer: Alamaji gorko maako ɗin holli ko o don heɓa rafi shuga (Diabetes Mellitus), ngam yargo diyam sosai, ɗonka, e ustaare ɓanndu ko maande mawɗe rafi on. Rafi on wadata to shuga nder yiiyam ɓurti haa ɓanndu waawaa huutoraago ɗum, ɗum saabi o yara diyam duddum, o ɗonka, kuma o nana jumri ngam sembe yaraa nder ɓanndu mako. Ko haani o yaha asibiti kaffake ngam ƴeewndaago shuga nder yiiyam mako (Fasting Blood Sugar) ngam anndugo no rafi on yaari hade fuɗɗugo lekki. To o heɓi shuga, safara mako wadata bee hokkugo mo lekki (hano Metformin), waylitigo nyaamdu, e wadugo kuuje ɓanndu. Shuga naatataa ɓanndu bee yarugo diyam, amma o wadata bee nyaamdu ɓurtundu sukkar, ustaare wadugo kuuje ɓanndu, e kuma irsiya.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer:
Ɓingel ngel no mari maandeeji haɗɗi: sali nyamde/ɗaɓɓude, ɗaɓɓa/ɓandu hollude bone, wala sembe, walla “attack”/jiɓa—ɗum ɗoo ina waɗi ngam yaade hoore mum asibiti jooni.
To “attack” waɗii, waɗɗee ɓingel ngel e wettere, hoto naatnu huunde e hunduko, hoto jogii mo doole; ɗowee mo asibiti.
E asibiti ɓe ƴeewata malaria, sukaru ƴiiƴam, ƴiiƴam seeɗa (anaemia), infection, ruwa ɓandu, giiɗe/ƙwari, walla nyamiri waasde.
Hoto kuutoroo magani gidaaji walla leɗɗe ngam ɗum ina waawi ɓurtinde bone; addanee mo ndiyam/ORS seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi yarude.
So o waɗii fefere mawnde, muta-muta, hawni, waasde nootaade, walla ɓandu ɓiiɓude—ɗum ko gawatire, yaa asibiti tuma ɗon.

question: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam. Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
answer: Debbo ɗo en yimɓe eclampsia, irin batal laawol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Ko min tura asibiti to walli, sabo eclampsia gaaɗa laawol debbo fere kanjum moo fof. Ɗoktoor ɗo wara leppol magnesium sulfate seeda fotti fitte, kala o foti fitte foti. Ko min wadda debbo ɗo oxygen, kala min jaɓɓe sukaabe, kala min leppi fere kanjum moo fof. Waɗɗa debbo ɗo asibiti manga na, kala Ɗoktoor o waddi leppol fere kanjum moo fof.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer: Goonga, ko o siftinii koo ina holla maande nyawu *asthma* hawti e *allergic rhinitis* (guttugol hono jullere/jiiɓru) e ɓanndu julnde. Ngam caɗeele foofaago, o huutoroo lekki piindiraangal *salbutamol inhaler* (bana Ventolin) nde o tampii, kono so o ɗon mari caɗeele balɗe fuu, doktoor waawi winndande mo inhaler goɗngal *beclometasone* (steroid) ngam haɓɓaade ɗum. Ngam jiiɓru jemma, jullere e julde ɓandu, o waawi yarde tablet *cetirizine 10 mg* (bana Zyrtec) jemma gooto, ɗum hisnan ko ɗuuɗi. O ɗaɓɓoo o daɗa ɓulli (dust), ɓoole (smoke), e heendu mawndu ngam ɗe mbaawan wadda tampingol. So tawii ɗum yahraaki, o yah asibiti militina ngam doktoor waɗa jarribooji goɗɗi, sabu e sahaaji goɗɗi caɗeele ɓernde walla nyawuuji ƴiiƴam ɗon saɗtina foofaago.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
answer:
Tawde ɗo e jamma, ɗikkirde kala nde a waɗi tan e saɓo a yaltude ko ɗum mbaawi wonde orthostatic hypotension, koda aɓɓaaji, haɓɓinaaji (anemia), ko masalalla e wulgo e ɓurngal.
Ɓuri moƴƴi, a no feere a waɗu yaltude tati-tati, a nyaamtu ndiyam no feewi, a ɓeydu saare e maɓɓe, tee a waɗu ko yowitaako jam.
To ɗikkirde ɗon no feewi, maa a waɗu test masalalla, hemoglobin (anemia), e seedeji blood pressure nde a tokkude e nde a yaltude.
So aɗa yi’i njamdi, billaaji, ko aɗa fawri ko aɗa tottirta, yah to asibiti ɓe yila e sauri.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
answer: Alamaji ɗi on mbii ɗo ɗon holla nyawu taifo (typhoid) on naati hoore maako, naa metol ɓernde ko nyawu hakkilo. To nyawu man lo'ini ƴiiƴam ɓandu, ɗum saabay neɗɗo sooda nder suudu kadi o acca nyaamugo bee yimɓe. Walaa haaje on yaha wur likitaajo anduɗo nyawuuji ɓernde ko hakkilo ngam o heɓa laawol. Soodee kwayaaji maleriya bee taifo tiiɗuɗi, kadi on ɓedda lekki ƴiiƴam (blood tonic) ngam o yara. Bawo balɗe seɗɗa, ƴiiƴam maako ɗon hebbata, o warta garwanoowo bana no o waawi wakkati fuu.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
answer: Rufugo iyam masin ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage) ɓuri waddata ɗum kanjum on laasol danyugo tayaaki boɗɗum, lura (placenta) heddi nder bandu, koo bo tayugo ɓandu wakkati danyugo. Ngam iyam mai dara be o heɓa sembe, sey o kwanta haa sibiti lawlaw heɓa ɓe lumba mo ndiyam (IV fluids), ɓe ɓesda mo iyam ngam sembe lora, denbo ɓe hokka mo leɗɗe bano *Oxytocin* koo *Misoprostol* ngam taya laasol danyugo. To lura on heddi nder mako, likitajo woggata nder laasol danyugo mai laaɓa, o hokka mo leɗɗe *antibiotics* ngam taa nyau nasta mo. Shawara am haa maɓɓe kanjum on; debbo danyiɗo mai sey nyama nyamdu sembindinndu ɓandu mari *iron* bana kusel, nyebbe, be haakooji ngam iyam mako lora law, denbo o tokka hokkugo ɓingel mako endi wakkati fuu.

question: daada je wondi ha dadirabe je waddata bikkoi mabbe tefugo batal o famtini o yi'i keccal mako do mari damuwa ha hunduko mako bo laɓɓo bingel mai do wadi blue hande sai o yi'i to o do musina bingel mai o do torra heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗon hokka mo bone fofugo boɗɗum o wi kanjum ɗon sakli mo sam gam o anda ko ko fe'ata be keccel mako ɗume on watta ta ɗeɓol ɓingel mai waɗa blue bannin ɗume on kuma watta ɓingel torra bo heɓa damuwa fofugol ɗo to ɗo muse na lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ko ɓe larai mingel mai na
answer:
**Ndaɓɓal ngal ɓinngel:**

Ko woni to ɓinngel maa mari cyanosis (nawgu ha ubbi hunduko e keccel), ɗum tinndina hendu (oxygen) walaa no haani e ƴiiƴam ɓinngel, ɗum foti tinnda ɓaawo ɓernde walla ndoolndoolal ɓalndu.

**Ko foti waɗeede:**

Ɓinngel maa foti yaajaa to hospital walla clinic mawnde law-law, sabu cyanosis (blue) e torra puɗɗugol foti tinndina rafi ɓernde walla puɗɗugol (heart or breathing problem) ɗum saawaani.

**Ko ɓe foti larde:**

Ɓe foti ndaara ɓernde ɓinngel maa (echocardiogram/heart scan), ɓe ƴeewa hendu e ƴiiƴam (oxygen level), e X-ray becce.

**Ndaardi:**

Wota a nennu, yaaru ha hospital mawnde nde tawi wallitorɓe ɓe (specialist ɓernde ɓinngel/pediatric cardiologist) ngoodi, sabu ɗum foti wallude fooyre ɓinngel maa.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Ɗojugo mai amma mi lari accdai joɗugo ha sare to mi dilli be fajira se a warta jego dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala deɓi wakkati yonugo min ɗo yona min nana ko ɗo yecca am woɓɓe. Ɓingel ambi joi on kosam ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi dayi miɗo kosam mi yarni mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗo hokka mo. Nyamduuji kala kala bana gaari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yardi amma fofugo mako dana o fofi ba dan o vowi fofugo ba o wala fufa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat. vidum be hande wakkati o do yiwa mo be fajira sanga o naftiri ndiyam jumjum ha kine mako be haberde mako gam ndamba mai sati fofugo mai fuddi o acci fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acca kuseni. on min naftirta hamaku je acca tabba mai kuma hala fufugo mai je lebbi die waɗata mum kuma min wadata hala fufugo boɗɗum. haɗata mo fufugo.
answer: Alamaaji ɗoja kalluɗi e saɗugo fofugo ɗi ɓingel ma lebbi jowi mari ɗon holla omo heɓi nyawu puf-puf (pneumonia), nguu nyawu ɗon wada masin bo ngu ɗon mbara ɓikkoi pamari. Daccu naftirgo e lekki leɗɗe malla "hamaku" ɗum a wi'i ɗon wada maa, koo law yaaru ɓingel ngel asibiti ngam o heɓa ndiyam poofirɗum (oxygen) e lekki likita. Fuɗɗugo hokkugo ɓingel nyaamdu bana gaari nde o waɗi lebbi tati tan ustani mo sembe ɓanndu; kosam endi tan handi o yara har o heɓa lebbi joweego ngam haɗugo nyawuuji irin ɗi'i. A waawi jokkugo laɓɓingo kine maako e ndiyam ngulɗam seɗɗa ngam weeɗugo fofugo maako, amma yaahugo asibiti jotta-jotta woni ko hisnata yonki maako.

question: mi hakkili miko amperti domo vowi fiji gobe so birabe mako canji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan judo taya sudu mako kullum o acce yauta gobo o wala fala ko vowi hidigo mi hakkili bo komi ninje woni sare o yidai nyamugo be amin odon andi mo woni dar billa ko chomri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata mettol berde on na ko torruko hakkilo on damata mun hertoi min wawata vallugo mun gam seyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko shawara na ko likita mon den yahu jeberde
answer: Mi faami hakkilannde maa. Omo jogii maandeeji nawnaare hakkille (depression) malla rafi ɓanndu baawɗo waɗde ŋanngal e mettinde ɓernde. Wasiya am ko ngaddo mo to opitaal (jeberde) nde min ngoofta ƴeewndo timmungo; so min ndaarii ɓanndu e hakkille makko, min ndokka mo safaara potɗo. Woto kuli, miɗo sikki o waawi moƴƴude so o heɓii ballal jaajngal.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer: Suka on ɗo mari rafi meningitis (nawnaare ɓanndu hore) e rafi ɓeƴƴi (kidneys) sabu maande futugo yeeso e kosɗe, ɗum ɗon hawti e mboros mawɗo haani o ya'a asibiti mawɗo jooni-jooni. O haani o acca yargo leɗɗe gargaaji ɗen fow sabu ɗe ɗon ɓeyda nawnaare redu e ɓusugo, kadi ɗe ɗon halka ɓeƴƴi makko ɗin. Tama e typhoid ɗon halki, amma juɗe ɓeldi e rafi hore ɗon holla wonde ɓanndu hore ɗon nawni, haani dokita en ƴeewa ndiyam ɓanndu hore (lumbar puncture) e ƴiiƴam. Nguleeki hore e huccugo ɗum waɗataa ko haani, o haani o heɓa leɗɗe dokita (antibiotics) e ndiyam nder ɗaɗi ngam hisnugo nguurndam makko gila rafi on ɓeydaaki. Wada mo asibiti laawol ngol wootol ngam o heɓa wallifaare dokita'en nde haani, o acca yargo leɗɗe ɗe anndaaka.

question: mi hakkili miko amperti domo vowi fiji gobe so birabe mako canji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan judo taya sudu mako kullum o acce yauta gobo o wala fala ko vowi hidigo mi hakkili bo komi ninje woni sare o yidai nyamugo be amin odon andi mo woni dar billa ko chomri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata mettol berde on na ko torruko hakkilo on damata mun hertoi min wawata vallugo mun gam seyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko shawara na ko likita mon den yahu jeberde
answer:
Salaamaalaykum, jaabawol maa ko himmuɗi haala kiiɗka.

Alaamaaji ɗi kaalu-ɗaa - accirde fijugo be sobiraaɓe, seedago wakkati ustaade, waacugo yaltugo suudu, ustagol nyamdu, be metteego bernde - ɗum na haani jokku wondude ndaargo tiiɗugo, sabu na wawi wonde alaama depression (naawɗe bernde) walla nammnde woɗɗe.

Ko ɓuri himmude ko: naɓen mo yeeso likita walla wallo bernde (mental health / psychiatrist) ngam ndaartaa laawol feewnugo, sabu ɗum na waawi feewnude no feewi si jaɓaama law.

Suusudi ndaarde: ndaaren tawa alaamaaji kaɗɗe (kaɗugo ƴellitaade koye mun walla nammnago maayde), sabu si ɗum woodi, ko jaggol law haani jibinde.

Yo Allah addu cellal - accu mo yiiya likita ban law, sabu naawɗe bernde na waawi feewneede.

question: inde am mrs akinleye bawo lebbi didi ko sali do mi hirliti ni gorko am fofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam be odo isra akai akai banda ma odo babel sollaji ko habe sa'ata hunde wodo isra akai akai ni bo fofugo daidai o hukka mo bone fofugo mako do wada ta'a be odo isra to odo bebbel curde ko sollaji wodi koji min wadata heba hefta ko wadata dottugo do be isrugo ko jonde ha pellel mari sollaji dow don waddata dum ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe'a irin lekki toi don o naftirta fofugo mako hota dai dai be kuma o wawan o jo da belɗum ko ha uwonifu
answer:
Mrs Akinleye, ɗum ɗoo ko **alamaaru hattannde**: fofugo ɗiɗi lebbi, isrugo/coughing walla tufaade, e waawde ɗaanade no feewi ena waawi wonde **asthma/COPD, ciwon zuciya, TB/pneumonia, walla ñawndu ɓeru/haɓɓere**.
Mi waɗa on yaade **asibiti jooni-jooni** ngam doctor ƴeewta mo: oxygen, BP, ECG, X-ray ɓernde, gwajin jini, e gwajin TB/sputum.
So o heɓii **fofugo tiiɗɗo, ɓernde na metta, huɗo/ɓeɓe na laɓɓi, o waawaa ɗaanade, walla o na fena**, ngal ko emergency—naatnee mo asibiti ɗoon ɗoon.
Hoto on hokku mo lekki “fofugo” walla lekki gargajiya tawa doctor ƴeewtaaki, sabu ena waawi bonnude.
Ɗum noon o ɓeyda ɗaanade dow pillow, o haɗa sigari/alkol, kono **ƴeewtere asibiti ko ɓuri haaƴde**.

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
answer:
Jam, ko a siftii ɗum ina wayi e **caɗeele fofugo**: fofugo yaawngo, ɓernde/ɗaɓɓude ɗo nasta, sauti bana hendu, bonna jemma, e waawde nyaamugo—ɗum ena waawi wonde **asma/bronkiolitis walla nimoniya (pneumonia)**.
**Njaaɗu mo asibiti jooni**, sabu o ena waawi waɗde sokla **oxygen**, nebulizer salbutamol, walla lekki nimoniya caggal ɗe ɓe ƴeewti mo.
Hoto jogii e lekki kemis tan, hoto hokku cough syrup walla ganye; ɗum ena waawi bonnude fofugo mako.
Ɗo laawol, waɗ mo no o jolii, hokkir **njaram/nonno seeɗa-seeɗa**, hoto ɗon tilna nyaamugo, yaltin mo e hayaki, kura, turare, e dabbunde.
To o waawaa yara, leɓɓi mako ɗo ɓuuɓa, o ɗo dogoo, o ɗo henna sossai, walla ɓernde ɗo nasta—**ɗum ko gawat, njaaɗu asibiti ɗoon-ɗoon**.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. answer: Bingel maa woodi kokkombal (abscess) nder daande maako, ko ɗum waɗi o waawata modaago, ɗiyam ɗon worta, o bodi, e gabaki gootel tiiɗo ɓanngii. Nyau ndu’u ina sattina, ina waawi haɗugo peewol so ɗum yahraani opital law. Taa huutoro leɗɗe aada malla sabulu gargajiya, ɗum mettinan ɓingel ngel, ɓeyda nyau ndu’u na halka. Yahru ɓingel ngel ha opital ngam limjo en ndaara, ɓe ɗakita, ɓe kokka lekki haa pus oo woppa. So a leeli, ɓingel ngel waawi maayde.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer: Ɓingel ngel waawaa musuugo boɗɗum, ngel ɗon soma lawlaw ngam foofaango tiiɗungo ɗon haɗa ngel munyugo wakkati ngel ɗon hokka endi. Foofaango yaha dow jippa les bana doggudu bee ɓaandu wulndu ɗon holla alaama nyawu haatari bana pahuumbi (pneumonia) malla nyawu masiinji nder ƴiiƴam, naa ngam ngel musaay tati. Anniya daada ngel yahugo asibiti lawlaw ko huunde woodunde masin, ngam likita'en ɗon haaji lartugo ngel e hokka ngel lekki (antibiotics) malla hendu (oxygen) ngam hisnugo yonki maggel. Alaamaaji haatari ɗi daada e baaba poti hakkilango kofai kanjum woni to ɓingel salake musuugo, ɗon foofa lawlaw bee sembe, ɓaandu ɗon wula, malla ngel ɗon ɗaani masin walaa finka. Nder asibitiiji amin, min ɗon heba nyawuuji irin ɗi'i wakkati fuu, amma to baaba e daada waddi ɓingel lawlaw walaa ɓaawugo, insha Allahu ngel heɓan jam e kisndam.

question:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
answer: Wannan ɓingel dubi jui ne na fofugo (fever) da kuma dambali (malaria). A cikin yanayi na kasashen Afrika, fofugo da janzin jiki gabaɗin fofugo kusa da rumbun dambali ne, wanda ke buƙatar fito nan (antimalarial drugs). Likita yana buƙatar ciṣawa (testing) don tabbatar da wannan cuta, domin wasu cututtukan kamar typhoid ko fofugon saƙo (typhoid) suna nuna alamomin da suka iri. Idan fofugo ya ƙi fita bayan kwanaki biyu, yana nuna cewa cutar ta ƙaru ko kuma akwai cuta ta ƙasa (sepsis) da ke buƙatar magungunan ɗauƙa (antibiotics). Don haka, dole ne likita ya ciṣawa da kuma ba da magungunan da suka dace don hana mutumin ƙarancin rai.

question:
Reedujo wari sibiti kikide do, sai ovi gorko mako do hoolinaamo akai akai be do doofa mo kullum. Ovi do watimo odinga hurtuluggo. Yalaade dumdum to onani gorko mako do warta saare ko to onangan lawol sare, se odo hurtila gam odo daami ta o tappamo ko o huda mo.
O hirliti fuu berde mako do dogga, do fi’ya. O dilli haunugo sembe eyam mako, se tawi do fa’i.
Sai ovi o tori vallinde ha saaro mako be oyechhi be wanni be bayani ko feddata. Kanjum don saare mako hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acchi sam bawo o naftiri.
Oyidi o anda, dume don o wadata heba ta oringa hurlituko sosai do, to odo hota sare ko to o nani gorko mako do warta?
Dume don owadata o lornina hakkilo mako, berde mako waala , jam e hakkilo?
answer: Wannan hali ya nuna cewa gorko mako yana da matsalar "sarkin garkuwa" (immune system) wanda ba zai iya yaki da kwayoyin cuta yadda ya kamata ba. Saboda gorko mako ya dace da kukkide, yana da damar samun cututtuka masu muni ko cututtukan gargajiya cikin sauƙi. Akwai bukatar yin bincike na jini (blood test) don ganin ko akwai matsalar "anemia" ko kuma matsalar jini ta "HIV" ko "Hepatitis" wanda ke raunana garkuwar jiki. Ina ba ku shawarar ya nemi likita don yin gwajin jiki domin ganin yanayin kwayoyin cuta da ke cikin jikinsa. Dole ne ya fara shan magungunan da likita zai ba shi don ƙarfafa garkuwar jikinsa da kuma magance cutar da ke damunsa.

question: debbo mo ɗuɓi caɓɓanɗe tati danyi minti seɗɗa ko saali danyugo may daidai ɗon amma day ɓe danyi ɓingel ɗo ɓingel ɗo ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum ndenbo wala notititta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo danyugo ɓingel may wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone ha finugo ɓandu ɓingel may ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimbano handi ɓingel may wala nyama boɗɗum ɓe torna mo musulungo dada may ɗo sakli ngam ɓikkoiji mako ɓe saali ɗo ɓe ɗo woka ataake to ɓe ɗanyi may ɗume on waɗata damuwa ɗo godi toy ɓe waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki geggewol toy hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo
answer:
Ndenɗam ngam salaare heewnde ha ɓingel wonaa keccel:

Ndenɗam mari sababuuji keewɗi. Sabu ɓurɗo teppude ko debbo ɗuɓi caɓɓanɗe tati saka wari, ɓingel wonaa keccel (premature/preterm), ɗum firti ɓandu mum timmaa mba juuti. Ɓikkon njaltuɗi keccel eeɓe hoore ɓaawaawo, ɗum wonaa haala moƴƴa, kaɓe fooful, e ndogoodu wonaa laaɓndu ha nootittaa. Kadi ɓe potaani ɗaɓɓude ha finugo ɓandu (jaundice/damuu boɗum) ngam heftol ɓe ɓe timmaani.

Feere ndaɗndoore ko: 1) Yaha suudu safaara wamnde (hospital) hakkunde law-law ngam ɓe ndenndina ɓingel e KMC (Kangaroo Mother Care), ɓe muynina ndenɗam ndaneeɗam (colostrum), e ɓe ndaɗndoo baram. 2) Salno tinndinooji ɓaawaawo e njaltingol, tafngo, walla ɗoftaare woɗɗunde nde wonaa ha safaara. Musulungo/salaare ɓe ndogooru walla ndaɗndoo ɓingel keccum ɗum warata mo; ko ɓe ndaɗndora ko yaadu ha safaara law.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
answer:
# Jaabawol

Ndee mballa woodi ko fayti e **ɗojere ɓinngel** (constipation) e bimmuɓe—ɗum wonaa ko heewi caɗeele so tawi wonaa nde ɗon addi cellal boɗɗum.

## Ko poti waɗeede jooni-jooni:

1. **ORS e ndiyam**: Ustir dehugo ndiyam (dehydration) ko sabu maggol; hokku ORS so ɓinngel ɗon musa walla ɗon toonya, sabu ɗum newnan ɗojere e reedu.

2. **Sukkar ɓoccu (glycerin suppository) walla mballa suumugo reedu**: Nde poti wallude ɓinngel ta'ude ko newii; ustu waɗugo lekki dojugo (laxatives) heewi so alaa fotde.

3. **Ƴeewto alaamaaji bonɗi**: So ɓinngel ala nyaamde, ɗon ruttitoo (vomiting), reedu mun ɗon buutɗi (distended abdomen), walla alaa toorde e balɗe ɗiɗi—ɗum waawi wonde caɗeele bernooji (bowel obstruction) haaniri caatorɗe.

4. **Ƴeewto caɗeele jibinaaɗe**: Nde ɗojere fuɗɗi daga jibinngo (since birth) e balɗe sappo e nay, ƴeewto **Hirschsprung's disease** walla ittere anus feewnaani—ɗum haaniri ƴeewndo hakkille (surgical review).

## Ndaɗɗudi:
Miɗo yiɗi wallude on, kono **ɓinngel ɗum foti ƴeewreede e sibiti** (physical examination) hakkunde reedu e ɓoccu, sabu miɗo waawaa hokkude on ceɓal celɗungal e ndiyam nokku, e nder ɗee alaamaaji—ittugo caɗeele bonɗi ɗe foti ittiingal ko himmi.

question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. Emol hado ɗume on waddini debbo redul jodo fiyel berde be lau lau do a viya mo timmini dogugo dembo dume on sanadu uppugo dande do irin nyau do kam wawan mema maunugo bingel redu mako do na dume on alamaji kalludum je be watinta gite hasare ba irin nyamduji ko kuje yare yareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko beddata nyamugo ha irin wakkati do.
answer: Uppugo dande (goiter) bee fiyugo ɓernde debbo joom-reedu man ɗon wara saabe caahu gland thyroid, ɗon ɗuuɗi saabe ŋakeera gishiri iodine walla caahu ɓernde maajum (hyperthyroidism). Nyau ɗo e waawi memugo mawnungo e danyugo ɓigel reedu man (bano ŋakkeera mawnungo ɓandu e hakkilo) to o heɓay lekki law. Alaamaaji kaɗuɗum ɗon mari haaje yahugo asibiti law kanyum on: fiyugo ɓernde haa ɓurti, somaare timmunde, e uppungo yeeso walla kosɗe. O handi o lara likita gam o heɓa sarto, o nyaama nyaamduji mari iodine (bano liyyi e gishiri mari iodine), kadi o acca kujeji yare-yare walla lekkiiji lekki leɗɗe (herbs) ɗi likita yiɗay.

question: rawandu gati bingel banɗan dubi mako jeɗiɗi de rawandu mai gati mo e yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta'i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum a foro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuɗɗi wurtugo namputure bo ɓuti e yecci ɓe yara mo asibiti useni iri kalariroye toy e wannata ɓingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo wutandu gam rawandu may koda rawandu may ɗo dama bo iri sabandi toy hani e wanna ɓingel petel ɗo mandoro wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako
answer:
Eɓe mari haaje yaago asibiti jooni-jooni ngam rawandu naɗɗun waawan saalugo nyau mbarndi rawandu (rabies) ngu walaa lekki to ngattondirɗo fuɗɗi heɓugo maande majum, koo rawandu ndun yi'ake bana ndu sellaani.

Ta'ugo babal ngal e gollal gargajiya ɓesdi caɗeele nyau tetanus (sanka-maral) e mborosaaji (bacteria) goɗɗi, ɗum ɗon addini ɓutol e namputure ɗon ngurtotoo jonta.

Haa asibiti, ɓingel ɗo heɓan lekki tuungon (rabies vaccine) e lekki kaddoojum tetanus ngam hisgo yonki mako bako nyauji ɗin mbarooje puɗɗa.

Kadi, dotooɓe ɓen laɓɓinan babal ngal, ɓe naddina mo lekki kaddotooni mborosaaji (antibiotics) ngam yooringo ɓutol ngol e namputure man.

Useni taa ɓennee saa'i, ngaddannee mo asibiti maa ɓuri ɓadiiɓe jooni-jooni ngam afora koo gollal gargajiya waawaaka hisgo mo haa nyauji barooji ɗi'i.

question: inde am titilola daga keya ɓandu ɓingel am ɗo wuli o ɗo fita diwna ɓingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam ɗo nandama bana dande ɓingel man wuitata wailutuggo wite wore ɓingel man wawata maɓɓutugo ɗumejum on wawata woda zazzaɓi ɗo beko bo haɗata dande mako wailutuggo gwal toi hande mi wanna mo heɓa mi anda sababu zazzaɓi man be ko haɗata dande mako wailutuggo jawabu toi bo ɓe yecce tamen je kowanni darɓan duɓɓingarman je waddata zazzaɓi be kora ta dade mako wailutuggo
answer: Titilola, ko heɓi ɓingel ma bee zazzaɓi e tiiɗgo dande (wala wawa wailitugo) ɗon holla alaamaaji nyau mbaroodi dande e hoore wi'eteeɗum **Meninjitis** (Meningitis). Nyau ɗo ɗon mawniri sanne, kadi to a neeɓni yaago asibiti, ɗum waaway waɗugo sabaabu caɗeele ɗuɗɗe haa hoore mum walla heɓugo maide. Mi ɗon yamure a yaara ɓingel man asibiti ɓurɗo ɓadaade ma hande hande ngam heɓugo kurnol likotoro'en bee lekkiuji caahu (antibiotics) bee jawɗum. Taa kuusa lekkiiji ladde walla jaɓugo lekki goɗɗum haa saare, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓeyda caɗeele nyau man bee jawɗum. Haa asibiti, likotoro'en ɓen ƴeewan ɓingel man booɗɗum kadi ɓe mballa mo bee kurnol laaɓngol ngam hisgo yonki maako.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer: Diga alamaji ɗi limtaa, bana doyru tiiɗndu, foofugo jaawngo malla tiiɗngo, e nguleendi ɓandu, ɗum ɗon hollita debbo oo ɗo mari nyaw *pneumonia* (nyaw mbooy-maasa). Kiri-kiriiji (bacteria) malla virosji ngaddata ndu'u nyaw, ɗi mboowa hebbungo gaduwal e ndiyam, ɗum waɗa foofugo tiiɗa. O haandi o yaaree asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en ndaara mo boɗɗum, ɓe mbata mo hoto gaduwal (X-ray) ngam tabbintingo nyaw man. Likita'en mbindan mo lekki kooɗoyki (antibiotics) ngam mbara kiri-kiriiji ɗin, bee lekki deeltinanki nguleendi ɓandu bana paracetamol. O haandi kadi o foofta boɗɗum, o yara ndiyam ɗuɗɗam ngam ɓandu maako heɓa jam law, foofugo maako warta daidai.

question: Debbo fere kam waddi bingel mako mo dimbi tati asibiti be laramo hande subaka ko be halibo eketo yimɓe olo wani binge on tatata kosam o larata goddo fere mo wolwal tamo heddi inde mako o sota mo damai ha noi masan hingare jungo nyami debbo on cokali on medi hiɓugo badde na mako. O meda himɓe baɗɗe minbedi men cokali heɓi jaɓugo kala batel mum ha tummude ko o fotti noɓugo bana no inna mako waddi redi nyaudugo ɗum min kotoltol laɓii mingew on jarbi bate mako pat feiti. Innde cukali on ingol wala paɗɗe o jaɓi bate pesode mako pat ko dami cu.
answer: Cuccal ngal heɓii tampere ndiyam ɓanndu (severe dehydration) saabe tikkere e rufugo, ngam maajum min kokkay ngel ndiyam nder ɗaɓɓe (IV Ringer's Lactate) jooni-jooni. Nder wakkati o woni asibiti, min mballitay ngel yara ORS e ɓeydaago Zinc ngam wallitugo reedu mako warta. Ɗum waɗi ko saabe cuccal ngal ittaama kosam inna mako, ngel yari kosam feere ndam laaɓaani walla ngel nyaami nyiiamji ɗi ɓanndu mako jaɓaani. Min jannginay inna mako no o heɓirta nyiiamji laaɓɗi, o wotta cuccal ngal e juuɗe laaɓɗe, e no o hokkirta ORS seeɗa-seeɗa. To ngel wurtii, o haani o hokkitay ngel kosam mako walla nyiiamji ɗi ɓanndu mako jaɓi, o faddoo hokkugo ngel kosam nder butel ndam laaɓaani.

answer:
Mi faami sunaare maa fii bingel maa. Ndaa ko foti waɗeede:

**Ko fewti e nyawu bosaru (sofroso/futere):**
- Yaha suudu safaararu (hospital) walla clinic law-law, ngam bingel bee lebbi nayi ko keɓi tan, ɓe potii ndaɗndeede. Nyawu bosaru e ngati kofeta (kofeti/mira) waawi warugo cukalel to a heɓ-a-ho safaara.
- Bingel maa ina foti heɓde antibiotics e ORS (ndiyam fu' e lamɗam) fii mballa ɓe ɓalndu maa hokka ndiyam heewɗam.

**Fii "bosaru" ngati e futere:**
- Hoto woodi jarrdeede ma tinare "bosaru" no naata e futere maa; ɗum ina waawi wonde nyawu ummagol (infection) walla ko woɗɗi. Doktor tan waawi ndaɗndaade ma haala goonga.
- Wata a jaɓ ko yimɓe mbi'i ma waɗ ngam "yaltingol bosaru" – ɗum waawi barmingo ma walla nyawningo ma.

**Ko a foti waɗde jooni:** Yaha law-law suudu safaararu ngam bingel maa e maa on ɗiɗo ndaɗndee. Wata a habbo!

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
answer:
Useni, ko a nanani hakkille maa haa ɓinngel maa. Ko a sifii ɗoo—foofugo bana sautu henɗu (wheezing), ɓernde nasta e lukka, foofɗe nangaade seto o nyami—ko maandeeji **asma** (asthma) walla **bronchiolitis** to ɓinngel famɗuɗo.

**Ko boɗɗum e maccugol:**
- Ɓinngel ɗo hatti yaha sibiti law, ngam maandeeji ɗi (foofɗe nangaade, ɓernde nasta, waylaade nokkuure) ko maandeeji foofugo saɗtingol wonaa ko fewjete e suudu tan.
- To o foofa saɗti no feewi walla ndeer mako naɓɓi baleeje (cyanosis), ndaɗɗudi mawndi—yaa sibiti hankin jotta.

**Nyaamdu:** Woodaa nyaamdu keeriɗndu haɗoowo asma; kono soofto nyaamduuji ɗi hokkata mo allergy (bana kosam, gertooɗe) so tawii ɗum ɓeydi mo.

**Feere:** Likita to sibiti waɗana mo taro (spirometry walla feere foofugo), o hokka **inhaler** (ventolin/salbutamol) haɗoowo foofugo, e feere feere so tawii ko asma. Wata a soodu lekki tan e kemist—ngam ko waɗaali njeñtudi law, foofugo saɗtingol wawi warde ɓinngel.

question: dada fere hakkili layi ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man
answer: A dojju mo ɓeydotoo e jamma, mo ustata so ɓingel ummiima, e foofaare semmbe, ana waawi wonde maande “postnasal drip” (ɗoyre nder kinna) malla asma ɓesngu boyɗe. So dojju ngun foofaare alaa ko boni masin, ndiyam ngulɗam e honnduko ɓingel dow pillow, e hummbe kosam cuɓɗam, ina mballita ustugo dojju ngun. Ammaa so ɓingel ma foowii e semmbe, hakkee fuu, sey ɗaɓɓitee safaara foolɗo ɓutte boyɗe (bronchodilator) to asibiti ngam hisnugo foofaare. Kadi, ɗoyre dojju ko heddiiɗe (nde o dojjata o wurtina ɗoyre deeƴnde) ana waawi hollude rafi-ndiyan-haaɓere (pneumonia), nden ɓingel maa haani laataade e juuɗe cafroowo ngam ɓe ndaara sey ɓe toɗɗira antibiyotik. Ngartam to asibiti ngam ɓe ƴeeuwora mo timma, ɓe ndokka safaaru jowitiingu e sabaabu dojju man.

answer:
# Jaabawol

Ndaa alaamaaji hattaraaji sanne (danger signs) e nde debbo reedu—kanjum woni **abruption placentae** (ka placenta seedtoo e reedu ko adii yontere), walla wonaa dañal jibinannde ko juuti e nawnaare reedu.

## Ko waɗata:

1. **Iyam rufugo sanne be nawɗum reedu**—ɗum ko alaamaaji abruption placentae, ko haɗata heɓɓere e ɓingel be dada, ɗum ko hattara sanne e nguurndam ɗiɗon.

2. **Wallitgo law-law**—dada foti yaadu sibiti mawɗo (referral) law-law, ndaa ɗum foti waɗde operation (caesarean section) walla resugo iyam (blood transfusion).

3. **Lekki**—darnata nawɗum reedu ko wallitgo dada, resugo iyam ka ɓennii, be waɗde operation so ɓingel ina wuuri walla ina maayii e reedu.

**Tinno:** ustu nde tawi dada wonaa sibiti hannde, yaha law—ɗum ko hattara nguurndam maako be ɓingel maako.

Likita ɗon hoola ɓingel ngel sa'a fuu, ɗon lara ɓanndu mako, nden ɗon hokkago mako leɗɗe ha sifa mo haani ngam ngel wurtina sembe.

Kilungo iyam ko ɗume wa nanta mo min hokka mo iyam na ko min hokka mo nyiri.
answer: Debbo man ɗon holla maande ŋakkeende ƴiiƴam (severe anemia) sabu ƴiiƴam maako vurtii, ngam majjum tilay min hokka mo ruwan allura (IV fluids) da yaawe min dilla min hokka mo ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion). Nyiri bee nyamdu wallataa mo da yaawe sabu ɓanndu maako ɗon hawra e ŋakkeende ƴiiƴam ɗon addana mo ŋakkeende sembe bee gite laɓɗo. Ha asibiti, hokkugo ƴiiƴam woni laawol ngol dokotaaɓe kuutirta ngam artirgo ƴiiƴam ɗi o waasi, haa o heɓita sembe o laɓɓina gite maako. Min ɗon kiisa "hemoglobin" maako bee "vital signs" har ƴiiƴam ɗin njaha ha nder maako o warta cellal. Ngam majjum, hokke mo ƴiiƴam bee ruwan allura, nyamdu ndu o nyami wonaa mayre o heɓirta sembe ha nder wakkati seɗɗa.

question: Goɗɗo ɓe nodeta suberu duɓi mako sappan ɗe joyi nyande mum fere o fuddi nyouru arande bo yori ɗum nyadai amma de ɗum fabi asawai je sedda tan yarugo lebbi be hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum hallobi sedda sai ɗum salda rimopde ɗum gonga on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata inde ko nyauru ɗon satai amma. Pat manju ɗum wadai da ha nu o nyaɗita yonru de o hilliti dow o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha nyaudo o yawto o yokki nyaurde o hecci ɓe ɗo jalibi tati ko sali o lori fahin o hecci ɓe o hafti ko o wawata waɗugo bana ko himɓe shawari mo ko larani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum. Ɗo heɓe lekki ɗuɗi ka ko o suɗi da ha nuno o nyaɗita sei nyouru wari tullitti ɗum yottike wakkati fere fu mahe salda roɗi sei o nyami nyautawo on ko waɗi nyoru ɗum neɓuri bana ni salo yamɗetugo o yidi o anda ko waɗi dabare be leɗɗe ɗe o fuɗi fu nafi. oyam ɗume o wannata yoru ɗon yamɗita ɗo fu maru gam o heɓa o fufa no hani olollita jamu bandu makko.
answer: Suka biyeteeɗo Suberu duuɓi 15, nyouru makko neli, fuɗɗi semsimnde bo arti semmbiɗi, sali ummaago e roɗugo, ana holla sanngeeɗe manngo mum ko *malaria* manngu malla *typhoid* na’i waɗi ƴiiƴam. Jonta, woppu leɗɗe gaɗaade ɗee ngam ngalaa semmbe, yahee to asibiti safaara laaɓɗo ɓe ƴeewa ƴiiƴam maa (misaal, RDT malla microscope) ngam anndugo ko waɗi nyouru man. To ko malaria manngu, a heɓan lekki *artesunate* e ɓalndu malla *quanine* e les hakkillo doktoor, nden nyaamdu *ACT* timmuɗum balɗe tati. answer: Sannu Mrs. Akinleye, alamaji ishol bee saɗugo fofugo ɗi gorko ma wondi bee mum, ɗon nufa nyawu asma (asthma) koo bo nyawu poho (COPD) ɗum curde bee sollaji waddata, naa ngam ndottaku ba. question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. answer: Ngam ustaago ɓuuɗi yeeso e ɓandu debbo reeduujo on, o haani o acca yarugo ndiyam faf nden o ɓesda lamɗam ɗuɗɗam nder nyamdu maako ngam o heɓa semmbe. Hokku mo lekki Lasix (Furosemide) ɗuɗɗum ngam ɗum wurtina ndiyam ɓurɗam nder ɓandu maako lawlaw. Ngam naawalla e yangi ɓandu, o haani o hooya lekki Ibuprofen kappe tati nyande fuu haa o heɓa laafiya. Ɗum alamaaji garzini e boodɗi ngam debbo reeduujo, ngam maajum walaa haaje o yaha asibiti koo o ndaara ƴiiƴam maako. Huutugo leɗɗe ɗe'e wallan mo lawlaw nden ɗum semmbiɗina ɓingel ngel nder reedu maako.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer:
Alaamaaji ɗon (musungo seeɗa, ɓandu wulngo, e caɗeele fofungo) na holla nyau mawnungo bana *sepsis* (infection mawnungo) ko *pneumonia* (pankali) ha ɓingel petel.

Fofungo bingel ngel bana ɗon yaha dow e les (chest indrawing) e wongo wala sembe musungo ɗum alaamaaji kulneere mawnunde (*danger signs*) je yiɗi yaadu asibiti jaw-jaw.

Baba e dada ɓiyel ngel poti yaadu asibiti ɓurɗo ɓadaade jooni ngam heɓugo kuugal kiiniɗum bana lekkiiji *antibiotics* e kurgal fofungo (*oxygen*).

Taa ɗon dole mbo o musina bee sembe ngam taa kosam man nasta ha ɓandu fofungo (*aspiration*), ammaa kuuwnee mbo bee durngo seeɗa-seeɗa bee jogaago mbo ha wulngo heyiingo.

Yaadu asibiti tawa ko yawti ɗon haɗa maayde e caɗeele mawnunde ha ɓiyel ngel.

answer:

Dole ɓingel ngel yaaree suudu ndaarngo keccoy (SCBU) ngam ngel heɓa hendu oxygen e safaara nder asibitiiji mawɗi.

Ndilline daada mayru hara o taa o fukka ngel muynugo tukun har ngel warta daidai, ngam heɓtugo ngel lawlaw ɗon haɗa naunugo ngaandi ɓingel may.

question:
Debbo dayi bingel. Bingel mai leuru jew ko saali. Owadi bayani hala bingel mai, ovi wala damuwa do bingel mai wakati odayi mo, bingel mai do musina sosai bana no haadi, bani tan o laari bingel mai do wooka naudum ha juude be kostejimako.
Yotti har mingel mai wooka be bamtamo o ladda, ko o dimba, heba oyotta daada mambe.
Useni dume don dada do wannata bingel do, hoinina naudum ha jude be kosteji bingel do, be da darna mounugo bingel mai? Kanjum daada idi wara sibiti, be bingel mai be laara likita heba be hefta ko be wannata be vallita bandu mingel do, o wonna o jamo.
answer: Debbo on wona anaemia (ɓoyngu damuwa) sabo ɓinngel o viya damuwa dow, kadi o laari wakkati o dal, kadi o wona mo jaango. Anaemia on ɓoyya juuɗe be kosɗeeji maako yotti, kadi ɓinngel woka ɓe ɓamtan, kadi o laada koo o dimba heba. Ko wadi wona anaemia, o wadi yahude likita heɓa ko o wannata ɓinngel ɗo o jamu, kadi o wona sababe (misala: cinde, fibroid, ko jangirde) e o wona laawol (misala: ferro, folic acid, ko damuwa).

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. Lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwini mo sei o vi o dilli tan o yahi a sibiti heɓa ɓe hefta ko fe’ata be petul damuwa ɗo wawan hoina ɓingal ɗo damuwa ɓerde na ko asma ɗon fe’ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toi ɗon handi ɓingel ɗo handi acca heɓa ko. damata mo wadinta mo o dodda ho’ina mo usta sosai.
answer:
Ɗum ko alamaare nde ina waɗi haɗari: ɓinngel duuɓi gootel so ina ho’ina, ina fofira no wuɗɗi/wari, walla ɓernde ina naasti, waɗee mo yaaɓugo sibiti jooni.
Ina waawi wonde asma, amma e ɓikkon ɗiɗi/duuɓi gootel ko bronchiolitis walla pneumonia ɓuri heewde, ɗoktoor kam heɓata ɗum ɗum ka o nani huhu, o ƴeewi oxygen, o hokki nebulizer salbutamol/oxygen walla antibiotics so huhu na fe’ata.
To o waawi ɗaanna, o ɗaɓɓa ɓamtaare, o ɓulɓula, o yiɗaa ɗam/ɓira, walla ɓeɗe mun ngoodi, ɗum ko gawatiri—yaaɓee gawatiri.
Hoto hokkire lekki gargajiya walla lekki ho’ina/cough syrup e ɓinngel ngal, sabu ɗum waawi ɓurɗinde fofugo.
Heɓee mo ɗam/ɓira no heewi, laɓɓinee hunduko/konngol makko, hisnee mo e duɗal, faynugol, sigaaru, ƙura e sanyi.

Moƴƴi timming: haɗuude e yiite (ovulation) ko 12–16 njamaaji kala lewru, kisa jipporde semen 2–3 yume ɗo henndu, haɗuude 2–3 yaha e yontere waɗi.

question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma
answer: Ko ɗum ko sembe iyam ɗe debbo jahroowo woni (preeclampsia), ɗe o ndara ko ɓuuɓri ɓanndu, mette hoore, e mawnugol ƴiiƴam, ɗum noon ko nyawu bonɗu no feewi wonande yumma e ɓiyum. Leɗɗe ɗe o ndokkaa ngam ustude sembe iyam ɗe (jamu redu) ɗe ko ɗe mbaawi addande ko o ñaamata ko yaltata e ƴattooje ɓanndu, ɗum noon ina haani yo o hollite doktoor ko yaawi ngam waylude lekki man. Dowkugol koyɗe walla hoore fof alaa ko nafata ɗum, sabu ɓuuɓri ɓanndu ndi ko caɗe e nder reedu e ƴiiƴam (protein) woni ko addanta ɗum, wonaa ko dowri. Ɗum ko nyawu kaawisɗo no feewi wonande debbo jahroowo, ɗum noon omo haani nawteede to safrirde mawnde oon ñalawma. To safrirde nden, doktoor on maa jokku sembe iyam makko e reende ɓiyum e juuɗe mum.

question: daada peju ɗon mari ɓikkon tati peju ɗon petel may peju ɗon mari duuɓi gotel daada peju may hirliti ɓawo ɓalɗe seɗɗa nde o danyi peju ɗon mari nyawu dojjugo kuma tun wakkati may o ɗo ta ojja wala darugo sam o wi kuma o hirliti fofugo fu ɗo hokka mo bone o wi ɗojjugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be kikkiɗe wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗana o wi fofugo mako ɗo sadinamo o fofata boɗɗum kam ɗojjugo ɗo wala accamo o fofa o wurtina boɗɗum o wi o yahi haa nyawdigo gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwinimo se o wi o dilli tan o yahi asibiti heba ɓe hefta ko fe'ata be pejum damuwa ɗo wawan hoyina ɓingel ɗo na damuwa ɓerde na ko asima ɗon fe'ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toy ɗon hanɗi ɓingel ɗo hanɗi acca heɓa ko damata mo waɗinta mo o ɗojja hoyina mo usta sosai
answer:
**Nde peju maayo ɗon foti waɗde:**

Peju ma ɗon mari ɗemngal nyawu bonngo (asthma) walla nyawu ɓernde/muusu keeci to nde o ɗojjata boɗɗum ummiima ɓawo danygo, ɗum toɓɓe muhimmi buy. Ɗum ina foti wonde:

1. **Ɗojjugo ɓawo danygo** - waɗde tan ɓawo o danyi peju, ina foti wonde nyawu ɓernde walla ɗemngal o fahamta hade o ojja.
2. **Bone ɓawo o hokka mo** - ina foti wonde nyawu keeci walla asthma ɗo huna nde o hokka mo.

**Ko foti waɗde:**
- Nawru mo asibiti **jonta**, hokku ustaz nyawuuji ɓikkon (pediatrician), sabu ɗum ina foti hoolaade ɓernde walla ɗemngal.
- Hokku mo lekki gargajiya tan ɗo **fahamaani** - hoto artu haa nyawdiiɓe gargajiya sabu ɓe waɗi mo kuma o ustaani.
- To o naɓi mo asibiti, ɓe foti waɗde **X-ray ɓalndu**, **echo ɓernde**, e ndaarugol pusru (oxygen).

Ustinaani mo — ndaɗɗi ɗum ina foti wonde huunde muusuru fotnde ɗaɓɓitde saa'a jonta.

question: Bawo mi dayi , bandu am fuddi hoinugo , kikide fere ni minumi, tunde dai en wala diam labdam ha fattude amin, to idi mi yiiwa kullum kullum diam be dotti , minaftirita , mi numii amma fah haadi ni mido hakkilona hore am mido yiiwa boddum. Se mi hirliti eyam je vurtata bawo dayugo don hacchega mi nannata daga ton bo vellai bo. Hacchega mai duudi bo meddai fudugo be am bo. Mi kaasi ittugo gite am daga totton. answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa kwayar cutar datti (diarrhea) da kake da ita tana bukatar kula sosai domin kada ka rasa ƙarfi. Ka fara shan ruwan da aka sa sauran magungin da ke ƙarfafa jiki (ORS) ko kuma ruwan da aka zuba gishiri da suga don kaucewa rashin ruwa a jiki. Idan cutar ta ci gaske, ka nemi likita domin ya ba ka magungin da zai kashe kwayar cutar (antibiotics) idan lallai akwai kwayar cuta. question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
answer:
Alam ɗon ko feere e “anxiety” (tindi e hulgo) wano maa, sabu ko waɗi e saare kala kadi ko feere ko ina haɓɓa sey ko jangirde.
Ɗum si wonaa dooli nanangol “hauka”, amma waɗi no feere waɗa a yiɗi tottude e dogo mum, ko feere ko dokto/likita nafsiyyan ɗo hokki.
Ɗum waɗi no waɗɗo kaɗi a feere no mbaawa: yah to asibiti ko saduuɓe mental health, waɗi baawɗe tuma kala, laawol mawnude, ko waɗi waɗude duba laamu e hurgo.
Ngam faida, waɗi waɗude ndiyam, ndiyam hakkunde, haɗa kofe/shaayi, waɗi ndaarude, ɗum ina waawi wallude.
So gani e yowitaade “shadow” e tingo ɗoɗi ko ɓuri, ko waɗi waɗude magani tawa likita ɗo waɗi, sabu ɗum ina foti a duba sosai.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
answer: Nyau man ɗon anndiraa meningitis (nyawu holluho tildi dekol e nawol hore semmbe), ngonka caɗtuka ɗon wara to ɗum safraaki law. Ɗi kuli pamari ɗe ɗon mburta nder ɓandu makko ɗon holla bakteri naati nder ƴiiƴam, waɗi ɗerewol nder hoore maako ɗon huuɓa. Gorko mon ɗon woodi haaje seɗɗa yahugo asibiti mawngo law law ngam heɓugo enjeksiyon antibiotik nde hisnata yonki makko; woto ɗaɓɓu lekki leɗɗe tan. Debbo, aɗa waawi wallude mo eggaade bannge asibiti, hokku mo ndiyam haa ɓernde, laɓɓina mo, ammaa kuuɗe mawɗe ɗon woni safara anɗaaka. To ɗum saɗti, nodda mota walla mo ɓadi ngam ɓe njaɓɓa mo haa asibiti, sabo koo ɗume himmita.

question: Jam ɓandu likita waddi bingal amin larin no o fofata ɗon woni bana sautu hendu ɗo sala babal petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo dake o fofata milliti bo balɗe tati jotta o ɗo ɗotta be jamma wakkati fere mi ɗo lara ɓe ɗo nasta sosai. Ɗo sosai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako seto o naftira sembe mako o hokkata mi lari bo o wala nyama banani to o nyamai fu sauto nyamai fu sau to o nangi pofɗe mako seto nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokka tame oɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati. Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. To handini hotina heɓa famta ko damata mo be kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum irin nyaundi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha sare hoinina mo heɓa o fofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataki je hosata hado ɓingel ɗo.
answer:
Jam. Mi faami ko a wullitii dow ɓinngel maa: fofto mabo ina saɗti (bana sautu hendu), ina ndoosa, wondude e ronkude ñaamde no moƴƴiri gila balɗe tati.

Ndeen alaamaaji njeewti masiin (wheezing) e cattuɗum foofaango e ronkude ñaamde ina mbaawi wonde **cattuɗum foofaango ɓinngel (bronchiolitis walla asma ɓinngel)**, walla **ñawu jofngo (pneumonia)** ina waawi jibinde ɗum. Ɗum ko caɗeele haani heñaade — sabu ɓiɓɓe famɗuɓe ina mbaawi lohde law si ɓe njeñtinaani foofaango.

Miɗo waawi wallitaade ma so a addii ɓinngel to sibiti law, kono aɗa foti yiɗde ɗum jooni si a yi'ii ɗee alaamaaji: (1) ɓalndu ɓinngel ina wojja walla ina ɓaawɗi (bluish), (2) foofaango yaawii sanne, (3) balɗe/reedu ina ndilla law tuma foofaango, (4) o ronki ñaamde walla yarde haa laaɓi, walla (5) o daroyii walla o waawaa finndinde. **Nde tawnoo alaamaaji ɗii ko heñoraaɗi, addu ɓinngel to sibiti walla to safrooɓe hannde jooni — hoto habbo — sabu o foti heɓde ndaɗɗudi (oxygen), lekki ummorde e ndaɗɗudi, e safaara pneumonia so ina yahdi.**

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer:
Paracetamol ko feewi so tawii a waɗata dose ɗiɗi sai ɗum waɗata jam, a waaw rewa 500 mg ko 1 g kowane awa 6-8, amma hoto ɗo ndiyam haa kaɗai waaw e dume—ndiyam feewi, waɗtu ndiyam banndu banndu.
Hoto 500 ml ndiyam ɗaya ɗum wiindi baɗo, a waaw ɓeydu ndiyam goɗɗo goɗɗo kala sahaa ngam ɗumɓude ndiyam ɗum.
So aɗa waɗi paracetamol ɗum e saama aɗa waɗi ko 4 g (4000 mg) ñalawma, hoto ɗum haɗata; so aɗa waɗi ko e syrub walla alluwol goɗɗo, toɗɗo ɗum ɗoo.
Sababbu malaria, waɗa antimalarial ɗin kamar yadda aka umurta, kuma so feber ɗum waɗi kadi ko ɗum haɗi, walla aɗa waɗi ciɗɗiya, amaana, wulaa, ko ɗum waɗi ndiyam feccere, yah to hospital.
So aɗa welta e jam, waɗɗo hurum, naanaa, e ɓeydu ndiyam; so ko hoto aɗa waɗi fuu aɗa foti, jokkondir e likita.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti
answer:
Ɓanɗu ɓingel ngel ɗo sali ƴiiƴam (hypothermia) ɓaawo nde wuli ina hollira ñawu mawngu ko wayi no neonatal sepsis, ɗum noon ina haani yaawnude yahde opitaal.
Awa haɗee kuutorgol ñawbuje aadaaji ɗe ko wayi no ɓatal (scarification) walla sabulu aadaaji, sabu ɗe mbaawi addande ñawu tetanus e ɓeydude caɗe ɗe ɓingel ngel mari.
E nder opitaal, doktoor en maa ndokk mo leɗɗe (antibiotics) ngam haɗde ñawu nguu, ɓe mbaɗa kaiɗe ko faati e nguleedu ɓanndu makko.
Haa nde aɗa yaha opitaal, ɗaɓɓir woppude ɓingel ngel e nder ɓernde yumma (kangaroo mother care) ngam wallitde nguleedu e muññere ɗoftaare.

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer:
Alamuuji ɗi a limti ɗo, bana ɓaandu wulngo, ɓuuɓri e ɓaandu (bosaru), e salugo nyamdu, ɗon holla ɓingel maaɗa wondi e nyawu bosaru (measles).

Nyawu nguu ɗon naawa masin, kadi nguu waawan addango ɓingel caɗeele manngu bana doggudu reedu, nyawu poofɗe (pneumonia), ko wumre gite to a wadaay sasa.

Danndu ɓingel ngel haa ɓikkon feere ngam taa nguu raaba ɓe, nden yaara ngel asibiti lawlaw ngam ngel heɓa laccuugo.

Haa asibiti, likita hokkan ɓingel maaɗa lekki *Vitamin A* ngam hisnugo gite e semmbiɗingo ɓaandu maagel, hawtaade e lekki ustaago wulngo ɓaandu.

Haa a yotta asibiti, jokku hokkugo ngel ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam, enɗam, e nyamdu ngam ɓaandu maagel heɓa semmbe habda e nyawu ngu.

question: debbo do danyi ha sibiti mai dan labbi jego ko sali o wadi sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi bingel mardo labbi jego mai o wardi be mako jonta dada man wadi bayani du o heriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nayi ko sali o wi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda o wi dojjere man halli on daga ki'a balde tati ko fuddi amma har durti o wi de o musinimo fu odon hokkamo lekki diyam je nder gora je be sorata je do jogo do je o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara o wi daga keya do jogoman turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawan fofa be boddum gidami am sosai bana bofde man do ta'a on do yaha dow do je palace kala wakkati fu be hultiri hanjum wadi be waddi musibiti meden jotta emol am hado hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo be bingel do ha sare na larugo no pofde mako ta'ata be dojjere do min vindina be lekki dojjugo na ko'en wadda goje goje dow bingel man yiddeko min hokkamo lekki ko bate
answer: Bingel man don mari nyaw rai (meningitis) e o musinimo sabu o yari "damba" e ndiyam gora laabataa, ko addi bofde maako yaha dow. O haandi o naatna emergency haa jooni ngam min mballa mo fofa, min tilla lekki gora fu, min hokka mo IV antibiotics (bana Ampicillin e Gentamicin) e IV fluids. Min vindina mo "Lumbar puncture" ngam ƴeewgo ndiyam rai maako (CSF), "Blood culture", e "FBC" ngam min annda no feewi ko woni nyaw man. Min hokkata mo oxygen e lekki ballitooki to o haandi, nden min janngina inna maako wata o hokka bingel damba abada sabu don wadda musibiti. question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer: Ko nyaw gorko mako woni ɗum ina waawi wonde 'Asthma' (asma), ɗum woni nyaw hufgo ngokaddita to o heɓi solaji, kuuje ɓuuɓɗe, walla cuurki. Ngam dandugo mo, o haani o doga solaji e kuuje ɓuuɓɗe, o soka hufgo mako to o yalta, nden o wona nder suudu laaɓundu ndu walaa cuurki. Lekki ɓurki moƴƴugo ngam udditugo hufgo mako ko 'Salbutamol Inhaler' (pomp hufgo), ki o hufata to nyaw ngun fuddi ngam o heɓa jam ɗon e ɗon. Ammaa, tilay o yaha asibital ngam likita ndaara mo, hokka mo lekki 'preventer inhaler' ki o hufata kullum ngam tiiɗingo hufgo mako. To o naftiri lekki ki haa laawol, o wawan o jooɗa belɗum, o hufa daidai bana no o haaniri fu.

answer: Anniya dada ɓingel wargo sibiti lawlaw woni kuugal ngal ɓuri wooɗugo, ngam naawalla kosteji e juɗe haa ɓingel lewru jowi ɗon holla alaama nyawu 'sickle cell' malla nyawu mboowu (infection) nder i'e mako. Ha wakkati ɗo, ƴii'yam danyaaɗum ɗon wayla nder ɓandu ɓingel, ngam maajum to ɓingel woodi 'sickle cell', juɗe e kosɗe ɗon fuufa (hand-foot syndrome), ɗum naawa masin wakkati ɓe ɓamta mo. Bako on yotta sibiti, dada hokka mo magani hoynugo naawalla bana 'Paracetamol drop', bo taa ɓe dirba (massage) juɗe e kosɗe man ngam taa naawalla man ɓesda. question:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
answer: Wannan ɓingel da ya sa kalar kanta ta cança kuma ya yi kofin nesa da kofin jiki (fatigue) yana nuna cewa akwai matsalar jikin da ta shafi jini ko kwayar kashi. A yankinmu, wannan na iya zama alamun cutar malaria ko kuma matsalar jini (anemia) da ke sa jiki ya zama maras karfin. Dole ne ya ziyarci asibiti don a yi masa gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) don ganin adadin kwayar kashin da kuma duba ko akwai kwayar cuta. Idan aka gano matsalar jini, likita zai ba shi abinci mai dauke da ƙarfin jini da kuma maganin da zai gyara cutar da ke damunsa. Kar ya yi amfani da magungunan gargajiya ba tare da ganin likita ba, domin hakan na iya kara masa hadari.

question: Mini amodai we'e anɓɓa he jo jonamo o warti wuro o wulla, kominma ko fetiyam bosaru ha kosɗe mako me kala bo saru on toi ɗum ɗuroi koɗum bosaru kindiraɓe on wakkati nden meban ha balbe bo salun nga timmo ngam ɗum warake bo saru. mi yarama asibiti danyu dare kindira bate den tan mi yaha mi soda ha kemis mi sodi bata on ɗum tufuma ɗum kenya illa wakkati den mi yarima wuro amma lake man umti nokkure nanwoji jotta kam hakkila ammi hemi tammi bo sare ɗon hokki ɓingel nyamdu bo sare. mido nyama wodi lekki combiti larugo ko mo.
answer: Ɓuuɓri ndii wonande e nder reedu, haa teeŋti e juuɗe e koyɗe, nde wondude e ƴiiƴam toowɗam (BP), ina hollira caɗeele mawɗe biyeteeɗe preeclampsia, ɗe mbaawi warde yumma e ɓingel. Kuutoragol lekki wuro ko wayi no "combiti larugo" ko weeɓnaani e nder reedu, sabu ina waawi bonnude ɓingel walla addude jibineede ko yaawi. Alaa e sango o yah to asibitee jooni ngam ƴeewde ƴiiƴam makko e ƴeewndo urine, tawa o jokkii e ƴettude lekki asibitee ɗii o woppaaki lekki wuro ɗii. Woppude lekki asibitee ɗii ko bonnata cellal maɓɓe, tee ina waawi addude caɗeele wuyɗe ɗe mbaawataa fiyde. Laawol gootol tan ngam hisnude nguurndam maɓɓe ko huutoraade safaara laaɓɗo e les njiimaandi doktoor haa reedu nduu yaltu.

Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
answer: Wannan ɗan ƙarfin ciwon jiki ne (anemia) wanda ya kawo ƙarfin haƙuri da ƙarfin jiki (fatigue), domin ba jiki ba ya samun ƙarfin ƙarfi saboda ƙarfin jiki da ba ya isa. Akwai yiwuwar ɗan ƙarfin ciwon jiki ya fito daga ƙarfin jiki da ba ya isa (iron deficiency) ko kuma ɗan ƙarfin ciwon jiki na ɗan ƙarfin jiki da ba ya isa (sickle cell anemia) wanda ya fi yawa a yankinmu. Ina ba da shawarar a yi gwajin jini don sanin ƙarfin jiki da ba ya isa da kuma yiwuwar ɗan ƙarfin ciwon jiki na ɗan ƙarfin jiki da ba ya isa. Idan ɗan ƙarfin ciwon jiki na ɗan ƙarfin jiki da ba ya isa ne, ya kamata ɗan ƙarfin ciwon jiki da ba ya isa ya ci abinci mai ƙarfin jiki da ba ya isa (iron-rich food) da kuma kiyaye lafiyar jiki. Dole ne ya ga likita don samun maganin da ya dace da yanayin jikinsa don hana ciwon jiki da ba ya isa

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
answer:
To debbo reedu nyama sare bee doro, o hani o yara ndiyam masin bee gabaaji bana ORS (lamdam bee sukor) gam o lora o hokka bandu mako ndiyam.

O hani o nyama nyamdu koydum beldum diggugo bana nyiri diggundi, kosam, walla ndiyam maaro, ammaa o nyama petel petel.

O acca nyamdu mardum nebam walla daddum bee sukor masin gam banni fottata sare man.

To sare man luti kadi bee lau, o yaha sudu nyawnduki (asibiti) gam hebugo dandiya foti mako bee boofngu mako.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer:
Tari mo waɗata ɓingel jemma haa lewruuji/ɗum ɓurii, seriyaaji, wonaa huunde nde a fotata ɗaɓɓude lekki galle tan; ena waawi wonde asma/allergy, mura ɗo yaltina ruwa e hondu, reflux, pneumonia, TB walla tari-wuumi.
Yah e asibiti/likita ngam a yiya fuffugo mako, a ɗonɗa kirji, a waɗa bincike tawa ko haaju—ko ɓuri si ɓingel ko tokooso walla o ɗo fufa.
E galle: hoto hokku “defadira” walla sirop tari tawa likita yamiraani; hokku nono/ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa, waɗu o ɗaani hoore ɓamnde, woɗɗit sigareeti, ƙura, turare, ɗumare, tee a laɓɓina hondu mako da saline drops.
Si o ɓurii hitaande 1, zuma seeɗa waawi wallude tari jemma; amma si o famɗii hitaande 1, hoto hokku zuma.
Si o ɗo fufa no sattii, fuffugo ɗo sattini/wawan naati kirji, wulngo, o sala nono/nyamde, o ɗo ɗoyɗi, ɓamde, laɓɓi ɗiƴam, walla tari ɗo ɓeydude—yah asibiti jooni.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer:
Ko hebi ɓiyel maaɗa ɗon woni **"febrile convulsion"** (dimbugo ɓandu ngam zazzabi mawnungo), nden ɓurna fu malaria ko goɗɗum nawdum ha nder ɓandu addata ɗum ha ɓayri bibbe tokoɓe.

To ɗum ɗon waɗa, waalinu ɓiyel man ha mbeɗu mum (recovery position) ngam ta o njaara jillu mum, nden kadi ta nastinu ko woni fuu ha hunduko mako. Pampoo ɓandu mako e ndiyam mbuldam seɗɗa (lukewarm water) ngam jippingo zazzabi man, ammaa ta loofugo mo ndiyam peewɗam masin.

Ko dimbugo man hitti, yahdu e mako asibiti lawlaw ngam likitoci larta sabaabu zazzabi man (hano malaria) mbe mballa mo bee lekki laaɓki.

question:

Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda.
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu.
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden.
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
answer: Debbo ɗo wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego, ko waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.

Don yedde je o yahi sibiti, be odo volla be daadiraabe fere, sai o Nani ta be hosa mere kala hundeji be lari fu fedata ha bandu mappe. Kanjum waddi mo odi olaara likita ovolwina be.

answer: Wannan yanayi ya nuna cewa akwai matsalar jini ko kuma matsalar zuciya da ke sa jini ya ki tafiya yadda ya kamata a cikin jini. Yana da kyau a je asibiti domin a yi gwajin jini (CBC) da kuma gwajin zuciya don tabbatar da dalilin wannan kumburin da ciwon kai. Idan akwai matsalar jini, za a ba da magungunan karfafa jini da kuma abinci mai dauke da sinadarin ƙarfin jini. Idan kuma matsalar zuciya ce, za a ba da magungunan rage hawan jini da kuma magungunan da za su kara daidaita gudun zuciya. Kada a bari matsalar ta tsawaita, domin ganin cikakken ciwon jiki da kumburi na bukatar kulawar likita kai tsaye domin kare rayuwa.

question: debbo fere mo duɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti balɗe tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hanɗe waɗugo diga kafi ɓikkoi keccon de o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musungo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko seɗɗa po ɗanan tan o vi ɓingel man wala joga en ɗi nden bo ko dey jungo mako kosɗe be ɓandu mako pat ɗo fewi delem har ɗo hulna mo to o memi ɓingel man be jungo mako har ndikka o hosa mo ha nder saɓɓode o hakkilini ɓingel man saali en ɗi ɓandu mako ɗo fewi to ɓe memi nden bo ɓandu man ɗo ɓedda watugo har o wala wawa ɓamta jungo mako forta kosɗe bo o wala dimba sam o ɗo wali babal gotel tan to a lari ɓingel man ni o ɗo yonti bo nyaugel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗume on a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoy keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko ngam o sali musungo on tan ko ngam ɗume on ɗume min wawata waɗugo hala salari kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga kafi handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma hado man
answer:
Alaamaji ɓingel ngel, bana salugo musinugo, walaa sembe, be ɓandu fewugo delem, ɗon holla nyawu mbuuɓri cattuɗum (neonatal sepsis) ɗon nder ƴiiƴam maagel.

Ɓandu fewugo e rafi dimbugo wonaa ngam salugo musinugo tan, ammaa ngam nyawu ngun ɗon usta nguleeki e suukar nder ɓandu (hypoglycemia), ɗum bo ɓillaaji cattuɗi ɗi wannginta mayde lawlaw.

Taa waɗan ɓingel ngel riga-kafi (vaccine) hanɗe faf, ngam asibiti jaɓata riga-kafi sey to ɓingel walaa nyawu, ɗon jam.

Shawara am lawlaw, daada waɗa ɓingel ngel e ɓandu muɗum haa gaba (Kangaroo Mother Care) ngam ngel wula, nden on nawa ngel haa likita'en ɓikkon keccon lawlaw taa ngel maaya.

Ɓingel ngel ɗon haaji kwantugo asibiti jooni-jooni ngam heɓugo leɗɗe *antibiotics* e ndiyam suukar nder ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) ngam mbarmugo nyawu ngun e hisnugo yonki maagel.
