question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma
answer: Oɗo debbo reeduujo ɗo mari nyawu ƴawoore ƴiiƴam mawndi nder reedu (Severe Preeclampsia), ngam hoore naawande, ɓuutol ɓandu, be gite daurɗe ɗe o yi'ata. Nyawu ngun ɗo holla ƴawoore ƴiiƴam ɗon tora ɓandu be ngaandi mako, ɗum bo wawan waddigo faddere (eclampsia) haa debbo to ɓe reenay. O haani o jooɗa haa asibiti lawlaw ngam ɓe auna ndiyam cille mako, be hokkugo mo lekki bammbiiji (Magnesium Sulfate) ngam haɗugo faddere nden. Magani nyawu ngun timmi ko rimmbugo cukkayel ngel, ngam maajum likito'en haani ɓe kakkilana mo sosaay koo ɓe seeka mo (CS) to wakkati rimmbugo yottake ngam hisnugo mo be ɓingel ngel. O haani o fowta boɗɗum, o acca miilooji mettooji ɓernde, nden o tokka yarugo lekki ƴawoore ƴiiƴam ɗi likito'en hokki mo.

question: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon nde o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musongo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko sedda bo o nan o vi ɓingel man. dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en di bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawata waɗugo hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man.
answer:
Ɗum wonaa ko ɓinngel keso waɗata no feewi; ɓinngel mo sala muusungo, wala sembe, juuɗe/koyɗe ɓe ɓuuɓi, walla ɓandu mako ɗo ɗaɗi/ɗikka si memaa mo, ɗum ko **alamaji haɗari**.
Ina waawi wonde **ciwon jini/sepsis**, **sukari ɗiɗɗo haa jinna**, **ɗoɓɓere ɓandu**, walla **tetanus ɓinngel keso**, waɗi ko ɗum waɗi o sali muusungo.
Shawara am: **ndeeɗon mo law haa asibiti/SCBU yanzu**, haa likita en ƴeewta mo, ɓe waɗa zafi, sukari, oxygen, allura antibiotics, ko magani ɗiɗɗa spasms/tetanus so ɗum ne.
Haa on yotta, **ɗaɓɓitinee mo haa ɗumɗum**, ɗon ndippina mo e daaka hakkunde rewɓe, kono **hotoon hokkugo kosam force** so o waawaa muusde walla o ɗo ɗikka.
Rigakafi no waawi ɗon caggal nde ɓinngel stabilise, amma jooni ko **cetugol heɓugo ɗawgol gorko** tawata gila ɗum ko emergency.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji haɗari e reedu: ƴuɓɓude koyɗe/juuɗe/ yeeso, sembe ŋakki, walaa nyamde no feewi, maa woni BP ɗuuɗi (pre-eclampsia) walla ɗiɗiƴam ŋakki (anaemia).
Haani o yahaa asibiti/ANC jooni-jooti ngam aawde BP, ndiyam jandu (protein), Hb, malaria, e ƴeewtere reedu; woto o huutoro lekki gidaaji walla ganyen gargajiya.
O nyam nyamdu moƴƴu: tuwo/ruɓɓe, kossam, kifi/nyama/ƙwai, wake, ganye, ɓurdi; o yara ndiyam, o ɗuɓɓina lemun ɗanɗi/salt ɗuuɗi.
O jokkondir iron-folate, malaria prevention (SP) e allurar tetanus ɗum ɗoctor/ANC hokki ɗum tan.
So o heɓii hoore mettuɗo, yiitere ŋakki, nyiiɓe reedu metta, ƴiiƴam, ɓiɗɗo waɗataa motsude, walla konvulshon—ɗum ko gaggawa, yahaa asibiti sam-sam.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
answer:
Fofugo bee caɗeele e ɗojjuru ɓiŋgel petel ina waawi saabeere mum wona peewri (pneumonia) ko jorre yaasi feere.

Ɗum alaama caɗeele mardo haaje yaago asibiti ɗon ɗon ngam hisnugo ɓiŋgel man.

Yaaru ɓiŋgel man suudu lekki jawɗum ngam heɓugo kuutorɗe e lekki caahuɗum.

Ta hokka mo lekki ko a anndaa, jogu mo e nokkuure wuldunde, den bo jokku hoddungo mo kosam enndu.

answer: Ɓingel ngel jaangol weendu tan naawi ngel, ɗum waɗi ngel tampi ngel sali musinngo, amma walaa ko njanndi. Ngam ɓandu ngel wula, lootiree ngel nder ndiyam gulɗam masin lawlaw, nden mboolee ngel nder bargooji tekkuɗi. Ɓaawo ɗon, yaaree ngel wuro ngel ɗaana deƴƴere haa ngel fina hoore maagel ngam ngel musina.

question: mi debbo ɓanginga on duuɓi am 35 useni mi ɗo mari ɓingel am lebbi joi on lari mi ammugo mi hoti kugal ko helɗi mi am nyalɗe tati saali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗojja sosai min godi koɗume je darnata dojjugo mai amma mi lari accai mi duɗai joɗugo hasari to mi dilli be fajira sai asira mi wartata jego'o dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala da mi heɓi wakkati ɗonugo miɗo ɗona mi nana ko o ɗo yojja kuma ɓe ɗo yecca am o ɗo ja ɓingel am lebbi joi on o acci yarugo kosam tun ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi ɗayi mi ɗo kosam mi yarai mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗon hokka mo nyamduji kala kala bana gari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yalɗini am tun kenya jamma fofugo mako ɗo dana o fofoi ba dana o vowi fofugo ba o wala fofa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat dada am biɗɗum be hande wakkati o ɗon yiɗa mo be fajira seɗɗa o naftiri diyam jum jum hakkine mako be haɓarde mako gam damba mai sati fofugo mai fuɗɗi o acceti fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acceyai mo useni mdm dime'on min naftirta har mako jey acceh ta damba mai kuma hala fofugo mai jey lebbi dime mi wadata dime mi naftirta mo kuma dime mi wadata hala fofugo bodum do hadata mo fofugo
answer:
Useni, mi faami ko a haɓori. Ɓingel maa ngel lebbi joyi ɓe hollirta maalaaji laaɓɗi ɗi njiɗ-ɗaa fewnude: fofugo saɗti, foofaango ceɓɓinaango, e battane damba (sukkere hunuko). Ɗum e waawi wonde alaama sella-ngal ɓernde walla ɓoccooɗi (bana pneumonia walla bronchiolitis), ngal foti yaawnaade sabu ɓingel keeɗel waawaa haɓaade sella yaawii.

**Ko poti waɗeede jooni jooni:** Yaha suudu safaara (clinic/hospital) law-law, sabu foofaango saɗtungo e sukkere hunuko ko maale hulɓiniiɗe wonande ɓingel tokoson. Ɓe mbaawi ɗaɓɓitude ɓingel ɓoccooɗi, hokka mo lekki (bana antibiotics si wonii sella ɓoccooɗi), e wallude mo foofaade no moƴƴiri.

Wonande kosam: jokku hokkugo mo kosam maa sabu ɗum ko ñaamdu maako moƴƴuru wondude e diyam, kono taƴ-taƴ e law naftinaa mo cafirdu.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer:
Mi faami ko mballa. Ndaa ɗum ko debbo je heɓi tampere e ɓalndu, ɗo woni yendu, damuwa be ɓernde ɗo doola, e endiije ɗo muusa jemma. Ɗum foti wonde ko **anemia** (ɗiiɗe ndiyam ɓaleeje ustaade), ko wooda geɗe keewɗe: mala ko ɓaawo esugol suuka (postpartum anemia), mala malaria, mala ustaare ñaametee (iron/vitamin deficiency), walla mala ñawu ɓernde walla deftorde (thyroid/hormonal).

Ko moƴƴi ɗo wonaa woɗɓe hakkille tan—o yaha safirde ndeen ɓe njiɗi **ɗiiɗe** (blood count/PCV), ɓe ndaara malaria, ɓe ndaara ndiyam, ɓe ndaara ɓernde e endiije mako. So anemia woni, ina moƴƴi o ñaama ñaametee moƴƴo (kolce, teew, ɓoccooɗe) e o defta lekkeeji ferro (iron) e folic acid. So ɗum sabu ñawu goɗɗo (malaria walla infekison), ɗum ma safre haa mo yiɗi.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi kaal-ɗaa ɗo ɗon holla bana mborodi **"pre-eclampsia"** (ɓeydaari sembe-iyee haa debbo jom reedu).

To ɗum laaraaka e asibiti ko yaaji, ɗum waawan addugo masiibooji bana **"eclampsia"** (gii-iɗe), halkugo ɓiɗɗo, walla maayde debbo jom reedu on.

Sey o jokko yardugo lekkiiji sembe-iyee ɗi o nelanoo, e o yaada asibiti ngam laartugo yahdu reedu ndu kaddib.

O siuta boɗɗum, o ustoo nyamugo lamɗam, e o danyitina torra ɓanndu fuu.

To o yi'i alaamaaji masiibo bana larnaago gite, nawugo hoore ɓennunge, koo ustugo dille ɓiɗɗo, sey o dogga asibiti law ngam danyugo woni safaare mawnde haa mborodi ɗon.

To o ɗo fofa yaasi, kirji mako ɗo naata, o ɗo waɗi nguleendi, o ɗo sonnda, o ɗo wulaa yarugo/nyamugo, walla leɓɓe mako ɗo wayla bulu—ko gila doole asibiti.
Alaa sirop hossugo/cough mixture, antibiotic, walla “cold medicine” ko hokketee ɓingel ngal duuɓi ngal haa doctor yi’i; ko waawi wallitde ko saline drops e ɗaɗi, huutora aspirator seɗɗa, ɗow mo seɗɗa, tee hokkude kosam ɗuuɗum.

Nyamduji bana gari e diyam ɗuuɗum ko ɓuri moɗɗude a sabbo haa lebbi 6, ngam e waawi addude ciwon ciki, infection, e yahrude kosam.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
answer:
Mi yiɗi anndinde ma wonde ndee toranki ina holla alaamaaji tiiɗuɗi to bannge miijo (ruuhu). Ɓee alaamaaji—ronkude ɗaanaade, ronkude ñaamde, sunaare mawnde, faalaade waɗde ko boni e neɗɗo maa e hoore mun, e miijaaji bonɗi—ina holla wonde debbo oo alaa e nder cellal to bannge hakkille (depression) walla ina foti waɗde caɗeele goɗɗe mawɗe.

Ɗum wonaa ko heɓantee e cafrgo cebe walla to nokkuuji ceniiɗi tan; ina waɗɗii yaarude mo asibiti to woni likita to bannge nawnaare miijo (mental health/psychiatry) hakkeere ko yaawi. Ina himmi kadi hisnude mo, sabu neɗɗo mo alaamaaji ɗii ina waawi hara ina fooɗa hoore mun—wonaa yeewtude tan, kaɗ mo heɓde ko waɗiraa hoore mun walla goɗɗo.

Ustu dille e hakkille juuɗe, huɓɓin mo e giggol e hakkillanteeku, hokku mo lekki fewndo (safaara depression) so likita hokkii, ndaaru mo no feewi haa nootto. Sabu ceenal (support) e cafrgu wonanii, ɓee ñabbuuli ina cellina to bannge Alla.

question: Ɓawo mi dayi bandu am fuɗɗi hoinugo kirinni min dadai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam ha fattude en yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum ndiyam be dotti min naftirta min ma fa. Hakina hore amin ɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigi fere bo wari min nana belɗum ɓandu amin fuɗɗi nanugo jagol be bandu am fuɗɗi dimugo kulum nda min ɗo nana jangol bo hauti be bandu amlai fahin semiti iyam je vurtata bawo dayugo. haccenga min nanata daga totton bo valai bo haccega mai dudi bo medai fedugo be am mi kasitugo giteam daga totton de mi ummi sei don mi yahi sibiti mi’ama ko diyam laɓɗam je min naftirta mi yiwa be mai kanjum. waddata kala wodago.
answer: Ɗuum ko cilol mette mawɗe ɓaawo jibingol, ko wayi no sepsis (ɓuuɓri nder ƴiiƴam), malaria, walla ɓernde mettu, sabu aɗa woya ƴiiƴam e ɓernde maa. Ɓanndu maa semteede e ƴiiƴam danyugo (anemia) ina ɓeyda caɗeele cellal maa. Ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam ɗam aɗa naftora e hoore maa waawi addande ɓuuɓri goɗɗo, kono ko mette ɗee mawɗe njaltata e nder ƴiiƴam. Aɗa haani yahde sibiti safaa e yaawre ngam ƴeewndo ƴiiƴam, heɓde leɗɗe ɓuuɓri (antibiotics), leɗɗe malaria, e rokkeede ƴiiƴam so ina haani. Kadi, ƴeew ndiyam ɗam ɓuuyna hade maa fattude, ñaam geɗe ɗe mballirta cellal, tawa ko ɗee mette poti ñifde ko leɗɗe sibiti tan.

question: jabore dum mo dum e safa neto teteti mo diri di lebbiji di'i ke dure makowai nga dimo nyawu do be am mi dai wi'i reduma fana mo dum dum e wi'i enko e wuti leya samako e o inna e o woya ngawna en bon kodi sembe mako sawa en makko biben sara en makko bi e don kodi tawi mutawa dada ko mungel dun yamde arandere de nyauto yami nyamde diga beren dume hani wadi gobela wo hade borede wojo on nyamre teta wure dume hanira bute go hefta nyamdun damreno yauren ero nde kikiya hani nyamderemo damrejo yauren ero nyamden di'a owadato bebo ero gendam dayayya hani of ujira
answer:
Njaɓɓaali. Ndaɗɗi laɓɓa ko lamndal ngal, kono mi eggan e majjum:

Ɓinngel ngel woni e nyawu e reedu (ngawna/dogudi reedu) kanngel duumii lebbi ɗiɗi, ngel ronki nyaamde no moƴƴiri, ngel ustii semmbe. Ɗum e waawi wonde diarrhée duumtiindu e malnutrition, ɗum ɗon wadda hoolde jiiɓol (dehydration) mbo hulɓinii.

**Ko foti waɗeede:**
- Yaru ngel ndiyam ORS (nasannde jiiɓol) e Zinc lebbi ɗiɗi, ngel jokkina muynugol (breastfeeding) so ngel muynatoo.
- Fewndo ngel yiɗi nyaamde, hokku ngel nyaamdu laɓɓundu, wutuundu, no gari, koko, e nyaamduuji jom protein wano gawri.
- **Kono si tawii ngel ronkii yaru walla nyaamde, ngel yoora, gite mum liwii, walla ngel ustii semmbe no feewi — nawee ngel yaawnde to safrirde/hospital ɓoyri.** Ɗum e waawi wonde ngel hatonjinii ndiyam e ɓalndu (IV fluids) e ceenugol.

Woɗɗitaade safrirde ɗon hulɓinii; nawu ngel to lokaco ngasa.

question: ɓawo mi danyi ɓandu am fuɗɗi hoynugo kikiɗe fere ni mi numi tunda dai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam hafa to de am to mi yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum diyam ɓeddoti mi naftirta mi numi am hafa handi ni ɓiɗo hakkina hore am miɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigide fere bo wari mi nanai belɗum ɓandu am mi fuɗɗi nanugo jahagol be ɓandu am fuɗɗi diwunugo kullum kullum da miɗo nana jagol bo hauti be ɓandu am belɗum feyin semi hirliti iyam jey vurtata ɓawo daigo ɗon haccega minanata daga totton bo velai bo haccega mayi ɗuɗi bo meɗai feɗugo beyam mikasi ittugo gite am daga totton demi ummi sai ɗon miyahi sibiti mi'ema ko ndiyam labɗam jemi naftirta miyiwa bemai kamjum on wadda takalayam bawo daygo
answer: Ndiyam laɓɗam ɗam naftirataa waddude takalayam, sabu ƴiiyam daygo ɗam yahaayi ɗon wadda mbarjaari (anemia) e rafi nder ɓernde. Hore diwugo nde ummataa darii, diwunugo, e jahagol ɓandu ɗon holla wonde ƴiiyam ma ɗon ŋakka sanne sabu ƴiiyam yahaago ɗam. A haani yaawugo yahugo asibiti hannde ngam ɗakkugo ƴiiyam ma, heɓugo maganin ƴiiyam (iron), e maganin kasu (antibiotics) to rafi woodi. Nyaamu nyamdu jeewndu ƴiiyam hano haako, gawri, e teewu ngam wallitugo ɓandu ma heɓtugo semmbe. Wata a numu ndiyam ɗam waddi rafi, yaawu heɓugo ballal safara ngam ƴiiyam ma ɗon yaha ɓurti ko haani.

question: jabore dum mo dum e safa neto teteti mo diri di lebbiji di'i ke dure makowai nga dimo nyawu do be am mi dai wi'i reduma fana mo dum dum e wi'i enko e wuti leya samako e o inna e o woya ngawna en bon kodi sembe mako sawa en makko biben sara en makko bi e don kodi tawi mutawa dada ko mungel dun yamde arandere de nyauto yami nyamde diga beren dume hani wadi gobela wo hade borede wojo on nyamre teta wure dume hanira bute go hefta nyamdun damreno yauren ero nde kikiya hani nyamderemo damrejo yauren ero nyamden di'a owadato bebo ero gendam dayayya hani of ujira
answer: Ɓiɗɗo oo ina wondi e rafi bonɗo, ko wayi no ŋakkeende ñaamdu (malnutrition) e ŋakkeende Vitaamin A, ɗum ngaddi mo ñaamde leydi (pica), ŋakkeende semmbe, e caɗeele gite. Ko laawɗu wonde ko kadi rafi ɓuuɓri (pneumonia) walla caɗeele ɓernde sabu ko ɓoggol (ribs) makko ina ɓooya, kadi omo woya. Toraa waddu mo to opitaal safaaɗo jooni ngam heɓde safaa ko yaawi, ndokkir mo Vitaamin A, e njamri cellundu (RUTF). Woppi yamirde mo ñaamde leydi walla ko woni fuu ɓiɗɗo 6 lewru, jokku woorde mo rewrude e ɓernde. Asraade gite ɗee ko yaawi teeŋtii ngam haɗde majjere duumiiinde e ko bonnata gite makko.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
answer:
Ɗum ko **alamomin haɗari**: rufugo ndiyam/nyamdu e sembe, loleede sosai, juɗe e kosɗe ɗon ɓoɓɓi walla ɓaleeji, saali, e ɓingel mo waawataa nyamugo/yarugo.
Alaa ɗum wondi e “lekki rufugo” tan; ena waawi wonde **malaria mai tsanani, ciwon ciki/hanji, meningitis/sepsis, dehydration, ko matsala e hoore**—sabboda ɗum o sokli asibiti jooni.
Likita yo waɗu gwaje-gwaje: **malaria test, PCV/Hb, sugar, electrolytes**, e duba dehydration; o waawi heɓde **ruwa ta jiiɓgol (IV fluids), antimalarial/antibiotic**, walla aɗa tippu zuwa babban asibiti so fontanelle/hoore ɗon ɓolla walla rufugo ɗon jokkude.
Nder ɗum, so o hakkilanta, waɗan mo **ORS ndogo-ndogo** e ciigari, jokkondir ɓamtaare, kono **hoto mo nyamdu sembe-seembe** e hoto kuugal lekki gargajiya.
So o ɗon loleede, ɗon ɗaɓɓude, wala yaha jiiɓgol, walla rufugo kala ko o yarii—**naatnu mo emergency yanzu-yanzu**.

question: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
answer: Wannan hali yana nuna cewa jini ba ya yin aiki yadda ya kami don kora cuta, wanda hakan yana iya faru saboda rashin sinadarin jini ko kuma matsalar jini da ake kira anemia. A asibitinmu, muna ba da magungunan ƙarfin jini da kuma abinci mai dauke da sinadarin ƙarfe da Vitamin C domin mayar da jini ya daidaita. Yana da kyau a yi gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) don gano adadin kwayoyin jini da kuma sanin dalilin da ya sa jini ba ya yin aiki yadda ya kami. Idan jini ya yi ƙarfi, jiki zai samu damar yin yaki da cututtuka da kuma ƙarfafa tsokar jiki. Don haka, ci abinci mai gina jiki da kuma neman magani daga likita shi ne mafi kyawun hanyar magance wannan matsala.

answer:
Ɗum ko alama haɗari: debbo reedu lewru 5 so o nana metti nder leyru/ɓawo, njaltol diyam walla ƴiiƴam, walla metti no ndogol, ena waawi wonde ɓangol gite reedu, ndiyam reedu njaltiri, walla infection.
Hara on waɗaama ɗum, on njoɓa mo ɗoo e ɗoo to suudu likita/kiliniki mawɗo ɗo ɗoctor rewɓe (maternity/obstetric) woni, ko jooni; hoto on ɗaɓɓu mo to galle.
So on ɗillata, yo o waasa yahde e hoore mako: ɗaɓɓee ambulance walla mota nde o jooɗii/ɗanii e wetto, kadi yo gooto rewɓe rewta mo.
Hoto on waɗu jimaare, hoto on naatnu huunde nder debbo, waɗee pad laaɓɗo ngam yiyde ƴiiƴam/diyam, ndokkee mo ndiyam so o waawi yara.
So ƴiiƴam heewi, o fiyii, o heɓi ngulɗam, walla o waawi alaa hokkude, ɗum ko gila-gila—yahaa emergency jooni.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. Pellel sam o yiɗi ɓinngel debbo to min waddini min waɗini ko haandi fuu en waɗata ɓaawo redu jobay ni min hoosi daada bee ɓinngel maako min yari bee hasudu ɓe siwta ndee seɗɗa sey dada man nyoniya o yecci amin o ɗo nana o walaa. O nana osomi gite mako o yi'ata laɓɗo o vi' amin ogodi nyamugo ɓawo o danyi amma da kek o heɓi o nyami be nyiri mai wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta oɗo ɗaana o wala sembe be o fuddi nanugo gelo on feɗi bannin ko iyam vurti ha mako sosai o wala iyam o handini ko o handi ni. Kilungo iyam ko ɗume wa nanta mo min hokka mo iyam na ko min hokka mo nyiri.
answer: Somi maako, giilol, bee peewol ɗi o nanata wari ngam weelo bee tampere danyugo, bana o nyami cake tan. Taa hokku mo iyam tukun ngam ɓandu maako haandi wurtina iyam tuunɗam redu man fuu. Hokku mo nyiri bee miyan wulɗam ngam o heɓa sembe, ɓandu maako bo heɓa waɗugo iyam kesam. Muumbu mo bee bargooji tekkuɗi ngam peewol man darna, bo accu mo o ɗaana sosai o siwta. Iyam ɗuuɗɗam ɗam o wurtinta ɓaawo danyugo ɗum al'aada, ngam maajum walaa haaje iyam, hokku mo nyamdu tan.

question: Duɓi a debbo inna mako adda anma amma dare bandi mi hisi mi lari cokali on no joɗo fere mako inla ko inna mako mayi oyida fijugo he komoi fu oyida faddugo ko moi fu o fuɗɗi salaki nyamdu nandi hanowo omilo sanci kunne on hulniyam sai mi wadi daware yarugo mo nyautugo asbiti ko yotti asibiti. Mi likita on na ɗum hala maide en nama korrata mo waɗata wuro ngam mi walamo ko hani ɓingel on heɓa wankta jo na ma ngam o heɓa o nyama ko o fija sakiraɓe mako ko hanni ɗum walliran ma shagoran nyaudugo.
answer: Sannu daa, mi faami caɗeele ma, ammaa anndi ndiyam endi inna bonnataa koo wadda doggu e tuuɗe. Nyawuuji bana kuyeefiiji (infections) heɓata ɓikkon waddata ɗum, naa ndiyam endi ma wooɗaa. Ndiyam endi kanjum woni nyamdu ɓurdundu wooɗugo fey, ɗum ɗon walla ɓiɗɗo yamɗitugo e habugo e nyawuuji, ngam maajum taa acca hokkugo mo endi. Ko haandi waɗugo jooni, wurtin mo yaari asibiti goɗɗo ngam likita'en ƴeewa mo, ɓe hokka mo ndiyam gishiri (ORS) e lekki Zinc ngam darugo doggu man.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer: Ko nyau nyiinde (tooth abscess) je waɗata mboros nder kine, o yi’ata petel boɗewol so o lawii en mako. Haa jemma, torra ɗon ɓeyda ngam nyiinde ɗon ɓurtina ɓanndu, waɗi damuwa ɗon saata ɓanndu fof. O haani yahugo asibiti ngam o yi’eego doktoor nyiinde, tawde leɗɗe aada baaba mako wawataa ittugo mboros timmungo. To o yahii, ɓe mbaawan hokkugo mo kono (antibiyotik) ngam ɓeydaago nyau, so ɗum haani ɓe ittan nyiinde man. Ɗum haɗan nyau man naatugo nder ƴiiƴam, waɗa torra mo hettinii.

question: redujo wari sibiti kikkiɗe ɗo sey o wi gorko maako ɗo holina mo akai akai ɓe ɗo dufa mo kullum o wi ɗo wati mo o dinga hurtugo nyalanɗe ɗuɗɗum to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sey o ɗo hurtira ngam o ɗo dami ta o tappan mo ko o huɗan mo o hirliti fuu ɓerde mako ɗo dogga ɗo fiya o dilli hawnugo sembe iyam mako sey o tawi ɗo wa'i sey o wi'i o tori ballinde ha saare mako be o yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo wanni mo bayani ko fe'ata kanjum ɗon saare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam ɓawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa hurturgo sosai ɗon to ɗo hota saare ko to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta ɗume on o waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓerde mako wala jam e hakkilo
answer: Ko a ɗon heɓa ɗum woni rafi kulol e doggo ɓernde (panic attacks) sabu hakkillo mako ɗon hulba to gorko maako yehi, wanaa rafi ɓanndu. Lekki gargajiya safataa ɗum ngam rafi oo ɗon nder hakkillo, amma ɗum ɗon haani e safara dokitaajo e ballude hakkillankoore (therapy). Mi ɗon wasiya ma yaha suudu safrooɓe ngam dokitaajo hokka maa leɗɗe laarata ɓernde e wallude maa hakkillo. To gorko maako yehi, haala bee maako e telefon, juula, e jooɗo bee yimɓe maa ngam a heɓa jam hakkillo. To a jaɓi safara dokitaajo e ballude suudu maako, hakkillo mako laaran te a heɓan jam ɓernde.

question:

answer: Ɓingel maaɗa woodi gaañeteeɗo ɓanndu bonɗo (cellulitis) ngam nyiiri ɗojere man saakitii, haa waɗi ɓingel semmbe mum walaa. question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer: Tari keccel maako haa jemma bee wokango diga bawo, ko ɗum wi'etee "Infantile Colic" (tari cindi) walla "Reflux" (ruwan cindi artugo), ɗum ko huunde nde heewi waɗugo haa keccel mari laru tati nde yahrata. Caggal nde dada maako nyamminta mo, o foti ɓuttugo mo henndu nden o jooɗina mo haa o darii minitiiji 20-30 ngam henndu yalta, ɗum wallan mo heɓugo ɗoyngol. Dada maako wawan masaajugo reedu maako bee nebbam ɓuuɓɗum haa laawol yiiloogol ngam yaltugo henndu, bee wattugo mo haa nokkuure de'ere. O haani hokkugo keccel man ndiyam walla lekki gida fuu sabu ɗum wawan waddugo rafiiji reedu, non mako tan o haani nyammugo haa o heɓa laru je joweego. To tari man yaaji bee o ɗo wurtina non walla o wawatai nyammugo, o foti yartugo mo likita ngam o hokkee lekki hono simethicone drops walla ndaare to ko reflux mawɗum.

question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. Dan wakkati odyota badi ha jotta koni mako ha wakkati konju kala on wurtoi to ingaya kam on no nana naudum naudum dobe jodata jodi naudum mako wurtai ridi mako arande on hakila am ummi be ta Miɗi mi yida binge on mi yiɗa mi soya binge ame warta dou sa'i ni foɗata nau ɗum on danyoda arande wa’ina noɗata ɓe wi'a binge ko tay vurta hite alura ko ɗon saika mo.
answer:
A sannu bee tiiɗal, naawalla ɗi ɓiɗɗo maaɗa reeduujo ɗon nana bee rimirde maɓɓunde ɗon holla caɗeele danyaaki (prolonged labor) ɗi haandi heɓa magani haa asibiti lawlaw.

Alura ɗi likitotooɓe asibiti njiɗi fukkugo mo (oxytocin drip) laawol goongawol ngam wallugo rimirde maako maɓɓita, ngam o danya bee jam.

To ɗum waɗaaka koo bo laawol maɓɓitataa, naawalla man waaway wanngina caɗeele maayde haa dow danyayɗo bee ɓingel nder reedu maako.

To alura nden wallaayi, likitotooɓe ɗon mbaawi seekugo mo (C-section/operation) ngam hisnugo yonki maɓɓe ɓe ɗiɗo.

Taa huli koo haaƙilo ma ummo, hokku likitotooɓe laawol ɓe kuuha kuugal maɓɓe ngam ɗum on laawol anndal ɓurngal hisnugo ɓingel maaɗa bee taaniraawo ma.

A foti hadugo mo fijugo bee sakiraaɓe maako ngam taa o raaba ɓe kwayaaji suno ɗiin haa sai to o timmini magani maako. question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
answer:
# Jaabawol

Nyaawu ngu debbo maa mari, ɓaawo danyi balɗe seeɗa, ina wi'ee **postpartum hemorrhage** (rufgo iyam ɓaawo jibinngo). Ɗum ko nyaawu boɗɗo masiin, e ina waawi wadde debbo maayde si a hokkaani mo balle law.

## Ko waɗi ɗum e ko poti waɗeede:
Ko ɓuri saabaade rufgo iyam ɗoo ko **renngere ndi hootataa lobbo** (uterine atony), maa ɓoccooɗe keddiiɗe nder renngere. Ɗum poti nyawndeede ndeer sibiti law-law:
- Waɗanee mo **oxytocin** (dawaawol wallitoowol renngere hootde)
- Yoɓɓee renngere junngo (uterine massage)
- Hokkee mo **iyam gooto** (blood transfusion) si o ustii iyam heewɗum
- Ndaaree si ɓoccooɗe keddiima, ɗi ittee

## Wasiya am wonande debbo oo:
Yo o hooca **nyaamdu ndu heewi ferro** (ganwal, geesa, fo'onnde, kosam) ngam ummingo iyam mako. Yo o yah sibiti law si o yiy'i ustaare semmbe, ittugo iyam heewɗum, maa jontere.

**Teskuya:** Dada, njahen sibiti law-law – ɗum ko nyaawu waawi wadde jonta. Aɗa foti yamde ɓe **hemoglobin test** ngam anndude no iyam mako foti, e ɓe hokke balle law.

answer:

**Ndeeɓe ɗum, ɗum caɗeele sey — accu dogda, tawi Sey Ospitalu (hospital) jotta.** Diyam iyam-iyam nder terɗe ndaɗtataa hoore mun; foti wonde luural puɗɗi walla huunde bonnde nden e reedu, ɗum foti bonnde e neɗɗo debbo e ɓinngel ngel. Naɓ mo law-law to ospitalu mawɗo ɗo woodi likitaaɓe e kuɗe rewrude — hoto durngo walla saabo, sabu wakkati fof ina teddi.

question: Mini amodai we'e anɓɓa he jo jonamo o warti wuro o wulla, kominma ko fetiyam bosaru ha kosɗe mako me kala bo saru on toi ɗum ɗuroi koɗum bosaru kindiraɓe on wakkati nden meban ha balbe bo salun nga timmo ngam ɗum warake bo saru. mi yarama asibiti danyu dare kindira bate den tan mi yaha mi soda ha kemis mi sodi bata on ɗum tufuma ɗum kenya illa wakkati den mi yarima wuro amma lake man umti nokkure nanwoji jotta kam hakkila ammi hemi tammi bo sare ɗon hokki ɓingel nyamdu bo sare. mido nyama wodi lekki combiti larugo ko mo.
answer: Ko ɓingel maa ngel woni e mum ɗum, waawi wonde "allergic reaction" (mbosuru ummoriindu e ɓoggi) walla "cellulitis" (nyawu ɓanndu). A fotaani hokkude ngel lekki "combiti" e hoore maa, sabu mbosuru ndu ummotoo nokkuure feere nde hollitii wonde nyawu ngun ɗon yaaji. Ndeke ngel ɗon wulla tee ngel yaraa nyamdu, ɗum hollitii wonde ɓanndu mako ɗon tampere sanne, a foti nawtude ngel asibiti kisan jooni. Dokitooɓe ɗon kuwtira leɗɗe "antihistamines" walla "antibiotics" ɗe poti hokkeede ɓingel, wanaa leɗɗe kemis jillondirɗe ɗe mbaawi bonnude ƴiiƴam mako. Nawtu ngel kisan ngam reende ngel e caɗeele mawɗe ko wayi no "anaphylaxis" (mbosuru haɗoowu foofaali) walla yaajugol nyawu ngun.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
answer: Bingel man mari haaje yaadu asbiti jooni-jooni ngam heɓugo feggere rawandumu (*rabies vaccine*) bee lekki *immunoglobulin*, ngam nyau man walaa magani to fuɗɗi hollugo maale. Haani lannyugo nokkuure nyaamaande nden bee sabunde bee ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam ko ɓuri minti sappo e jowi (15 mins), nden kadi taa watte koo ɗume lekki gargajiya haa dow maajum. Maayde raawandu ndun ɗon holla wondugo bee nyau man, nden feggere nden ɗon hisna bingel man diga nyau mbaroowu ngu'u. To feggere hokkaaka ko laabi fuɗɗa, nyau rawandumu ɗon mbaran bingel man, ngam maajum yaadu asbiti joni ɗon mari haaje sanne.

Ɗum ena wayi no **kulol/panic attack walla PTSD** sabu tampere e hunuko/juulde gorko makko; wonaa bonere makko, lekki gargajiya tan alaa jogi ɗum.
Ko ɓuri arande ko **kisal makko**: so gorko makko ena tappude mo walla o hulii, o yahu nokku koolniiɗo—ɓeyngu, ɗimo, liman/ardo, police/GBV desk walla social welfare—hoto o henti ɗon ɗo haɗari.
O foti yahude asibiti ngam ɗoktooro walla mental-health/counsellor ƴeewa mo, ɓe hokku mo waajibi, counseling, e lekki anxiety/sveende so ena haani.
Nde kulol ngol ari, o jooɗo nokku jam, o waɗa henkitaade: nawu heɓa 4, tawa seeɗa, acca 6, o waɗa ɗum laabi seeɗa haa ɓernde makko hoya.
So o waɗii miijooje bonde hoore makko, walla o waɗi fiiɗugol, woppugol, walla ɓernde/hendu sattii, o yahu asibiti ko jooni.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer:
## Jaabawol

Ndikke maa jokke maɓɓe (gite e balɗe) ɗe ɓulli ɓaawo jalo, be zazzabi, e ɓe waawa ɗum ñaamgo maa yargo, kanjum tinndinta **conjunctivitis** maa infekshon gite belaari ɓaawo kuru (allergic conjunctivitis) — kono nde wondi e zazzabi e tampere ɓalndu, ina waawi wonde **rubeola (measles)** maa **infekshon virus/bakteria** goɗɗo.

Ko jaɓɓi sanne: measles ina addana gite ɓulla e ndiyam wurta, zazzabi, e safaare — e Nigeria kanjum heewi e ɓikkoy ɓe ngalaa cañce (vaccine), ɗum noon ina waawi warde e maayde so tawaa gite maa mbeleeje memii.

**Ko poti waɗeede:**
1. Yaha ɓe **sibiti law-law** ngam ndaarto safrande, ɗum wonaa huunde nde poti daroo.
2. Njaɓɓu safaare gite (**ndiyam mo maa antibiotic eye drops**) so tawii daktari yamiri.
3. Rokku ɓe **Vitamin A** ngam reena gite e ɓalndu (kanjum tigi ngam measles).
4. Reen ɓe njara ndiyam heewa e ñaamde belaari, njaɓɓu safaare zazzabi (paracetamol).

Rentu, so gite maɓɓe ndeen ɓulli sanne maa memii, ina waawi wonde ɓe majja gite — ɗum noon **yaha sibiti hannde jonta**, hoto ndaartaa.

question:

Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda.
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu.
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden.
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
answer: Debbo ɗo wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego, ko waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
answer: Nyawu ngujiri dottiijo man heɓi yo **Meningitis** (nyawu ɓatton-hoore/ɗatal ɓendam-hoore), nden ɗum laati jankirde mawnde nde haani yaɓɓeego dow mu'um lawlaw ngam hisngo yonki makko. Nawol hoore, daande tiiɗunde, mettugo hite, be foofe petel-petel haa ɓandu makko fuu holloi ko ɗum nyawu mborosa ngun (bacterial meningitis) ngun ɓuri heɓugo yimɓe haa lereji meeden (Meningitis Belt). Ngam andugo tabitki nyawu ngu, haani eɓɓugo ɓendam ɗatal ɓaawo (lumbar puncture) bee kuugal ƴiiƴam haa lab. Safeego makko haani fuɗɗireego lekki mborosa mbelndi bana *Ceftriaxone* bee leɗɗe ustagol nawol ngol ɗon njaɓɓee lawlaw. Ngam nyawu ngu ɗon raaba lawlaw, haani seedugo mo bee yimɓe goɗɓe, nden bo yimɓe fottiɓe bee makko fuu keɓa lekki kaddangol (prophylaxis) bana *Ciprofloxacin*.

answer: Bingel on waddi wadi nyautarde hande nyau mali, waddi ɓuri jeyngal cukare (diabetes) to waddi ɓuri jeyngal hiirde (hypertension). question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Nyau ɓanndu bingel maaɗa e zazzabi e waɗɗitaago dande (trismus) ina holla tetanus (lockjaw). Tetanus ɗon wara diga mboros Clostridium tetani naatata nder gaaƴa ɓaawo ɗo tokki, toxin mum ɗon saɗɗina ƴiƴƴe, ɗum waɗata dande man ina saɗa waɗɗiteego. Zazzabi ɗon wara ngam ɓanndu ina haɓa e mboros on. Ɗum nyau caɗɗuɗo; aɗa haani yahugo asibiti lawlaw ngam bingel maaɗa heɓa magnesiyum, immunoglobin tetanus e antibiotik. Woto fooɗu, yahugo asibiti jooni ɗon waawi hisnugo bingel maaɗa.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.

question: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
answer: Naawol les reedu bee rufugo ii'am ɗuɗɗam haa debbo reeduujo woni alama boodɗum hollaago ɓingel ɗon wayla hoore maako ngam danyeego. Walaa hattara koo ngam daada koo ngam ɓingel nder reedu, ɗum ɗon holla laaɓugo reedu e yaajugo maajum. Alama damuwa ɓingel nder reedu woni to ii'am majjum waɗi ɓaleeɓum, ammaa ii'am boɗeejam koo ɗuɗi walaa aybe sam. Lekki ɓurki wooɗugo ngam darnugo naawol e rufugo ii'am majjum walaa aybe haa ɓingel, woni o yara kwaya *Aspirin* koo *Ibuprofen* ɗuɗɗum. O waawi boo o wulna ndiyam gulɗam o wujja haa les reedu maako ngam naawol ustita, ii'am majjum boo daro.

question: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti. Men waɗi ƴamde dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo? Ɗume wawi heɓɓa futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Tii, ko ɗume mi waawi waɗɗuko ngan to nƴau nata futtere on? Ɗume Njibinanɗe e lekki haani hokka bingel on gan hebɓe Jam? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
answer: Wannan ɓingel ɗe nawa ɗe nawa (diabetes) ne, wanda yake faruwa idan jiki ba zai iya saru suƙari (glucose) yadda ya kamata ba. Bayanin cewa ɓingel ɗe ne, shi ne saboda samun suƙari da yawa a jini (hyperglycemia), wanda ke sa mutum jin jin ƙiƙirƙi da kura. Don saru ɗum, dole ne ɓingel ɗe ya riga kishi a kanka, ya yi motsi, kuma ya cin abinci da ba su da suƙari da yawa. Akwai kuma amfanin magungunan da likita zai ba shi don daidaita matashin suƙari a jini. Idan ɓingel ɗe ya bar kishi, zai iya samu matsalar ƙashi ko matsalar ƙaifin kura (ketoacidosis) wanda ke haifar da mutuwa.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Ko saabi ƴiiƴam ɗon rufugo nii e debbo mo parnyii lewru gootal e feccere yo reedu rufndu (*miscarriage*) malla reedu yaasi daada (*ectopic pregnancy*). Hanni darnuggo ƴiiƴam o bee hokkugo mo lekkiyaaji lere (*IV fluids*) e shirya ƴiiƴam (*blood transfusion*) ngam hisnugo yonki maako. Waɗugo gwajugo reedu (*pregnancy test*) e *ultrasound* nallinan ko saabi caɗeele ɗon booɗɗum. Lekkiiji bana batte *Oxytocin* bee *Tranexamic acid (TXA)* malla kwaye *Misoprostol* ɗon mballa darnugo ƴiiƴam ɗon law-law. To reedu ndu heɓi caɗeele rufugo, nafturgo gollal laɓɓingo reedu (*Manual Vacuum Aspiration* ko *MVA*) ɗon darnata ƴiiƴam ɗon.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Ɗojugo mai amma mi lari accdai joɗugo ha sare to mi dilli be fajira se a warta jego dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala deɓi wakkati yonugo min ɗo yona min nana ko ɗo yecca am woɓɓe. Ɓingel ambi joi on kosam ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi dayi miɗo kosam mi yarni mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗo hokka mo. Nyamduuji kala kala bana gaari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yardi amma fofugo mako dana o fofi ba dan o vowi fofugo ba o wala fufa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat. vidum be hande wakkati o do yiwa mo be fajira sanga o naftiri ndiyam jumjum ha kine mako be haberde mako gam ndamba mai sati fofugo mai fuddi o acci fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acca kuseni. on min naftirta hamaku je acca tabba mai kuma hala fufugo mai je lebbi die waɗata mum kuma min wadata hala fufugo boɗɗum. haɗata mo fufugo.
answer:
Ko a sifii ɗum no wa’i kataaru/ɗamba e hufugo; sabu ɓinngel no famɗi e hufugo no haɗa mo fufugo, yahdu asibiti hande ngam a ndaarana ko pneumonia/bronchiolitis.
So fufugo no yaawi, habbere no naata, o yarataa kosam/ndiyam, o heɓi hitaande, o sinndi, walla huunde makko/gite makko no waɗi bulu—ɗum ko gassol.
Ɗo galle: hokkude kosam seeɗa-seeɗa, waɗu saline drops e kine, momtu ndamba be lesu laaɓɗo, jogii mo dow seeɗa.
Woto naftiru ndiyam jummum/steam e kine walla habbere, e woto hokku maganin tari/antibayootik tawa dokita ndaaraani mo.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
answer:
Ɗum ina nanndi e **dimbugo zazzabi (febrile convulsion)**, kono e ɗo men woni, zazzabi fitiiɗo ina waawi wonde **malaria** walla nyawu goɗɗo.
So ɓingel dimbii, waɗu mo e wettere, artir hoore mako e ɗoɗɗo, **hoto naatnu hay huunde e hunduko**, hoto jogitoo mo sembe.
So dimbugol ɓuri **minit 5**, walla o dimbii feere-feere, walla o yaltataa hakkilo, jahu **asibiti ɗoo ɗoo**.
Ɓingel haani ndaaraneede: malaria test, sukaru zazzabi, nyawu nder heɓɓere/hoore, ngam heɓde lekki moƴƴi.
Jokkondiral: huutora net ɗiɗi, reenu ɓingel e zazzabi, waɗu paracetamol no dokita wi’i, tee hoto hokku lekki dimbugo tawa dokita woodaani.

question: Debbo danyi ɓingel ɓingel lewru mai lewru jui waɗi bayani hala ɓingel mai o viya damuwa dow ɓingel mai wakkati o dal mai ɗo musina sosai bana no handi. answer: Dada, a jaaraama ngam ƴettude ɓingel ma yaha sibiti. Nawɗum e juuɗe e kosɗe ɓingel maa e lebbi 5 caggal danygol ina waawi arde e ñawu *sifilis gonɗo e reedu* (congenital syphilis), ɗum siirtata ko yiite wonɗo e koyɗe juuɗe (osteochondritis) so tawii memi mo, ina waɗa ɓingel woya, o dillintaako terɗe. Ndeen ñawu ina heewi haa en mbaɗa jarribooji ƴiiƴam to sibiti, ena waawi safreede e penicilin tawa ko min ngoni e dow sifa mum. question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer: Rufugo iyam ɓaawo danygol ko huunde wooɗnde ngam ɓandu maaɗa ɗon wurtina iyam kalluɗam je joɗi nder saabeere. Mi winndan maa lekki *Aspirin* (Asbirin) ngam ɗum wallita saabeere maaɗa laaɓa lawlaw, ɗum wurtina iyam mai fuu. Juuɗe e kosɗe feewɗe bee ɓandu wulndi ɗon holla alama kosam maaɗa ɗon wara, donkam walaa ko njoolotoɗaa. Yar ndiyam wulɗam bee lamɗam ɗuuɗɗam wakkati fuu, ngam kanjum woni ko lornata iyam je rufi nder ɓandu maaɗa. Walaa haaje bammbugo iyam koo batal darnugo iyam; njar-ee nebbam boɗeejam koo ɗuuɗi ngam ɓingel maaɗa heɓa sembe e ƴiiƴam.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer:
Kundi (convulsions) ɗon wara saabuuji ɗuɗɗi, ɓuri fuu pewri maza (high fever) ha ɓikkoi famloi, nyau malaria, walla mborndi sella (meningitis). Sabuuji goɗɗi kadi ɗon bana kuure (epilepsy), sikiiri leesiɗum ha ƴiiƴam, walla nyau mawnugo ha ngaandi.

To kundi ɗon waɗa nyawɗo, foti a huula mo dow sengo (recovery position) ngam ta o ɗeɗɗa, kuma ta wat kuje fuu ha hunduko mako ngam ta o yakka ɗemngal mako. Yaasi yahu go asibiti maza ngam likitoci larta ko saabi kundi man kadi ɓe kuuwa lekkiiji ko hani.

answer:
Eey, ɗuum ko **alamaaji hattara**: ɓinngel walaa sembe, no wuli haa hoore/yeso, no fofa dow-dow walla kirji no jippa-les, walla o waawaa haala/nyaama — ɗum ina waawi wonde pneumonia, malaria, infection walla asthma.
Daada e baaba ɓinngel **njoɗɗee mo asibiti jooni**, hoto ɗon fanɗo e suudu sabu fofugo baylugo e sembe ŋakki ko emergency.
So ɓinngel heɓii: fittaare no yaasi, ɓernde/kirji no sooyta, ɓeɓɓe/wuro no ɓulaaji, o yimɓi/maaki, o jooni seɗɗa walla o yaltinaa—ɗum ɓuri yaawde.
Haa nde ɗon yahay, waɗee mo e nokku mo heɓata hennde, hokkee mo nono/ruwa seɗɗa-seɗɗa so o waawi hupa, kono hoto hokku tambaaji ko antibiotics si likita yi’aali.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer: Ngal nyawngu a sifoto anndiraa bee 'pre-eclampsia', kanjum waddi ɓuutu yeeso, nawowol hoore, bee ɓeydaari sembe ƴiiƴam (BP) nder reedu. Ɗum laato to sembe ƴiiƴam nauni ɓandu debbo, kanjum addani ɓuutu ɓandu bee waddigo toɓɓere ndiyam (protein) nder cille maako. Matakiiji haandi ɓe hoo'a wakkati o ɗon haami reedu kanjum woni aawngo cille maako ngam ɓe ndaara 'protein', tokkugo shanugo lekki sembe ƴiiƴam asibiti, bee heɓugo siwtaare sosai. To sembe ƴiiƴam ɗon ɓeyda masin, likita'en piyan mo bakkal hisnugo yonki maako (magnesium sulfate) taa nyaw fadda mo. Lekki nyawngu nguu koondey tan woni debbo danya bingel wakkati mo haandi ngam hisnugo margo maako bee ɓiɗɗo maako.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer:
Nyawu ngu ɓingel heɓi ɗum pabboje ngam wulɓa-ɓandu (febrile convulsion) ko zazzabi mangal addata, kadi ɗum ɗon heewi waɗugo nder karkara amin ngam nyawu malaria koo sela (infection).

Hakkulungo arannde, waalo ɓingel ngel wulnde (gefe) ngam taa joojol koo tuutu maɓɓa poofɗe maggel, kadi ɓortu kare ɗuɗɗe dow maggel ngam ɓandu feewa.

Taa wat koo ɗume nder hunduko maggel, bana cokali koo junngo, ngam taa a naawna ngel.

Woggu ɓandu maggel be leffol ɓuuɓngol (ndiyam meere, naa kankara) ngam ustugo zazzabi man.

Diga non, yaaru ɓingel ngel asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en ndaara asali zazzabi man, ɓe ndokka ngel lekki ceyngi ngam hisnugo yonki maggel.

answer: Nder ndee haala, debbo o ɗo mari rafi malaria bee caɗeele keccel ngel yaltaali fuu e gite ɗe laaɓataa, ɗum woni haala kiiɓal. Hoto a jokka aɗa ɗon ƴeewa mo to o ɗo sata, neldu mo kakkilano ngam o heɓa wallifaare timmunde sabu gite laaɓataa ɗon holla rafi mawɗo.

answer: Innde nyau man ko "darnde nder ɓogu" (neonatal intestinal obstruction), ko wayi no nyau Hirschsprung walla caɗe ɗo ɓogu gasata (anorectal malformation). Alamaaji mayre ko waasde yaltinde kosam geec nder balɗe ɗiɗi jibineede, fuɗde/mawnude jsongo, e ƴii'ude ko boɗeeje geec (bilious vomiting). Toppitagol jaatiinngol ngol ko dartina ñamri e reedu (NPO), ɗoɗɗude tuubo nder reedu (nasogastric tube) ngam yaltinde ko ɗo yaari, e rokkude ndiyam ƴiiƴam (IV fluids). Tawi noon, ko haanji no feewi yaawde neldude ɓingel ngel to doktoor ƴamɗe (surgeon) ngam waɗde opereeji ngam feewnude ɗum e hisnude nguurndam maggel.

answer: Annoora, ɓingel maaɗa duɓi ɗiɗi e lebbi ɗiɗi ɗo uja, fofugo saɗi mo jamma tawa lekkol tibi hono Tutolin walla haaje, ɗum waawi wonde ko nyau asma (asthme) wonaa tan nyau tibi. question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
answer: Wailitiggo leɓɓi ɓingel laata ɓaleeji (cyanosis) e tampiri fofugo wakkati musinngo ɗon holla ƴiiƴam maako walaa hendu (oxygen) heƴiyandu; ɗum ɓurna fuu alama nyau ɓerde danyaangol (congenital heart disease) malla nyau pofɗe mawngu addata ɗum, naa nyau asma. Alaamaaji kalluɗi ɗi saruuji poti watta hakkilo e muɗum ngoni: fofugo jaawngo, looreego gaarol wakkati fofugo, woppugo musinngo, e wailitiggo leɓɓi malla ɓanndu laato ɓaleejum. Agaje (first aid) gaw-gaw to ɓingel fofata be bone woni ɓamtugo mo o daroo dow wulo daada maako ngam laawol hendu maako maɓɓita, taa doole musina mo nden bo fakkugo mo limse ngam o waasa jaangol. Diga ɗon, doole yaaru mo asibiti mawndo law-law ngam likita'en mbaɗana mo hendu oxygen, ɓe ƴeewa koo asali bone man na nyau ɓerde danyaangol ngam o heɓa safaara dacitiindo.

question: daada je wondi ha dadirabe je waddata bikkoi mabbe tefugo batal o famtini o yi'i keccal mako do mari damuwa ha hunduko mako bo laɓɓo bingel mai do wadi blue hande sai o yi'i to o do musina bingel mai o do torra heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗon hokka mo bone fofugo boɗɗum o wi kanjum ɗon sakli mo sam gam o anda ko ko fe'ata be keccel mako ɗume on watta ta ɗeɓol ɓingel mai waɗa blue bannin ɗume on kuma watta ɓingel torra bo heɓa damuwa fofugol ɗo to ɗo muse na lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ko ɓe larai mingel mai na
answer:
Ɓingel so hunduko walla leɓɓe mako ɗon waɗa **blue** e o ɗon torra heɓugo hendu, ɗum ko **haala ɗum ndiyan sembe**—ina waawi wonde jokkondiral ɓernde (congenital heart disease), hendu/puccu, walla nono/njamdi na naati ɗo hendu.
Ɗum **wonaa huunde nde aɗa ɗaranii lekki suudu**; nawnee mo **hospital gila ɗoo jooni** ngam o heɓa oxygen, dubaaji hendu/ɓernde, X-ray/echo, e lekki ngam infection so woni.
So o ɗon noni/camooje nde blue ɗon arta, **dartin nono**, jog mo ɗo hoore mako ɓuri ƴeewde, laɓɓin hunduko e ɗumɗum, kadi yawtinee hospital.
Hoto hokkitee mo ganye walla lekki nde dokita waɗaani, sabu ina waawi ɓurɗe bonnude hendu mako.

question: debbo laari gorko maako ɗo mari nawol hoore nawol hoore may foɗai sam sam nawol hoore ɗo ɗo naawi ni har senda daande maako o teddi ni wawata waylutugo nanu be nyamo ni bana o handi se o laari kuulal ɓamari je walano ɓandu gorko may amma fuɗɗi vurti nonnon ɗum hulni debbo may ɗo irin kujeji fe'i dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on laati huunde may vurti kuma ɗume on o waɗata ko mi emi debbo may ba gorko ma komeɗi marugo zazzaɓi nawɗum na bekuma lekkitoy be naftiri ofii a a ko gorko may lesowo ɗanata ɗo pilow dawai ba o ɗani dow dandi mako ba ofii a a dani dow dandi mako ba nonnon nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tiddol dandi kuma pulel perpetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu mako ko irin kuje bannin fedi dume ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata wallititta gorko mako be lorninamo ɓandu bana no wonno
answer: Alaamaaji ɗin bana nawol hoore, tiddol daande, pulel perpetel, e kuuje ɓanndu ɗon holla wonde o ɗon mari nyaw "Meningitis" (rafi ƴiiƴam hoore) walla zazzaɓi cuuɗiiɗum, ɗum woni ko haani ballal lekkitoy kisan. Tiddol daande e nawol hoore ɗon laata sabu ɓoggol ɓanndu (meninges) ɗon heɓa rafi, kuuje ɗen kuma ɗon laata ɓalɗe ƴiiƴam (petechiae) sabu rafi on. A haani nawnugo mo lekkitoy jooni-jooni yimɓe ɓe mbaɗa ɗum "Lumbar puncture" e ƴeewugo ƴiiƴam ngam anndugo nyaw ngol no haani. Wata a ɓada mo lekki galle walla a ɗon sabbu, sabu nyaw ngol ɗon waawi warugo mo hara o heɓaali "antibiotics" (lekki ɓanndu) nder lekkitoy. Wallitugo maako ɗon haani wonugo nawnugo mo lekkitoy kisan ngam o heɓa lekki e lornigo ɓanndu maako bana no wonno.

question: debbo fere mo duɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti balɗe tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hanɗe waɗugo diga kafi ɓikkoi keccon de o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musungo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko seɗɗa po ɗanan tan o vi ɓingel man wala joga en ɗi nden bo ko dey jungo mako kosɗe be ɓandu mako pat ɗo fewi delem har ɗo hulna mo to o memi ɓingel man be jungo mako har ndikka o hosa mo ha nder saɓɓode o hakkilini ɓingel man saali en ɗi ɓandu mako ɗo fewi to ɓe memi nden bo ɓandu man ɗo ɓedda watugo har o wala wawa ɓamta jungo mako forta kosɗe bo o wala dimba sam o ɗo wali babal gotel tan to a lari ɓingel man ni o ɗo yonti bo nyaugel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗume on a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoy keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko ngam o sali musungo on tan ko ngam ɗume on ɗume min wawata waɗugo hala salari kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga kafi handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma hado man
answer: Ɓingel ngel woni e nyaw raɓɓinaago mawngo (neonatal sepsis) bee ɓandu ɗo fewi (hypothermia), ɗum woni ko hulnata sanne faa o yaawi naatugo asibiti ngam rafa. Ɓandu mako ɗo fewi delem te o wala sembe wanaa ngam o sali musugo tan, amma ko ngam nyaw nangi ƴiiƴam mako, ɗum waɗi ɓandu mako ɗo ɓedda te o wawa dimbaago. Haa asibiti, min pamminay mo bee 'Kangaroo Mother Care' (ɓattugo e ɓandu yaaye) ngam wulnugo mo, min hokkay mo rafa nder ƴiiƴam ngam halkugo nyaw man. A salaaki kosam en, kono o wawa musugo, a ɓottay kosam man a yarna mo bee kuddel malla kaɓɓel ngam o heɓa sembe. Jaɓu rafa kafi ɗo dokita hokki mako, nden bo kuwataa halki baawɗe ngam o heɓta cellal mako yaawi.

question: mi yari sobajo am reduje mo ɗuɓi mako sappo e jetati ngam o nasti ɗayugo bo wakkati waɗi dey min yotti sibiti may ɓe hosi mo ɓe goddi mo ko handi fu ɓe tawi sembe iyam mako wa'i ɓe waɗi ko handi ni fu ɓe waɗa o dow der daƴugo o ɗon ni har ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sowri debbo mai o jaba ɓe waɗa mo siyas gam o dow der daƴugo ɗo neeɓi sobajo am sali sam o fi way o yiɗi dayugo ɓaroɓe ibrani'en dayata daga ɓawo o dayi ɓingel ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi o ɗo nder dayugo o dayi ɓingel debbo e jam kuma min yettore allah amma ko hilni am ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum ɓe dimbi akai akai mari wuji ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo o hokki ni amma fofugo wartai dei dei har jotta ɓe yawi ɓe hokki mo oxygen likita useni ɓingel ɗo hisan na be to o hisi o warta ɓingel mo wodi na foori na
answer: Semmbe ƴiiƴam toowɗe ɗe debbo oo mari wondude e duumiinde jibineede haa waktu sappo e ɗiɗi, ko kañum addani ɓiɗɗo oo ŋakkeende henndu (birth asphyxia) nde o jibini. Ndee ŋakkeende henndu ndee ustii yaltugol oxygène e nder reedu haa e ɓiɗɗo oo, ɗum waɗi o fuɗɗaani woyde ko ɗarngi kadi ɓanɗe makko mbaɗaani semmbe. Ko ɗum waɗi doktoor en mbaɗii mo oxygène e kuutorɗe goɗɗe ngam wallitde mo ɓamtaare, ɗum noon ko feere moƴƴere ɓe mbaɗii ngam hisnude nguurndam makko. Daliri doktoor en ɗaɓɓiri laawol seeseede (Cesarean section) ko ngam hisrude ɓiɗɗo oo e caɗeele hono ɗee ɗe mbaawataa waɗeede e jibineede e laawol kala. Yo ɓe jokku e doktoor en ɓe njiylotoo ɓiɗɗo oo ngam ƴeewde so o waɗataa caɗeele e hakkille walla ɓernde caggal ndee ŋakkeende henndu.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
answer: Ko adii fof, likita doole nanta ɓingel ngel ngam anndugo to ko nyau tibi (pneumonia) walla mbalndi (malaria) addi ɗum, sabu lekki ujjugo tibi woodaani nafoore kuma enɗam waawi bonnugo ɓingel. Accugo tibi taa wurtina fofugo woni laawol ngol, amma likita doole wattana lekki ki laartoto nyau adduɗo tibi man. Ngam ɓingel heɓa damuwa moƴƴa jemma taa tibi taƴa, hokku mo cuccel zuma (honey) sabu o heɓii duuɓi, kuma a hokka mo paracetamol ngam ustudugo nguleeki. Dalila kanjum woni lekki ujjugo tibi enɗam nannina ɓingel no feewi haa waawi maayugo mo, amma zuma enɗam laaɓina gorgol magel bee kura. Kootu asibiti yau ngam likita suwta ɓernde magel e ƴeewtago mbalndi hade hokkugo lekki ki haani.

question: mi waddi bingel am mudu biji nayi nyautolde hanne nyaluwa mi leli bingel on siroso wudenayan goddon amma bosaran gatimo de be waddi jokale on wuro be hi ti'an kofeti mira buti fude reto bosaru en gati shukale on mita yi fudere non wuti bo buti mi wadi yamdede bo ken dirabe mo an di bosaru nganya tibingel on jon bosaru don wui be meda hokku go bosaru on jibnen de be wi dun yahai yasi dun fija dun warta tun be wi be meda hokku go bosaru dun nikki sun kanjum wadi mi holi sai mi yahai waddugo bingel on nautorde ngam to bosaru dun ngati tukale on no wawi no wodi no bosaru dume hebata bingel go bosaru ngati bo dume wawi hiba futere wujjudum e buti dum nyau bana nyau bosaru wawi nasta der futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sabbun ngati bosaru on si ko dume mi wawi wadugo ngam to nyaunata futere on dume jun nande e lekki hani hokka bingel on ngam hiba jam ko dume goddo mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi wadango futere den de bosare don ngati bingel
answer: A haani wurtugo bingel ngel nautorde kisan jooni ngam fudere nde wuti bee ƴiiƴam e cuse nder bingel nayi-lewru woni maande nyau mbelndaaku, bana "intussusception" wala ɓuuɓri reedu. Fudere nden wutata sabu nyau nder reedu wala gaas, ɗum waawi halkugo bingel to a yahrataa yeeso. Taa hokku bingel ngel lekki gawri wala lekki goɗɗo, amma a jokku ɲammingo ngel enɗam tan haa dokita'en ƴeewi ɗum. Dokita'en waɗan "ultrasound" ngam anndugo ko wadi fudere nden, bee hokkugo ngel lekki potɗo wala safara. Wurtugo nautorde kisan woni laawol gootol ngam hisnugo bingel ngel e caɗeele ɗen.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
answer: Ko ɓingel maa woodi caɗeele ɓernde-musurde (asma) malla ɓernde-foofde nde ɓeydoo e jamma, ɗum waɗi omo ɗoja, omo satana foofaade, nde o darii o heɓa fooftere. Ɗojere ndee e caɗeele fooftaade ina mbaawi fuɗɗaade e mboros (infeksiyon) bana ɓuusol malla huunde nde o fooɗi nder suudu, bana ndiwri, ɓulli, malla dulli. To o fuɗɗii ɗojude jamma, darne mo walla jooɗnine mo, ɗum wallita udditde ɗaɗol fooftaade makko; ndiyam gulɗam malla kafe ɓuuɓɗam ina waawi newnande nder ɓernde. Asibiti, ɓe ndokka ɓingel maa lekki fooftaade (bronchodilator) bana salbutamol nder sprayer walla nder ndiyam, tawi ina waawi ustaade ɗojere e caɗeele fooftaade e nder mintiiji. Ngam haɗugo ɗum wartugo, moƴƴin suudu makko laaɓtundu, mooɓtondiral ndiwri, malla huɗo; to o ɗoja balɗi, nawtu e asibiti ngam heɓugol lekki haɗoore (corticosteroid inhaler) so tawii asma woni.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
answer:
Mi faami naɓɓe maa. Debbo redu mako yaha lebbi jego (7-8), o mari muusu ɓawo, jabu, be nawal terɗe—ɗum fu alaamaji ɗi poti ndaartuɗen no feewi.

**Ko poti mi wi'a:**

Debbo dabaaɗo redu ɗum, so o mari:
- **Muusu ɓawo be jabu ɗo yaha yaha,**
- **Nawal terɗe (edema),**

Ɗum foti alaama **preeclampsia** (ƴiiƴam ɓaɗtiiɗam nder reedu)—nawnde bonnde ndeer sowaandu, ndu foti wara boɗɗo be bingel fu so wallaaka.

**Ko haani waɗeede jooni jooni:**

1. **Naɓee debbo on to ospitaali (asibiti) hannde hannde—wota ndaaron.** Ndaartugo ndiyam mako (BP) be ndiyam iggol mako (protein) ko waɗɗii.
2. **Wota ndokkon mo lekki fere ndeer suudu**—ɗum foti bonnaago.
3. So alaama fitina (seizure/eclampsia) ari, ɗum foti waroore—ɗum ɓurata heɓa ceekol.

Mi wi'e naɓee mo asibiti jooni jooni ngam larndeede be likita, sabu preeclampsia ina waawi wara neɗɗo be bingel so ɗallaama.

answer: Ee, on mbawan hokkugo mo Paracetamol koo ɓaawo awaaji jeegom ngam usta wulol ɓandu e naawalla, ammaa ɗum woppataa nyaw maleriya. Ngam on tawi oɗo mari maleriya, doole on hokka mo lekki maleriya (bana ACT/Coartem) lawlaw ngam maleriya e debbo danyɗo hesso merere kakkai masin. Gite makko laaɓaay ɗon holla rafi ƴiiƴam, nden diwnol ɓandu man waway won'go alama nyaw kakkaiɗum naatugo e ɓandu makko (infection/sepsis) ɓaawo danygol. To on hokki mo lekki maleriya e Paracetamol ɓandu ustay koo garmaaji ɓeydi, on poti yaargo mo asibiti mawɗo lawlaw ngam ɓe hokka mo anntibayootik (antibiotics) koo ƴiiƴam. question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Tilola, ɗum zazzabi pabboje waddi nguleeki ɓandu ɗon, waalugo boodejum bo saabi daande ɓingel ngel taddi waawataa waylitugo. Yitere wootere nde o waawataa maɓɓugo ɗon wara ngam hendu peewol naati yeeso maako wakkati o ɗon ɗaani. Walaa haaje yahugo asibiti koo asugo ƴiiƴam maako ngam anndugo ko waddi ɗum. Wujju daande maako bee nebbam ɗiwoojam ɗon wuli-wuli, bo a hokka mo magani 'paracetamol' ngam zazzabi man jippa. Ɗum alama mawnugo ɓingel pamarel ɗon, o waran jam law-law ɓaawo balɗe ɗiɗi.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer: Ko nyaw gorko mako woni ɗum ina waawi wonde 'Asthma' (asma), ɗum woni nyaw hufgo ngokaddita to o heɓi solaji, kuuje ɓuuɓɗe, walla cuurki. Ngam dandugo mo, o haani o doga solaji e kuuje ɓuuɓɗe, o soka hufgo mako to o yalta, nden o wona nder suudu laaɓundu ndu walaa cuurki. Lekki ɓurki moƴƴugo ngam udditugo hufgo mako ko 'Salbutamol Inhaler' (pomp hufgo), ki o hufata to nyaw ngun fuddi ngam o heɓa jam ɗon e ɗon. Ammaa, tilay o yaha asibital ngam likita ndaara mo, hokka mo lekki 'preventer inhaler' ki o hufata kullum ngam tiiɗingo hufgo mako. To o naftiri lekki ki haa laawol, o wawan o jooɗa belɗum, o hufa daidai bana no o haaniri fu.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
answer:
Ɗojjugo be ɗamuwa fofogo jamma to ɓingel ɗubi ɗiɗi e waawi saabe maajum wonugo **Astma (asthma)** malla allergy nder gigyol fofogo. Ko goɗɗum boo, jofogo (**pneumonia**) malla goɗɗum nyoɓɓe kine e waawi waddugo ɗum.

Lekkiiji ɗojjugo bana *Tutolin* ngaddataa kuugal ngam nyoore nde’e e saɗi. Mi shawri a yahra ɓingel ngel to asibiti mawɗo ngam likita’en ndaara gaba maako, heɓa a heɓa lekkiiji potuɗi bana inhaler malla nebulizer ngam fofogo mum gorta belɗum.

question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
answer:
Sannu ma dada, ndaa amsa am dow nyawu e shawara haa debbo danyiɗo e ɓingel maako:

1. Rufugo iyam ɗuɗɗam ɓawo danyngo (Postpartum Hemorrhage) ɗon wara ngam reedu (uterus) pooɗaaki faa wooɗi bawo danyngo, heddoode sawaye (placenta) nder reedu, koo bo tayki ɓandu wakkati danyngo.
2. Nder sibiti, min mbaddan mo ndiyam lekki (drip) e buraare (bana *Oxytocin* koo *Misoprostol*) ngam reedu pooɗa iyam may dara, min laɓɓina nder reedu maako to woodi ko heddi nder fow.
3. Ngam o lorna sembe maako, e hoore iyam rufi sosai, o yidi ɓe tura mo iyam (blood transfusion), ɓe hokka mo leɗɗe ɓeydooje iyam, e nyaamdu ndu woodi nafu bana teewu e haako (vegetables).
4. Shawara am haa dada may, o tokka musnugo ɓingel may kosam endi maako wakkati fuu, ngam musnugo ɗon walla reedu pooɗa (contract) iyam bo dara.
5. O faddina ɓingel ngulɗum, o ɓamta laaɓal wuro e bandu maɓɓe, kadi o jooɗa nder sibiti haa likitajo wi'a o heɓi jam kanko e ɓingel fuu kamin ɓe lora wuro.

answer: Doccugo ɗo waɗi sanne, ɗum holla torra ndiyam ɓanndu (dehydration) kiiki. Walaago foofa walla semmbe ina waawi warde e ŋakkeende ndiyam ɓanndu malla nyawu pawɗe (convulsion) sabu soosugo. Ɓingel ngel haani nawteede asibiti mawɗo jaawngal ngam heɓugo enjekson e ndiyam laawol (IV) e safaara goɗɗo. So ɓe neldiima, ɓe njeena ndiyam ORS seeɗa-seeɗa wakkati fuu so o ɗoftaaki. Reenuwo oo yo hokka ɓingel ndiyam laaɓɗam e nyamdu, o artira asibiti law so o walaa foofa, o ɗoftii, malla so doccugo ɓeydii.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer: Nyau man ko "Meningococcal meningitis", ɗum woni ko bacteria naati ha ƴiiƴam e kwakwalwa waɗi daande tiiɗi, fofe, vilel, e peppetel vurtini ha ɓandu. Ko nyau kakkilango, o foti heɓugo lekki "Ceftriaxone" (antibiotic) ha ɗaɗol kisan ha asibiti, wanaa leɗɗe goji ɗe mbaawataa wallugo mo sabu ɗe ɓeydan tan hallugo. Tiiɗal daande, lara hite, e vilel ɗon holla bacteria man ɗon yaaji ha kwakwalwa, ɗum waɗi o haani ballital duktur yaawgo. Kawtu mo yaawgo ha asibiti mawɗo ngam o heɓa lekki antibiotic, ndiyam ha ɗaɗol, e ballital fofe ngam halkugo nyau man e danda nguurndam maako.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
answer: Ɗum ɗon wi'ee nyawu man "pije zazzabi" (febrile convulsions), ɗum ɗon heɓa ɓikkon tokoson to zazzabi maɓɓe ɓeydi mangu masin ha ɓandu. To ɗum ɗon waɗa, wallin ɓingel ɗon dow sera ngam o lohaay (choke), nden ta waɗu ko ɗume ha nder hunduko mako bana cokali ko lekki leɗɗe. Naftir ndiyam ɓulɗum (lukewarm water) ngam fappugo ɓandu mako ha zazzabi man ustoo, ammaa ta naftir ndiyam ɗam peewɗam masin. Yahdu bee ɓingel man asibiti lawlaw ngam likitoci ndaara ko saabi zazzabi man, bana maleri (malaria) ko nyawu sanye (meningitis) ngam ɓe mballa mo. Ta hulu, nyawu ɗo ɗon faasa to o heɓi lekki nden boo ɓingel man maunan acca ɗum.

answer: Ɓingel ngel ɗon mari rafi pofɗe e ɗofaare (neonatal sepsis/pneumonia) sabu rimayel e ndiyam dargo, den haaje arande woni hokkugo oxygen ngam wallugo pofɗe mako. Min mannga laawol nder ɓanndu (IV line) ngam hokkugo lekki Ampicillin be Gentamicin ɗi tiggata rafi ɓingel ngel, be ndiyam nder ɓanndu (IV fluids) seɗɗa. Min tila dada mako hokkugo ɓiraaki tan, o woppa ndiyam dargo ɗam sabu ɗum ɗon ɓeyda rafi. Min reena ɓingel ngel ha nder ward ngam en ndaara pofɗe, nguleeki ɓanndu, e ɗofaare mako kala wakkati. Ɗum ɗon laara laawol WHO ngam cellugo ɓiɓɓe rimayel ɓe ngala pofɗe moƴƴe, ɗum wallan ɓingel ngel heɓugo cellal.

question: mi yari sobajo am reduje mo ɗuɓi mako sappo e jetati ngam o nasti ɗayugo bo wakkati waɗi dey min yotti sibiti may ɓe hosi mo ɓe goddi mo ko handi fu ɓe tawi sembe iyam mako wa'i ɓe waɗi ko handi ni fu ɓe waɗa o dow der daƴugo o ɗon ni har ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sowri debbo mai o jaba ɓe waɗa mo siyas gam o dow der daƴugo ɗo neeɓi sobajo am sali sam o fi way o yiɗi dayugo ɓaroɓe ibrani'en dayata daga ɓawo o dayi ɓingel ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi o ɗo nder dayugo o dayi ɓingel debbo e jam kuma min yettore allah amma ko hilni am ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum ɓe dimbi akai akai mari wuji ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo o hokki ni amma fofugo wartai dei dei har jotta ɓe yawi ɓe hokki mo oxygen likita useni ɓingel ɗo hisan na be to o hisi o warta ɓingel mo wodi na foori na
answer:
Ko ɗum woni caɗeele ɓinngel ɗo mawɗe: foofugol ɗo boni, ɓe hokki mo oxygen, e “dimbigol” ɓanndu ena waawi wonde oksijin ŋakki mo nder jibingol (*birth asphyxia*), walla infection/sugaari lesɗi/convulsion.
Hisan makko Allah no e juuɗe likitaaji: o foti heddude nder neonatal unit, ɓe ƴeewa sugaari, infection, hitaande ɓanndu, ɓe hokku dawa convulsion/antibiotic so ena haani.
So wallitorde waɗaama law, ɓiɓɓe heewɓe ena hisa ɓe njogii jam; amma so oksijin ŋakki haa neeɓi walla dimbigol waɗii ɗuum, caɗeele hakkiilo walla jokkondiral ɓanndu ena waawi arde.
Woto ɓe jaltin ɓinngel ɗo sibiti fyrrude; so o ronkii foofude, o dimbii, o sala ƴamde, walla ɓanndu makko waylii, ɗum ko gawatiri.
Allah newnani mo, amma ɓe ɗoofto kala ko likitaaji neonatal mbi’i.

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. Lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwini mo sei o vi o dilli tan o yahi a sibiti heɓa ɓe hefta ko fe’ata be petul damuwa ɗo wawan hoina ɓingal ɗo damuwa ɓerde na ko asma ɗon fe’ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toi ɗon handi ɓingel ɗo handi acca heɓa ko. damata mo wadinta mo o dodda ho’ina mo usta sosai.
answer: Ko ɗuum ko waawi waɗde e rafi o: ko ɓuuɓri muusuɗo (pneumonia), TB, walla asma, nde tawno ko ɓuuɓri (cough), naange (fever), e fa'naare henndu ɗe njalti ko lekki galleeji safrataa. No woniri ɗuum, ko haani yo o jokkude e sibitaa ngam waɗde foto nder ɓalndu (chest X-ray) e ƴeewndorde kammu (sputum test) ngam hoolkisaade ko feewti e TB walla ɓuuɓri. So ko asma walla ɓuuɓri, ko leɗɗe ɗe ɓuuɓnata henndu (inhalers) walla antibiyotik (antibiotics) ɗe doktoor yamiri ko poti huutoreede ngam ustude ɗuum. Huutoraade lekki galleeji ɗii e rafi teeŋtuɗo ko njiyaani tan, ɗum waɗata ko rafi o ɓeyda bonde. Ɗum waɗata, acca mo o woppa lekki galleeji ɗii, o jokku e sibitaa haa o ƴeewtaake no feewi o heɓa safaara ko moƴƴi.

answer: Debbo maa on ɗon woodi iyam ɓaawo danygol, ɗum waawi wartaago diga tonus reedu (atonie) malla heddiingo geɗal leppol/bingel nder reedu, ko ɗum waɗata reedu waɗaaki semmbe darnugo iyam. **Kalar (rabies) woni ɗon lekki mari:** Ɓe fottii yaha asibiti law-law sabu rabies ko rawaandu duñi ko rafi cattuɗo hono maayde. Ndeen wutaandu ɓingel woni:
