## Ko woni caɗeele ɗe?

Ndaw debbo reedu maaru, mo woni e balɗe cukuri (2nd/3rd trimester), oo mari **naawɗi lesdi reedu** e **rufugo iyam sosai** (heavy vaginal bleeding). Ɗum firti woni **caɗeele bonɗe** njogii woni **Placental Abruption** (placenta seytii wanti reedu ado saatu), maa woni **Placenta Previa**, maa woni **fuɗɗorde jibingol ado saatu maaru (preterm labour)**.

## Alaamaaji hattara (Danger signs):
- Rufugo iyam ko heewi
- Naawɗi lesdi reedu doole
- Bingel mai anndaa woni (reduced fetal movement) — ɗum tinndina bingel oo woni e caɗeele.

## Ko foti waɗeede (Management):
1. **Yaha sibiti mawnga law-law** (emergency referral) — ndee nge doole waɗtata operation (Cesarean section).
2. **Ngaddan ɓiɗɗo iyam (blood transfusion)** sabu iyam heewi rufii.
3. **Etee IV fluids** ngam wallude balɗe maaru.
4. **Larugo bingel** e ultrasound e monitor ngam anndude woni bingel oo wuuri.

Ndaw caɗeele ɗum foti wallude **debbo e bingel fof**, kanjum ɗum foti yahude **sibiti mawnga** law-law, hade caɗeele ɓeydaade.

question: renowo ɓingel laari ɓingel may ɗo docca sosai nauɗum har karshe doccugo mingel nonnon tan fofugo daker toh ɗume ɗon waɗata doccugo haa ɓingel bannin tan har karshe doccugo may wala fofa boɗɗum daker daker fofata goji ɗume be ɗume ɓe wawata ɓe wanna ɓingel ɗo coɓoraaɗe toy min hokkata mo be kuma shawara toy hokkata reenuwo ɓingel may
answer:
Ɗum ena wayi no **ɓingel ɗon chokii**: nyaamdu walla huunde tokosere naati ɗaɗol, ɗum haɗi fofugo.
Si o hara ena docca walla woya, accitee mo o doccu; hoto hokku ndiyam/nyaamdu, hoto naatnu jungo e hunduko.
Si o waawataa fofa: ɓingel les hitaande 1—waɗee **ɗabɓe 5 e takko** e **tiiɗgol kirji 5**; si o ɓurii hitaande 1—waɗee **ɗabɓe 5 e takko** e **Heimlich/tiiɗgol reedu**.
Si o majjii walla o bonii, fuɗɗo CPR so aɗa waawi, ɗaɓɓu wallitorde gaggawa, njahaa asibiti/kiliniki ɓadiiɗo ko jaawɗum.
Shawara: reenoo ɓingel tawa o nyaamataa ko hawrataa huunde tokosere, kono hoto accitee mo e groundnut, kobo, kankana, walla wasaaji tokosuuji.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
answer:
**Jaabawol:**

Ndee ɓingel woodi maale konvulsiyo (feɓre nyawu wonande ɓikkoy tokosoy) wolla feɓre saɓaabu zazzabi (febrile seizure), sabu zazzabi nanngii ɓingel refti dimbagol e majjere hakkilo. Ɗum ina wonaa nyawu mawngu wonande ɓikkoy hakkunde lebbi jeegom haa duuɓi joy, kono ina foti laarude no feewi sabu ina waawi wonde maleeriya, meningite, wolla nyawu goɗɗo mawngu.

**Ko dada foti waɗde jooni:**
1. Waɗ ɓingel e leydi (bannge) ngam wata ɓe ututo, hokku ɓe ɓulli, taƴ comci ɓe ngam ɓuuɓnude ɓandu.
2. Wata ɓugɗu huunde e hunuko ɓingel, hokku ɓe paracetamol (syrup) ngam ustude nguleeki.
3. Yaaccin ɓingel haa suudu safaara (asibiti) yaawaare ngam laarude maleeriya (malaria test) e nyawu meningite, keɓa safaara feewuɗo.

Ustude zazzabi law law ko himmi ngam haɗde dimbagol ngam heddaade.

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer: Ɓuuɗol ngol e nder cugale (naawo) e taari (saru) on ko sabu ƴiiƴam ɓuuɓugol e nder ɓanndu, wonaa ko nyau sepperata naatata nder cugale. Nyau nguu ko baawɗe mboro bana malaria walla typhoid mboro on njuutata ko e mette cugale e taari ɓuuɗuɗe. Ɗamɗin hokka mo ndiyam Jewte (ORS) ngam lomtinde ndiyam ko majji e Paracetamol ngam ustude ƴiiƴam. Wanaa naafa lekki leɗɗe walla lekji goɗɗi tawa ko ɗe ngalaa doktoor njoɓɗini, ɗum waawi bonnude ɓingel on. So tawii ƴiiƴam ngal wanaa usta nder balɗe ɗiɗi walla ɓingel on waawi jega, nelngo mo to opitaal ngam ƴeewndaango ƴiiƴam e nder mboro.

question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
answer: Ɓingel ngel rafa rafi bonɗo no feewi ko wayi no ñawbuuli ɓernde (cerebral malaria) walla ƴiiƴe ɓernde (meningitis), ɗum noon alaa e sago ñaawo defte aadaaji ɗe ko wayi no cutugol ɗaɗe walla ɓuuɓnude ɗe, ɗe nana ɓeyda bonnude nguurndam makko. Ɓooygol ɗam (bulu) ina holla ɓingel ngel alaa butel (oxygen) e nder ɓanndu, ɗum noon ina poti yahde e safrirde (hospital) jooni ngam ɗaɓɓude cafrirɗe. Dammle ɗe e nder hunduko ina gasa tawa ko ɗe ngaddi ɗum sabu cutugol ɗaɗe ɗe njuɓɓini walla ko ñawu ngu ko wayi no ñawu ƴiiƴe (oral thrush). E nder safrirde, ɓe ɗokka mo butel, ñemre ngam dartinde kammu, e leppi ko wayi no antimalarial walla antibiotics ngam safrude ñawu nguu. Woppu rokkude mo leɗɗe galleeji, sabu ko safrirde tan woni ko waawi hisnude nguurndam ɓingel ngel e haɗde mboro o yahde e hoore.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
answer: Nyawu mbernde (heart failure) koo jofugo fofango wakkati ɗoyngol (sleep apnea) on waddata ɗooga fofugo, somre bee yawugo, e gundoore mawnde fajiri fu. Ɗon damuwa ɗo ɗon nyaama mbernde mako, e wawan waddugo maayde bee kuraas (sudden death) koo nyauneeji mawɗi ba "stroke" to ɓe keɓay kureerɗum law. Handi o yaha asibiti dondon ngam heɓugo auneeki mbernde (ECG koo Echo) e aunugo ƴiiƴam mako (blood pressure) bee teddungo mako. Alamaji hulɓinaaji ɗi handi kuuwa hakkilo dow maajum ngoni: naawege dow gaba (chest pain), taƴugo fofango ko o fowtaaki, bee ɓuutugo koyɗe. Yahugo asibiti law bee kuwtorgal magunguna handuɗi bee linyal likita on tan hisnata yonki mako.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
answer: Sannu ma, asali ɗuujugo bee saɗugo fofugo ɓingel ma haa jamma woni ngam jontere bee pabboje ɗon cuuɗi nder poofirgel maako. To jamma wari, peewol ɗon ummina kulle pabboje man, ɗum on saabi o ɗon ɗuuja nden fofugo ɗon saɗa mo. Taa hokka mo lekki tibi fahin, ammaa sodan mo kwayaaji pabboje je mawɓe. A taƴa kwaya man, a jillinda bee njuumri, a hokka mo o yara koo wakkati jamma. Ɗum wulan poofirgel maako, ɗum haɗa ɗuujugo man, nden bo ɗum booyan mo fof nder balɗe seɗɗa.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer:
Ɗee alamaji—yarugol ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, sillugol ɗuɗɗum jemma, sembe ɓamta, ɓandu ɓeyda ma yitere lara—ɓuri hollugo **ciwon suga (diabetes)**, amma foti waɗugo gwaji ngam tabbitude.
Yahaa asibiti/chemistry ngam auna **suga heɗen ƴiiƴam**: fasting blood sugar, random blood sugar, ko HbA1c; so suga no dow, likita hokkat loowe/insulin.
So o heɓii wonde o ɗo fota, o ɗo yarrata ndiyam no feewi, o ɗo hula/hakkille majji, o ɗo fowta ko numfashi yaawi—ɗum ko gawatir, yahaa asibiti jooni.
O acca zuma, soft drink, lemu mai zaki, shayi mai zaki, da abinci fari ɗuɗɗum; o ɲaama kaɗan-kaɗan: wake, kayan lambu, hatsi/tuwo kaɗan, kifi/kwai/nama kaɗan, e o waɗa yaha-yaha/exercise.
Ciwon suga no waawi feewugo so a ɗo auna suga kullum/kullum-kullum, a ɗo ɗowta magani, a ɗo rewata shawara likita.

question: dada joɗata ha fattude amin ɗo mari redu je ɓingel mako ɗiɗabo ha fuɗɗere redu mai komai o yaha dai- dai o ɗo nana belɗum ɓingel fere ɗo wara amma lewru seɗɗa ko saali ɗo o fuɗɗi nanugo les redu mako ɗo nawa nyande nawɗum mai waɗi mo sossai har dakai o darata boɗɗum neɓai sam ɓawo ton o fuɗɗi rufugo iyam sossai rufugo iyam mai nda no rufata ɗon ba rufi sossai kuma watti mo tuni o do somi nde o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri ta ni ɗon ko fe'i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi valli mo ɓeyahi sibiti ɗemle am kanjum ɗume ɗon watata nawugo les redu haa redujo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo alama hattara ɗon nana jey dada ko ɓingel haa redu may ɗume on alama goɗɗo larata redu may ɗon damuwa ɗon lekki jey darnata nawɗum may na ɓeddarna iyam may jey nawnata ɓingel may
answer: Nawugo les reedu bee rufugo ƴiiƴam sossai haa debbo ridaajo ɗon hollita caɗeele bana reedu sankitike (miscarriage) malla reedu heɓi haa yaasi jorngo (ectopic pregnancy), nden ɗum alama hattara mawɗo haa yonki dada bee ɓinngel fof. Alamaaji caɗeele ɗon ngoni rufugo ƴiiƴam sossai, nawnugo reedu naa heɓta jooɗugo, be sommugo ko faɗɗugo ngam ƴiiƴam lalli sossai. To caɗeele ɗon ngari, taa o naftira lekki darnugo nawɗum ngam hoore mako haa saare, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓesda rufugo ƴiiƴam malla mbonna ɓinngel haa reedu. Sey o yaha asibiti jaawɗum ngam likitoci lara ko wooɗi nden mballa mo bee lekki gaddotoondi jam bee kisndam.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer:
Iyam e tetteki (clots) ɗe a yi'i ɓaawo sati go'o e danyugo waawan laatago ngam luttal rida (retained placenta) walla nyawu nder reedu (endometritis), nden ɗum naa huunde meere ngam ɗum waawan waddugo asiri iyam (postpartum hemorrhage).

To a ɗon lara iyam ɗuɗɗam masin (ɗon hebbina pad go'o nder saa'i go'o), uurdi boondi diga jabuuru, ɓandu guldungel (fever), walla tampere masin, ɗum alamaaji hulɓiniiɗi ɗi mballataa ma anndugo woodi baasi.

Ta a jaɓu bolle wi'ooje ɗum huunde meere, ngam asiri iyam ɓaawo danyugo ɗon wadda maayde danyowo to a heɓay wallande dondon.

Handi a yaha asibiti dondon ngam likita'en korta ma, ɓe ndaara ko lutti nder reedu kadi ɓe mballce ma e lekkiiji poofooɗi (antibiotics e uterotonics).

Hakkilango hoore e tokkugo laawol asibiti ɓaawo danyugo (postpartum care) ɗon hisna danyaɓe diga baasiiji mawɗi e jankirde.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer:
Nyau dottijo ɗo mari ɗum mbarojum bi'eteeɗum **Meningitis** (nyau tewu miiyam ngaandi), musamman irin 'Meningococcal Meningitis' ngam o ɗon mari nawol hore tiiɗngol, daande tiiɗnde, fofe, fotofobiya (nyaw larde hite), be pepete ha ɓandu. Nyau ɗo ɗon raaba bee ɗisre walla soyre diga goɗɗo mo mari mborodi ndin, musamman saanga ngulɗum bee ceeɗu ha Naajeeriya.

Ngam tabbintingo nyau ɗo, sey likitaaji ƴetta miiyam ɓaawo daande (lumbar puncture) be ƴiiƴam ngam jarribugo ndaarol mborodi ndin ha dakin burtan (laboratory). Doon e doon, sey o hokkee lekki antibiotik bee faawu bana **Ceftriaxone** ha ɗaɗol bee lekki ustooji fofe be nawol bana **Paracetamol** ngam hisgo yonki mako bako nyau ndon lorta. Kadi, yimɓe saare mako walla ɓen ɓe o fotti bee maɓɓe sey mballitire bee kure (vaccines) walla lekki kaddoki nyau (chemoprophylaxis) ngam taa ɗum sankaroo ha ummatoore.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer: Tari tiiɗɗo jemma bee fofugo bee bone haa keccel lebbi tati ɗon holla alaamaaji guura (pneumonia) koo tari mboyri (pertussis/whooping cough). question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
answer: Ngel ɓingel walaa nyawu tibi, ɗum peewol naati nder kofol maggel dondini ƴiiƴam, ɗum on addani ngel ɗojjugo e saɗugo fofugo jamma. Lekki Tutolin huwata ngam nyawu man ɗum malaria nder ɓernde (chest malaria) addata ɗum, naa nyawu ɗojjugo meere. Saɗugo fofugo jamma ɗon wara ngam aɗa hokka ɓingel man ndiyam gulɗam, ɗum ɗon ɓesa maɓɓugo ɓernde maggel. Heɓa a ndaɗɗina mo, soodu lekki malaria mawɓe bee Ampiclox caplet, a jillinda a hokka mo o yara koo wato jamma. Kadi, lencin mo o waalo flat walaa pillow heɓa kofol maako maɓɓita; ɗum on lawol jam ngam ittugo nyawu man.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
answer: Fofugo jaawngo bee pofɗam ɗam walaa daidai nder ɓikkoi pettoi ɗon holla alaamaaji nyawu *Pneumonia* (muri/nyawu ɓesnooje), nguu woni nyawu kallungu masin. Yiwgo ɓingel bee ndiyam peewɗam ɗon ɓesda bone man, ngam ɗum waddan peewol ɓanndu cattuɗum (hypothermia) ngol faddata pofɗam ɓingel boo waɗa ngel lo’a. Darga yiwgo ɓingel ngel bee ndiyam peewɗam jooni-jooni, nden a saawa ngel nder wudere ngam ngel heɓa nguleeki ɓanndu. Yaar ɓingel asibiti lawlaw walaa fasaare ngam likita'en ndaara ngel, ngam hala kan ɗon laato masibo yonki. Ton nder asibiti, ɓe hokkan ngel henndu pofɗam (oxygen) bee lekki (antibiotics) ngam hisnugo yonki maagel.

Ndaa noone mi faami naamngal maa: Debbo darnjo (juuɗiiɗo/reedu) mo woni e zazzabi (feebru), refi non ɓernde mum fuɗɗi dimbaade, hakkilo mum wayli, wonaa hoɗi e hakkiilo laaɓngo — ɗum tinndina eclampsia.

**Ko foti waɗeede jaka:**
1. **Magnesium sulfate** ko lekki ɓurngi moƴƴude ngam haɗde/dartinde jinl (convulsions) — ko ɗum lekki gadiingi.
2. Ustu tampere (blood pressure) e lekki wa'i no **hydralazine** walla **labetalol** so tampere ɓuri 160/110.
3. Reena laawol henndu (airway), rokku oxygen, hisnu debbo o hokku ka o waasa yanude walla barmaade.
4. **Ko ɓuri himmude:** ummin debbo o yaha suudu safaraaji timmuɗi (referral) law-law ngam jibinngo ɓinngel ngel — ko jibinal tan safrata eclampsia haqiiqa.

Waɗ ɗum law sabu eclampsia ina wara neɗɗo e ɓinngel mum so safaaki law.

question: mi yari sobajo am reduje mo ɗuɓi mako sappo e jetati ngam o nasti ɗayugo bo wakkati waɗi dey min yotti sibiti may ɓe hosi mo ɓe goddi mo ko handi fu ɓe tawi sembe iyam mako wa'i ɓe waɗi ko handi ni fu ɓe waɗa o dow der daƴugo o ɗon ni har ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sowri debbo mai o jaba ɓe waɗa mo siyas gam o dow der daƴugo ɗo neeɓi sobajo am sali sam o fi way o yiɗi dayugo ɓaroɓe ibrani'en dayata daga ɓawo o dayi ɓingel ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi o ɗo nder dayugo o dayi ɓingel debbo e jam kuma min yettore allah amma ko hilni am ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum ɓe dimbi akai akai mari wuji ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo o hokki ni amma fofugo wartai dei dei har jotta ɓe yawi ɓe hokki mo oxygen likita useni ɓingel ɗo hisan na be to o hisi o warta ɓingel mo wodi na foori na
answer:
Ɓingel ngel e waawi hisgo ngam oxygen e kulle cafrigal ɗi ɓe kokkata ngel jooni, amma tiggol maagel ɗon teddi ngam neeɓugo nder daƴugo e ƴaw ƴiiƴam ɗi ƴeewi (preeclampsia) ɗi daada maagel heɓi.

Salagol jaɓugo aiki (CS) wakkati daƴugo waɗi ɓingel waasi heɓugo foofaango booɗɗum nder reedu, ɗum addani ngel sika wakkati danyeeki (birth asphyxia).

To ngel hisi, ngel waawan wartugo ɓingel cellungel, amma wodi tammaaku ngel heɓa caɗeele nder ngaandi maagel (brain damage) ngam rafi oxygen, ɗum boo waawan harla mawnugo e faamu maagel yeeso.

Likita'en ɗon ndaara ngel koondey ngam ɓe annda to ngaandi e ɓandu maagel fiyi kura, amma dole on du'anoo ngel heɓa jam e cellal.

Ngam yeeso, e wooɗi rewɓe reeduɓe tokka shawari likita'en wakkati daƴugo ngam hisnugo yonki daada e ɓingel, e taa ɓe tura kange to ɓe mbiaama aiki (CS) ngam jam maɓɓe.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
answer:
# Jaabawol

Ɓingel ngel woni e alaamaaji **cutcuki ɓernde ɓingel** (congenital heart disease), teeŋti noon **Tetralogy of Fallot** walla nyaw ɓernde goɗɗo, ɗum jiidi e ko nyaw ɓernde jibinaaɗo waɗata ɓingel fofa boɗɗum e nawnaare (cyanotic spells) tuma ngel wailii walla ngel gulli.

**Alaamaaji ganndinooji ɗum:** ɓingel fofa boɗɗum tuma ngel wailii, ngel wailtoo seeɗa seeɗa ngam tampere fofugo, e ngel wontugo bulu-bulu (cyanosis) heen sahaaji.

**Ko haani waɗeede jooni:** Yaaru ɓingel to hospital mawnge (referral) haa ɗon woodi **cardiologist** e masiŋ ɓanndugo ɓernde (echocardiogram) ngam faamugo nyaw ɓernde ngel woodi.

**Ballal:** Ɗum ngu safroro lekki tan; ngel foti waɗireede opereesiyoŋ (surgery) to ɓernde ndam, ɗum firti yo ɓingel yaaru hospital mawnge tawi ɗon woodi jaɓɓorɗe cutcuki ɓernde e opereesiyoŋ sabu ɗum foti dañaɗe ballal timmungal.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer: Alaamuuji ɗi a limti, bana ɓuuɗugo yeeso e kosɗe, naawalla hoore tiiɗka, gite daari-daari, e ɓamtol sembe ƴiiƴam (high BP), ɗon holla nyawu masibo bi'eteengu *severe pre-eclampsia* (hawugo ƴiiƴam mawngu ngam reedu). Ɗum nyawu nguuɗingu masin, ngam to o heɓaay lekki law-law, ɗum waawata addango mo pampo (fijugo koo convulsions) koo maayde mako e ɓinngel nder reedu. Mataki maapindiiji wakkatiire nde'e kanjum on yaargo mo asibiti mawɗo wakkati oon ngam likita'en pukkina mo (admission). Haa asibiti, ɓe lokka mo leɗɗe nder ƴiiƴam (bana *Magnesium sulfate*) ngam haɗugo pampo, ɓe jippina sembe ƴiiƴam mako. Lekki nyawu ngu'u timmungu kanjum on danyingo ɓinngel ngel wakkati oon, koo e seƴugo (operation), ngam hisnugo yonki inna e ɓinngel.

question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
answer:
Ɗum no wayi ko **candidiasis/thrush** ɗo hunduko ɓinngel: caccu/bulu daneeji ɗo ɗemngal e hunduko, ɓinngel ɗo wulla so o muynata.
Yo ɓe **lartu ɓinngel ɗo asibiti/dispensary**, sabu so hendu, bonnugol muynude, walla turagol ɗon woodi, ɓe ƴeewta ngam wonaa koɓgol goɗngol.
Lekki ɗo ɓe hokkata ɗo nokkuuje keewɗe ko **Nystatin drops** (walla miconazole gel so dokter yamiri), a waɗa ɗum no ɓe yamiri, kadi ndeena koore endam/ɓernde inna ndee laaɓɗum.
Ina woodi moƴƴi inna **jokkude muynugol**, kono so ɓinngel ɗo turra no feewi, ɗo waɗi hendu, ɗo haɗi yara, walla ɗo hoyni, yo ɓe yaa asibiti jooni.
Woto ɓe hokka lekki gargajiya walla antibiotics ko ɗo woodaani yamiroore, sabu ɗum ina waawi ɓeydude ɗam damuwa.

question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
answer: Alamaaji bana tonndu ɓawlayndu (cyanosis) bee tampere foofugo to ɓingel ɗo musina, ɗum holla nyaw ɓernde danyngal (congenital heart defect) malla nyaw boɓɓi mawngu. Nyaw man ɗon haɗa ƴiiƴam heɓugo hendu (oxygen) boɗɗum nder ɓandu, kanjum waddata ɓawlaago tondi. Naa lekki pamari tan ɓe hokkata, haani o yaara ɓingel asibiti mawndo lawlaw ngam likita'en cukuɓe (pediatricians) laara ngel. Ɓe mbaɗan bincike bana hoto ɓernde (echocardiogram) ngam anndugo asali nyaw man ngam heɓugo laawol lekki. Ɓaawo bincike, ɓe anndan irin magani ko yaawi, malla bo sai ɓe waɗi tiyata (surgery) ngam ɓingel woya.

answer: Malamin kiran da kike ji yana nufin jikin ki yana da matsaka da kuma samun kwayoyin cuta a cikin jini, wanda ke haddasa ciwon kai da kuma jin zafi. Domin tabbatar da wannan, ya kamata ki je asibiti domin a yi miki gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) da kuma gwajin zazzabin malaria ko kuma kwayoyin cutar kwayar jini (Typhoid). A yanzu, kina bukatar shan magungunan rage zazzabi da kuma kariya daga kwayoyin cuta wadanda za a ba ki da su bayan gwajin. Kuma yana da kyau ki rika shan ruwa mai yawa da kuma kwanciya domin jiki ya samu karfin da ya kamata. Idan ciwon kike ji ya karu ko kuma ki fara jin karkatar garkuwar jiki, ki nemi magani cikin gaggawa don kare rayuwar ki.

answer: Dammutore vurtotoonde haa babal rawandu ngati ɗo holli dow lekki gargajiya man ɗon huuwa boo ɗon fooɗa tooke rawandu ndun vurtina. Walaa haaje yaarugo mo asibiti ngam ɓe fukka allura ngati rawandu, ngam tooke mai fuu vurtake wakkati dammutore nden wurti. Safaare nde hani ɓe hokka ɓingel petel ngel ko paracetamol tan bee wujjugo nebbam mbodejam haa babal ngal kadi. Walaa koo ille feere wawan heɓugo ɓandu mako to ɓe wadi ɗum, o jamtatan law.

answer: Bingel, a common insect in Nigeria, is a vector for various diseases, including malaria, dengue fever, and yellow fever. The most common symptoms of a Bingel bite include itching, swelling, and redness at the bite site. In severe cases, Bingel bites can lead to anaphylaxis, a life-threatening allergic reaction. To prevent Bingel bites, it is essential to use insect repellent, wear protective clothing, and avoid areas with high Bingel populations. If a Bingel bite occurs, cleaning the area with soap and water and applying a cold compress can help alleviate symptoms.

Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
answer: Wannan halin da kuka bayyana, wanda ya hada da zazzabin jiki, zazzabin koya (malaria), da kuma fargaba, yana bukatar binciken jini (blood test) domin sanin kansa. Idan akwai zazzabin koya, muna ba da magungunan 'Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy' (ACT) wadanda suka zama mafi kyau a yankinmu. Idan kuma akwai fargaba, muna amfani da magungunan 'Antipsychotics' don daidaita yanayin kwakwalwa da kuma rage fargaba. Yana da mahimmanci a kiyaye tsawon lokacin shan magani ba tare da tsawaita ba domin samun cikam. question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. Dan wakkati odyota badi ha jotta koni mako ha wakkati konju kala on wurtoi to ingaya kam on no nana naudum naudum dobe jodata jodi naudum mako wurtai ridi mako arande on hakila am ummi be ta Miɗi mi yida binge on mi yiɗa mi soya binge ame warta dou sa'i ni foɗata nau ɗum on danyoda arande wa’ina noɗata ɓe wi'a binge ko tay vurta hite alura ko ɗon saika mo.
answer: Ee, goonga ma danyol arande ɗon ɓura ƴamugo wakkati e tiiɗugo gam laawol ɓingel wurtata meedaay mboowugo. Kono nyawɗum e naawalla hoore mawndu ɗi o wondi e mum ɗon holla alamaaji ƴiiƴam ƴettata nder reedu (pre-eclampsia), ko heewi heɓugo rewɓe haa reedu maɓɓe arandeere. Nyawɗum ɗum ɗon waddana inna e ɓingel caɗeele, fahin ɗon waɗa danyol ngol ɓooya koo ɓitta. Ko on ngari nyawndoore ɗum nafaari mawndi; likita'en ɗon ndaara ƴiiƴam maako e pottal ɓingel ngel. Munyee, on accu ɓe tokka ndaargo mo; to danyol ngol waawi haɗaago, ɓe mballan mo gam o danya jam e hoore lamdam.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer: Gorko ma ɗon mari nyawu nguu ngam ndiyam e sela (mucus) ɗon heewi nder bubuuji (lungs) mako, ɗum waɗi sollaare ɗon naawa mo. Ngam o warta daidai, a foti hokkugo mo lekki esugo mari 'codeine' heewɗum ngam ɗum darna esugo man pacak, bubuuji mako heɓa siwta. Kadi, o foti foofugo cuurki leɗɗe gulɗi wakkati-wakkati ngam cuurki man yoora ndiyamji e sela ɗon nder ɓandu mako. Taa acca o yara ndiyam koo seɗɗa, ngam yarugo ndiyam ɗon ɓesda sela nder ɓandu, ɗon fukka esugo. To o waɗi ɗum, foofugo mako wartan daidai, o joɗoto belɗum walaa haaje yahugo asibiti kadi.

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer: Lootugo fuutere nden bee ndiyam e saabunde lawlaw ko kuugal lobbal masin, amma ɓingel ngel haandi heɓa bakkal *Rabies* (vaccine) hannde-hannde ngam faddaago nyawu boosaaru ndun. Ngam boosaaru ndun meɗai heɓugo bakkal, nyawu mbuuɓri ndin waawan naatugo nder ƴiiƴam ɓingel, to ngu naati bo walaa safaara baawɗo hisnugo yonki maagel. Ha asibiti, likitaajo hokkan ɓingel ngel lekki buuɓri (antibiotics) e bakkal *Tetanus* ngam faddaago fuutere nden nyo'ugo. Likitto'en nyo'ata (suture) fuutere ngati boosaaru lawlaw ngam taa nyawu ngun lumba nder ɓandu ɓingel ngel. Ndan wakkilan woydu ɓingel ngel asibiti mawndi ngam ngel heɓa bakkal *Rabies* hannde-hannde walaa fasaago ngam hisnugo nguurndam maagel.

Ngam caɗeele foofaago, o huutoroo lekki piindiraangal *salbutamol inhaler* (bana Ventolin) nde o tampii, kono so o ɗon mari caɗeele balɗe fuu, doktoor waawi winndande mo inhaler goɗngal *beclometasone* (steroid) ngam haɓɓaade ɗum. Ngam jiiɓru jemma, jullere e julde ɓandu, o waawi yarde tablet *cetirizine 10 mg* (bana Zyrtec) jemma gooto, ɗum hisnan ko ɗuuɗi. O ɗaɓɓoo o daɗa ɓulli (dust), ɓoole (smoke), e heendu mawndu ngam ɗe mbaawan wadda tampingol. So tawii ɗum yahraaki, o yah asibiti militina ngam doktoor waɗa jarribooji goɗɗi, sabu e sahaaji goɗɗi caɗeele ɓernde walla nyawuuji ƴiiƴam ɗon saɗtina foofaago.

question: dai bo je jodata hasari amin o huwa dowada kugal mako bo o wala nyawu yande fere wakkati o do yi wa o nane en e mako do mari hunde petel satinga hada o numi wala ko dume o nani wala ko dume o lari o nani dum fahim nyande fere fahim do wakkati o dillai o fuddi numugo be mai sosai o fuddi numugo de mai on ha en e nyaku wala nyamugo molana wamo amma babali mai o sati bo sali dillugo o fuddi tum bo labari je ingol robbe je mari dum ha'i ndi naddi sati je sali o yahi larugo likita o yidi o anda dume on dasi dum de dumi on o wadata hala mai mdejema mdejemako mi on dasata hunde mai ha'i en idi bo ko mi onje satinga ha'i en i'o nagansa mi on de bolora talara fahim ha'i en imai
answer:
Ko on kaaloton ɗum no wa’i ko **majjum fahim/haala majjere** caggal hasara; ɗum waawi ummaade e **jorɗe hoore/ɗamol e nder hoore**, walla nyawu goɗɗo (malaria, sugar, stroke, infection).
Alamaaji ɗi—o nani/yi’i ko wonaani, o haala labari ngoonga wonaa, o sali nyaamude walla yahude asibiti—**ko haɗari**, hoto on ɗabbin.
Ɗillinee mo jooni to **asibiti/likita** ngam a ƴeewta BP, sugar, malaria, infection, e hoore (CT-scan so woodi).
Haa on yaha, woppitee mo e jam: wota o ɗow motor, wota on hokka magani/alcohol tawa likita yamira, ndeenee mo e hoore mum.
So o fainti, o heɓi seizure, o ruufi, hoore muusii no feewi, walla o waɗi ɗemngal/violent, noddee gargaɗe jooni.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
answer: To ɓe njauni ɓe kokki ɓigel man henndu fowfugo (oxygen), ɗum ɗon walla no feewi ngam o sellita bee jam. Amma, caɗeele fowfugo wakkati danygol waawan addingo caɗeele hoore (brain damage) to henndu yottaaki ɓenndu hoore ngam wakkati ɗuuɗɗum saabe danygol ngol neeɓi. Ngam ɗon, o ɗon mari haaje yaadu asibiti to likita sukaaɓe (pediatrician) ngam laartugo mawnugo maako bee caɗeele ɗon. Sukaaɓe ɗuuɗɓe heɓuɓe caɗeele ɗon ɗon sellita timmunde so tawii ɓe keɓi kandinol bee wallitoo jotta bee law.

question: ɓawo mi danyi ɓandu am fuɗɗi hoynugo kikiɗe fere ni mi numi tunda dai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam hafa to de am to mi yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum diyam ɓeddoti mi naftirta mi numi am hafa handi ni ɓiɗo hakkina hore am miɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigide fere bo wari mi nanai belɗum ɓandu am mi fuɗɗi nanugo jahagol be ɓandu am fuɗɗi diwunugo kullum kullum da miɗo nana jagol bo hauti be ɓandu am belɗum feyin semi hirliti iyam jey vurtata ɓawo daigo ɗon haccega minanata daga totton bo velai bo haccega mayi ɗuɗi bo meɗai feɗugo beyam mikasi ittugo gite am daga totton demi ummi sai ɗon miyahi sibiti mi'ema ko ndiyam labɗam jemi naftirta miyiwa bemai kamjum on wadda takalayam bawo daygo
answer:
Ɗum ko waawi wonde **hurum-hurum/allergie ɓandu**, walla **cukkuli (scabies)**/infection ɓandu, ko ndiyam ɗi laaɓaani, saabunde walla sewnde naawnuɗe ɓandu ngaddi.
Hoto njiyataa ndiyam bonɗam: **suuɗu/taaƴu ndiyam, seyɗin/boil ɗum**, walla huutora chlorine/tablet ɗi jeyaa, kadi njangu colte e leppi ɗi jeyaa.
So ɗum ko cukkuli, ɓandu ena nyaama ko jaɓɓi ma, soɗɗi ma e ɓesngu maa ena waɗi, ɗum waɗata ngam **Permethrin 5% cream** e ɓandu fuu jamma, kadi ɓe njangu leppi fuu.

# Jaabawol

Ndee mballa woodi ko fayti e **ɗojere ɓinngel** (constipation) e bimmuɓe—ɗum wonaa ko heewi caɗeele so tawi wonaa nde ɗon addi cellal boɗɗum.

## Ko poti waɗeede jooni-jooni:

1. **ORS e ndiyam**: Ustir dehugo ndiyam (dehydration) ko sabu maggol; hokku ORS so ɓinngel ɗon musa walla ɗon toonya, sabu ɗum newnan ɗojere e reedu.

2. **Sukkar ɓoccu (glycerin suppository) walla mballa suumugo reedu**: Nde poti wallude ɓinngel ta'ude ko newii; ustu waɗugo lekki dojugo (laxatives) heewi so alaa fotde.

3. **Ƴeewto alaamaaji bonɗi**: So ɓinngel ala nyaamde, ɗon ruttitoo (vomiting), reedu mun ɗon buutɗi (distended abdomen), walla alaa toorde e balɗe ɗiɗi—ɗum waawi wonde caɗeele bernooji (bowel obstruction) haaniri caatorɗe.

4. **Ƴeewto caɗeele jibinaaɗe**: Nde ɗojere fuɗɗi daga jibinngo (since birth) e balɗe sappo e nay, ƴeewto **Hirschsprung's disease** walla ittere anus feewnaani—ɗum haaniri ƴeewndo hakkille (surgical review).

## Ndaɗɗudi:
Miɗo yiɗi wallude on, kono **ɓinngel ɗum foti ƴeewreede e sibiti** (physical examination) hakkunde reedu e ɓoccu, sabu miɗo waawaa hokkude on ceɓal celɗungal e ndiyam nokku, e nder ɗee alaamaaji—ittugo caɗeele bonɗi ɗe foti ittiingal ko himmi.

Haa asibiti, likita'en mbaɗan ndaargal ƴattugo ndiyam ɓaawo (Lumbar Puncture) e ndaargal ƴiiƴam ngam anndugo tigi-tigi ko waddi nyawu ngun, bee ndaargal jontere (Malaria) ngam heɓugo safaara feewndaare. Yaawnu yahrude mo asibiti jooni-jooni ngam likita'en puɗɗa barmugo mo bee bakkale e leɗɗe ngam kisndam yonki maako.

answer: Alaamuuji ɗi a limti, bana ɓuuɗugo yeeso e kosɗe, naawalla hoore tiiɗka, gite daari-daari, e ɓamtol sembe ƴiiƴam (high BP), ɗon holla nyawu masibo bi'eteengu *severe pre-eclampsia* (hawugo ƴiiƴam mawngu ngam reedu). Ɗum nyawu nguuɗingu masin, ngam to o heɓaay lekki law-law, ɗum waawata addango mo pampo (fijugo koo convulsions) koo maayde mako e ɓinngel nder reedu. Mataki maapindiiji wakkatiire nde'e kanjum on yaargo mo asibiti mawɗo wakkati oon ngam likita'en pukkina mo (admission). answer:
Ee, naftirgo ndiyam ɗam labaa ngam lootugo malla iirtugo ɓandu ɓaawo danyugo na faddan jonte e puyre danyuggo (*puerperal sepsis*). Nde a danyi, nokkuure danyugo nden ɗon feera, ndiyam ɗam labaa boo ɗon mari koorooji (*bacteria*) nasta nder, wadda jonte, diwunugo, e iyam ɓaawo danyugo bee haccungo.

Ɗum ɗon, ɗon waajibi a naftira ndiyam labɗam, mbelnaaɗam ngam lootugo ɓandu e nokkuure deedaaye ngam reenugo cellal ma. Ngam jonte e haccugo man, haaje ma ɗon woni lekkiiji mboyri (*antibiotics*) haa asibiti ngam sooytugo puyre nde e hisnugo yonki ma.

answer: Kulol ɗam e ɓernde yaawde hawnude ɗe o mari ɗen ko ɓuuɓol hakkille (anxiety/PTSD) ɗe ngaddi ko sabu fitinaaji e tooñannge gorko makko ɗin. Omo foti arde suudu nyawndeeji ngam rokkoreede lekkiiji kiiɗtinkoɗi kulol ɗam e heɓde yeewtere ballal (counselling) ngam wallitde mo jogaade hakkille. E sabu nguurndam makko ena nder kisre e tooñannge ngol, o foti ɗaɓɓude ballal ummii e ardiiɓe renndo malla kiiseeji ngam seertude e gorko oo. question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
answer: Tarihi cattuɗi, fofugo lau, be salugo musnugo ɗo holla alamu nyawu gidaaɗo nawɗum bana 'pneumonia' ko bo fuɗɗoode fuka (asthma) haa keccel. Nyawu man ɗo ɓura nyadugo jemma gam jaangol, ko bo curki wuro (bana leɗɗe defugo ko tapozi) be kura ɗon omba laawol heendu ɓingel, ɗum waɗa o fofa be bone. Angal heendu laɓɓundu ɗon haɗa keccel man ɗana woka jemma, kadi ɗum wawan waɗugo hasare mawnde ngam ɓingel ɗon maaya heendu. Taa hokka ɓingel lekki tarihi wuro; likita asibiti wawan hokkugo mo lekki mbarmu (antibiotics) to ko 'pneumonia', ko lekki ombitirki gidaaɗo to ko fuka waɗi mo. Gam hisnugo ɓingel ma, sora mo nguleeka jemma, woɗɗin mo diga curki, nden a tefa kowale kala o musna gam o heɓa ndiyam be sembe.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
answer:
# Jaabawol

Kuje ɗe kaalu-ɗaa fu—wula bandu, bingel yiddi saali, hunduko puuɗam ɗiyam ɗo, e bingel wawaa nyaamde—maɓɓan ɗum e maale **safari ɓowɗo (malaria)** be nyauɗo ɓaleeje, kono kadi ina waawi wonde **nyawu keɓal (infection)** wo'aa buri sanne.

Woodi ko ɓuri himmude: bingel wawaa nyaamde e ronki yara fu, ɗum wonan موتوکو ماوندو, سابابا o waawi heɓde **danndaare ɗiyam (dehydration)** e wattidde nguru kaɓaru.

Miɗo wi'a ma: **hoto ɗaɓɓaa safaari gargajiya (safarhoore aduna) walla nyaamirde nyauɗe ganndi**, sabu ɗum ɓeydan nyawu ngu tan e waawi wonde لورا e beeɗu (hunduko puuɗam) e liver bingel oo.

**Wallu bingel to safirdu (asibiti) jooni jooni**, ngam ina foti heɓde binndol لاری مالاریا (RDT), lekki safaari malaria (ACT), e لیککی keɓal so tawaama nyawu keɓal woodi, e وا للا دیام so danndaare woodi.

Jokku njorndi maayo (breastfeeding walla دیام safirteeɗam) so bingel waawi yarde, kono to o ronki fu, حوتو leelnaa—yaadu asibiti hannde hannde لیینی فوف.

Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. answer:
Ɗee ɗaɓɓe ɗe a holli—futtiingo yeeso, juuɗe e koyɗe, naange hoore, ɗaanaaki, e “BP” to 150—ina foti waɗde **bone reedu-kidney walla hawan jini mawɗo**; so debbo on ina jogii ciki, ina foti wonde **pre-eclampsia**, ko haɗiinde ɗo mawni.
Ɗum waawataa habde e lekki gida walla “herbs” tan; waɗee mo **gila hande** to asibiti mawɗo/ER ngam waɗde BP, fitsari protein, urea/creatinine, electrolytes, full blood count, malaria, e pregnancy test.
So o heɓii ɗoyngol, miijo yahugo, ɗaɓɓere, fitsari ɗo ɓeydii/seɗɗa, ko ciwon kirji/numfashi—ɗum ko emergency.
To asibiti ɓe njogoto mo lekki hawan jini/diuretics walla maganin ciki no haaniri, sabu ngam a hisna kammu e reedu mako.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer:
Ɗum ena waawi wonde **jinl/zunzuma sabu zazzabi** (febrile convulsion), kono **malaria mai tsanani, meningitis walla infection** ma ena waawi waɗude ɗum.
Ɗum ko **haɗari**, a waɗa haraawa: **naatinaa ɓingel ngal asibiti/PHC jooni-jooni** ngam a ɗon ƴeewta malaria, sugar, infection, tee a waɗa magani.
So ngal fuɗɗii dimbugo, **ɓennu ngal e sawru/side**, ittude ko woni e hunduko, **woto njaru ruwa ko magani e hunduko**, woto njogoo ngal haa sembe.
So dimbugo ngal ɓuri **miniti 5**, walla hakkilo makko artataa, walla wuurngol/mettitgol neck, ɗum ko **emergency**.

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer:
Mi faami sun'u maa. Ɓingel maa duɓi nayi, ɗon nyawa nyaw mo wi'ete "sickle cell" (ɓoli-ɓoleeje), ɗum waɗi cuggal ɗon foti hitta e futere.

**Ko foti waɗeede:**

1. **Yaha to lopital manngo (specialist):** Nyaw ngu ina foti wallireede haala doktoor mo andi ɗum. Ɓe njeytoto ɓingel maa e ndiyam ɓalndu (test), ɓe cuɓoto lekki jokkiingel.

2. **Lekki ɗi poti:** Ɓe mbi'ete "hydroxyurea", ndi ina wallita cuggal (crisis) e nyawɗe. Wonaa lekki mo njoɗtortaa e daawal — ina soklina doktoor mo andi ɗum.

3. **Ndiyam ɗuuɗugo:** Yaru ndiyam ɗuuɗum, waɗ ɓingel maa ina yara ndiyam ko heewi, sabu ngesa ndiyam ina wallita hebbina cuggal.

4. **Folic acid** — ndi ina moƴƴi ɓe njokka fii ƴiiƴam.

**Kaɗugo cuggal e nastugo futere:**
- Reen ɓingel maa e ɓuuɓɗi (cold), e nokkuuru buuɓngu, e ronkere (stress), e ɗiggere (dehydration).
- To cuggal fuɗɗii, waɗ ndiyam heewa, hokku lekki ronkiɗinoowo naawɗe (paracetamol), jaɓɓo doktoor law.

**Ndaartugo:** Alaa lekki gootel ndi haɗata nyaw ngu haa laaɓa, kono ndaarugo lopital e lekki cuɓaaɗi ina wallita ɓingel maa yaha yeeso e cellal. Yaha to lopital manngo law fii wallugo mo.

Aɗa haani a nelda mo asibiti mawɗo law ngam o heɓa ƴiiƴam be opareesu, sabu rufugo iyam sosai ɗon haɓɓa yonki. Nde aɗa nelda mo, laatimo o lelii, a ɗon hokka mo laccitirɗe ɗen, kuma a ɗon reena nguleeki mako. Ngam hisnugo yonki mako, neldugo mo asibiti mawɗo law be hukkugo laccitirɗe ko woni mataki geggewal ɓurɗo haajugo.

answer:
Alaamaji ɗi a limti ɗo, bana yarugo ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam, sillugo akai-akai, lo'ugo ɓandu, e wumre gite, ɗi ɗon holla alamaaji nyawu suga (diabetes) nangi gorko ma.

Ɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓandu ɗon tefa wurtinki suga ɗuuɗɗum nder ƴiiƴam ta laawol silleeji, ɗum hokka mo ɗonka ndiyam, nden sootaaki suga ngam heɓugo sembe waddata soomaye ɓandu mako e matsala gite.

Yaru mo asibiti wuro mon lawlaw ngam likita en ƴeewa suga ƴiiƴam mako saa'i o suumii (Fasting Blood Sugar) e ɓamtuki ƴiiƴam (Blood Pressure) ngam tabbitingo nyawu nguu e hokkugo mo safaare de heedata.

Daga jooni, o acca yarugo kuujeji mari suga koo ndiyam leemuuji mbilaaɗi, o ustita nyaamduuji tedduɗi bano nyiiri, o ɓesda nyaamugo haakooji e tokkugo yarugo ndiyam laaɓɗam ngam ɓandu mako heɓa ndiyam.

Awnugo suga ƴiiƴam e sappoondirgo bee likita handi waɗee akai-akai no likitaajo umri, ngam a lura e laamu ɓandu mako e faddaago naawallaaji goɗɗi.

Ko mari nafa hannden woni a yaawa be maako ha asibiti mawɗo ɓadiiɗo on nannoni ngam heɓugo lekki mboɗe ha ɗaɗi (intravenous antibiotics bana Ceftriaxone) e wallitande goɗɗe. answer:
Bingel lewruuji nayi (4 months) to woni e bosaru/yarsude, a yahdu mo nautorde/asibiti hannde, sabu o waawi heɓde ɗoyngol ndiyam (dehydration) ko yaawi.
Tee e ɗamtugo/ɗokkugo nono no feewi; so a heɓii ORS, hokku mo ɗooɗum-ɗooɗum caggal kala bosaru.
So ORS alaa, waɗ ndiyam laaɓɗam lita 1 + shukare cuɓe 6 + gishiri cuɓel heewaani (1⁄2 teaspoon), hokku ɗooɗum-ɗooɗum; hoto waɗ lekki wuro walla lekki dartinirɗo bosaru.
Zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala haa ñalɗi 10–14 wawi wallude, kono dokita/ma’aikacin lafiya yo hollu dose.
So fuɗɗere hoore naatii, hunduko ɓorni, o ɗamataa, o yaltataa pissi, o waɗi ngulɗi, ƴiƴam e stool, walla o tampii/no hoyi—ɗum ko gawat, yah asibiti jooni.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
answer:
Debbo reeduujo mo duuɓi cappande tati (30) bee reedu lewru ɗiɗi mo ɗon tuuta masin (Hyperemesis Gravidarum) haani yahugo asibiti bee law ngam heɓugo ndiyam ɓandu (drip) bee safareeji ngam o heɓta sembe.

O huutora nyaamdu keeccum bee seeda-seeda bana biskiit (biscuits) ko leri belɗum, o hefta nyaamgo kuuje tekkuɗe ko ɗe leydi (oily/spicy foods).

Yarugo ndiyam ORS, dakamme, ko ndiyam ɓulɗam ɗon wallita masin ngam ɓandu maako yoora jiiɓol (dehydration).

Lekkiiji bana 'Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine)' bee 'Promethazine' ko 'Metoclopramide' ɗon kuutore ngam ustugo tuutre nden, ammaa sey bee yamiroore doktoor ngam reento ɓingel ngon.

question: Dana kesum ko danya e ha asibiti amen minti cappanɗe ɗiɗi ko waɗi ɓingel waɗi nuɗum danyi woya woya teli nude danya ngel wadai woyade boɗɗum min yiwi fu nanugo mako tidum no bingel delabi tan mi yiwi kadi tamreji mako tidum no alai nalle mako ko dume. Ɓingel kesum waɗi danyi ha ɗa'i waɗa de boɗɗum gele danya harnuje jamu wala doraja. Ɓingel foti heɓɗe e nati wuro ɓingel ko ɗume o wawi kokkude ɓingel ti ko ɗume o wawa hokkude ha irin nyau. ma nyamana enjamgel ma waɗi enjam.
answer:
Mi hokkete jaabuye e ɗe naamnde:

**Waɗde ɓinngel woytaaki gila danaango:** Ɓinngel mo woytaaki e nder minti sappo caka danaango, e ɓaawo mum tampere e teentungol, ina waawi tinaade wolde e "birth asphyxia" (ronkere ɓinngel heɓde henndu no haani e sahaa danaango). Ɗum ko caɗeele mawɗe — jokkondir e asibiti tawa ɓinngel yeeso doktoor walla nurse wonande **resuscitation** (ummitingol foofaango) yaawnde.

**Waɗde tammareji tiiɗdo:** So tammareji (jiiba) ɓinngel tiiɗi walla ina ɓoloo, ɗum ina waawi holldude jeyaango ɗon walla jaango — jokkondir e safrooɓe fii yeewtinde walla ittude jiiba maɓɓe.

**Ñaametee ɓinngel:** Ɓinngel foti heɓde tan **birdi endam yumma mum** (exclusive breastfeeding) gila jibinaa haa lebbi jeegoo, hay ndiyam ɗoo alaa; endam ndaaman yiiwan ɓinngel jamu, hisnan mo e nyawuuli, tokkoo yaltinde mo bonnere ɓalndu.

**Njaafodaa:** Rokku ɓinngel endam sahaaji fof so wela mum tinii (jofnde 2–3 e nder waktu), tawa a woppaani mo woytaade juuti tawa a rokkaani.

answer:

Ballal maa: waɗ mo yiɗde e hakkille, wallito mo yaltina metteende makko, jokku e ñaameteeɗi cewɗi ko o yiɗi (heewnude leemuuje, mbaroori, kosam), addana mo ñaametal laabi keewɗi caggal—suka fowti ñaama, wonaa suka mawɗo. question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer: Kuje satiɗum nder endi debbo man, ɗum ƴii'yam wondi e kosam fotti ɓuuti ngam gorko maako ɗon muusa endi man jemma. Muusugo endi bee sembe ɗon lora ɗaɗi nder maajum, ɗum waɗa kuje satiɗum bana ɓuure. Walaa haaje o yaha asibiti larugo likita; o heɓa ndiyam ngulɗam o ɗon wogga babal man subaka e kiikiiɗe. O hana gorko maako muusugo endi man har sati ɗiɗi, kuje man saayata kanko e hoore maako. Nyau kansa endi walaa naawata bana nii, ngam maajum taa o damu hoore maako o lora fuɗɗa kugal maako.

answer: Bingel man don mari nyaw rai (meningitis) e o musinimo sabu o yari "damba" e ndiyam gora laabataa, ko addi bofde maako yaha dow. O haandi o naatna emergency haa jooni ngam min mballa mo fofa, min tilla lekki gora fu, min hokka mo IV antibiotics (bana Ampicillin e Gentamicin) e IV fluids. Min vindina mo "Lumbar puncture" ngam Æ´eewgo ndiyam rai maako (CSF), "Blood culture", e "FBC" ngam min annda no feewi ko woni nyaw man. Min hokkata mo oxygen e lekki ballitooki to o haandi, nden min janngina inna maako wata o hokka bingel damba abada sabu don wadda musibiti. Ndaarugo bingel preterm (balde 36) e asibiti (NICU) no feewi waawi hisnugo nguurndam maako daga musibiti lekki gora.

answer: Miɗo faama hillo maa; ɓingel ngel heɓii ŋakkere henndu (birth asphyxia) sabu dayugo ngoo ɓooyii no feewi haa iyam mako ustitii. To ngel hisii, no ngel wartirta e foori (tampere ɓernyel) ina fawii e no ŋakkere henndu ndee heewiri e no ɓernyel ngel tampiraa. Likita'en ina ndokka ngel oxygen ngam wallitugo ɓernyel ngel hoota, amma ɗum ɗaɓɓi ƴeewtago ngel e lebbi garooji ngam anndugo no ngel mawnirta. Ko haani jooni ko jokkugo wasiyaaji safrooɓe, hokkugo ngel nonniri, e ɗaɓɓitugo ballal physiotherapy to a tawii ɓanndu mako ina tiiɗi walla ina looyi. Allah wallu ngel hisa e jam, amma e wakkatiiji garooji, jaɓɓaade wasiya siyas to dayugo ɓooyii ko huunde hisnunde nguurndam e haɗoode foori.

Ɗum heɓata ko nde ɓiɗɗo o heɓi ñawu baasal ɓanndu, haa teeŋti nde o haɓaama musngo non boo o fuɗɗii ñaameteele kese ɗe mbaawaa mo.

To ɓiɗɗo wooki, woto ngoppu e miijaade colique walla lekkije ɗe mobel, ngam ɗum alamu emergency caatuɗo; fofa wuliingo e ɓuttiingo ko huunde ɓanndu meeɗaani yi’eede.
Nyaamu, defte walla lekkije leɗɗe ɗe nguurndam wonaa haɗude ñawu ngu; aɗa waɗa hasre heɓa ɓiɗɗo maaɗa ɗana boɗɗum jemma tan ko e yaawgo haa dokto’en mbaɗa safaara timmuɗo.

Ofuddi numugo ko don ye’u je wattada damuwajido . Jango mai sai o volwini gorko mako beyaha sibiti be laara likita, heba be hefta ko daamata mo. Demde mai, dumedon waddata dojjugo kalnudum banni be yawugo somugo, be foofugo daker do? Damuwa do wawan ko shafi balle na ko ye’u ko shafi berde?. Alaamaji kalnudum je damuwaji foofugo je dardiraabe haadi laara, hakilina je dojjugo be foofugo daker do?
answer: Debbo laari gorko maako o dojjugo nonnon ni fuɗɗata o neeɓa ni bako dara balɗeji o waɗa ni o laari gorko maako o yara bone foofugo to o yaaɓi seɗɗa ni ko o fa'i scal o do dara lorna foofɗe maako nden bo o do yawa soomugo be lau don nyande gorko maako neɓi o do ɗojja be o do haɓda lorna foofɗe ɗami debbo may o fuɗɗi numugo ko ɗon nyawu je waddata damuwaji jango may sai o volwini gorko mako be yaha asibiti ɓe lara likita heba ɓe hefta ko damata on ɗemɗe may ɗume on waɗata ɗuttugo kalnuɗi bannin be yawugo somugo be fofugo dakere ɗo damuwa ɗo wawan ko shafi ɓerɗe na ko yanko shafi ɓerɗe hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko tsarna goɗɗo bone fofugo harje goɗɗo mai handiri dasa hakkilo yauɗiɓe alamaji kalnuɗun je damuwaji fofugo je derdiraɓe handi lara hakkilina je tsugo be fofugo da kerɗum.

answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa gorko yana da matsalar ɗan ƙarfi a cikin jikinsa wanda ke sa shi ya ji nauyin da kuma faduwar ƙarfin jiki, wanda galibi yana faruwa ne saboda ƙarancin ƙarfe (anemia) ko kuma matsalar ƙaɗanacen riga (malnutrition). Dole ne ka kai shi asibiti domin yin gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) don sanin ko akwai ƙarancin ƙarfe ko kuma wani ƙoshin jiki (infection) da ke cin ƙarfin jiki. Idan ƙarancin ƙarfe ne, za a ba shi ƙarfe da kwayoyi masu ƙarfin jiki da kuma abinci mai gina jiki don daidaita jikinsa. Zai yiwu kuma ya kasance akwai matsalar ƙarfin jiki saboda wata cuta ta ƙasashe (parasitic infection) wadda ke sa jiki ya rasa ƙarfin da ya kamata. question: Ɓawo mi dayi bandu am fuɗɗi hoinugo kirinni min dadai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam ha fattude en yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum ndiyam be dotti min naftirta min ma fa. Hakina hore amin ɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigi fere bo wari min nana belɗum ɓandu amin fuɗɗi nanugo jagol be bandu am fuɗɗi dimugo kulum nda min ɗo nana jangol bo hauti be bandu amlai fahin semiti iyam je vurtata bawo dayugo. haccenga min nanata daga totton bo valai bo haccega mai dudi bo medai fedugo be am mi kasitugo giteam daga totton de mi ummi sei don mi yahi sibiti mi’ama ko diyam laɓɗam je min naftirta mi yiwa be mai kanjum. waddata kala wodago.
answer: Ko a nani ɗon woni alaamaaji mbononda ɓandu ɓawo dayugo (puerperal sepsis), nden ɗum nyawu mawnungu nguje heɓata debbo saabe naftirgo ndiyam nyoluɗam. Jaangol, ɗimmooje ɓandu, be haccenga ƴiiƴam ɗam vurtata holli woni mbononda ɗon haa nder reedu maa nden ɗum woni jofngu haaje yaadu sibiti. Yahu sibiti joni-joni ngam likitootooɓe mballa ma be lekkiiji (antibiotics) ko hisnata yonki maa bako nyawu ngun mawnugo fahin. To ndiyam laɓɗam walaa haa fattude mon, sey nattiron ndiyam ɗam ɗon tufa (boil) bako kuwtinon ɗam ngam laɓɓingo ɓandu mon. Hore maa heɓugo jam woni ko ɓuri haaje joni ngam a joondu be jam e ɓinngel maa bo.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer: Ko honno feewi, waɗtu ɗum adii ɓuri ko waɗugo wadata: waɗtu jadduɗe daawuɗe, nafoore, e ɓeyngu kala ñalngu, kadi haɗtu tatiinde e ɓanngel kala sahaa. Ɓeydu golle ɗiɗi-ɗiɗi, waɗtu ɗum foti fii seeɗa, tee kuutoro bikkon e sifannde (visual) ngam ɓeydude faamugol e heɓtugol hakkille. Momtu ɓe e jawdi: njaaɓndi e jam, njiylawol yahdude, mboddi e leemun, e faamdu no feewi wonde ko hakkunde mo ɓuri no waɗi. Momtu kadi no feewi waɗugo baawɗe ɓenndude e ɓanngel, kadi addi waɗude goonga e mo, tee yaltu sankiraaji. So ɗum ɓuri, walla alaa ɓuri fayde, yah to asibiti ngam warorde ɗaɓɓitde mawnude ko feewi (jiital, kordeji, hakkunde ko ADHD walla waɗɗere sawru) ngam feere e tappugol mawɗo.

question: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti. Men waɗi ƴamde dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo? Ɗume wawi heɓɓa futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Tii, ko ɗume mi waawi waɗɗuko ngan to nƴau nata futtere on? Ɗume Njibinanɗe e lekki haani hokka bingel on gan hebɓe Jam? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
answer: Wannan ɓingel ɗe nawa ɗe nawa (diabetes) ne, wanda yake faruwa idan jiki ba zai iya saru suƙari (glucose) yadda ya kamata ba. Bayanin cewa ɓingel ɗe ne, shi ne saboda samun suƙari da yawa a jini (hyperglycemia), wanda ke sa mutum jin jin ƙiƙirƙi da kura. Don saru ɗum, dole ne ɓingel ɗe ya riga kishi a kanka, ya yi motsi, kuma ya cin abinci da ba su da suƙari da yawa. Akwai kuma amfanin magungunan da likita zai ba shi don daidaita matashin suƙari a jini. Idan ɓingel ɗe ya bar kishi, zai iya samu matsalar ƙashi ko matsalar ƙaifin kura (ketoacidosis) wanda ke haifar da mutuwa.

Ɗee alamaje—ɓernde fiya law-law, tampere, jungo dimbude, ɗande/koɗol ɓeydugo—ina fitinaade nyawu **thyroid/goitre (hyperthyroidism/Graves)**, kono anemia, malaria walla nyawu ɓernde maa ina waawi waɗude ɗum.
Debbo reedu o yahdu **asibiti/ANC ɗoon ɗoon** ngam a waɗa BP, Hb/ƴiiƴam, malaria test, ECG so woodi, e test thyroid **TSH/Free T4**; hoto o huutoro lekki walla maganin gargajiya ɗooɗɗum.
So thyroid ɓurti, likita ina waawi hokku mo lekki kisɗo e reedu; so a woppii, ɗum waawi waɗde zubar ciki, haihuwa ɗooɓɗo, bingel ɓurta famɗude, BP reedu, walla heart failure.
Alamaaji haɗari: numanɗe/henndu ƴeewde, ciwon ɓernde, fenteede, fever, amai ɗuuɗɗum, ciwon hoore mawɗo/yiite mum woni leydi, ƴiiƴam jippa, walla bingel dilli famɗi—yahdu emergency.
O nyaamu nyamduji celluɗi e protein, folic acid/iron ɗum ANC hokkata, huutoro gishiri iodine no feewi; o fanyina coffee/cola/energy drinks, hoto alcohol/sigaare, e hoto o ɓeyda iodine walla herbal drugs.

question: ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hanɗe fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha mako sosai fa kuma ɗo sakli mo ɗa seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o wi meɗi feɗugo ɗe ɗiɗi ko sali ɗe fe'ata o ɗo nana nauɗum den bo iyam mai rufata a rufata be emi ko reɗu ɗon rufata o wi o anda ko oɗon mari reɗu ko oɗo be reɗu be emi dai o lari al'ada mako o wi neɓai ko o lari o wi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo em ɗo fuɗɗi dai hande fajira useni ɗume on watata debbo rufugo em sosai ɗo banni mataki geggewal toi hosata yahu ndigi toi hokkata debbo ɗo hisnu yonki mako be darnata emmai lekkiji toi be bateji toi be hokkatamo je darnata emmai
answer:
## Nafsee Feejo (Emergency) - Debbo mo Iyam Rufata

Nii woni deytaare nde huutortoo debbo mo iyam rufata sanne (severe postpartum/vaginal bleeding), tawa reedu woodi walla o rimii:

**1. Darnude iyam ndeen law (Resuscitation):**
Waɗ IV line ɗiɗi mawɗi, hokku mo **Normal Saline** walla **Ringer's Lactate** law fii yo iyam mako ummito. Darnu al'ada mako (pressure), heɓsere (pulse), e nauɗum (temperature).

**2. Lekkiji ɗi darnata iyam (Uterotonics):**
Hokku mo **Oxytocin** (10 IU IM walla e IV drip), walla **Misoprostol** (tabo 600-800 mcg fii nder becce walla nder ɓorki). Ɗiɗi ɗam ina darna reedu mako yo o hoɗtu fii dartinude iyam.

**3. Ƴeewndo sabaabu (Cause):**
Ƴeew si reedu mako yoora (uterine atony) - moƴƴin reedu junngo (uterine massage). Ƴeew si woodi ɓaawo tiggu (retained placenta) walla nawnere (tear/laceration).

**4. Nawtu mo suudu mawndu (Referral):**
Si sibiti maa alaa doole (blood transfusion, operation), nawtu mo law-law to suudu mawɗu, tawa oɗon jokki lekki e IV fluids e hoore laawol.

**5. Ƴeew ɗeen:** Waɗ mo **cross-match** fii ƴiiƴam, sabu o foti heɓa ɓeydannde ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion).

*Ndee wonaa fii sabbaade - waɗ ɗum law fii yo o daɗa!*

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer:
Ɓinngel duuɓi 4 so ina waɗi tari/ɓosaru walla mura, ko feewi ngam o yahdu to asibiti ngam dokita ƴeewta mo—sabu o waawi wonde mura tan, asthma, pneumonia walla malaria.
Hokku mo ndiyam/kunun no feewi, nyaamdu, e zuma seeɗa so o ɓurii hitaande 1 ngam tari; paracetamol tan so o waɗi jontinoore, e doosi ɗi dokita walla rubutu lekki wi’i.
Hoto hokka antibiotic, cough syrup mawɗo, walla “lekki gida” tawa dokita ƴeewtaaki, sabu ɗum waawi bonnude.
Yahdu gila jooni to asibiti so o ina haɓɓitii henndu, fuu-fuu ɓurti, ɓernde/daande na njippa, jontinoore mawnde, o haɗii yarude/nyaamude, o na tampi no feewi, walla tari ɗin ɓurii balɗe 2–3.
Ɓosaru/tari waawi yaade nder futere/hendu ngam pneumonia, kono ƴeewtagol dokita tan hollata lekki mo haani.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
answer: Dada gorko ma wolwi goonga, ndiyam danygo on nati nder hore ɓingel ngel, kancum sukki kine maagel haa ngel wawata fofugo boɗɗum. Ngam kine maagel maɓɓita, sey a acca musingo ngel fahin haa balɗe tati, ngam kosam ma on ɓesdata damba ɗon sukka pofɗe man. Rokku ngel ndiyam ngulɗam tan ngam ngel yara, hanjum woynata ndiyam hore man boo maɓɓita kine man. Wuju nebbam manja nder kine ɓingel ngel e nder hunduko maagel ngam a wurtina pewol ngol dow-dow. To a tokki kural am ngal, ɓingel ma yamɗitan garaw, haran, boo a wala haaje yaargo ngel asibiti sam.

question: debbo do danyi ha sibiti mai dan labbi jego ko sali o wadi sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi bingel mardo labbi jego mai o wardi be mako jonta dada man wadi bayani du o heriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nayi ko sali o wi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda o wi dojjere man halli on daga ki'a balde tati ko fuddi amma har durti o wi de o musinimo fu odon hokkamo lekki diyam je nder gora je be sorata je do jogo do je o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara o wi daga keya do jogoman turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawan fofa be boddum gidami am sosai bana bofde man do ta'a on do yaha dow do je palace kala wakkati fu be hultiri hanjum wadi be waddi musibiti meden jotta emol am hado hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo be bingel do ha sare na larugo no pofde mako ta'ata be dojjere do min vindina be lekki dojjugo na ko'en wadda goje goje dow bingel man yiddeko min hokkamo lekki ko bate
answer:
Ɗum ko haala mawɗo: bingel labbi joyi/jeego jogii dojjere balɗe 13–14, reedu ɓurii, walaa waawi fofa, e goje-goje caggal lekki—yahitee sibiti/ward bingel’en jooni, hoto tawatara ka suudu.
Hoto hokkitir lekki dojjugo walla lekki a anndaa, tee so goje-goje ngal arii caggal lekki, dartin lekki ngal, ngal waawi wonde allergy.
So bingel on waawi muuyde, hokkee nono inna ɓuri, e ORS kaɗan-kaɗan: sachet gooto e liitar 1 ndiyam laɓɓam, hokkugo e cokali/cup; zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala balɗe 10–14 waawi wallude dojjere.
Amma sabu o walaa waawi fofa/reedu ɓurii, o ena hasiira drip, ɗaɓɓitannde infection/malaria, ndiyam jiiɗɗam e ɗaɓɓitannde stool/electrolytes.
Ɗon ngoɗɗaa, hoto hokku “diyam gora” walla maganin gargajiya, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeydude musiba.

question: gorko am dubi mako cabbane nayi den bo mi hirliti sati tati ko sali dum o do fiyi ta yara diyam sosai sosai no yarata diyam mai nonnon o sillata to o yari duddum ma nonnon kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadan de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o do woka fu o do nana jumri kullum bo o don beddi bandu sedda wakkati fere o do fiya o do lara daure o wala lara boddum to o ummi o do wanca mi hirliti o do silla akai akai be duddum bo dume on watata sillugo mere mere do be donka do ko wadi o yarata diyam duddum den bo o do silla duddum ko alamaji do wawan jeyan shuga ko hundeji fere don awnugo toi be goji toi wadata a heba hefta irin yahu toi don do ko wadi o do somi kullum do dume on waddata sellugo akai akai do do sembe inyam mako bamti on waddata yamu do ko diyam bandu mako timmina ko kuje fere don tan irin yiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma dume on handi o dinga yamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji do dey handi noi goji be haunugo je yahu shuga handi wada kullum na koyande go yande go yewtoi don wadata alamaji do je fe'ata ha bandu mako
answer:
Alamaji di a wolwi do—yaru go diyam duddum, sillugo duddum (fere ma jemma), somugo bandu, be larde daure—kanko woni alamaji nyaw suga (Diabetes Mellitus), ngam suga mako samti ha inyam ammma bandu mako yida hebugo sembe diga mum.

Do sillugo be donka do do wada ngam suga duddum don yalta diga ha inyam yahugo ha sillirde, den o do hosa diyam bandu mako o do sillo, dum woni wadata o do yara diyam duddum o do somi.

Handi a yaha asibiti yaasi heri to a wawan wadugo gwaje-gwaje bana awnugo suga inyam (*Fasting Blood Glucose/HbA1c*) be awnugo sillo mako (*Urinalysis*) ko o heba hefta goonga nyaw man.

Wakkati do, o acca yarugo kujeji beldi bana lemooji be nyamduji beldi, o yarata tan diyam la’al biddum, den bo o larna nyamdu mako.

To o lari likita, likita on hollata no o awnira suga mako nyande fu be lekkiuji goonga di o yardata ngam bandu mako sellita.

answer:
Mrs Akinleye, ɗum ɗoo ko **alamaaru hattannde**: fofugo ɗiɗi lebbi, isrugo/coughing walla tufaade, e waawde ɗaanade no feewi ena waawi wonde **asthma/COPD, ciwon zuciya, TB/pneumonia, walla ñawndu ɓeru/haɓɓere**.
Mi waɗa on yaade **asibiti jooni-jooni** ngam doctor ƴeewta mo: oxygen, BP, ECG, X-ray ɓernde, gwajin jini, e gwajin TB/sputum.
So o heɓii **fofugo tiiɗɗo, ɓernde na metta, huɗo/ɓeɓe na laɓɓi, o waawaa ɗaanade, walla o na fena**, ngal ko emergency—naatnee mo asibiti ɗoon ɗoon.
Hoto on hokku mo lekki “fofugo” walla lekki gargajiya tawa doctor ƴeewtaaki, sabu ena waawi bonnude.
Ɗum noon o ɓeyda ɗaanade dow pillow, o haɗa sigari/alkol, kono **ƴeewtere asibiti ko ɓuri haaƴde**.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer: Alamaaji ɗen cifata ko rafi baawɗo tiiɗnude no feewi, ko wayi no malariya ɓurndo tiiɗde (severe malaria) walla ñawu ngaandi (meningitis), nguaddi ɗum ŋakkere ƴiiƴam (anemia) e ɓuuɓri gite. Omo haani yaade e opitaal ngam ƴeewndirde ƴiiƴam no feewi ngam anndude sabaabu rafi o, tee ƴeewde so tawii omo haani ƴettude ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) sabu ŋakkere ƴiiƴam ndee. Ngam dartinde ɓuuɓde, doktoor ina waawi hokkude mo leɗɗe ko wayi no metoclopramide walla ondansetron hade makko jogaade ɓernde mettude. So tawii ko malariya walla ñawu nguu tawaama e ƴeewndorɗe ɗee, doktoor maa hokku mo ɓuuɓnugol (injection) ko wayi no artesunate ngam safrude ɗum e nder reedu. Woppu hokkude mo leɗɗe keertuɗe tawa ko e les njiimaandi doktoor, tee accu mo wona ko e les toppitagol safaara ngo yaajata.

question:
Alabukun vii, odo ye’a dowre , kanjum be chomri, bo hore naawata mo do hadi mo jode belde. Saati didi ko salli, o wala naaana jamma boddum sam. Koste mako didi be juude mako be yeso fu pat ni do puuti puuti. Odo tani habda be mai. Be saurimo o yara hundeji fere nii, amma dai fu pat walaa ko hoini sam. Amma nii be viimo o tammi waddugo daama.
Be laari mo bevi daa ko shafii foofugo don ba. Ko haadini beda be wadi, be vii da kodume manga don bah. Odo fada eskal wala bone. Sembe eyam mako fu be hauni be tawi 168/100. Gammai bevi o suita , be godi sembe eyam mako fain be tawi 150/90.
Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. Be yechi mo kala hundeji fu je owatta, bandamo hundeji tornato mo soosai watata sembe eyam mako bedda. Demde am ba, bawo hundeji be wanni irin jaumu reedu do, jedo mari nawwugo hoore kullum be uppugo yeeso mataaki toi hosata hado reedujo do, ta ye’u yotta har debbi mo do jima?
Be kuma dume don jaumu redu wadata da yotta irinbanni bako owonna banni?
answer: Sarkin tsoro da kake ji akan wannan maganin (jamu redu) ya dauraye ne saboda yana dauke da sinadarai da za su iya kara karfin jinin da ya yi yawa (hypertension) ko kuma ya lalata tsokokin zuciya. A matsayi na likita, ina ba ka shawarar ka daina shan wannan maganin nan nan, domin ba shi da kyakkyawar bincike da kuma tabbacin aminci ga mutum mai ciwon zuciya. Ya kamata ka nemi asibiti domin a ba ka magungunan zamani (antihypertensive drugs) wadanda aka tantance za su rage jinin da ya yi yawa cikin aminci. Zai yi kyau kuma ka guji abinci mai yawan gishi da kuma shan abubuwan da suke kara jini sosai a kowace rana. Idan ka fara jin zazzabin zuciya, ciwon kai mai tsanani, ko girgiza, ka nemi taimakon likita nan take don kare rayuwarka.

answer:
Alamaji ɗi—lorna foofde, sembe ŋakki, ɗojja/soomugo, yawugo, walla mettuɗe kirji—wawan wonde nyawu ɓernde, nyawu hendu/kirji (pneumonia, asthma/TB), anaemia, walla sickle-cell crisis; ɗum no haani o yaha asibiti hannde, wonaa jango.
So foofde makko no tawi, kirji/ɓernde no metti, o waawaa yahde seeɗa, o siddi, leɓɓe makko mblaa, walla o naasa ƴiiƴam—ɗum ko emergency.
Likita maa ƴeewto BP, oxygen, ECG, X-ray kirji, ƴiiƴam, malaria/anaemia/TB, ngam heftinde ko woni sabu.
Hade o heɓa likita, o jooɗo ɗow, o acca doggo/yahugo, sigara/giya, e dawaaaji ɗe likita yamiraani.
Eey, ɗum wawan shafa ɓernde, sabu ɗuum waɗata ko ɓe foti yi’a jaawngal.

question: Ɓawo mi dayi bandu am fuɗɗi hoinugo kirinni min dadai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam ha fattude en yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum ndiyam be dotti min naftirta min ma fa. Hakina hore amin ɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigi fere bo wari min nana belɗum ɓandu amin fuɗɗi nanugo jagol be bandu am fuɗɗi dimugo kulum nda min ɗo nana jangol bo hauti be bandu amlai fahin semiti iyam je vurtata bawo dayugo. haccenga min nanata daga totton bo valai bo haccega mai dudi bo medai fedugo be am mi kasitugo giteam daga totton de mi ummi sei don mi yahi sibiti mi’ama ko diyam laɓɗam je min naftirta mi yiwa be mai kanjum. waddata kala wodago.
answer: Ko fii a faami no feewi tuma nde a waɗi “lockdown”, ɗum waawi warti ko batureeji ɓe waɗi no feewi ɗum, kono bandu am futti ko haɗata; so a yaltiri batureeji ba tare da laawol fiyuugo ba, bandu am ena waawi ɓari koyɗum tawa a yiɗi wala a yiɗa. A waɗɗa haɓɓa ka a waawi yiɗde batureeji ɗin a ñiiɓirɗe kala goje, kadi a yewtu bandu am (BP) e laawol joŋngol ko ɓuri moƴƴa, a laatoree kosam baabaajo walla asibiti. A yaru njaatigiiji “salt” (gishiri) e waɗude hayre, a waɗi yowiti, a tuuti ndiyam, a waɗi yilla e ɓeyngu yaaɓe, kadi a ɗaɓɓi ka a waawi feccere e goonga. So a miijii “miɗo yiɗi mi ngarta e huunde” walla aɗa waɗi no feewi ko wulnda, naamni goonga ka a haɗu jamaa, ko ɓe suuɗi-mbaydi am, walla a noddi laylaytol goonga; ɗum ko addi ballal.

answer:
Ina ra, miɗo ɗaɓɓita ɗum ɗan, mi faalaa miɗo waɗde ɗum ɗum falsitaare ɗangal ɗum.Toɗɗo laawol feewngal: huutoro ORS (ruwan gishiri da sukari) e zinc so tawii feewi, kadi yah to asibiti so alaaɓe ɗiɗi ɓe yi'ude (ruwaaji daɗi, jini, ko ɗimɗe).
Ɓeydu kaɗi kaara: wassa e saabu ndee fii junngo, caggal toilet, caggal canje e caggal muuyɗe.

Gargaaji: rotavirus vaccine, Vitamin A, deworming e goongaaji feere ɓe mbaawi wallude, kadi a yiɗi kaani antibiotics so doktoor o hollata ɗum.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer: Alamaaji ɗi ɓingel ngel holli ɗi ɗon njaada bee caɗeele ŋakkere henndu poofngol (oxygen) wakkati danyeeki, ɗum nde laggitotooɓe noddata 'birth asphyxia'. Matakiiji gaggawol ɗi haandi hoosee lawlaw kanko woni: gogga ɓingel ngel booɗɗum, suuɗa ngel bee limse gulɗe ngam ngel heɓa nguleeki, nden laɓɓina hunduko e hinere maagel to ɗon heeɗi ngam ngel waawa foofugo. To ngel fuɗɗaayi foofugo koo wookugo booɗɗum, sey a huutora kuutinirteeɗum ɓuttugo henndu (bag and mask) ngam wallugo ngel foofa. To haala ka waylaaki, ɗum ɗon haandi ɓingel ngel yaaree suudu asibiti teeriindu ngam ndaareeki ɓikkoy hesboy bee lawlaw ngam heɓugo walliende laggitaaku ɓurndu mawnugo.
