question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
answer: Nyau man ko ndiyam ɗuɗɗam mooɓti nder ɓanndu debbo reeduujo, ɗum ɗon waɗa yeso e koyɗe mako ɓuuɓa. Ngam o heɓa afiya lau lau, o haani o hoosa lekki wurtinta ndiyam bi'eteeki Furosemide (Lasix) hawtaade e hapkun Ibuprofen ngam usta ɓuuɓri e naawalla ɓanndu mako fuf. Fahin boo, o haani o fasa yarugo ndiyam ɗuɗɗam koo dakkere ngam taa ndiyam ɓesda mooɓtugo nder ɓanndu mako. Kanjum woni laawol e lekki ɓurki wooɗugo ngam o danya ɓingel mako jam walaa damuwa.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
answer: Alamaaji ɗii kollitii ɓingel ngel ina waawi heɓde caɗeele henndu les (wano pneumonia walla bronchitis) ɗe ngaddi ɓuuɓri ndii e kooka ɗum kañum e ƴattaare e jamma. Ngam ustude kooka kuuɗɗinɗo ngal, ko himminaaɗo ko timminde kuɗe ɗe doktoor on siforii ɗe kala, tawi ko ɗe ngartiri heege ngam safrude ɓawri ɗe ngaddata ɗum. Hesɗitin mo ndiyam laaɓɗam no ɓuuɓniri ɓalndu, nana yumma ko no famɗi, e ooña mo e ɓoggol makko ngam newnude henndu nduu. So ɓalndu mum fuɗɗiima ƴellitaake (chest in-drawing) walla o waɗaani moƴƴere e balɗe 48, ɗoon e ɗoon ruttoɗ e asibiti ngam yaajnude toppitagol. Ɗam ko safaaɗe moƴƴe ɗe ngam ɓingel ngel hesɗtude, tawa ko e jokkude kuɗe ɗen e toppitagol moƴƴol e nder suudu.

question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
answer: Rufugo iyam dudi masin e lornugo sembe ɓaawo danygo ko nyawu geɗe nguurndam, wonaa ko nandi, o ɗaɓɓi yahde sibiti jooni. Sibiti ɓe mbara hokkude ndiyam nder cippi (IV fluids), kuutorgal bana Oxytocin walla Misoprostol ngam tiiɗtinde reedu ngam dartinde iyam, e ɗabbuneede jiyam ngam hokkude semmbe. Hokku ɓingel mako ƴamre no weeɓi, ɗum wallata reedu tiiɗtude e dartinde rufugo iyam. Wata a ɗaccu o yam leɗɗe gure walla kuutorgal gure, ɗe waawi bonnude cellal maako ɓurde. Lornugo sembe mako ngol hollata ko o heewi iyam (anemia), ɗum waɗata ko sibiti ko ɗaɗɗude ngam daɗndude nguurndam maako e maɓɓe ɗoo fof.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi kaal-ɗaa ɗo ɗon holla bana mborodi **"pre-eclampsia"** (ɓeydaari sembe-iyee haa debbo jom reedu).

To ɗum laaraaka e asibiti ko yaaji, ɗum waawan addugo masiibooji bana **"eclampsia"** (gii-iɗe), halkugo ɓiɗɗo, walla maayde debbo jom reedu on.

Sey o jokko yardugo lekkiiji sembe-iyee ɗi o nelanoo, e o yaada asibiti ngam laartugo yahdu reedu ndu kaddib.

O siuta boɗɗum, o ustoo nyamugo lamɗam, e o danyitina torra ɓanndu fuu.

To o yi'i alaamaaji masiibo bana larnaago gite, nawugo hoore ɓennunge, koo ustugo dille ɓiɗɗo, sey o dogga asibiti law ngam danyugo woni safaare mawnde haa mborodi ɗon.

question: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
answer: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.

question: Dana kesum ko danya e ha asibiti amen minti cappanɗe ɗiɗi ko waɗi ɓingel waɗi nuɗum danyi woya woya teli nude danya ngel wadai woyade boɗɗum min yiwi fu nanugo mako tidum no bingel delabi tan mi yiwi kadi tamreji mako tidum no alai nalle mako ko dume. Ɓingel kesum waɗi danyi ha ɗa'i waɗa de boɗɗum gele danya harnuje jamu wala doraja. Ɓingel foti heɓɗe e nati wuro ɓingel ko ɗume o wawi kokkude ɓingel ti ko ɗume o wawa hokkude ha irin nyau. ma nyamana enjamgel ma waɗi enjam.
answer:
Ɗum ɓingel danyaangel ngel heɓaayi hendu poofirteeɗu (oxygen) wakkati danyeeki, anndiraaɗum 'Birth Asphyxia', nden ɗum haala cattuɗum masin haa ɓikkon kesso.

Sadaare fooftugo, ɓanndu lo'undu (walaa semmbe), e jaasugo woyugo ɗon holla ɓingel ngel heɓaayi hendu foondaaku nder ɓanndu e ngaandi maagel.

Taa hokku ngel lekki hunnduko malla ƴiiƴam jooni; ko ɓuri haaje lawlaw koo wulnugo ɓingel ngel, goggo poofirɗe maagel laaɓa, e huuturgo leemooru fooftinirndu ('Ambu bag') ngam wallugo ngel foofta.

To ngel fuɗɗaayi fooftugo boɗɗum lawlaw, ngel haani lencineego haa heɓugo hendu oxygen e kakkilaaku likita'en ɓikkon kesso (neonatal care) nder asibiti.

Nyawu ngu ɗon heewi heɓaade haa asibitiiji gure meeɗen, ammaa wallugo ngel foofta lawlaw (resuscitation) ɗon hisna yonki ɓingel ngam taa ngaandi maagel naawa koo maaya.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer: Debbo darnajo on ɗo jogi zazzabi tiiɗɗo (cerebral malaria) sabu hakkillo mako yalti, nden o haani yaawgo hospital ngam heɓgo safaara. Safaara arandeejo mo WHO e laamu Naajeeriya njamiri ngam ɗum ko *Intravenous (IV) Artesunate*, mo wonaa ko bonnata ɓingel nyiɓetengel. Artesunate ɗon wara kulle zazzabi (parasites) ɗen yaawi nder ƴiiƴam, o ɗon wallita hakkillo mako wartugo bee sahaa. Likitaaji ɗon kadi wallita mo bee ndiyam (IV fluids) e ƴeewtago suukara nder ƴiiƴam ngam tiiɗinaago ɓanndu mako. O haani accugo nyiɓugo ɓingel mako haa o heɓa semmbe e hakkillo, ammaa safaara *Artesunate* ɗon laaɓi sanne ngam rewɓe darnooɓe.

question: debbo laari gorko maako debbo laari gorko maako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira be do leso mai ni dojjugo nonnon ni fuɗɗata o neeɓa ni bako dara balɗeji o waɗa ni o laari gorko maako o yara bone foofugo to o yaaɓi seɗɗa ni ko o fa'i scal o do dara lorna foofɗe maako nden bo o do yawa soomugo be lau don nyande gorko maako neɓi o do ɗojja be o do haɓda lorna foofɗe ɗami debbo may o fuɗɗi numugo ko ɗon nyawu je waddata damuwaji jango may sai o volwini gorko mako be yaha asibiti ɓe lara likita heba ɓe hefta ko damata on ɗemɗe may ɗume on waɗata ɗuttugo kalnuɗi bannin be yawugo somugo be fofugo dakere ɗo damuwa ɗo wawan ko shafi ɓerɗe na ko yanko shafi ɓerɗe hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko tsarna goɗɗo bone fofugo harje goɗɗo mai handiri dasa hakkilo yauɗiɓe alamaji kalnuɗun je damuwaji fofugo je derdiraɓe handi lara hakkilina je tsugo be fofugo da kerɗum
answer: Ɗojjuru neeɓndu, somugo jaawɗum, bee bone foofugo nyannde fuu wawan heɓugo diga damuwa ɓernde (bana ɓuuti ɓernde) malla nyawuuji ɓofooji bana TB, asthma, ko COPD. To ɓernde fuɗɗi somugo, ɗon waɗa ndiyam jooɗoo nder ɓofooji, ɗum waddata ɗojjuru bee bone foofugo to neɗɗo dillii seɗɗa bana dillaade sikaale. Sey ɓe nasta asibiti ngam likita yeewta ɓernde bee ɓofooji gorko man bee kuutorɗe bana X-ray bee sariya tabaare ngam heftugo ko woni. Alaamaaji hulɓiniiɗi ɗi njiɗi hakkilongo bee jaawal ngoni: tuutuugo ƴiiƴam, tonndi ko demngal laataade bulu-bulu, muuseeki dow ɓreande, bee lallugo hakkilo. To on ngi'i koo gooto nder alaamaaji ɗon, ndillen o asibiti faago suudu toraare jaawndum (emergency) ɗon-ɗon ngam hisgorgal yonki maako.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer: Iyam wurtotooko bee ɓaale (clots) e naawawol les reedu ɓaawo debbo dacci danyugo (menopause), wawan warugo ngam canji tagu (hormones), ɓuuɓri nder sappaandu, koo bo nyawu kansa sappaandu. Naawawol les reedu woni alaama moolanaandi holloore wondi caɗeele ɗon nder sappaandu maako, ngam maajum taa o jooɗa e wuro. Daada ma haandi waata hakkilo masin to iyam ɗon ɓeyda ɗuuɗugo, to o ɗon fusa ndiyam luuɓɗam, koo bo to ɓanndu maako ɗon usta. Mataki je o tokkata wakkatiire nde'e woni o yaha asibiti mangu lawlaw ngam likita'en pija mo (ultrasound scan) e ƴeewndaago sappaandu maako laaɓɗum. Taa o sakka ɓernde maako ngam kulol, amma yi'ugo likita lawlaw wallan anndugo ko dammi mo ngam o heɓa safaara boɗɗum.

question:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali, o yeti larugo likita. O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa yaron yana da matsalar "anemia" ko kuma rashin jini da ya yawaita, wanda ke sa shi jin rawa da kura. Dole ne a kai shi asibiti domin a yi masa gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) domin ganin yawan jini da kuma daidaiton kwayoyin halitta (parasites) a jinsa. Akwai yiwuwar jinin ya yi kasa saboda rashin abinci mai gina jini ko kuma ciwon kwayoyin halitta kamar malaria wanda ke yawaita a yankinmu. Idan an gano matsalar, za a ba shi magungunan da za su ƙarfafa jini da kuma magungunan da za su kashe kwayoyin cuta. Kar ka bari ya ci gaba da kawowa, domin idan ba a yi magani ba, yana iya janyo masa matsalar zuciya ko rashin ƙarfin jiki sosai.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam feuɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
answer: Caɗeele fofugo e ɗojjuru bee dakkere ɗon ha ɓiɗɗo petel ɗon holla o ɗon mari gongol ɓernde (pneumonia) malla peewri masin (hypothermia) saabe yiwgo mo ndiyam peewɗum. Yiwugo keccum ndiyam peewɗum ɗon ustata semmbe ɓandu e ɗon addana ɓernde caɗeele fofugo, kadi ɗum ɗon mbaro ɓiɗɗo law ngam ɓandu maako wala semmbe jooni. Ko haani mbaɗon jooni woni, njaaree ɓiɗɗo o asibiti ɓurɗo madaade heso-heso ngam heɓugo kuutorɗe likita. Bako on njaaro mo, pawa mo gude ko ɓoorna mo limce gulɗe (malla njaaron mo ha gaba mon ngam o heɓa wulaaku) kadi ta yiywe mo ndiyam peewɗum sam. To on ngari asibiti, likita'en ɗon mballa mo bee oksijin (oxygen) e leɗɗe cafrirɗe (antibiotics) ngam hisgude yonki makko.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer:
Ko ɗum o waɗi ena wa’i no **nyawre hakkille**: yi’ugol walla nanugol huunde nde woni, kulol/damuwa, walla ɗum waawi wonde psychosis, epilepsy, malaria/fever, walla huunde goo e ɓandu.
Ko ɓuri moƴƴude ko **on nawa mo ɗo likita/hospital jooni** ngam aawtagol: temperature, BP, sugar, malaria, pregnancy, drugs/substance, e ƴeewndo hakkille.
To o fuɗɗii wonde o yiɗi waɗugol bonannde e hoore makko walla e yimɓe, walla o haɗii ɗaɓɓitde/nyaamde, **hoto woppitee mo tan—nawa mo emergency**.
Hoto ɓe ɗaɓɓu mo, hoto ɓe fiya mo, hoto ɓe haɓɓa mo; ɓe waɗu mo jam, ɓe nyaamnu mo, ɓe ɗaɓɓu mo ɗoyngol.
Larugo/traditional ɗum waawi wonde e al’ada, amma **hoto ɗum haɗa hospital**, sabu nyawre ɗum ena woodi lekki ngam wallaade mo.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer:
Tari keccel e jamma ɗon heewi wonde nyawu muskelji gomnati (growing pains) sabo pijal nyande fuu, ammaa fufa e wokan ɗon waawi ummoraade e defadira ɓurtunɗum ɓorniiɗum laral.
Ngam sago, dagginee defadira booɗɗum, waɗee komsa ɓuuɓɗam (ndiyam laaɓɗam ɓuuɓɗam) e nebbam shea dow keccel man, ɗum yusɓoya nyaw man.
So tari ɗon jokki walla fufa ɗon mawnina, ɗum waawi alamaaji nyawu sickle cell ɓingel maa, haa teeŋti e koyngal, ngartee asibiti ngam ƴeewteede.
To o woppi defadira ɓuuɓɗam, o waɗanaa komsa seeɗa e yusɓam, keccel man ɗaani boɗɗum jemma.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
answer: Gonga kine ɓingel ma ɗon sukki ngam pewol, kanjum on haɗata mo musungo boɗɗum. Ngam a maasa kine man, hokku ɓingel ma ndiyam gulɗam seɗɗa jilluɗam bee njumri. Damba man e fofaango nawngo ngo o waɗata, ɗum alama nyi'e ɗon yiɗi wurtaago wakkati o keccel, wanaa ndiyam naati hoore mako. To o sali musungo, hokku mo kosam nagge ngam o heɓa sembe. Walaa haaje yahugo asibiti, a reyna mo nder saare bee ndiyam gulɗam tan o waran boɗɗum.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer: Jaundice ɗo hollaama e gite e ɓanndu e tawi e zazzabi, ɓernde reedu, e ɓeydaare reedu, ɗum holli ñawu heewu e nder heeñere walla plasmodium malaria seeda. Ɗum ɓuri waɗde ko rafi hepatitis mawɗo (B,E) walla yellow fever. Minen ɗon e sibiti, min ƴeewa Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT) ngam malaria, min ndaara bilirubin e liver enzymes (ALT/AST) ngam anndude ɗum. So RDT hollii malaria, min fuɗɗa e artesunate injection ngam hisnude heeñere. So walaa malaria, min ɗaɓɓoo nono immunisation card maɓɓe, min ɗaɓɓita ƴiiƴam, min ndaara leptospirosis, min toppino ɓe e fluids IV, glucose, e vitamin K ngam hisnude reedu maɓɓe. Wartee ɗo yawwi, ɗum woni ko ɓuri himmude.

question: jabore dum mo dum e safa neto teteti mo diri di lebbiji di'i ke dure makowai nga dimo nyawu do be am mi dai wi'i reduma fana mo dum dum e wi'i enko e wuti leya samako e o inna e o woya ngawna en bon kodi sembe mako sawa en makko biben sara en makko bi e don kodi tawi mutawa dada ko mungel dun yamde arandere de nyauto yami nyamde diga beren dume hani wadi gobela wo hade borede wojo on nyamre teta wure dume hanira bute go hefta nyamdun damreno yauren ero nde kikiya hani nyamderemo damrejo yauren ero nyamden di'a owadato bebo ero gendam dayayya hani of ujira
answer:
Nyawu nguu naawi, ngam tuure e doggu-reedu lebbi fof ina addana bingel lo'eende masin e nattude semmbe.

Ngam reedu ndun lo'i, taa fudu e nyaamdu teddundu; arandu hokka mo ndiyam lamdam e sukkar (ORS) bee kunuuru ndu hawtiraa e nebbam, biiri, koo murgu-soya ngam o heba semmbe.

Dalila woni, reedu ndun foti heba nyaamdu ndu sahtaani nyaameede seede-seede, ngam taa o tuuta fahin, haa teteki din ndammba heba laamu.

To asibiti, minen ndarata koo o hokka nyaamdu asibiti (Plumpy'Nut) e lekki mboondi (Zinc) ngam darta doggu-reedu ndun.

Yaawnu yahru mo asibiti bako semmbe makko timma pat, ngam likita en mbaawa wadugo gwaji nden mballa mo diggasam.

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
answer:
Sannu ma, alamaji ɓingel ma ɗo holla ngel ɗon dami be nyawu 'Pneumonia' (siiwa) ko asma nawɗum, laarugo no ɓernde mako nastata lukka, o fofata be sembe, kadi o wawataa nyamugo.

Ɗum masibo cattuɗo, ngam maajum taa ɗaɓɓu nyamdu ko lekki kemist haa saare, baawo hosi ɓingel ngel yaara asibiti manga jotta-jotta.

Haa asibiti, likit'en mballan mo be henɗu (oxygen) heɓa o foofa boɗɗum, kadi ɓe fiyan mo botiiji ngam mbara kuyeji dasata nyawu man.

Lekki ɗojjugo ki keɓuda haa kemist wala ko nafata ngam ɓufu-ɓufu (lungs) mako ɗon cukkii sossai.

Useni taa haku be nyamdu wakkati ɗo, yawo yaru mo asibiti kadi kakkilana ɗawrol likita, ɗum on hisnata yonki mako.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer:
Ndarial am e ngal windannde maa, hida faama debbo ɗo o wondi e balɗe ɗiɗi malaria e nawnaare ɓandu. Ono woodi ko haani heɓde reenugo:

**1. Ƴeewndo caɗeele mawɗe (Danger signs):** Ono haani ƴeewde so debbo ɗo ina waawi yarude e nyaamude, walla ina mari ɓaƴgol, ɓaleeje, doole ustaade, walla toɓɓe. So o waawaa yarude walla ina wullita, ono foti neldeede to nokku mo mari doole ɓurɗe (referral).

**2. Malaria kesuɗo:** Wonaa e nokkeele Naajeeriya, ono haani hokkude ACT (Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy) hono Artemether-Lumefantrine so tan test malaria (RDT) hollii ko woodi. So debbo ɗo waawaa yarude, ono foti hokkeede Artesunate lekki (injection).

**3. Ndaarugo ndiyam:** Ƴeewndo so o ɓoyi ndiyam (dehydration) sabu ɗo wuli, ono haani hokkeede ORS walla drip so o waawaa yarude.

**4. Ƴeewndo goɗɗum:** Wonaa tan malaria — ɗo wuli sanne e ɓandu muusaa ina waawi wonde typhoid, UTI, walla nawnaare goɗɗo, ono foti waɗde test ɓe ɓureewol e widto so ina hasii.

Mi wiimaa yahdu e mo to safrirde mawnde so caɗeele ɗe ɓeydaki, sabu hoore muusaa e ɓandu wulɗo balɗe ɗiɗi ina waawi wonde nawnaare mawnde.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti
answer: Ndii nyawu ɓingel ɗon wondi e mum ko piiro (febrile convulsion) ngam nguleeki ɓanndu, ɗum waawan laata jonnde masooro (malaria) tiiɗuɗi koo nyawu mbooma. Nyawu nguun ɗon maara daama sosay, ammaa doole sey on njaara ɓingel haa asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en mballa mo. Taa naftire lekki koo sabulu gargajiya, bo taa wattu koo ɗume nder hunduko mako ngam taa ɗum maɓɓa foofngo mako o maaya. Haa asibiti, min ɗon fukka piiro ngoon bee alluraaji, min ndaara ko waddi nguleeki ɓanndu ndin min safra ngam hisnuki yonki ɓingel. Doggu yaaru mo asibiti koo kilinik ɓadiiɗo jooni-jooni taa wakkati saala!

answer: Aɗa haani yaaɓinde bingel maa ngel safrirde jawdi, sabu ronkugo nyamugo e majjugo hakkilo ko maande nyaw mawngow (neonatal sepsis) wala caɗeele fofgol. Bikkon bannge marɓe balɗe jeɗiɗi woodaa sembe ngam haɓugo nyaw, nden suudugo fofaandu e dille ɗee ena waawi warde ngel to a yaaɓinaaki. Likita ena haani ƴeewugo ko haɗi fofaandu ngel laaɓugo, wano ɓuure wala nyaw, nden ɓe mballa ngel heɓugo fofaandu e kosam. Ngam ɓerɗe maa ɗe keewi kosam, ɓillu kosam man e junngo maa nga wooda, kaa ndokka ngel e koppel haa safrirde. Taa faddo sam, yaadu safrirde jooni-jooni ngam hisnugo nguurndam bingel maa ngel.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. answer:
Ɗum ko **rufugo ƴiiƴam ɓawo jibinannde (post‐partum haemorrhage)**, ko heɓi bontere; hokkitee ballal haa ɗon e ɗon, tee **hoto ɗaɗanee turaade asibiti mawɗo**.
Noddee ballal, waɗdee IV cannula ɗiɗi, hokkitee **normal saline/Ringer lactate**, ɗaɓɓitee ƴiiƴam, tee memmbitee/reɓɓitee mahaaru; hokkitee **oxytocin 10 IU IM/IV** walla 20–40 IU e drip, so alaa hokkitee **misoprostol 800 mcg** ɗiɗɗo/nder ɗemngal walla rectal, e **tranexamic acid 1 g IV**.
Ƴeewitee ko placenta/tabital timmi, ko alaa bingel goɗɗo nder reedu, ko alaa jeexal/ɗaɗol vagina/cervix, tee deftere ndiyam ɗoofu ngam bladder ɓurataa waɗde mahaaru soft.
So ƴiiƴam ɗariiɗa, waɗdee **bimanual uterine compression** walla **condom balloon tamponade** tawa on tura mo asibiti mawɗo.
Ɗum ina wawi warude debbo cikin minti, sabu ɗuum hoto ndeenee lekki ɗiɗi tan—resuscitation e referral ɗon ɗon.

answer:

Haani daada maaɓo yahra ɓingel asibiti wakkati oon, ngam likita'en ndaara ngel, ndokka ngel lekki (antibiotics) malla weeyo foofaango (oxygen) to ɗum haandi.

Shawara am haa daada oon kanjum woni o tabbitina ɓingel maako ɗon heɓa pempel/baasal (routine vaccines) ɗi laamu hokkata haa asibiti ngam faddaago nyawu nguu e nyawuuji feere.

answer:

answer: Titilola, ɓingel maa ɗo mari haaju wallafaaki law sabu fita diwna e wailitugo dande ɗon holla laawol henndu ɗon haɗee, kadi wite maɓɓituɗe ɗon holla ɓanndu mako ɗomɗaaki ndiyam. Dokita wadata mo safaraaji bana *antibiotics* ngam halkugo bakteria wala *steroids* ngam udditugo laawol henndu, kaman wadata mo ndiyam ɓanndu. Ndaa mo comci ɓuluɗi ngam ustudugo nguleeki (zazzaɓi), kaman yar mo ndiyam ORS ngam wallitugo ɗum heɓugo semmbe. Watta haa jemma, yaha suudu ndewgu jooni-jooni ngam kila ɓingel man wata henndu mako timma.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
answer: Eey, ɓingel ngel wartay e cellal timmungal, ko ɗum waɗi doktoor on sikki o hisata. Nde yaaje (jaundice) ko ɓuri heewde e nder ɓiɗɓe jibinaaɓe kesa, ko ɗum ko sabu ƴiiƴam ngal ɓingel ngel ngalaa semmbe ngam filtugo ɗemɗe ɗe mbiyata 'bilirubin' e nder dammol. Kuutoragol annoore (phototherapy) ndee e lefɗe ɗe doktoor on hokki, ko ngam ustugo ɗum bilirubin ngam haɗugo nge bonnugo hoore ɓingel ngel. Nde tawno o heɓi safrugol ko yaasi, caggal nde o selli, o wartata ko e ngonka makko timmungal tawa rafi alaa e makko. Yo ɓe mbooja ɓingel ngel no feewi, nde woni ko ballirta wurtinugo ɗum ñawu nguu ɓura laaɓude e nder ndiyam.

question: Duɓi a debbo inna mako adda anma amma dare bandi mi hisi mi lari cokali on no joɗo fere mako inla ko inna mako mayi oyida fijugo he komoi fu oyida faddugo ko moi fu o fuɗɗi salaki nyamdu nandi hanowo omilo sanci kunne on hulniyam sai mi wadi daware yarugo mo nyautugo asbiti ko yotti asibiti. Mi likita on na ɗum hala maide en nama korrata mo waɗata wuro ngam mi walamo ko hani ɓingel on heɓa wankta jo na ma ngam o heɓa o nyama ko o fija sakiraɓe mako ko hanni ɗum walliran ma shagoran nyaudugo.
answer:
Mi faami hakkillo maa e sunaare maa feere ɓinngel maa. Faddaare nde ngaddaa asibiti ndee moƴƴii sanne — ɗum ko golle moƴƴe ngam wallugo cukalel ngel heɓa balndu.

**Ko fotti waɗeede:**
- **Nyaamdu:** Hokku ɓinngel nyaamdu moƴƴuɗo e leemrunde — poroteyin (gawri, ñebbe, kosam, boccooɗe/ganyi, liingu, teewu), e fruits e legumes. Cukalel keewngel nyaamdu moƴƴuɗo ina wanka.
- **Yarugo lekki:** Jokku yarugo lekki ki asibiti hokki on fof no likitaajo wi'iri, taa accu hakkunde.
- **Ruttaango asibiti:** Rutto asibiti no fotiri ngam ɓe ndaara balndu ɓinngel e taari mum (weight monitoring).

**Ko foti taweede:** Cukalel ngel wanki, nyaamata no moƴƴiri, welti, hokka darorgel — ɗum ko maale cellal.

Taa hulanaa sanne, kono jokku darnde maa moƴƴere. So a yi'ii ɓinngel ronki nyaamde, ronki ɓamaade, walla naw-ɗum, hooti asibiti law-law.

question: Debbo danyi ɓingel ɓingel lewru mai lewru jui waɗi bayani hala ɓingel mai o viya damuwa dow ɓingel mai wakkati o dal mai ɗo musina sosai bana no handi. answer: Eey, a foti nawnugo ɓinngel maa hospital kisan jooni-jooni, ngam "woka" haa ɓinngel lewru jui ɗum maande nawɗum mawngum bana meningitis, malaria, ko infection. Wakkati o woki, taa nannga mo bee semmba, kaa waɗa mo dow leeso, waylita mo haa bannge ngam o waasa suffaago, nden yaawu nawnugo mo. Likita'en hospital waɗan mo testji ngam heɓugo ko addi nawɗum man, nden ɓe kokka mo safara timmunga ngam halkugo nawɗum on. Taa ɓooydu bee safaraaji leɗɗe ko taaɗe, ngam ɗum waaway bonnugo ɓinngel maa. Yaawugo maa hospital kisan ɗum wallitan ɓinngel maa heɓugo cellal be jam.

answer: Bingel ngel mari rafi ñamdu ŋakkunde (malnutrition) bonɗo, sibaabu dojjol balɗe 13 tan e hokkude lekki damba e diyam gora—ɗum waddani ɓanndu man ta'ugo bana bofde, maanaa kwashiorkor. Haɗu debbo oo fuu hokkugo diyam gora malla lekki damba, ngam ɗum bonnata bingel ngel ɓeyda. To opitaal ngel hatojinii ñamdu safriru terapötik (F-75/F-100), antibiyotik, e toppitagol ɓuuɓngol. question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer:
# Jaabawol

Ndee mayram ina waɗi maale keewɗe kaɗtuɗe: **rufugo ƴiiƴam sanne (postpartum hemorrhage)**, sabu ɓawo dayugo ɓingel makko o rufi ƴiiƴam keewɗam wondude e robo, ɓanndu makko wuli, koɗe e juuɗe makko fewi, o somini sanne, ɗum fuu ina holla o alaa ƴiiƴam yonɓam (anemia) e nder ɓanndu makko.

Ko boɗɗum sabu likita ndaari mo o yiɗi lotude babel ɓingel (uterine cavity/D&C) e okkude mo ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) e lekki darnata ƴiiƴam, sabu ɗum fuu ina walla wallude yonki makko so tawii ƴiiƴam ndam heewii yaltude.

Mi wiya jaɓ ndee sabaawu sabu **rufugo ƴiiƴam ɓaawo jibinegol ina waɗi maayde** so tawii feewnaaka law; ɗum wonaa ko wontata boɗɗam so a jaɓaani.

Rewnu ndee mayram to sibiti law-law haa hebtee kisal makko, sabu ndee saha ko himme mawɗe.

question: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. answer: Bingel on waddi wadi nyautarde hande nyau mali, waddi ɓuri jeyngal cukare (diabetes) to waddi ɓuri jeyngal hiirde (hypertension). Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
answer: Wannan ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo (kurmin da zama da jiki) yana nufin cewa mutum yana da matsananciyar cutar zuciya ko kuma matsalar jini da ke sa zuciya ba ta iya aikin da ya dace. A fannin likaci, hakan yana nufin zuciya ba ta iya dukan jini zuwa ga sassan jiki yadda ya kamata, wanda hakan zai iya janyo fafata ko mace-mace a jiki. Saboda haka, mutum yana bukatar ganin likita cikin gaggawa don yin gwajin zuciya da jini don kiyaye rayuwarsa. question: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
answer: Alamaaji ɗin (naudum lesdi, rufugol ƴiiƴam heewɗam, e suntugol) ina kolla wonde Dada ina heɓi burtugol redu (miscarriage) walla redu fawii nokku mo haanaa (ectopic pregnancy), ɗum ko kulol mawngol sabu ƴiiƴam ɗam ina waawi warde mo. Sababuuji ɗum ina mbaawi wonde ŋakkeende cellal ɓingel ngel e nder fuddarde, rafiiji, walla fawagol ngol caggal ɓanndu. Ngam darnugol rufugol ƴiiƴam e naudum, o haanaa yarugol leɗɗe galleeji sabu ɗi mbawaa hisnude mo; o foti yaawde naweede sibiti ngam heɓde ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) e safaraaji laaɓtuɗi. E nder opitaal, dokotooɓe ɓee kuutortoo ko safaraaji darnooji ƴiiƴam (ko wayi no Misoprostol) walla firo (MVA) ngam ittude ɓanndu ndu e hisnude nguurndam makko. Kala debbo redu mo heɓi ɗii alamaaji foti yaawde naweede sibiti ko adii fof, sabu yarugol leɗɗe galleeji ina ɓeyda kulol maayde.

So ina ɓuuti foondooji fuu, ɓe kawritina mo to asibiti mawɗo ngam toppitaagol jowitiingol. So o fuɗɗii naangoore, ɗum holla eclampsia, ɗum yaawii torraade; ngam maajum ɓe ndokka mo magnesium sulfate e ɓe ngardana mo ɓanndu.

answer: Kilungo iyam maako hollay o woodi iyam seɗɗa (anemia) sabo iyam wurti heewi ɓaawo danygol. To ɗum ɗon naawataako, wala haaje o yaha asibiti koo o lara likita. O lara tan to ɓanndu maako ɗon wula, amma hunde man dillan hoore maako baawo balɗe seɗɗa.

question: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Keccel mako ɓingel petel tari (high blood pressure) ma ɗo fofa beu fido ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum (diabetic nephropathy) koda ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari (heart failure). Jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma.

Allura tetanus tan he'ai to boosaaru ngatii, ɓingel ngel don haaji heɓugo allura nyawu boosaaru (rabies vaccine) ngam hisnugo yonki maako. Nguli ɓanndu e woyugo wuro man ɗon nufa wuro man heɓi nyawu (infection), ɗum bo ɗon haaji lekki asibiti. Wakkati fu to boosaaru ngatii neɗɗo, a haani a loota wuro man e sabunde e ndiyam doggojam haa minti sappo e jowi bako a yaha asibiti. Yaaru mo asibiti jotta-jotta ngam likitooki lara mo.

answer:
Mi faami sango maa. Ko a sifi ɗum ena nanndi e **kaake tetanus (giɗɗi)** walla **meningitis** walla kadi **cellulitis/abscess** e nokku ka bingel maa suumi. Sabu bandu bingel man ena wuli, dande mako ena tiiɗi (kala nanndi e tetanus), be zazzabi—ɗum ko maslaha caɗɗo foti yaadeede lopital law-law, wonaa hakkunde suudu.

**Ko poti waɗeede jooni:** Naɓ bingel maa **lopital** walla wuro safaari yeeso ɓaawo ɗum sabo tetanus ena wara, ena foti nafteede e keɓe tetanus (TIG), antibiotik, be safaara bee ɓoli. Centi kadi so heɓii keɓinaali **NDT/pentavalent** (giɗɗi be tawa), ɓe naɓa ɗum wonaande ndeer safaara.

Wontah suumen ka suudu sabu ndee ñawu foti ittude bingel maa so alaa safaara law—yaa lopital jooni.

answer: Ngam bosaaru ndu waataama, tooke nyawu maggu kadi maayi, ngam maajum nyawu ngun raaɓataa ɓinngel maaɗa. Ɓuuddi kosngal ngal ɗon holla tufgal ngal cood-ɗaa haa kemis ɗon huuwa ngam wurtinki tooke ɗen daga nder ɓandu. A haajaaka hootugo asibiti ngam ɓesdugo tufgal nyawu bosaaru (rabies), ngam lekki kemis kin he'ii maako. Wuuwru nokkure nden bee ndiyam gulɗam e lamɗam ngam ɓuuddi ndin saaya. answer: Bawo dayugo, mettere hoore, ɓandu dimgo, jagol e iyam vurtanɗam ɗum maande kulɓiniinde. Ɗum ina waawi hollude ƴiiƴam dow (preeclampsia) walla infection nder reedu. Sey yah sibiti lawlaw ngam ƴeewteede, heɓa dose, tawa a woppaama oto; maande ɗee mbaawi haɓɓaade ngurndam ma. Woto ɗaɓɓo ndiyam teddungam, fooɗa jam.

question: mi yari sobajo am reduje mo ɗuɓi mako sappo e jetati ngam o nasti ɗayugo bo wakkati waɗi dey min yotti sibiti may ɓe hosi mo ɓe goddi mo ko handi fu ɓe tawi sembe iyam mako wa'i ɓe waɗi ko handi ni fu ɓe waɗa o dow der daƴugo o ɗon ni har ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sowri debbo mai o jaba ɓe waɗa mo siyas gam o dow der daƴugo ɗo neeɓi sobajo am sali sam o fi way o yiɗi dayugo ɓaroɓe ibrani'en dayata daga ɓawo o dayi ɓingel ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi o ɗo nder dayugo o dayi ɓingel debbo e jam kuma min yettore allah amma ko hilni am ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum ɓe dimbi akai akai mari wuji ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo o hokki ni amma fofugo wartai dei dei har jotta ɓe yawi ɓe hokki mo oxygen likita useni ɓingel ɗo hisan na be to o hisi o warta ɓingel mo wodi na foori na
answer:
Yo Allah waɗ ɓingel ma e jam, hɓɓaajo am.

Ndaa ko mi faami e ko winndu ɗa: ɓingel maa dimndaama ɓaawo dayugo ɓe fandi (siyas/CS), kono jotta ɓanɗu makko wonaa boɗɗum, ɓe hokki mo oxygen (henndu). Ɗum holli wonde ɓingel ɗon e caɗeele fooftaango (birth asphyxia), ko jibinɗo mo o heɓaali henndu no haani ndeen o dayaaka law.

Miɗo waawaa fii tigi rigi wonde o hisan naa o wonaa, sabu ɗum fawii e no henndu makko wa'i, no bernde makko e ngaandi makko ɓadi, e no ɓe defirta mo e sibiti. Ɓe ɗon ndenta mo e faggude oxygen, ɗum ko no haani; naamno likita en fii sabaabu kalse feere (peertugol henndu ngaandi walla infection) ɗe poti ndaɗugo.

Waɗ hakkillo, jokku e wallude e du'a, hokku e ɓe hakkilaade mo law-law—jonta jonta ɓe ndenta mo, ɓuri moƴƴude fii wellitaare makko.

question: debbo fere mo duɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti balɗe tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hanɗe waɗugo diga kafi ɓikkoi keccon de o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musungo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko seɗɗa po ɗanan tan o vi ɓingel man wala joga en ɗi nden bo ko dey jungo mako kosɗe be ɓandu mako pat ɗo fewi delem har ɗo hulna mo to o memi ɓingel man be jungo mako har ndikka o hosa mo ha nder saɓɓode o hakkilini ɓingel man saali en ɗi ɓandu mako ɗo fewi to ɓe memi nden bo ɓandu man ɗo ɓedda watugo har o wala wawa ɓamta jungo mako forta kosɗe bo o wala dimba sam o ɗo wali babal gotel tan to a lari ɓingel man ni o ɗo yonti bo nyaugel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗume on a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoy keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko ngam o sali musungo on tan ko ngam ɗume on ɗume min wawata waɗugo hala salari kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga kafi handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma hado man
answer: Ɓingel ngel ina haaji ƴettude to asibiti jooni ngam safaara tiiɗɗo, nde tawno ɗum ko ñawu mawngu ko wayi no ñawu nder ƴiiƴam (sepsis) walla caɗe ɗe mbaɗata e saanga danygol. Ɓuuɓri ɓanndu nduu e heende maggo, kam e waylo yeeso ngal (facial palsy), ko ɓataakeeji ɗaɗɗuɗi ɗi kollorta wonde ɓingel ngel ina haani ballal jaajal. Ɗuum waɗaani ko ngam feere ɓamtaare (CS) tan, kono ko sabu caɗe tawaɗe e nder reedu walla e jibineede, ɗe ɗaɗɗaani safrude e nder galle. Waddu ɓingel ngel to suudu nyawndirdu sukaaɓe to asibiti ngam doktoor en ɗokka ɗum liqite ƴiiƴam (IV fluids), antibiyotik, e toppitagol tiiɗngol ngam hisnude nguurndam maggo. Ko ɗum tan woni ko woppata musibba, ɗum waɗi ɗaɓɓitannde ɗum ko yaawa tawa o Fewja ɗum.

answer: Bingel ngel mari rafi ñamdu ŋakkunde (malnutrition) bonɗo, sibaabu dojjol balɗe 13 tan e hokkude lekki damba e diyam gora—ɗum waddani ɓanndu man ta'ugo bana bofde, maanaa kwashiorkor. Sey ngel neldee to suudu safrirdu mawndu ngam laarugo no feƴƴi, sabu ngel woodi SAM (severe acute malnutrition) e aynaaji pamarɗi (ko wayi no basboje ɓanndu). Haɗu debbo oo fuu hokkugo diyam gora malla lekki damba, ngam ɗum bonnata bingel ngel ɓeyda. To opitaal ngel hatojinii ñamdu safriru terapötik (F-75/F-100), antibiyotik, e toppitagol ɓuuɓngol. Min mbaawaa hokkunoo ɗum lekki goɗɗo tan, sey e dow toppitagol annduɓe.

question: likita daada joɗata haa sare amin lari ɓingel maako wala musugo boɗɗum nde o yiɗi o musina mo sey ɓingel may musina seɗɗa sey yofta bana o ɗo somi daada may bo hirliti ɓingel may wala sembe musugo nden bo o ɗo fita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso na kanjum tamba nden bo fofugo ɓingel may canji o ɗo fofa bana yaha dow dow ɓeɗo jippa les les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata wani fofugo ɓalleji ɗo dilla ni dada may o ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel may wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolwa ɓingel may to sey o wi ha o yaha sibiti o lara likita koyninamo ɓingel mako ɗemne am ɗume on latata ɓingel heɓa damuwa musungo boɗɗum no ɓingel may fofata ɗo alama nyamu fere ɗon na alamaji hattara toy dada be ɓaɓa ɓingel may hakkilinta ɗume on wattata ɓingel petel wolwugo to ɗo musina
answer: Alamaji ɗi kaalɗaa, bana tampugo wakkati musinugo, wulinago haa hoore e yeeso, e fofaango tiiɗungo, ɗum alamaji hattaraaji hollooje ɓingel ngel danyi nyawu ɓernde (congenital heart disease) koo nyawu pampamje (pneumonia) nawngu. Ɓingel ɗon wulina, ɗon tampa wakkati musugo ngam musinugo ɗum kuugal teddungal haa ɓikkon; to ɓernde koo pampamje walaa sembe, ɗi mbaawataa lilaago ƴiiƴam e henndu (oxygen) heƴoowu haa ɓanndu. Fofaango dowdow e lesles ngo ɓingel waɗata ɗon holla ɓanndu maagel ɗon tiiɗoo ngam heɓugo henndu ngam ɓernde ɗon sooya sembe, ɗum bo alama masibo mawndo. Daada e baaba ɓingel ngel sey ɓe dogga e maagel lawlaw yaha sibiti ngam likita'en ndaara ngel, mbaɗana ngel hottollo henndu (oxygen) e hoto ɓernde ngam anndugo asali nyawu ngu. Yaawugo yahugo sibiti wakkatiire nden wallan haa ɓingel ngel heɓa lekki koo lamoore kisndam.

question: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon nde o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musongo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko sedda bo o nan o vi ɓingel man. dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en di bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawata waɗugo hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man.
answer: Alaamaji ɗi a liddi bana sattugo ɓandu, salgo musinugo, e kuskungo (spasms) to ɓe memi ɓingel, ɗum alhaali nyawu kulniingu bi'eteengu Tetanus (Tetanosi). Nyawu ngun ɗon heɓa ɓingel kesyel diga wuddu to ɓe tayiri ndu bee kuje ɗe laaɓaay, koo boo to ɓe wuji ndoondi koo leɗɗe yimɓe haa dow maajum. Kuje nyawu Tetanus ɗon wadda tooke (toxins) nder ƴi'ƴam ɗam faggata ɓandu ɓingel, waddata sattugo ɓandu, ɓamtol, e salgo musinugo. Yaaru ɓingel ngel asibiti mangu lawlaw ngam likito'en ndaara ngel, ngam ɗum masibo yammu ko haani heɓugo lekki e kakkilanol mawngol. Ngam faddago ɗum dow ɓikkon hesɓen, haani ɓe taya wuddu bee reza kesum laaɓuɗum, nden ɓe wuja lekki wuddu (bana chlorhexidine) tan haa ndu ɓoorta.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
answer: So, soodaa jo’onde am tawi ɗum ina feccere, ina puɗɗiti no ɓurnde, o ina kaɗi yo o yaha wartaajo kala sa’i, waɗe “chest indrawing” e puɗɗital yawru, ɗum ko alama mai haɗari. A be wujibi a ɗau ko ɓuri laawol: yah da hospital ɗum tawi oxygen, e a laatino ɗokita yo o naatna jiyya (misali maganin huhu ko kashin cutar sankara pneumonia) no haaniri. To o ina ɗau asthma, nebulaizer/inhaler ɗokita waɗi ko feewi, kadi a yidere hayaki sigaar e haya duhu. A tiiɗno a waɗde follow-up, a waɗde allɓe rigakafi e nutrition mo feewi, kadi a waawi noddude ko ɓuri waɗde. To alamaaji haɗari ɓeɗi, a faɗa wartaajo saatin nan.

question: Duɓi a debbo inna mako adda anma amma dare bandi mi hisi mi lari cokali on no joɗo fere mako inla ko inna mako mayi oyida fijugo he komoi fu oyida faddugo ko moi fu o fuɗɗi salaki nyamdu nandi hanowo omilo sanci kunne on hulniyam sai mi wadi daware yarugo mo nyautugo asbiti ko yotti asibiti. Mi likita on na ɗum hala maide en nama korrata mo waɗata wuro ngam mi walamo ko hani ɓingel on heɓa wankta jo na ma ngam o heɓa o nyama ko o fija sakiraɓe mako ko hanni ɗum walliran ma shagoran nyaudugo.
answer: Ngam ɓingel ngel yejjita baasi inna maako, a foti hokkugo mo kwayaaji ɗaaniingo (Diazepam) ɗi mawɓe kade tati nyande fuu ngam ngaandi maako foofta. To o sali nyaamdu, doldu mo dow doole a loowa nyaamdu nder hunnduko maako ngam taa o maaya weelo. Ɓingel ngel ɗon mari mboowka puyɗam nder ƴiiƴam, ngam maajum hokku mo lekki 'antibiotics' ngam o fuɗɗa nyaamugo. Taa accamo o worta yaasi o fiya bee ɓikkon feere, faggidu mo nder suudu niduundu haa o yejjita. Laawol ngol wallan mo o warta jam lawlaw bo o heɓa semmbe ɓanndu.

question: jan bandu mi wari gam mini ko am mi lari ni gite jibe balli mako don wadi yalo yalo ne kuma banni mai ni har kusan balde tati bandu mabbe bo do wuli o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma be wawata nyamugo be wawata jogugo ko dume fu ha redu bo be do diwna be do somi wala sembe ngam hore mabbe do rigga do nawa be bandu mabbe do wuli min godi nafturgo hunde je min mari ha sare amma wala ko canji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli mabbe je canji kolo jalo har jotta dillai be do bedda beddugo tan kullum be wala der jam be yamdai be do yara bone kanjum wadi allah hadu be do nana bone sosai kanjum wadi min wari sibiti heba min handa ko min takata heba bandu mi ni ko am baldi begiteji je wadata jaloro haccen be hoinai
answer:
Ɗum ko ɗaɓɓitannde jawdi: zazzabi e gite/balli ɓen woni yalo-yalo, ɓinngel waawataa nyaamde walla yaraade, sembe wala—ɗum ena waawi wonde malaria mawɗo, hepatitis, walla jontinooje ƴiiƴam.
Awa on njahdu ɗoon e asibiti jooni; dokita waɗa test malaria, PCV/FBC, sugar, urine, e liver test/bilirubin, ngam anndude ko woni.
So malaria woni, a waɗee dawaaji malaria e drip; so ƴiiƴam lesɗi, a waawi soklude ƙarin ƴiiƴam.
Hoto on hokku leɗɗe gargajiya walla paracetamol heewɗo, sabu ena waawi bonnude hanta; on jokkondir ORS/ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi yaraade.
So o hurta, o nyaamataa/yaraataa, o yiɗi ɗaanude tan, o waɗi amai heewɗo, fits, walla fitsari ɓaleejo—ɗum ko emergency, hollu dokita ɗoon-ɗoon.

question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
answer:
Damuwa bulu (cyanosis) bee caɗeele jeyango hendu je ɓingel ma mari wakkati muynugo ko turraugo ɗon holla matsala mawnungo ha ɓernde ko ha fofugo mako, nden ɗum kuugal ganniirgal (medical emergency) ngal yiɗi yahugo asibiti ɗon-ɗon. Ɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ƴiiƴam mako ɗon heɓa caɗeele lortugo bee hendu oxygen boɗɗum, ɗum ɗon hesa wonugo matsala ɓernde diga danygol (Congenital Heart Disease).

Walaa lekki ko a hottata mo ha saare, sai dai a yarra ɓingel mai asibiti mawɗo ɗon-ɗon ngam likita’en lara mo boɗɗum, ɓe auna oxygen mako, nden ɓe nɗara no ɓernde mako yiɓirta. Likita’en ɗon puɗɗata hokka mo hendu oxygen bee kuuje goɗɗe hisnooje yonki mako bako ɓe naɓa mo heɓugo kure jonde jam. Yahugo asibiti yeeso lawlaw kanjum on tan hisnata yonki ɓingel ma diga ɗon.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
answer: Alaamaaji ɓinngel ma, bana dimbugo e majjugo hakkilo, ɗon holla o heɓi pabbooje (febrile convulsions) ɗe guldi ɓanndu masin waddi, ɓuri teema ko nyawu jonte (malaria) mawngu heɓi mo. Nde ɓanndu ɓinngel wuli tal ngam rafi, ɗum waawi waddango mo dimbugo e laawugo hakkilo, musamman to o wulaama. Ngam hakkilgo mo e wuro, fukka mo e seengo maako, taa saaw mo kadde tedduɗe ngam nguli usta, bo taa loowa koo ɗume nder hunnduko maako saa'i o ɗon dimba. Yaaru mo asibiti koondeye ngam likita'en mbeenda ƴiiƴam maako, ɓe ndaara to ko malaria, ɓe ndokka mo lekki bittol e lekki ustuki guldi.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
answer:
Damuwa fofugo/cough mo lebbi ɗiɗi, tawa ɓuri jemma, ena waawi wonde **asthma**, allergy/sinuses (ruɓɓere nder hunduko), reflux, wala infection ɗum ko **TB**—si tawii ena jungo, ɓeydude sooynude, weelo, wala o jokkondiri e mo TB.
Mi waɗata: yahaa asibiti ngam **auna hendu**, ɗowirde, **X-ray kirji**, test TB (sputum/GeneXpert) ngam cough mo juuti; syrup “Tutolin” tan wonaa ɗaɓɓitorde ɗum.
Si oɗo fofata saɗa, kirji ena yiɗi, leɓɓi/huunde ena ɗumɗum, wala o waawaa haala/nyaamde—**yaaɗe emergency jooni**.
Si likita yi’i wheeze/asthma, o hokku **salbutamol inhaler be spacer** (wonaa syrup), e lekki goɗɗo so haani.
Accu haye-haye, duumol, kuli kuli nder suudu, e muyde ko ɓuri jemma; hokkude ndiyam, amma jokkondir e likita ngam heɓde asali ɗum.

question: likita mi waddi bingel dubi duri be zebbi didi kuma godo be bannin ko lebbi didi ko sali o do be damuwa be fofugo do sadini mo jemma kuma o do wacca kullum kullum wajjugo do ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki wajjugo tibi inde magal tutolin o yardi gora gotel amma duggugo may dillay kuma har jotta do duggugo be jemma do sadini mo mi wanni mo gojji je tibi amma bevi wawan o wala nyau tibi dum likita dume on waddata bingel dubi joy heba accugo wala acca do be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi juy heba damuwa fofugo dakere do be jamma
answer: Sannu maada, alaamaji ɓingel ngel duuɓi jowi holli o do wondi be nyawu Asma (Asthma), musamman nde gwaji holli o walaa nyawu tibi (TB). Nyawu Asma on ɓuri waddigo wajjugo (duggugo) juutungo e tiiɗugo fofugo jemma ngam pewol koo kuraa do sukka gori fofugo maako. Accu hokkugo mo lekki Tutolin ngam lekki wajjugo walaa nafu to nyawu Asma on waddi damuwa man. Yahu be ɓingel asibiti lawlaw heɓa likita'en ndaara mo, ɓe hokka mo lekki pampel (inhaler) bana Salbutamol heɓa maɓɓitugo gori fofugo maako. Kanjum on laawol ɓurngol wooɗugo nder asibitiiji amin ngam wallugo ɓingel heɓa fofugo e jam, wajjugo man bo dilla.

question: duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi neɓai mi danyi balɗe jeɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on mi danyi mi hirriti dow to miɗon musuni keccel am ɗo yarnama bone musugo to o musuni seɗɗa ni se o itta hunduko mako tomi habdi musugo mo fahin se o musuni seɗɗa o itta hunduko se mi numi ko haɗi mo musugo boɗɗum se mi herriti oɗo mari damba wala fofa boɗɗum bana ɓingel ɗo hara bannin mi nanata ɓofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am ovi tema de miɗon danya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo mi numi to ndiyam nasti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min koɓuri pusugo am ɓerde ma kanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am walai o wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai tomi waɗi sembe tomi yiɗi o musina sai tomi findinimo o musina seɗɗa to fottinimo mi yiɗi mi ema dow sababu pewol man je o wala foofa be boɗɗum ɗo bo de o foofi fu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum
answer: Pewol ngol e hoore ɓingel ngel ko heewi wuyde sabu tuggol ɓanndu e laawol danygol (ko wiyetee Caput succedaneum), ɗum ko ɓuuɓri ndiyam nde heewa heɗaade tawa ko sellaani, ɗum maa woppu ko ɓooyi balɗe seeɗa. Musugo ɗam e juurooje ɗee ko kewɗe e sukaaɓe kesi sabu ɓulluuji ƴiiƴe maɓɓe seeɗa, ɗum waɗata ɓe nana henndu tawa ko bana tagoore kon, ɗum ɗaɓɓirta ko ko ɓingel ngel ƴama nebbam ƴiiƴam (breastmilk) tan ɗe poti. "Damba" walla cemte ɗe o waɗata mbaawaa ko ɗemɗe tago (jitteriness), kono so tawii ko ɗe nanaa ɓeydude walla o wanaa semmbe, ko haani hawrude e doktoor ngam ƴeewde ƴiiƴam (sugar) walla ñawu nguu. Woppa tooñude ɓingel ngel e ƴettugol muus ɗam ko ɓuri dabbunde, huutoro ko ndiyam suukara (saline) seeɗa tan ngam neɓtaade ɗam. So tawii ɓingel ngel wanaa ƴamde, walla o jogii hari (fever), walla o ɓeydii foofa, yah e opitaal ngam ɓeydaade ƴeewteede.

question: Debbo mo dubi cappande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali. Dayugo mai daidai don. Amma dai be dayi mingel do, mingel do do Mari damuwaaji manga. Mingel do Wala wooka boddum. Denbo wala nootititta bana kejjel wadata. Bawo dayugo bingel mai wookai boddum bo do hebba bone ha finigo. Bandu bingel mai do bana do tiddi ko kuma bana walaa dimba no haadi. Bingel mai wala yaama boddum be torna mo musunungo. Daada mai do sakli gam bikkoiji mako de saali do bedo wooka, ataake to be dayibe . Dume don waddata damuwa do? Goji toi be wadata do kechel do, be kuma mataaki gwagaawal toi hosata? Dumedon wannata mingel kejjum do?
answer: Wannan ɓingel ya nuna cewa akwai matsalar jini ko kuma wani ciwon jiki da ke sa jiki ya yi kaukaci da kuma kurafe da daukaka (dehydration) saboda rashin tsami. Mutum ya kamata ya fara bin shaidin kwanan wuta da kuma shan ruwa sosai don rage kurafe, yayin da ana bincewa da jini don gano matakin sassan jini (hemoglobin) da kuma kansa. Idan kurafe ya ci gaske, ya kamata a kai shi asibiti don a ba shi "IV fluids" da kuma kwararan magani don ƙarfafa jikin. A cikin yanayinmu na nan, ana yawan ganin wadannan alamomin a matsayin ciwon malaria mai tsanani ko kuma wani ciwon kansa (anemia) da ke bukatar kulawa ta gaggawa. Don haka, kar a bari mutum ya jira, ya kamata a kai shi asibiti don a ba shi kulawar kwarai don kare rayuwarsa.

Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
answer:
Ɓingel man heɓi caɗeele fofugo (birth asphyxia) sabu danyugo ngon sili (prolonged labor), ɗum acci ngaandi maako heɓay henndu fofugo (oxygen) ko heyi.

Dimbugo bandu (seizures) e bajjuki ɓandu ngon ɗon holla wonde ngaandi mako heɓi lallaandu ngam ɓillaare fofugo nden.

Jonta, wallito goɗɗum bee henndu (oxygen) e kofngol likita'en haa suudu pettuɓe (SCBU) ɗon mari nafa sanne gam o hisa.

To o hisi, o waaway o sella boɗɗum, ammaa e woodi dama o heɓa caɗeele mawnugo (developmental delays/cerebral palsy) to ngaandi man lallini sanne.

Useni mballite likita'en bee tokkugo kuuje ɗe ɓe mbi'i on nden njaaranee mo du'aawu ngam heɓugo cellal.

question: dada fere hakkili layi ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man
answer:
** Nyannde ndee ko sabaabu he "sleep apnea" (ustaango foofaango he ɗoyngol).**

Ɓingel maa ina foofa no boni he ɗoyngol, ɓerndeeru mun ina fiya seɗɗa, sabu foofaango mun ina daroo seeɗa-seeɗa he ɗoyngol, ɗum woni "obstructive sleep apnea," ko heewi wonaa sabu adenoid maa tonsils ɓennuɗe (mawnuɗe he kokkol).

**Ko foti waɗeede:**
1. Fokkitodu asibiti (ENT wallitoowo naɓɓe hunuko-nofru) fii yo ɓe ndaaru adenoids e tonsils; ɗum ina foti soppeede so ɓe mawni.
2. Waɗ mo tafeede he balɗe kala fii yo ɓe njiy no ɓingel maa foofirta he ɗoyngol (sleep study/oximetry).
3. Ɗoyn mo takke maayo (bakkat) hara wonaa yeeso wallita mo foofude no moƴƴi.

**Faayii sanne:** so a yiy ɓalndu ɓingel maa waylii bulewol (cyanosis), maa o wonii mette sanne he foofugo, naɓ mo asibiti law-law sabu ɗum ina foti wonde caɗeele mawɗe.

answer: Nyawu ngu ɓingel ngel heɓi noddirtee "febrile convulsion" (dimbugo ngam pampammi zazzabi), ɗum ɓuri waddugo ɗum ko zazzabi pabboje (malaria) nyawndu malla mboowu (infection) nder ɓandu maagel. Ɓe mbaawaa tilsingo ngel nyamugo to ngel wokaayi walla fofɗaayi no haaniri, ngam ɗum waawan naatnugo nono nder fofɗo maggel. Ɓe poti nawgo ngel yaago asibitiiwal mawngal law ngam ngel heɓa oxygen, ɗam nder ɓanndu (IV fluids), e kakkilango fahin ngam hisnugo ngel. Nder asibitiiwal, wallitooɓe danyugo poti heɓugo janngirde "Helping Babies Breathe" ngam hisnugo ɓikkoy keccoy.

question:
Likita, daada joodata ha sare amin, laari mingel mako wala musungo boddum. Dai o idi o musinamo sai mingel mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi. Dada mai bo hirliti bingel mai wala sembe musungo denbo odo fi ta wulina sosai ha hore be yeso. Da kanjum tanba denbo foofugo bingel mai changi. Odo foofa bana yaha do do be do jippa les les , bana goddo mo hokkata bone foofugo. Balleji do dilla ni, daada mai obedda damugo. Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako.
Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna? Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
answer: A ɓingel no wulina sosai, jippa les les, dow dow, e damuwa fere, wadi wadi seeda hiiraaɗo e coli e salmonella. O soodata a yahata likita to jooda, to fofa wallude e to ɓingel a wadata ndiyam e solisyon ORS nden a fofa deftol. Likita o sooda fita wallude labo (coproculture) to fahama baynoy nde e to yiɗa wallude antibiyotik (ciprofloxacin wala azithromycin) wala anti-parasitic (metronidazole) nder baynoy nde. A sooda wallude zinc e vitamine A to ɓingel a fofa deftol e to yiɗde defgol. Ko wulina o fota, o sooda yeeya likita to wallude elektrolit e a wadata solisyon IV.

question:
Deɓbo fere kam wandi ɓingei mako mo duuɓi tati asbiti ɓelaramo ande subaka.
Ko ɓe halibo, ike tọ ƴiɓẹ wolwani ɓingei on,o tonta takọ sam, ọlarata gọdọ fẹrẹ mo wọlwatamọ,e ta nọdi indẹ makọ ,ọsọŋata,mọ damai hanọ ọnai naima sam.
E ndẹr ƴamai ŋgal, ƴammi debbo on , "cukalei on mẹɗi hebki paɗɗe na?" Inna makọ wi'i ,ọ meɗa hebki paɗɗẹ. Meen ɓedi men ƴamimo " cukalei ngei heɓɓi jaɓɓukọ kala baatẹ pesoode mun a timmuɗẹ , ko o fotnoo hebki bana nọ inna maakọ waddi?' Ereeji ŋaudugol din min kuutọrto laaɓini,ɓingei on jaɓi baatẹ mako pat .
Mi ɓedi mi ƴami: " kọ fayti huunɗẹ cukalei on ,ngel wala paaɗɗẹ e ọjaɓi baatẹpesoode makọ pat,kọ daami cukaley ọn?
answer: Wannan dabi ne na cutar da zazzabin suga (Diabetes mellitus), inda jiki ba zai iya mayar da sukari zuwa karfe ba, wanda ke sa sukari ya yawa a jini. Dole ne debbo ta fara cin maganin sa yadda ya kamata da kuma kula da abinci ta hanyar rage cin abinci mai sukari da fatar kifi. Idan ba ta bi dabarar kiyaye lafiyar jikinta ba, zai iya janyo cutar kura a kwayar ido, cutar kwayar jana, ko kuma sa jikinta ya yin rawa har ya kai ga mutuwa. Akwai bukatar ta ganin likita don a yi gwajin sukari a jini domin a san matakin cutar da kuma karkatar maganin da ya dace. Kula da lafiyar jiki da cin abinci mai amfani shi ne mafi mahimmanci don kare jikinta daga hadari.

question: dada fere hakkili layi ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man
answer:
Ɗojjuru ndu ɓingel ma heɓata be jamma e caɗeele fofugo hewata ko ngam naawalla asma (asthma), pewol duguwal (pneumonia), malla ɓaraku ngam pewol yaasi.

Kujeiji kalluɗi ɗi potɗaa hakkilugo ngoni to duguwal makko ɗon nastata nder asiri fofugo (chest indrawing), to kine makko ɗon njaaje (nasal flaring), malla to toni makko mbortake ɓaleeji ngam rafi fofongo (cyanosis).

Ngam wallugo mo joni-joni be jamma, ɓornu mo comci kuɓtinɗi pewol, darnu ɓandu makko bana o jooɗi ngam o fofa booɗɗum, nden kadi yarna mo ndiyam mbulɗam meshin.

Hatooje kuuje ɗi potɗaa accugo ngam usta ɗojjere ɗon ngoni cuurki, sollaare, be pewol fenaa nder suudu nden kadi a tabbitina o ɗon fofa henndu laɓɓundu.

Ɗum ɗon mari nafa sanne a yahra mo asibiti jango law ngam likita'en ndarta pofɗe makko nden ɓe ndokka mo lekki potɗum bana nebulizer malla inhalers.

question:
Bingel am wadi reedu; duɓi makọ woɗa lasọ ẹ nayi. Kankơ nọn mọ wodi redu. Kọ fayti hanɗẹ bọ.
Jemma, mi hissi ọɗọ wondi nauɗu. Ọ arti ọ mofti karẹ makọ ,ọ wari wurọ am. Nauɗu mei ɓeidi ,ndẹ mi lari nawɗum makọ darai, mi mofti karẹ makọ, arandẹ kam o ƴiɗa mi yaramo Nyaudọrdẹ . Mi yari mọ Nyaudọrdẹ ɓẹ larimọ. Ɓẹ wi'i rimirdẹ makọ fuɗi nọ maɓitọ, den wakkati o danygol ɓadi.
Ha jotta kam ,danygol makọ nọ maɓinti fa wakkati kọ cukaley ọn wurtoitọ. Iga Ƙenƴa kam ,cukaley ọn nọ nana nawɗum ,den nauɗum nọ ɓẹddo tam ha min yọtti.
O wondi nawɗum, cukaley makọ wurtay, reedu makọ arandẹ ọn. Hakkilo am ummi , ɓẹrne am de itaaki.
Mi ƴidi mi yida ɓingel am, mi ŷiɗa mi soya ɓingel am nge warata do.
Useini,ɗumẹ fọɗata nawɗum on? Non daynrgol arandẹ wa' i na?
Ɗun watọn na ɓẹ wi'a ɓingel fotay wurta heedi alaura ? Ko ɓọ dun sẹkan mo?
answer: Wannan ƙarɓe ƙarɓe (fever) da ya nuna gagar jiki da rashin ƙarfin jiki ya nuna cewa akwai ɗan ƙarƙashin jiki da ya shahara a yankinmu, kamar numfashin ƙwayar cuta (malaria) ko kuma ɗan ƙarƙashin jiki na ƙwayar cuta (typhoid fever). Dole ne ya yi gwajin jini don tabbatar da cutar da ke damunsa domin lissafin maganin da ya dace. Idan aka tabbatar da numfashin ƙwayar cuta, maganin da ke kashe ƙwayar cutar (ACTs) da kuma maganin rage zazzabi (paracetamol) suna da kyau sosai. Sannan ya kamata ya sha ruwa da yawa da abinci mai gina jiki don ƙarfafa jikinsa. Kada ya yi amfani da magungunan da ba a san asalin su ba don gudun kiyaye lafiyar sa.

question: addirawo am danyi ɓinngel debbo balɗe saali sey o laari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo wala foofa boɗɗum wakkati feere ɓinngel man yofta kosam bamo fofɗe maako ta'i yande woore daada ɓinngel timmini musungo mo bee jemma sey o laari leɓɓi ɓinngel ba wala ba wayliti seɗɗa seɗɗa sey o tampi ko o waɗata sey o goɗi ɓamtugo ɓinngel man ngam o heɓa o foofa boɗɗum ammaa bo ɓinngel gaagiri foofugo boɗɗum bee boo canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel man sey o yaawi o hoosi ɓinngel o yaari asibiti ngam ɓe laaranamo ɓinngel may ɗume on canjini ɓinngel man leɓɓal nden bo walaa aybe no ɓinngel foofata na ko bo nyawuɓe nde walla nyawu hanta dasinta ɓinngel man foofugo bee bone ɗume on alaamaaji kalluɗum jee saarooji waatinta hakkiilo ɗume on agaji ɓe waawata hokkugo ɓinngel mo foofata bee bone
answer:
Ko saabi mbayliigu mbeela leɓɓi ɓinngel ngel (cyanosis) e caɗeele foofugo ko nyawu fofɗe (pneumonia/sepsis) malla nyawu ɓernde ngu danyaangal, ɗon ɗon addana ɓinngel ngel luttugo heɓugo foofunde (oxygen) haa ɓandu mum.

Alaamaaji kalluɗum ɗi saarooji poti maatugo e waatugo hakkiilo ngoni: mbayliigu leɓɓi waɗa bulu-bulu, jaawal foofugo bee bone (wecco na sotta nnder), ɗonngol, e salaago muusungo.

Ballal ngal saarooji mbaawata hokkugo ngam arandeeji woni laɓɓingo kine ɓinngel ngel to woodi goɗɗum modduɗum, faddango ngel peewol (kippol boɗɗum), e yaawugo yahugo asibiti ɗon e ɗon.

Minen haa asibiti, min ɓamtan ɓinngel ngel bee hokkugo ngel foofunde (oxygen) e safareeji bano antibiotics ngam hisginki yonki maajum.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer: Alamuuji ɗi gite yalo, ɓandu wulngo, tutugo, e somri mawndi njiɗ-ɗon ɗo holli nawnande mawnde bana zazzabi malaria lanyata (severe malaria) malla sanyere ngulaandu ɓernde-ɓandu (viral hepatitis). Ɗum ɗon holla dow heto (liver) maɓɓe ɗon nawa sanne, kanjum waɗi yalooyee gite be ɓandu maɓɓe ɗon ɓeydoo nyannde kala. Jotta ɗo, e min njaaɓon ɓasɗe ƴiiƴam ngam heɓugo sabaabu nawoojum ɗon, bana eɓɓoore malaria, hepatitis, e typhoid. Ngam ɓe mbaawaa nyamugo boo, min mpuɗɗatna ɓe lekki ɗaɗol (IV fluids) be lekkiije nargol zazzabi be nawooje ngam ɓandu maɓɓe heɓa sembe. Taa kuskuttee, tawan nde on ngarii sibiti, min mballat ɓe ko wooɗi bee baawɗe Alla haa ɓe cella law.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. Pellel sam o yiɗi ɓinngel debbo to min waddini min waɗini ko haandi fuu en waɗata ɓaawo redu jobay ni min hoosi daada bee ɓinngel maako min yari bee hasudu ɓe siwta ndee seɗɗa sey dada man nyoniya o yecci amin o ɗo nana o walaa. O nana osomi gite mako o yi'ata laɓɗo o vi' amin ogodi nyamugo ɓawo o danyi amma da kek o heɓi o nyami be nyiri mai wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta oɗo ɗaana o wala sembe be o fuddi nanugo gelo on feɗi bannin ko iyam vurti ha mako sosai o wala iyam o handini ko o handi ni. Kilungo iyam ko ɗume wa nanta mo min hokka mo iyam na ko min hokka mo nyiri.
answer:
Mi yi'ii ɗum ko caɗeele ceɗɗe ɓaawo jibinannde (postpartum complications). Bannginooji ɗi mbi'uɗaa ɗii - iyam ɓurtungam ɓaawo jibinannde, semmbe ustaade sanne, gite ɓoɗɗe (yi'oyre ɓaawuru), koyngal juknugol e semmbe alaa - ɗum hollata:

**1. Yiwooru ɓurtunngu ɓaawo jibinannde (postpartum hemorrhage) e ɗum addani anemia (ustaare iyam)** - ɗum ko caɗeele mawɗe wonata sabaabu maayde rewɓe ɓaawo jibinannde.

**Ko poti waɗeede jotta jonta:**
- **Wallee mo yaha sibiti law law** - o wonaa e suudu tan, ko caɗeele mawɗe ɗii. O walaa e nanugol ɗum hollata anemia mawnde wolla wonugol e nder shock.
- To yeeso, **ɓe mban mo iyam (blood transfusion)** sabu iyam mum ustii sanne.
- **Yiylo sabaabu yiwooru ndu** - hara ko rendu waɗto e nokku (retained placenta), hara ko ɓoyle waɗi (uterine atony) walla ɓoltere.

Wota mbaɗɗon o nyaama walla o yara e suudu tan - **caɗeele ɗii poti safreede sibiti law**, sabu maayde ina waawi heɓde law to safaara alaa.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
answer: Kine ɓingel ma ɗo sukki ngam kosam ma ɗo feewi, nden dada gorko ma wi'i goonga dow ndiyam naati hoore ɓingel man wakkati danyeeki. Accu musinugo ɓingel man jooni, fuɗɗa hokkugo ngel kosam na'i ngulɗam ngam gadi maako maɓɓita boɗɗum. Hokku ɓingel man ndiyam ngulɗam bee njuumri seɗɗa subaka fuf, ɗum safray pewol man lawlaw. Fahin bo, maɓɓu kine ɓingel man bee juude ma ngam o ekkita fofugo bee hunduko maako to o ɗo yara kosam. To a waɗi nihi, ɓingel ma heɓay laafiya, wala haaje yahugo asibiti fahin.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer:
Ɗum ko caɗeele: nguleeki/ɓandu wuli, cufi, damuwal ɓandu, gite laɓɓini-sari (jaundice), e ko on wi’i o wari ko nandi ɓingel—ɗum waawi wonde malaria mai tiiɗɗi, hepatitis, infection, walla caɗeele ciki/ɓingel.
Alaa moƴƴi hokkude “parasita” walla magani malaria haa anndaa; ɗowon mo asibiti hande ngam a waɗa malaria test, PCV/Hb, pregnancy test/scan, urine test, e liver test.
So o woni ɗaɓɓude ɓingel walla ƴiiƴam/cufi e jonte, ɗum ena waawi wonde miscarriage walla infection, ko emergency.
Haa on yotta asibiti, hokkon mo ndiyam/ORS seɗɗa-seɗɗa, nyamiri ndiyam-ndiyam, paracetamol tan so nguleeki/damuwal (hoto ɓurta dose), hoto hokka antibiotics ko antimalarial tawa dokita holli.
So o waɗi jaundice sosai, cufi no ɗuuɗi, heɓa sammuya, naange ɓeewa, walla o metti ɓernde/ɓawo, yahattee emergency jooni.
