Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer: Jonde debbo reeduujo marɗo malaria, nguleeki ɓandu (38.2°C), e tuutu ɗon laati hatsari mawɗo ngam ɓingel nder reedu e daada kam fuu. To o ɗon tuuta lekki, umminee mo mo wuuwa ɓandu makko e ndiyam delemɗam ngam ustugo nguleeki man, kadi on ndokka mo lekki bakkal (injection) ngam darna tuutu man. Ngam o waawaa yarugo lekki malaria hunnduko, tilas on mbaɗana mo bakkal Artesunate malla Quinine ngam nawnugo malaria man haa o fawti yarugo ngu hunnduko. Kadi, to o tuuti masin, on mbaɗana mo ndiyam ƴi'ƴam (IV fluids) ngam ɓandu makko heɓa semmbe. On ndaara mo boɗɗum; to nguleeki man e tuutu man jippaaki, on nelda mo suudu ndaɗndoore mawndu lawlaw.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Ɗojugo mai amma mi lari accdai joɗugo ha sare to mi dilli be fajira se a warta jego dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala deɓi wakkati yonugo min ɗo yona min nana ko ɗo yecca am woɓɓe. Ɓingel ambi joi on kosam ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi dayi miɗo kosam mi yarni mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗo hokka mo. Nyamduuji kala kala bana gaari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yardi amma fofugo mako dana o fofi ba dan o vowi fofugo ba o wala fufa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat. vidum be hande wakkati o do yiwa mo be fajira sanga o naftiri ndiyam jumjum ha kine mako be haberde mako gam ndamba mai sati fofugo mai fuddi o acci fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acca kuseni. on min naftirta hamaku je acca tabba mai kuma hala fufugo mai je lebbi die waɗata mum kuma min wadata hala fufugo boɗɗum. haɗata mo fufugo.
answer: Ɓingel maa ɗon mari alaamaaji jonte ɓernde (pneumonia) bee fofugo yaawungo e sukkiingo keesi, ɗum ɗon nawa sosai, handi njaaɓon mo asbitil jooni-jooni ngam o heɓa faabo. Accee wattugo ndiyam ha kine e nuffi makko ngam ɗum ɗon ɓeyda caɗeele fofugo man walla o suuɗoo ndiyam ɗon ha ɓernde (aspiration). Hokkugo ɓingel lebbi joi gaari walla nyamduuji goɗɗi ko jaasi, ngam kosam enndu tan haandi o yara haa o yotta lebbi joweego. Likotoro'en haandi ndaara mo ngam hokkugo mo lekkiiji fofugo e larna kine makko bee ndiyam lekki (saline drops) bee kisndam. Dada man bo handi yaha asbitil ngam heɓugo lekki ɗojru makko ngam taa o saata ɓingel man nyawu ngun.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer:
Tari jemma, fofugo bee bone, fofugo lau-lau, e salugo musinugo haa ɓingel lewru tati ɗon holla alamaaji nyaw mbuɓɓri masin (severe pneumonia) koo mura sottiire.

Tari e bone fofugo ɗon ɓura haa jemma ngam jaangol e no ɓingel waaloto ɗon saaba soofnde haɗa laawol hendu.

To ɓingel faɗɗi habdugo fofugo bo sali musinugo, ɗum alama masibo (danger sign) mo haandi yaare asibiti lau-lau, ngam walaa lekki koo kuugal saare baawangal lencitugo ndaarugo likita.

Amma ko waawata waɗugo haa saare kanko daada, o ɓaama ɓingel ngel e gabaare maako (upright position) ngam fofugo weeɓa, o faddina ngel heɓa ngel wula, bo o tefo laawol hokkugo ngel kosam seɗɗa-seɗɗa.

Likitaajo haa asibiti hujjata ndaarugo ngel ngam hokkugo lekki mbuɓɓri (antibiotics) e hendu fofugo (oxygen) heɓa ngel yamɗita, ngel daana boɗɗum.

answer: Debbo on waawi heɓde ñawu ƴiiƴam ɓaawo danygol (puerperal sepsis) walla kosam ɗam heddii nder reedu, ko ɗum waɗi o warii e maɓɓe ɓuuɓri nde mettundi e ƴiiƴam. Hokkude lekji galleeji walla lekji ndiyam, hono ko o ɗaɓɓiri, ko hattannde mawnde nde waawi yaajnude ñawu nguu e bonnude cellal maɓɓe. Bingel man nden fuu, ko himmugo ƴeewtaade mo kadi to sibiti ngam hokkugo mo lekki potɗi sabu o yalti ko e sibiti tawa o yaafinaani. Alaa doktoor mo waawi winndude lekki ko ɓuri heewde e ngooluum sahaa tawa o ƴeewtaaki mo, ko ɗum waɗi ko yaawi e sibiti ko laawol tan ngam cellal makko e bingel man.

question: daada peju ɗon mari ɓikkon tati peju ɗon petel may peju ɗon mari duuɓi gotel daada peju may hirliti ɓawo ɓalɗe seɗɗa nde o danyi peju ɗon mari nyawu dojjugo kuma tun wakkati may o ɗo ta ojja wala darugo sam o wi kuma o hirliti fofugo fu ɗo hokka mo bone o wi ɗojjugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be kikkiɗe wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗana o wi fofugo mako ɗo sadinamo o fofata boɗɗum kam ɗojjugo ɗo wala accamo o fofa o wurtina boɗɗum o wi o yahi haa nyawdigo gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwinimo se o wi o dilli tan o yahi asibiti heba ɓe hefta ko fe'ata be pejum damuwa ɗo wawan hoyina ɓingel ɗo na damuwa ɓerde na ko asima ɗon fe'ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toy ɗon hanɗi ɓingel ɗo hanɗi acca heɓa ko damata mo waɗinta mo o ɗojja hoyina mo usta sosai
answer: Yoppu hokkugo ɓingel ngel lekki gargajiya sabu ɗum waawi bonnugo ɓanndu mako, nawnu mo asibiti ngam ɓe ƴeewa ɓerde mako bee foto (X-ray) be hokkugo mo "nebulizer" ngam yaajingo laawol fofugo. Dokto en hokka mo lekki yaajingo fofugo (bronchodilators) walla "antibiotics" si tawii ko nyawu peju kikiiru (pertussis) walla pneumonia, ngam wallitugo mo wurtinko kikiɗe. Reena ɓingel ngel haa cuural, hayre, be hendu kaso, sabu ɗum ɓeydan peju be tikkere ɓerde mako. Hokku mo ndiyam be nona kadi ɗon jooɗina mo toowngo ngam kikiɗe ɗen mbaawa wurtugo haa o fofa boɗɗum. Si a waɗi ɗum, peju mako en usto, ɓerde mako en hoyina, o heɓa jam.

Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer:
Ngam ngatiri ɓosaaru ɗon hulyini, lawlaw fu, lootee nokkuure ɗon ngataama ɓingel man bee ndiyam ɗon ila e saabunde ko ɓuri minti sappo e jowi (15) ngam riiwtugo guurɗum nyau man.

Yahdu asibiti ɓadiiɗo jooni jooni ngam ɓingel man heɓa lekki haɗugo nyau saru (*rabies vaccine*) e riga-baddo *tetanus*.

Ta faɓɓitir bee maggal gure ngam nyau saru (*rabies*) walaa lekki ndiyamtoowo to ɗum fuɗɗake nder ɓanndu, nden boo ɗum ɗon wara yonki.

Ta nyootu buuluure/nokkuure ngatiri man seɗɗa fu ngam ɗon ɓeyda nastinki nyau man nder ɓanndu, sey to likita'en mari daliila waɗugo non.

To ɓosaaru ndu'u anndaama, yoobee ndu haa balɗe sappo ngam yi'ugo to ndu maayi ko ndu ɗon njaura, ammaa ta faɓɓitir hokkugo ɓingel man lekki asibiti jooni jooni.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer: Sannu ma, alaamaaji ɗi kaaldi-ɗaa ɗi'i, bana gite e cille ooldude (jaundice), zazzaɓi catuɗi, naawalla hoore, e somo, ɗon holla aɗa mari pabbooje (malaria) cattuɗe, tayfot, koo bo nyaw ɓalngal (hepatitis). Ngam a waawataa nyamgo koo yargo, a haani a waɗa teendugo (gwaji) ƴiiƴam lawlaw haa asibiti ngam likita'en annda asli nyaw ngu'u e ko waddi ooldum man. Likita'en mbaɗan ma alluura ndiyam (drip) e alluuraaji goɗɗi ngam ɓandu ma heɓa semmbe, koo a nyamaay. Acu nafturgo e leɗɗe ngam hoore ma ngam ɗum waawan ɓeydugo bonnugo ɓalngal ma. To a heɓi magani asibiti laaɓuɗi lawlaw, ooldum gite e cille ɗin dillan, ɓandu ma bo wartan jam.

question: redujo wari sibiti kikkiɗe ɗo sey o wi gorko maako ɗo holina mo akai akai ɓe ɗo dufa mo kullum o wi ɗo wati mo o dinga hurtugo nyalanɗe ɗuɗɗum to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sey o ɗo hurtira ngam o ɗo dami ta o tappan mo ko o huɗan mo o hirliti fuu ɓerde mako ɗo dogga ɗo fiya o dilli hawnugo sembe iyam mako sey o tawi ɗo wa'i sey o wi'i o tori ballinde ha saare mako be o yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo wanni mo bayani ko fe'ata kanjum ɗon saare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam ɓawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa hurturgo sosai ɗon to ɗo hota saare ko to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta ɗume on o waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓerde mako wala jam e hakkilo
answer:
Ko a **redujo** (rasiido) ɗon, kaajal, hulɓingo, e piiɗe ɗo ɗon mbaro cellal ma bee ngatere ɓinngel ma, ngam majjum, kisndam ma woni ko ɓuri haaje jonta.

To a nani ɓerde ma ɗon dogga ngam hula, tufu fofundu heeso-heeso (deep breathing exercises) haa hakkilo ma e ɓerde ma deƴƴita, kadi accu nafturgo lekki gargajiya ngam ɗum waawan bonnugo reedu ma.

Sey a yilla sibiti law ngam likitiraaɓe ɓeta sembe iyam ma (blood pressure) bee layɓugo kisndam ɓinngel ma, kadi ɓe mballa ma bee kawtal hakkilo ngam deƴƴingo ɓerde ma.

A mari haaje a yewta bee linyoowo haala cellal hakkilo (counselor/therapist) haa sibiti ngam heɓugo jam e kuutorgal deƴƴinoowal kaajal ngal.

Kadi, pootu bee bandiraaɓe ko ardiiɓe hoolaaɓe ɓe mbawoy naatugo hakkunde ma bee gorko ma bee laawol kisndam ngam a heɓa jam saare bee kisndam mbar ka nyonƴata ma.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer: Nyawu nguu ɓingel maa waɗi e wakkati danygol wi’etee *asfiksiya jibinannde* (birth asphyxia), ko ɓingel heɓaani fooftere wooɗunde, ngam maajum wokaani, ɓanndu maggel tiddi. So tawi ɓe nguurnii ɗum, caɗeele ɗee mbaawa waddude rafiiji ɓanndu duumotooɗi bana *cerebral palsy* (caɗeele dillooje e ɓanndu). Ngam ɗuum, ɓe ngarta ɓingel ngel to suudu nyawndiigu hopital law ngam ƴeewndo timmungo e fuɗɗaade ballal fooftere walla fiziyoterapi so ina haani. E wuro, yumma waɗana ɓingel ngel *kangaroo mother care* (haɓɓa ɓingel ngel e hooseere mum wakkati fuu) ngam wulnude, semmbinde fooftere, e ñamminde ngel nonsee kosam yumma. So ɓingel ngel fuɗɗii nanngaama (convulsion), ɓe njaawta to safrirde mawnde ngam heɓugo leɗɗe baawɗe daɗndinde nguurndam ko wayi no *phenobarbital*, tawa ko doktoor tan winndata.

question: renowo ɓingel laari ɓingel may ɗo docca sosai nauɗum har karshe doccugo mingel nonnon tan fofugo daker toh ɗume ɗon waɗata doccugo haa ɓingel bannin tan har karshe doccugo may wala fofa boɗɗum daker daker fofata goji ɗume be ɗume ɓe wawata ɓe wanna ɓingel ɗo coɓoraaɗe toy min hokkata mo be kuma shawara toy hokkata reenuwo ɓingel may
answer: Ɗum alamaaji dojju rabeeru (whooping cough), nyawu ngu kootuuji (bacteria) ngaddata nder poofirɗe ɓingel, waɗa dojju naawngu haa fofugo saɗa ngel sosai. Ha asibiti, likita'en ɗon mbaɗa awo ƴiiƴam (blood test) bee ƴeewndo ndiyam daande ngam anndugo tigi-tigi irin kootu waddi nyawu ngun. Safaara maajum kanko laati hokkugo lekki mbaroohi kootuuji (antibiotics) bana *Azithromycin*, hawtaade bee ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam ngam taa ɓanndu ɓingel njoora. Shawara am to renowo on, kanko yaara ɓingel asibiti lawlaw ngam ɓingel ɗon haaji wallinde oksijin (oxygen) wakkati ngel fofata daker. Kadi, o tabbintina ɓingel heɓi allura rigaakafi (immunization) dow wakkati ngam hisnugo ngel diga irin nyawuuji ɗi'i nder yeeso.

question: debbo fere danyi keccel har asibiti amin fajiri do danyugo mai hokkaimo bone sam o danyi wala damuwa neɓai sam bawo danyi min lari leppol min wanni mo bulli sofni be iyam bawo minti seɗɗa debbo do naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam neɓai sam debbo fuɗɗi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai don rufa sosai sali darugo dume on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo ɗume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata ɓingel fere ɗon ha nder redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe darata ɗo ba je deɓɓo ɗo ɗume min wawata min wanna deɓɓo ɗo irin batal ko lekki toi naftirta deɓɓo ɗo be min tura deɓɓo ɗo siɓiti manga ko ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai
answer:
## Jaabawol

Deɓɓo ɗo ɗon e **rufugo iyam bawo danyugo (postpartum haemorrhage)** ɗo waɗi tokkere sabaabu maɓɓe, kono ko ɓuri waawude wonde sabaabu (ko wi'etee **uterine atony**) - nde redu deɓɓo (uterus) salii darnude hakkilo mun bawo danyugo, ɗum waɗta iyam ruftude sanne.

### Ko poti waɗeede jaawe (emergency):

1. **Massaage redu** – waɗ massaage dow redu (uterine fundal massage) ngam waɗta redu darnude e ruftude iyam.

2. **Nawnude lekki Oxytocin** – hokku **10 IU Oxytocin** e ɓalndu (IM) walla e ɗaɗi (IV infusion), ɗum ko lekki ɓurngo moƴƴude ngam darnude iyam. So Oxytocin alaa, naftir **Misoprostol** (tablet 800mcg) hokku ley ley walla e reeta.

3. **Waɗ IV line** – uddu ɗaɗol e hokku ndiyam (IV fluids - Normal Saline walla Ringer's Lactate) ngam faabaade e sembe deɓɓo, e habbaade **blood transfusion**.

4. **Ƴeew so tokkere heddii** – so placenta walla huunde heddii nder redu (retained placenta), ɗum kadi waɗta iyam ruftude; ɗum foti ittireede.

### Ko boɗɗi:
Neldu deɓɓo law-law to asibiti mawɗo (referral) so rufugo iyam heddi bawo massaage e lekki, sabu ɗum ko heege maayde. Ndaaru **blood pressure** e **pulse** deɓɓo sahaa e sahaa.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer:
A hakkille: to beɓe ɓingel mako, hoto feere ndiyam dow ko ɓe yiɗi, waawaa jooɗnude ko woni nder, tee hoto fowta kaɗi.
Hoto sennin foreskin mako (ɓerɗe ɓingel) ko feere, sabu e doole ena waawi heɓde daddam, yaafaaji, walla toɗɗo.
Alamaaji njogiiɗi waɗude ne doctor ko: ko ɓingel ena mburtu kala, ena mawni, ena wondi daddam, ena yiɗi koɗum, urinating ena heddii/walla ina muusɗi, walla fever.
Ko ɓerɗe ɓingel ena seɗɗa kala e kato, saabi e nder yahi-ɗam ena waawi seɗɗa haa e mawnude; so tawii ena seɗɗa ko feere, aɗa waawi naftorɗe kaɗi, a feere nder nder, kadi a naatnoy ɗum to bee.
So ɓerɗe ɓingel ko naatnoyaa e nder tawi o waawaa firtude (ena hokkataa), ɗum ko emergency, yah to hospital haa sauri.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.
answer: Alamii ɗo woni e piɓol “reino/ngel” ena waawi haɗata e ciñol kankara (kidney stones) walla sankaraaji urinary tract infection, gila so aɗa heɓi ciñol, hawsa, ko mbanndu e haɓɓere. So kaɗi kaɗi, nde ko sankaraaji ko feere, a waawi yiyde ndiyam mbuddu, wulɓe (blood) e ndiyam, ko fii feber, ciñol e haɓɓere, ko a waawi faaba. Fof ko waɗɗa, yah to hospital ngam suɓa urinalysis, blood test, walla ultrasound ngam anndude ko waɗi tigi. Jooni, ndi mbiyɗaa ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa, haɗa tee/kafeen e alkohol, te maatir ɗum ko feere ngam ciñol. Ɗum woni haɗa a reende medicine e hoore maa; so ko infection, ɗokita maa waɗi antibiotics moƴƴi, so kankara, ɗokita maa waɗi pain relief walla planning feere.

answer: Fofugo jaawngo bee somugo ɓingel wakkati musinngo ɗon holla alama puɗɗi nyi'e, denbo kosam dada maako ɗon tuddini masin waɗi o ɗon soma. answer: Nyawu ɗo ɗum ko laati ngam ɓurtugo gollal dande daborgo (*hyperthyroidism*), kanjum waddata fiyal ɓernde masin, somaare, e uppugo dande nden ha wakkati reedu. Alamaji masiibo je mari haaje yahugo opital lawlaw ngoni: jonte mawnunde, caɗeele foofugo, bee ɓernde fiyata masin haa o waawaa munyugo. question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Alamaji ɗi ɗo holla debbo o reedu on rufata (incomplete abortion), ngam lewru woyni mo lewru gootel e reeta, kadi o meeɗi rufugo reedu nde ɗiɗi ɓaawo. Kuje arande je waɗata lawlaw ngam hisnugo yonki maako kanjum on lornugo ndiyam ɓandu be leɗɗe rufa-rufa (IV fluids bana Normal Saline), e ƴeewugo ko o ɗon haaji ɓesdeego ƴiiƴam ngam iyam rufi sosai. Batteji (injections) je darnata iyam man kanjum on Oxytocin malla Ergometrine, ko kuroje wiyeteɗe Misoprostol je wallata reedu fasa ndarna iyam rufugo. To reedu man laaɓai pat, likita'en doole naftira be kuugal pamaral wiyeteengal Manual Vacuum Aspiration (MVA) ngam laɓɓinugo nder reedu maako heɓa rufugo iyam man daro fey. Ɓaawo ɗon, o hokkete lekki mboondi (antibiotics) ngam haɗugo kure, kadi o hositee yeeso ngam bincike anndugo ko saabata o rufa reedu koo-nde-to heɓa o wallitee.

answer:
# Jaabu

Ɗum ɗon holliti **rufgo iyam ɓaawo dayngol** (postpartum hemorrhage) - ko ɗum tan waɗi debbo o wala sembe, hoore wonta yeewnde, e junngo/koyngal wonta ɓulaaɗi.

**Ko waddata mo:**
- Ko ɓuri jogorde ko **uterus mo wontaa wuppa** (uterine atony) - dijol ɓingel ngol wontaa tokka ɓaawo dayngol, ɗum jaalta ɗaɗi maggol, iyam heewa yalta.
- Mette hesere fewndo dayngol maa keɓe ndosaandu keɗɗa nder reedu ndu.

**Ko poti waɗeede:**
1. **Wattu junngo dow reedu ndu (uterine massage)** ngam wonta uterus o wuppa.
2. **Hokku legde Oxytocin** maa Misoprostol ngam uterus o dijoo tokka.
3. **Hokku iyam (blood transfusion)** so debbo o wala sembe, ngam iyam mo yalti ko heewi.
4. **Ndoson ɓe ta legde iyam (IV fluids)** ngam bandu ndu heɓa sembe.

**Feere:** So kala ɗiin ɗoon jaalataa, poti ɓe wattira operation ngam darnude rufgo iyam maa hettude uterus. Ɗum ko caɗeele bonɗe - naɓ debbo o **law-law haa sibiti mawɗo** ɗo ɓe mbaawi hokkude iyam e safaara timmuɗo.

question: ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hanɗe fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha mako sosai fa kuma ɗo sakli mo ɗa seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o wi meɗi feɗugo ɗe ɗiɗi ko sali ɗe fe'ata o ɗo nana nauɗum den bo iyam mai rufata a rufata be emi ko reɗu ɗon rufata o wi o anda ko oɗon mari reɗu ko oɗo be reɗu be emi dai o lari al'ada mako o wi neɓai ko o lari o wi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo em ɗo fuɗɗi dai hande fajira useni ɗume on watata debbo rufugo em sosai ɗo banni mataki geggewal toi hosata yahu ndigi toi hokkata debbo ɗo hisnu yonki mako be darnata emmai lekkiji toi be bateji toi be hokkatamo je darnata emmai
answer:
Ruɓugo ɗam heewngo e debbo hono ɗum ko **golle gorko (emergency)**: haalaaji mum ina mbaawi wonde **ɓolugol reedu (miscarriage), reedu ɗo ngal wonaa ka maha (ectopic), walla cuta/ciɓtorgal ka reedu**, sabu o wi’i al’ada mako waɗii lewru gooto tan.

Mataki aduna: **ɗaɓɓitanee BP/pulse**, wallaade mo, waɗee **IV cannula ɗiɗi**, hurminee **normal saline/Ringer’s lactate**, ɗaɓɓitee ɗam ngam **cross-match/transfusion** so ɗam ɗon rufa sosai.

Ɗaɓɓitee **pregnancy test** e **ultrasound**; so o woni e reedu ngam ɗo nawa e ɓernde/ciɗɗol, **ectopic rupture** ina jogii haɗari—yahat ko ɗo theater/likita OB-GYN jooni.

So ko ɓolugol reedu walla ɗam ina heddii ka maha, aɗa waawi hokka **misoprostol** walla waɗa **MVA/evacuation** e antibiotics so infection woni; so o rufi ɗam heewi, **tranexamic acid 1g IV** e transfusion ina wallita.

Hoto neeɓnee: noddee ambulance/referral to babban asibiti ɗo ɗam, ultrasound, theater e likitan mata woni, sabu yonki mako ina waawi haɓɓude.

answer: Rufugo iyam masin, febugo juuɗe e koyɗe, e wulngo ɓandu ɓaawo danygol ko kuuje masiibooji ɗon mari haaje laral likita bee yaawre. Min ɗon lara ma jooni ngam min winndane lekkiiji darnata iyam (uterotonics), lekkiiji nyawu (antibiotics) ngam wulngo bandu, e min ɓesda ma iyam ngam sembe ma lorta. **Nyaawu ngu:** Alaamaaji ɗi kollirii **Diabetes (Suakkere/Sukkar)** — ɗum woni cutuɗum ngam heɓde sukkar ɗuuɗɗum e ƴiiƴam.

**Ko waɗi mi hollirii ɗum:**
- Yarugo ndiyam ɗuɗɗum (polydipsia) e sillugo ɗuɗɗum (polyuria) — ɗum alaama mawɗo ka diabetes.
- Weeɓde ɓalndu, jempude, e lorlaade — ngam ɓalndu waawaa huutoraade sukkar ka.
- Somugo kullum e ustaade sembe — ɗum kadi alaamaaji diabetes.

**Ko foti waɗeede:**
1. Yaha suudu safraaru law-law ngam etagol sukkar ka ƴiiƴam (**random blood glucose** walla **fasting blood sugar**) e etagol sukkar ka taari (urine test).
2. Etee kadi **HbA1c** so ina heɓoo, ngam anndude no sukkar mako foti gaa.

**Reentino:** So sukkar ka ƴiiƴam ɓamti no feewi, ina waawi naatde e diabetic ketoacidosis — ɗum saɗtude, foti ƴawreede law suudu safraaru.

**Dawaa:** Nyaamdu moƴƴu (accu sukkar e nyiiri ɗuɗɗum), doole ɓalndu, e lekki (insulin walla metformin) so doktoor hollii. Yaha safrirde law-law ngam ndaartee cutuɗum ngu.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer:
Miɗo yiɗi miɗaara ɗum no feewi, miɗo waawi haɗa sifaaɗi ɗiɗi waɗi waɗata e waɗi waɗataako, kisa miɗo hokku maka taliiji ɗiɗi waɗi waɗataako.Ko fii, hakillee e dundal maɓɓe ɗiɗiɗi to mawnude tan wonaa sabu mawɗo wonde e saɗitoowo; ko feewi, saɗitoowo ɓuri waɗude sabu laawol yaynirde (chromosome) mo o waɗi e leydi, ko kaɗi cuduruuji walla soklaaji ɗe njiɗi ndaarataako.
Hakillee mawɗo, yawtude fota, walla bonnude sago “trauma” e dundal maa waawi addude haɗari, amman ɗum wonaa ko wonaa sabu ɓuri toɗɗa.
Beederi goɗɗi caggal ɓeeroowo e nder ɗogguure waawi waɗude, amman so beederi, saare, gasi, walla bonnude ko ɓuri, yah to asibiti ndee.
Jokkondir e asibiti e antenatal, waɗtu hakillee e jokkondiral, ngarta kaɗi siggordu e alkool, sigaar, e dawaa ɗe dokita yewtataako.

answer:
Nyawu ko debbo o mari ɗon woni **Pre-eclampsia** (sembe ƴiiƴam jowtiiɗo haa debbo reeduujo), mo woodi nyawalla hoore, giide zoom, e ɓuuti haa kosɗe, juuɗe, e yeso.

Ɗon haaje o hoota asibiti mawndu heɓa kheenyooji bee yaawre, nden to reedu ndun yottii koo to nyawu ɗon ɓeydoo, danyinol (delivery) woni safara mawɗo jooni-jooni.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
answer: Ɗum wonaa nyawu raɓoowo wala hunde nde o yahi, amma ko fustugol ƴiiƴam ha nder kwakwalwa (stroke) sabu ɓillitaare ƴiiƴam, ndu waɗi hoore nawa, daande tiiɗa, kuma o wawaa haalda wala yaha. Ƴiiƴam mako ɗon ɓilla sosai haa ƴiiƴam fusi ha nder kwakwalwa mako, ko ɗum waɗi gite mako ɗon nawa, o foofataa no moƴƴi, kuma feccere ɓandu mako ɗon lora. Njaɓɓee mo kisa yaake asibiti ngam ɓe ƴeewa ƴiiƴam mako, ɓe ndokka mo lekki, kuma ɓe mbaɗa mo sakan (scan) hoore ngam anndugo no ƴiiƴam ɗam fustiri. Accitee leɗɗe ɗe ɗon muuɗa ɗen ngam ɗe ɓeydat tan nyawu nguu, sabu ɓillitaare ƴiiƴam e fustugol kwakwalwa ɗon haani lekki asibiti tan. So on njahaay jooni, nyawu nguu waɗat mo ɓolu wala o maaya, ngam majjum ɗon haani safrooɓe annduɓe ɓe njaɓɓa mo kisa.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
answer:
E alamaji ɗum, ɗee alamuuji—jooɗii e suudu, haala woodaani, yidugol geɗe ɗe o yiɗnoo woodaani, nyamugol famɗii, yeewugol/woodugol weltaare—ko ɓuri nanndude e **nyawu hakkillo/depression** walla nyawu goɗɗo; ɗum wonaa laawol walla bonugol.
Kono sabu metol ɓernde, tampere, walla ɗaɓɓere ɓandu, yo on yahdu e **asibiti/likita** ngam ƴeewtagol: malaria, anemia, infection, thyroid, substance, e nyawu ɓernde.
So o waɗii metol ɓernde mawɗo, hoto woni hendu, faanɗi, yaram wala nyamugol, walla o wowli fii bonnugol hoore makko—**yahdu e emergency jooni**.
Hakkilinan on mo no ɓuri: haalanee mo no ɗooɗi, hoto on jooɗo mo gooto, ittee dawaaji/guba/kaafahi e juuɗe makko, ngam suudu makko woni kisal.
Likita maa waawi hokku mo shawara, ƴeewtagol ɓernde, e so ɗum depression, walla jokkude e mai-lafiya hakkillo/psychiatric nurse.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
answer:
Sannu ma, rufugo iyam masin ɓawo danyugo har juɗe e kosɗe fewa, ɓandu soma ɗum alama holloore iyam ɗuɗɗum saali ma (Postpartum Hemorrhage).

Mi laaɓinan bo mi laara baabel danyugo ngam mi ɓenna koo heddande ɓaawel (placenta) don nder dimru malla ɓandu seeki, ngam kanjum ɓuri waddude rufugo iyam ɗam.

Mi winndan ma lekki kiɗon ɗarna iyam rufata bee wallude dimru famɗita e hoota nokkuure maari (bana Oxytocin malla Misoprostol).

Ngam lornuki sembe ma e ɓesdugo iyam nder ɓandu ngam a waawa hakkilgo bee ɓingel ma, a heɓan ndiyam caahu (IV fluids) malla a ɓesde ƴiiƴam to haaji waɗi, bee lekki ɓesdata iyam (iron supplements).

Barka ma ɓingel ma na ɗon jam bana a yi'i, jooni ɗum wakkati nyawndugo ma ngam a heɓa sembe nde a hakkilinta be mako booɗɗum.

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
answer: Lootugo fuutere nden bee ndiyam e saabunde lawlaw ko kuugal lobbal masin, amma ɓingel ngel haandi heɓa bakkal *Rabies* (vaccine) hannde-hannde ngam faddaago nyawu boosaaru ndun. Ngam boosaaru ndun meɗai heɓugo bakkal, nyawu mbuuɓri ndin waawan naatugo nder ƴiiƴam ɓingel, to ngu naati bo walaa safaara baawɗo hisnugo yonki maagel. Ha asibiti, likitaajo hokkan ɓingel ngel lekki buuɓri (antibiotics) e bakkal *Tetanus* ngam faddaago fuutere nden nyo'ugo. Likitto'en nyo'ata (suture) fuutere ngati boosaaru lawlaw ngam taa nyawu ngun lumba nder ɓandu ɓingel ngel. Ndan wakkilan woydu ɓingel ngel asibiti mawndi ngam ngel heɓa bakkal *Rabies* hannde-hannde walaa fasaago ngam hisnugo nguurndam maagel.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Sannu ma Tilola, nyawu ɓingel ma ɗon wi'ee "Benign Teething Spasm", ɗum waddata zazzabi be taƴugo ɗaɗol daande. Daande nde waawataa waylitugo be yite nge waawataa maɓɓugo ɗum alamaaji ɓingel ɗon fuɗa nyiiƴe ɓaawo mawɗe. Ngam a wura ɗum, a hooya nebbam ɓoɗeejam gulɗam a wujja daande maako semmbe ngam ɗaɗi man yofta. Walaa haaje yahugo asibiti, a fiilna daande maako bee wudere wulnde, a toɓɓa nebbam man nder yite maako nge maɓɓataa. To a waɗi ɗum, zazzabi man be nyawu man fuu saalo nder balɗe ɗiɗi walaa damuwa.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.
answer:
Si ɓinngel maa ko ɓiraaɗam tan ɗo muyna, ɗo ɗoɗɗa heewi amma wala fepu, wala ƴiiƴam/ɓodɗum e roɓɓi, wala yuttude, ɗum ena waawi wonde al’ada.
Jokku hokki mo ɓiraaɗam tan haa lebbi jeegom; hoto hokku ndiyam, kunu walla magani gargajiya.
Si roɓɓi ɗin ko ndiyam-ndiyam, hokku ORS seeɗa-seeɗa caggal ɗoɗɗe kala, e zinc 10 mg ñande kala ñalɗi 10–14 si o les lebbi 6.
Yah asibiti ɗoonɗoon si fepu, ƴiiƴam e roɓɓi, yuttude, o sala muynude, jonta/yimɓe, gite suɓii, wala ndiyam fittaade/urine.

question: ɓinngel am waɗi reedu duuɓi makko wudala so henayi kanko mo woodi reedu ko feeti hannde bo jeema mi yisi o ɗo woodi nawuɗo o arti o mofti kare makko o wari wuro am non ɓeydi nde mi laari nawuɗo makko daraayi mi mofti kare makko arannde kam o yiɗa mi yaara mo nyawdorude mi yaari mo nyawdorude ɓe laari mo ɓe wi'i remirde makko fuɗɗi no maɓɓito nden wakkati o danyol maɓɓito nden wakkati o danyota ɓadi haa jotta kam danyoyi makko no ɓanti fa wakkati kon cukale on wurtoyta inga keenya kam cukale on no nane nawuɗo nawuɗon ndon ɓedota hammi jotti o wondi nawuɗon cukale makko wurtayi ridu makko arande on hakkilo am ummi ɓene am de itake mi yiɗi mi yida ɓinge am mi yiɗa mi soya ɓinge am ge warta du useini ɗume fodata nawudon on non dayodan arande wa'ina no fodata de wi'a ɓinge fotayi wurta hide alaura ko baɗon seka mo
answer:
Ɗum ɗon caɗeele mawɗe ngam danygol ɓinngel ma ɗon lorta kadi o ɗon famɗi duuɓi, ɗum waɗi danygol ngol fati (obstructed labor). Ngam o cukalel kadi ko reedu makko arannde, yaasin taasa makko (pelvis) famɗi ko waɗi ɓinngel ngun waawaayi wurtugo jotta.

Ɗon haaje on njaara mo nyawdorude mawnde (asibiti) nden e jotta ngam likitootooɓe tawa laawol taƴugo reedu (C-section) ngam hisnogo ngendam makko e ngendam ɓinngel ngun. Ta kuɗe o wona saare fey, ngam ta wakkati yawta, danygol ngol waawan fusgo reedu makko koo wadda caɗeele "fistula" bee maide. Yahugo nyawdorude mawnde jotta jotta woni laawol tan ngol hisnata ɓinngel ma e cukalel mum kisndam.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer:
Damuwa ka ɓingel ɗo mari kanon woni **Birth Asphyxia** (asfiksiya danygol), ɗum waɗata to ɓingel heɓai henndu fofoore (oxygen) boɗɗum wakkati danyi ɗum.

Ngal kuuranno auna ɓandu ɓingel kanon woni *APGAR score* ngam laargo no fofoore, ɓernde, e ɓandu mako woni nder minti arandeejo e minti jowi ɓawo danygol.

Handi likotoro'en mbaɗana ɓingel mbalitiri fofoore (neonatal resuscitation) e law nder "Golden Minute", bana laɓɓingo hunduko e kine, e nafturgo *Ambu bag* ngam fitoojo henndu to o fofitai.

Hokkingo ɓandu ɓingel ngunndi (warmth) bana daɗugo mo e dada mako (Kangaroo Mother Care) ɗon mari nafu masin ngam hisgo mako.

Yaɓɓugo ɓingel ɗo asibiti mawɗo mo mari kujeji kuraani keccel (NICU) e law ɗon walla ngam rento mako e hisgo damuwa ka ɓando.

question: Jam ɓandu likita waddi bingal amin larin no o fofata ɗon woni bana sautu hendu ɗo sala babal petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo dake o fofata milliti bo balɗe tati jotta o ɗo ɗotta be jamma wakkati fere mi ɗo lara ɓe ɗo nasta sosai. Ɗo sosai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako seto o naftira sembe mako o hokkata mi lari bo o wala nyama banani to o nyamai fu sauto nyamai fu sau to o nangi pofɗe mako seto nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokka tame oɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati. Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. To handini hotina heɓa famta ko damata mo be kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum irin nyaundi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha sare hoinina mo heɓa o fofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataki je hosata hado ɓingel ɗo.
answer: Sannu, alaamuuji ɗi a baddi, bana ɓingel ɗon taya foofa kadi ɓernde ɗon nasta, ɗon holla ngel mari nyawu pneumonia koo fofa-hakkol (asthma). Lekkiji chemist tan waawataa safrude nyawu mangu banni. Yaaru ɓingel asibiti mawɗo jooni-jooni ngam likita'en ɓesda laara ngel, ɓe hokko ngel lekki koo oxygen. Taa leeli sam, ngam nyawu ɓokko-ɓokko ɗon hula haa sukaaɓe tokosɓe. Haa asibiti tan ɓe mbaawi wallude ngel heɓa daama wakkatiire nde'e.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
answer: Ɓaŋugo ƴiiƴam (high blood pressure) e fiyugo ɓernde ɗi debbo oo wondi e mum ɗon umma ngam kulol e fitina ɗi gorko maako waddani mo. Lekki gargajiya waawataa wallugo mo ngam aslu nyawu nguu ko tikkere e jiiɓru hakkilo, naa laataaki nyawu meere. Ko ɓuri wooɗugo, sey o hoota saare danyiɓe mo ko nokkuure nde o walaa kulol ngam o daɗna yonki maako, o heɓa jam hakkilo. Baawo ɗon, o yaha asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en ndaara ƴiiƴam maako, ɓe hokka mo lekki mongu, kadi ɓe mballa mo e ɓanggal nyawu hakkilo (counseling) ngam o fita e ndu'um kulol.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
answer: Ɓingel ngel ina waawi heɓde ñawu ɓernde (pneumonia) wonnde e mboro o, sabu ko faafo yaajngo e ƴiiƴam ɓernde (chest in-drawing) min njiyata ɗum ko baawɗo warde ɓingel ngel. Ko poti waɗeede ko yo ɓe ngoppu leɗɗe kese ɗe kaaldaani ɗee, ɓe ndokku ɓingel ngel lekkiiji nder mboros (IV antibiotics) ko wayi no Ceftriaxone, tawa o woni ko e sibiti ngam heɓde toppitagol e oksijen. Min poti ƴeewnde ƴiiƴam ɓingel ngel ngam anndude so tawii ko ñawu vi (malaria) walla ñawu mborosaaji (sepsis), ngam ndokkude mo lekkiiji potɗi ko wayi no Artesunate so tawii ko vi. Hokkude yumma mum oo e ɓingel ngam ɓe mbaawa waɗde ko ɓuri moƴƴude e nder galle ina waawi bonnude mo, ɗum noon ko haanji ɓe njooroo e nder sibiti haa ɓe ngurtora cellal. Caggal nde ɓe ngurtorii, min ndokka yumma oo jaŋde dow no o wisirta ɓingel ngel ɓoggi ñawu vi (mosquito net) e no o jokkirta dewgal ñawu nguu (immunization) ngam reende mo ñawuuji goɗɗi.

question: mi waddi bingel am mudu biji nayi nyautolde hanne nyaluwa mi leli bingel on siroso wudenayan goddon amma bosaran gatimo de be waddi jokale on wuro be hi ti'an kofeti mira buti fude reto bosaru en gati shukale on mita yi fudere non wuti bo buti mi wadi yamdede bo ken dirabe mo an di bosaru nganya tibingel on jon bosaru don wui be meda hokku go bosaru on jibnen de be wi dun yahai yasi dun fija dun warta tun be wi be meda hokku go bosaru dun nikki sun kanjum wadi mi holi sai mi yahai waddugo bingel on nautorde ngam to bosaru dun ngati tukale on no wawi no wodi no bosaru dume hebata bingel go bosaru ngati bo dume wawi hiba futere wujjudum e buti dum nyau bana nyau bosaru wawi nasta der futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sabbun ngati bosaru on si ko dume mi wawi wadugo ngam to nyaunata futere on dume jun nande e lekki hani hokka bingel on ngam hiba jam ko dume goddo mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi wadango futere den de bosare don ngati bingel
answer:
# Jaaburu

Bingel maa dujunayi-bo nyawu nasara ɗum ɗon waddira malaria malla nyawu ɓuuɓɗo. Bosaru ɗon wuyi nde tawno ɗum ko ɓanndu nduu ina wuli fof, a ɗaɓɓirta ko e hoore ndee sabu woni ko ɓuri heewde ƴiiƴam. Ngam hisnude bingel maa, njokku hoorde maa reedu mum, ndarooro mo nebam, waɗa heeferde mum, ndokku mo leɗɗe paracetaamol ngam ustude nyau nguu. So tawii nyau nguu wota woppude caggal duuɓi tati, yah yo o yiyee doktoor ngam ƴeewnde ɓeydaare ko wayi no malaria. Woto ndokku bingel on lekki neem malla lekkiiji gaadanteeji tawa ko e wasiyaaji doktoor.

question: debbo laari gorko maako ɗo mari nawol hoore nawol hoore may foɗai sam sam nawol hoore ɗo ɗo naawi ni har senda daande maako o teddi ni wawata waylutugo nanu be nyamo ni bana o handi se o laari kuulal ɓamari je walano ɓandu gorko may amma fuɗɗi vurti nonnon ɗum hulni debbo may ɗo irin kujeji fe'i dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on laati huunde may vurti kuma ɗume on o waɗata ko mi emi debbo may ba gorko ma komeɗi marugo zazzaɓi nawɗum na bekuma lekkitoy be naftiri ofii a a ko gorko may lesowo ɗanata ɗo pilow dawai ba o ɗani dow dandi mako ba ofii a a dani dow dandi mako ba nonnon nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tiddol dandi kuma pulel perpetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu mako ko irin kuje bannin fedi dume ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata wallititta gorko mako be lorninamo ɓandu bana no wonno
answer: Debbo, ɗum alamaaji meningitis (nuunɗu hoore) bonɗi, ɗon holla infeksiyon tedduɗo nder ƴiiƴam. Nawra hore mawnge, tiddol daande, e pulel perpetel ɓalewol ɗon mbaadi petechiae (ƴiiƴam les deri ngam mboros) ɗon waɗa gorko maa nder haɓɓere. Ɗum nyau yaawɗo maayde; taw gorko ma heɓaay lekki yaawre, o waawi maayde nder sahaa seɗɗa. Ngaɗaa ko nyawma: njaaɓondir gorko maa law law to asibiti mawɗo ngam dokke mo enjeksiyon antibiotic nder ƴiiƴam. Woto ɗowtaano safaara gaadanteeri walla lekkitoy wuro; yah to doktoor jooni, ko tan woni no hisnetee ngurndan makko.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
answer: Ko ɓuri heewde wadde rufgo iyam balɗe caggal danygo ko ɓawngal (placenta) ɗam accaama nder reedu, walla reedu nduu accaali momtude hoore mun (uterine atony), walla ɗum ko ɓaktuungal nder reedu (infection). Sibiti ɗo, dokajo ene hokka leɗɗe ngam wallitde reedu nduu taaqaade ngam ɗaɓɓude iyam (ko wayi no Oxytocin), ɓe ɗaɓɓirta ko heddii e nder reedu, ɓe hokka mo iyam (blood transfusion) walla leɗɗe njamndi ngam artirde semte mako. Ɗum ko nyawu tooñaɗo no feewi, ɗum noon dada oo ina haani e teeŋtinde yaawnude hootde sibiti ngam ƴeewteede, tawa ko ɗum waawi waddude hattan e nguurndam. Wonande ɓingel ngel, so yumma mum ƴeewtaama o artiraama semte, ina moƴƴi o ɗaɓɓa ƴamde yumma mum so tawii ko leɗɗe ɗe dokajo hokki yumma ɗe njahrata e ƴamde. Dada oo ina haani ñaamdu ɓuri heewde njamndi e ko waawi heɓtude semte (ko wayi no kosam e ƴi'e) ngam wallitde cellal mum e ɓingel ngel, kono ñaawoore dokajo ko ko ɓuri teeŋtude e ɗaɓɓude caɗe ɗee.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
answer: Waylaggo launi ɓanndu ɓinngel e tampiri foofugo ɗum alaama ŋakkere henndu (oxygen) nder ƴiiƴam, ɗum ɓurna fuu nyawu dabbude (pneumonia) malla nyawu ɓernde lallaandi addata ɗum. Irri foofugo nii walaa jam, ɗum holla ɓinngel ɗon nder naawalla mawɗo mo haandi e ndaare law-law. Alaamaaji kalluɗi ɗi saarooji poti hakkilango kanjum woni; yaawugo foofugo, pofɗe ɗon loosa nder gaduhi (chest indrawing), salugo muusugo, e ɓawluggo leɓɓi malla ɓanndu. Taimako law-law mo mbaawata hokkugo woni wulnugo ɓinngel, laɓɓina hinere maagel taa sukka, nden taa dolnugel muusugo ngam taa ngel siro kosam. Ko ɓuri anfaani fuu woni yaargo ɓinngel asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en mbaawa ƴeewugo ngel, hokkugo ngel henndu (oxygen) e lekki.

question: Goɗɗo ɓe nodeta suberu duɓi mako sappan ɗe joyi nyande mum fere o fuddi nyouru arande bo yori ɗum nyadai amma de ɗum fabi asawai je sedda tan yarugo lebbi be hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum hallobi sedda sai ɗum salda rimopde ɗum gonga on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata inde ko nyauru ɗon satai amma. Pat manju ɗum wadai da ha nu o nyaɗita yonru de o hilliti dow o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha nyaudo o yawto o yokki nyaurde o hecci ɓe ɗo jalibi tati ko sali o lori fahin o hecci ɓe o hafti ko o wawata waɗugo bana ko himɓe shawari mo ko larani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum. Ɗo heɓe lekki ɗuɗi ka ko o suɗi da ha nuno o nyaɗita sei nyouru wari tullitti ɗum yottike wakkati fere fu mahe salda roɗi sei o nyami nyautawo on ko waɗi nyoru ɗum neɓuri bana ni salo yamɗetugo o yidi o anda ko waɗi dabare be leɗɗe ɗe o fuɗi fu nafi. oyam ɗume o wannata yoru ɗon yamɗita ɗo fu maru gam o heɓa o fufa no hani olollita jamu bandu makko.
answer:
Ko anndoru ndiyam fota anafilaksiya (jawdi jamdi) sabu baawgal ngesa caggal noddude ceftriaxone e azithromycin, ndee kañum ina waawi yaltinde BP e ɓeyditinde heart rate.
Babeejo o wadi fota shock anafilaktik, ngam kesal laawol yeeso e hawrude hawruuji.

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. Lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwini mo sei o vi o dilli tan o yahi a sibiti heɓa ɓe hefta ko fe’ata be petul damuwa ɗo wawan hoina ɓingal ɗo damuwa ɓerde na ko asma ɗon fe’ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toi ɗon handi ɓingel ɗo handi acca heɓa ko. damata mo wadinta mo o dodda ho’ina mo usta sosai.
answer: Nyau nguu ko ndiyam ɗuɗɗam e peewol nder huhuuwo ɓingel ngel waɗata asma bee ɗojju man. Ngam hoinugo ɓingel ngel, a foti accugo hokkugo mo ndiyam yarugo fof ngam huhuuwo maako heɓa yora lawlaw. Hubbu yiite nder suudu maɓɓaande wakkati jemma ngam cuurki man e nguleeki man wallita mo fofugo boɗɗum nder ɗaangol. Wujju nebbam wulɗam nder hinere maako ngam ɗum maɓɓita laawol henndu kadi. Hada mo nyaamugo walla yarugo koo ɗume peewɗum, bee nii damuwa fofugo man usta, ɓingel yamɗa pat.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
answer: Sannu mon, alaamaji gite e ɓandu ooldi (jaundice), zazzaɓi nguli, naawalla hoore, e tuutuɗi ɗi on limti ɗon holla alhaali nyawu pabbooje (severe malaria) cattuɗum, yellow fever, ko bo nyawu nawa-heenyere (hepatitis). Ngam ledde asali wawaay wallugo bo oolde man ɗon ɓesda, min ɗon ƴeewa ƴiiƴam maako jooni-jooni ngam min tabbitina asali nyawu nguu nden min ndaara no heenyere maako huuwatirta. Min ɗon fukkina mo haa sibiti (admit) ngam min loka mo ndiyam nder ɗaɗol (drip) e leɗɗe nyawu pabbooje cattuɗe ngam o darna tuutuɗi, o heɓa sauki lawlaw. On waɗi ko woodi on ngaddi mo sibiti, ammaa mbalee acce hokkaago mo ledde asali kadi ngam ɗi ɗon ɓesda bonnugo heenyere maako. Insha Allahu to min fuɗɗi hokkugo mo leɗɗe sibiti e ndiyam, zazzaɓi e naawalla man ɗon usta, gite maako bo ɗon fuɗɗa laaɓugo.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer: Ngal nyawngu a sifoto anndiraa bee 'pre-eclampsia', kanjum waddi ɓuutu yeeso, nawowol hoore, bee ɓeydaari sembe ƴiiƴam (BP) nder reedu. Ɗum laato to sembe ƴiiƴam nauni ɓandu debbo, kanjum addani ɓuutu ɓandu bee waddigo toɓɓere ndiyam (protein) nder cille maako. Matakiiji haandi ɓe hoo'a wakkati o ɗon haami reedu kanjum woni aawngo cille maako ngam ɓe ndaara 'protein', tokkugo shanugo lekki sembe ƴiiƴam asibiti, bee heɓugo siwtaare sosai. To sembe ƴiiƴam ɗon ɓeyda masin, likita'en piyan mo bakkal hisnugo yonki maako (magnesium sulfate) taa nyaw fadda mo. Lekki nyawngu nguu koondey tan woni debbo danya bingel wakkati mo haandi ngam hisnugo margo maako bee ɓiɗɗo maako.

answer: Dabare ɗe kaalto-ɗaa ɗen, bana futugol ɓanndu fu, hoore ɗoygol, e ŋakkere ƴiiƴam, hollata ko o mari caɗe niɓɓe (kidney failure) walla caɗe ɓernde ɗe mbaɗata ɗam mooftugo nder ɓanndu. Ŋakkere ƴiiƴam ɗum ko sabu niɓɓe ɗen njaltataa hormones ɗe ɗaminoo ƴiiƴam, ɗum waɗi o ɗoya haa omo waawaa semmbe, omo ñaawa ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) ngam wallugo ɓernde mako. Ko ɗum waɗi, ko yaajata o heɓa ƴiiƴam ɗam ɓe ɗon nji'a ngam ɗokkindo mo, tawa kadi omo sokli "shafi fofugo" (dialysis) ngam wurtinde ɗam ɗam ɗon ɗoƴɗina mo. Yumma maako ɗo jima ɗon mari haaje heɓugo ballal, kono omo waawi wallude ɓiɗɗo maako e jaɓugo doktoor'en ngam timminde ɗokkinde ƴiiƴam e shafi mako. Alaa lekki galle waawi safrude ɗum, ko yaajata o jokka e opitaal ngam heɓugo ƴiiƴam e "shafi fofugo" ɗi doktoor'en ɗon njuɓɓinta ngam hisnude mo.

question: addirawo am danyi ɓinngel debbo balɗe saali sey o laari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo wala foofa boɗɗum wakkati feere ɓinngel man yofta kosam bamo fofɗe maako ta'i yande woore daada ɓinngel timmini musungo mo bee jemma sey o laari leɓɓi ɓinngel ba wala ba wayliti seɗɗa seɗɗa sey o tampi ko o waɗata sey o goɗi ɓamtugo ɓinngel man ngam o heɓa o foofa boɗɗum ammaa bo ɓinngel gaagiri foofugo boɗɗum bee boo canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel man sey o yaawi o hoosi ɓinngel o yaari asibiti ngam ɓe laaranamo ɓinngel may ɗume on canjini ɓinngel man leɓɓal nden bo walaa aybe no ɓinngel foofata na ko bo nyawuɓe nde walla nyawu hanta dasinta ɓinngel man foofugo bee bone ɗume on alaamaaji kalluɗum jee saarooji waatinta hakkiilo ɗume on agaji ɓe waawata hokkugo ɓinngel mo foofata bee bone
answer: Alaamaaji ɗin, hono leɓɓi ɓawluɗi, ta'ugo yande les, e salugo yoftugo, hollata wonde ɓinngel ngel ina jogii nyawu foofaango tiiɗungu (severe pneumonia) adduɗe ŋakkere oksijin. Alaamaaji kalluɗi poti hakkillaago ko: foofaango yaawungo, ta'ugo yande, leɓɓi ɓawluɗi, salugo yoftugo, e tampugo sanne. Ballal arande ngal ɓe mbaawi hokkugo ko laɓɓingo hunuko man so ina heewi, wulnugo ɓinngel ngel, e yaawnugo nawgo ngel asibiti. Njaawgu maɓɓe nawgo ngel asibiti ko huunde haanunde sanne ngam ngel heɓa oksijin e safara, ngam nyawu nguu ina waawi warugo so safaraaki e wakkati.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer: Alamaji makko ɗin, haa teeŋti e sillugol, ɓuygol, e larugol daure, ɗon holla wonde o ɗon waawi heɓugo nyau shuga (Diabetes Mellitus) sabu suukara heewɗo nder ƴiiƴam ɗon saɓa ɓanndu yaltina ndiyam nder cille. Ko haani o yaha asibiti law ngam o waɗa gwaji ƴiiƴam (Fasting Blood Sugar e HbA1c) e gwaji cille ngam tabitina nyau man. Haa o heɓa sakamako, o acca nyamugo kuje ɗe njogii suukara e fure (no shinkafa, tuwo, e shukara), o ɓeyda nyamgo leɗɗe, e yargo ndiyam laaɓɗam ngam haɗugo ɓanndu mako yoorgo. Bawo gwaji, dokotoore hokkan mo safaraaji ɗi ɗon ustu suukara, amma o wota o jilla ngam dille hoore e ɓuygol ɗon waawi saɓugo o faya ko o waɗa halkere.

question: goɗɗo ɓe noddata subeeru duuɓi makko cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowuru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko
answer: Nyaw ƴowru neeɓndu bana ndu lebbi tati, na foti wonugo maale nyawuji caɗtuɗi bana pahu (Tuberculosis) malla caɗeele pofol, nden kadi duuɓi maa cappanɗe joyi ɗon ɓeyda riskiku man. Lekkiiji ladde, goro, e jumri mballataako ngam kurugol nyawuji mawɗi bana ɗi, ɗum kadi ɗon halkude ma wakkati ngam heɓugo nyawndugol gonga. Ko haani mbadɗaa joni woni a yaha suudu nyawndirdu mawndu (hospital) ngam ɓe njannga tuutre maa (sputum test) nden ɓe mbeɗa nate gaba maa (Chest X-ray). To tawaama ɗum nyaw pahu (TB) on, nyawndugol man ɗon mari caahu (free) e nder asibitiiji laamu nden bo a sellan kadi a foofa jam. Ngam man, accee hoosugo lekkiiji walaa qira'a walla leɗɗe ladde, yheehee asibiti joni-joni ngam asibiti on tan woni laawol sellal maa.

question: Debbo fere kam waddi bingel mako mo dimbi tati asibiti be laramo hande subaka ko be halibo eketo yimɓe olo wani binge on tatata kosam o larata goddo fere mo wolwal tamo heddi inde mako o sota mo damai ha noi masan hingare jungo nyami debbo on cokali on medi hiɓugo badde na mako. O meda himɓe baɗɗe minbedi men cokali heɓi jaɓugo kala batel mum ha tummude ko o fotti noɓugo bana no inna mako waddi redi nyaudugo ɗum min kotoltol laɓii mingew on jarbi bate mako pat feiti. Innde cukali on ingol wala paɗɗe o jaɓi bate pesode mako pat ko dami cu.
answer: Alaamaji ɗi on kaali na holla ɓingel ngel na wondi e nyawu pabuwa (malaria) mawngu nguu naati e ngaandi, koo bo nyawu mbuuwa (meningitis). Ɗum nyawu nguu na saati masin, ngam maajum dole ɓingel ngel njaale e asibiti lawlaw ngam ɓe laara yiiyam maagel ɓe annda ko wondi e maagel. Likita'en ɗon haaji ɓe fukka ngel, ɓe loka ngel barmel koo lekki e ɗaɗi (IV drips) ngam ngel waawaa saawugo nyamdu koo ndiyam. E nokkuuje meeɗen, to ɓingel wondi e gulɗum ɓanndu masin haa ngel dilla anndugo yimɓe, ɗum haaji heɓugo lekki lawlaw ngam faɗɗago bonneeji ngaandi koo maayde. Taa hokku ngel lekki leɗɗe e saare, acca likita'en puɗɗa ndaargal e lekki lawlaw.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
answer: Debbo omo heɓi nyau ƴiiƴam ɓurtuɗam e rediyo (Severe Preeclampsia), ɗum ko *emergency* tilay o yaha asibitirwal law ngam daɗndugo nguurndam makko e ɓinngel ngel. Dokita'en hokkata mo lekki ustugo ƴiiƴam (hono Nifedipine) e *Magnesium Sulfate* ngam haɗugo mo heɓugo rafiiji (seizures). Nyaamdu makko haani wonde ko ŋakki lamɗam, kadi haani o yara leɗɗe gaaɗi ɗe mbonnata ɓanndu, o hokke lekki asibitirwal tan. Haani o hutora e nder asibitirwal, o ɗaana e bannge nano ngam ƴiiƴam yila no feewi faade e ɓinngel ngel. Sabou o heɓiino redu lediiɗi ɗiɗi, *risk* makko ɓeydike, donkin tilay dokita'en ɓe ndaara mo haa o jibina e jam.

question: mi waddi bingel am mudu biji nayi nyautolde hanne nyaluwa mi leli bingel on siroso wudenayan goddon amma bosaran gatimo de be waddi jokale on wuro be hi ti'an kofeti mira buti fude reto bosaru en gati shukale on mita yi fudere non wuti bo buti mi wadi yamdede bo ken dirabe mo an di bosaru nganya tibingel on jon bosaru don wui be meda hokku go bosaru on jibnen de be wi dun yahai yasi dun fija dun warta tun be wi be meda hokku go bosaru dun nikki sun kanjum wadi mi holi sai mi yahai waddugo bingel on nautorde ngam to bosaru dun ngati tukale on no wawi no wodi no bosaru dume hebata bingel go bosaru ngati bo dume wawi hiba futere wujjudum e buti dum nyau bana nyau bosaru wawi nasta der futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sabbun ngati bosaru on si ko dume mi wawi wadugo ngam to nyaunata futere on dume jun nande e lekki hani hokka bingel on ngam hiba jam ko dume goddo mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi wadango futere den de bosare don ngati bingel
answer:
Bingel lewruuji nayi (4 months) to woni e bosaru/yarsude, a yahdu mo nautorde/asibiti hannde, sabu o waawi heɓde ɗoyngol ndiyam (dehydration) ko yaawi.
Tee e ɗamtugo/ɗokkugo nono no feewi; so a heɓii ORS, hokku mo ɗooɗum-ɗooɗum caggal kala bosaru.
So ORS alaa, waɗ ndiyam laaɓɗam lita 1 + shukare cuɓe 6 + gishiri cuɓel heewaani (1⁄2 teaspoon), hokku ɗooɗum-ɗooɗum; hoto waɗ lekki wuro walla lekki dartinirɗo bosaru.
Zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala haa ñalɗi 10–14 wawi wallude, kono dokita/ma’aikacin lafiya yo hollu dose.
So fuɗɗere hoore naatii, hunduko ɓorni, o ɗamataa, o yaltataa pissi, o waɗi ngulɗi, ƴiƴam e stool, walla o tampii/no hoyi—ɗum ko gawat, yah asibiti jooni.

question: duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi neɓai mi danyi balɗe jeɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on mi danyi mi hirriti dow to miɗon musuni keccel am ɗo yarnama bone musugo to o musuni seɗɗa ni se o itta hunduko mako tomi habdi musugo mo fahin se o musuni seɗɗa o itta hunduko se mi numi ko haɗi mo musugo boɗɗum se mi herriti oɗo mari damba wala fofa boɗɗum bana ɓingel ɗo hara bannin mi nanata ɓofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am ovi tema de miɗon danya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo mi numi to ndiyam nasti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min koɓuri pusugo am ɓerde ma kanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am walai o wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai tomi waɗi sembe tomi yiɗi o musina sai tomi findinimo o musina seɗɗa to fottinimo mi yiɗi mi ema dow sababu pewol man je o wala foofa be boɗɗum ɗo bo de o foofi fu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum
answer:
Mi faami: ɓingel balɗe jeɗiɗi so o waawataa musude nono boɗɗum, oɗon nana ɓofde/foofde makko no metti, ɗum ko alama waɗi ndeen; njahen ɗo likita walla emergency jooni.
Sababu ena waawi wonde hanci makko suɗɗi, infection/pneumonia, walla sepsis—ɓiɓɓe sukaaɓe no bonata ɗaɓɓude no weeɓi.
Hoto waɗ mo sembe ngam o musa; so hanci suɗɗi, waɗ “saline drops” walla ndiyam gishiri seeɗa e hanci, ndeen ɓattin nono hokku mo e koppu/spoon.
So oɗo mari wulɓe, ɓernde/honnduko no naata, oɗo suusataa, oɗo woni ɗumɗum/blue, walla o musaataa haa waktuuji 4–6, ɗum ko jokkondiral gila jooni.
Ndiyam naatde noppi/hoore ɗum ɓuri ɗaɓɓude likita, kono ko ɓuri hawrude ko foofde e musude makko.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
answer: Fofugo cattuɗo haa ɓingel petel ɗon waɗa ngam peewol ndiyam naati gabaare maagel. Ngam wallugo ngel, hokka ngel njuumri e ndiyam ngam ɗum usta fofugo ngo'o. Wuju nebbam manja e gabaare maagel, bo fiila ngel e bargooji tekkuɗi masin haa ɓandu wula. Fukka ɓingel ngel e ɓawo, taa ɓamta ngel, ngam fofugo maagel deƴƴa. Walaa haaje yahugo asibiti, to a waɗi ɗum ɓingel ma sellan jam.

question: Mini amodai we'e anɓɓa he jo jonamo o warti wuro o wulla, kominma ko fetiyam bosaru ha kosɗe mako me kala bo saru on toi ɗum ɗuroi koɗum bosaru kindiraɓe on wakkati nden meban ha balbe bo salun nga timmo ngam ɗum warake bo saru. mi yarama asibiti danyu dare kindira bate den tan mi yaha mi soda ha kemis mi sodi bata on ɗum tufuma ɗum kenya illa wakkati den mi yarima wuro amma lake man umti nokkure nanwoji jotta kam hakkila ammi hemi tammi bo sare ɗon hokki ɓingel nyamdu bo sare. mido nyama wodi lekki combiti larugo ko mo.
answer: To ɓoosaaru man waatama, nyawu maggu raɓɓitataako ɓingel maaɗa kadi. Allura kemis mo coodaa e tufi mo ɗon he'i ngam haɗugo nyawu dabbaaji nastugo ɓandu maako. Ngam ɓuuɗi e naawalla man, wujju nebbam ngulɗam haa kosngal man nden maɓɓa nokkure man bee leppol faat. Taa huli koo yaha asibiti kadi, hokku ɓingel man magani paracetamol tan ngam naawalla. Ɓaawo balɗe ɗiɗi ɓuuɗi man tellan, ɓingel maaɗa sellan fey.

question: debbo fere mo duɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti balɗe tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hanɗe waɗugo diga kafi ɓikkoi keccon de o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musungo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko seɗɗa po ɗanan tan o vi ɓingel man wala joga en ɗi nden bo ko dey jungo mako kosɗe be ɓandu mako pat ɗo fewi delem har ɗo hulna mo to o memi ɓingel man be jungo mako har ndikka o hosa mo ha nder saɓɓode o hakkilini ɓingel man saali en ɗi ɓandu mako ɗo fewi to ɓe memi nden bo ɓandu man ɗo ɓedda watugo har o wala wawa ɓamta jungo mako forta kosɗe bo o wala dimba sam o ɗo wali babal gotel tan to a lari ɓingel man ni o ɗo yonti bo nyaugel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗume on a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoy keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko ngam o sali musungo on tan ko ngam ɗume on ɗume min wawata waɗugo hala salari kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga kafi handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma hado man
answer:
# Alaamaaji e Reedu Musidal Ɓingel

Ndikka ɓingel man ɗo e nder **caɗeele bonɗe** (**neonatal danger signs**) ɗe wonaa hakke sali musungo tan.

## Musidal Alaamaaji:
- **Ƴakkugo ɓandu, ɓandu fewugo (hypothermia)** e reedu doole heɓaa
- **Wala sembe, wala dilman, wala wawa ɓamtugo jungo** (lethargy/floppiness)
- **Sali ƴakkugo, sali musungo** (poor feeding)
- **Nyawgel/dasol reedu** (possible sepsis walla infection)

## Ko Foti Waɗeede:
1. **Ndikka ɓingel man nawon asibiti law law** — ɗum wonaa caɗeele salari tan, ko waawi wonugo **infection (sepsis)**, walla **hypoglycemia** (heewre suukara reedu), walla **hypothermia**.
2. Kadi ɓe waɗana ɓingel **firlito reedu (blood test)** e **kaɓɓaam ndiyam-suukara** e **kaɓɓaam nyawgel**.
3. Reedu doole feewnee: uddu ɓingel e cuurki, resu e ɓalndu inna nde welnata ɓandu (skin-to-skin/kangaroo care).
4. To ɓingel wawaa musugo, ɓe okkora kosam e **NG tube** walla **IV fluids** asibiti.

**Shawara**: Wonaa sali musungo saabii, ko nyawgel waawi wonugo saabii. Nawon ɓingel asibiti hannde jooni — sabu neonatal sepsis ɗo waawi warde ɓingel to feewnaaka law.

question: ɓawo mi danyi ɓandu am fuɗɗi hoynugo kikiɗe fere ni mi numi tunda dai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam hafa to de am to mi yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum diyam ɓeddoti mi naftirta mi numi am hafa handi ni ɓiɗo hakkina hore am miɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigide fere bo wari mi nanai belɗum ɓandu am mi fuɗɗi nanugo jahagol be ɓandu am fuɗɗi diwunugo kullum kullum da miɗo nana jagol bo hauti be ɓandu am belɗum feyin semi hirliti iyam jey vurtata ɓawo daigo ɗon haccega minanata daga totton bo velai bo haccega mayi ɗuɗi bo meɗai feɗugo beyam mikasi ittugo gite am daga totton demi ummi sai ɗon miyahi sibiti mi'ema ko ndiyam labɗam jemi naftirta miyiwa bemai kamjum on wadda takalayam bawo daygo
answer:
Ee, goonga ma, naftirgo ndiyam ɗam laaɓaa ngam yiiwugo ɓaawo danygol ɗon naada kuukooje nyawu (bacteria) nder reedu ma, wadda nyawu masiin.

Gulɗum ɓandu, jaangol e diwunugo, kadi e iiyam luuɓɗam ɗam a yi'ata, ɗon holla alaamaaji nyawu man (puerperal sepsis) naati ɓandu ma.

Haa gure meeɗen, caɗeele ndiyam laaɓɗam ɗon saaba nyawuuji irin ɗi'i ɓaawo danygol, ngam maajum yahugo ma sibiti wakkati on waɗi nafuda masiin ngam taa nyawu man naata yiiyam ma.

Likita'en ɗon haandi ɓe hokke lekki (antibiotics) lawlaw ngam mbara nyawu man nder ɓandu ma.

Daga jotta, to a heɓai ndiyam laaɓɗam, heɓu a wulna ndiyam man ɗam waasa nden a naftira, ngam faddaago nyawuuji irin ɗi'i.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
answer: Ɗum no waɗa koondei, ɗum nyawu bi'eteengu somoore danyaaki (birth fatigue) ngam bone dango. Ngam magugo ɗum, saawu ɓingel ngel nder bargooji ɗuuɗɗi ngam ngel wula, acca ngel ɗaana boɗɗum taa dimba ngel koo seɗɗa. Hokka ngel ndiyam ngulɗam iidaaɗam be njuumri e hunnduko ngam laɓɓingo gafaare maagel e hokkugo ngel semmbe doggugo ƴiiƴam. Taa hokka ngel hendu (oxygen) koo waɗa goji, ngam wookaandu fustay semmbe maagel luttiindi. Munnya saa'iiji noogas e nayi tan; ɓingel ngel ummoto e jam, fuɗɗita musnugo dada maagel no haandi.

question:
Debbo lari gorko mako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira bedo do leso maini. Dojjugo nonon ni fuddata, oneba ni bako dara. Baldeji owada ni o lari gorko mako o yarabone foofugo . To o yapi sedda ni ko ofa’e eskal , odo dara lorna fofde mako , denbo odo yawa sommugo be lau. Don yende gorko mako neebi odo dojja be odo habda lorna fofde , daami debbo mai. Ofuddi numugo ko don ye’u je wattada damuwajido . Jango mai sai o volwini gorko mako beyaha sibiti be laara likita, heba be hefta ko daamata mo. Demde mai, dumedon waddata dojjugo kalnudum banni be yawugo somugo, be foofugo daker do? Damuwa do wawan ko shafi balle na ko ye’u ko shafi berde?. Hundeji toi don watata goddo maya ko yarna goddo bone foofugo, harje goddo mai hadine dasa hikkilo yaudibe?
Alaamaji kalnudum je damuwaji foofugo je dardiraabe haadi laara, hakilina je dojjugo be foofugo daker do?
answer: Debbo mako wona en yimɓe fofugo e darde handi, ko waddata damuwaji dogo, ko yahugo chafi berde, ɗon koɗɗe goɗɗo vonugo, wadi hakkilina je dottugo dateɗum, wona no jibinan eclampsia. Yalla o wara asibiti heba be hefta to o yahay likitaaro marse eclampsia wadi hiirugol hiira mbaalu, waddude damuwa, je waddude hakkilina. Likitaaro wanaa wadi: MgSO4 (Magnesium Sulfate) e waddude hakkilina, njuuɗe tensiyon (Labetalol/Nifedipine) e waddude damuwa, ko ceeɗude dewgal (Dexamethasone) e woodi debbo je yargo. Yimɓe fofugo wanaa wadi jibinan HELLP syndrome walla Placental Abruption, woodi likita o wadaa laawol labo (CBC, LFT, RFT, Coagulation profile) je sonare feto. Debbo mako wona wara hayɓude asibiti toɓɓo to o yahay wallude e jaɓɓude yargo si Alla jaba.

question: Debbo fere kam waddi bingel mako mo dimbi tati asibiti be laramo hande subaka ko be halibo eketo yimɓe olo wani binge on tatata kosam o larata goddo fere mo wolwal tamo heddi inde mako o sota mo damai ha noi masan hingare jungo nyami debbo on cokali on medi hiɓugo badde na mako. O meda himɓe baɗɗe minbedi men cokali heɓi jaɓugo kala batel mum ha tummude ko o fotti noɓugo bana no inna mako waddi redi nyaudugo ɗum min kotoltol laɓii mingew on jarbi bate mako pat feiti. Innde cukali on ingol wala paɗɗe o jaɓi bate pesode mako pat ko dami cu.
answer: Alam ɗi (huuji, feewanɗe, woppu kala, waɗde ngoodi) ko mawnude, ɗum ena waawi waɗde feewnde tawa kaɗi ko asibiti waɗata. Tukaale humondiral/hayre e “sangande” ngam newnude ɗiɗi waawi haɗa ngoodi walla ɓuri waɗde, sabu ɗum ena addi yiite e haɗari. Wadde ɗum, waɗɗo ɗiɗi e nder haako, seɗɗa seɗɗa, kadi naatnoy e asibiti ɓe ngay yiya feewnde, njaaci, walla ndiyam nder hanci so ena waɗi. So ɗiɗi woppataa, ena newnataa, ena feewa no feewi, walla feewanɗe ɓuri, waɗɗo ɓe ɗoctor ko feewi ko jooni. Kadi tawto ko ɗiɗi waɗi alluwol (immunization) e yitere, tee suuɗo ɗiɗi haako e leydi woppu.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
answer: Alamaji ɗi laraa, bana dojoore, somugo lau, bee ɓuutu yeeso, ɗum asali alamaaji jontere (malaria) bee taifot (typhoid) mangu naati nder garki maako. Ɓuutu yeeso bee tiiɗugo fofaango ɗon wara ngam o ɗon yara ndiyam peewɗam ɗuuɗɗam warta sanyi nder ɓokkooji maako, ɗum walaa ko laarani nyawu ɓernde sam. Nyawu ɓernde waddataa dojoore koo somugo law, ngam maajum taa dammu ngam ɓernde maako ɗon kalaw. Wi'u mo o acca yarugo ndiyam peewɗam, o hoosa bo lekki jontere caatuɗum fahin, o heɓan jam nder balɗe seɗɗa.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
answer:
Gorko ma ɗon mari alaamaaji nyaw mbuubu ngaandi (**meningitis**) bee nyaw mbuubu kure (**meningococcemia**), ngam nawol hoore nyaaɗngol, tiiɗol daande, bee ɓuule purple haa ɓandu.

Ɗum nyaw jaddum e kulniidum sanne ngu waawan wardugo bee maide to ɓe kortaay mo law. Doole maa njaha bee mako haa suudu nyawndirdu ɗonɗon ngam o heɓa lekki (*antibiotics*) ndartinteeɗi haa ɗaɗol.

Ta jooɗu haa saare, kuma ta naway bee lornugo lekitaajo ngam nyaw mako ɗon fannya lawlaw. Nyawnduki njaawɗum tan woni daliila belɗum ngam hisnugo yonki mako e lornugo mo jam.

question:
Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Dai owari jambi je tati be fajiri , mo wondi be mako ha sare yooni amin, vi debbo do bandu mako do duina bo do vuli sosai denbo odo mari damuwaaji ko shafi bandu mako je daamata sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.
Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.
Sai minvi debbo mai o umma o hoods obaara bawo mako , heba vallita bandu mako hoina sedda da pat ba, amma vallitai bo gite mako Labai. Min sauri mo to yamini sai oyara paracetamol. To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
answer: Debbo ɗo wari jamdi tati, ɓandu mako dimna, wuli sosai, damuwaji, e nyamugo nden, wallude malaria. Min laari suddo mo kare, wolugo, e godi je nyamo cufi wallude anemia (ɓawo mako) mo hikka malaria. Parasita mol tonda o satai to dillai wallude anemia hemolitiik e anemia falciforme (genotype SS/SC) mo yahata malaria. Min waɗi test hemoglobin, genotype, e RDT/microscopy malaria se min hokki anemia e malaria. Wallude anemia e malaria, min nafa suka blood transfusion, ACT (AL/AS-AQ), folic acid, e paracetamol.

answer: Alamoji ɗi gorko ma waɗata, bana dooyru duumiindu lebbi ɗiɗi e soofunde (fuka) saanga sollaare, ɗon holla oɗo mari nyawu asma malla nyawu dooyru tumpaaru (TB). answer: Ɓingel ngel ina wondi e caɗeele yaafde e wuumde (hypothermia), ko ɗuum waɗi ko haani ko yaawi wuttude mo e wutte wuurɗe walla naatnude mo e nder incubator ngam ɓamtude mo. Hokku mo henndu (oxygen) walla ballal yaafde (PPV) so o accaani yaafde no feewi, kadi laaɓtin laawol henndu makko so tawii ko ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam (meconium) nguli. Ɗaɓɓir ƴiiƴam makko ngam ƴeewde sukar (glucose), hokku mo antibiyotik hono Ampicillin e Gentamicin, haa e tuubaare ɗam ndiyam (IV fluids) ngam wallitde semmbe makko. So o naatii suudu ɓiɗɓe, ko haani ko ƴeewaake nguleendi makko, ƴiiƴam makko, e yaafde makko ballogal ngam reende ɓamtal makko. answer:
Redujo ɗo wonndi e caɗeele **damuwa/tashin hankali** (anxiety e nguru ɓernde), be t(a)wi hino e nder ceɗeele ɓaawo warngo mo (yeru **PTSD** - kaawni ɓaawo bone waɗanooma).

Ndaa ko yo o waɗ:

1. **O yaha to likita/sibiti mawɗo** wonaa dammuwal tan - o yiɗi likita kaawƴa hakkillaaji (**mental health/likkita hakkilo**) sabu caɗeele maako no fewti e ɓernde e hakkilo, ɗum walaa ko lekki gargajiya waɗata.

2. **O yeewta e neɗɗo mo o hoolii** — dille'en saare, ndiwaawu deene walla ballal kadi ballal maantoraaki (counseling) no wallita ɗuytude kulol e nguru ɓernde.

3. Si caɗeele ɗe ɓeydii, likita no waawi hokka mo **lekki fewndaningel** (yeru anti-anxiety walla anti-depressant) e waktu ɗo o feewata.

Sey o anndira wonaa keɓi tan, be caɗeele hakkilo hino sella si o heɓi ballal likita e wallitanoore.

question: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
answer: Alamaaji ɗii ko ɗi rafi ƴiiƴam wuyteeɗi (mastitis) walla ɓuuɓri ƴam ƴiiƴam (abscess), ko ɗum ardata e ɓuuɓri tiiɗndi, waasde ƴam yaltude, e rafugol ɓanndu.
