So tawii ɓuuɓri ndii ɓeydii tiiɗnaade ɗoon e ɗoon, o foti ɗaɓɓude feere ɓuuɓnondiral (incision and drainage) to sibiti ngam ƴaltinde ƴam ɓuuɓɗam ɗam. Ɓingel ngel waawi jokkude re'ede e ƴiiƴam ɗam ɗam ɗam cellaani, so wonaa tawa doktoor on haɗii ɗum, ngam ɓadde ƴam ƴiiƴam moƴƴam.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. Pellel sam o yiɗi ɓinngel debbo to min waddini min waɗini ko haandi fuu en waɗata ɓaawo redu jobay ni min hoosi daada bee ɓinngel maako min yari bee hasudu ɓe siwta ndee seɗɗa sey dada man nyoniya o yecci amin o ɗo nana o walaa. O nana osomi gite mako o yi'ata laɓɗo o vi' amin ogodi nyamugo ɓawo o danyi amma da kek o heɓi o nyami be nyiri mai wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta oɗo ɗaana o wala sembe be o fuddi nanugo gelo on feɗi bannin ko iyam vurti ha mako sosai o wala iyam o handini ko o handi ni. Kilungo iyam ko ɗume wa nanta mo min hokka mo iyam na ko min hokka mo nyiri.
answer:
Ko ɗum ɗo hollata haɗari: debbo ndee ɓaawo jibinannde o walaa sembe, gite mako no rufde, o ɗo ɗaana, walla ƴiiƴam no yaltude — ɗum wa’i ko “ɗiiɗam/ƴiiƴam boni” walla shock ɓaawo jibinannde.
Wadde mo sibiti jooni-jooni; dokita haani auna BP, duba ko placenta timmi, Hb/ƴiiƴam, hokka drip, oxytocin/misoprostol, walla hokka ƴiiƴam so ɗum haani.
Haa ɗon, waɗee mo o ɗaanii leydi e tuggude, hokka ndiyam/ORS seɗɗa-seɗɗa so o ɗo waawi yarde, amma hoto hokka magani garaya walla lefol.
So ƴiiƴam no yaltude buy, o ɗo honga, o yi’ataa laaɓɗo, o ɗo waɗa fittu, walla o walaa sembe sam — ɗum ko emergency.
Nyiri e iron/folic acid maa walla, kono jooni ko sibiti ɓuri himmude, sabu o maa yiɗa ƴiiƴam/transfusion.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. answer: Nda, alaamaaji ɗi kaalɗaa, bana maɓɓugo leɓol (hunnduko), tiiɗugo ɓandu, e faddugo ɓingel keso ngel, ɗon holla nyawu masiibo wiyeteengu *Tetanus* (Dooki). Nyawu ngu'u ɗon heɓa ɓikkon ngam kessugo wuddu bee kuuje de laaɓaayi koo wujjugo lekkiiji gargajiya haa wuddu ndu'u. Taa huutore lekkiiji koo sabuluuji gargajiya sam ngam ɗum waawataa yamɗintingo nyawu ngu'u, bo ɗum ɓesdan masiibo haro ɓingel ngel. Woto tu’i tan e lekkol ngol a soodi tawa anndaaki konngol maggo, sabu ɗum waawi mettinde nyawu o. Bate tentanos ɗon hisnu maa e tetanus, kadi o hisni, taa hul. question: Debbo fere moh dubi chappan eh Didi eh Didi moh danyi ha asibiti balde Tati ko sali waddi bingel mako hande wadugo riga kafi bikkoi kecchon. Deh o wari sei o yechchi Amin bingel doh sali musungo, ha yotti bingel man wala sembe koh sedda boh o danan tan. Ovi bingel man wala joga endi, denbo kodei jungo mako, kosde beh bandu mako pat doh fewi delem har doh hulna moh to’omemi bingel man beh jungo mako, har dikka o hosa moh hader sabbodeh. O hakkilini bingel man sali endi, bandu mako doh fewi to beh memi denbo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala Wawa bamta jungo mako, forta kosde boh o wala dimbah sam, odo wali babal gotel tan. Toh a lari bingel manni odo yonti boh nyaugel. Dimeh Dasi bannin man? Dimeh on a numata dasata bandu bikkoi kecchon fewa delem toh goddo memi? Koh ngam o sali musungo on tan koh ngam dimeh on? Dimeh min wawata wadugo hala salareh kosam endi man? Denbo hala Riga kafi hadi min jabah man dimeh on shawara mah ha Dow man?
answer: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande. Dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. Jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawatauffedu hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man. Dembo ko ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer: Futtugo yeso be kosɗe, hawtaade be sembe iiyam dillo haa 150/80, ko alamaaji normal haa debbo marɗo reedu ngam ɓiɗɗo heɓa iiyam boɗɗum. Haani o acca yarugo lekki sembe iiyam man wakkati gooto ngam ɗum ɗon hokka ɓiɗɗo reedu rafi sembe. Ngam usta naawalla hoore be futtugo man, wi'i mo o ɓesda lamdam ɗuɗɗam nder nyamdu maako ngam ɗum walla ndiyam worta daga ɓandu. O lora o ɗaana haa saare nder jam, o fawta yaago asibiti fahin ngam taa likit'en ɓesdana mo damuwa. Ɗum fuu ɗon holla ɓiɗɗo ɗon mawna e jam, gam majjum walaa ko haani hultorgo sam.

answer:
Miɗo yiɗi yo a yaha da hospital/clinic haa a tottir ko woni, sabu hujjo dumɗe (ɓarnaaɗe) kala e kese baafal, sankira, ko goongaare e ɓernde (ɓayda) naatata.
Rewde e njuru-ɗaa e minndol kaarol no feewi, wonaa ko aɗa waawi waawde waɗude ngam barke, sabu kaarol goɗɗo ina mbaawi ɓeydude ruuhu, ɓernde, walla ɓoyde mbarɗe.
So aɗa yana ruuhu kala, saare, feber, haɓɓe jini, ko njoɓdi ndiyam, walla nana sokli baafal sosai, yo a waɗa to hospital ko haani.
Hakkille, a naamno ndiyam haa ɓuri, a ɓeydu ko aɗa waawi ñamde, tee hoto kaarol baafal doole so aɗa njuru-ɗaa ko feewi, haa doktoor on waɗi ko feewi.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer:
Alamaaji ɗi a limti ɗon holla masibo mawɗo; iyam wurtotoɗam be ketuuji, naawalla les jaaburu, e tampiri daada ɗon holla nyawu mboobu (infection) koo kedde danygol (retained placenta), nden ɓingel chanji e nguleefi ɗon holla ngel heɓi nyawu cemuɗam (neonatal sepsis).

Taa yardu e haala rewɓe wiyooɓe ɗum mere, ngam ɗum naa al'aada ndiyam ɓaawo danygol boɗɗum; on danyi haaje yahaago asibiti wakkati oon ngam likita en ndaara daada e ɓingel.

Zubar ƴiiƴam ɓaawo danygol e nyawu ɗon wadda naawalla reedu e soofugo ɓanndu, nden bo ɓikkoy keccoy ɗon yaawa waatugo to ɓe keɓi nyawu mboobu.

Ngam faddugo ɗum, daada handi tokka laaɓal ɓanndu, jaɓa lekki ƴiiƴam, nden bo o yaha asibiti (postnatal care) ngam taa nyawu nanga mo koo ɓingel.

Yawnee yahu asibiti wakkati oon ngam heɓugo laggol mboobu (antibiotics) e hisnugo yonki daada e keccel ngel.

question: debbo feere kam waddi ɓinge makko mo duuɓi tati asibiti ɓe laara mo hande subaka koɓe haali bo hikke to yimɓe wolwani ɓinge on o tannitataako sam o laarata goɗɗo feere mo wolwalta mo hetaano di'in de makko o sonyata mo daamayi hano o nane maasaba hindere ƴamoyi ngoyme ƴamidebbo on jukale omme ɗi higuguɓa tena e namakko wi o me daya hebike badde membedi mem tsamimo jukale ngoya hebi jabugo galapate be sode mun hatimude ko ofotino hebigo bana non inna makko waddi ereji nyawudugol dum min kotorto labini min ge on jabi bate makkosa but min bedi min tsami ko feti hunde jukale on ingol wala padde e o jabi bate pesode makko pat ko dami jukale on
answer:
Jukalel ngel no e haala nyawu mawɗo: ko o heɓi nguleendi, o waawataa jaabaade, gite/ɓalli mum no wayi haaɗi—ɗum ena waɗi min tuuma **malaria tiiɗnde (cerebral malaria)** walla **meningitis/sepsis**, hara ɗum ko gollal jaawngal.
Ɗum hinaa padde/epilepsy tan haa min ƴeewi mo; min waɗata sukaru ƴiiƴam, test malaria, PCV, ƴiiƴam ɗiɗi, e ƴeewtagol meningitis so ena woodi.
Pawtugol jaawngol: toppitagol ndiyam/oxygen so ena woodi, diazepam so o naŋgi, dextrose so sukaru leydi, **IV artesunate** ngam malaria tiiɗnde, e **ceftriaxone** ngam meningitis/sepsis.
Hoto ɓe naatnu mo ɗaɗi walla kosam/lekki saare nde o waawataa ɗaɓɓude, sabu ena waawi naatde henndu e ɓernde.
O foti wonde e asibiti, ɓe reena mo haa o yahrata e anndal e nguleendi leɗɗi.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Ɗojugo mai amma mi lari accdai joɗugo ha sare to mi dilli be fajira se a warta jego dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala deɓi wakkati yonugo min ɗo yona min nana ko ɗo yecca am woɓɓe. Ɓingel ambi joi on kosam ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi dayi miɗo kosam mi yarni mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗo hokka mo. Nyamduuji kala kala bana gaari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yardi amma fofugo mako dana o fofi ba dan o vowi fofugo ba o wala fufa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat. vidum be hande wakkati o do yiwa mo be fajira sanga o naftiri ndiyam jumjum ha kine mako be haberde mako gam ndamba mai sati fofugo mai fuddi o acci fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acca kuseni. on min naftirta hamaku je acca tabba mai kuma hala fufugo mai je lebbi die waɗata mum kuma min wadata hala fufugo boɗɗum. haɗata mo fufugo.
answer: Ɗoja e ndamba ɓingel maa ɗon wara ngam o ɗon fuɗa nyiiye, ngam maajum walaa ko a hulata koo a yaha asibiti. Ngam a maasa kine maako ɗe sukki, hooy nebbam guluuji koo Robb a wuja caka nder kine maako ngam o heɓa fofugo boɗɗum. Kadima, hokku mo njumri (honey) e nder gaari maako nyande fuu, ngam njumri ɗon hisna ɗoja ɓikkoi ɓe lebbi jowi. Sakkiti, accita yarnugo mo endam faf, a ɓesdana mo nyamduuji tedduɗi ngam ɓokkol maako heɓa semmbe fofugo.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
answer: Nyau ɓingel ma ɗo ko jontere nde sanyi naati nder ƴi'e, kanjum waɗi ɓandu mako tiddi bo hunduko maɓɓi. O heɓan batal to a tokki wujja mo sabulu gargajiya mai haa ɓandu mako fuu ngam ɗum hoosa sanyi ɓandu mai. Heɓu cokali a tura haa nyi'e mako ngam a maɓɓita hunduko mai pacak, sai a loowa lekki gargajiya ɗon ngam o yara o tuuta nyau ɗon. Kadi bo, saawa mo be bargooji ɗuɗɗi koo to ɓandu mako ɗon wula, ngam guldum mai wurtina nyau ɗon be wukko. To a waɗi ɗum, ɓandu mako fukkan, ɓingel umman nden bo o fuɗɗan nyamugo nyiiri.

question: Dana kesum ko danya e ha asibiti amen minti cappanɗe ɗiɗi ko waɗi ɓingel waɗi nuɗum danyi woya woya teli nude danya ngel wadai woyade boɗɗum min yiwi fu nanugo mako tidum no bingel delabi tan mi yiwi kadi tamreji mako tidum no alai nalle mako ko dume. Ɓingel kesum waɗi danyi ha ɗa'i waɗa de boɗɗum gele danya harnuje jamu wala doraja. Ɓingel foti heɓɗe e nati wuro ɓingel ko ɗume o wawi kokkude ɓingel ti ko ɗume o wawa hokkude ha irin nyau. ma nyamana enjamgel ma waɗi enjam.
answer:
Ɓingel ngel e woodi caɗeele fooftaago e woyaare tiiɗnde, ɗum holla maande heege oksijen e jonta (asphyxia neonatale) maa caɗeele ɗon e nder daande fooftaago, ko ɗum waɗi ɓalli mbaɗa no alaa nalle.
Ko foti waɗeede ha asibiti ko yaawde: laaɓtina kinndu hunnduko e nofru, mooɓtina ɓalli ngel wulnaa, e wallude fooftaago bee foondaango so tawii haani.
So ɓingel dartii fooftaago, inna oo foti ñamnude kosam ɓernde (colostrum) tan, sabi ɗum woni nyamdu reenuki ɓurngu moƴƴude e o sahaa.
So ɓingel waawaa musindego, o waawi ɓiɗɗude kosam o hokku ɓingel e koppu laaɓɗo, ammaa woto hokku goɗɗum bana ndiyam maa leɗɗe.
Nyau nduu ɗaɓɓi toppitagol yaawngol to suudu safrirdu; inna oo alaa ko wawata hokkude ɓingel so wonaa kosam mum tan, haa doktoor timmina laawolngol.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Tilola, zazzabi nguli bandu be dande nde wailitatta do, alama nyigge bingel man don pusa, dum waddata tannyugo kusel dande. Yitere nde o wawata mabbugo bo, ngam o tampi be diwuna man on, wala ko woni. Wala nyawu mangu nder bandu mako, peewol on nangi mo waddi damuwa man. Hokku mo paracetamol tan, bo wujju dande mako be nebbam bodi dam wuli ngam dande man wailita. O wadan jam, wala haje yahugo asibiti ngam beddugo ndaara ko woni nder bandu mako.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji haɗari: ɓinngel no fofa yaawde walla ɓernde no naata les, o wala sembe, o ɗaɓɓaani ɗaɗɗa/njaram, o yartata fof, nguleendi mawndi, walla hunduko/koyɗe no laɓɓi.
Ɗum ena waawi wonde pneumonia, asma/bronchiolitis walla nyaw sepsis; sabu ɗum ɓinngel haani yahde asibiti jooni, hoto sabbo.
Haa ɗon yahude, waɗee mo no joɗi ɗow seeɗa, loosen kolte, laɓɓinee hanci so no ɗaɓɓi, hokkee ɗaɗɗa walla njaram seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi ɗaɓɓude.
So nguleendi woodi, on waawi hokde paracetamol ɗo doosiiji ɓinngel, kono hoto hokku antibiotics, cough syrup, leppi walla magani ko likita yamiraani.
So o fota haa o waɗi sowru, o finta, walla o waɗi convulsion, noddee taimako/ambulance ko law.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer: Alamaji ɗi a limti ɗo, irin yarugo ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, sillugo koondeye haa e jemma, sombo, e lallaago gite, ɗon holla gorko oo ɗon mari nyau shuga (Diabetes) e tawe ɓamtol ƴiiƴam (Hypertension). Sillugo e ɗonka ɗuɗɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓandu mako ɗon tefa wurtinki shuga ɓurtunɗo nder ƴiiƴam mako ta laawol sille. Diga jooni hani o yaha asibiti ngam likitaajo auna shuga ƴiiƴam mako koo o nyaamai (Fasting Blood Sugar) e ɓetol ƴiiƴam (BP) ngam tabbatingo nyau man e hokkugo mo lekki. Ngam ustugo ɗum, o wajiba o acca yarugo kuuje mari shuga e nyaamduji swiiti, o usta nyaamugo nyiiri ɗuɗɗum, kadi o ɓedda nyaamugo haakooji e ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe. Hosaago lekki asibiti e wakkati, tokkugo laawol nyaamdu boɗɗum, e waɗugo jarsiisi wallitan ustugo alamaji ɗi fuu haa o heɓa jam, o hisa daga masibo nyau shuga.

question: Dana kesum ko danya e ha asibiti amen minti cappanɗe ɗiɗi ko waɗi ɓingel waɗi nuɗum danyi woya woya teli nude danya ngel wadai woyade boɗɗum min yiwi fu nanugo mako tidum no bingel delabi tan mi yiwi kadi tamreji mako tidum no alai nalle mako ko dume. Ɓingel kesum waɗi danyi ha ɗa'i waɗa de boɗɗum gele danya harnuje jamu wala doraja. Ɓingel foti heɓɗe e nati wuro ɓingel ko ɗume o wawi kokkude ɓingel ti ko ɗume o wawa hokkude ha irin nyau. ma nyamana enjamgel ma waɗi enjam.
answer: Nyawu nguu ko tampere danygol, ɓingel ngel haaji semmbe ngam ngel woya boɗɗum. Ngam a woyna ngel kadi fooftere maggel fesa, lootu ngel e ndiyam peewɗam lawlaw ngam ngel fina. Baawo ɗon, hokku ngel ndiyam ngulɗam jillindiraaɗam e suukara malla njumri ngel yara. Yaraande ndee hokkan ɓingel semmbe nder ƴiiƴam lawlaw ngam ngel heɓa yamɗugo. Taa hokka ngel masin henndu (oxygen) tukun, tokku laawol ngol tan ngel warta jam.

question: nonnon tan min laari debbo reduje je sibiti amin wari fajiri ɗo o wari be nauɗum sosai o ɗo hoka be sembe o ɗo jogi ɓawo mako be redu mako ngam nonɗum o nanata ɓawo minti jetati yahugo sappo haa nder sudu dayugo min waddi mo min laari mo min tawi ɓingel ɗo jippa pellel dayugo ɗi neeɓai sam o dayi ɓingel debbo to min waddi ni ko haandi fu en waɗata ɓawo redujo dayi neeɓai ni min hoosi dada be ɓingel maako min jari ɓe har suudu ɓe siwtata de neeɓi seɗɗa sai dada mai yoni amin o yoni amin o yecci amin o ɗo nana o wala sembe o nana o somi gite maako o yi'ata laɓɗum o wi'a amin o godi nyamugo ɓaawo o danyi amma daker o heɓi o nyami be yiri may wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta o ɗo dana o wala sembe be o fuɗɗi nanugo gilol ɗime on fe'i bannin ko yi'am vurti ha maako sosai o wala yi'am o handi ni ka ko o handi ni kaɓilungo yi'am ko ɗume wadanta mo min hokka mo yi'am naa ko min hokka mo nyiri
answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaru haɗiiɗum ɓawo jibingol: sembe alaa, gite yi’ataa laaɓi e ɗoyɗeende ina waawi wonde ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗum yaltinii mo, BP ɗowii, sukaru lownii walla infection.
Ngarnee mo asibiti jooni ngam a ƴeewta BP, ƴiiƴam/Hb, sukaru, urine e no reedu/bleeding woni; hoto on ɗow mo e suudu tan.
To o waawi lumude, o wurtataa, hokkee mo yi’am walla ORS/kaɓilungo yi’am seɗɗa-seɗɗa, kadi hokkee mo nyiri newiriɗi: kunu/akamu, miya, shinkafa, wake, kifi/nama.
Si ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗum ɗo yalta, o ɗo faint, o heɓii fits, hoore mettii, o ɗo honyugo walla fever, ɗum ko gawat—ngarnee mo asibiti yaasi.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer: Bana no o lari alamaaji ɗi'i, hunde satiŋde nder endi fuɗɗi naawugo be ɓuutuwa, ɗum ɗo nufa endi man heɓi mboordi (pewuri) ko bo ketungol nyau daji (kansa). Mboordi ko daji nder endi ɗo waɗa ɓuudi satiŋdi, ɗo naawa, bo babal man ɗo woya ngam kwayaaji nyau ɗon mooɓta nder ɗon. O haandi o yaha asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en mema lara endi man, ɓe waɗa hoto (scan) ngam ɓe tabaatika asali ɓuudi man. To ɓe tawi nyau man law, likita hokkan mo magani ko ɓe waɗa seere pamarde ngam ittugo ɗum, ngam non taa o fasa ko o mema ɗum kanko e hoore mako ngam ta nyau man ɓedda.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
answer:
Ngam kuje ɗo, haaji laartuggo debbo ɗon bee yaawre ngam ruffugo iyam ɓaawo danygol:

1. **Semmbiɗingo ɓandum mako:** Sey ɓe tinna ɓe semmbiɗina ɓandum mako bee lamba (IV fluids) nden ɓe waɗana mo iyam (blood transfusion) ngam o kaas-iyam masin.
2. **Hokkugo lekkiiji:** Sey ɓe hokka mo lekkiiji ba *oxytocin* ko *misoprostol* heɓa reedu mako taara (contract), ruffugo iyam ɗon horta.
3. **Laartuggo ko waɗi:** Sey ɓe waɗana mo hotto reedu (*ultrasound scan*) ngam laara to woodi ko luttii nder reedu mako, nden ɓe hokka mo lekki kofotoboodi (*antibiotics*) to o ɗon heɓi jorfol (*infection*).
4. **Laɓɓingo reedu:** To iyam ɗon jokki ruffugo boo, haaji yaahugo suudu kireerugal ngam ɓe laɓɓina reedu mako (*uterine evacuation*).

To opitaal, ɓe mbaɗat kadi tetanus prophylaxis so tawii yumma mum heɓaani nyawndu nduu e reedu. Toppitaa ɓingel ngel e nokku laaɓɗo, ngoppuɗo gaafe ɓuuɓɗi, haa ɓe ngoppitaa safrude e asibiti haa timma.

question: daada peju ɗon mari ɓikkon tati peju ɗon petel may peju ɗon mari duuɓi gotel daada peju may hirliti ɓawo ɓalɗe seɗɗa nde o danyi peju ɗon mari nyawu dojjugo kuma tun wakkati may o ɗo ta ojja wala darugo sam o wi kuma o hirliti fofugo fu ɗo hokka mo bone o wi ɗojjugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be kikkiɗe wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗana o wi fofugo mako ɗo sadinamo o fofata boɗɗum kam ɗojjugo ɗo wala accamo o fofa o wurtina boɗɗum o wi o yahi haa nyawdigo gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwinimo se o wi o dilli tan o yahi asibiti heba ɓe hefta ko fe'ata be pejum damuwa ɗo wawan hoyina ɓingel ɗo na damuwa ɓerde na ko asima ɗon fe'ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toy ɗon hanɗi ɓingel ɗo hanɗi acca heɓa ko damata mo waɗinta mo o ɗojja hoyina mo usta sosai
answer: Ko nyawu mawɗi ɗi ngamɗam ɗe wasiya yo ɗon yah asibiti haawti ngam testiji e examination, lekki gargajiya acca tan ɗo ngalaa faayda. Daada ɗo mari dojjugo (seizures) e fofugo (swelling) ɗe waawi wonde epilepsi, kidney disease, wala hypertension - testiji ɗe gawne (blood, urine, EEG) ngalaa haaju ngam anndugo ko woni. Nyawu nguu ɗo ngalaa keerol, ɗo waawi bonnugo ɓeyda e ɗe ngamɗam wakkati ɗo ngalaa mawni - ɗon yah asibiti haawti.

answer:
Iyam e kureeji (clots) vurtooji ɓaawo danygol satti ɗiɗi nandi e heddungo kuuje danygol nder reedu (retained placenta/membranes) malla jonte nder saare danygol, kanjum waddata nawalla les reedu. Kujeji meeraaji ɗi dada kesum haandi lara ngam hakkilango yo: to iyam ɗon vurta ko heewi, urdi mbonndi ɗon vurta, jontere ɓanduu, malla nawalla reedu burtuka. Haandi a yaha asibiti yaasi ngam likita’en ndara ma, ɓe njuurto to woodi kuuje keddiɗe nder reedu ma mbel ɓe njaara ma lobbo.

Kadi, tokkugo yaadu asibiti ɓaawo danygol (postnatal care) e heɓugo siwtaare be nyaamdu lobbu ɗon wallita dada kesum sanne ngam heɓugo sellingo timmungo.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer:
Ɗum ɗum alaamaaji ɓurtuɗi: zazzabi mawɗo e ñaw dande/waawataa lootugol, yite boɗɗe, walla waawataa ñaamugol/yarugol.
Ko sabu mum waawi wonde tonsillitis, malaria, measles, walla ko ɓuri hulɓinde—meningitis; sabo ɗum waɗi, a yahdu e bingel ngal sappo-sappo to asibiti/dispensary jooni.
Hoto on addan mo magani antibiotics walla injections e suudu tawa dokita yi’aali, kono on waawi hokku mo paracetamol ɗumɗum ngam zazzabi (15 mg/kg kala awaaji 6) e ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi yara.
So o woni ɗaɓɓude, o yiɗaa yara, o waɗi fits, o ɗaɓɓi moƴƴere, walla dande mako na ɗiiɗi/na tippi—ɗum ko emergency.
Dokita maa ƴeewto malaria test, throat/tonsils, measles, e alaama meningitis ngam hokkitinde magani moƴƴo.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
answer: Ɓingel ɗon mari alamaji sariya pofɗe ta'aade (severe pneumonia), nden ɗum woni daliila ngal o waawataa hootugo saare, sey en naatna mo asibiti jotta. Lekki ɗojugo ngal dada mako hokkata mo wallataa mo, nden ɗum ɗon ɓeyda mako challungol hallugo ha ɓikki tokosɓe bana lebbi jego. Sey en binda mo asibiti, en hito pofɗe mako, en hokka mo oksijin to o ɗon haaje, nden en puɗɗa mo lekki batir (antibiotics) bee ndiyam murtiniingal (IV fluids). Doon kadi, en ngada bincikeji bana foto gaba (chest X-ray) e jiiɗam mako ngam en annda daliila nawnande mako jotta. Yarinki mo saare jotta ɗon waɗi masiibo mawɗo ngam hisgo yonki mako, nden sey en tinna en naatna mo mbarata.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer: Alamaji ɗi ɗon holla ɓokkooji (kidneys) maako ɗon mari peewol, ɗum saabi o ɗon silla ndiyam ɗuɗɗum. Dulla gite bee mirligo maako ɗon waɗa ngam ndiyam ɗuɗɗum ɗam o yarata ɗon loota vitaminji gite maako. Ndi'i nyau walaa kawtal bee nyau shuga (diabetes), ammaa famɗugo shuga nder iyam maako saabi ɓandu ɗon woya ndiyam akay. Ngam o heɓa jam, o handi o usta yarugo ndiyam koo seɗɗa, bo o ɗinga nyamugo nyiri bee shuga ɗuɗɗum ngam ɓokkooji ɗin ngula. Walaa haaje o yaha asibiti ngam aunugo shuga; sey o hufa limse nguli o ɗaana ngam nyau man timma.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
answer:
Ɗum ɗo kaalata no wa’i ko **alamaaji stroke (ɓiiɓe ƴiiƴam ka hoore)** walla caɗeele mawɗe ka hoore, tawa haala/yahugo makko ɗon boni, oɗo yuuɓa/amai walla habe hoore.
Awa **hoto ndaaru lekki e suudu**; ndettu mo haa asibiti/referal hospital jooni ngam likita ƴeewta **BP, sukari, ƴiiƴam, scan hoore** so heɓii.
Hoto hokku aspirin/ibuprofen walla lekki stroke sey likita ƴeewtii, sabu so ƴiiƴam ɗon yaltude ka hoore ɗum maa bonnu.
So oɗo yuuɓa, waɗ mo e laawol (side) ngam o waas mumtaade, hokku ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi njaamde.
Ɓawo ƴeewtagol, o maa haaja lekki ngam BP/sukari, physiotherapy, e ɗemngal/haala therapy ngam o heɓa no o joɗirta e haala ɗum ɓeydora.

question: debbo do danyi ha sibiti mai dan labbi jego ko sali o wadi sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi bingel mardo labbi jego mai o wardi be mako jonta dada man wadi bayani du o heriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nayi ko sali o wi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda o wi dojjere man halli on daga ki'a balde tati ko fuddi amma har durti o wi de o musinimo fu odon hokkamo lekki diyam je nder gora je be sorata je do jogo do je o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara o wi daga keya do jogoman turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawan fofa be boddum gidami am sosai bana bofde man do ta'a on do yaha dow do je palace kala wakkati fu be hultiri hanjum wadi be waddi musibiti meden jotta emol am hado hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo be bingel do ha sare na larugo no pofde mako ta'ata be dojjere do min vindina be lekki dojjugo na ko'en wadda goje goje dow bingel man yiddeko min hokkamo lekki ko bate
answer:
Taa accitu debbo on hoota saare be lekki dojjere tan, ngam poofde ta'oore e gabaare loppotoonde ɗon holla ɓingel ngel wondi be nyawu pofɗe cattuɗum (*severe pneumonia*).

Sey a nasta ɓingel ngel asibiti (admit) ɗon e ɗon, a lornana ngel poofde (*oxygen*) to haaje waɗi, bo a fuddana ngel pije (*IV antibiotics*) ngam hisnugo yonki maggel.

Hokkugo ɓingel lebbi jeego'o lekki leɗɗe malla lekki dojjere ceeɓaaki haa kanti walaa nafuura, kadi ma ɗum ɗon hallina nyawu man sosai.

Aanaa a waɗa bincike/ndaarndaaki bano hooto gabaare (*chest X-ray*) e ndaarugo ƴiiƴam ngam a tabbatina asali nyawu man hiddeko a timmina harka lekki.

Haa asibitiiji gure meɗen, sey a famtina daada'en taa ɓe nyawnda ɓikkon haa saare be leɗɗe, sey ɓe wadda asibiti lawlaw to dojjere fuɗɗi ngam taa tura yotta ɗo.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer: Alamuje ɗe ɗe cifaa ko ɓuuɓri ƴiiƴam henndu (pneumonia) walla bronchiolitis, ɗum ko ñawbuuji keewɗi e sukaaɓe tokosɓe. Tari maako yaajɗo e jamma, heɓgol henndu yaawngol (fufa be lau), e coorɗe ɗeɗɗe nder ɓalndu (keccel wokan) ko sabu ɓuuɓri ndi yani e paabi ɗi henndu naatata ɗii, ko ɗum saɗtina gallol kammu. Yaawgol haalaaji ɗii ko maande ñawu nguu tiiɗii, ko ɗum waɗi ina teeŋti no feewi yaawnude yahde to safrirde ngam ƴeewde ɓingel ngel, ƴeewde hayre mum, e rokkude kammu (oxygen) so ina haani. Doktoor tan ko waawi rokkude leppi ngam hisnude ɓuuɓri ndii (antibiotics) walla leppi ballitooji udditgol paabi ɗii caggal nde o ƴeewta ɓingel ngel. Woto rokku ɓingel ngel leppi ɓurtuɗi e hoore maa, kono ndokku muumɗum ɗam ɓuuɓndam ñalawma kala ngam yaafnude paabi ɗii haa nde ɓe njaltata to safrirde.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer: Ko likita on wi'i ko goonga, sabu ɓiɓɓe dayaaɓe ɓe heɓaayi balɗe (premature) ɗon yaawi heɓugo rufugo suukara nder iyam (hypoglycemia) e rafi sepsis sabu ɓanndu maɓɓe woodaa sembe. Ɓingel ngel woodaa "glycogen" (cukara mo ɓanndu mooftata) heewɗo nder hecceere, ɗum waɗi sembe mako ɗon rufa yaasi to o nyaamaayi ko heewi. Wulugo ɓanndu e fewugo juuɗe e kose ɗon holla rafi "neonatal sepsis", ko waɗi likita on hokki mo batal cukara (IV Dextrose) ngam darnugo rufugo suukara on kisa. Nyaamugo nono inna ɗon wallita hokkugo ɓingel ngel sembe, cukara, e kuuɗe darnooji rafiiji (antibodies) ngam haɓaade rafi. Ɗum woni laawol ɓurngol moɓɓugo ngam dandugo ɓiɓɓe ɓe heɓaayi balɗe nder asibituuji men.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
answer: Alamaaji ɗi'i, bana nguleeki ɓanndu (zazzabi), tiiɗal daande, e wawaytaare waylitago daande, ina kolla wonde bingel ngel mari nyaw kulbiniiɗo bana Meningitis (nyaw ƴonɗe ƴiiƴam) wala Tetanus. Aɗa haani yaawgo nawgo ngel to hopitaal jooni-jooni ngam heɓgo safaraaji tiiɗɗi (antibiotics) e ballal nguurndam. Eey, nyaw ngal ina waawi safrugo to a yaawii, kono to a leeli, ngal ina waawi warugo bingel ngel. Ngam daɗndo ɗum yeeso, tilay bingel ngel heɓa allurar rigakafi (immunization) e reengo laaɓal.

answer:
Based on your description, this appears to be a **postpartum woman (recently delivered) presenting with fever (38.2°C), body aches, and joint pain, with a confirmed malaria diagnosis** — this is a serious situation requiring careful management.

Ndaa ko mi wi'ata:

**Debbo danyɗo ɗo mari malaria e nawnaare ɓalɗe (fever 38.2°C) — ɗum ko caɗtuɗum, kono maa a hokku ɓe uncomplicated malaria** — hokku ɓe **Artemether-Lumefantrine (Coartem)** ko ɓe njarata laabi ɗiɗi ñalnde tati (naange fuɗɗi e hiirnde), tawa ɓe njoni sanne, sabu ɗum ko safaara ɓura moƴƴude e postpartum. Fahin ndaaru **anemia** (ƴiiƴam ustii) sabu o danyi e o mari malaria, so no waawi ndaaru **haemoglobin/PCV** e ndaaru infection goɗɗo (sepsis) sabu 38.2 e postpartum ina foti ndaaru puerperal sepsis. Yamir mo yo o yara ndiyam heewɗam, o ñaama, o dañ boɗɗam, e to fever timmaani ñalnde ɗiɗi, o warta lella.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
answer:
Ɓingel lebbi joyi mo saare/ɗojugo balɗe 13–14, o waawaa yarugo walla o tampii no feewi, ko **tampere mawnde**—waɗee mo **sibiti jooni**, hinaa lekki suudu.
Ngam yahde sibiti, hokkitee mo **ORS** seeɗa-seeɗa kala ɗakiikaaji seeɗa e jokku **nono**, amma so o wuttii kala ɗam walla o waawaa yarugo, accitee hokkugo ley hunduko.
Ha sibiti min ndarata kuivde ndiyam, malaria, sepsis, e sukar; so kuivde ndiyam ɗuuɗi, min hokkata **Ringer lactate/normal saline IV**.
Hokkitee **zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala balɗe 10–14**; antibiotic hinaa ko hokkata kala saare, sey so jiiɗam woodi e saare, kisaare mawnde, cholera, walla sepsis.
Accitee **lekki damba/traditional** ngam ina waawi ɓeydude tampere e waɗde ɓingel o bonde.

answer:
**Jaabawol:**

Alamaji ɗe dada wi'i—iyam ka duuɓe (lochia) je vurtata ɓawo danyugo, ɓingel mo o mari kadi mo mari vodai (jaundice/kesol), be tampol mako be munyaari ka ɓandu mako—ko alamaji je hanndude reftol likita, wanaa haala je waɗeten sai be munyaani.

**Ko mi wi'ata:**
1. Iyam je vurtata ɓawo danyugo (lochia) ko hunde je feƴƴata ha balɗe 4-6, kono to ɗum ɗuuɗi walla to o mari uddu bonɗo, ko alama bone (postpartum hemorrhage walla infection) je hanndi reftol asibiti law.
2. Kesol ɓingel (neonatal jaundice) to ɓe tokka, ko waawi bonugo ha hakkille ɓinngel—hanndi ɓe yaha asibiti ngam ɓe ndaara iyam mako be ɓe ndokka ɓe safaara (phototherapy) to hanndi.
3. Dada je tampi, je alkasi be munyaari ka ɓandu, ko waawi wonugo anaemia (asewre ƴiiƴam) walla infection, ɗum kadi hanndi reftol likita.
4. Mi wi'a dada nde ta munyu—yaha asibiti law ngam ɓe ndaara mo be ɓinngel mako, sabu ɗee alamaji ko waawi wonugo je haɗata yontere to ɓe kokki safaara.
5. Sanaji je ndiyam (traditional/spiritual remedies) waawaa lomtinde safaara likita e ndee saa'i, hanndi reftol asibiti ngam danygol dada be ɓinngel.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer: Alamaji ɗii—yarugo ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, silla ɗuɗɗum, weelo, e ɓeydaago ɓandu seɗɗa—kanje ngoni maandeeji nyau shuga (diabetes mellitus). O haani yaadu to asibiti ngam en ƴeewa suukara nder iyam makko, ndeen o fuɗɗoo yarugo leɗɗe (metformin) so ɗum haani. O haani haayde nyaamduuji baaguɗi suukara no heewi bana keke, buuru laaɓuɗum, o ɓura nyaamugo ko wayi no maaro moƴƴo, alkamaari timmuɗi, ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe e li’al. So o nyau shuga o rewaani, ɗum waɗan fitinaaji mawɗi e ɓanndu makko, ko wayi no wumtugo gite, toƴe ƴi’e, rafi ƴiƴre ndeen e ɓernde. Ngam ɗum, o waɗa fooɗuki ɓanndu, o tokkita nyaamdu mo haani, o ɗaɓɓita e dow doktoor sahaa e sahaa ngam semmbe iyam suukara makko waddaago e dow laabi.

Ngam a heɓa yamɗitugo goonga, a haandi a waɗa teendinore soofnde (sputum test) e hoto gabaare (Chest X-ray) haa asibiti ngam anndugo aslu nyawu ngu. answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa gorko yana da matsalar "diarrhea" mai tsanani, wanda ya sa ya rasa ruwan jiki da sinadaran da jikinsa ke bukata. Yana da kyau a fara ba shi "Oral Rehydration Salts" (ORS) don mayar da masa ruwa da sinadar gishiri da sukari. Idan ba ya iya shan ruwa ko kuma yanayin ya kara tsanani, ya kamata a kai shi asibiti nan da sauri domin ya sami "IV fluids" (tsarin zuba ruwa ta jiki). question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. answer: Suka on ɗo mari rafi meningitis (nawnaare ɓanndu hore) e rafi ɓeƴƴi (kidneys) sabu maande futugo yeeso e kosɗe, ɗum ɗon hawti e mboros mawɗo haani o ya'a asibiti mawɗo jooni-jooni. O haani o acca yargo leɗɗe gargaaji ɗen fow sabu ɗe ɗon ɓeyda nawnaare redu e ɓusugo, kadi ɗe ɗon halka ɓeƴƴi makko ɗin. Tama e typhoid ɗon halki, amma juɗe ɓeldi e rafi hore ɗon holla wonde ɓanndu hore ɗon nawni, haani dokita en ƴeewa ndiyam ɓanndu hore (lumbar puncture) e ƴiiƴam. Nguleeki hore e huccugo ɗum waɗataa ko haani, o haani o heɓa leɗɗe dokita (antibiotics) e ndiyam nder ɗaɗi ngam hisnugo nguurndam makko gila rafi on ɓeydaaki. Wada mo asibiti laawol ngol wootol ngam o heɓa wallifaare dokita'en nde haani, o acca yargo leɗɗe ɗe anndaaka.

Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
answer: Mako mo waddi sibiti heɓa e wawata waɗugo kanjum noon woni fitina fukara (severe anemia) tati o yahata ndiyam nden. Kuuɗa o waddi mo laawol ɓingel (hepatomegaly) e ɓingel ngalama (splenomegaly) tati o yahata talabiya ɓingel wala jangirde blood (thalassemia wala sickle cell). Likita o yami wadata laawol blood complete (FBC), blood film, electrophoresis, e liver function tests nden. Kuuɗa o sappo wara ndiyam (blood transfusion) to o waddata kanjum, saka vitamin folic acid, e yeeso likita specialist (pediatrician/hematologist) to jangirde. Kori jooni mako mo to hospital ndi gilla to wallude e dewgula laawol.

question: debbo do danyi ha sibiti mai dan labbi jego ko sali o wadi sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi bingel mardo labbi jego mai o wardi be mako jonta dada man wadi bayani du o heriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nayi ko sali o wi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda o wi dojjere man halli on daga ki'a balde tati ko fuddi amma har durti o wi de o musinimo fu odon hokkamo lekki diyam je nder gora je be sorata je do jogo do je o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara o wi daga keya do jogoman turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawan fofa be boddum gidami am sosai bana bofde man do ta'a on do yaha dow do je palace kala wakkati fu be hultiri hanjum wadi be waddi musibiti meden jotta emol am hado hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo be bingel do ha sare na larugo no pofde mako ta'ata be dojjere do min vindina be lekki dojjugo na ko'en wadda goje goje dow bingel man yiddeko min hokkamo lekki ko bate
answer:
Taa accitu debbo on hoota saare be lekki dojjere tan, ngam poofde ta'oore e gabaare loppotoonde ɗon holla ɓingel ngel wondi be nyawu pofɗe cattuɗum (*severe pneumonia*).

Sey a nasta ɓingel ngel asibiti (admit) ɗon e ɗon, a lornana ngel poofde (*oxygen*) to haaje waɗi, bo a fuddana ngel pije (*IV antibiotics*) ngam hisnugo yonki maggel.

Hokkugo ɓingel lebbi jeego'o lekki leɗɗe malla lekki dojjere ceeɓaaki haa kanti walaa nafuura, kadi ma ɗum ɗon hallina nyawu man sosai.

Aanaa a waɗa bincike/ndaarndaaki bano hooto gabaare (*chest X-ray*) e ndaarugo ƴiiƴam ngam a tabbatina asali nyawu man hiddeko a timmina harka lekki.

Haa asibitiiji gure meɗen, sey a famtina daada'en taa ɓe nyawnda ɓikkon haa saare be leɗɗe, sey ɓe wadda asibiti lawlaw to dojjere fuɗɗi ngam taa tura yotta ɗo.

question: goɗɗo ɓe noddata subeeru duuɓi makko cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowuru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko
answer:
Maande ɗe a sifii—poppe/ɓandu saldude, foofde saɗude ɓurta nde o ɗaani, tampere, salo nyamdugol e hakkillo waylude—ɓuri hollude ndiyam mooftiima nder ɓandu sabu ɓernde, kidini walla hanta ngalaa gollude no haani; ɗum wonaa nyawu ƴowru seedaa tan.
O foti yaade nyawndorde mawnde jooni, ngam ɓe ƴeewta BP, jini, sukari, urine, kidney/hanta tests, ECG/X-ray/ultrasound/echo.
So foofde saɗii, hakkillo waylii, walla saldorde ɓurtii, ɗum ko gorko emergency—o waawi heɓde oxygen e lekki yaltina ndiyam bana furosemide, kono ko nyawtoowo tan foti hokde.
Hoto o yaaru alcohol, hoto leɗɗe gargajiya/lekki dikka, hoto nyamdugol ko ɗiɗɗi solɗam; ɓeydu himo ɓe walla o ɗaani dow pillows ngam foofde.
Dabare ɓurnde ko ƴeewtere nyawtoowo, sabu waɗde lekki e suudu alaa ƴeewtere waawi bonnude kidini walla hanta.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
answer:
Bismillah. Ndaa ko mi yi'i e ɗemngal daaɗo:

Nawnaare ndee no wa'i wa **anemia mawnde (severe anemia)** je ɗon habda be dama mai (malaria) e nawnaare ummii be redu. Ɓeydari sembe iyam (blood transfusion) bee lekki dama no boɗɗum, ammaa ko ɓuri himmude, ɗum ɗon foti yeecude sabaabu maggo: yara hundeji fere (fatigue), uppa yeeso (facial swelling), namuki hore, e bandu fu hoore-nawnaare — ɗum fuu ina holla anemia ummi be nawnaare mawnde wolla nawnaare ɓernde.

Miɗo waawi wi'a hankadi tawa mo joonde ndaa ɗiin: **kaɗe redu (kidney)** wolla **ɓernde (heart failure)** foti wonde sabaabu uppki yeeso e bandu, kañum ɓuri wa'ude be dama mai jaɓɓungol. Ɗum waɗi tawa be waɗugo mo:
- **Urine test (fii proteins e redu)** e **kidney function test**,
- **Blood film for malaria parasites** e **full blood count**,
- **Hemoglobin electrophoresis** (sabu sickle cell ina waawi wonde e Nigeria).

Miɗo yeecoo mo ustaa mo he **hospital mawndu (referral)** ɗo woodi doctor mo nawnaare cukalel (pediatrician) e specialist redu, sabu nawnaare ndee no wa'i mawnde, alaa e sago wattee lekki tan e community hospital.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer:
Alamaji ɗi a siftii—ɗufte/ɓirta ndiyam e hunduko, dande ko wa’i no jogii, hulde ndiyam, damuwa/tampere—ɗi mbaawi fota e **rabies** ɓawo ɗaɓɓere rawaandu, kadi jarrabooji asibiti ɗi mbaawi wonde “normal” kono rabies ɗon woodi.
So alamaji ɗi fuɗɗii, rabies ko nyaw bonɗo ɗo keewi ɗaɓɓude yonki; yahaa **emergency/asibiti mawɗo jooni**, hoto ɓooy.
So ɗaɓɓere ndee ko hesere, wuddo gulɗo ndee e saabulu e ndiyam ɗo yahata miniti 15, ngam heɓa **vaccine rabies** balɗe 0, 3, 7, 14, e **rabies immunoglobulin** to gulɗo so gulɗo no tiiɗi.
Hoto haɗ vaccine sabu rawaandu ndee no ndaartee balɗe 10; tetanus e antibiotic no waawi soklude.
Hoto mem ɗufte mako; kala mo saliva mako naati e gulɗo, hunduko walla gite, o yahaa heɓa kariya rabies.

Ɗo heɓe lekki ɗuɗi ka ko o suɗi da ha nuno o nyaɗita sei nyouru wari tullitti ɗum yottike wakkati fere fu mahe salda roɗi sei o nyami nyautawo on ko waɗi nyoru ɗum neɓuri bana ni salo yamɗetugo o yidi o anda ko waɗi dabare be leɗɗe ɗe o fuɗi fu nafi. oyam ɗume o wannata yoru ɗon yamɗita ɗo fu maru gam o heɓa o fufa no hani olollita jamu bandu makko.
answer: Nyouru nguu ɓurata jibineede ko sabu bakteeriyam (bana Staphylococcus) walla ko gonga lampa (cyst) jiibilindi nder ɓanndu mako, ɗum noon ko ɗum sabaɗata ɗum yaltude so ɗoftaaka haa e ɗoɗɗu. Omo haani yahde sapparal ngam ƴeewtaade sample makko (laboratory) ngam heɓde lekki peewnutiɗo, walla waɗde opereeji laaɓtuɗi ngam ɗofta gonga on haa e ɗoɗɗu. Ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam ɓuuɓɗam ina nafra deeƴnude mette ɗee, kono ñaamde goro (kola nut) wonaa ñawbu, ɗum noon omo haani woppude ɗum. Omo haani kadi laaɓtude ɓanndu makko e comci makko, kadi ƴeewndaade ƴiiƴam makko (sukara) ngam daɗndude ko ɗum addantaa. E waɗde ɗuum fow e les njiimaandi doktoor, o heɓay ñawbu timmuɗo o woppata ñawu nguu, o artira e cellal e jam.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer:
Tari mawnugo jamma bee caɗeele never-failing fofugo ha ɓiŋgel petel ina waawi laatago saabe nyawuuji bana pneumonia (nyawu foofugo) koo malaria mawɗo. Ɗum alama bone mawɗo mo yiɗi yaadu asibiti dow njaawri ngam kooni hisnugo yonki ɓiŋgel man.

Ha saare, a waaway huutorgol ndiyam belɗam ngam feewningo ɓandu ɓiŋgel ngam ustagol tari man. Kadi, hokka mo paracetamol bee ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam ngam o lutta heefeere, ammaa uftugo yaadu asibiti dow njaawri woni ko ɓuri maantorgo.

question: Ɓawo mi dayi bandu am fuɗɗi hoinugo kirinni min dadai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam ha fattude en yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum ndiyam be dotti min naftirta min ma fa. Hakina hore amin ɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigi fere bo wari min nana belɗum ɓandu amin fuɗɗi nanugo jagol be bandu am fuɗɗi dimugo kulum nda min ɗo nana jangol bo hauti be bandu amlai fahin semiti iyam je vurtata bawo dayugo. haccenga min nanata daga totton bo valai bo haccega mai dudi bo medai fedugo be am mi kasitugo giteam daga totton de mi ummi sei don mi yahi sibiti mi’ama ko diyam laɓɗam je min naftirta mi yiwa be mai kanjum. waddata kala wodago.
answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi kaalɗaa ɗii ena mbaawi iwde e ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam/ɓurɗam: hoore nawa, ɓandu yuli/yahɓa, waasde semmbe, joonde, walla jiiɓugol/moccal rewɓe e ndiyam (schistosomiasis) tawa ngam ƴiƴam walla miiji ina yaltata caggal yiɗugol.
Kono joonde be hoore nawa e dimmugol ena mbaawi wonde malaria walla typhoid, sabu ɗum sey a yahu sibiti ngam test malaria, Widal/culture, urinalysis e stool test.
So ƴiƴam, naaɗe, walla miiji ina yaltata e ɗiyam, walla ɗum ina sattina yiɗugol, yahu sibiti jooni—hoto njogi lekki aɗa soodi tawa test alaa.
Hakkil: daf ndiyam walla huutora “Water Guard/chlorine”, suɓu ndiyam laaɓɗam, hoto lootoro e maayo/ruwa dotti, huutora mosquito net ngam haɗde malaria.
Likita maa waɗa magani ɗum foti—so schistosomiasis woni, praziquantel; so malaria, ACT; so infection ɗiyam, antibiotic ngam test.

question: debbo danyi ɓingel ɓingel lewru mai lewru joi ko saali o waɗi bayani hala ɓingel mai o vi wala damuwa ɗo ɓingel mai wakkati o danyi mo ɓingel mai ɗon musina sosai bana no handi banni tan o lari ɓingel mayi ɗon woka nauɗum ha juɗe be kosteji mako yotti har ɓingel mayi woka ɓe ɓamta mo o lada ko o dimba eh ba o yotta dada maɓɓe useni ɗume on dada ɗo wannata ɓingel ɗo hoyninamo nauɗum ha juɗe be kosteji ɓingel ɗo ɓe darnamo wonugo ɓingel kanjum dada yiɗi wara sibiti be ɓingel may ɓe lara likita heɓa ɓe hefta ko ɓe wannata ɓe wallita ɓandu ɓingel ɗo o wona o jamu
answer:
Bismillah, mi faami hala am.

Ɓingel maa ɗo ndiyam yiiwde e kosteji be juɗe (yaa woni oedema/heɓɓugo ndiyam), be ɓingel wonaango bana no woɗɓe, ɗum wonaa fijo — ɗum musiiba tokkugo likita law.

Ɗum wadata bana ɗum: ɓe foti ndaru ɓingel ha sibiti; hoore muuɗum foti ɓe ndaru ɓernde (heart failure) walla koyɗe/becce (kidney disease) walla ñawu ñebbe walla protein famɗugo e ɓandu (kwashiorkor).

Ɗo dada wannata ɗo ɓingel arta sibiti: hokku ɓingel ñaametee moƴƴe (breastfeeding walla nyaametee protein bana ndiyam-kosam, gujjo, njamndi), taa hokku lekki mbaawaa hoore muuɗum, be ɗaɓɓu ndiyam laaɓngu tan.

Amma ko ɓuri himmude: **ɓe njehu law ha sibiti**, likita foti ndaru ɓingel, wadde jarrabuji (ɓernde, koyɗe, ñebbe) haa ɓe keɓa ko wonata mo be nafta mo — ɗum wonaa fijo, tokkugo law waɗata ɓingel maa wonugo jam.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
answer: Rufugo iyam sembe ɗo alama normal je redu ɗon laɓɓina ho're mako ɓawo danyugo, ngam maajum taa kule sam. Hokke mo lekki Aspirin ɗuuɗɗum lawlaw ngam ɗum wawa helugo iyam matuɗam e laɓɓinugo redu mai law. Wadde ndiyam ngulɗam nder leda dora haa dow redu mako ngam redu mai foya, ɗum darnan rufugo iyam mai. Taa wanne mo ruwa (drip) sam, ngam ɗum lootan iyam je luttani mo nder ɓandu. Jo'ine mo o jooda gege o yara shayi ngulɗo, iyam mai daran ho're maajum wala haaje turugo mo asibiti manga.

question: debbo feere kam waddi ɓinge makko mo duuɓi tati asibiti ɓe laara mo hande subaka koɓe haali bo hikke to yimɓe wolwani ɓinge on o tannitataako sam o laarata goɗɗo feere mo wolwalta mo hetaano di'in de makko o sonyata mo daamayi hano o nane maasaba hindere ƴamoyi ngoyme ƴamidebbo on jukale omme ɗi higuguɓa tena e namakko wi o me daya hebike badde membedi mem tsamimo jukale ngoya hebi jabugo galapate be sode mun hatimude ko ofotino hebigo bana non inna makko waddi ereji nyawudugol dum min kotorto labini min ge on jabi bate makkosa but min bedi min tsami ko feti hunde jukale on ingol wala padde e o jabi bate pesode makko pat ko dami jukale on
answer: Alaamooji ɗi kollaa ɗin ɗon holla ɓinngel ngel waawi wonde bee nyawu 'Autism' koo bo ma ngel paho. To ɓinngel heɓi duuɓi tati ammaa ngel laarataa neɗɗo, ngel jaabataako innde maagel, koo fittugo to ngel nani kundiila, ɗum alaama nyawu Autism ngal tamminday hakkillo e faamu ɓikkon. Ammaa ngam tabbitingo, dole ɓinngel ngel waɗa tes (test) noppi ngam laarugo koo ngel ɗon nana, ngam ɓinngel ngel nanataa fuu waawata waɗugo irin nii. To ɓe tawi noppi ɗin walaa damuwa, ɓinngel ngel haani heɓugo wallinde e ekkitinki (therapy) wuro annduɓe ngam wallugo ngel ekkita wolde e jokkondiral bee yimɓe. Fottuki bee annduɓe lawlaw hokkan ɓinngel ngel daama ekkitugo wolwugo e faamugo koo wurngo bana ɓikkon feere.

question: Duɓi a debbo inna mako adda anma amma dare bandi mi hisi mi lari cokali on no joɗo fere mako inla ko inna mako mayi oyida fijugo he komoi fu oyida faddugo ko moi fu o fuɗɗi salaki nyamdu nandi hanowo omilo sanci kunne on hulniyam sai mi wadi daware yarugo mo nyautugo asbiti ko yotti asibiti. Mi likita on na ɗum hala maide en nama korrata mo waɗata wuro ngam mi walamo ko hani ɓingel on heɓa wankta jo na ma ngam o heɓa o nyama ko o fija sakiraɓe mako ko hanni ɗum walliran ma shagoran nyaudugo.
answer: Ngam ɓingel ngel heɓa cellal, tilay a tokka yamiroore likitaajo on haa laaɓi, a hokka mo safaraaje makko haa timma ngam ɗum woni ko wallirta mo. Nyamdu moƴƴuru (hono maaro, haako, teewu, e kosam) waɗan mo semmbe, amma a woppa hokkugo mo "daware" ngam ina waawi bonnugo ɓanndu makko walla jillondira e safaraaje asibiti. Waɗu mo nokkuure de'eere nde alaa fitina, a fuɗɗa hokkugo mo golle pamare nder galle, caggal ɗum a jaɓɓina mo yimɓe seeɗa-seeɗa haa o heɓa semmbe o farta e sakiraaɓe makko. Reenu mo haa o yara safara makko fuu, nden a artira mo asibiti sa'a fuu nde a tawi o ɓeydiike walla safara on na waɗa mo ko haanaa. Cellal hakkillo (hala maide) na ɗaɓɓi muñal e giɗal, a watta hoolaare nde a tokka yonki asibiti ngam o walliree haa o laara.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer: On ngaɗi boɗɗum sosai nde on suddi mo, on hokki mo paracetamol, ngam ɗum tampiri e malaria ɓaawo danygol. Tokke suddoogo mo bee bargooji tedduɗi ngam o waɗa wuli wurtina nguleeki ɓandu maajum pat. Vi'e mo o acca musinngo ɓingel ngel tukun ngam taa ngel yara kosam wulɗam ngel heeɓa nyawu malaria maajum. To ɓandu mako ɗon tokki wulgo, ɓedde ɗuuɗɗugo paracetamol maajum tan, bo on tokka hokkugo mo sha'i wulɗo. Walaa haaje bincike malla kuɓɓi (antibiotics), o waran jam kanko e ɓingel mako nder balɗe seɗɗa.

question:
Debbo lari gorko mako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira bedo do leso maini. Dojjugo nonon ni fuddata, oneba ni bako dara. Baldeji owada ni o lari gorko mako o yarabone foofugo . To o yapi sedda ni ko ofa’e eskal , odo dara lorna fofde mako , denbo odo yawa sommugo be lau. Don yende gorko mako neebi odo dojja be odo habda lorna fofde , daami debbo mai. Ofuddi numugo ko don ye’u je wattada damuwajido . Jango mai sai o volwini gorko mako beyaha sibiti be laara likita, heba be hefta ko daamata mo. Demde mai, dumedon waddata dojjugo kalnudum banni be yawugo somugo, be foofugo daker do? Damuwa do wawan ko shafi balle na ko ye’u ko shafi berde?. Hundeji toi don watata goddo maya ko yarna goddo bone foofugo, harje goddo mai hadine dasa hikkilo yaudibe?
Alaamaji kalnudum je damuwaji foofugo je dardiraabe haadi laara, hakilina je dojjugo be foofugo daker do?
answer: Wannan ɗan ƙaramin yaro yana da matsalar rashin numfashi (asphyxia) wanda yake da haɗari sosai ga rayuwarsa. Dole ne a ba shi numfashi na gaggawa (CPR) da kuma samar da hanya mai buɗe don sa numfashinsa ya yi daidai kafin a kai shi asibiti. Rashin numfashi yana sa jikin yaron ba zai sami ƙarfi ba, kuma tsoron da mahaifiyarsa take da shi ba zai taimaki yaron ba idan ba a samar da kulawa ta likita ba. A asibiti, likitoci za su duba numfashinsa, zuciyarsa, da kuma tabbatar da cewa ba yana da cutar da ke hana shi numfashi ba. Dole ne a mayar da hankali kan samun numfashi nan take domin ceton rayuwarsa daga mutuwa.

question:

question: Mini amodai we'e anɓɓa he jo jonamo o warti wuro o wulla, kominma ko fetiyam bosaru ha kosɗe mako me kala bo saru on toi ɗum ɗuroi koɗum bosaru kindiraɓe on wakkati nden meban ha balbe bo salun nga timmo ngam ɗum warake bo saru. mi yarama asibiti danyu dare kindira bate den tan mi yaha mi soda ha kemis mi sodi bata on ɗum tufuma ɗum kenya illa wakkati den mi yarima wuro amma lake man umti nokkure nanwoji jotta kam hakkila ammi hemi tammi bo sare ɗon hokki ɓingel nyamdu bo sare. mido nyama wodi lekki combiti larugo ko mo.
answer: Jam naa, mi faami huuwaande maa. Kuuɗe gaañannde booraande (stump) ɗon lortoo saabunde malla ɗaɓɓaande no nyaw sukkara (diabetes) walla keejam nder kosngal (osteomyelitis) waɗi ɗum wuurtaaki. Mi wasiyotoo maa yahugo asibiti mawnde ngam safroowo yi’ata gaañannde nden, waɗa test sukkara e X-ray, o hokka maa antibiotik so ɗum haani. Hakkunde majjum, laɓɓinu gaañannde nden ndiyam laaɓɗam e saabonnde tokoose nyalnde fuu, ɓoornu dawayru laaɓndu, woto huutoroo lenyol gelooji. So ɗum wuurtaay haa balɗe ɗiɗi, yahugo doktoor ɗon ɓeyda himma.

question: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa yaron yana da ciwon kwayar idon da ya yi tsanani, wanda ya iya zama sakamakon kwayar cuta (infection) ko kuma radadin zafin gari. Yana da kyau ka fara shafa masa ruwan dumi wanda aka zuba sabulu mai tsafta domin tsarke kwayar idon da ke damunsa. Idan idon ya ci gaba da ja'i ko yaron ya fara zargin jiki, ya kamata ka kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa domin a ba shi magungin kwayar cuta (antibiotics) ko maganin zafin idon. Kada ka bar shi ya shafa idon da hannunsa don gudun kar cutar ta karu ko ta shiga cikin idon. Muna ba da shawara cewa neman tallafin likita shi ne mafi aminci don tabbatar da cewa idon ba zai laldu ba.

question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma
answer: Ko ɗum ko sembe iyam ɗe debbo jahroowo woni (preeclampsia), ɗe o ndara ko ɓuuɓri ɓanndu, mette hoore, e mawnugol ƴiiƴam, ɗum noon ko nyawu bonɗu no feewi wonande yumma e ɓiyum. Leɗɗe ɗe o ndokkaa ngam ustude sembe iyam ɗe (jamu redu) ɗe ko ɗe mbaawi addande ko o ñaamata ko yaltata e ƴattooje ɓanndu, ɗum noon ina haani yo o hollite doktoor ko yaawi ngam waylude lekki man. Dowkugol koyɗe walla hoore fof alaa ko nafata ɗum, sabu ɓuuɓri ɓanndu ndi ko caɗe e nder reedu e ƴiiƴam (protein) woni ko addanta ɗum, wonaa ko dowri. Ɗum ko nyawu kaawisɗo no feewi wonande debbo jahroowo, ɗum noon omo haani nawteede to safrirde mawnde oon ñalawma. To safrirde nden, doktoor on maa jokku sembe iyam makko e reende ɓiyum e juuɗe mum.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
answer: Dada gorko ma wi'i gonga, ndiyam wakkati daygo on nati nder hoore e kine ɓingel ma, kanjum on waɗi damba haɗi mo fofugo. Ngam maganugo pewol man, a foti a acca musingo ɓingel ngel haa balɗe tati, sai dai a hokka mo ndiyam gulɗum jiilɗum be njumri seɗɗa. Wakkati a hokkata mo ndiyam man, ɓoɗa kine mako sukka ngam a tilasta mo o ekkita fofugo be hunduko mako. Kadi bo, wuju manja gulɗum dow hoore ɓingel man faat ngam ɗum yoora ndiyam ɗi nati nder hoore maajum. Ɗum on kugal likita'en ɓuri wooɗugo haa asibiti, to a waɗi bannii ɓingel ma yamɗitan, fofan boɗɗum, kadi o haran.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
answer:
Debbo ɗo rufata iyam sosai e muusɗe reedu, eɓe waɗi mo ngam **haihuwa/roŋko woni** haa nde laɓɓini—haa huunde feewi, ɗum ina waawi wonde **ɓinngel ɗon seŋi (miscarriage)** walla **ciki ɗon ɗaɓɓi leydi reedu (ectopic pregnancy)**, ɗum haɗii yonki.
Mataki adii: **a waɗu vital signs**, waɗu **IV line ɗiɗi**, hokku **normal saline/Ringer lactate**, waɗu **PCV/Hb, grouping & cross‐match**, e **pregnancy test**, ngam so iyam heewi a ɗaɓɓita **jini**.
Ɗaɓɓita consent ngam **duba farji/speculum** e **ultrasound**; so miscarriage incomplete ne, likita waawi waɗude **MVA** walla hokku **misoprostol** e antibiotics/pain relief; so ectopic ne, o yiɗi **operation/urgent referral**.
To o ɗon rufude sosai, o ɗon fita, BP lesɗi, ko o ɗon hoosude, **hoto mo gila ɗo emergency/gynae theatre**—wonaa lekkol tan ngam darnude iyam.
Alaa no a hokkata “tablet darnata iyam” ko feewi tawa a anndaa sabu, sabu ɗum waawi suuɗde bala’i e ɓeydude haɗari.

question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
answer: Ɓingel ngel ɗon mari haaju yaaɓingo asibitijo koye-koye gam damuwa man ɗon addana ngel macca (shock) be caɗeele hendu. Dokkooɓe ɓe maɓɓita hunnduko mako, ɓe mbaɗa ngel ndiyam nder ɓanndu (IV fluids) walla ƴiiƴam ngam artirgo doole mako. Turragol be heɓataago hendu ɗon holla wonde ƴiiƴam mako ɗon usta no fe'ee, ɗum waawi maaygo de ɓe njippinaaki. Kada ku hokku ngel lekki gadaaje, ku yaaɓino ngel to asibitijo ngam ku waɗa ko dokkooɓe mbi'i. Tufugo ɓikkoi (FGM) ɗon adda nyawuuji bonɗi, nden on haani accugo ɗum gam hisnugo ɓikkoi mon.

question:
Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.
Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Dumejum on wawata wadda zazzabi doh beh bo ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Gwal toi handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sababu zazzabi man beh ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa akwai matsalar jini ko kuma yanayin jini ya zama mai yawa (anemia) saboda rashin karfin jini da kuma faduwar karfin jiki. A asibiti, muna amfani da gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) don duba adadin kwayoyin jini da kuma sinadarin jini don tabbatar da dalilin wannan rashin karfi. Yana da kyau ka samu magungunan karfin jini (iron supplements) da abinci mai dauke da sinadarin jini don mayar da jiki da karfi. Idan rashin karfi ya ci gaba, yana bukatar bincike domin ganin ko akwai wata cuta ta jini ko kuma rashin abinci mai gamsar jiki. Ka nemi likita don a yi maka gwajin dukkan sinadaran jini domin a ba ka maganin da ya dace da yanayinka.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
answer:
Alamaaji ɗi mbiɗa ɗon, bana yardugo diyam masin, sillugo koosaai, e somugo kullum, no holla wonki nyawu shuga (diabetes).

Ɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓandu maako waawaa huuturgo shuga ha ƴiiƴam maako booɗɗum, ɗum waɗa o sillata masin e o somata.

Handi o yaha sudu lekki yaasi ngam ɓe auna ƴiiƴam maako ngam ɓe taba tawa ɗum shuga on.

Ha joni, o accha nyaamugo ko yardugo kujeji ɗi woodi shuga masin, bana leemooji lodooji, o ɓesda nyaamugo kujeji gabaaji (vegetables).

No nafata masin o heɓa lekki joodiɗon to doktoor winndani mo ngam o dilla yeeso bee jam.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
answer: Ee, ɗum ɗon heewi masin debbo heɓa jontere malaria be dimnugo ɓandu ngam peewol ɓawo danygol. Gite maako ko laaɓi poy ɗon holla nyaw man ɗon wurta ɓandu maako, ngam maajum tokke hokkugo mo paracetamol be sha'i gulɗo sosai. On waɗi boodɗum ko on piyi mo battal malaria man; on ɓesda piyannde woyndu jaango fahim. To on damu ngam ɓingel njaɓay musinugo, hokke ngel ndiyam seɗɗa haa nguleeki daada man usta. Tokke suddo mo be bargooji tedduɗi ngam o wula ɗuɗɗa, wuli-wuli man wurtina luttuɗum nyaw man pat.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
answer: Mi heɓii haala maa. Haalaaji gorko maa, hono waɗde siire e ɗaanaade e weeɓitaade, ɓernde makko dogga, e ɓaawo ɗuum saɗtude hakkillo, ina kollita wonde o dañaani tsoka (seizure) walla rafi ƴiiƴam mum hulɓinaaɗo. Ngam maajum, alaa ko waawi waɗeede so wonaa addude mo law ngam semmbinde to suudu safrirde, ɗo ɓe njiylotoo ko wayi no rafi mboros oo, toɓɓere suukara, walla ko fayi e ƴiiƴam. Woto kokkee mo lekki aadaaji goɗɗi, ngam ɗum waawi bonnude ƴiiƴam makko walla addude caɗeele goɗɗe. So on ngaddii mo to galle, mbaɗee mo e nokku deƴƴuɗo, moƴƴuɗo, accon mo fooɗa haa o yaha to opitaal. Nde o yahata to opitaal, doktoor en mbaawat semmbinde hakkillo makko e ɓernde makko, o artirta jam.

question: inde am titilola daga keya ɓandu ɓingel am ɗo wuli o ɗo fita diwna ɓingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam ɗo nandama bana dande ɓingel man wuitata wailutuggo wite wore ɓingel man wawata maɓɓutugo ɗumejum on wawata woda zazzaɓi ɗo beko bo haɗata dande mako wailutuggo gwal toi hande mi wanna mo heɓa mi anda sababu zazzaɓi man be ko haɗata dande mako wailutuggo jawabu toi bo ɓe yecce tamen je kowanni darɓan duɓɓingarman je waddata zazzaɓi be kora ta dade mako wailutuggo
answer:
Mi faami mettuki maa. Bee ko a wiyi—ɓanndu ɓinngel wuli feere, dande maɓɓe waawaa wailtaade, e dolol ngol—ɗum foti waɗtinaango yaaɓe ngam ɓinngel resa doktoor law.

**Sababuuji dande dow waawaa wailtaade e nguleeki:**
- **Meningite** (naɓɓol hoore/dande) ko caɗtungel: nguleeki, dande dolngel, ɓinngel haɓɓataa e yaltaa, feere hoore, e mbeeleeki.
- **Tetanus** (tannoowa) so tawii ɓinngel yiɗaa heɓa dokaaji: ɗum kadi hokkata dande e ɓanndu dolngel.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer:
Heɓugo kulel satingal ngal naawaataa ha endu debbo waaway laatago saabe kuuje feere-feere bana *fibroadenoma* (felle ɗe mbonataa), *cysts* (jiibe ndiyam), walla kansa enndu (*breast cancer*). Ko ngal naawaataa boo, ɗum nattintaa yiilugo likitaajo, ngam kansa enndu boo heewata fuɗɗugo bee kulel ngal naawaataa.

Miɗo saawano o yaha asibiti law ngam likitaajo lara mo, kadi o waɗa masiin larde bana *ultrasound* walla *mammography* ngam tabbintingo ko woni ha nder. Hoto o huli, ammaa yo o dilli law, ngam yiitugo nyau ndu law kadi e heɓugo safareeji potɗi ɗon hisna yonki debbo sanne.

Kadi bo, bingel ngel jaawdi yiɗi ficeego bocal cirol rawandu (Anti-Rabies vaccine) bee bocal tetanos ngam hisnugo yonki maagel.

Ndaree tayugo yammunde rawandu koo watugo lekki gargajiya, ngam ɗum ɓesdan bone yammunde walaa hisnugo neɗɗo haa nyawu mbaroowu rawandu.

## Faamnde e Jaabawol

Ɓinngel maa ngel woni e maale keɓɓe **preeklampsiya** walla **eeklampsiya** ɓaawo jibinannde (postpartum preeclampsia/eclampsia), ndeen ko haala teddungal kaɗ, teemede ɗoo:

**Maandeeji keɓɓe (danger signs):**
- Ɓandu fof feewi ndeer, terɗe kala teddi walla ɗi hebbi ndiyam
- Ɗum yaltini ley ley (ɓandu heewaani sembe, hoɗɗi)
- Jungo e kosɗe forti (rigidity/stiffness) - ngel ina foti wonde alaama seizure walla eeklampsiya

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:**
1. **Yaadu asibiti mawnungel jooni jooni** - ngel maale ko urgency, ina foti heɓde tension checkugo e ndiyam ɓinngel (proteinuria).
2. Ndeen safaara mum ko **magnesium sulfate** ngam haɗde walla safrude eeklampsiya, e safaruuji tension ɗi ɓamtinta.
3. So ɓinngel ina waɗi konvulziyon walla o wonaa e hakkille, ɗum ko emergency mawɗo - **haɗ nyaamde walla yarde**, waɗ ɓinngel e sera (recovery position), ndaartaa faabo asibiti tafon.

Mi wiy-maa: **hoto woɗɗitin, hokku ɓinngel maa faabo asibiti mawɗo jooni jooni**, sabu preeklampsiya ɓaawo jibinannde ina wara so faabaaka law.

answer:
**Jaabawol:**

Debbo dumji (dubi 30) mo woni e reedu je-ɗiɗaɓol (multigravida), mo woodi maale saɗeende reedu (danger signs) wano yeeso woyngo (facial edema), sembe hoore (headache), e naawka reedu — ɗum hollata **Pre-eclampsia**, saɗeende mawnde nde foti nde faytuki eclampsia (dami/convulsions) so ɓe nyaawaay ɗum law.

Ko foti waɗeede tafon ko: **hokka ɗum lekki dami caltingo dami (Magnesium Sulphate)** ngam haɗugo dami e reedu, e **hokka lekki jippingo ƴiiƴam (antihypertensive)** wano *Methyldopa* walla *Nifedipine* so ƴiiƴam mum ɓeydiima.

Kono, safaara timmuɗo pre-eclampsia ko **jibinaango ɓinngel** (delivery) — sabu tan so ɓinngel e placenta yaltii, saɗeende nde fusata; ɓe foti hokka ɗum reeru ha ɓe eggina ɗum yaawnde faade suudu safirdu mawndu (referral) ɗo woni doktoora rewɓe (obstetrician).

Refto ɗum ɗon, ɓe foti ƴeewa ƴiiƴam mum sahaa e sahaa, ɓe ɓetta protein e mbindi (urine), ɓe njokka feƴƴude reedu e cellal ɓinngel ngam reentaade lorla.
