Faamii-am maale ɗe hbe bandu debbo e bingel mako. Miɗo yiɗi humpitde maale ɗe no laaɓi:

**Ummaade debbo:**
- Bingel ngel wari lekki jego (jego labbi), ɗum firti ko lekki jego wari e reedu.
- Dojjere (labor) ɗe njuuti balɗe sappo e tati haa sappo e nayi — ɗum ko dojjere juutunde, hono bofɗe (contractions) ɗe njuuti sanne.
- Yeeso yotti, bingel ngel wooданii, sabu bofɗe ɗe njuuti e tampere dojjere ndee.

**Ko mi yiɗi humpitde:**
1. **No debbo oo woni jooni?** Hade mo yeewde ƴiiƴam heewɗam (postpartum hemorrhage)? Ndaaree reedu mako so hbe ɓennitii walla habɓee.
2. **No bingel ngel woni?** Hbe bingel ngel woodi ƴellitaare (life signs) — habɓde, doggol ɓernde, no cifol mun?
3. **Nokkuuji lekki:** Hokku mo lekki ittooji naange (uterotonics) hono **oxytocin** walla **misoprostol** ngam suɓde reedu (uterus) yo habɓu, ndenta ƴiiƴam heewɗam.

Miɗo ɗaɓɓe humpito e maale ɗiɗi ɗee gila mi hokka feere selannde, sabu ballal potel ko waɗtude jooni fof.

question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. answer: Sannu ma, mi faami ɓoosaaru ngati ɓingel ma, kadi aɗa huli nyau ɓoosaaru nasta nder putere man. Ngam faddugo nyau man nastugo nder ƴiiƴam, a foti nyootugo putere man caca jonta-jonta ngam uddugo ginaaji man, nden a wuja nebbam boɗeejam dow maajum. Walaa haaje a hokka ɓingel man bakkite (vaccine) jonta; lura ɓoosaaru nduun balɗe sappo e nayi tukun ngam a aanda to ndu woodi nyau. To ɓoosaaru man maayi nder balɗe ɗen, nden kam a yaha a hokka ɓingel man lekki, ammaa to ndu maayaay walaa damuwa. Hokka mo lekki amoxicillin e paracetamol tan ngam ɗum haɗa nyau man, ɓingel ma heɓan jamu fey.

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. Wulnu ɓulɓulɗi yiite malla urnu turare haa nder suudu maɓɓaandu ndu ngam cuurki man wulna gande ɓingel ma, taarna ɗojju man. question: likita daada joɗata haa sare amin lari ɓingel maako wala musugo boɗɗum nde o yiɗi o musina mo sey ɓingel may musina seɗɗa sey yofta bana o ɗo somi daada may bo hirliti ɓingel may wala sembe musugo nden bo o ɗo fita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso na kanjum tamba nden bo fofugo ɓingel may canji o ɗo fofa bana yaha dow dow ɓeɗo jippa les les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata wani fofugo ɓalleji ɗo dilla ni dada may o ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel may wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolwa ɓingel may to sey o wi ha o yaha sibiti o lara likita koyninamo ɓingel mako ɗemne am ɗume on latata ɓingel heɓa damuwa musungo boɗɗum no ɓingel may fofata ɗo alama nyamu fere ɗon na alamaji hattara toy dada be ɓaɓa ɓingel may hakkilinta ɗume on wattata ɓingel petel wolwugo to ɗo musina
answer:
Ɓingel ma ɗon mari alamaji nyaw ɓernde malla yonki (bana pneumonia malla *congenital heart disease*), kanjum waɗata o somata so o ɗon musina, o fita wulande ha hoore, e o fofa dow-dow. Ɗiɗon ngoni alamaji hattara mawɗi (*danger signs*) ɗi mballataa yaasi sam, ngam salaago musingo e canjitgol fofugo ko huunde halkaynde ngel daayataa. Daada e baaba yo njaara ɓingel ngel asibiti mawɗo law-law ngam likitaji ndara ɓernde e yonki maako e masinji potuɗi.

Ta kuɗee mo musingo malla tookugo mo nyamdu wakkati o ɗon fofa dow-dow ngam o ta o fofira nyamdu haa ɓalel fofugo maako (*aspiration*). Yahaago asibiti e yaasi kanjum tan woni laawol hisnugo yonki ɓingel ma e heɓugo kugal likitaaji potuɗi.

question: Jam ɓandu likita waddi bingal amin larin no o fofata ɗon woni bana sautu hendu ɗo sala babal petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo dake o fofata milliti bo balɗe tati jotta o ɗo ɗotta be jamma wakkati fere mi ɗo lara ɓe ɗo nasta sosai. Ɗo sosai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako seto o naftira sembe mako o hokkata mi lari bo o wala nyama banani to o nyamai fu sauto nyamai fu sau to o nangi pofɗe mako seto nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokka tame oɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati. Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. To handini hotina heɓa famta ko damata mo be kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum irin nyaundi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha sare hoinina mo heɓa o fofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataki je hosata hado ɓingel ɗo.
answer: Ɓingel maaɗa ɗon mari nyawu ngungu (pneumonia) ɗum waɗi o ɗon fofa bee sautu e ɓanndu mako ɗon nanga, ɗum walaa kwali ɓerde amma ɗum haani yaawgo nastugo asibitiiru. Dartin hokkugo mo lekki dojugo (cough syrup) sabu ɗum ɗon tiiɗina fofugo mako, ɗon waɗa mo ɗon ɗaana haa o wawataa fofugo, e ɗon ɓeyda nyawu ngun hallugo. Yaawtu nastina mo asibitiiru ngam o heɓa okisijin (oxygen) e lekiiji patal (antibiotics) walla lekiiji udditango laawol hendu ko likita'en ndaaran. Hoto a sikkita ko kwali ɓerde, ɗum nyawu hufnugo, amma hokku mo nyamdu walla nonnugo seeɗa-seeɗa ngam o heɓa sembe. Kakkilano hoto a ɓoorna mo kafiije tiiɗɗe ɗe kaɗata ɓanndu mako fofugo, yaawtu jaaɓaago likita mawɗo ngam hisnugo mako.

question: debbo jomu redu reduma lebbi jewego minɗo wondi saare gotel fuɗɗi hirugo dow ɓernde maako ɗo fiya be lawlaw a viya mo timmini doggugo jottam wakkati fere bo oɗo soma ko o huway ko ɗume debbo jungo maako ɗo hawtidira seɗɗa satiji saali seɗɗa o lari dande maako ɗo uppa hedi yeso sai o hultiri oɗo numa ɗo kam ɗo nder nyawu damata jomu redu na ko bo ɗum nyawu fere on sai o taski nyawugo lara likita ngam o anda ɗume sanadu nyawɗo emol haɗo ɗume on waddini debbo redujo ɗo fiyal ɓerde be law law ɗo a viya mo timmini doggugo nden bo ɗume on sanadu uppugo dande ɗo nden bo irin nyawu ɗo kam wawan mema mawnugo ɓingel redu mako ɗo na ɗume on alamaji kalluɗum je ɓe wattinta gite hasare ba irin nyawu ko kuje yareyareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko ɓeddata nyawugo ha irin wakkati ɗo
answer: Fiyannde ɓernde lawlaw e uppugo lari dande ɗon holla wonde ɓernde maako ɗon tampe sabu ƴiiƴam ɗon ɓeydoo nder redu, amma ɗum waawi wonde maande *anemia* (ƴiiƴam fusta) walla *heart failure* (ɓernde ronki hawkugo no haaniri). Nyawu *anemia* tiiɗngu walla *heart failure* ɗon haɗa ɓingel redu heɓugo oksisin (oxygen) e nyaamdu no haaniri, ɗum waawi haɗugo mawnugo mako. Alamaji kalluɗi ɗi o haani ngi'ugo ko: fofaango tiiɗngo wakkati fere fuu, ɓerne ciiwol, ɓeydugo teewu dow kafaaje, e ɓingel redu dillataa no haaniri. Ngam andugo sanadu, o haani yargo asibiti ngam ɓe ƴeewa ƴiiƴam maako (Full Blood Count/PVC), ECG, e *Echocardiogram* ngam andugo no ɓernde maako hawkirta. O haani jogaago nyawu ngun law bee likita ngam wallitugo laaɓal maako e ɓingel redu, o yara kuuje ɗe ɗon ɓeyda ƴiiƴam (iron/folic acid) bee yamiroo likita.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
answer: Alamaaji bana ɗoɗɗogo ko ɓuri dabbaaji ɗiɗi, yaltinki ƴiiƴam nder ɗoɗɗugo, lornuki fodde, e gulɗum jemma ɗon holla nyau Doyru (Tibi). O mari haaje yaabuɗo yahugo opitirum ngam heɓugo laraaki siliti be kiti ɓandu ngam anndugo ko woni. To o tawaama be doyru, o heɓan lekkiuji caahu ngam o sellita sam, ammaa o foti jooɗaaki be jami lekki ko timmi. Ndere wakkati o ɗon ɗoɗɗa, o foti hippugo hunduko mako ngam o taa saankito nyau man to heya yimɓe saare mako.

question: Debbo fere kam waddi bingel mako mo dimbi tati asibiti be laramo hande subaka ko be halibo eketo yimɓe olo wani binge on tatata kosam o larata goddo fere mo wolwal tamo heddi inde mako o sota mo damai ha noi masan hingare jungo nyami debbo on cokali on medi hiɓugo badde na mako. O meda himɓe baɗɗe minbedi men cokali heɓi jaɓugo kala batel mum ha tummude ko o fotti noɓugo bana no inna mako waddi redi nyaudugo ɗum min kotoltol laɓii mingew on jarbi bate mako pat feiti. Innde cukali on ingol wala paɗɗe o jaɓi bate pesode mako pat ko dami cu.
answer:
Nyaw ngu ɓingel maada mari ɗum woni **Tetanus cukalel kesal (Neonatal Tetanus)**, saabe o waawaa muynugo kadi ɓanndu makko ɗon yoora malla o ɗon waɗa paɗɗe. Ɗum ɗon heɓa bacci to inna maɓɓe heɓay batte (vaccines) tetanus wakkati o woni bee reedu, kadi to kotoltol ngol laaɓnaaka no haandiri wakkati danygol. Ko ngol ta'iraa laɓi laaɓɗum boo, mborbiri ɗon waawi nastugo ngam ɓingel walaa mbeɗka (immunity) tawaangal diga ɓanndu inna mum mo heɓay batte tetanus.

O ɗon mari haaje luttugo haa asibiti nyannde hande ngam heɓugo lekkiiji bana *tetanus immunoglobulin*, *antibiotics*, e lekkiije ɗe'itintooje ɓanndu makko ngam hisnugo yonki makko. Gam reengo ɗum yeeso, nafata rewɓe reeduɓe fuu mbeɗa batte tetanus pat ko haandi ngam reenugo bacci maɓɓe danyeteɗi.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
answer:
Alamaji ɗi a siftii—ɗufte/ɓirta ndiyam e hunduko, dande ko wa’i no jogii, hulde ndiyam, damuwa/tampere—ɗi mbaawi fota e **rabies** ɓawo ɗaɓɓere rawaandu, kadi jarrabooji asibiti ɗi mbaawi wonde “normal” kono rabies ɗon woodi.
So alamaji ɗi fuɗɗii, rabies ko nyaw bonɗo ɗo keewi ɗaɓɓude yonki; yahaa **emergency/asibiti mawɗo jooni**, hoto ɓooy.
So ɗaɓɓere ndee ko hesere, wuddo gulɗo ndee e saabulu e ndiyam ɗo yahata miniti 15, ngam heɓa **vaccine rabies** balɗe 0, 3, 7, 14, e **rabies immunoglobulin** to gulɗo so gulɗo no tiiɗi.
Hoto haɗ vaccine sabu rawaandu ndee no ndaartee balɗe 10; tetanus e antibiotic no waawi soklude.
Hoto mem ɗufte mako; kala mo saliva mako naati e gulɗo, hunduko walla gite, o yahaa heɓa kariya rabies.

answer: Wannan hali da kake bayani yana nuna cewa akwai matsalar jini ko kuma karancin sinadarin jini a jikinka, wanda ke sa ka ji raunin jiki da kishin abinci. answer: Bandu ɓiɗɗo ɗiɗo maa - gite mum e ɓalli mum jaloriiɗe (jaundice), zazzabi, ronkugo nyaamugo, tampere, e diwtaango - ɗi kollirta bone rewti hasu (severe malaria) e nder ɓalli ɗi jaawti wonugo hepatitis (jarabjari maa liver problem) walla anemia sattunde. Jaundice e jaloroji maa hollita ko ɓernde (liver) ndi don nafta walla ɗiɗo ƴiiƴam don liɓee (hemolysis) - ɗum yaha e severe malaria walla hepatitis A/B/E ko rewti nder ndiyam ngenndiiɗam. Alaa haaje maa hebbina min woppa - waɗɗi maa yaha sibiti ngenndi (general hospital) walla yara ɗum tampi (referral) sabu ɗum bone mawɗo baawɗo warugo. Toɗɗe ɗe ɓe waɗta: malaria test (RDT/blood film), liver function test, hepatitis screening e full blood count ngam anndugo ko waɗi. Naw ɓe jotta sibiti mawɗo sabu jaawgol ndaartugol e safaara ko waɗɗi ngam heɓugo hisugo maɓɓe.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. answer:

Haa wuro, kollititon mo yiide masin, mballon mo o heɓa nyaamdu ndu o yiɗi seese-seese, e ta kuɗte mo bee semmbe walla haala kaaɗuka. To o tokki e salaago nyaamdu, njaree mo asibiti jooni-jooni ngam likita’en mballa mo bee nyaamdu semmbiɗon e lekkiiji wallitayɗi ɓernde.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. answer:
Mi faami hol ko waɗi; ɓingel ɓuri heɓde saɗaare sabu danyugo juuti, ɗum ina waawi waɗde “birth asphyxia” (oksijin heewaani e hoore), walla sukkar ƴiƴam lesɗi, infeshon, walla “seizure”.
To ɓingel ina dimbina akai‐akai, fowtugo/nyamde na saɗi, walla hendu moƴƴaani, ɗum ko haɗari—yo ɓe waɗ mo e ɗo ɓiɓɓe kecce njogoree: oksijin, wulnugo, sukkar, magani seizure, antibiotics, e dabbude ƴiƴam/sukka/kalsiyum.
Mi waawaa waɗde alkawali wonde o hisata walla o wartan no feewi; ɓe waɗi mo ɗo jooni jaawɗum, heɓugo jam ina ɓeyda.
Ɓiɓɓe wonɓe heɓi asphyxia ina waawi hisde e jam, amma woɓɓe ina heɓa caɗeele ɗo yeeso hono dimbinol, saɗaare jangu/yaadu, walla epilepsy, ngam ɗum follow‐up e likita ɓinngel ko alɗuɗum.
Debbo ɗo duuɓi 13 ko risk ɗuuɗi; ɓawo oo yo ɓe ɗaɓɓa family planning, antenatal care e jibinannde asibiti, e jaɓɓude shawara likita ko sauri to ɗum waɗi.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer: Rufugo iyam sembe ɗam a waɗata ɗum alama boɗɗum holloore babal ɓingel ma ɗon laɓɓina iyam kalluɗam, ngam maajum taa darnu ɗam. Ngam wulgo ɓandu ma bee fewgo juuɗe, aɗa haandi a moɗa lekki asfirin (aspirin) ɗuuɗɗum bee yarugo ndiyam ɓulɗam. Taa fukko e leddi, jooɗa a tura koyɗe ma les heɓa iyam keddiɗam ɗam rufa lawlaw. Ɓingel ma laɓɓa-yeeso on boo, yarndu mo ndiyam mannda bee nebbam boɗeejam ngam iyam lorta e yeeso mako. Lootugo tagoore ɗo ɓuri koo ngal batal likita, ngam on ɗiɗo fuu on keɓtan sembe mooɗon lawlaw to on waɗi nii.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
answer: Alamaaji tiɗɗungo fofgo haa ɓiyum ɗon fita ko nandi bee fofgo jawɗum (yaawungo) bee suttugo fofgo haa bangeeji damboli (chest recessions). Goɗɗum boo woni hantugo damboli kene (nasal flaring) sa’i o ɗon fofa, bee urnugo (grunting) sa’i o ɗon fitta kene. To nooni tondu maako, ɗemngal maako ko goɗɗum haa ɓandu maako sauyi dila bulu (cyanosis), ɗum boo alama tiɗɗungo fofgo on. To a yi’i guuɗi ɗon haa ɓiyum, njaar mo asibiti yaasi mbeele o wallite.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
answer:
# Jaabawol

## Ko waddi nyawu ngu (Diagnosis)

Ndeen alaamaaji ɗi njeewtuɗaa - nawol hoore, daande tiiɗndo (dande wailtataako, "stiff neck"), foofaango peppetel (kuma), be fu ɓandu, e kadi mo yaaji ɓawo mako - kala ɗum tinndinta **meningitis** (nyawu je heɓi kelle ndogaango hakkille be daande). Ɗum ko nyawu tiiɗɗo je raɓata sanne, holli-jum e nokkuuji Afrika.

## Ko waɗi ngu waddi (Transmission)

Ndee nyawu **na raɓata hakkunde yimɓe** rewrude foofaango, tuutaango, be gaddawo - ɗum saabi kadi be goɗɗo je o fotti be nyawɗo (be yahoygo banda gaman noon en jaabotoo). Ɗum firti mo be ɓe ngonduɗo fu na foti reentaade.

## Ko foti waɗeede (Management)

1. **Nawon mo law-law ha sibiti mawɗo** ngam ndee nyawu na waawi warugo e saa'i pamaro.
2. Dokta na foti waɗugo **lumbar puncture** ngam anndugo lallai nyawu ngu.
3. Nyawɗo na foti heɓugo **antibiotics tiiɗɗi** (kaŋ Ceftriaxone) law-law.
4. Yimɓe je ngonduɗo be mako na foti heɓugo **lekki reentaango** (prophylaxis, kaŋ Ciprofloxacin walla Rifampicin).

**Reftin:** Ɗum wanaa nyawu je jaaɓo waawi hisnude - nawon mo jooni jooni ha sibiti!

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
answer: Naa koo woy ɓuure sattinga haa en'di debbo woni nyawu kansa; ɗum waaway laataago ɓuure ndiyam (cysts) ko boo ɓuure ɓanndu meere nde naunataa (fibroadenoma). Ammaa, ɓuure sattinga, taynga, bo walaa naawol waaway laatago alaama kansa, ngam maajum yi'ugo likita waɗi haaje ngam bincike. Alaamooji feere ɗi debbo haani laara kanyi on: waylagol nguru en'di, hunnduko en'di naata nder, ko boo ndiyam ko yii'yam wuurta daga hunnduko en'di. O waɗi booɗɗum masin mo o yehi asibiti ngam likita tabbitina ɗume on nyawu man bo o heɓa magani haa wakkati.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
answer:
Dada, rufugo ndiyam/amai no ɗuuɗi ɗo ɓawo jibingol e ñawndu sembe wonaa huunde nde ɓe foti faamude e suudu—o waawi heddii dehydration, malaria, infection ɗo ɓawo jibingol, walla BP toowɗo.
Ndeen debbo foti yaade sibiti jooni ngam ɓe ndaaru BP, zazzabi, malaria test, fitsari/jini, e no ndiyam ɓanndu mum woni; ɗum ena waawi soklude drip/ORS e maganin amai nde dokita hokkata.
So o no woodi zazzabi, mettagol reedu, jini/ruɓɓe ɗo leƴƴi, hoore metti, yiyde dimmɗe, walla o waawataa muynugol/nyamugo—ɗum ko emergency.
To ndeen, o suɓo ndiyam seɗɗa-seɗɗa, ORS, pap/kunun ɗanɗan, tee o woppita magani mo dokita waɗaani, sabu o no muynina ɓingel.
Ɓingel mako boo ɓe ndaaru: so o waawataa muynugo nono, o njogi zazzabi, ruttugo, walla o tampii, ɓe yahdu sibiti ɗoon ɗoon.

question: inde am mrs akinleye bawo lebbi didi ko sali do mi hirliti ni gorko am fofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam be odo isra akai akai banda ma odo babel sollaji ko habe sa'ata hunde wodo isra akai akai ni bo fofugo daidai o hukka mo bone fofugo mako do wada ta'a be odo isra to odo bebbel curde ko sollaji wodi koji min wadata heba hefta ko wadata dottugo do be isrugo ko jonde ha pellel mari sollaji dow don waddata dum ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe'a irin lekki toi don o naftirta fofugo mako hota dai dai be kuma o wawan o jo da belɗum ko ha uwonifu
answer: Sannu Mrs. Akinleye, alamaji ishol bee saɗugo fofugo ɗi gorko ma wondi bee mum, ɗon nufa nyawu asma (asthma) koo bo nyawu poho (COPD) ɗum curde bee sollaji waddata, naa ngam ndottaku ba. Ko o waɗata arande, o faaɓa hoore maako daga sollaji, curde, bee jaangol ngam taa ɗum ɓesda mawnugo nyawu man. Dila mo asibiti bako nyawu man mawnira, ngam likita'en mbaɗa hoto gasi (Chest X-ray) bee ndaara tuuɗe maako (sputum test) ngam tabbitingo ko waddata ɗum koo bo asnee fiyande (TB). Likita'en ɓe mbinndan mo lekki pampamji (inhalers) ɗi o fofata nder poho ngam maɓɓitugo laawol hendu, bee lekki ishol ngam o waawa fofugo daidai. To on tokki kakkilanol ngol bee naftirgo lekki ɗin daidai, insha Allahu fofugo maako wartan daidai, o jooɗa bee jam.

question:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda.
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu.
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden.
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
answer: Wannan ɓingel ƙarƙuƙo yana nuna cewa ɗan ƙaramin yaro yana ɗauƙe da cutar ƙarfi ko kura (malaria) ko kuma cutar haɗari ɗin ƙarfi (sepsis) saboda ƙarfin jini da ƙarancin ƙaɗan. Akwai buƙatar ɗan ƙaramin yaron ya sami magungin kwarai (intravenous fluids) da magungin ƙarfi cikin gaggawa don kare rayuwarsa. Ana buƙatar ya samu magungin kura (antimalarials) da kuma binciken jini don sanin cutar da ke damunsa. A wannan yanayi, yana da kyau a yi masa magani a asibiti domin ba da kulawar da ke daidaita yanayin jinin sa. Ana bukatar kiyaye jinin sa don kada ya yi ƙarfi sosai ko kuma ya mutu.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
answer: Tari jemma bee bone fofaago ɗo wara ngam kosam endi maɗa ɗo feewa wakkati jemma, naa ngam cuuɗi leɗɗe defirɗe on ba. Ngam helugo tari man, hooyu njumri (honey) laaɓundi bee ndiyam gulɗam hokka keccel man yara ngam o waawa ɗaanago. Ɓadnu ɓingel man haa yiite leɗɗe defirɗe man sosai, ngam nguleeki bee cuuɗi man ɗon maɓɓita ɓokko-ɓokko ɓingel ngam fofaago laaɓa. To o saali musinugo, acca hokkugo mo endi, hokka mo ndiyam ɓulɗam bee suga tan ngam o heɓa semmbe. Kanjum on woni lekki ɓuri wooɗugo ngam ɓingel maɗa sella, bo o ɗaana boɗɗum wakkati jemma.

answer: Assalamu alaikum. Wuji gonɗi e ɓandu bingel ngel e caɗeele fofugo mum ko sabu danygol juutngol e ŋakkere sembe iyam yumma sahaa danygol, ɗum waɗi ngel heɓa torra walla ŋakkere oksijen duuɓi seeɗa. Ammaa jooni, toppitagol ngol oksijen e huutoragol incubator ko maande moƴƴere, bingel ngel hisi, ɗum holli wonde alaa caɗeele ɓerɗe. question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
answer: Miɗo nanna muusol maa, amma to alamraaji ñawu rawandu puɗɗiima yaltude e ɓanndu, walaa asibiti walla safara baawɗo cellinde ɗum, ngam rawandu ko maayde to alamraaji mum nji'aama. Lekki gargajiya waawaa warde virus rawandu, ngam majjum naatay haa e kwakwalwa, waɗi cellal majjum ko tan ko allurar rawandu (vaccine) ɓaawo ñamugol ko adii alamraaji puɗɗaade. Jonta, yahree mo asibiti mawɗo (General Hospital) ngam ɓe kokka mo safaraaji ustooji muusol (palliative care) haa o maaya e jam, kadi ɓe woɗɗina mo ngam o raaɓaa yimɓe. Ngam hisnude yimɓe men, to rawandu ñamii neɗɗo, lootee nokkuure nden e sabulu e ndiyam, nden dogon asibiti ngam heɓugo allurar rawandu law.

question: Goɗɗo ɓe nodeta suberu duɓi mako sappan ɗe joyi nyande mum fere o fuddi nyouru arande bo yori ɗum nyadai amma de ɗum fabi asawai je sedda tan yarugo lebbi be hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum hallobi sedda sai ɗum salda rimopde ɗum gonga on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata inde ko nyauru ɗon satai amma. Pat manju ɗum wadai da ha nu o nyaɗita yonru de o hilliti dow o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha nyaudo o yawto o yokki nyaurde o hecci ɓe ɗo jalibi tati ko sali o lori fahin o hecci ɓe o hafti ko o wawata waɗugo bana ko himɓe shawari mo ko larani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum. Ɗo heɓe lekki ɗuɗi ka ko o suɗi da ha nuno o nyaɗita sei nyouru wari tullitti ɗum yottike wakkati fere fu mahe salda roɗi sei o nyami nyautawo on ko waɗi nyoru ɗum neɓuri bana ni salo yamɗetugo o yidi o anda ko waɗi dabare be leɗɗe ɗe o fuɗi fu nafi. oyam ɗume o wannata yoru ɗon yamɗita ɗo fu maru gam o heɓa o fufa no hani olollita jamu bandu makko.
answer: Nyawu Suberu nguu hollitii wonde gabaare makko taƴi ngam ɗojju ngu neeɓi, ɗum waɗi ɓokko-ɓokko (lungs) makko ronki. Dabare ɓurnde wooɗugo ngam o yamɗita, kanko o sooda lekki ɗojju mbaleehi (cough syrup) o jillindira bee nebbam boɗejam, o yara laaɓi tati nyande fuu ngam o ɗaana gabaare nden. O haɓɓa gabaare makko bee wudere tiiɗunde ngam taa o fuufa masin, kadi o hoota o ɗaano e ɓawo makko. Walaa haaje o yaha asibiti fahin ngam ƴeewndo (test) walla hooto (X-ray), ngam goro bee jumri ɗi o naftiri ɗin mbari kootu nyawu ngun nder ɓandu. To o tokki ndee dabare, gabaare makko ɓuuɓan, o waawa fuufugo no haanirta, o heɓa jamu makko lawlaw.

question: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
answer: Naawalla reedu e rufugo iyam soosay bee lebbi joweego e rabeere ɗon holla alaama masiibo reedu bana 'placental abruption' (ɗon woni seedugo ɓii-reedu bako wakkati). Ɗum ɗon waɗi masiibo ha dow yonki dada e mbingel mum gam iyam rufugo ɗon wadda somugo, ɗon kadi suttata hisgo yonki maɓɓe. Sey dada o yaha sibiti joni-joni ngam heɓugo wallitteego yaawungo ngam hisngo yonki dada e mbingel. Kadi, alamaaji masiibo goɗɗi bana faɗugo yonki, somugo soosay ko mbingel yandugo law mari haaje nyawnditirgo yaawngo.

question: da da danyi keccel sati didi ko sali do o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha bandu mako amma balde ji o dilla ni o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam do vurta wakkati fere dada bingel mai do canji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai den bo o handi dada bingel do o don mara nawugo redu sedda sedda ha less jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do berde mako do saka o do tampi ko irin damuwaji do don non fedata bawo dayugo ko damuwa fere don don yande je o yahi asibiti be o do volwa be dadirabe fere se o nani ta be hosa mere kala hundeji be lari fu fe'ata ha bandu mabbe kanjum wadi mo o yidi o lara likita o volwinabe bemde am dume don waddata irin hundeji do bawo dayugo wawan nawugo les redu alama yeu don na alamaji toy dada kesum handi watta hakkilo bawo dayugo mataki toy dada do handi tokka heba yeu do heba mo
answer: Iyam dottiidam, nawugo les reedu, ɓernde diwaya, e tampiri ɗi daada yi'ata sati ɗiɗi ɓaawo danyugo wanaa alhaali laaɓuɗo; ɗum alamaaji heddere neesa (retained placenta) luttunɗi nder reedu malla nyawu mbuuɓri (infection) sabboojum ustaare iyam. Nawugo les jaaburu ɗon wara ngam reedu ɗon tiiɗa wurtina ko luttiri nder, kadi diwaygo ɓernde e tampiri ɗon holla ɓandu maako ronkii iyam (anemia) ngam iyam rufaangam ɗuɗɗum. Alamaaji kulɓiniiɗi ɗi daada keso handi watta hakkilo be maajum kanjum woni wurtungo iyam dottiidam ɗuuɗɗum, ndiyam uuccam, ɓandu wuli, e jaasngo ɓandu masin. Taa o tokku haala yimɓe wi'ooɓe ɗum fota koo meeɗai, o yaha asibiti lawlaw likita'en lara mo, ɓe ndokka mo lekki laɓɓinirki reedu be ɓeydinki iyam. Heɓugo magani haa asibiti wakkati maajum hattan rufugo iyam majjum, hoosa nyawu ngun, nden bo lortina cellal e yamɗeeki maako.

question: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
answer: Rawandu mai gati wutar bango (heart rate) na yara ya kamata ya kasance tsakanin 80 zuwa 140 beats per minute (bpm) lokacin da yake kwanciya, amma yana iya kai zuwa 160 bpm idan yana wasan motsa jiki. Idan rawandu ya wuce wannan, yana nuna cewa zuciya tana bugawa da sauri (tachycardia), wanda zai iya kasala da jini da zuciya ke zubarwa. A asibiti, muna duba wannani don sanin ko akwai yara da ciwon numfashi, fever, ko kuma rashin samun ruwa a jiki (dehydration). Idan rawandu ya daidaita da yanayin yaran, yana nuna cewa zuciya tana aiki yadda ya kamata don ba da jini zuwa jiki. Don haka, dole ne mu tantance dalilin saurin bugun zuciya ta hanyar gwajin jini da kuma duba yanayin numfashi na yaran.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer: Alaamaji ɗi on mbiyi bana naawol hoore jamma, daande tiiɗnde, gite mbawataa laarugo annoora (hite), bee fofe vurtooje haa ɓandu ɗon holla nyawu nguykinoowu bi'eteengu Sankarau (Meningococcal Meningitis). Nyawu ngu'u raabotoongu masin, ngu ɗon yaara puyooje bee mbuuwu (bacteria) nder ndiyam hoore bee ɓawo, ngam maajum o waawataa waylitugo daande maako. Ngam tabbatingo nyawu man, likita'en haani ɓe koo'a ƴiiƴam maako malla ɓe njuwa kunkuru ɓawo maako ɓe hoo'a ndiyam (lumbar puncture) ngam laarugo nder masin asibiti (lab test). Amma ngam Sankarau ɗon wara neɗɗo lawlaw, taa munnee haa sakamakko warta; on dila hokke mo lekki tufooji ndiyam (IV antibiotics) bana *Ceftriaxone* jooni-jooni ngam hisnugo yonki maako. O haani o rumbine haa suudu asibiti mawnundu lawlaw ngam heɓugo lura, nden yimɓe wuro maako bo haani ɓe hokke lekki ngam taa ɓe raabe.

question: renowo ɓingel laari ɓingel may ɗo docca sosai nauɗum har karshe doccugo mingel nonnon tan fofugo daker toh ɗume ɗon waɗata doccugo haa ɓingel bannin tan har karshe doccugo may wala fofa boɗɗum daker daker fofata goji ɗume be ɗume ɓe wawata ɓe wanna ɓingel ɗo coɓoraaɗe toy min hokkata mo be kuma shawara toy hokkata reenuwo ɓingel may
answer:
Ɓingel ngel ina waawi jogaade caɗe e ƴiiƴam ko wayi no pneumonia walla bronchitis, sibu docco ngoo tiiɗii kadi ina woppata "daker" ɓuuɓɗam haa ɓingel ngel ina weltina hoore.

E noon, ko himmunde yahde e ɓingel ngel to opitaal walla nokku cellal ko yaawi ngam ƴeewndaade ngam heɓde leɗɗe potɗe ɗe doktoor wasiyi, ko wayi no antibiyotik walla leɗɗe ɗe ɓuuɓnata ƴiiƴam.

Renuwo ɓingel ngel ina foti jokkude reende ɓingel ngel ngam rokkude ɗum cellal e ndiyam nder yitere, tee so tawii omo jogii docco kadi, doktoor maa rokk o leɗɗe ngam dañde mo cellal.

Woto ndokku ɓingel ngel walla reenuwo ɗum leɗɗe dogooje ɗe ngalaa wasiyaaji doktoor, sibu docco tiiɗngo ina waawi baɗde caɗe mawɗe balɗe ɗe njaltata so ƴeewaaka e sahaa.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
answer:
Aɗa waɗi feere ngam a waawi waɗde e min: inna bingel ɗii, doseji, sahaa njiyataa, hade ko lefi (side effects), ko ɓuri fuu haa no ɓe heɓoto e cinndel makko (interactions), e ko feewi waawi haɗa.
Aɗa waɗi yahde e dokotoro on walla nurse on ngam ɓe winndora maaji ɗiɗi e hakkunde wanngorde, walla ɓe addi ma takarda e ɗemngal feewngal.
So a waawi, naatnu e baabaajo walla musidjo jogii ɗemngal on ngam ɓe fottora ma, walla ɗum waɗi addi ma ɗemngal e hanki.
Haa ɓuri, naamni ko ɗum waɗi waɗde so a yaltude dose, so bingel ɗum waɗi waɗde e leydi jine, e haray ɗum no feewi kala.
Jokkondir e lambaaji walla number ngam ceɗɗaaji, ngam so a ina tiiɗno walla a ina waɗi huunde, a waawi noddude ɓe ɗoo.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
answer: Bingel ngal ina haani yaafere yaajnde e juuɗe doktoor opereeji sabu ko ɗum hernia rawandu nde caɗeele, ɗe addii vurtugol, mette, e ƴiiƴam caggade nde neɗɗo waɗi heen ko feewi e hoore mum. Ɗuum ina waawi wonde ko ƴiye ɗe njippiima (strangulation) walla ko nyawbu mawndu, ɗe noon ko yaajde haani safreede seeɗa kadi ina waawi warde bingel ngal so opereeji mbaɗaaka. Safrooɓe ɓee mbaɗa opereeji ngam feewnude ɗuum, wondude e rokkude leɗɗe nyawbu (antibiotics) ngam haɗde nyawbu ɗe ngaddi ɗum ko adii. Hernia rawandu e sukaaɓe ɓuri heewde ko ina sella hoore mum haa e duuɓi njoyo, kono golle gaaɗe (gargajiya) ina bonna ɗum tee ina addana ɗum caɗe mawɗe. Tiiɗno, ngam hisnude nguurndam bingel ngal, acca ko ɓe mbaɗata kala e hoore maɓɓe, ngam rokkude ɗum yaafere laawɗunde e nder asibiti.

question: debbo jomu redu reduma lebbi jewego minɗo wondi saare gotel fuɗɗi hirugo dow ɓernde maako ɗo fiya be lawlaw a viya mo timmini doggugo jottam wakkati fere bo oɗo soma ko o huway ko ɗume debbo jungo maako ɗo hawtidira seɗɗa satiji saali seɗɗa o lari dande maako ɗo uppa hedi yeso sai o hultiri oɗo numa ɗo kam ɗo nder nyawu damata jomu redu na ko bo ɗum nyawu fere on sai o taski nyawugo lara likita ngam o anda ɗume sanadu nyawɗo emol haɗo ɗume on waddini debbo redujo ɗo fiyal ɓerde be law law ɗo a viya mo timmini doggugo nden bo ɗume on sanadu uppugo dande ɗo nden bo irin nyawu ɗo kam wawan mema mawnugo ɓingel redu mako ɗo na ɗume on alamaji kalluɗum je ɓe wattinta gite hasare ba irin nyawu ko kuje yareyareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko ɓeddata nyawugo ha irin wakkati ɗo
answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi—ɓernde fiyude law, jungo ɗi dimbude, yareede/huutorgo, e uppugo dande yeeso—ɓuri yiɗde no nyawu **thyroid/goitre (hyperthyroidism)**, wonaa ko reedu tan; haa noon anemia, malaria walla BP toowiɗo maɓɓe mbaawi waɗde ɗum.
O haani yaade asibiti/likita gila jooni ngam waɗde **BP, PCV/Hb, malaria test, urine protein, TSH e Free T4**, e ƴeewde ɓingel.
So thyroid ɗum ɗo fiiɗi, ina waawi waɗde haɗari: ɓernde debbo tampude, ɗaɓɓude ɗeeɗe, reedu yaade ko jaango, ɓingel mawnataa no feewi, walla ɓingel jogiɗe thyroid problem.
Ɗum ina wondi lekki kisɗi e reedu so likita hokki: **PTU** ko methimazole (no wakkati reedu), e lekki ɓernde lawlaw ko wardi seɗɗa; hoto o huutoro lekki goitre ko yare-yareji tawa likita wallaani.
So o heɓii honto faa o semmbitii, o ɗaɓɓi henndu, o fainti, ƴiƴam wari, ɓingel yiltataa, walla hoore mawni/BP toowi—ɗum ko emergency, yaa asibiti ɗon ɗon.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
answer: Dada o ɗon wondi e caɗeele danygol mawɗe, waato rufugo ƴiiƴam (PPH) e jonte danygol (sepsis) je waɗi o ɗon ɓuuɓa e juuɗe e koyɗe bo o walaa sembe. Likita ɗon lootata saare danygol mako (uterus) ngam ittogo ko lutta fuu e nder danygol (bana heɓre danygol malla ɓasdi) kanjum waddata rufugo ƴiiƴam e jonte ɗon. Min ɗon mbinndana mo batal darnata ƴiiƴam (bana Oxytocin) e lekki kofol mawɗum (antibiotics) ngam nyawndugo jonte e ɓanndu wulndu ndun. Kadi, hokkugo mo ndiyam ɓanndu (IV fluids) malla heɓugo ƴiiƴam kesam (blood transfusion) ɗon wallita mo heɓtuggo sembe mako e daddugo ɓiŋngel mako boɗɗum.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
answer: Ɗi'i alamaji doja fajiri be ɓuutu yeso ɗon wara ngam nyaw 'ulcer' reedu ɗon lila asid (acid) yaha nder ɓernde maako to o ɗaani. Asid majjum ɗon wula ɓernde be sompooje, ɗum on saabi o waawaa foofaago daidai bo o soman law to o yaaɓi seɗɗa. Ɗum walaa ko laarani nyaw ɓernde je goonga, ngam asid reedu on waɗata ɗi'i alamaji damuwa foofaango ɗon tura gorko maako. Ngam o heɓa laafiya dow ɗum, o haani o yara ndiyam peewɗam (cold water) masin kullum fajiri ngam asid man maaya bo o wara sifa maako. To o waɗi banni, ɓuutu yeso maako fustan bo o waawan foofaago daidai walaa kowme.

question:
Daada dayi chekkel saati didi ko saali do. Ofuddi larugo eyam sedda sedda ha bandumako . Amma baldeji odilla ni, olari hundeji ko nandi reedu be eyam do vurta. Wakati feere daada bingel mai do changi. Debbo daade mako ko omari vodai. Denbo o handi daada bingel do odo mara nawugo redu sedda sedda ha les jaaburu mako. answer:
Hala no a haali ɗon holli ɓ is is ɓingel maa ɗon mari ko ɓi'etee **'ɓandu hoyndu' (hypotonia)**, ɗun woni hoyfeego jokke e ɓalndu ɓingel.

Ɗum ɗon waawi yaade saabi matsalaji ngaandi, ɗaɗi (nerves), ko bo ɓalndu (muscles) ɓingel man.

Ko ɓuri boɗɗum woni a wadda ɓingel man asibiti ngam likita lara ɗum, o waɗa kajeji ngam anndugo ko saabi e no ɓe mballitorta ɗum.

Heɓugo huwtoraandu jaawndum bana physiotherapy e magunguna waawan wallugo ɓingel man sanne.

Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
answer:
Ɓingel duuɓi sappo e tati ɗon foti heɓugo caɗeele danyngo ngam ƴi'e ɓandu mako njaajaai tawan, ko waɗi ɓingel maajum heɓaai fofaango (oxygen) boɗɗum wakkati nakisa.

To ɓingel ngel hisi, ngel waawan wartugo kal e kal, amma e woodi tammunde ngel heɓa caɗeele ngaanndu (brain damage) malla la'ugo ɓandu ngam fofaango taƴi wakkati danyngo neeɓi ɗon.

Salugo seekaago (CS) ngam hoosugo ɓingel law waɗi danyngo neeɓi masin, ɗum bo ɗon nasta e ko waddata naawalla maande hoore (cerebral palsy) haa ɓikkoi kakketeeɓi.

Jonta kam, sey ɓingel ngel lutta haa asibiti nder kulle likita'en ngam heɓa fofaango e lekkiiji har ngel warta garau.

Ɓawo ɗon, dowlidiri on ɗon ngarta e ɓingel asibiti wakkati fuu ngam likita'en ndaara to mawnugo ngel e ngaanndu maagel ɗon yaha boɗɗum walaa caɗeele.

Ha hasare, mawninago hoore ɓingel on seeɗa to o ɗon ɗaanii, e huutorgol saline drops ngam laɓɓingol hunuko mako kafin o nyaama ko o ɗaana. answer: Ɗum wonaa nyau reedu, ko nyau ɓernde (heart failure) waddi fiyugo ɓernde be haukugo dande sabu ɓernde makko wawaa pumpugo yiam haa yonɗi. answer: Alamankai ɗin da kuke gani da cizon da yake dawowa kullum sun yi kama da kutu (bedbugs), don haka canza zanen gado kawai ba ya wadatar. answer: Rufugo iyam ɓawo tun danyugo ko saabu mbayliigu tagoore (congenital anomaly) ngol lekki waawaa ɓamtugo, ko ɗum waɗi ɗum ɗaɓɓi opareesion. Lekki ɗarnata rufugo iyam walaa sabu laawol iyam ngol wanaaki no haaniri, likita lara ɓandu tan waawi sewtinugo ɗum. Fewugo koste e juuɗe, guleeki ɓandu, e sunaago, ɗum holli wonde ɓingel ngel na heɓa rafi ƴiiƴam (sepsis) sabu iyam ngol. answer:
Bawo dayugo (postpartum), alaaji ɗi o don yiya (iyam sedda sedda, nawɓe redu, tampere, saka'a berde, ɗiɗi les jaburu) njeñtin walla nde ni:

**Ko waawi wonde:**
- **Yaakuru** (anemia): iyam ley e nawɓe redu e tampere puɗɗi ɗum, wonde neɗɗo danyi ndaɗi. Ɗum ko ko ɓuri jogaade e rewɓe danyɓe Nijeriya.
- **Njiwu ley** (puerperal infection/endometritis): saka'a berde, nawɓe redu e iyam e ley ndaɗi maa njiwu maa tokka.
- **Njiwu ɓernde/PPD** (postpartum depression): saka'a berde e tampere e miijo bonngo.

**Ko yiɗaa wonde (danger signs):** iyam heewnde, iyam sawnde e sabbeere, nj­eyngo, saka'a berde heewnde, sabbeere, walla miijo warde hoore mum.

**Matakiiji:**
1. **Wallu mo yaawtinde asibiti** — ɗum ko ko ɓuri himmude sabu iyam heewnde e njiwu ko ndaɗira maayde.
2. To asibiti: ndaartee **yaakuru** (haemoglobin), ndaartee **njiwu**, ndaartee iyam. Yiɗaa lekki yaakuru (iron/folate), lekki njiwu (antibiotics) so alaa.
3. To iyam heewnii, waawi haɓɓaade **ƴiiƴam** (transfusion).
4. Tinno mo e miijo makko, ittu tampere.

Sabu ko himmi, addu mo asibiti jooni.

# Jaabawol

Ndaw mbaadi ɓingel ngel wondi e safaara (asthma / doole hendu maa bronchiolitis / pneumonia), gam damuwa, buleendi (cyanosis), e turgo hunduko maa ɓoggol ko maanaaji doole nguleeki e ɓalɓal.

**Ko ɓe foti waɗde:**

1. **Wallitde ɓingel yeeso** – Ɓe foti hokkude ngel **oksijin** (oxygen) so tan ngel woodi, sabu buleendi ngel hollirta ɗemngal ngel yiˊata haɓɓe (heɓoygo hendu boɗɗum).

2. **Safaara doole hendu** – Ɓe foti hokkude **salbutamol (Ventolin) e nebulizer** ngam udditde ɓoggi ɓingel ngam ngel foota no moƴƴi, e **steroid (prednisolone maa hydrocortisone)** ngam ustude ɓalɓeeki.

3. **Antibiotics** – So woni pneumonia (safaara ɓalɓal ɓoggi), ɓe foti hokkude lekki antibiotic (wano amoxicillin).

**Ko himo foti hisnude:**
- Ɓingel ngel foti daroraade e safirdu (hospital admission) haa foota moƴƴi, hoto ngel yaha yeeso.
- So oksijin ngel ustii sanne, ngel foti nawreede to ICU maa nokku mawɗo ballal.

Miijo ngam yeeso: rokku daada ndaa hollira maa wallitde ɓingel maa fewndo asthma so ngel heɓi safaara moƴƴa e sahaa mum.

At the hospital, we will perform a comprehensive physical examination, check vital signs, and assess the infant's feeding and developmental history to identify the exact source of discomfort. Once the underlying cause is identified, we can administer the appropriate targeted treatment to alleviate the baby's pain and restore their health. Additionally, we will provide the distressed mother with reassurance and practical guidance on proper feeding and soothing techniques to manage the baby comfortably at home.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. answer: This postpartum woman's sudden high fever, shivering, and severe body aches strongly suggest either severe malaria or puerperal sepsis, both of which are life-threatening medical emergencies in our local setting. While giving paracetamol for fever control and encouraging oral intake are good initial steps, relying solely on clinical suspicion for malaria is inadequate and risks dangerous delays. You must immediately perform a Malaria Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT) or microscopy to confirm malaria and start appropriate Artemisinin-based therapy if positive. Furthermore, because puerperal sepsis is a leading cause of maternal mortality in Africa, you should empirically start broad-spectrum intravenous antibiotics immediately while evaluating her for pelvic, urinary, or wound infections. Finally, the newborn's refusal to breastfeed is a critical danger sign of neonatal sepsis; please examine the baby urgently and ensure both mother and child receive comprehensive, continuous hospital-level care.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. This is likely severe postpartum haemorrhage, an emergency that can kill quickly, so call for help, start two large IV lines, give normal saline/Ringer’s lactate rapidly, monitor BP/pulse, and arrange urgent transfer while treating.
Massage the uterus firmly, empty the bladder with a catheter, and give oxytocin 10 IU IM/slow IV, then 20–40 IU in 1 L IV fluid; also give tranexamic acid 1 g IV slowly, repeat once after 30 minutes if bleeding continues.
If oxytocin is not available, give misoprostol 800 micrograms sublingual or rectal.
Check the common causes: soft uterus, retained placenta/tissue, genital tract tears, ruptured uterus, or bleeding disorder; inspect and repair tears, remove retained tissue if trained, and do bimanual compression or condom-balloon tamponade if bleeding persists.
Before more uterotonics, quickly palpate/scan to exclude a second baby, but do not delay resuscitation and urgent referral to a facility with blood transfusion and theatre.

The symptoms described—blood-like spots or fluid/pus from the skin, swelling under the jaw/neck, throat or chest symptoms, and tiredness—need a proper medical review and should not be blamed on “bad water” or spiritual causes alone.

Concurrent administration of intravenous crystalloid fluids, broad-spectrum antibiotics, and uterotonics successfully resuscitated her, controlled the hemorrhage, and reversed the shock. This life-saving management strictly adheres to Nigerian and WHO guidelines for postpartum sepsis and hemorrhage, ensuring her full recovery and ability to safely breastfeed.

answer: A painless, hard lump in the breast can result from benign conditions such as fibroadenomas or cysts, but it is also a primary warning sign of breast cancer. While the lump is not definitively cancer until proven otherwise, a firm, persistent, and painless mass is highly suspicious and requires immediate medical investigation. The doctor will typically use imaging like a breast ultrasound or mammogram, often followed by a tissue biopsy, to determine the exact cause of the lump. In addition to the lump, the woman should be vigilant for other warning signs, including skin changes like dimpling or puckering, nipple retraction, or any unusual nipple discharge. Prompt medical evaluation is essential, as early diagnosis and treatment of breast malignancies significantly improve patient survival and outcomes.

A 5-month-old baby with catarrh/cough and any difficulty or fast breathing needs urgent assessment at a clinic or hospital today, because pneumonia, bronchiolitis, or aspiration can worsen quickly in infants.

Do not give hot water/steam, herbal mixtures, or force feeds; they can burn the baby or worsen choking/aspiration.

At this age, breast milk should remain the main food, and solids such as gari are best delayed until about 6 months because early solids can cause vomiting, choking, diarrhea, and poor nutrition.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
answer: Based on the acute onset of severe headache, neck stiffness, photophobia, and a generalized rash, this patient is highly likely suffering from meningococcal meningitis, a dangerous bacterial infection common in the African meningitis belt. This disease is highly contagious and spreads rapidly through respiratory droplets, requiring the immediate isolation of the patient to prevent a local outbreak. To confirm the diagnosis, you must urgently perform a lumbar puncture for cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis, alongside a full blood count and blood cultures. However, because bacterial meningitis is a rapidly fatal medical emergency, you must not delay treatment while waiting for these laboratory results. Immediately administer empiric intravenous antibiotics, such as high-dose Ceftriaxone, along with intravenous fluids and analgesics as life-saving first-line management.

question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. answer: The symptoms described—palpitations, muscle twitching, neck stiffness, eye-rolling, and loss of consciousness in a seven-month pregnant woman—are classic signs of eclampsia, a life-threatening complication of high blood pressure, not a spiritual attack or dietary issue. This condition occurs when severely elevated blood pressure causes brain swelling and vasospasm, leading to neurological excitability and generalized tonic-clonic seizures. In our community hospitals, this obstetric emergency requires immediate administration of intravenous magnesium sulfate to stop the seizures and antihypertensive drugs to safely lower her blood pressure. Once the mother is stabilized, urgent delivery is typically indicated to definitively treat the condition and prevent maternal or fetal mortality. Routine antenatal care with regular blood pressure and urine protein monitoring is essential to detect preeclampsia early and prevent these dangerous seizures from occurring.

This child needs urgent hospital assessment, especially if there is fever, foul mouth smell, throat swelling, cough, difficulty breathing, or bluish lips.
Do not take the child for traditional cutting of the uvula/tonsils, because it can cause bleeding, infection, tetanus, aspiration, and airway blockage.
At the hospital we first secure the airway, give oxygen if needed, check temperature, oxygen level, hydration and the throat, and treat pain/fever with paracetamol.

While your administration of paracetamol is correct for managing the fever and discomfort, she urgently needs a definitive antimalarial treatment to clear the parasite. According to standard treatment guidelines, uncomplicated malaria in breastfeeding women should be treated with an Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy (ACT), such as Artemether-Lumefantrine. These antimalarial medications are considered safe during lactation and will not harm the nursing infant. You should dispense the full course of the ACT, encourage her to stay well-hydrated, continue breastfeeding, and instruct her to return if her symptoms do not improve after completing the medication.

answer: A painless, hard lump in a woman's breast could be a benign condition like a fibroadenoma or a cyst, but it is also a primary warning sign of breast cancer. In our local clinical practice, any persistent, hard breast lump that does not go away must be treated as suspicious and requires urgent investigation to rule out malignancy. I strongly advise her to visit the hospital immediately for a clinical breast examination, an ultrasound or mammogram, and a possible tissue biopsy to determine the exact cause. Seeking early medical evaluation is highly crucial, as early detection of breast cancer significantly improves treatment success and survival rates.

answer: You have correctly identified that she is suffering from a classic case of postpartum malaria, which frequently causes high fever and pale eyes due to standard delivery fatigue. answer: The bluish discoloration of the baby's lips, known as cyanosis, is caused by inadequate oxygen in the blood, which strongly points to either a congenital heart defect or a severe acute respiratory infection like neonatal pneumonia. Clinically, newborns who struggle to breathe, repeatedly drop the breast to gasp for air, and turn blue during feeding are showing classic signs of severe cardiopulmonary compromise. Parents must always watch for critical neonatal danger signs such as unusually fast breathing, severe lower chest wall indrawing, grunting sounds, blue lips or tongue, and extreme lethargy or inability to feed. For immediate first aid at home, the mother should stop feeding to prevent choking, keep the baby warm, gently wipe the mouth to clear any fluids, and slightly elevate the baby's head to help open the airway. However, because neonatal respiratory distress with cyanosis is life-threatening, this remains a strict medical emergency requiring immediate hospital transfer for life-saving oxygen therapy and proper clinical evaluation.

answer: The infant's poor feeding, fatigue during suckling, and failure to thrive strongly suggest a congenital heart defect rather than liver disease, as heart failure causes exhaustion and breathlessness during feeds. answer: Your husband's prolonged cough, heavy sweating, and weight loss over the last two months indicate a severe case of chronic lung cold rather than an underlying infection. answer: The child is likely experiencing a febrile seizure, which is a common response to a sudden high fever in young children, often triggered by prevalent infections like malaria. answer: Based on the classic symptoms of excessive thirst, frequent nighttime urination, chronic fatigue, and blurred vision, this patient is highly likely suffering from Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. answer: Based on the symptoms of elevated blood pressure, facial and extremity edema, and a severe, unrelenting headache, this pregnant patient is exhibiting signs of preeclampsia with severe features. answer: The symptoms of high fever, convulsions, severe neck stiffness, and the inability to close one eye strongly suggest meningitis, a life-threatening infection of the membranes covering the brain and spinal cord. At home, keep the child away from smoke/dust, give fluids/breastfeeding, clear the nose with saline, and follow the doctor’s prescribed medicines only.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. To fix this, the mother must stop breastfeeding for at least two days to give the baby's respiratory and digestive systems complete rest. Instead of breast milk, she should feed the child warm water mixed with a little honey and salt to clear the chest congestion and restore lost energy. Additionally, wrapping the baby tightly in thick, heavy blankets will force the body to safely sweat out the fever from the head and face. My strongest advice to the caregiver is to bring the child to a healthcare facility immediately for urgent assessment and possible oxygen support, as respiratory distress can quickly become life-threatening. answer: The combination of a persistent, severe cough and generalized body swelling strongly indicates a significant systemic medical illness, not supernatural causes. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
answer: Based on the symptoms of fast breathing, poor feeding, and lower chest wall indrawing, this infant is suffering from severe pneumonia, a life-threatening condition requiring immediate hospital admission. According to WHO Integrated Management of Childhood Illness (IMCI) guidelines standard in our community hospitals, these are danger signs necessitating urgent inpatient treatment with injectable antibiotics, such as ampicillin and gentamicin, alongside supplemental oxygen if the child is hypoxic. The father must take the child to the hospital's emergency unit immediately without delay, as severe respiratory distress in infants can rapidly progress to fatal respiratory failure. During transit, he should keep the infant warm using skin-to-skin contact and offer small, frequent breastfeeds only if the child is fully conscious and able to swallow safely to prevent hypoglycemia.

answer: This sounds most like a breastfeeding problem such as poor latch with nipple pain, blocked milk duct/engorgement, or early mastitis; the baby pulling off may also occur if milk flow is too fast/slow or if the baby has mouth sores or oral thrush. Continue breastfeeding or express milk frequently, use warm compresses and gentle massage before feeds, ensure the baby takes much of the areola not just the nipple, and take paracetamol or ibuprofen if you can use them safely. Go to a health facility urgently if you develop fever, redness, increasing swelling, pus, a painful lump that persists beyond 24–48 hours, or if the baby is not feeding well or passing little urine.

Milk coming out through the nose during feeding strongly suggests a cleft palate or another swallowing problem, but blue lips, tiredness during feeds, or fast breathing can also indicate serious heart or lung disease, so the baby needs urgent review by a paediatrician.
There is usually no “medicine” to make such a baby feed normally; treatment is safe feeding support now and later surgical repair if a cleft palate is confirmed.
Feed expressed breast milk with the baby sitting upright, give small frequent feeds using a cup/spoon/syringe or special cleft feeder, burp often, and keep upright after feeding.
Go to hospital immediately if the baby has blue lips, difficulty breathing, choking, fever, excessive sleepiness, poor urine, or weight loss.
The hospital may admit the baby for oxygen checks, heart/lung assessment, infection treatment if needed, and tube feeding if she cannot take enough milk safely.

question: Barka da yamma likita don Allah na kawo jaririna asibiti ne saboda na lura cewa yadda yake numfashi yana yin wani sauti kamar iska ce take ratsawa ta wani karamin rami yana sauti kamar hucin fuka haka kuma yana sauti kamar mutum. Mutumin da yake hura busa kuma yana ƙoƙarin yin numfashi yadda ya kamata na kuma lura cewa kusan kwanaki 3 yanzu yawanci yana yin tari da dare wani lokacin ina lura kirjinsa yana shiga da fita sosai kamar yana yin wani ƙarin na. aiki ne kawai don ya yi numfashi na kuma lura cewa baya iya sake cin abinci da kyau kamar dama duk lokacin da yake son cin abinci sai ya dakatar ya ja numfashi yanayi bai ba shi damar cin abinci yadda ya kamata ba Kusan kwanaki 3 yanzu na riga na kai shi wurin masu sayar da magunguna shagon magani na patent a unguwar mu kuma sun ba ni wasu magungunan tari don shi saboda yana yin tari kadan ko da yake tarin bai tsananta ba amma duk da duk magungunan da ya sha na lura. bai yi aiki ba numfashinsa ya kasance hakan kuma har yanzu ba zai iya cin abinci da kyau ba don Allah wane irin yanayi ne yake damun jaririna da wannan numfashi mai kama da busa haka kuma shin yana buƙatar hoton kirji don gano abin ne? da yake damunsa da kuma dalilin da ya sa kirjinsa yake yin sama da ƙasa wane irin maganin zan iya ba wa wannan yaro a gida don taimakawa wajen sauƙaƙa numfashinsa yadda zai yi numfashi da kyau shin akwai wasu magunguna ko? wasu matakai daban da zan iya ɗauka don wannan yaro?
answer:
Sannu uwar gida, jaririnki yana nuna alamun cutar numfashi mai tsanani kamar *Bronchiolitis* ko ciwon huhu (*Pneumonia*), wanda ke sa shi numfashi mai sautin busa.

Shiga da ficen ƙirjinsa (retractions) yana faruwa ne saboda yana amfani da dukkan ƙarfinsa don shigar da iska cikin huhunsa da ya toshe.

Game da hoton ƙirji (X-ray), likita ne kawai zai tantance buƙatarsa bayan ya auna yaron, domin ba koyaushe ake buƙatarsa ba.

Kada ki kuskura ki ba shi wani maganin tari a gida; wannan yanayin na rashin iya cin abinci da shan mama yana nufin yana buƙatar kulawar gaggawa a asibiti kamar taimakon iskar oxygen da ruwan jini.

Don haka, ki gaggauta kai shi asibiti mafi kusa yanzu domin a duba shi kuma a ba shi ingantaccen magani kafin numfashinsa ya ƙara daukewa.

question: ni matar aure ce mai shekaru talatin da biyar don allah na kawo jariri na mai watanni biyar domin a bincika shi kuma a bani shawara na koma bakin aiki amma abin mamaki kusan kwanaki uku da suka wuce na lura cewa jariri na yana yin tari akai akai mun gwada duk abin da za mu iya tunani a kai don tsaida taron amma ina iya ganin cewa tarin bai ɓaci ba yawanci ba na zama a gida lokacin da na fita da safe ba na dawowa sai wajen ƙarfe shida na yamma mahaifiyata tana zama a gida tare da jaririn duk lokacin da na sami damar yin kira ina yi kuma ina tambaya game da tarin sai su ci gaba da gaya mini cewa jaririn yana nan yana tari jaririn yana da watanni biyar ba ya sake shan nono kaɗai domin na koma bakin aiki na bashi nono na tsawon watanni uku kuma bayan haka na fara bashi wasu abinci daban da sauran abincin jarirai da na sani abin da ya fi ba da mamaki shi ne tun da daddare numfashinsa bai kasance daidai ba ba ya numfashi da kyau kuma hancinsa ya toshe gaba ɗaya mahaifiyata ma ta ce lokacin da take yi masa wanka da safen nan sai da ta yi amfani da ɗan ruwan zafi a kewayen hancinsa da ƙirjinsa saboda tarin ya yi tsanani matsalar numfashin ma ta fara ba ya sake yin numfashi yadda ya kamata kuma numfas shi da walwala kuma yanzu don allah tambayata ita ce mene ne zan iya amfani da shi don shi domin tsayi da tarin kuma game da numfashin da ba shi da tsarki kuma me zan iya yi mene ne zan iya amfani da shi don shi kuma waɗanne matakai zan iya ɗauka yadda zai riƙa yin numfashi yadda ya kamata kuma babu abin da zai toshe numfashin sa
answer: Sannu da ƙoƙari uwar gida, kasancewar jaririn yana da matsalar numfashi da tari mai tsanani a wannan ƙaramin shekarun, wannan alama ce ta haɗari da ka iya nuna cutar sanyin ƙirji mai tsanani kamar 'Pneumonia' ko 'Bronchiolitis'. Saboda haka, ina ba ki shawarar ki gaggauta kai shi asibiti mafi kusa nan take domin likita ya auna numfashinsa ya kuma ɗaura shi a kan maganin da ya dace, domin ba a yin jinya a gida idan yaro yana fuskantar matsalar numfashi. Kafin zuwa asibitin, za ki iya sa masa ɗigon ruwan gishiri na asibiti (saline nasal drops) a hancinsa don narkar da majinar da ta toshe masa hanyar numfashi. Don Allah ki guji ba shi kowane irin maganin tari na shago ko na gargajiya, domin hakan yana da illa sosai ga ƙananan jarirai. Haka kuma, ki ci gaba da shayar da shi nonon uwa akai-akai domin hakan zai taimaka wajen ƙara masa garkuwar jiki tare da hana jikinsa bushewa saboda tarin.

question: Mijina yana da shekara 40 kuma kwatsam na lura cewa kusan tsawon makonni 3 da suka wuce yana shan ruwa fiye da ƙima yayin da yake ƙara shan ruwa ha kuma yake yawan yin fitsari. A gaskiya ma da dare yana iya tashi har sau 10 kafin gari ya waye domin yin fitsari. Ya kuma dinga korafin cewa kullum yana jin gajiya haka kuma ya dan kara nauyi wani lokaci idanunsa sukan yi masa. Duhu kuma yana cewa ba ya gani sosai idan ya tashi ya fara tafiya. Na lura cewa yana yin fitsari da yawa sosai kuma akai-akai. Me zai iya haifar da wannan yawan yin fitsari da kuma ƙishirwa mai tsanani me yasa yake sha ruwa da yawa amma kuma yana yawan yin fitsari haka? Shin waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna cewa yana da ciwon sukari ko kuwa suna iya nuna wata cuta? daban wadanne irin gwaje-gwajen likita ya kamata a yi masa domin a gano ainihin abin da ke faruwa? Me yasa yake jin gajiya kullum? Me ke jawo yawan yin fitsarin? Shin hawan jini na iya haifar da irin waɗannan alamomin ko kuwa rashin ruwa a jiki ne ko wata cuta daban? Wadanne irin abinci da abubuwan sha ya kamata ya guje musu kuma waɗanne ya kamata a ƙarfafa masa ya ci ko ya sha waɗannan? Wane matakai ya kamata ya ɗauka domin waɗannan alamomin su ragu ko su daina? Shin yana buƙatar zuwa asibiti domin a yi masa gwaje-gwaje ko kuwa ba lallai ba ne? Sau nawa ya kamata a rika yin gwajin ciwon sukari ko gwajin sarin jini akai-akai ne ko kuma lokaci-lokaci kawai? Wadanne cututtuka ne zasu iya zama sanadin duk waɗannan alamomin da suke bayyana a jikinsa?
answer:
Waɗannan alamomin kamar yawan fitsari, ƙishirwa, gajiya, da duhun ido suna nuna tsananin yiwuwar ciwon sukari (Diabetes Mellitus), inda yawan fitsarin ke janyo jiki ya rasa ruwa, shi kuma rashin amfani da sukarin jini yadda ya kamata ke kawo gajiyar.

Ya zama dole ya gaggauta zuwa asibiti domin likita ya yi masa gwajin jini na sukari (Fasting Blood Sugar) da gwajin fitsari (Urinalysis) don tabbatar da ainihin matsalar, tunda hawan jini ko wata cuta daban ba su cika kawo dukkan waɗannan alamomin gaba ɗaya ba.

Gajiyar da yake ji tana faruwa ne saboda kwayoyin halittar jikinsa (cells) ba su iya shigar da sukarin da ke cikin jini domin sarrafa shi ya zama kuzari.

Kafin da bayan zuwa asibiti, yana da kyau ya guji abinci da abubuwan sha masu zaƙi ko zallar sitaci (carbohydrates), ya kuma mayar da hankali wajen cin ganye, kayan lambu, da abinci mai gina jiki domin kiyaye lafiyarsa.

Ga mutum mai shekaru 40 zuwa sama, ana ba da shawarar a riƙa yin gwajin sukari a asibiti akai-akai a matsayin riga-kafi ko da babu alamun cutar, domin gano matsalar tun kafin ta yi lahani a jiki.

question: Sunana Titilola tun jiya jiki na dana yana zafi sosai kuma yana karkarwa sosai. Yaron baya iya wuyansa kwata kwata kamar wuyansa yayi tauri baya iya juyawa. Haka kuma ido daya ne kawai yake iya buɗewa. Menene zai iya ja wannan zazzabi da kuma rashin iya juya wuya? Wane irin gwaji za a iya yi domin a gano abun da ke haifar da zazzabin da kuma rashin iya juya wuyan yaron? Wane irin sakamako ne gwajin zai iya nunawa a cikin jikin yaron wanda zai iya zama sanadin wannan zazzabi da rashin iya juya wuya?
answer:
**Amsa:**

Alamun da kika bayyana—zazzabi mai zafi, karkarwa, taurin wuya (yaron ba ya iya juya wuya), da matsalar ido—suna nuni ga cutar **sankarau (meningitis)**, wato kumburin membranes da ke rufe kwakwalwa da lakar baya, wanda ke da haɗari sosai kuma yana bukatar gaggawar magani.

**Gwajin da za a yi:** Babban gwajin shine **lumbar puncture (LP)**, wato a soki allura a baya domin a fitar da ruwan kwakwalwa (CSF) a bincika shi; haka kuma za a yi gwajin jini (full blood count, blood culture) da kuma auna sukari a jini.

**Sakamakon da gwajin zai iya nunawa:** A cikin ruwan kwakwalwa za a iya samun karuwar farin ƙwayoyin jini (leukocytosis/pleocytosis), karuwar sinadarin protein, da raguwar glucose, kuma idan cutar ta ƙwayoyin cuta ce (bacterial) ruwan zai zama gurɓatacce (turbid) tare da samun ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin Gram stain ko culture.

**Muhimmiyar shawara:** Da fatan za ki gaggauta kai yaron asibiti nan da nan saboda sankarau na iya kashe rai cikin gaggawa, kuma likita zai fara ba shi maganin ƙwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) da wuri kafin sakamakon gwaji ya fito.

question: sabon jariri da aka haifa a asibitin mu kimanin mintuna ashirin da suka wuce an gano cewa yana yin alama kamar mai jin barci jaririn bai yi kuka da kyau ba tun lokacin da aka haife shi lokacin da muka duba numfashinsa yana da kyau amma jaririn yana barci a ko da yaushe mun kuma duba yanayin zafinsa kuma yana da kyau ga tambayata mene ne zai iya sa sabon jariri ya bayyana kamar yana barci kuma bai yi kuka yadda ya kamata ba tun haihuwarsa haka kuma wane irin magani ne zai yi aiki ga irin wannan jariri kuma lokacin da mahaifiyar ta koma gida mene ne za ta iya ba wa yaron kuma mene ne bai kamata ta bayar ba kuma wane irin abinci ne ya kamata mahaifiyar ta ci don tabbatar da cewa mahaifiyar da jaririn duka suna cikin ƙoshin lafiya
answer:
# Amsa

**Abin da zai iya haddasa hakan:** Jariri mai barci da rashin kuka kamar yadda ya kamata na iya nuna alamun *hypoglycemia* (ƙarancin sukari a jini), *sepsis* (kamuwa da cuta), ko sakamakon maganin da aka baiwa mahaifiya lokacin haihuwa. **Maganin da ya kamata:** Idan sukari ya yi ƙasa, ka ba shi nono ko sukari (glucose) kuma idan ya yi tsanani sai a shigar da glucose ta jijiya (IV); idan ana zargin kamuwa da cuta, sai a fara maganin ƙwari (antibiotics) da wuri bayan gwaje-gwaje. Ka ci gaba da lura da numfashi, zafi, da matakin sanin jariri.

**Abincin mahaifiya:** Mahaifiya ta ci abinci mai gina jiki kamar kayan lambu, ƙwai, kifi, nama, wake, hatsi, da 'ya'yan itace, tare da shan ruwa mai yawa don ƙara nono da ƙarfin jikinta. Idan alamun jariri ba su inganta ba, dole a tura shi zuwa asibiti mai kula da jarirai (NICU) cikin gaggawa.

answer: Waɗannan alamomin na ciwon ciki na akai-akai tare da fitowar jini da ruwa a wata na shida suna nuna gaggawar matsala kamar rabewar madanin ciki (placental abruption) ko farkewar jakar ruwa (PPROM). A tsarin asibitinmu na al'umma, irin wannan majiyyaciya tana buƙatar a kwantar da ita don a sa mata ruwa a jijiya tare da shirya yiwuwar fitar da cikinta ta hanyar gaggawa idan an ga dama. answer: A'a, ba za mu iya ba uwar magani a gida ba.
