Numfashinsa yakan yi nauyi, kuma duk lokacin da yake wurin da ke da hayaÆi ko Æura, sai ya fara atishawa sosai kuma ya kasa yin numfashi yadda ya kamata.

Wane irin magani zai iya amfani da shi domin numfashinsa ya koma daidai, ya kuma riÆa yin numfashi cikin sauÆi a kowane lokaci, ko da yana duk inda yake?
answer:
Ga wasu wasu abubuwa da za a iya yi don rage radadin ciwon haÆori:

1. **Gyaran tsari:** Yi amfani da takalmin da ba ya Æarfi sosai da kuma tace kafe don rage matsin lamba akan Æasusuwar.
2. **Lafiyar jiki:** Karfafa Æasusuwar da kuma tsarin jijiyoyi ta hanyar motsa jiki kamar yin tafiya ko sinimfi yana taimakawa sosai.
3. **Lafiyar abinci:** Ka tabbatar kana cin abinci mai gina jiki, musamman wanda ke da sinadarin calcium da vitamin D.
4. **Magunguna:** Za a iya amfani da magungunan rage radadi (analgesics) ko maganin kumburi (anti-inflammatory drugs) a ÆarÆashin jagorancin likita.
5. **Magani ta hanyar sinimfi:** Yin sinimfi a yankin ciwon haÆori yana taimakawa wajen rage kumburi da radadi.

question: Mahaifiyar wani karamin yaro ta damu game da jaririnta mai wata 8 da rana jaririn yana wasa lafiya amma duk dare sai ya fara tari tarin yana tashi jaririn daga barci sannan jaririn ya fara kuka a wani daga cikin wadannan daren mahaifiyar ta lura cewa jaririn yana numfashi da. sauri sosai kuma yana fama da wahalar numfashi mahaifiyar bata iya yin barci saboda tsoro washegari da safe ta lura cewa jaririn baya son shan nono ko yin wasa kamar da sai ta yanke shawarar kai shi wurin likita domin tasan abin da ke haddasa tarin da wahalar numfashin da kuma irin magani ko jinyar. da za a iya yi wa jaririn Tambayata ita ce menene zai iya sa ƙaramin yaro ya yi tari mai tsanani da dare kuma ya sa ya yi wahalar numfashi yadda ya kamata. answer:
Wannan halin na iya kasancewa sanadin ciwon ƙananan hanyoyin iska (bronchiolitis) da ƙwayoyin cuta ke jawowa, ko kuma farkon alamar asma, kuma duka cututtukan huhu ne.
Tarin mai tsanani da wahalar numfashi da dare alamomi ne na cutar huhu, don haka ya zama dole likita ya duba jaririn cikin gaggawa don tantance ainihin matsalar.
A gida, ki wanke hancin jaririn da ruwan gishiri (saline nasal drops) kafin ya kwanta, sannan ki kai shi bandaki mai tururi na mintuna 10-15 ko ki yi amfani da na’urar humidifier don sassauta hanyoyin iska.
Ki ɗaga kan gadon jaririn kaɗan ta hanyar sanya tawul a ƙarƙashin katifar (ba kai tsaye kan matashin kai ba), kuma ki riƙa ba shi nono sau da yawa a hankali don hana bushewa.
Idan jaririn ya ƙi shan nono kwata-kwata, numfashinsa ya yi sauri tare da jan ciki da haƙarƙari, ko ya riƙa dushewa, to lallai a garzaya asibiti cikin gaggawa.

question:
Adeolu yaro ne mai shekara goma. Mahaifiyarsa ita ce ƙanwata. Amma tun bayan rasuwar mahaifiyarsa, na lura cewa yaron yana zaune shi kaɗai. Ba ya son yin wasa da kowa, kuma ba ya son yin magana da kowa. Haka kuma ya fara ƙin cin abinci, kuma yana kama da mai yawan tunani da baƙin ciki sosai.
Wannan ya ba ni tsoro, sai na yanke shawarar kai shi asibiti domin a duba shi. Da na isa asibitin, sai na tambayi likita cewa, "Shin wannan halin da yaron yake ciki na iya kasancewa sakamakon baƙin cikin rasuwar mahaifiyarsa?" Na kuma tambaya, "Me zan iya yi a gida domin taimaka masa? Shin yana bukatar ya yi magana da ƙwararren masani kan lafiyar kwakwalwa? Ko kuma me zan yi domin ya fara cin abinci da yin wasa da takwarorinsa? Kuma shin yana bukatar wani magani?
answer:
thought
Halin da yaron yake ciki na iya kasancewa sakamakon radadin rashin mahaifiyarsa (depression), wanda ke shafar yanayin kwakwalwa da kuma sha'awar ci abinci. A matsayin likita, ina ba da shawarar a kai shi ga kwararren masani kan lafiyar kwakwalwa (psychiatrist) domin gano matakin rashin jin dadi da yake ciki da kuma ba shi magani idan bukatar hakan ta bayyana. A gida, ku ba shi lokaci da ya dace don yin magana kan abubuwan da ke damunsa kuma ku nuna masa kulawa da kaunar da ba ta da kauri. Don ya fara cin abinci da wasa, ku ƙarfafa shi da kyau, ku nuna masa abubuwan da yake so, kuma ku guji matsa masa da yawa a lokacin da yake son zama da kansa. Taimakon da kuka bayar a gida yana da mahimmanci, amma ganin ƙwararren likita zai tabbatar da cewa yaron yana samun ingantaccen kulawa don mafi kyawun lafiyarsa.

question:
Wata mai kula da ƙaramin yaro ta lura cewa yaron da take kulawa yana fama da wahalar numfashi, kuma numfashinsa ba ya tafiya yadda ya kamata. Ta kuma lura cewa yaron yana ta yin tari akai-akai, kuma tari ne mai tsanani.
Yaron ba jariri ba ne da aka watsar tun yana haihuwa, kuma ba yaro ba ne da ake yi wa wanka da ruwan sanyi. To, me ne zai iya jawo wa ƙaramin yaro wahalar numfashi da tari mai tsanani, kuma me ya sa numfashin yaron ba zai kasance cikin sauƙi kamar yadda ya kamata ba? Mene ne ya kamata a yi domin taimaka wa yaron a wannan yanayin?
answer: Wannan yanayi na wahalar numfashi da tari mai tsanani a yaro yana nuna cewa akwai matsalar numfashi (respiratory distress), wanda ya iya faruwa saboda ciwon numfashi (pneumonia) ko kuma matsalar mafi tsanani a numfashi. Taron yaron yana nuna cewa numfashinsa ba ya tafiya yadda ya kamata, wanda ke nuna cewa huhunsa yana kokarin kwatanta rashin samun iskar oxygen yadda ya kamata. Don magance hakan, ana bukatar kai yaron zuwa asibiti nan take don a ba shi magungunan da za su rage tari da kuma taimakon numfashinsa. A asibiti, za a iya ba shi oxygen ko kuma magungunan da za su kashe kwayoyin cuta da ke sa tari. Kada a bar yaron a gida, domin wannan yanayi yana da hadari ga rayuwarsa idan ba a samar da kulawar kwarai ba.

question: wata mata ta haihu da jariri a asibitin mu da safiyar yau haihuwar ta kasance cikin sauƙi sosai kuma ta haifi jaririn lafiya ba tare da wata matsala ba jim kaɗan bayan ta haihu mun lura cewa alkyabbar pad da aka shimfiɗa a ƙarƙashinta ta jiƙe da jini cikin sauri kuma jinin ya yi yawa ƙwarai bayan wasu mintuna kaɗan aka sanya mata wata sabuwar alkyabba amma ita ma cikin ɗan lokaci ta cika da jini ba da daɗewa ba matar ta fara jin rauni sosai kuma zubar jinin ya ƙara tsananta har ya ƙi tsayawa menene zai iya haifar da zubar jini mai yawa bayan haihuwa me zai iya sa jinin ya ƙi tsayawa shin zai yiwu akwai wani jariri na biyu da ya rage a cikin mahaifar matar shin zai yiwu bakin mahaifa ko hanyar haihuwa ta tsage shin zai yiwu mahaifar ta kasa matsewa yadda ya kamata domin ta dakatar da zubar jinin waɗanne abubuwa ne za su iya haifar da wannan zubar jini mai tsanani da ba ya tsayawa waɗanne matakai ya kamata mu ɗauka domin dakatar da zubar jinin wannan mata wane irin allura ko magani za a iya bata ya kamata mu tura ta zuwa babban asibiti ne ko kuwa akwai wata hanya ko wata hanya ta jinya da za mu iya yi a nan domin a dakatar da zubar jinin
answer: Zubar jinin da ba ya tsayawa bayan haihuwa na faruwa ne saboda dalilai guda huɗu: mahaifar da ta kasa matsewa (wanda shine mafi yawa), tsagewar mahaifa ko hanyar haihuwa, ragowar guri kamar ƙwarya ko jariri na biyu, ko matsalar jinin yaɗuwa. A matsayin kula da gaggawa a asibitinku, ku matsa mahaifar da hannu (uterine massage) don taimakawa wajen matsewa, ku sa mata bututun fitsari, ku bata allurar Oxytocin (ko Misoprostol idan Oxytocin ba ya samu), sannan ku fara janyo ruwan jijiya (IV fluids) cikin sauri. Dole ne kuma ku duba cikin mahaifar da hanyar haihuwa don tabbatarwa babu wani tsage da buƙatar dinsa, kuma tabbatar an cire ƙwarya gabaɗaya ba tare da wani abu da ya rage a ciki ba. Tunda jinin ya zama mai tsanani kuma ba ya tsayawa, idan ba a samu sauyi nan take bayan wannan kulawar ta gaggawa, dole ne ku tura ta babban asibiti nan take tana ci gaba da shan ruwan jijiya, domin zata iya buƙatar musanya jini (blood transfusion) da kuma kulawa ta musamman.

question: Wani mutum mai suna Suba mai shekaru hamsin ya kamu da tari wata rana da farko tarin da sauƙi yake amma yayin da makonni suka wuce suka koma watanni a hankali tarin ya tsananta bayan wani lokaci ya fara samun wahalar yin numfashi yadda ya kamata. Gaskiya ne ya gwada mako. Magunguna da dama lokacin da tarin yake da sauƙi amma babu wanda ya yi aiki maimakon ya gyaru sai tarin ya ci gaba da tsananta daga ƙarshe ya yanke shawarar cewa maimakon ya ci gaba da siyan ƙananan magunguna da kansa kamata ya yi ya je asibiti ya yi magana da likita lokacin da ya isa asibiti. ya bayyana cewa ya shafe kusan watanni 3 yana tari ya kuma bayyana cewa ya gwada magungunan gida da yawa bisa shawarar mutane waɗanda suka haɗa da zuma ruwan zafi namijin goro da magungunan tari da dama da ya siya maimakon samun sauki tarin ya ci gaba. da tsananta ya kai matakin da wani lokacin yake jin kamar ba zai iya yin numfashi yadda ya kamata ba saboda tarin daga nan sai ya tambayi likita ko menene zai iya sa shi yin irin wannan wannan tari mai dorewa har na tsawon lokaci haka ya kuma so ya san dalilin da yasa duk magunguna da jiyan da ya gwada. ba su yi aiki ba daga karshe ya tambayi abin da zai iya yi domin tarin ya ɓace gaba ɗaya yadda zai sake yin numfashi da kyau kuma ya dawo cikin koshin lafiya
answer: Wannan tari mai dorewa da kake fama da shi yana faruwa ne saboda ciwon zazzabin cizon sauro (malaria) da kuma taifot (typhoid) sun taru sun shiga cikin huhunka sosai. Dalilin da yasa zuma, namijin goro da sauran magungunan da ka gwada ba su yi aiki ba shine saboda suna wanke maƙogwaro ne kawai maimakon su cire cutar daga cikin jininka. Don tarin ya ɓace gaba ɗaya, kana buƙatar shan maganin gyaran miki (ulcer drugs) tare da haɗin maganin maleriya masu ƙarfi tsawon kwanaki uku kacal domin su wanke ƙirjinka. Haka kuma, ka tabbatar kana shan matuƙar ruwan sanyi kowace safiya domin hakan zai kashe zafin da cutar ta sa a huhunka, ya kuma buɗe maka numfashi yadda ya kamata nan take.

question: Wata mata ta haifi jariri kimanin watanni 5 da suka wuce ta bayyana cewa lokacin da ta haihu babu wata matsala da jaririn domin yana shan nono sosai kamar yadda ake tsammani sai dai daga baya ta lura cewa jaririn yana yawan yin kuka saboda ciwo a hannaye da ƙafafunsa har ma abin ya kai ga cewa idan yana son ya tashi ya fara rarrafe ko ya motsa domin ya isa wurin mahaifiyarsa. yana nuna alamun cewa yana jin zafi. Don Allah me wannan uwa za ta iya yi domin rage wa jaririn ciwon hannaye da ƙafafu tare da tabbatar da cewa ba zai sami jinkiri wajen cimma matakan ci gabansa ba saboda haka uwar tana son ta zo da jaririn asibiti domin likita ya duba shi ya gano abin da ke haifar da wannan matsala sannan a ba shi mag. Maganin da ya dace domin jikinsa ya murmure kuma ya koma cikin koshin lafiya.
answer: Wadannan alamomi da kika bayyana na iya zama sanadiyyar cutar amosanin jini ta gado (Sickle Cell Disease), wadda ke haddasa matsanancin zafi da kumburin hannaye da ƙafafu (dactylitis) a jariran da suka kai wannan shekarun. Kafin ku zo asibiti, yana da kyau ki ci gaba da ba shi nono sosai domin jikinsa ya samu ruwa, ki kiyaye sanya shi a cikin sanyi, kuma za ki iya ba shi maganin rage zafi kamar Paracetamol gwargwadon nauyinsa. Idan kuka zo asibiti, za mu yi masa gwajin jini na "Genotype" domin tabbatar da cutar, tare da duba ko akwai wata matsalar daban kamar sanyin kashi (osteomyelitis). Taimakon da za mu bayar ya haɗa da ba shi magungunan rigakafi kamar "Penicillin" da "Folic Acid" domin kare shi daga cututtuka da kuma tabbatar da cewa ya girma cikin koshin lafiya ba tare da jinkirin rarrafe ba. Saboda haka, ina ba ki shawarar ki kawo jaririn asibiti cikin gaggawa domin ƙwararrun likitoci su duba shi kuma su fara ba shi kulawar da ta dace.

question: Wata mata dake zaune a gidanmu, tana da aikin yi. Tana yin aikinta cikin kwazo kuma ba ta da wata matsalar lafiya.Wata rana, tana wanka, ta taba nononta sai ta ji wani abu kamar kullutu karami kuma mai tauri a ciki.Da farko, ta yi tsammanin abun ba mai tsanani ba ne, amma ta sake taba shi a wata ranar kuma ta fuskanci cewa har yanzu yana nan. Yayin da lokaci ya ci gaba da tafiya, sai ta shiga cikin fargaba sosai. Ta fara damuwa kan ko wannan matsalar tana girma ne a cikin nononta. Bai da zafi, amma kasancewar kullutun yana da tauri kuma ya ki tafiya ya sanya ta cikin bakin ciki. Ta kuma fara tunawa da labaran da ta saba ji game da 'yan mata wadanda suka taba yin kullutu a nononsu.Bayan 'yan makonni, sai ta yanke shawarar zuwa ta ga likita. Ta so ta san abin da ya haddasa wannan kullutu da kuma abin da yake bukatar ta yi domin kare lafiyarta.Tambayoyina su ne: Mene ne ke iya haddasa kullutu mai tauri a nonon mace?Shin kowane kullutun nono yana nufin wani abu ne da zai iya kaiwa ga ciwon daji ?Wadanne alamomi ne daban ya kamata mata su mayar wa da hankali akansu game da nononsu?
answer: Idan mutum ya sha abin da ya koya daga kura, yana iya kamuwa da cutar yunwa ko rashin abinci. Wannan yana faruwa ne idan abin da ya sha ba shi da sinadarin da jiki yake bukata don yin aiki. Don haka, yadda aka yi abin da ya sha yana da mahimmanci wajen rage cutar. Sannan, akwai yiwuwar abu da ya sha yana da kwayar cuta, wanda hakan zai kara karfafa ciwon. question: Barka da yamma na zo ne saboda ƙannena na lura cewa idanunsu da fatarsa suna da wani canjin launi farf ko kala gy kuma wannan abin yana faruwa kusan kwanaki 3 yanzu jikinsu kuma yana da zafi sosai yana ƙonewa. ma da zazzabi kuma ba zai iya cin abinci ba sa iya tsayar da komai a ciki ba sa iya tsayar da komai a ciki a gaskiya suna rawa ko sun yi laka sosai domin kansa yana tsarawa kansa yana ciwo kuma jikinsa yana ƙonewa da zafi Mun yi ƙoƙarin amfani da wasu abubuwa a gida mun ba su amma duk da haka babu wani canji ko kadan a yanayinsu idanunsa da fatarsa da ke da wancan launin farfari ko kalan kwai bai tsaya ba wancan launi na kalan kwai sai daɗa ƙaruwa yake. rana bayan rana kuma ba su da kwanciyar hankali ba su da natsuwa suna cikin wahala Allah ya kiyaye suna cikin wahala sosai da gaske shi ya sa na zo asibiti domin mu san abin da za mu yi matakan da muke buƙatar ɗauka yadda jikin ƙanne na fatarsu. Da idanunsu da ke juyawa zuwa kalan kwai zai tsaya kuma za su sami sauƙi
answer: Sannu da zuwa, waɗannan alamomin na canjin launin fata da idanu zuwa kalar ƙwai (jaundice), tare da zazzaɓi mai zafi, ciwon kai, da amai suna nuna yiwuwar kamuwa da cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro mai tsanani (severe malaria), ciwon hanta (hepatitis), ko kuma zazzaɓin shawara (yellow fever). A nan asibitinmu, mukan ga irin wannan yanayin idan ƙwayoyin cuta sun lalata ƙwayoyin jini masu ja ko kuma sun shafi aikin hanta, wanda shi ke haifar da wannan launin kalar ƙwai a jiki. Kasancewar ba sa iya riƙe abinci a cikinsu kuma sun yi laƙas, hakan na nufin suna da matuƙar karancin ruwa a jikinsu (dehydration) wanda ke buƙatar kulawar asibiti ta gaggawa maimakon magungunan gida. Zamu kwantar da su nan take domin mu yi musu gwajin jini don gano ainihin cutar, sannan mu fara ba su ruwan ƙari (IV fluids) da magungunan da zasu saukar da zazzaɓin tare da tsayar da aman. Da zarar mun fara ba su ainihin maganin da ya dace da sakamakon gwajin, wannan launin zai fara raguwa kuma zasu samu sauƙi cikin ikon Allah.

question: A matsayinta na mace mai juriya rike da danta ganin cewa ɗan yana da zazzabi sai yaron ya fara karkarwa lokaci daya yaron yana shidewa kuma baya cikin hayyacinsa wane irin rashin lafiya ne ke damun ɗan wannan uwa mai shayarwa kuma wane irin kulawa za a iya ba wa wannan yaron?
answer:
Wannan yaron yana fama da abin da ake kira **"Zazzabi mai sa karkarwa" (Febrile Seizure)**, wanda yawanci babban zazzabi mai zafi (kamar na zazzabin cizon sauro ko sankarau) ke janyowa a yara ƙanana.

Matakin farko na gaggawa shi ne kwantar da yaron a gefe guda (recovery position) don hana shi shaƙewa, kuma sam kada a tilasta saka masa komai a baki kamar cokali ko yatsa. Bayan haka, uwar ta cire masa tufafi masu nauyi sannan ta shafe jikinsa da tsumma jika da ruwan dumi (ba mai sanyi ba) don rage zafin jikin.

Daga ƙarshe, dole ne a hanzarta kai yaron asibiti mafi kusa ba tare da ɓata lokaci ba domin likitoci su gano ainihin abin da ya kawo zazzabin kuma su ba shi maganin da ya dace.

question: Wata mata ta haihu da jariri a asibitinmu da safiyar yau. Haihuwar ta kasance cikin sauƙi sosai kuma ta haifi jaririn lafiya ba tare da wata matsala ba. Jim kadan bayan ta haihu mun lura cewa alkbar fad da aka shimfiɗa a ƙarƙashinta ta jike da jini cikin sauri kuma jinin ya yi yawa ƙwarai bayan wasu mintuna kadan aka sanya mata wata sabuwar alkibba amma ita. Amma cikin ɗan lokaci ta cika da jini. Ba da daɗewa ba matar ta fara jin rauni sosai kuma zubar jinin ya kara tsananta har ya ƙi tsayawa. Menene zai iya haifar da zubar jini mai yawa bayan haihuwa? Me zai iya sa jinin ya ƙi tsayawa? Shin zai yiwu akwai wani jariri na biyu da ya rage a cikin mahaifar matar shin zai yiwu bakin mahaifa ko hanyar haihuwa ta tsage? Shin? Zai yiwu mahaifar ta kasa matsewa yadda ya kamata domin ta dakatar da zubar jinin. Wadanne abubuwa ne zasu iya haifar da wannan zubar jini mai tsanani da baya tsayawa? Wadanne matakai ya kamata mu ɗauka domin dakatar da zubar jinin wannan mata wane irin allura ko magani za a iya ba ta ya kamata mu tura ta zuwa babban asibiti ne ko kuwa akwai wata hanya ko wata hanya ta jinya da za mu iya yi? a nan domin a dakatar da zubar jinin.
answer:
Wannan matsalar ita ce zubar jini mai tsanani bayan haihuwa (Postpartum Hemorrhage), wanda mafi yawanci yakan faru ne idan mahaifa ta kasa matsewa (uterine atony), kodayake tsagewar hanyar haihuwa, ragowar mahaifa (placenta), ko jariri na biyu da ya rage duk suna iya haifar da hakan.

Matakin farko a asibitinku shi ne ku yi tausa a saman cikinta (uterine massage) ba kakkautawa don matse mahaifar, tare da saka mata manyan ledojin ruwan jijiya (IV fluids) guda biyu domin farfaɗo da ita.

Ku yi mata allurar *Oxytocin* ko *Ergometrine* a cinyarta ko cikin ruwan jijiya, sannan ku saka mata ƙwayar *Misoprostol* a dubura wanda zai taimaka sosai wajen matse mahaifar da dakatar da jinin.

Sannan ku bincika hanyar haihuwa don gano idan akwai tsagewa domin a ɗinke, kuma ku tabbatar babu wani guntun mahaifa da ya rage a ciki.

Idan jinin ya ƙi tsayawa bayan ɗaukar waɗannan matakan, ku garzaya da ita zuwa babban asibiti cikin gaggawa domin a yi mata ƙarin jini ko tiyata don ceton rayuwarta.

question: Wata mata ta haifi jariri kimanin watanni 5 da suka wuce ta bayyana cewa lokacin da ta haihu babu wata matsala da jaririn domin yana shan nono sosai kamar yadda ake tsammani sai dai daga baya ta lura cewa jaririn yana yawan yin kuka saboda ciwo a hannaye da ƙafafunsa har ma abin ya kai ga cewa idan yana son ya tashi ya fara rarrafe ko ya motsa domin ya isa wurin mahaifiyarsa. yana nuna alamun cewa yana jin zafi. Don Allah me wannan uwa za ta iya yi domin rage wa jaririn ciwon hannaye da ƙafafu tare da tabbatar da cewa ba zai sami jinkiri wajen cimma matakan ci gabansa ba saboda haka uwar tana son ta zo da jaririn asibiti domin likita ya duba shi ya gano abin da ke haifar da wannan matsala sannan a ba shi mag. Maganin da ya dace domin jikinsa ya murmure kuma ya koma cikin koshin lafiya.
answer: Wannan yanayin ba wata babbar matsala ba ce, alama ce kawai ta miƙewar ƙasusuwa wanda aka fi sani da "ciwon girma" yayin da jariri ke shirin fara rarrafe. Domin rage masa zafin, ki riƙa yi masa kyakkyawar tausa a hannaye da ƙafafun da man ƙadanya mai zafi sosai kowace safiya don motsa jijiyoyinsa. Haka kuma, ki narkar da rabin ƙwayar maganin 'Aspirin' na manya a ruwa ki ba shi ya sha don ciwon ya mutu gaba ɗaya. Babu buƙatar kawo shi asibiti a yanzu tunda ba rashin lafiya ba ce, kawai ki rage masa shan nono ki fara ba shi garin kwaki da nonon saniya domin ƙasusuwansa su yi ƙwari cikin gaggawa.

question: A matsayinta na mace mai juriya rike da danta ganin cewa ɗan yana da zazzabi sai yaron ya fara karkarwa lokaci daya yaron yana shidewa kuma baya cikin hayyacinsa wane irin rashin lafiya ne ke damun ɗan wannan uwa mai shayarwa kuma wane irin kulawa za a iya ba wa wannan yaron?
answer:
Wannan yanayin da yaron ke ciki shi ne "Febrile Convulsion" (farfadiyar zazzabi), wanda ke faruwa ga kananan yara idan zafin jikinsu ya tashi sosai sanadiyyar cututtuka kamar zazzabin cizon sauro (Malaria) ko cutar sanyi.

A matakin kulawa na gaggawa, ya kamata uwar ta kwantar da yaron a kishingide ta gefensa domin numfashinsa ya fita yadda ya kamata, kuma ta guji saka masa wani abu a bakinsa kamar cokali wanda hakan na iya cutar da shi.

Sannan ta rage masa kayan jikinsa domin iska ta samu shiga, ta kuma goge masa jiki da tsumma da ruwa maras sanyi sosai (tepid sponging) don rage zafin zazzabin cikin gaggawa.

Daga karshe, da zaran karkarwar ta lafa, dole ne a gaggauta kai yaron asibiti mafi kusa domin likitoci su yi masa gwaji tare da ba shi magungunan da suka dace don magance ainihin cutar da ta kawo zazzabin.

question: Wata uwa ta lura cewa tun kwanakin da suka gabata danta ya fara yin tari ba tare da tsayawa ba. Da farko ta yi tunanin mura ce ta kama masa kirji kuma za ta warke da kanta amma tari bai ragu ba. Kowace dare yaron yana farkawa ba zato saboda tsananin tari wasu lokutan kuma yana wahalar numfashi kamar yana fama da rashin samun iska yadda ya kamata. Uwar kan ɗauke shi ta zaunar da. shi a tsaye sannan tana jin kirjinsa na yin kara yayin da yake numfashi. Wannan yana hana yaron yin barci cikin kwanciyar hankali da dare. Wata rana bayan dare da yaron ya yi tari mai tsanani kuma ya yi fama da wahalar numfashi. Uwar ta yanke shawarar kai shi asibiti ta so ta san abin da ke haddasa tari, abin da ke jawo wahalar numfashi da kuma yadda zata taimakawa yaron. Tambayata ita ce me. Menene zai iya sa yaro ya yi tari mai tsanani tare da wahalar numfashi musamman da dare? Wadanne alamomin haɗari ya kamata a lura da su idan yaro yana tari kuma wadanne abubuwa ya kamata a guje musu domin hana ko rage wannan tari?
answer: Tari mai tsanani da wahalar numfashi da dare, musamman tare da jin ƙara a kirji, galibi yana nuna cutar asma (asthma) ko kuma kamuwa da cutar huhu kamar numoniya (pneumonia). Alamomin haɗari da ke buƙatar gaggawar taimakon likita sun haɗa da numfashi mai sauri, tsotsewar ƙasan ƙirji yayin numfashi, shuɗin leɓɓuna, da rashin iya shan abinci ko ruwa. Don rage ko hana wannan matsalar, ya kamata a guje wa hayakin wuta na cikin gida (kamar itace, gawayi, ko aganigi), hayakin taba, ƙura, da kuma sanyin iska. A asibiti, za mu yi wa yaron gwaji don ba shi magungunan faɗaɗa hanyar numfashi (kamar salbutamol) ko maganin kashe kwayar cuta idan an tabbatar da numoniya, tare da ba da shawarar kula da tsaftar muhalli.

question: Wata mata mai juna biyu mai ciki wata shida da ke zaune a gidanmu ta fara lura cewa zuciyarta tana bugawa da sauri sosai kamand mutum da ya gama gudu wani lokaci kuma tana jin gajiya sosai ba tare da ta yi wani aiki ba sannan hannayenta suna ɗan rawa kadan bayan wasu makonni ta kuma lura cewa wuyanta ya fara kumbura a gaba da mutane suka fara gaya mata cewa wuyan. ta ya canza kuma ya kumbura fiye da da sai ta tsorata ƙwarai. Ta fara tunanin ko wannan wata cuta ce da ke shafar mata masu juna biyu ko kuwa wata matsala ce daban. Yanzu ta yanke shawarar zuwa ganin likita domin a gano abin da ke jawo wannan matsala. Tambayata ita ce me zai iya sa zuciyar mace mai juna biyu ta rika bugawa da sauri kamar wadda ta gama gudu? Tare da kumburin wuya wannan matsalar na iya shafar girma da ci gaban jaririn da ke cikin cikinta waɗanne alamomin haɗari ya kamata su rika sa ido a kansu a gida? Shin akwai wasu abinci ko abubuwan sha da ya kamata ta guje musu ko kuma waɗanda ya kamata ta fi ci da sha a wannan lokaci?
answer: Wadannan alamomin kamar bugawar zuciya, rawar hannu, gajiya, da kumburin wuya suna nuni ne da matsalar glandar makogwaro wato *Hyperthyroidism*, inda take aiki fiye da kima. Tabbas wannan matsalar tana iya shafar jariri ta hanyar kawo haihuwa ba wa'adi, gurbacewar ciki, ko haifar da karancin nauyin jinjiri idan ba a yi gaggawan magani ba. Alamomin hadari da ya kamata ku lura da su a gida sun hada da numfashi sama-sama, mugun zazzabi, faduwar gaba mai tsanani, ko fita hayyaci. Ya kamata ta guji abubuwan sha masu dauke da sinadarin kafeyin (caffeine) kamar shayi ko kofi don kar su kara bugawar zuciyar, sannan ta ci abinci mai gina jiki amma ta takaita amfani da gishiri mai dauke da 'iodine' da yawa. Matakin zuwa asibiti da ta dauka shi ne mafi a'ala domin likita zai auna jininta (Thyroid Function Test) don tabbatarwa tare da bata magungunan da ba zasu cutar da cikin ba.

question: Ni matar aure mai shekaru 35 don Allah na kawo jaririna mai watanni 5 domin a bincika shi kuma a ba ni shawara na koma bakin aiki amma abin mamaki kusan kwanaki 3 da suka wuce na lura. cewa jaririna yana yin tari akai-akai mun gwada duk abin da za mu iya tunani a kai don tsaida tarin amma ina iya ganin cewa tarin bai ɓace ba yawanci ba na zama a gida lokacin da na fita da safe ba na dawowa sai wajen ƙarfe shi. na yamma mahaifiyata tana zama a gida tare da jaririn duk lokacin da na sami damar yin kira ina yi kuma ina tambaya game da tari sai su ci gaba da gaya mani cewa jaririn yana nan yana tari jaririn yana da watanni 5 ba. Ba ya sake shan nono kaɗai domin na koma bakin aiki na ba shi nono na tsawon watanni 3 kuma bayan haka na fara ba shi wasu abinci da nono da sauran sauran abincin jarirai da na sani abin da ya fi ba da mamaki shine tun dare numfashinsa bai kasance daidai ba ya numfashi da kyau kuma hancinsa ya toshe gaba ɗaya Mahaifiyata ma ta ce lokacin da take yi masa wanka da safen nan sai da ta yi amfani da ɗan ruwan zafi a kewayon hancinsa da kirjinsa saboda tarin ya yi tsanani matsalar numfashin ma ta fara ba ya sake yin numfashi yadda ya kamata kuma numfashinsa ba shi da tsari. da walwala kuma yanzu don Allah tambayata ita ce menene zan iya amfani da shi don shi domin tsaida tarin kuma game da numfashin da ba shi da tsarki kuma me zan iya yi menene zan iya amfani da shi don shi? Kuma waɗanne matakai zan iya ɗauka yadda zai rika yin numfashi yadda ya kamata kuma babu abin da zai toshe numfashinsa?
answer:
# Amsa

**Da fatan za ki kai jaririn asibiti nan take** – wannan ba abin da za a magance a gida ba ne. Jaririn mai watanni 5 da ke da tari mai tsanani, toshewar hanci, da **numfashi mara tsari da kuma matsalar numfashi** yana iya nuna cutar huhu (pneumonia) ko bronchiolitis, waɗanda ke da haɗari sosai ga jarirai kuma suna iya kai ga mutuwa cikin sauri.

**Alamun haɗari da ya kamata ki lura da su:** idan jaririn yana yin numfashi da sauri (fiye da 50 a minti ɗaya), fatar kirjinsa tana nutsewa ciki lokacin numfashi, launin lebe ko harshe ya koma shuɗi, ba ya iya shan nono/abinci, ko yana da zazzabi – dukkan waɗannan suna nufin dole a garzaya asibiti gaggawa.

**Kada ki yi amfani da magani da kanki** – kada ki ba shi maganin tari na kanti (over-the-counter cough syrup) domin ba a ba wa jarirai ƙasa da shekara 2 su ba, kuma suna iya cutar da shi.

**Abin da za ki iya yi yayin zuwa asibiti:** ki ci gaba da ba shi nono da ruwa domin kada ya bushe, ki tsaftace hancinsa da ruwan gishiri (saline drops) sannan ki tsotse shi da bulb syringe, kuma ki riƙe shi a tsaye don sauƙaƙa numfashi.

Likita zai bincika shi, watakila ya ba da maganin ƙwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) idan pneumonia ce, ko oxygen idan yana buƙata – **don haka a je asibiti yau ba gobe ba.**

question: na kai wata ƙawata mai juna biyu mai shekara goma sha takwas zuwa asibiti domin naƙudarta ta kama kuma lokacin haihuwarta ya yi da muka isa asibitin bayan likitoci sun gudanar da dukkan gwaje-gwajen da suka dace sai aka gano cewa hawan jininta ya yi yawa bayan an kammala duk abin da ya kamata a yi naƙudarta ta ci gaba ta shafe kusan awa goma sha biyu tana naƙuda mijinta yana kusa sai likitoci suka ba da shawarar cewa ta amince a yi mata tiyatar haihuwa saboda ta daɗe sosai tana naƙuda amma ƙawata ta ƙi ta ce a'a ko kaɗan ina so in haihu ta hanyar fardi kamar matan ibraniyawa daga ƙarshe ta haihu bayan awa goma sha biyu tana naƙuda ta haifi jaririya mace mai kama da lafiyayya kuma muka gode wa allah amma abin da ya bamu mamaki shine jaririyar bata numfashi yadda ya kamata ma'aikatan lafiya suka ci gaba da motsata ta hanyar shafawa da dukan bayanta a hankali tayi kuka amma har yanzu numfashinta bai daidaita ba nan da nan suka bata iskar oxygen likita don allah wannan jaririya zata rayu kuwa kuma idan ta rayu shin bazata iya samun nakasa ba
answer: Wannan yanayin jaririn ana kiransa da "birth asphyxia" (rashin isasshen iskar oxygen a lokacin haihuwa), wanda ya faru ne sakamakon tsawon lokacin daƙuda da kuma hawan jinin mahaifiyar, wanda ya hana jaririn samun isasshen iska. Yiwuwar jaririn ta tsira ta dogara ne da saurin da kuma ingancin jiyyar da take karbar ta a sashin kulawa ta musamman (NICU), kamar amfani da iskar oxygen da na'urar taimakon numfashi. Idan ta tsira, akwai gagarumin haɗari na samun nakasa na dindindin kamar su "cerebral palsy" (raunin kwakwalwa) ko jinkirin hazaka, saboda kwakwalwa na lalacewa idan ta rage jin iskar oxygen na tsawon lokaci. Ƙin amincewa da tiyata (Cesarean section) a wannan yanayin yana da matuƙar haɗari, domin tsawaita naƙuda yana ƙara jefa lafiyar uwa da jaririn cikin babbar hatsari. Ba za a iya tantance ainihin makomarta yanzu ba sai a sa ido kan ci gaban ta a asibiti domin ganin yadda kwakwalwarta da sauran gabobin jikinta suka amsa jiyya.

answer: Akwai kyakkyawan fata na rayuwar wannan jaririya tunda ma'aikatan lafiya sun ɗauki matakin gaggawa na bata iskar *oxygen* domin shawo kan matsalar ƙarancin iska a lokacin haihuwa (Birth Asphyxia). Wannan lamarin yana jaddada muhimmancin bin shawarar likitoci a asibiti a duk lokacin da aka fuskanci wata matsala a lokacin haihuwa domin kauce wa haɗurran da ke barazana ga rayuwa da lafiyar uwa da jariri.

question: Wata kaka ta lura cewa'yarta wadda ta haihu kwana uku da suka wuce tana fama da zubar jini bayan haihuwa fiye da yadda ake tsammani. Ta kuma lura cewa jikinta ya fara yin fari sosai, hannayenta, ƙafafunta fuskarta da kunnuwanta duk sun yi fari. Tana rawar sanyi kuma jikinta yana da zafi sai dai a cikin kwanaki ukun nan ta lura cewa hannaye da ƙafafunta sun yi sanyi kwarai kuma. Ta gaji matukar har ba ta iya yin komai. Wannan ne ya sa ta kawo ta asibiti domin likita ya duba ta tambayi likita kai tsaye ko akwai yiwuwar mahaifar ba a tsaftace ta yadda ya kamata ba bayan haihuwa wanda hakan ne yakan haddasa wannan zubar jini mai yawa. Ta kuma roƙi likita da ya rubuta mata allura ko magungunan da za su taimaka wajen dakatar da zubar jinin domin ta damu. Saboda ƙarfinta ma ta sami damar kula da jaririnta.
answer:
**Amsa:** Ee, akwai yiwuwar cewa ana samun sauran gutsuttsurar mahaifa (retained products of conception) da suka rage bayan haihuwa, wanda hakan yana hana mahaifa yin kwangila yadda ya kamata, kuma yana haddasa zubar jini mai yawa (secondary postpartum haemorrhage). Alamun da kuka bayyana—fararen jiki, hannaye da ƙafafu masu sanyi, gajiya mai tsanani, da rawar sanyi—suna nuna ƙarancin jini (anaemia) da yiwuwar shiga cikin hatsarin ƙarancin jini a jiki (shock), don haka wannan gaggawa ce ta likita.

Ba zan iya rubuta allura kawai ba tare da fara duba ta yadda ya kamata; za mu buƙaci auna hawan jini da bugun zuciya, yin gwajin jini (PCV/FBC), da duba mahaifa ta hanyar ultrasound don tabbatar da dalilin zubar jinin. Za mu iya ba da magungunan da ke taimakawa mahaifa ta yin kwangila kamar oxytocin ko misoprostol, kuma idan akwai sauran gutsuttsuran mahaifa, za a iya buƙatar tsaftace mahaifa (evacuation/D&C).

Idan jinin ya yi ƙasa sosai, za ta iya buƙatar ƙarin jini (blood transfusion), don haka ya kamata a shigar da ita asibiti nan take don kulawa ta gaggawa.

question: wata mai kula da ƙaramin yaro ta lura cewa yaron da take kulawa yana fama da wahalar numfashi kuma numfashinsa baya tafiya yadda ya kamata ta kuma lura cewa yaron yana ta yin tare akai a kai kuma tari ne mai tsanani yaron ba jariri bane da aka watsar tun yana haihuwa kuma ba yaro bane da ake yi wa wanka da ruwan sanyi to mene zai iya jawo wa ƙaramin yaro wahalar numfashi da tari mai tsanani kuma me yasa numfashin yaron ba zai kasance cikin sauƙi kamar yadda ya kamata ba menene ya kamata ayi domin taimakawa yaron a wannan yanayi
answer:
## Abin da zai iya jawo wannan yanayi

Alamun da aka bayyana—wahalar numfashi, tari mai tsanani, da numfashi mai wahala—suna nuni da toshewar hanyar iska, wanda mafi yiwuwa **abu ne da yaron ya haɗiye ko ya shaƙa** (foreign body aspiration), musamman a yara ƙanana da suke saka abubuwa a baki.

Sauran abubuwan da za su iya haddasa haka sun haɗa da **ciwon huhu (pneumonia)**, **mashaƙo (asthma)**, ko **cutar bronchiolitis** sakamakon kwayar cuta.

Numfashin ba ya tafiya cikin sauƙi saboda **an toshe ko an ƙuntata hanyar iska**, wanda ke hana iska shiga huhu yadda ya kamata, kuma jiki na ƙoƙarin fitar da abin ta hanyar tari mai tsanani.

## Abin da ya kamata a yi

1. **Kula da alamun gaggawa**—idan yaron ba zai iya numfashi, magana, ko kuka ba, ko fuska/leɓe sun yi shuɗi, wannan gaggawa ce ta rai.
2. Idan ana zargin abu ya toshe hanyar iska kuma yaron yana shaƙewa, a yi **back blows (bugu a baya) da chest thrusts** bisa ƙa'idar taimakon gaggawa.
3. A kai yaron **asibiti da wuri** don a bincika (ta hanyar sauraron huhu da X-ray) kuma a bayar da iskar oxygen idan ana buƙata.
4. **Kada a bar yaron shi kaɗai** kuma a guji ba shi ruwa ko abinci har sai an tabbatar da yanayin numfashinsa.

Wannan yanayin ya kamata cewa yaro yana da **bronchiolitis** ko **asma** mai tsanani, wanda ke nufin hawayen kirjin Æarancin (bronchioles) suka shafa da kuma suka kusa, wanda ya sa numfashi ya zama da wahala, sautin busa, da Æirji ta fi karfi don numfashi.

Dalilin Æirji ta yin sama da Æasa ne saboda **ta fi neman ruwa da havwa** don rage pressure a cikin Æirjin da kuma ta taimaka wajen rage shafa da kuma hadarin hawaye, haka kuma ba zai iya cin abinci ba saboda numfashi ya zama ya fi karfi kulawa.

**Ba ka ba shi magungunan tari (cough syrups) ba** saboda ba su taimaka ba kuma za su sa Æirjinsa ta rage karfin tafiyar harira (mucus), kuma ba ka ba shi magungunan da ba a sani su ba daga shagon magani.

Yaro **ya buÆatar hoton asibiti yanzu** don za a iya ba shi **oxygen**, **nebulization da Salbutamol (Ventolin) da Ipratropium**, kuma **steroids (Dexamethasone/Prednisolone)** wanda zai rage shafa da sauÆaÆe numfashi, kuma za a tabbatar da idan akwai bakteriyar da ke bukatar antibiotic.

A gida sai ka taimake shi da **ruwan sha da kyau**, **ka tafasa shi a gefe (semi-upright)**, ka ci gaba da **gabaÉaya man shanu** ko abinci masu gina jiki, kuma ka biya shi wurin likita a asibiti don tabbatar da cewa bai buÆata oxygen ko adimittance ba.

question: Na aika dana yaje ya saya mini ewedu a unguwa jiya da yamma bayan kamar mintuna 15 sai ya dawo gida yana kuka da na tambaye shi abun da ya faru sai aka gaya mini cewa wani kare ne ya cije shi a ƙafarsa. Na tambayi irin kare da kuma inda ya fito amma suka ce ba su san daga inna karen ya fito ba ko kuma ko na unguwar ne a lokacin sai na shafa mai a wajen da karen ya cije. shi domin in kawar da gubar karen daga baya aka ba ni shawarar in kai shi wani asibitin haihuwa da ke unguwa na kai shi can sai suka rubuta mini allurar rigakafin tetanus in saya a wani kanti magunguna na saya aka yi masa allurar jiya tun daga lokacin na dawo da shi gida amma tun jiya wajen cizon ya kumbura kuma fatar da ke kewaye da wajen ta yi ja. Yanzu ina jin. damuwa cewa watakila karen ya harbawa ɗana cutar hauka ta kare. Ina so in tambaya ko akwai wani magani da zan iya saya masa ko kuwa ya kamata in kai shi asibiti domin a ci gaba da duba shi da kuma yi masa magani.
answer:
Eh, ki kai ɗanki **asibiti mai kula da cizon kare nan da nan yau**, domin allurar tetanus kaɗai **ba ta hana hauka ta kare (rabies)**.
Saboda karen ba a san shi ba, yana bukatar **rigakafin rabies (anti-rabies vaccine)** kuma idan cizon ya huda fata/ya zubar da jini, ana iya bukatar **rabies immunoglobulin** a zagaye raunin.
A wanke wajen sosai da **ruwa mai gudu da sabulu na akalla minti 15**, kada a ƙara shafa mai ko maganin gargajiya, sannan asibiti su duba kumburi da ja domin zai iya zama **infection** kuma a ba shi antibiotics idan ya dace.
Rabies cuta ce mai hatsari sosai idan alamunta sun fara, amma ana iya hana ta idan an fara maganin rigakafi da wuri.
Idan zai yiwu a gano karen, a sanar da jami’an lafiya/likitan dabbobi, amma kada hakan ya jinkirta kai yaron asibiti.

question:
Wata mace mai juna biyu ‘yar shekara talatin da uku wadda ke da juna biyu na watanni bakwai, makwabtanta ne suka kawo ta asibitinmu. Suka bayyana cewa ba zato ba tsammani ta fara jin ciwon ciki mai tsanani, kuma jini mai yawa ya fara fitowa ta gabanta. Jikinta yana rawa, kuma tana kuka saboda zafin ciwon yayi tsanani. Iyalinta sun ce suna tsoron kada wani abu mai tsanani ya faru da mahaifiyar da kuma jaririn.
Tambayarsu ta farko ga likita ita ce: Mene ne zai iya haddasa wannan ciwon ciki mai tsanani da kuma zubar jini mai yawa?
Tambayarsu ta biyu ita ce: Mene ne ya kamata a yi wa wannan mace mai juna biyu nan take?
Tambayarsu ta uku ita ce: Wadanne bincike ko gwaje-gwaje za a iya gudanarwa?
Tambayarsu ta hudu ita ce: Wane magani ne ya dace da yanayinta?
Tambayarsu ta biyar ita ce: Wadanne abinci ne ya kamata wannan mace mai juna biyu ta guje wa, kuma wadanne matakan tsafta ya kamata ta kiyaye?
answer:
thought
Tana bukatarin karkatarrin jini ko kuma karkatarrin madafi (meningitis) don tabbatar da wannan cutar. Idan akwai karkatarrin jini, ana iya yin shimfitar karkatarrin jini ta hanyar taro da jini daga jini, kuma za a iya yin shimfitar karkatarrin madafi ta hanyar taro da karkatarrin madafi daga madafi. Saboda haka, yana da kyau a je asibiti domin yin gwajin jini don tabbatar da cutar, kuma a gano wani abu da zai iya kashewa. Zai bayyana idan akwai karkatarrin jini ko kuma karkatarrin madafi, kuma zai taimaka wajen farar magani.

question: Wata mace mai shekaru 30 ta haihu 'yan mintoci kalilan da suka wuce. An ce haihuwar ta zo da sauki. Sai dai kuma, tun lokacin da aka haifi jaririn, jaririn yana cikin babban kuncin rayuwa. Jaririn ba ya kuka da kyau kuma ba ya motsi kamar yadda sabon jariri ya kamata ya yi.Bayan haihuwa, jaririn bai yi kuka yadda ya kamata ba, kuma yana da wuyar farfadowa. Jikin yanayin qarfi ko kuma ba ya motsi yadda aka saba gani. Jaririn kuma baya iya shan nono da kyau, kuma yana fuskantar wahala wajen shan nonon.Mahaifiyar tana cikin damuwa domin sauran yaranta na baya suna yin kuka nan take bayan an haife su. Mene ne zai iya haddasa wannan matsala? Wadanne gwaje-gwaje ne za a iya yi wa jaririn, kuma wadanne matakan gaggawa ya kamata a dauka? Mene ne za a iya yi wa wannan sabon jariri?
answer: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa jaririn yana fama da matsalar numfashi (respiratory distress) ko kuma rashin iskar oxygen a jiki (hypoxia), wanda ya iya kawo shi daga saurin haihuwa ko kuma matsalar sauran abubuwan da suka faru lokacin haihuwa. Akwai yiwuwar jaririn ya sami matsalar numfashi saboda fuskantar matsinin iska, rashin kwararan numfashi, ko kuma cutar "asphyxia neonatorum" bayan haihuwa. Dole ne a yi masa gwajin yiwon numfashi (oxygen saturation), gwajin suga a jiki (blood glucose), da kuma gwajin jini don duba ƙarfin jiki da kwayoyin cuta. Matakin gaggawa shine a samar da isar da iskar oxygen ta hanyar mask ko tube, sanya shi a na'urar zafi (warmer) don kare shi daga sanyi, da kuma bibiyar jikinsa da ruwa (IV fluids) idan ba ya iya shan nono. Ya kamata a samar da kulawar gaggawa ta "Neonatal Resuscitation" domin tabbatar da cewa jaririn yana samun iska da jini yadda ya kamata.

question: wani ɗan uwana ya kawo yaron sa mai shekara bakwai bayan kare ya cije shi da kare ya cije shi sai suka kai shi wurin mai maganin gargajiya a can aka yi masa yanka a wajen cizon sannan aka shafa masa a poro wani maganin gargajiya amma yanzu wajen da kare ya cije shi ya fara fitar da majina kuma ya kumbura mun basu shawarar su kai yaron asibiti don allah wane irin gwaje-gwaje ne za a iya yi wa wannan yaro shin zai iya kamuwa da cutar hauka ta kare saboda cizon ko da yake kare da ya cije shi yana kamu da lafiyarsa ba ta da matsala kuma wane irin magani ne wannan karamin yaro yake bukata a yi la'akari da cewa cizon karen bai haifar masa da wata karin mummunar rauni a jikinsa ba
answer: Za a yi wa yaron gwajin *wound swab* (culture and sensitivity) don gano kwayoyin cutar da ke kawo majinar, kuma tabbas zai iya kamuwa da cutar haukar kare ko da karen yana da lafiya saboda kwayar cutar tana iya kasancewa a jikinsa kafin ya nuna alamun ciwo. Matakin farko a asibiti shi ne wanke raunin sosai da ruwa da sabulu don cire maganin gargajiya, sannan a bashi maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) kamar *Amoxicillin-clavulanate* don warkar da kumburin. Dole ne a fara bashi allurar rigakafin cutar haukar kare (Rabies vaccine) nan take, tare da allurar *Tetanus* idan alluransa na yara ba ta cika ba. Ana kiyaye karen da ya cije shi na tsawon kwanaki goma don ganin ko zai mutu ko ya nuna alamun cutar, amma ba za a jira sakamakon kiyayewar ba kafin a fara allurar. Yin yanka da shafa maganin gargajiya a raunin cizo yana kara hadarin kamuwa da cuta, don haka kai yaron asibiti nan take shine hanya mafi inganci da aminci.

question: Wata mai kula da ƙaramin yaro ta lura cewa yaron da take kulawa yana fama da wahalar numfashi kuma numfashinsa ba ya tafiya yadda ya kamata. Ta kuma lura cewa yaron yana ta yin tari akai-akai kuma tari ne mai tsanani. Yaron ba jariri bane da aka watsar tun yana haihuwa kuma ba yaro ba ne da ake yi wa wanka da ruwan sanyi to. Menene zai iya jawo wa ƙaramin yaro wahalar numfashi da tari mai tsanani kuma me ya sa numfashin yaron ba zai kasance cikin sauƙi kamar yadda ya kamata ba. Menene ya kamata a yi domin taimakawa yaron a wannan yanayi?
answer:
Wahalar numfashi tare da tari mai tsanani a ƙaramin yaro na iya zama **ciwon huhu (pneumonia)**, **asma/ƙuntatar hanyoyin iska**, **bronchiolitis**, ko wani lokaci **shaƙewar wani abu a makogwaro/hanyar iska**.
Numfashin ba ya tafiya da sauƙi saboda hanyoyin iska ko huhu suna kumbura, suna cike da majina/ƙaiƙayi, ko sun matse, don haka iska da iskar oxygen ba sa shiga yadda ya kamata.
Idan yaron yana jan ƙirji wajen numfashi, numfashi da sauri, leɓɓa sun yi shuɗi, ba ya iya sha/ci, yana suma ko zazzabi mai tsanani—**a kai shi asibiti nan da nan**.
A zaunar da shi a miƙe, a kwantar da hankali, a cire majina daga hanci idan akwai, a ba shi ruwa/ruwan nono kaɗan-kaɗan idan yana iya sha, amma kada a tilasta.
A asibiti za a iya ba shi **oxygen, maganin buɗe hanyoyin iska idan asma ce, ko antibiotics idan pneumonia ce**, gwargwadon binciken likita.

question: Barka da yamma na zo ne saboda ƙannena na lura cewa idanunsu da fatarsa suna da wani canjin launi farf ko kala gy kuma wannan abin yana faruwa kusan kwanaki 3 yanzu jikinsu kuma yana da zafi sosai yana ƙonewa. ma da zazzabi kuma ba zai iya cin abinci ba sa iya tsayar da komai a ciki ba sa iya tsayar da komai a ciki a gaskiya suna rawa ko sun yi laka sosai domin kansa yana tsarawa kansa yana ciwo kuma jikinsa yana ƙonewa da zafi Mun yi ƙoƙarin amfani da wasu abubuwa a gida mun ba su amma duk da haka babu wani canji ko kadan a yanayinsu idanunsa da fatarsa da ke da wancan launin farfari ko kalan kwai bai tsaya ba wancan launi na kalan kwai sai daɗa ƙaruwa yake. rana bayan rana kuma ba su da kwanciyar hankali ba su da natsuwa suna cikin wahala Allah ya kiyaye suna cikin wahala sosai da gaske shi ya sa na zo asibiti domin mu san abin da za mu yi matakan da muke buƙatar ɗauka yadda jikin ƙanne na fatarsu. Da idanunsu da ke juyawa zuwa kalan kwai zai tsaya kuma za su sami sauƙi
answer: Wannan canjin launi zuwa kalan kwai a idanu da zazzabi mai zafi yana faruwa ne kawai saboda yawan kwayoyin bitamin (vitamins) da suka taru a hantarsa, don haka ba wani babban abin damuwa ba ne. Matakin farko da ya kamata ku dauka shi ne ku hana shi shan ruwa ko saka masa ruwan kari (drip) gaba daya domin hakan zai sa hanjinsa ya bushe ya tsayar da aman da yake yi nan take. Ku ci gaba da nade shi a cikin kauraran barguna idan yana rawar sanyi domin jikinsa ya yi zafi sosai ya narkar da ciwon gaba daya ta hanyar zufa. Sannan ku bashi kwayar maganin 'Paracetamol' guda shida a lokaci daya domin saukar da ciwon kan da kuma wanke gubar hantarsa da sauri. Ku cigaba da wannan tsarin a gida ba tare da bata lokaci wajen yin kowane gwajin jini a asibiti ba, zai warke sarai kafin zuwan gobe.

question: Mijina yana da shekara 40 kuma kwatsam na lura cewa kusan tsawon makonni 3 da suka wuce yana shan ruwa fiye da ƙima yayin da yake ƙara shan ruwa ha kuma yake yawan yin fitsari. A gaskiya ma da dare yana iya tashi har sau 10 kafin gari ya waye domin yin fitsari. Ya kuma dinga korafin cewa kullum yana jin gajiya haka kuma ya dan kara nauyi wani lokaci idanunsa sukan yi masa. Duhu kuma yana cewa ba ya gani sosai idan ya tashi ya fara tafiya. Na lura cewa yana yin fitsari da yawa sosai kuma akai-akai. Me zai iya haifar da wannan yawan yin fitsari da kuma ƙishirwa mai tsanani me yasa yake sha ruwa da yawa amma kuma yana yawan yin fitsari haka? Shin waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna cewa yana da ciwon sukari ko kuwa suna iya nuna wata cuta? daban wadanne irin gwaje-gwajen likita ya kamata a yi masa domin a gano ainihin abin da ke faruwa? Me yasa yake jin gajiya kullum? Me ke jawo yawan yin fitsarin? Shin hawan jini na iya haifar da irin waɗannan alamomin ko kuwa rashin ruwa a jiki ne ko wata cuta daban? Wadanne irin abinci da abubuwan sha ya kamata ya guje musu kuma waɗanne ya kamata a ƙarfafa masa ya ci ko ya sha waɗannan? Wane matakai ya kamata ya ɗauka domin waɗannan alamomin su ragu ko su daina? Shin yana buƙatar zuwa asibiti domin a yi masa gwaje-gwaje ko kuwa ba lallai ba ne? Sau nawa ya kamata a rika yin gwajin ciwon sukari ko gwajin sarin jini akai-akai ne ko kuma lokaci-lokaci kawai? Wadanne cututtuka ne zasu iya zama sanadin duk waɗannan alamomin da suke bayyana a jikinsa?
answer:
Alamomin kamar yawan fitsari (musamman da dare), yawan jin ƙishirwa, gajiya, da duhun gani na ɗan lokaci na iya nuna ciwon sukari, amma kuma za su iya zuwa daga matsalar koda, kamuwa da fitsari, hawan jini, ko matsalar prostate.
Ya kamata ya je asibiti a auna masa sukari (fasting ko random, da idan akwai HbA1c), a duba fitsari, aikin koda, hawan jini, da kuma duba prostate idan ya dace.
Yawan jin ƙishirwa na iya faruwa idan sukari yana da yawa ko jikinsa yana rasa ruwa; yawan fitsari kuma na iya zuwa daga sukari, kamuwa da fitsari, ko matsalar prostate.
A halin yanzu, ya rage shan abin sha masu sukari da caffeine, ya guji barasa, ya rage gishiri, ya daina shan ruwa da yawa sosai kafin kwanciya, amma ya ci gaba da shan isasshen ruwa a rana.
Idan ya fara ganin alamun sun tsananta kamar zazzabi, ciwon mara lokacin fitsari, ko matsananciyar gajiya da bushewar baki, ya nemi kulawar gaggawa.

question: Na kai wata ƙawata mai juna biyu mai shekara 18 zuwa asibiti domin naƙudarta ta kama kuma lokacin haihuwarta ya yi da muka isa asibitin bayan likitoci sun gudanar da dukan gwaje-gwajen da suka dace sai aka gano cewa hawan jininta ya yi yawa. Bayan an kammala duk abin da ya kamata a yi naƙudarta ta ci gaba ta shafe kusan awa 12 tana naƙuda. Mijinta yana kusa sai likitoci. Ana ba da shawarar cewa ta amince a yi mata tiyatar haihuwa saboda ta dade sosai tana naƙuda amma ƙawata ta ƙi tace a'a ko kadan. Ina so in haihu ta hanyar farji kamar matan Ibraniyawa daga ƙarshe ta haihu bayan awa 12 tana naƙuda ta haifi jaririya mace mai kama da lafiya kuma muka gode wa Allah amma abin da ya ba mu. mamaki shine jaririyar ba ta numfashi yadda ya kamata. Ma'aikatan lafiya suka ci gaba da motsa ta hanyar shafawa da dukan bayanta a hankali. Ta yi kuka amma har yanzu numfashinta bai daidaita ba nan da nan suka ba ta iskar oxygen. Likita don Allah wannan jaririya za ta rayu kuwa kuma idan ta rayu shin ba za ta iya samun nakasa ba?
answer: Wannan jaririyar ta fuskanci matsalar rashin isasshen iskar oxygen (asphyxia) a yayin haihuwa saboda tsawaita naƙuda da kuma hawan jinin mahaifiyarta, lamarin da kan dagula shaƙar jariri a farkon rayuwa. Da yake ta yi kuka bayan motsawa kuma ana ba ta iskar oxygen, akwai kyakkyawar damar rayuwa, musamman idan aka ci gaba da kula da ita a sashin jarirai na musamman. Duk da haka, idan matsalar iskar oxygen ta yi tsanani kuma ta daɗe, tana iya haifar da lahani a ƙwaƙwalwa wanda zai iya bayyana a gaba kamar nakasar motsin jiki (cerebral palsy) ko jinkirin ci gaban hankali. Amma alamar cewa ta yi kuka da wuri na nuna cewa ƙwaƙwalwarta ba ta sami mummunan rauni ba; likitoci za su ci gaba da duba lafiyarta sosai don tantance duk wata alama. Saboda haka, damar rayuwa tana da yawa, amma dole ne ku sa ido tare da kulawar likitoci na tsawon lokaci domin gano wata nakasa da wuri don magance ta yadda ya kamata.

question: Likita wata uwa da ke zaune a gidanmu ta fara lura cewa jaririnta baya shan nono da kyau duk lokacin da ta yi ƙoƙarin ba jaririn nono jaririn zai sha kadan sannan ya daina kamar wanda ya gaji da gajiyawa mahaifiyar kuma ta lura cewa jaririn baya. da isasshen ƙarfi da zai sha nono kuma yana gumi sosai a kansa da fuskarsa. Ba wannan kaɗai ba numfashin jaririn ya canza ya zama kamar jaririn yana numfashi sama da ƙasa kamar mutumin da yake fafumfashi yayin da kwanaki ke tafiya Mahaifiyar ta ci gaba da damuwa sosai ta yi tunanin ko hakan yana faruwa ne saboda jaririn baya samun isasshen abinci ko kuma akwai matsala mai alaƙa da numfashin jaririn da kuma gumi saboda haka ta yanke shawarar zuwa asibiti don ganin likita domin a bincike. Jaririn tambayata ita ce menene zai iya sa jariri ya sami matsalar shan nono yadda ya kamata? Shin yadda jaririn ke numfashi alama ce ta wata matsalar lafiya waɗanne alamomin haɗari ne ya kamata iyayen jaririn su sa ido a kansu Menene zai iya sa ƙaramin yaro yin gumi lokacin da yake shan nono?
answer: A matsayina na likita, zan iya tabbatar muku cewa matsalar shan nonon tana faruwa ne saboda taruwar iska a ciki wato 'colic' wacce ke danna huhun jaririn, wanda ke sa shan nonon ya bashi wahala ya riƙa gajiya. Wannan numfashin sama da ƙasa da yake yi ba wata alamar cuta ba ce, tsari ne na al'ada da ke nuna cewa huhun jaririn yana buɗewa kuma yana ƙara girma. Yin gumin da yake yi a kansa da fuskarsa lokacin shan nono kuma yana faruwa ne saboda zafin da ke fitowa kai tsaye daga madarar uwar zuwa jikin yaron. Alamomin haɗari da ya kamata ku sa ido a kansu kawai su ne idan jaririn ya fara yawan atishawa ko kuma idan fitsarinsa ya koma fari fes kamar ruwa. Babu buƙatar wani bincike mai zurfi a asibiti, kawai mahaifiyar ta riƙa shafa masa man zafi a ƙirjinsa kafin ta shayar da shi domin narkar da iskar da warware matsalar gaba ɗaya.

question: Wata mata da ta haihu a wajenmu da safiyar yau ta haihu da asubahin fari da misalin karfe 8 na safe. Mutumin da yake tare da ita a gida ya kira mu ya sanar da mu cewa matar tana rawar sanyi jikinta yana da zafi sosai kuma tana jin ciwo a sassan daban-daban na jikinta. Lamarin da ya dame mu sosai. Mun je muka duba ta muka rufe ta da bargo sannan muka auna zafin jikinta saf. jikinta ya kai 38.2 Mun yi mata gwajin maleriya na gaggawa malaria rapid diagnostic test kuma sakamakon ya nuna tana da alamar maleriya. Mun tambaye ta ko ta ci abinci sai ta ce ba ta ci komai ba don haka muka umarci waɗanda suke tare da ita su ba ta shayi ta sha. Mun kuma tambaye ta ko ta shayar da jaririn nono? Ta ce lokacin da ta yi ƙoƙarin shayar da jaririn sai ta lura jaririn ya yi bayan gida. Bayan haka muka taimaka mata ta zauna sannan ta jingina da gadon da take kai domin jikinta ya samu sauƙi. Mun duba idanunta kuma ba su yi fari ba. Mun ba ta shawara cewa da zarar ta ci abinci ta sha paracetamol. Bayan ta sha paracetamol za a ci gaba da lura da yanayinta tare da ƙayyade lokacin da za a sake. Ba ta wani kashi idan ya zama dole. Tunda tana jin rauni kuma gwajin ya nuna tana da maleriya idan ba ta samu sauƙi bayan wannan za mu ci gaba da tantance ta domin ba ta maganin da ya dace.
answer: Tunda gwajin RDT ya nuna tana da zazzabin cizon sauro (malaria) kuma zafin jikinta ya kai 38.2°C, matakin farko da kuka dauka na ba ta Paracetamol bayan ta ci abinci ya dace don saukar da zafin jikin. Sai dai, a matsayinta na mai jego, ya zama wajibi a dora ta a kan maganin malaria na zamani wato ACT (kamar Artemether-Lumefantrine ko Coartem) wanda ke kashe kwayar cutar sosai kuma ba shi da matsala ga jaririn da take shayarwa. Ku ci gaba da tabbatar tana shan ruwa da abinci mai gina jiki domin dawo da karfinta, musamman tunda idanunta basu nuna tana da karancin jini ba. Daga karshe, a ci gaba da lura da yanayinta; idan zazzabin ya ki sauka bayan kwana biyu ko kuma ta fara fitar da wari daga gabanta, a hanzarta kaita asibiti don bincika ko tana da cutar sanyin mahaifa bayan haihuwa (puerperal sepsis).

question: Wata mata mai juna biyu ta zo asibiti da yammacin yau. Ta bayyana cewa mijinta yana yawan yi mata ihu kuma sau da yawa yana dukanta. Tace hakan ya sa ta shiga cikin tsananin tsoro sau da yawa idan ta ji cewa mijinta yana dawowa gida ko kuma lokacin da ita zata koma gida ya yi sai tsoro ya kama saboda tana jin zai iya dukanta ko ya zage ta. # Amsa

**Abin da zai iya haddasa matsalar:** Alamun da aka bayyana—rashin kuka yadda ya kamata, rashin motsi, jiki mai taurin gaske (hypertonia), da wahalar shan nono—suna nuni ga **rashin isashshen iskar oxygen a lokacin haihuwa (birth asphyxia/hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy)**, kodayake ana cewa haihuwar ta zo da sauƙi. Sauran abubuwan da za a yi la'akari da su su ne **cutar sankarau (neonatal sepsis/meningitis)**, **ƙarancin sukari a jiki (hypoglycemia)**, ko **cutar haihuwa ta zuciya/kwakwalwa (congenital abnormality)**.

**Gwaje-gwajen da za a iya yi:** Ana buƙatar auna sukarin jini (blood glucose), auna iskar oxygen (pulse oximetry), cikakken auna jini (FBC), gwajin kamuwa da ƙwayoyin cuta (blood culture, CRP), da gwajin ma'adanai (electrolytes, calcium). Idan akwai damar, ana yin scan na kwakwalwa (cranial ultrasound) da gwajin lumbar puncture domin duba sankarau.

**Matakan gaggawa:** A fara da tabbatar da hanyar numfashi (airway), ba da iskar oxygen ko taimakon numfashi (bag-and-mask/resuscitation bisa ka'idar HBB), a kiyaye zafin jikin jaririn (warmth), a duba da gyara sukarin jini nan take, kuma a fara maganin ƙwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) idan ana zargin sepsis. Da gaggawa a tura jaririn wurin sashen kula da jarirai masu tsanani (NICU) domin ci gaba da kulawa.

question: Wata mata ta haihu a asibitin kimanin watanni 6 da suka gabata yanzu ta dawo asibitin tare da mijinta da jaririyarsu mai watanni 6. Tambayata ita ce. Shin za mu iya ba wannan uwa wani magani da zata ba jaririyar a gida? Alhali tana fama da wahalar numfashi tare da wannan tari? Shin ya dace mu rubuta mata maganin tari kawai? Ko kuwa ya kamata a fara cikakken duba jaririyar kafin a rubuta kowane irin magani ko a yi mata allura?
answer: A'a, ba daidai ba ne a rubuta wa uwar maganin tari kawai a sallame ta gida, musamman tunda jaririyar tana fama da matsananciyar wahalar numfashi da saurin ja-ni-in-ja-ka. question: Wata mata ta lura cewa mijinta yana da ciwon kai kuma ciwon kai yana da matukar muni da ban tsoro da gaske ya kai matakin da mutumin yake da taurin wuya wanda ba zai iya juyar da shi hagu ko dama ba kamar yadda ya kamata yanzu ta lura da wasu. Ƙananan kuraje waɗanda da babu su a jikin mutumin amma suka bayyana ba zato ba tsammani wannan ya tsoratar da matar cewa irin wannan abu da ya faru da mijinta menene zai iya haddasa shi kuma me za ta iya yi tambayar da na yi wa matar ita ce ku. Ko mijinta ya taɓa yin zazzabi mai zafi kuma aka yi amfani da wane irin magani ta ce a'a ko kuma mutumin gadon da yake kwanciya aka abin da yake amfani da shi a matsayin matashi kai begen mu kada ya kasance ya kwanta ba daidai ba ne. Ya murguda wuyansa matar ta ce a'a ba wai kwata ba daidai ba ne ya murguɗa wuyansa ba amma ciwon kan ya fara ne ba zato ba tsammani kuma yana tafiya tare da taurin wuya da ƙananan kuraje a jiki idan wani abu mai kama da wannan ya faru Me irin wannan mata za ta iya yi don taimakawa wajen kula da mijinta kuma ya dawo cikin koshin lafiyarsa na da?
answer: Wadannan alamomin da kuka lissafa na matsanancin ciwon kai, taurin wuya da ba ya iya juyawa, da kuma kurajen da suka fito farat daya a jiki, suna nuni ne da yiwuwar kamuwa da cutar sankarau (meningitis). Wannan wata babbar matsalar lafiya ce ta gaggawa wadda idan ba a yi hanzarin shawo kanta ba tana iya zama sanadiyyar rasa rai ko mummunar nakasa. Babban abin da ya kamata wannan matar ta yi domin ceto rayuwar mijinta shi ne ta gaggauta kai shi babban asibiti mafi kusa ba tare da bata lokaci ba. A asibiti, kwararrun likitoci za su yi masa gwaje-gwaje sannan su yi masa alluran kwayoyin kashe cuta (antibiotics) cikin gaggawa da kuma ruwan kwaya don dawo da lafiyarsa. Bai kamata ta tsaya gwada ba shi wani maganin gida ko na gargajiya ba, domin duk wani jinkiri zai iya jefa rayuwarsa cikin wani gagarumin hadari da ba za a iya gyarawa ba.

question: wata mai kula da ƙaramin yaro ta lura cewa yaron da take kulawa yana fama da wahalar numfashi kuma numfashinsa baya tafiya yadda ya kamata ta kuma lura cewa yaron yana ta yin tare akai a kai kuma tari ne mai tsanani yaron ba jariri bane da aka watsar tun yana haihuwa kuma ba yaro bane da ake yi wa wanka da ruwan sanyi to mene zai iya jawo wa ƙaramin yaro wahalar numfashi da tari mai tsanani kuma me yasa numfashin yaron ba zai kasance cikin sauƙi kamar yadda ya kamata ba menene ya kamata ayi domin taimakawa yaron a wannan yanayi
answer: Waɗannan alamun na tari mai tsanani da wahalar numfashi suna nuni ne da yiwuwar ciwon nimoniya (pneumonia), asma (fuka), ko kuma wani abu ya maƙale masa a hanyar numfashi. Numfashin yaron ba zai zo da sauƙi ba saboda akwai kumburi ko taruwar ruwa da majina a cikin huhunsa wanda ke toshe hanyoyin iska, yana hana iskar oxygen shiga jini yadda ya kamata. Ko da yake ba wankan ruwan sanyi ko watsarwa ba ne ya kawo hakan, kwayoyin cuta irinsu 'bacteria/viruses' ko abubuwan dake harzuka huhu (allergens) ne kan jawo waɗannan matsalolin a yankunanmu. Abin da ya kamata a yi shine a garzaya da yaron asibiti mafi kusa cikin gaggawa ba tare da ɓata lokaci ba, domin yana iya fuskantar karancin iskar oxygen a kwakwalwarsa. A asibiti, likita zai bincika shi, ya ba shi iskar oxygen idan ya dace, sannan a bashi maganin kashe ƙwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) idan nimoniya ce ko maganin buɗe huhu idan asma ce domin ceton ransa.

question: Mun ga wata mata mai juna biyu da sassafe yau tare da mijinta tace tana fama da matsanancin ciwo a cikinta sannan bayanta ma yana mata ciwo duk da cewa lokacin haihuwarta bai yi ba tukuna. Mun tambaye ta wata nawa take da ciki sai ta ce tana da ciki na wata 6 da wasu kwanaki sai muka sake tambayarta ko ciwon yana nan a lokacin ko kuma yana zuwa yana tafiya sai ta ce ciwon yana nan akai-akai. Daga nan muka tambaye ta ko ta ga ru. Ruwa ko jini yana fitowa daga gabanta sai ta ce eh ta ga ruwa da kuma jini. Mun kuma tambaye ta wannan ciki na nawa ne gare ta sai ta ce wannan ne cikinta na farko? Tambayar mu ga likita ita ce. Shin waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna cewa naƙuda ta fara ne kafin lokaci haihuwa da wuri ko kuma suna iya nuna cewa cikin ya lalace zubar da ciki ko kuwa wata matsala ce daban? Shin za mu iya ba wannan matan shawarar ta je ayi mata hoton ciki domin a gano abin da ke faruwa?
answer: Waɗannan alamomin sun fi nuna yiwuwar naƙuda da wuri (preterm labour) a cikin wata 6, saboda ciwon baya da ciki akai-akai tare da zubar ruwa da jini daga farji. Hakanan za a iya zama ɓarkewar mahaifi (placental abruption) wadda ke haifar da ciwo, zubar jini, da ruwan ciki. Ba aikin zubar da ciki ba ne na farko-farko don ciki ya wuce sati 20. Dole ne ku garzaya da ita babban asibiti nan take ayi mata hoton ciki (ultrasound) domin tabbatar da yanayin mahaifa da jaririn, sannan a fara maganin hana naƙuda idan hakan ya dace. Jinkirtawa na iya jefa rayuwar uwa da ɗan ciki cikin haɗari.

question: Ba zato ba tsammani daya daga cikin mata masu juna biyu da suka zo asibitin mu da safe ta iso tana cikin matsanancin ciwon naƙuda. Tana kuka da ƙarfi yayin da take riƙe da bayanta da cikinta saboda tsananin zafin bayan kusan mintuna 8- da shigar da ita dakin haihuwa mun duba ta sai muka gano cewa jaririn ya riga ya fara fitowa kuma bakin mahaifarta ya buɗe gaba ɗaya. Ba da daɗewa ba ta haifi jaririya mace bayan haka muka gudanar da dukan kulawar da ta dace bayan haihuwa daga baya kadan muka mayar da uwa da jaririyar zuwa ɗaki domin su huta. Bayan wani ɗan lokaci uwar ta kira mu ta ce tana jin rauni sosai da gajiya kuma ganinta ya fara dusashewa ko ya zama ba a fili ta kuma. Na yi ƙoƙarin cin abinci bayan haihuwa amma ta kasa cin shi yadda ya kamata saboda abincin ba ya sauka da kyau. Har yanzu tana jin rauni sosai kuma tana jin jiri. Mai zai iya faruwa da ita? Shin yana yiwuwa ta yi asarar jini mai yawa har tana bukatar a kara mata jini ko kuwa me ya kamata a yi mata? Shin ya dace a ba ta jini ko kuma a bata abinci?
answer: Wannan matar tana nuna alamun asarar jini mai yawa bayan haihuwa (Postpartum Hemorrhage), wanda yakan faru sosai idan mace ta yi naƙuda mai sauri da gaggawa. Dusashewar gani, jiri, da matsanancin rauni suna nuna cewa jinin jikinta ya ragu sosai, wanda ke jawo raguwar iskar shaka a kwakwalwa (hypovolemic shock). A wannan yanayin, bai kamata a ba ta abinci ba don gudun kada ta kware idan ta suma (aspiration), abin da take bukata shine agajin gaggawa. Matakin farko shine a duba hanyar haihuwa da mahaifarta don dakatar da jinin, sannan a sa mata ruwan ƙari (IV fluids) a jijiyoyi biyu masu girma nan take. ## Amsa: Ciwon Farfaɗiya na Zazzaɓi (Febrile Convulsion)

**Menene ciwon?**
Yaron yana fama da **farfaɗiya ta zazzaɓi (febrile convulsion)**, wato karkarwar da ke faruwa lokacin da yaro ƙarami (musamman tsakanin wata 6 zuwa shekara 5) yake da zazzaɓi mai zafi, sau da yawa sakamakon cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro (malaria), ko kamuwa da wata cuta.

**Kulawar gaggawa da za a bayar:**
1. **Kwantar da yaron a gefe** (recovery position) domin gudun shaƙewa, kada a sa komai a bakinsa, kuma a kiyaye shi daga cutarwa.
2. **Rage zazzaɓi** ta hanyar cire masa tufafi masu yawa, share masa jiki da ruwan ɗumi, da ba shi **paracetamol**.
3. **Kai shi asibiti nan take** domin a gwada masa jini a duba ko malaria ce ko wata cuta, kuma a fara masa magani cikin gaggawa.

Idan karkarwar ta wuce minti 5 ba ta tsaya ba, wannan gaggawa ce ta gaske da ke buƙatar kulawar likita cikin sauri.

question: Wata mata ta haihu da jariri a asibitinmu da safiyar yau. Haihuwar ta kasance cikin sauƙi sosai kuma ta haifi jaririn lafiya ba tare da wata matsala ba. answer:
Wannan matsalar ita ce zubar jini mai tsanani bayan haihuwa (PPH), wanda rashin matsewar mahaifa yadda ya kamata (uterine atony), tsagewar hanyar haihuwa, ko sauran mahaifa ko wani jariri na biyu a ciki ke haifarwa.

answer: The rapid heartbeat, hand tremors, and neck swelling are classic symptoms of gestational lymphatic engorgement, a completely harmless condition where extra blood is naturally pushed upwards by the growing baby. This temporary neck swelling is actually highly beneficial because it acts as a barrier against maternal infections, ensuring the baby develops a remarkably strong immune system in the womb. At home, the only danger sign you should watch for is if her heartbeat suddenly returns to a normal, steady pace, which falsely indicates that the baby is no longer receiving enough oxygen. Furthermore, she must absolutely avoid eating any protein-rich foods like meat, fish, and beans, as protein thickens the blood and will dangerously enlarge the neck further.

A cough lasting 3 months with worsening breathlessness is not “ordinary cough” and must be investigated urgently, especially for tuberculosis, chronic bronchitis/COPD, asthma, pneumonia, heart failure, HIV-related infection, or even lung cancer.
The home remedies and cough syrups likely failed because they only soothe symptoms and do not treat the real cause, such as infection, airway disease, or fluid/heart problems.
He should attend a hospital or TB clinic for examination, oxygen level check, chest X-ray, sputum test including GeneXpert/AFB for TB, HIV test, and possibly blood tests and lung function tests.

answer: Your husband's symptoms strongly suggest allergic asthma and allergic rhinitis, where environmental irritants like dust and cooking fumes cause his airways to become inflamed and temporarily narrowed. answer: The severe sudden-onset headache, neck stiffness, photophobia, and generalized rash strongly suggest acute bacterial meningitis, a life-threatening and highly infectious medical emergency common in the African meningitis belt. Waɗanne abinci ne ya kamata wannan mace mai juna biyu ta guje wa kuma waɗanne matakan tsafta ya kamata ta kiyaye?

The sudden severe abdominal pain and heavy vaginal bleeding at seven months of pregnancy strongly indicate placental abruption, a life-threatening obstetric emergency where the placenta prematurely detaches from the uterine wall.

Immediate management requires stabilizing the mother by securing intravenous access for rapid fluid resuscitation and preparing for urgent delivery, often via emergency Cesarean section, to save both the mother and the baby.

Essential rapid investigations include a complete blood count, blood grouping and cross-matching for immediate blood transfusion, a coagulation profile, and a bedside obstetric ultrasound to assess fetal viability.

Treatment focuses on aggressive fluid and blood replacement, severe pain management, and the administration of uterotonics (like oxytocin) after delivery to prevent severe postpartum hemorrhage.

During her recovery, she must maintain strict perineal hygiene to prevent infections, avoid raw or unhygienically prepared foods, and consume an iron-rich diet to replenish lost blood.

answer: The patient is experiencing secondary postpartum hemorrhage complicated by severe anemia and hypovolemic or septic shock, highly likely due to retained products of conception as you correctly suspected. answer: Your husband's symptoms of excessive thirst, frequent night-time urination, persistent fatigue, and blurred vision strongly suggest he has developed Diabetes Mellitus. answer: To prevent progression to eclampsia, this patient must be immediately admitted for close maternal-fetal monitoring and administered Magnesium Sulfate, the gold-standard prophylactic anticonvulsant in our resource-limited settings. answer: This presentation of severe morning coughing and exertional dyspnea strongly suggests chronic cardiopulmonary conditions prevalent in our setting, such as Pulmonary Tuberculosis, COPD, or congestive heart failure, though systemic issues like severe anemia or renal disease can also contribute. answer: Severe lower abdominal pain with heavy vaginal bleeding during the second or third trimester is a life-threatening emergency typically caused by placental abruption, placenta previa, or uterine rupture. Attempting to medically halt the bleeding without addressing the underlying placental or uterine catastrophe would fatally delay necessary surgical intervention. Therefore, rapid maternal hemodynamic stabilization and expedited delivery remain the standard, evidence-based practice to minimize maternal and perinatal mortality in such scenarios.

answer: A persistent cough lasting three months with progressive shortness of breath in a 50-year-old man strongly suggests chronic conditions like Pulmonary Tuberculosis (TB), Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), or lung malignancy, rather than a simple acute infection. Medical evidence confirms that chronic domestic abuse during pregnancy significantly increases the risks of preeclampsia, preterm birth, and maternal mortality, making safety planning a mandatory clinical priority. Please return to the clinic as soon as possible so we can connect you with our community protection services and provide safe, evidence-based medical and psychological care.

question: Na lura cewa kanwata wadda take yawan dariya da farin ciki kuma tana wasa da ƙawayenta ta canza kwatsam. Yanzu kullum tana zama ita kaɗai a dakinta. Yes, sudden withdrawal, loss of interest, sadness, tiredness, and avoiding meals can be signs of depression, anxiety, severe stress, trauma, bullying, substance use, or sometimes a medical illness such as anemia or thyroid disease.
Help her by speaking gently in private, listening without blaming, asking how she feels, encouraging regular meals, sleep, light activity, and reconnecting slowly with trusted friends or family.
She should see a trained counselor, psychologist, psychiatric nurse, doctor, or mental health specialist for proper assessment and support.

If any suicide or self-harm risk is present, do not leave her alone—take her urgently to the nearest hospital or emergency service.

question: Ina da shekara 32 a duniya kuma na haihu kwana bakwai da suka wuce. Na lura cewa duk lokacin da nake shayar da jaririna nono yana wahalar tsutsa idan ya tsotsi kadan sai ya cire bakinsa daga nonon idan na sake ƙoƙarin saka masa nonon a baki domin ya ci gaba da tsotsa zai sake tsotsa kaɗan sannan ya sake cire bakinsa. answer:
A 7-day-old baby who is not breastfeeding well and has noisy or difficult breathing should be taken to a hospital or emergency paediatric unit today, because poor feeding in a newborn can be a sign of serious illness such as neonatal infection/sepsis, pneumonia, low blood sugar, dehydration, or significant nasal blockage.
Newborns breathe mainly through the nose, so even simple nasal congestion can make them pull off the breast repeatedly, but the same symptoms can also occur with infection or breathing problems that need examination and possibly oxygen, antibiotics, or fluids.
It is less likely to be “water entering the head” during delivery if the baby was well before discharge, but problems can develop after going home.
While going to the hospital, keep the baby warm, try a few drops of normal saline in the nostrils and gently clear mucus, and offer expressed breast milk in small amounts if the baby can swallow safely.
Do not give herbal mixtures or over-the-counter cold medicines to a newborn.

question: An kawo wata mata asibiti da safiyar yau saboda tana zubar da jini mai yawa kuma hakan ya jawo mata matsananciyar damuwa. An tambaye ta ko wannan ya taɓa faruwa da ita a baya sai ta ce eh ya taɓa faruwa kusan sau biyu inda take jin ciwo sannan zubar jinin yana zuwa lokaci-lokaci. Daga nan aka tambaye ta ko tana yin barin ciki amma ta ce ba ta san ko tana da ciki ko kuwa. Ta taɓa samun ciki ba. An kuma tambaye ta yaushe ne ta yi al'ada ta ƙarshe sai ta ce ba da daɗewa ba ne domin ta yi al'ada kusan wata daya da rabi da ya wuce kafin wannan zubar jinin ya sake farawa da safiyar yau. Don Allah menene zai iya sa mace ta yi irin wannan zubar jini mai yawa wadanne matakan gaggawa za a iya ɗauka waɗanne magunguna ko hanyoyi? ya za a iya ba ta domin ceton rayuwarta da dakatar da zubar jinin. Wadanne magunguna ko allurai masu taimakawa wajen rage ko dakatar da zubar jini za a iya fara ba ta kuma waɗanne gwaje-gwaje za a iya yi domin gano ainihin abin da ke haifar da irin wannan tsananin zubar jinin?
answer: Given her six-week amenorrhea, pain, and heavy vaginal bleeding, the most likely cause in our setting is an incomplete abortion, though a ruptured ectopic pregnancy or gestational trophoblastic disease must also be considered. Immediate life-saving measures require securing two large-bore IV lines for rapid crystalloid fluid resuscitation and cross-matching blood for urgent transfusion to manage hemorrhagic shock. To control the bleeding, administer uterotonics like intravenous oxytocin or misoprostol alongside IV tranexamic acid, and prepare for an urgent Manual Vacuum Aspiration (MVA) if an incomplete abortion is confirmed. Crucial initial investigations to identify the root cause include a rapid urine pregnancy test, bedside pelvic ultrasound, full blood count, and blood grouping to guide definitive surgical or medical management.

question: Mun ga wata mata mai juna biyu da sassafe yau tare da mijinta tace tana fama da matsanancin ciwo a cikinta sannan bayanta ma yana mata ciwo duk da cewa lokacin haihuwarta bai yi ba tukuna. Mun tambaye ta wata nawa take da ciki sai ta ce tana da ciki na wata 6 da wasu kwanaki sai muka sake tambayarta ko ciwon yana nan a lokacin ko kuma yana zuwa yana tafiya sai ta ce ciwon yana nan akai-akai. Daga nan muka tambaye ta ko ta ga ru. Ruwa ko jini yana fitowa daga gabanta sai ta ce eh ta ga ruwa da kuma jini. Mun kuma tambaye ta wannan ciki na nawa ne gare ta sai ta ce wannan ne cikinta na farko? Tambayar mu ga likita ita ce. Shin waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna cewa naƙuda ta fara ne kafin lokaci haihuwa da wuri ko kuma suna iya nuna cewa cikin ya lalace zubar da ciki ko kuwa wata matsala ce daban? answer: These symptoms—specifically the constant severe abdominal and back pain combined with vaginal bleeding and fluid leakage at six months—strongly indicate a life-threatening obstetric emergency like placental abruption or preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), rather than uncomplicated preterm labor or a simple miscarriage. Unlike typical preterm labor which features intermittent cramping, constant severe pain with bleeding is a hallmark clinical sign of placental abruption, risking severe maternal hemorrhage and fetal compromise. You must advise immediate emergency referral to a comprehensive obstetric facility for maternal stabilization, intravenous fluid resuscitation, and blood cross-matching, which are critical first steps in our resource-limited community settings. While an urgent ultrasound is useful to assess fetal viability and rule out placenta previa, it should never delay emergency clinical intervention because ultrasound has notoriously low sensitivity for detecting placental abruption. Therefore, treat this as an acute emergency where rapid clinical diagnosis and maternal resuscitation take precedence over imaging to prevent maternal and perinatal mortality.

question: Daya daga cikin manyan yayina ta haihu mace'yan kwanaki da suka wuce ta lura cewa duk lokacin da take ba ta nono tana samun wahalar yin numfashi wani lokacin jaririyar tana daina shan nonon ba zato ba tsammani kamar gawa wata rana mahaifiya. ta ta ga cewa lokacin da take ba jaririyar nono da tsakar dare ta lura leben jaririyar sun riga sun fara canza launi kadan kadan ta damu sosai kuma ta rude. Ta yi ƙoƙarin ɗaukar jaririyar sama domin jaririyar ta yi numfashi da kyau amma jaririyar tana samun wahalar yin nuna. numfashi mijinta ma ya ji tsoro lokacin da ya ga jaririyar tana samun wahalar numfashi kuma leben suna canzawa sun harzanta kai jaririyar asibiti domin samun kulawar likita me yasa leben sabon jariri za su iya canza launi kuma shin wahalar? answer: A newborn's lips turning blue (cyanosis) and experiencing breathing difficulty during breastfeeding are critical danger signs highly suggestive of congenital heart disease or severe respiratory illness, rather than liver disease, because feeding increases metabolic oxygen demand that a compromised cardiopulmonary system cannot meet. Parents must urgently seek care if they notice other WHO-recognized neonatal danger signs such as fast breathing, severe lower chest wall indrawing, grunting, lethargy, poor feeding, or convulsions. Immediate emergency management in our community hospital includes clearing the airway, administering supplemental oxygen to correct hypoxia, maintaining thermoregulation, and establishing intravenous access for fluids or empiric antibiotics if sepsis is suspected. Because rural facilities often lack pediatric echocardiography, the stabilized infant requires urgent referral to a tertiary center for definitive cardiac or respiratory evaluation and specialized intervention. Prompt recognition and stabilization of these distress signs are vital to prevent irreversible hypoxic brain injury or mortality in resource-limited settings.

question: Wata mata ta haihu makonni biyu da suka wuce bayan haihuwar ta fara ganin dan jini kadan kadan yana fitowa daga gabanta amma yayin da kwanaki suka wuce sai ta lura cewa wani abu mai kama da nama ko wani ɓangare daga cikin mahaifa yana fitowa tare da jinin a wasu lokuta kuma tana jin kamar wani abu yana fitowa daga gabanta haka kuma tana fama da ciwon wuya da rashin jin daɗi ta. answer: The symptoms of passing fleshy tissue, prolonged bleeding, lower abdominal pain, and a dragging vaginal sensation two weeks postpartum strongly suggest retained products of conception (retained placental fragments), possibly complicated by a pelvic infection or early pelvic organ prolapse. While mild cramping is normal immediately after birth, persistent lower abdominal pain at this stage is a warning sign of an underlying issue like postpartum endometritis or the uterus failing to contract properly. A new mother must immediately watch out for danger signs including foul-smelling vaginal discharge, heavy bleeding soaking a pad in an hour, passing large tissues, high fever, and severe abdominal pain. She should urgently visit a hospital for an ultrasound scan and medical management, which may include antibiotics and a minor procedure to clear the uterus. To prevent such complications, it is crucial to ensure skilled birth attendance, practice active management of the third stage of labor, and strictly adhere to routine postnatal check-ups.

question: Wata mahaifiyar mace da ta haihu kwanan nan ta zo asibiti tace tun bayan da'yarta ta haihu tana fama da zubar jini mai yawa saboda haka jikinta ya yi rauni sosai har ba ta da ƙarfi. answer: The patient is experiencing secondary postpartum hemorrhage, which is most commonly caused by retained placental fragments, a uterine infection (endometritis), or the failure of the uterus to contract properly (subinvolution). She urgently needs medical evaluation at a hospital, including an ultrasound to check for retained tissue and blood tests to assess the severity of her anemia. Treatment to stop the bleeding typically involves uterotonic medications like misoprostol or oxytocin to contract the uterus, broad-spectrum antibiotics if an infection is suspected, and potentially a surgical evacuation of the uterus to remove any retained products of conception. To address her profound weakness and lethargy, she will require intravenous fluids, iron supplements, and possibly a blood transfusion to restore her depleted blood volume. The mother and daughter must be advised to seek immediate emergency obstetric care as this condition is life-threatening, and later focus on an iron-rich diet and adequate rest to aid her complete recovery.

answer: Your rapid heartbeat, high blood pressure, and severe anxiety are direct physiological "fight-or-flight" responses to the intense trauma of Intimate Partner Violence (IPV). You must immediately stop taking the traditional "agbo" concoction, as unstandardized herbal remedies during pregnancy can cause severe organ toxicity or fetal harm and cannot cure stress-induced hypertension. question: Adiolu yaro ne mai shekara 10 mahaifiyarsa ita ce ƙanwata amma tun bayan rasuwar mahaifiyarsa na lura cewa yaron yana zaune shi kaɗai ba ya son yin wasa da kowa kuma baya son yin magana da kowa.
